title: Administrador de redes
description:
About the job

FITAL XYZ busca un Trafficker Digital para tomar el control total de nuestra pauta en Meta Ads y TikTok Ads. El objetivo del puesto es uno solo y es medible: generar leads calificados a un costo por cita agendada rentable.




No buscamos a alguien que publique contenido. Buscamos a quien administre presupuesto, lea datos y tome decisiones.




Responsabilidades

• Planear, configurar y optimizar campañas de generación de leads en Meta Ads y TikTok Ads.

• Administrar el presupuesto diario y reasignarlo según el costo por lead y por cita agendada.

• Configurar y mantener la infraestructura de medición: Business Manager, Business Center, píxeles, Conversions API y Events API.

• Construir y mantener la conexión entre las plataformas y el CRM, y devolver las señales de calidad de lead para optimizar por cierre y no solo por volumen.

• Diseñar y probar formularios instantáneos, ángulos creativos y ganchos, sosteniendo una cadencia de 8 a 12 creativos nuevos al mes.

• Escribir guiones y briefs creativos para video vertical nativo.

• Entregar un reporte semanal con gasto, CPL, citas agendadas y costo por cita, junto con las decisiones que se derivan de esos números.

• Trabajar de la mano con el equipo comercial para verificar la calidad real de los leads.




Requisitos

• Mínimo 2 años administrando presupuesto propio en Meta Ads y al menos 1 año en TikTok Ads.

• Experiencia comprobable en campañas de generación de leads, no únicamente en e-commerce o alcance.

• Dominio de Meta Business Manager y TikTok Business Center a nivel administrador.

• Conocimiento práctico de píxel, Conversions API, eventos, UTMs y atribución.

• Capacidad de leer un reporte y explicar por qué subió el CPL: CPM, CTR o tasa de envío de formulario.

• Manejo de al menos un CRM y de herramientas de automatización.

• Criterio creativo: saber qué hace que un video funcione en TikTok y qué no.

• Disponibilidad para trabajo presencial en Azcapotzalco, Ciudad de México.




Deseable

• Experiencia en negocios de servicios con venta por llamada o cita.

• Edición básica de video vertical.

• Manejo de Looker Studio u hojas de cálculo avanzadas para reportería.

• Experiencia con Google Ads.




Ofrecemos

• Sueldo mensual: [definir rango].

• [Esquema de bonos por resultados, si aplica].

• [Prestaciones].

• Presupuesto de pauta real que administrar desde el primer mes.

• Autonomía sobre la estrategia y acceso directo a dirección, sin capas intermedias.




Proceso de selección

Al postular, incluye en tu mensaje tres datos: 1) el presupuesto mensual más alto que hayas administrado, 2) tu CPL promedio y en qué industria lo lograste, y 3) qué harías en tus primeros 30 días con una cuenta nueva. Las postulaciones que no incluyan esta información no avanzan.

description:
About the job

Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead
About Flowerburst

We are the fastest growing and most disruptive business in publishing since Amazon. 




Flowerburst starts movements — ideas that burst into life radiantly. Publishing is broken: more than 80 percent of Americans feel they have a book in them, and only about 1 percent ever publish it. After taking 2-3 years to go to market, nine out of ten traditionally published titles fail to turn a profit. Why? There are three middle men between the author and end customer, and there simply isn’t enough margin for any party to invest in marketing. 




Success on self-publishing platforms like Amazon KDP is even more elusive – they leave authors marketing blind and without cashflow: Amazon KDP doesn't show authors who their customers are and where they came from, and pay 60+ days after a sale is made. The result is centuries of gatekeeping in which the best ideas rarely reach the people who need them, dying on shelves in the back of bookstores, undiscovered. We are building the company that fixes this: an AI publishing platform fused with social, direct-to-consumer commerce. The AI platform allows anyone, anywhere to compile their idea in book form - helping the author exactly where they need it. Social commerce allows authors to place books in the heart of culture – social media feeds – to get discovered, even by audiences who typically don’t read books. Anyone, anywhere can write a book and get it to the masses. The end goal is a literary revolution.




The flywheel is already turning and validation has been immediate. In under 12 months since prototype launch, we’ve grown to $7.5M ARR (GMV run rate), and we are one of the top book sellers on social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop; we operate our own publishing imprints, and a creator/affiliate program of hundreds of active creators. Over the next quarter, we’re releasing our own titles (we publish at the speed of movements, not years), and within the next year, we’re opening up our platform so any author – regardless of station in life – can put their idea on paper and bring it to people who are eager to hear it.




The team is scrappy, ambitious, fast-moving, and highly entrepreneurial.




About the Role

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale one of the most important parts of Flowerburst’s growth engine: our TikTok Shop affiliate and VIP Special Ops creator program.




This is not ordinary affiliate management.




Flowerburst has access to a large catalog of top-selling books and uses performance data to identify products with viral TikTok Shop potential before the broader market fully catches on. When we find those products, we bring them to selected creators with a compelling offer: higher commissions, product insights, performance analysis, content hooks, sample support, GMV Max support, and a real partnership designed to help them grow their GMV.




The goal is to help creators win. When creators consistently post around the right products, the upside can be substantial for both the creator and Flowerburst.




You will manage relationships with top TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators, convert them into active VIP partners, and help them produce more videos that sell books. You will be responsible for turning creator interest into posting commitments, repeat content, GMV growth, and long-term creator partnerships.




This is a creator-facing growth role for someone who is organized, persuasive, commercially minded, and excited to help build a repeatable creator revenue engine.




What You’ll Do

You will manage Flowerburst’s VIP creator pipeline from outreach to activation.




This includes identifying promising creators, sending personalized outreach, following up, tracking next steps, coordinating samples, sharing product briefs, asking for posting commitments, monitoring creator activity, and reporting what is working.




You will help build creator launch pods around new book releases and high-potential VIP products. For each campaign, you will help match the right creators with the right products, share content angles, track sample delivery and first posts, and encourage creators to post multiple videos rather than just one.




You will build relationships with creators so they see Flowerburst as one of their best affiliate partners. You will give them useful product insights, help them understand why certain books may resonate with their audiences, and make them feel like part of an insider program.




You will also help build the operating system behind the program: clean tracking, weekly reporting, repeatable follow-up workflows, creator briefs, and simple SOPs.




Responsibilities
Manage a pipeline of TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators
Invite high-potential creators into Flowerburst’s VIP Special Ops Program
Send warm, persuasive, personalized outreach and follow-up messages
Clearly explain the creator opportunity and why selected products may help creators grow GMV
Track creator status, next steps, samples, posting commitments, and performance
Coordinate with internal operations on creator samples
Help creators understand which books to post and what angles may work
Build and manage creator launch pods for new book releases and VIP products
Ask creators for specific posting commitments
Track first post date, number of videos posted, repeat posting, and GMV
Re-engage creators who have sampled from Flowerburst in the past
Report weekly on creator pipeline, activity, and performance
Identify which creators, products, and content angles deserve more investment
Improve outreach, follow-up, campaign briefs, and creator management workflows




What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will learn Flowerburst’s products, creator program, and TikTok Shop affiliate workflow. You will understand the VIP Special Ops pitch deeply enough to explain it clearly to creators. You will clean up the creator tracker, follow up with warm creator leads, make sure every creator has a clear status and next action, help launch active creator pods, and establish weekly reporting.




You will also build a repeatable workflow for creator outreach, onboarding, follow-up, and campaign management. You will increase the number of VIP creators actively posting, track sample-to-post and post-to-GMV performance, help creators post multiple videos per campaign, own creator follow-up with minimal founder involvement, and create reusable creator briefs and campaign templates.




In your first 60 days, you will own the VIP creator program day-to-day, manage multiple creator launch pods, improve creator activation and repeat posting rates, and give leadership clear reporting on what is working.




In your first 90 days, you will help turn Flowerburst’s creator program into a predictable launch channel for new books and high-potential VIP products.




You Might Be a Fit If
You write excellent English
You communicate in a tone that is warm, casual, direct, and professional
You are highly organized and detail-oriented
You follow up consistently without needing reminders
You are comfortable managing many conversations at once
You have experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, account management, sales development, customer success, ecommerce, or partnerships
You are comfortable using spreadsheets, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, or similar tools
You can work independently and take ownership
You are comfortable asking people for commitments and following up when they do not deliver
You can understand performance data and translate it into simple, compelling creator-facing communication
You are interested in TikTok, creators, social commerce, books, media, or ecommerce




Bonus Points
Experience with TikTok Shop
Experience with influencer or affiliate programs
Experience working with U.S.-based creators
Experience in ecommerce or social commerce
Experience managing launch campaigns
Experience creating creator briefs or campaign briefs
Familiarity with BookTok, publishing, books, or media
Experience in a fast-moving startup environment
Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, affiliate platforms, or creator CRM tools




Location and Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

We are equally interested in candidates based in South Africa, LATAM, and the Philippines.

You must be able to communicate with U.S.-based TikTok creators and affiliates during meaningful U.S. business-hour overlap, especially Eastern and Pacific afternoons.




Compensation

Expected base compensation:

$2,500–$3,500/month USD
Up to $4,000/month USD for an exceptional candidate




There is also significant performance bonus potential for measurable GMV growth.




This role has meaningful upside for the right person. If you help Flowerburst activate strong creators, increase repeat posting, and materially grow GMV from managed creator relationships, we want you to share in that success.




The bonus structure will be finalized after baseline performance and attribution are clear, but it will be tied to outcomes such as creator activation, videos posted, repeat posting, and incremental GMV from managed creators.




What We’re Looking For

We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.




We are looking for someone who feels like a high-performing account manager, creator partnerships operator, or affiliate growth manager. You should be proactive, commercially minded, organized, and excellent in written communication.




The goal is not just to send messages. The goal is to turn creator relationships into videos, repeat posting, GMV, and long-term creator partnerships.




The right person should be excited about the opportunity Flowerburst can offer creators. We are bringing creators data-backed product opportunities, improved economics, performance support, and a real chance to grow their GMV.

title: Fleet Acquisition Supervisor
description:
About the job

En PartRunner conectamos a las empresas que mueven mercancía de gran volumen con la capacidad de transporte que lo hace posible. Nuestra red integra flotas PyME y transportistas independientes en distintos puntos de México, con unidades que van desde vehículos ligeros hasta carga pesada.




Hoy el reto es construir capacidad instalada en los mercados correctos, con un equipo que replique el método en varias plazas al mismo tiempo.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Supervisor que construya la capacidad de transporte para una de nuestras cuentas de mayor volumen: una operación de e-commerce a escala nacional, con estándares de servicio altos y crecimiento sostenido.

Vas a dirigir a un equipo de negociadores regionales, cerrar las cuentas de mayor peso y construir la capacidad antes de que la demanda la pida.




El desafío

Este no es un rol de gestión de proveedores ni de administración de equipo a distancia. Es comercial, con responsabilidad sobre la capacidad de toda la red.

Del otro lado hay una cuenta que no espera. Cuando la demanda sube, la capacidad tiene que estar. Tu trabajo es que el equipo la construya con anticipación, no con urgencia, y que lo que funciona en una plaza se vuelva método replicable en las demás.




Lo que harás

1. Liderazgo y Desarrollo del Equipo Comercial

Supervisar, coordinar y desarrollar al equipo de negociadores regionales.

Asignar territorios, metas y prioridades según el déficit de capacidad de cada mercado.

Realizar sesiones semanales de pipeline review: avance por etapa, calidad de prospección y riesgos de cierre.

Detectar brechas de desempeño e implementar planes de desarrollo con objetivos observables.

Ser el primer nivel de escalación en negociaciones complejas o condiciones fuera de estándar.




2. Estrategia de Cobertura y Crecimiento de Red

Traducir la demanda proyectada de la cuenta en objetivos concretos de adquisición: cuántas unidades, de qué tipo, en qué ciudad y para cuándo.

Anticipar picos estacionales y campañas, asegurando capacidad disponible antes de que se necesite.

Priorizar plazas y segmentos de flota según el déficit real de capacidad, no según facilidad de cierre.

Diseñar y estandarizar el método de prospección para que sea replicable por cualquier integrante del equipo.

Abrir nuevos canales de captación y medir su rendimiento contra los existentes.




3. Ejecución Comercial Directa

Gestionar personalmente la negociación con flotas de alto volumen y contrapartes estratégicas.

Mantener cuota individual en las cuentas de mayor impacto para el negocio.

Acompañar a los negociadores en cierres críticos y en campo cuando el tamaño de la operación lo amerite.




4. Economics de la Red

Negociar y sostener condiciones que equilibren competitividad para el transportista y rentabilidad para PartRunner.

Monitorear el costo de adquisición por unidad activa y el tiempo entre cierre y primer viaje.

Identificar en qué plazas se está pagando de más por capacidad y proponer ajustes.




5. Enfoque Analítico y Digital

Monitorear indicadores de adquisición, activación y retención por plaza, tipo de unidad y canal.

Detectar patrones de churn de transportistas antes de que impacten la capacidad disponible.

Identificar tareas manuales del proceso de afiliación y traducirlas en requerimientos accionables para producto y sistemas.

Asegurar la disciplina de registro en CRM del equipo completo: sin dato, la etapa no existe.




6. Reporteo y Mejora Continua

Generar y presentar reportes semanales y mensuales por mercado con KPIs clave: unidades afiliadas · % activación · tiempo a primer viaje · costo de adquisición · % retención a 90 días.

Reportar el estado de capacidad frente a los compromisos de servicio de la cuenta, con alertas tempranas cuando un mercado vaya corto.

Presentar hallazgos e iniciativas a dirección de forma clara y basada en datos.

Realizar análisis post-mortem de plazas que no alcanzaron objetivo y proponer correcciones concretas.




Lo que necesitamos de ti

Must Have

3+ años de experiencia en adquisición, ventas o desarrollo de proveedores.

3+ años en transporte, logística, paquetería o marketplaces digitales.

1+ año liderando equipos comerciales, con responsabilidad sobre la meta del equipo y no solo la propia.

Experiencia negociando con flotas o transportistas de alto volumen.

Manejo de CRM y disciplina de gestión de pipeline, propia y de equipo.

Dominio intermedio-avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets y experiencia elaborando reportes ejecutivos.

Residir en Guadalajara o zona metropolitana.

Disponibilidad para viaje foráneo eventual a las plazas del equipo.




Nice to Have

Experiencia abriendo plazas o mercados nuevos desde cero.

Experiencia previa en startups o entornos de alto crecimiento.

Experiencia en prospección digital de fletes.

Manejo de herramientas de BI (Power BI, Looker, Google Data Studio).




Competencias Clave

Tomas decisiones rápidas con criterio y datos.

Alto nivel de seguimiento y cierre: no dejas hilos sueltos, ni tuyos ni del equipo.

Te autogestionas: en remoto y sin supervisión presencial, sostienes tu ritmo y el de tu equipo.

Curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA, y las usas para hacer más con menos.




Nuestra oferta de valor

Sueldo base competitivo + esquema de bonos por desempeño + prestaciones de ley y superiores + esquema 100% remoto. 




¿Listo/a para el reto?

Envía tu CV a f.castillo@partrunner.com o postúlate directamente por este medio.







En PartRunner promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de nuestros procesos se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra condición.

About the job

En PartRunner conectamos a las empresas que mueven mercancía de gran volumen con la capacidad de transporte que lo hace posible. Nuestra red integra flotas PyME y transportistas independientes en distintos puntos de México, con unidades que van desde vehículos ligeros hasta carga pesada.




Para seguir creciendo necesitamos algo fundamental: más capacidad en los mercados correctos. Hoy esos mercados son León-Querétaro, Puebla y Monterrey.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Specialist que viva en alguna de estas plazas y expanda nuestra red de transportistas desde ahí. Identificarás flotas y hombres-camión, negociarás condiciones y cerrarás afiliaciones, hasta lograr que cada unidad pase de ser una oportunidad comercial a capacidad activa dentro de PartRunner.




Es un rol 100% remoto y con ownership end to end. Construyes tu propio pipeline, lo trabajas y respondes por él hasta que las unidades están rodando.




Lo que harás

1. Prospección y Generación de Pipeline

Prospectar y reclutar hombres-camión y flotas PyME en distintos estados de México.

Ejecutar estrategias de prospección digital enfocadas en fletes: redes sociales, bases de datos, campañas y marketplaces del sector.

Construir y mantener tu propio pipeline en CRM, con seguimiento disciplinado por etapa.

Identificar y abrir nuevas fuentes de captación, no solo trabajar las existentes.




2. Negociación y Cierre de Afiliaciones

Negociar condiciones comerciales con transportistas y flotas, equilibrando competitividad y rentabilidad para el negocio.

Cerrar afiliaciones y asegurar la firma de las condiciones acordadas.

Gestionar objeciones de fondo: tarifas, tiempos de pago, garantías, volumen comprometido.

Trabajo en campo cuando acelere cierres estratégicos.




3. Activación y Onboarding de Unidades

Dar seguimiento puntual al proceso de onboarding dentro de la plataforma hasta la activación real de cada unidad.

Asegurar que la documentación y los requisitos de alta estén completos y en tiempo.

Reducir el tiempo entre cierre y primer viaje.




4. Relación con Transportistas y Retención

Mantener comunicación constante con proveedores vía WhatsApp, llamadas, correo y reuniones presenciales.

Detectar señales tempranas de churn y actuar antes de perder la unidad.

Ser el punto de contacto comercial de las flotas que traes a la red.

Levantar hacia el equipo interno lo que la red necesita para quedarse.




5. Enfoque Analítico y Estrategia de Crecimiento

Cumplir KPIs comerciales semanales y mensuales de adquisición, activación y retención.

Analizar métricas de desempeño para optimizar tasas de conversión y retención por estado, tipo de unidad y canal de captación.

Desarrollar estrategias para ampliar la red en mercados con déficit de capacidad.

Coordinar con Marketing para impulsar campañas de captación y aportar el input de campo que las haga funcionar.




Lo que necesitamos de ti

Must Have

2+ años de experiencia en adquisición, onboarding o ventas.

2+ años en industria de transporte, logística, paquetería o marketplaces digitales.

Experiencia comprobable en ventas y negociación, con números que la respalden.

Manejo de CRM y seguimiento estructurado de pipeline comercial.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y cierre.




Nice to Have

Experiencia en prospección digital de fletes.

Experiencia previa en startups.

Experiencia en trabajo de campo con transportistas.




Competencias Clave

Tienes pensamiento crítico: cuestionas el proceso cuando no está siendo funcional y propones mejoras.

Organización y capacidad de multitarea real, con varias negociaciones abiertas a la vez.

Curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA, y las usas para hacer más con menos.




Nuestra oferta de valor

Sueldo base competitivo + prestaciones de ley y superiores + esquema 100% remoto




¿Listo/a para el reto?

Envía tu CV a f.castillo@partrunner.com o postúlate directamente por este medio.




En PartRunner promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de nuestros procesos se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra condición.

description:
About the job

Reports to: Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director

Location: Mexico City

Type: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years







ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is one of Mexico’s fastest-growing beauty brands, born at the intersection of beauty, culture, entertainment and community.




Founded by Anna Sarelly and Rémi Martini, SARELLY is building a new generation of beauty brand: culturally relevant, social-first and deeply connected to its community.

After becoming one of Mexico’s most exciting emerging beauty players, the brand is now entering its next chapter of growth, with major retail expansion across Mexico and the U.S.

Creativity is at the heart of everything we do—from product and packaging to campaigns, social content, retail experiences and entertainment. We are looking for someone who wants to help shape and protect a distinctive creative universe as SARELLY scales.







THE ROLE

SARELLY is looking for an Associate Art Director to ensure Anna Sarelly’s creative vision is consistently and flawlessly executed across every brand touchpoint. Reporting directly to Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director, this person will work closely with her and with our Marketing and Creative teams, acting as the bridge between big-picture creative direction and day-to-day execution—translating campaign ideas into cohesive visual systems, guiding multidisciplinary teams, leading art direction, and ensuring everything we put into the world feels unmistakably SARELLY.




This is not a purely managerial role. We are looking for someone who can think, direct and make.

Someone with exceptional visual taste who can lead a shoot, ensure the vision is executed properly across different touchpoints, build moodboards, challenge layouts, guide designers, give meaningful feedback on social content, and step into execution when needed.

Most importantly, this role serves as the primary creative filter between Anna and the execution teams—protecting her time by determining what requires her input versus what can be independently resolved within established creative and brand standards.

Ultimately, your job is simple: Protect the creative vision from concept to execution.







WHAT YOU’LL DO

01 — Translate Creative Vision

Work directly with Anna to transform high-level campaign ideas, cultural insights and creative concepts into actionable visual direction.

You will help define and maintain consistency across:

Campaign visual systems
Art direction
Content pillars
Social expressions
Photography and video execution
Retail adaptations
Graphic design systems
Social media assets
Launch moments
Digital assets
Creator executions

You should be able to take a big idea and understand how it lives across an entire brand ecosystem—ensuring it remains visually coherent at every touchpoint.







02 — Lead Creative Execution

Own the execution of creative projects from briefing through final delivery.

Translate creative direction into clear, precise briefs for designers, photographers, videographers, editors, content creators, agencies, freelancers and brand creative production partners.

Ensure teams understand not only what they need to create, but why it matters to the overall vision.

Coordinate execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining consistency, quality and delivery timelines.







03 — Art Direct

Lead and support art direction across all brand outputs, including:

Campaign shoots
Social content shoots
Product photography
Video content
E-commerce visuals
Creator content
Brand activations
Retail experiences

You should feel comfortable making decisions around composition, lighting, styling, casting, props, sets, typography, motion and visual storytelling.

You will sometimes co-lead major campaigns with Anna and other times independently lead executions while maintaining full alignment with her vision.







04 — Own Creative Quality Control

Act as a guardian of the SARELLY visual universe.

Review creative output across teams and provide clear, actionable feedback before work reaches Anna.

This includes:

Social content
Reels / TikToks
Photography
Video edits
Graphic design
Campaign adaptations
Retail assets
Creator content
Digital assets
Brand presentations

Your responsibility is not simply to ask:

“Does this look good?”

It is to ask:

“Does this feel like SARELLY—and does it stay true to our creative vision?”

Act as the final creative checkpoint before work is escalated, ensuring Anna is only involved in decisions that genuinely require strategic creative direction.







05 — Lead Social & Content Execution

Partner closely with Social, Content, Growth and Market Pods to translate global campaign ideas into culturally relevant, platform-native executions.

Act as the primary creative interface between the Creative Studio and Growth teams, translating global creative direction into clear execution frameworks that allow local teams to execute autonomously while respecting SARELLY’s creative and brand guidelines.

The role provides creative direction and quality standards for social content but does not own the overall social media calendar, channel strategy or publishing cadence, which remain the responsibility of the relevant Social/Growth teams.

You will:

Refine visual consistency across social outputs
Improve execution of tone of voice, edits and formats
Identify opportunities for stronger visual storytelling
Maintain brand coherence in fast-moving content cycles
Ensure local market adaptations remain faithful to the global creative vision

Balance brand-building with the speed and spontaneity social requires.







06 — Strengthen the Creative Team Through Execution

Help raise the overall executional standard of the team.

Give clear, direct and constructive feedback focused on craft and consistency.

Mentor designers and content creatives in:

Layout
Composition
Visual hierarchy
Brand consistency
Execution quality

Create clarity when teams feel stuck and ensure the creative vision is understood and properly translated at every level.

Coordinate and prioritize work across Brand Design, Photo & Video, freelance creative resources and production partners, ensuring the right people are focused on the highest-impact work.

The goal is not for everything to depend on you.

The goal is to ensure the entire team executes at a higher standard.







07 — Own Creative Studio Operations

Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Creative Studio.

You will be responsible for:

Creative calendar management
Project prioritization
Creative briefs
Review processes
Resource coordination
Delivery planning
Cross-functional communication

Own creative prioritization and capacity planning across internal teams, freelancers and external partners.

When resources cannot support every request, proactively bring forward recommendations and proposed trade-offs—not just problems—for alignment with Anna.

Protect the quality of output while ensuring the Creative Studio operates efficiently at scale.







08 — Stay Hands-On

We are looking for a creative leader who still loves making things.

You should be comfortable working in:

Adobe Creative Suite
Moodboards
Presentations
Layouts
Visual references
Creative treatments
On-set problem solving

You do not need to execute every asset yourself.

But you must understand the craft deeply enough to elevate every piece of work.







THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You can walk into a room with designers, marketers, photographers, editors, producers, agencies and external partners and speak everyone’s language.

You understand that your role is to protect the brand, elevate execution and create clarity for the entire creative organization.

You have:

Exceptional visual taste
Strong art direction skills
A portfolio showing both concept understanding and execution excellence
Experience leading shoots and visual productions
Experience working with multidisciplinary creative teams
Strong project and creative workflow management skills
The ability to prioritize multiple creative initiatives simultaneously
Experience managing agencies, freelancers or external production partners
A strong understanding of social-first creative
High cultural awareness
Excellent communication and feedback skills
Strong organizational instincts
High attention to detail
The ability to move between thinking and making
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish

Experience in beauty, fashion, lifestyle or culturally driven brands is highly valued.

You can zoom out to understand the brand and zoom in to question a crop, a typeface, a transition or a layout decision.

Most importantly, you know how to take a creative vision, understand its intention, and make sure it is executed at the highest possible standard across every touchpoint—while enabling teams to move faster and more independently.







HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS

Within your first 6 months:

Creative consistency

Anna’s creative vision is clearly and consistently translated across campaign, social, retail and digital outputs.

Execution quality

The overall standard of visual execution across the team improves noticeably.

Creative autonomy

Day-to-day creative execution can move forward with minimal Creative Director intervention, with teams confidently operating within established creative standards.

Creative Studio effectiveness

The Creative Studio operates with clear priorities, efficient workflows and balanced resource allocation, resulting in fewer bottlenecks and stronger on-time delivery.

Team elevation

Designers and content creatives become more confident in executing the vision independently, while agencies and external partners receive clearer direction and require fewer revision rounds.

Creative Director leverage

Anna spends significantly more time on vision, concepting and innovation rather than execution oversight, creative triage and day-to-day decision making.







APPLICATION

A portfolio will requested to apply to this role. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of:

Art direction and campaign work
Photography and/or video productions
Social-first creative
Brand and visual identity execution
Projects where you translated a creative concept across multiple touchpoints
Your specific role and contribution to each project

description:
About the job

Operations & Product Support Coordinator

 Customer Support & Operations · Fintech / AI · Mexico · Remote, US hours




About the Company

My client is a US technology company building an AI platform for B2B loan servicing and legal collections. Commercial lenders, fintechs, and financial institutions use the platform to automate up to 90% of their servicing and legal workflows, from borrower communications all the way through UCC filing and enforcement.




The platform runs AI agents across voice, SMS, and email, connects directly to the client's loan management system, and layers in automated legal action with a network of attorneys. Compliance is built into the core, from FDCPA to state regulations, with full audit trails on every action. Customers report recovery rate improvements of up to 30%.




About the Role

This is a support-first seat at the center of a fast-moving fintech product. You will become the in-house expert on the platform, take care of the lenders who use it every day, and be the bridge between what customers need and what the product team builds.

Most of your week is customer facing: calls, questions, and requests from a portfolio of roughly 10 to 15 accounts. The rest is the work that keeps those customers happy behind the scenes: writing up issues as clear tickets, tracking them through to resolution, and closing the loop. You will also lend a hand to the marketing team when you have the bandwidth, which is a nice way to see more of how the business runs.

The core skill: answering "can the product do this for the customer?" accurately and quickly. That means learning the platform deeply, knowing its limits, and routing what it cannot do yet to the product team as a clear, well-written ticket.




What You'll Do

Own your accounts. Roughly 10 to 15 lenders, day to day, including scheduled calls. You are their person.
Handle support and product questions over calls, email, and chat, resolving what you can directly and escalating what you cannot.
Learn the platform inside and out. You will be trained on the internal software and become the person who knows what it can and cannot do. Expect a week or two to get there.
Write clear, well-structured tickets capturing the customer issue, the expected behavior, and how to reproduce it.
Track tickets end to end in Linear, following up until they are resolved and closing the loop with the customer.
Educate customers and build the relationship. Walk people through features, get them using more of the platform, and keep them confident in it.
Be the voice of the customer with product. Flag patterns and recurring requests, test new features, and feed real usage back into the roadmap.
Lend a hand to marketing. Most marketing runs through an AI tool, so this is light support when you have room: social posts, content coordination, the occasional campaign. Not the core of the job, but a real part of the week.
General operations support: internal coordination, documentation, and process work as the team scales.




What You Bring

2+ years in customer support, operations, customer success, or a similar coordination role, ideally at a software or technology company.
Fluent English (C1/C2), written and spoken. You will be on calls with US financial services customers. What matters most is communicating clearly and thinking well, not a perfect accent.
Strong written communication. A vague ticket costs engineering hours, so precision matters.
Technical curiosity. You do not need to code. You do need to genuinely enjoy learning how software works and being the person with the answer.
Organization under volume. Multiple customers, multiple open tickets, nothing dropped.
High agency and ownership. This is a pioneering seat on a small team. Nobody will hand you a checklist every morning.
Discretion. You will handle sensitive customer and borrower data in a regulated industry. Trustworthiness is not optional here.




One thing we screen for: you actually use AI

This team builds with AI and expects you to as well. We will ask you the same question they will: what is the coolest thing you have built or automated using AI tools?

It does not have to be work. A personal project, a workflow you automated, an assistant you wired up for yourself, all count. What we are listening for is that you have actually gone and made something, not that you have read about it.




Nice to Have

Experience with Linear, Jira, Notion, or similar ticketing and project tools. Linear is easy to pick up, so this is a head start rather than a requirement.
Familiarity with APIs and integrations, or comfort reading logs.
Background in fintech, lending, banking, financial services, or collections. Genuinely not required, curiosity about the space matters more.
Interest in financial markets or AI products.
Some marketing range: social content, copywriting, or campaign coordination. Helpful for the marketing support side of the role.
Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where roles are broad.




Compensation and Benefits

Monthly net salary: MX$30,000
Vacation: 12 days per year
Aguinaldo: 15 days
Company-provided equipment.
Direct exposure to product, leadership, and customers at an early-stage AI company.




Work Arrangement

Location: Remote from Mexico.
Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week. 9:00 to 5:00 PST, Monday through Friday. Some flexibility to 8:00 to 4:00 CST.
Setup: A stable internet connection good enough for daily Zoom calls, no dropouts.
Travel: None required for the job itself. Occasional team gatherings may come up.
Hiring process: Two interviews. The client keeps it simple and moves fast.
Start: Late August to early September.

description:
About the job

Important Notes

This position is based on-site in Mexico City, CDMX. Remote work is not available for this role.

Submitted resumes must be in English to be considered.

About Us

Since 2019, Landing has redefined apartment renting with the industry's first flexible living model. Our membership program provides consumers access to a network of apartments in 60+ top markets with no deposits, hassles, or stress.

About The Team

Our Member Support Team sets the standard for delivering a world-class experience throughout every member's Landing journey. You'll work with a close-knit, passionate group of people in an open, energetic office environment where hard work and great culture go hand in hand.

About The Role

We are looking for a Member Support Analyst to join Landing! In this role, you'll respond to emails, phone calls, and chats to ensure our members' questions and concerns are handled quickly and efficiently. You'll build customer support expertise while developing relationship-building and communication skills.

What You'll Do


Deliver exceptional customer service to all Landing members
Record all member interactions with clear, concise notes in response to each request
Coordinate member move-ins and move-outs at Landing homes
Own the resolution of home issues, including diligent follow-up between members, hosts, and properties
Create and assign the appropriate tickets to ensure proper follow-up and exceptional member experience
Find solutions to meet member needs and retain long-term relationships
Communicate and reinforce the value and benefits of Landing's products and services
Provide expert property knowledge to guide members throughout their Landing journey


What You'll Need


English proficiency: Fluent (B2-C1)
Ability to work from our Polanco office — a collaborative, fast-moving environment
Superb written and verbal communication skills
1+ year of proven customer service experience
Strong organizational skills and ability to use multiple administrative tools simultaneously
Self-motivated, hardworking, and customer-focused with a track record of achieving targets
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to change
Tech-savvy: familiarity with Mac, Google Drive, and Excel


Compensation & Benefits


Salary: $16,500 MXN gross per month + career growth plan
Grocery vouchers: $1,500 MXN net per month
Vacation: 12 days per year (available after 90 days of employment)
Paid time off (PTO): 40 hours per year (available after 30 days of employment)
Health insurance: Major medical (MetLife), minor medical (AXA Keralty), dental, and vision coverage
Parking: On-site parking for bikes, motorcycles, and cars
Travel benefit: $750 USD annually in Landing Stays

About the job

Job Location

MEXICO CITY GENERAL OFFICE

Job Description

Title of the Position: Trade Marketing Intern

Location: Interlomas General Offices

Work Hours: Part-time with flexible working hours.

Profile: Currently enrolled Bachelor's student in their first degree program in any business or engineering field.

Salary: The gross salary for interns ranges from 9,000mxn to 18,000 mxn and compensation may vary based on the work schedule you select.

Duration: 12-18 months.

Qualifications: Graduation date must be between December 2027 and June 2028. English Advanced.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Accommodations: At P&G, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive recruitment, assessment, and selection process. Are you ready to kick-start your career in sales and marketing? As a Trade Intern, you will gain hands-on experience while contributing to our team’s success. If you are eager to learn and make an impact, then this is the perfect job for you!

About the role: As a Trade Marketing Intern, you will participate in the development and implementation of new ideas, techniques, and services while collaborating with your team to maximize your learning experience.

Participate in the development and implementation of new ideas, techniques, procedures, services, or products under supervision.
Collaborate and network effectively within the team or immediate work environment to maximize work impact and personal learning.
Participate in learning opportunities and collaborate on change management initiatives for new processes under supervision.


Job Qualifications

Hard Skills:

Excel

Power BI

PowerPoint

Soft Skills:

Commercial attitude

Teamwork

Adaptability

Nice to Have Skills:

Data analysis

Important Note for Candidates:

Before submitting your application, we encourage you to review our Hiring Process and Assessment Information. Familiarizing yourself with this content will help you prepare for online assessments and enhance your chances of success.

What We Offer:


You will experience business responsibilities from Day 1 – You work every single day on key projects from the beginning.
You will be part of the P&G family since day one.
Attractive salary and benefits package – for you to keep your studies as a priority, salary is linked to the number of hours worked per day: 4 hours, 6.5 hours, or 8 hours.
You will receive continuous coaching & mentorship – We are passionate about our work.
We will make sure you receive both formal training and regular mentorship from your manager and others.
You'll get the chance to be in a dynamic and encouraging work environment – We live our Purpose, Values, and Principles daily.
Flex arrangements - We value every individual and encourage initiatives promoting agility and work/life balance.
We love hardworking people; you will have the opportunity to be promoted to full-time following successful completion of your Internship.

P&G serves consumers worldwide with a strong portfolio of trusted brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Crest®, Gillette®, Pampers®, and Tide®. Our community operates in approximately 70 countries. For more information about us and our brands, please visit www.pg.com.

description:
About the job

Job Title: Marketing Coordinator

Job Modality: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: B2B Marketing / Professional Services

Salary: $1,200 to $1,500 USD per month




About the Client

Our client is a growing organization focused on delivering innovative solutions while building a strong digital presence and scalable marketing operations. Their internal marketing team is responsible for driving brand awareness, generating qualified leads, and supporting business growth through data-driven marketing initiatives and automation.

As the company continues to expand, they are looking for a highly organized Marketing Coordinator who can execute marketing campaigns, optimize HubSpot, and keep marketing projects moving efficiently from concept to completion.




About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and execution-focused Marketing Coordinator to join GlobalTeam and work directly with our client.

In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of the marketing team, coordinating campaigns, managing marketing automation in HubSpot, supporting social media initiatives, tracking performance metrics, and ensuring projects are completed on time.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys both the technical and operational sides of marketing, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and takes ownership of marketing execution while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes.




Key Responsibilities

Coordinate internal marketing initiatives from planning through execution.
Manage the marketing calendar and ensure campaigns are delivered on schedule.
Maintain and optimize HubSpot CRM, Marketing Hub, workflows, automations, and contact databases.
Build and manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, landing pages, forms, and marketing reports.
Execute and coordinate social media activities across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
Coordinate the creation and publication of blogs, newsletters, case studies, lead magnets, and other marketing content.
Collaborate with designers, freelancers, agencies, and cross-functional teams to execute marketing initiatives.
Track campaign performance and prepare KPI reports for leadership.
Monitor lead generation, email engagement, website performance, and marketing analytics.
Maintain marketing documentation, SOPs, and internal processes.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing workflows, automation, and operational efficiency.
Support additional marketing and business development initiatives as needed.




Required Skills & Experience

Minimum 3 years of experience in marketing coordination, marketing operations, or digital marketing.
Hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub (required).
Experience creating and managing marketing automation workflows.
Experience building email marketing campaigns, landing pages, forms, and lead nurturing sequences.
Experience managing business social media platforms.
Strong understanding of inbound marketing and lead generation strategies.
Experience tracking marketing KPIs and preparing performance reports.
Excellent organizational and project management skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a remote environment.




Bonus Points For

Experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, or SEO reporting.
Experience with WordPress content management.
Experience using Canva for basic marketing assets.
Familiarity with ChatGPT and AI productivity tools.
Experience coordinating vendors, freelancers, or external agencies.
Previous experience working with B2B companies or professional services organizations.




What We Offer

Competitive compensation.
100% remote work environment.
Opportunity to work with a growing organization.
Collaborative and supportive team culture.
Long-term career growth opportunities.
Exposure to modern marketing technology and automation.

description:
About the job

Why this role exists




Charles, our founder, spends most of his week talking with the owners of short-term rental property management companies. Five or six of those conversations get recorded every week, and almost nobody sees them. Your job is to change that. You'll take everything he says on camera and turn it into the newsletter, clips, and posts that make him the best-known voice in this industry. He hits record and reviews your drafts once a week. Everything in between belongs to you.

About HostGenius




HostGenius is a private membership network and business operating system for short-term rental property management companies. More than 70 member companies managing about 3,000 properties run on our platform. Charles scaled his own property management company to 160 listings before starting HostGenius, so when he talks about this business, operators listen. We're profitable and growing fast, and this role turns his daily conversations into a growth channel.

What success looks like




A year from now, thousands of US property managers read our weekly newsletter. Clips go up on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube every week, and every word sounds like Charles wrote it himself. He spends under two hours a week on content once the cameras are off. The sales team uses proof clips you found. The ads team runs creative you handed them. When we host an industry event, you stretch one week of recording into three months of material.




What you will own

Turning raw recordings into published content. You pick the moments worth keeping, cut clips with Riverside's Magic Clips, and write the hooks and captions.
Final copy for the weekly newsletter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Our AI pipeline produces first drafts for you. You run it, check it, and edit everything until it sounds like Charles.
The publishing calendar. Everything ships on time every week without anyone chasing you.
The weekly review with Charles. One approval pass. You ship what he approves and rework what he flags.
A weekly scoreboard: what shipped, newsletter growth, engagement from actual property managers, and which clips went to the ads team.
Freelance editors, once long-form YouTube outgrows Magic Clips. They cut, you direct.




Not in scope: paid ads (our Growth Marketing Manager owns Meta), long-form video editing (we will outsource it), and inventing strategy from scratch. The system is already designed. Your job is to run it every week and keep making it better.




What we are looking for




Required:

3+ years running content production end to end for a company, founder, or creator, with published work you can show us
Written English at a native level. You'll be ghostwriting a Canadian founder, and if your copy needs a second edit before it ships, this isn't your role. Finalists complete a paid writing test in his voice.
Good instincts for short-form video. You can listen to an hour of conversation and know which 40 seconds will stop someone scrolling.
The discipline to run a publishing calendar for months without missing a date
At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time
You use AI tools daily for speed, and you catch what they get wrong




Nice to have:

Experience marketing to small business owners, or in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rentals
You've grown a newsletter on beehiiv, HubSpot, Kit, or similar
Podcast or webinar production, or familiarity with Riverside.fm
Enough design sense to make covers and carousels in Canva




Compensation

$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month as a full-time contractor plus up to a 30% annual bonus. This is a long-term role with upside as the media engine grows.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Make sure your resume or profile links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you personally produced. We read every application that includes work samples and skip the ones that don't. Finalists complete a short paid writing test.

title: Representante de servicio al cliente
description:
About the job




Representante de servicio a cliente 

(IN HOUSE) 

(EXPERIENCIA EN EMPRESAS DE MANUFACTURA O TANGIBLES)







Objetivo del puesto




Garantizar una experiencia de servicio excepcional mediante la gestión integral de las necesidades, requerimientos y oportunidades de los clientes, asegurando respuestas oportunas, seguimiento efectivo y cumplimiento de los compromisos establecidos.




Actuar como enlace estratégico entre el cliente y las áreas internas, anticipando necesidades, resolviendo incidencias y generando acciones que fortalezcan la satisfacción, fidelización y relación comercial con los clientes.







Principales responsabilidades




Gestionar de manera integral la atención y servicio al cliente, asegurando respuestas oportunas, claras y orientadas a la solución.




Comprender las necesidades y expectativas de cada cliente, anticipándose a sus requerimientos y proponiendo alternativas que mejoren su experiencia de servicio.




Dar seguimiento puntual a pedidos, requerimientos, cotizaciones, entregas, incidencias y compromisos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los acuerdos establecidos.




Coordinar con las diferentes áreas internas las acciones necesarias para atender los requerimientos del cliente y garantizar una respuesta eficiente.




Gestionar y resolver incidencias y reclamaciones, identificando la causa raíz, estableciendo acciones correctivas y dando seguimiento hasta su cierre satisfactorio.




Mantener una comunicación proactiva con los clientes, informando oportunamente sobre avances, cambios, retrasos o cualquier situación que pueda impactar el servicio.




Dar seguimiento a indicadores de servicio, identificando tendencias, desviaciones y áreas de oportunidad para elevar el nivel de atención.




Analizar el comportamiento y necesidades de los clientes, detectando oportunidades de fortalecimiento de la relación comercial y posibles necesidades adicionales.




Mantener actualizada la información de clientes, pedidos, compromisos e incidencias, asegurando trazabilidad y disponibilidad de información para la toma de decisiones.




Participar activamente en la prevención de problemas, identificando riesgos en el servicio y escalando oportunamente aquellos casos que requieran intervención de otras áreas.




Construir relaciones de confianza con los clientes, convirtiéndose en un punto de contacto confiable y orientado a generar relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.







Se busca un profesional con alta orientación al cliente, pensamiento analítico, sentido de urgencia y capacidad para resolver problemas.




Debe demostrar:




Alta orientación al servicio y satisfacción del cliente.




Enfoque en resultados y cumplimiento de compromisos.




Excelente comunicación verbal y escrita.




Capacidad para escuchar, comprender necesidades y generar soluciones.




Pensamiento analítico y capacidad para identificar causas raíz.




Proactividad y anticipación de necesidades.




Capacidad para gestionar situaciones de presión y clientes exigentes.




Organización y seguimiento disciplinado.




Capacidad para coordinar múltiples requerimientos simultáneamente.




Habilidad para negociar y manejar conflictos.




Sentido de urgencia y capacidad de respuesta.




Trabajo colaborativo con diferentes áreas.




Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer soluciones.




Orientación a la fidelización y construcción de relaciones de largo plazo.







Ofrecemos:




Sueldo Base.




Comisiones por retención y desarrollo de clientes.




Prestaciones superiores a la ley.




Plan de vida y carrera.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

title: Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket — Tecnología HIFU | Remoto | $3,200–$6,400 USD/mes en inbound + 10% outbound
description:
About the job

¿Sabes conducir una videollamada comercial, descubrir la necesidad real de un negocio y convertir una oportunidad de alto valor en una venta?




En Ultrasonic ampliamos nuestro equipo comercial internacional. Buscamos un/a Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket con experiencia real en cierre consultivo para trabajar con clínicas estéticas, centros de belleza y spas médicos en España, México y Estados Unidos.

No vendemos cursos ni servicios abstractos. Comercializamos Ultrasonic 12D, una plataforma de tecnología HIFU para tratamientos médico-estéticos de alto valor, dentro de un modelo llave en mano que combina tecnología, formación para el cliente y marketing para impulsar la demanda.

Tu misión es clara: recibir oportunidades comerciales reales, entender el negocio del prospecto, presentar la solución, construir una propuesta a medida y convertir la conversación en una venta cobrada.


Lo que hace diferente esta posición

Recibirás leads reales procedentes de campañas de marketing activas. Ultrasonic invierte en captación digital, retargeting y generación de demanda. No empiezas con una lista fría sin contexto: trabajas oportunidades que ya han mostrado interés y que necesitan una conversación comercial profesional para avanzar.

Tendrás un equipo de Setters profesionales agendando reuniones calificadas para ti. El equipo de setting identifica necesidad, valida información clave, nutre al prospecto con los materiales necesarios y confirma la asistencia antes de transferirte la reunión. Tu foco está donde aporta más valor: diagnosticar, presentar, resolver objeciones y cerrar.

Tu trabajo es procesar y convertir oportunidades en venta. No buscamos a alguien que haga presentaciones genéricas o deje propuestas sin seguimiento. Buscamos un Closer que domine la conversación de negocio, demuestre el retorno de inversión con los números del propio cliente y lleve cada oportunidad a una decisión concreta.

Tendrás onboarding, academia y dirección comercial. Recibirás configuración de CRM y herramientas, acceso a la academia de producto, dossier comercial, casos reales, configurador de propuestas, scripts, roleplays y sesiones de coaching con Dirección Comercial. El acceso a reuniones reales llega cuando demuestras en roleplay que puedes ejecutar el método, no cuando simplemente han pasado unos días.


Un sistema de comisiones diseñado para premiar el cierre

Es una posición 100% a comisión, sin salario base y sin techo artificial de ingresos. La lógica es directa: cuanto mejor cierras, más te beneficia el sistema.

En operaciones inbound, las primeras cuatro ventas del mes generan una comisión del 5%. Al cerrar la quinta venta, la comisión sube al 8% y se recalcula de forma retroactiva sobre todas las ventas inbound de ese mes. Con un ticket medio de referencia de $8,000 USD, cuatro ventas representan $1,600 USD; cinco ventas activan $3,200 USD; siete ventas equivalen a $4,480 USD y diez ventas a $6,400 USD.

Si generas tus propias oportunidades mediante prospección outbound, cobras un 10% flat por cada operación cerrada. Con cinco ventas inbound y dos operaciones outbound, el escenario de referencia alcanza $4,800 USD en comisiones.

El detalle completo del sistema, los requisitos de validación, la atribución de ventas, los objetivos y las condiciones operativas se muestra en la web antes de que tomes ninguna decisión.


El perfil que buscamos

Buscamos una persona con al menos un año de experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B, high-ticket, tecnología, salud, estética o entornos consultivos. Debe saber conducir una videollamada profesional, escuchar antes de presentar, usar un CRM con disciplina y manejar objeciones sin necesidad de improvisar promesas imposibles.

Necesitas español nativo o nivel profesional, ordenador propio, conexión estable, cámara y disposición para grabar reuniones como parte del proceso de calidad y coaching. El inglés es un plus para oportunidades en Estados Unidos. La relación es mercantil, por lo que debes poder emitir factura como autónomo/a, freelance o empresa.

Valoramos especialmente a quien sabe vender retorno, no descuento. Si entiendes que una clínica no compra una máquina sino una nueva línea de facturación, vas a entender muy rápido la propuesta de Ultrasonic.


Proceso de selección

El proceso es directo: registro en la web, vídeo de presentación, vídeo pitch de producto, entrevista por videollamada con roleplay, propuesta de incorporación y onboarding.

¿Te interesa cerrar ventas de alto valor con producto real, campañas activas, reuniones calificadas y un sistema de comisiones que escala a tu favor?




Haz clic en “Solicitar empleo”. Accederás a la web con toda la información detallada del puesto, el modelo de comisiones, el proceso y el formulario de registro:

https://ventas.ultrasonic-pro.com

Hay oportunidades comerciales activas. Incorporación según proceso de selección.

Ultrasonic — Blink Professional Studio S.L.

About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.





What you’ll be doing:


Field & Team Orchestration








Regional Field Operations Support: Serve as the central operational hub for our remote Field Marketing Managers across the Americas region. Oversee the complete lifecycle of regional event collateral and swag inventory, optimizing supply chains and workflows to guarantee seamless, friction-free daily operations.








Procurement & Legal Liaison: Drive the end-to-end procurement process. You will coordinate with Legal, Finance, and Procurement to shepherd contracts through approval, manage invoicing, and ensure vendors are paid on time.








Budget Tracking: Assist in developing event cost estimates and maintaining real-time budget accuracy across multiple regional activations.









Event Execution & Logistics








Customer Experience Ownership: Own the end-to-end logistics for customer-centric events (dinners, roundtables, workshops) in tight collaboration with Customer Marketing and Account Management teams.








Multi-Format Support: Provide logistical backbone for a diverse portfolio of events, including roundtables, industry trade shows, and co-sponsored partner events.









Data & Feedback Loops








AI-Driven Efficiency: Actively seek ways to use AI and automation (e.g., within Slack, SFDC, or Sheets) to streamline reporting, draft communications, and simplify repetitive administrative workflows.












We’re looking for:





2+ Years Experience: Proven track record in Event Coordination, Field Marketing, or a similar high-volume Ops role.








Tech-Forward Mindset: You don't just use tools; you optimize them. High proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs/Sheets) and Salesforce is required. Experience with JIRA and Slack as project management tools is preferred.








Service-Oriented EQ: You have a proactive mindset. You are friendly, professional, and capable of engaging with everyone from executives to warehouse vendors.








Async Mastery: You are comfortable working across time zones with high autonomy. You communicate clearly and directly, defaulting to "showing your work" so the team can stay aligned.








Remote-First: Ability to operate independently across global time zones.








On-Site Support: Willingness to travel up to 10% to provide hands-on support for key events.













Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. 




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

- Licenciatura concluida o en etapa final en Administración, Negocios, Marketing, Economía, Finanzas, Derecho, Relaciones Internacionales o áreas afines.

- Facilidad para investigar empresas, sectores y personas.

- Buena comunicación oral y escrita.

- Seguridad para interactuar profesionalmente con empresarios y directivos.

- Organización y disciplina para dar seguimiento a diferentes actividades.

- Iniciativa, curiosidad comercial y orientación a objetivos.

- Manejo profesional de LinkedIn y herramientas digitales.

- Buena presentación profesional.




Será un plus:




- Experiencia utilizando LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Conocimiento básico de algún CRM.

- Manejo de Excel o Google Sheets.

- Experiencia en prácticas profesionales, servicio social o proyectos relacionados con ventas, investigación o atención a clientes.

- Inglés intermedio o profesional.

- Interés en el sector empresarial y los servicios profesionales.




No es indispensable contar con experiencia previa en el sector legal.




Lo que ofrecemos:




- Capacitación y acompañamiento para desarrollarte en Business Development B2B.

- Trabajo directo con la Dirección de Castañón Abogados.

- Participación en la construcción y crecimiento del área de Desarrollo de Negocios.

- Exposición profesional a empresas, empresarios y directivos.

- Aprendizaje en prospección estratégica, networking y ventas consultivas.

- Oportunidad de aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional dentro de la firma.

- Esquema de bonos por cumplimiento de objetivos.

- Prestaciones de ley, incluido aguinaldo.

- Jornada presencial de lunes a viernes, de 09:00 a 19:00 horas, con dos horas de comida.

- Oficinas en Lomas de San Ángel Inn, Ciudad de México.




Importante:




Esta es una posición de desarrollo de negocios B2B. No está enfocada en community management, diseño gráfico, creación de contenido, publicidad digital, telemarketing o ventas masivas por volumen de llamadas.




Si te interesa investigar mercados, conectar con empresas, desarrollar relaciones profesionales y construir una carrera en Business Development, queremos conocerte.

Role: Social Community Manager

Based in Mexico City as part of OLIVER's LATAM in-house studio, you'll be the front-line specialist responsible for community engagement, brand voice, and real-time social presence across a portfolio of leading household brands. We are pioneers in the country in work-life balance practices such as extended maternity leave, open spaces, remote work and flexible working hours.

description:
About the job

Descripción de la empresa GREENFIELD AGRO es una empresa que ayuda a productores y marcas de alimentos y bebidas a vender y operar en nuevos mercados internacionales. Validamos el encaje producto-mercado, los canales de distribución y la estrategia de precios para asegurar el éxito comercial. Coordinamos muestras, requisitos regulatorios, órdenes de compra, producción, importaciones y distribución, asegurando que todo el proceso fluya sin problemas. Cuando surgen incidencias de calidad, inventario o entregas, trabajamos de cerca con proveedores y clientes hasta resolverlas. Operamos en México, Latinoamérica y Europa, con un foco especial en retail, distribución y proyectos de marca blanca.




Descripción del puesto Como Especialista en vinos, te encargarás de gestionar el portafolio de vinos de la empresa, asesorando sobre selección, compra y posicionamiento en los mercados donde operamos. En tu día a día, darás soporte al equipo comercial en la venta de vinos, prepararás materiales de formación para clientes y personal interno, y participarás en catas, presentaciones y eventos profesionales. También colaborarás con bodegas y productores para evaluar la calidad de los vinos, coordinar muestras y revisar fichas técnicas, asegurando que cada referencia cumpla los estándares de la empresa. Mantendrás una comunicación constante con los equipos de distribución y retail para optimizar el surtido y apoyar lanzamientos de nuevos productos. Este es un puesto de tiempo completo, presencial, ubicado en Ciudad de México, México.




Requisitos




Aptitudes en venta de vinos y desarrollo comercial, incluyendo Wine Sales y relación con clientes del sector HORECA y retail.
Conocimientos sólidos en Wine Education, capacidad para impartir formaciones, catas y asesoría técnica sobre vinos.
Formación o experiencia en Enología (Oenology), comprensión de procesos de elaboración (Winemaking) y trabajo con bodegas (Wineries).
Experiencia previa en el sector vinícola o bebidas alcohólicas, idealmente en puestos comerciales, de compras o de marketing de producto.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, organización y atención al detalle, así como buenas aptitudes de comunicación oral y escrita.
Disponibilidad para viajar de forma puntual y para participar en eventos, ferias y visitas a proveedores.
Se valorará formación específica en vinos (por ejemplo, WSET u otras certificaciones), manejo de herramientas ofimáticas y nivel intermedio de inglés.

About the job

Representante de Atendimento ao Cliente Trilíngue – Espanhol-Inglês-Português 

Últimas notícias: A TTEC recebeu o prêmio “Best Workplaces 2022” do CompuTrabajo, um dos principais site de empregos do México.

O objetivo da TTEC é levar sorrisos... Ao seu rosto e aos rostos dos nossos clientes. Como Representante de Atendimento ao Cliente Trilíngue –Espanhol-Inglês-Português– trabalhando na Cidade do México, você fará parte da criação e entrega de experiências incríveis ao cliente, enquanto vive a experiência de trabalhar na TTEC, uma empresa com uma cultura corporativa e experiência profissional premiada.

O que você fará:

Você gosta de ajudar as pessoas? Nesta função, você trabalhará para resolver os problemas do cliente antes de encaminhá-los para o próximo nível. Seja buscando respostas rapidamente, consultando produtos com empatia ou resolvendo os problemas da melhor forma possível, você será a diferença entre a experiência do cliente ser simplesmente média ou extraordinária.

Em um dia típico, você:


 Responderá às comunicações recebidas dos clientes
 Realizará pesquisas para fornecer respostas para que os clientes resolvam seus problemas



Requisitos para a função:


 Nível de português, inglês e espanhol avançado, tanto escrito como falado
 Disponibilidade para trabalhar à noite e finais de semana
 Habilidade para navegar por vários sistemas da web simultaneamente (multitarefa)
 Competência no uso do Microsoft Windows
 Vive na Cidade do México ou em seus arredores, perfeito. Vive na área metropolitana? Está ótimo também.



O que oferecemos:


 Suporte ao seu desenvolvimento profissional e progressão de carreira
 Uma empresa com uma cultura inclusiva e dedicada à responsabilidade social
 Uma equipe global de pessoas interessadas em aprender e guiadas pelos valores da empresa
 E sim, com o salário competitivo, oportunidades de bônus de desempenho e benefícios que você certamente esperaria e talvez alguns que poderiam te surpreender



Um pouco mais sobre sua função: 

Estamos empenhados em garantir que você tenha as habilidades e o apoio necessários para ter sucesso em sua função ao longo de sua carreira. Desde seu primeiro dia de treinamento, passando pelo treinamento individualizado via webcam, engajamento e treinamento, até os 1000 cursos gratuitos para dar suporte ao desenvolvimento de sua carreira. E acreditamos que você já possua as qualidades necessárias e que não podem ser ensinadas: a predisposição e a empatia para ajudar os clientes. A comunidade TTEC está aqui para você como uma família dinâmica e global.

Você se reportará ao supervisor do departamento e contribuirá para o sucesso da experiência do cliente e para o sucesso geral da equipe.

Sobre a TTEC 

O objetivo da nossa empresa é a satisfação dos nossos clientes. É isso que fazemos. Desde 1982, temos ajudado as empresas a construírem experiências engajadoras, positivas e lucrativas para os consumidores por meio de nossa combinação de talentos humanos e tecnologia. Em nome de muitas das empresas mais renomadas e inovadoras do mundo, nos comunicamos com os clientes via telefone, SMS, chat e vídeo, todos os dias. Essas experiências incríveis começam com você.

A TTEC se orgulha de ser uma empregadora igualitária onde todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou status de veterano protegido. Nossa empresa adota e está comprometida em construir um quadro de colaboradores diversificado e inclusivo para respeitar e fortalecer as culturas e perspectivas de suas equipes globais. Fazemos grandes esforços para representar as regiões onde atuamos, não apenas fornecendo serviços e tecnologia de última geração, mas também sendo mais humanos. Fazemos questão de garantir que todos os nossos colaboradores se sintam valorizados, parte da empresa e confortáveis com suas personalidades autênticas no trabalho. Como uma empresa global, sabemos que a diversidade é o nosso ponto forte porque ela nos permite ver as coisas de diferentes pontos de vista e dá espaço para que cada pessoa apresente suas ideias únicas e inovadoras.
