description:
About the job

Founding LinkedIn Outbound Campaign Strategist

Hey! We’re Scale Up, and our client is looking to hire a LinkedIn Lead Generation Specialist for a fast-growing AI startup building an AI-powered growth platform for LinkedIn outbound.

Type of Employment: Full-Time Contractor (Long-term)

Work Modality: 100% Remote

Work Schedule: Full-Time

Location: Global

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing AI startup building technology that helps companies identify the right prospects, start highly relevant conversations, and turn those conversations into qualified sales meetings.

They are looking for someone who is exceptional at LinkedIn outbound. This is not a role for someone who simply uploads prospect lists and creates standard sequences. They need someone who can understand a business, identify the strongest reasons to reach out, define the right audience, create messaging that generates genuine responses, and continuously improve campaigns based on real performance data.

You will have significant ownership, managing campaigns from initial research and strategy through launch, testing, and ongoing optimization.

What You’ll Own


Learn each client’s product, market, customers, positioning, and sales process. 
Identify the strongest ICPs, buyer segments, triggers, and campaign angles. 
Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other data sources. 
Determine who to target, why they would care, and why the timing is relevant. 
Write connection requests, opening messages, follow-ups, and campaign variations. 
Build and launch LinkedIn outbound campaigns using the company’s platform. 
Monitor acceptance, reply, positive reply, meeting, attendance, and lead-quality rates. 
Identify where campaigns are underperforming and make the necessary adjustments. 
Run structured tests across audiences, offers, messaging, and CTAs. 
Review replies and conversations to understand what the market is actually saying. 
Pause weak campaigns quickly and scale the ones that work. 
Maintain clear campaign documentation covering tests, results, and learnings. 
Turn successful campaigns into repeatable playbooks for the broader team. 


What Exceptional Looks Like

You can look at a company and quickly answer:


Who is most likely to buy this? 
What signals suggest they may need it right now? 
Who should we exclude from the campaign? 
What would make the outreach feel specific without sounding automated? 
Is the problem the audience, offer, message, timing, or follow-up? 
What does the campaign data tell us to change next? 


You understand that great outbound is not about sending more messages. It is about creating the right conversation with the right person at the right time.

You May Be a Great Fit If


You have built and optimized successful B2B outbound campaigns. 
You are extremely strong in ICP research, segmentation, targeting, and outbound copywriting. 
You have deep hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. 
You can write messages that are concise, casual, relevant, and genuinely human. 
You understand the difference between getting a reply and generating a qualified sales opportunity. 
You are comfortable working across multiple industries and quickly learning new markets. 
You use campaign data to make decisions rather than relying only on intuition. 
You can diagnose targeting and messaging problems and act on them quickly. 
You take full ownership and are comfortable working with minimal supervision. 
You can clearly explain why a campaign worked, why it failed, and what should happen next. 
You care deeply about the quality and business impact of your work. 


Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, Instantly, HeyReach, Expandi, Smartlead, Unipile, or similar outbound platforms is a plus, but results and strategic thinking matter more than the exact tool stack.

This Is Probably Not for You If


Your outbound strategy is mainly based on increasing volume. 
You rely heavily on generic templates with light personalization. 
You evaluate campaigns only through acceptance or overall reply rates. 
You need someone else to define the audience, angle, and offer. 
You launch campaigns and wait weeks before analyzing their performance. 
You cannot provide examples of campaigns you personally built and improved. 
Your messaging sounds like it was generated by a sales automation tool. 


How Success Will Be Measured

Your performance will be evaluated based on:


Quality and precision of targeting. 
Positive reply rate. 
Qualified meetings booked. 
Meeting attendance and lead quality. 
Speed and quality of campaign iteration. 
Client campaign performance over time. 
Strength of the insights and playbooks you produce. 


The focus is on qualified meetings, real sales opportunities, and revenue potential. Vanity metrics matter only when they help diagnose and improve campaign performance.

What Your First 90 Days Could Look Like

First 30 Days


Learn the product, customers, and existing campaign process. 
Audit current campaigns and identify the biggest performance opportunities. 
Take ownership of an initial group of campaigns. 
Establish a clear testing and reporting approach. 


By 60 Days


Independently research, build, launch, and optimize campaigns. 
Produce measurable improvements in targeting, messaging, or conversion rates. 
Turn early wins into repeatable campaign frameworks. 
Identify recurring process issues and propose improvements. 


By 90 Days


Own campaign strategy and execution with minimal oversight. 
Consistently generate qualified conversations through outbound campaigns. 
Raise the quality bar across the company’s campaigns. 
Help develop a world-class system for LinkedIn outbound. 


Why Join?


Work directly with the founder and have meaningful ownership from day one. 
Join a fast-growing startup where your work directly impacts customer results. 
Help shape both the campaign strategy and the AI-powered product behind it. 
Test strategies across different markets, offers, industries, and audiences. 
Play a key role in defining what world-class LinkedIn outbound looks like. 
Work remotely as part of an ambitious, highly autonomous team. 


Thanks!

description:
About the job

E-Commerce Marketing Specialist (TikTok Shop focused)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary: $1200 to $1800 USD/month based on experience + profit sharing bonuses based on performance.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




The Role

We are looking for a Marketing Specialist who can help make TikTok Shop a major growth engine for TopFoxx while supporting broader marketing, creative, influencer, and conversion initiatives.




This is not a traditional marketing manager role. You do not need prior TikTok Shop experience. You need to be a strong marketer who understands short-form content and learns platforms quickly. We are looking for someone who executes and brings results. You should be able to receive a problem like: "TikTok Shop isn't performing the way it should. Figure out what's happening."… and independently investigate the data, identify the problems, develop a strategy, start implementing solutions, monitor the results, and continue improving.




You will work across TikTok Shop, creators, influencer marketing, creative strategy, paid media, website conversion, and e-commerce marketing. You do not need to be the world's best expert in every area. But you need to be curious, capable, hands-on, and willing to figure things out.




What Success Looks Like

Grow TikTok Shop revenue and conversion while using creators, content, creative strategy, and broader marketing opportunities to drive measurable e-commerce growth.




You will be responsible for:

Understand → Identify → Strategize → Execute → Measure → Optimize → Scale




We want someone who can connect the dots between what customers see, what creators produce, how products are presented, and what ultimately makes someone buy.

Two numbers define this role. We get about 2,000 affiliate videos a month from roughly 650 creators, and only 1 to 2% of them drive any sales. Your job is to get us to 5,000 affiliates posting every month, and to take that 1 to 2% up to 5%. Volume alone would roughly triple this channel. Volume plus quality takes it about seven times where it is today.

And it has to be profitable. Every TikTok Shop sale carries a referral fee, affiliate commission, ad spend, discounts and shipping on top of product cost, so a campaign that looks like it is winning on reported ROI can still be losing us money. Growing revenue while margin disappears is not success here.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) TikTok Shop Growth (Primary Focus)

Understand the current state of our TikTok Shop and identify areas of opportunity.
Analyze GMV, sales, conversion, traffic, product performance, and creator-generated revenue.
Identify why products, content, or campaigns are underperforming.
Find opportunities to increase daily sales and overall GMV.
Develop and execute TikTok Shop growth strategies.
Test products, content, offers, campaigns, and creator strategies.
Follow TikTok Shop updates daily and be first to test them. New features are worth the most before the rest of the market catches on. 
Identify TikTok Shop features and opportunities TopFoxx is not currently utilizing.
Monitor performance and adjust strategies based on results.
Stay up to date, daily, on TikTok Shop updates, trends, tools, and best practices.
Build repeatable processes that make TikTok Shop growth more scalable.




2) Affiliate, Creator & Influencer Marketing 

Grow our affiliate base to 5,000+ creators posting every month, and lift the share of affiliate videos that actually drive sales from 1 to 2% up to 5%. Both numbers have to move together. More videos at the same quality is not the goal.
Build strong relationships with our top revenue-generating creators on TikTok Shop and win over the biggest GMV creators in our category. Keep a tracked written record of every conversation with each one, so the relationship lives in the company and not in one person's inbox.
Communicate directly with TikTok Shop creators and influencers.
Build relationships with high-potential creators.
Identify creators who have the ability to generate sales.
Identify which creators and content should be scaled.
Create clear creator briefs and content direction.
Give creators feedback on hooks, messaging, products, and content structure.
Help negotiate additional content or compensation when appropriate.
Develop creator campaigns around products, launches, promotions, and seasonal opportunities.
Identify opportunities for TikTok LIVE and other creator-led selling initiatives.
Connect creator performance back to GMV, conversion, and overall business results.




3) Creative Strategy

Review TikTok, Instagram, and paid creative.
Identify why certain videos capture attention and others do not.
Develop hooks, angles, concepts, and messaging.
Create content briefs for creators and internal teams.
Give actionable feedback on videos and creative.
Identify customer pain points that can become content opportunities.
Turn product benefits, reviews, objections, and customer questions into creative concepts.
Develop TikTok and Instagram content strategies.
Identify winning creator content that could be replicated or expanded.
Help determine which creative should be scaled.
Connect organic content, creator content, and paid advertising.
Build repeatable creative frameworks and testing processes.




4) Creative Execution

We want a marketer who can actually execute. You do not need to be an expert designer or professional video editor. However, you should have enough hands-on creative ability to make or modify content when necessary rather than being completely dependent on another person.




Experience with tools such as: Photoshop, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Other video or creative production tools is valuable.




You may:

Make simple creative edits.
Modify images or graphics.
Edit short-form video.
Create basic social content.
Build simple creative variations.
Add text, captions, hooks, or CTAs to content.
Prepare creator briefs and visual references.
Create basic marketing assets when needed.




5) Conversion & E-Commerce Optimization

Review product pages and landing pages.

Collaborate with the team to plan and conduct concentrated campaigns and forward-thinking customer outreach.

English level B2

Retorno sobre la inversión publicitaria.

title: Sales and Leasing Specialist
description:
About the job

About the Role




We're looking for a high-energy, results-driven Sales and Leasing Specialist to serve as the

critical first point of contact for every prospective resident who shows interest in our properties.

This is a fast-paced, hybrid position where speed, warmth, and persistence directly translate to

occupancy success. Your mission is simple but vital: connect with every lead within one hour,

convert interest into scheduled property tours, and guide qualified prospects through the

application process to move-in.




This role is perfect for someone who thrives on call volume, loves the challenge of winning

people over, takes pride in flawless execution of a proven system, and has the organizational

discipline to manage multiple prospects through various stages of the leasing journey.




What You'll Do: 




Speed to Lead Execution

• Monitor the CRM continuously throughout your shift for incoming leads across all

properties

• Contact every new lead within 5 minutes via phone (primary) and follow-up

communication

• Make multiple contact attempts using strategic timing and persistence until you reach the

prospect




Tour Conversion & Sales

• Engage prospects with warmth and professionalism, building rapport quickly over the

phone

• Qualify leads, understand their needs and timeline, and match them to the right property

• Overcome objections and address concerns to move prospects toward booking a tour

• Schedule tours and confirm appointments, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks

• Follow up with prospects who haven't responded or are "thinking about it"




Application Management & Administrative Support

• Guide qualified prospects through the application process, ensuring they understand

requirements and timelines

• Proactively follow up with applicants to collect outstanding documents (pay stubs, IDs,

references, etc.)

• Review submitted applications for completeness and accuracy before routing for

approval

• Communicate application status updates to prospects, keeping them informed and

engaged throughout the process

• Coordinate with the property team to resolve application questions and move approved

applicants toward lease signing

• Maintain organized tracking of all prospects in the pipeline—from initial contact through

move-in




CRM Management & Documentation

• Log all call activity, prospect details, objections, and outcomes in the CRM accurately

and immediately

• Update lead status and next steps to ensure seamless handoff to the touring team and

property managers

• Track your own metrics: contact rate, conversion rate, tours booked, applications

submitted, and speed to lead performance




Accountability & Optimization

• Own your daily and weekly goals for calls made, contacts reached, tours booked, and

applications completed

• Identify patterns in objections, application drop-offs, or process bottlenecks and

proactively suggest improvements

• Maintain high energy and quality standards even during high-volume periods




What We're Looking For: 

Required Skills & Traits

• Exceptional Phone Presence – You sound confident, friendly, and genuine. People

want to talk to you even when they didn't plan to.

• Natural Sales Ability – You know how to listen, ask the right questions, create urgency,

and close without being pushy.

• Self-Starter Mentality – You don't need someone looking over your shoulder. You see a

lead, you call it. You see a problem, you solve it.

• Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented – You're tracking dozens of leads and applications

at different stages and nothing slips through the cracks. You thrive on systems, follow-

through, and keeping meticulous records.

• Strong Administrative Skills – You can manage paperwork, chase down missing

documents, and keep multiple applicants moving forward without dropping the ball. You

understand that administrative excellence is what turns tours into move-ins.

• Resilient & Consistent – Rejection doesn't faze you. You understand that 50 calls

might lead to 10 conversations and 3 tours, and you're energized by that reality, not

discouraged.

• Process-Driven – You understand that accurate CRM data and complete applications

aren't busywork—they're what allows the team to win.

• Comfortable with Repetition – You're calling leads and following up on applications all

day. If you need constant variety, this isn't the role for you. If you love perfecting a craft

through repetition, you'll excel here.

Preferred Experience

• 1-2+ years in inside sales, appointment setting, leasing, or customer service roles

(property management experience is a plus but not required)

• Experience working in a CRM system (Yardi, Knock, Rent Manager, Salesforce, or

similar)

• Proven track record of hitting or exceeding call/conversion metrics

• Experience managing application processes, collecting documents, or similar

administrative workflows

• Experience in a hybrid or virtual work environment




What Success Looks Like

Within 30 days, you're:

• Consistently contacting 90%+ of leads within 60 minutes

• Booking 15-20+ tours per week

• Maintaining accurate CRM records with zero missed follow-ups

• Successfully guiding applicants through document submission with minimal hand-

holding from managers




Within 90 days, you're:

• A trusted subject matter expert on objection handling and lead conversion

• Hitting or exceeding monthly tour-booking and application completion targets

• Proactively identifying bottlenecks in the lead-to-lease pipeline and suggesting process

improvements

• Managing a full pipeline of prospects from first contact through move-in with minimal

supervision




Work Environment

• Hybrid position – Work from home with reliable internet and a quiet workspace

• Core working hours required – Leads come in during business hours and evenings;

schedule flexibility within coverage windows

• High call volume – Expect to make 40-80+ calls per day depending on lead flow

• Metrics-driven culture – You'll be measured on activity (calls, contact rate) and outcomes

(tours booked, applications completed)

About the job

PLEASE READ FULLY BEFORE APPLYING.




META ADS SPECIALIST — POSITION OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a skilled, strategic Meta Ads Specialist (Media Buyer) to own paid social performance for our contractor client base. You’ll be responsible for both the strategy driving our Facebook and Instagram campaigns and the hands-on execution that makes them convert — generating qualified inbound leads for land clearing, excavation, and related service businesses.

This is not a pure execution role. You’ll bring a strategic perspective to audience targeting, creative direction, funnel structure, and account-level performance — while also maintaining the high execution standards our clients expect. You’ll work within our established launch SOPs as a foundation and be expected to help evolve them over time.




WHAT WE OFFER

Pay Rate: $12-$17 USD hourly

Paid Time Off (PTO): 10 days (80 hours) per year, prorated first year

Paid Holidays: 9 paid holidays per year

Location: Remote – Flexible work environment

Position Type: Full-Time

Hours: Estimated 40 hours/week

Growth and advancement opportunities




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Strategy & Department Ownership

Campaign Strategy: Develop and refine our overall Meta Ads approach — including funnel structure, audience strategy, creative direction, and offer positioning — to maximize lead quality and volume across all client accounts.
Creative Strategy: Partner with our creative team to brief ad concepts, identify winning angles, and guide the development of assets that perform — not just look good.
Process Improvement: Identify gaps in our current launch SOPs and workflows, recommend improvements, and help build a scalable system for managing a growing client portfolio.
Performance Analysis: Regularly analyze account-level and portfolio-level trends to surface insights and make strategic recommendations to leadership and Account Managers.




Pre-Launch Quality Review

Copy Quality Check: Review all ad copy for accuracy — verify client name spelling, service area cities/regions, tracking phone numbers, and CTA consistency before anything goes live.
Visual Asset Review: Confirm images and videos meet Meta specs, check for pixelation, verify logo clarity, and preview all creative on mobile before launch.
Offer Verification: Confirm all promotions, pricing, and service descriptions match client documentation before going live.




Campaign Build & Setup

Account & Campaign Setup: Verify you’re in the correct ad account, set the correct campaign objective, and follow our internal naming standards.
Audience Targeting: Build geographic targeting to match client service areas, apply demographic filters aligned with ideal customer profiles, and configure exclusion audiences.
Budget & Scheduling: Set daily/lifetime budgets per client approval, configure correct start/end dates, and align bid strategy with the client agreement.
Tracking Setup: Confirm lead data is flowing correctly into WhatConverts and GoHighLevel (GHL) before launch.




Three-Point Quality Gate (Required Before Every Launch)

Self Review: You personally verify every checklist item before submission.
Peer Review: A team member reviews the campaign preview.
Manager Approval: Submit the final ad creative to your Manager for sign-off via ClickUp.




Launch Monitoring & Ongoing Optimization

Post-Launch Monitoring: Monitor the initial hours after launch for delivery issues, disapprovals, or policy flags; verify ads are spending as expected.
Performance Tracking: Review key campaign metrics regularly and flag anything outside expected ranges to the Account Manager.
Daily & Monthly Audits: Conduct daily performance checks on active campaigns; run full monthly account audits.




Error Protocols

Post-Launch Errors: Pause the ad immediately, document the error and its impact, notify your manager quickly, create a corrected version, and file an incident report in the client file.
Client-Reported Errors: Acknowledge promptly, pause affected ads, and provide a corrected timeline to the Account Manager.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have Experience

3+ years managing Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns
Experience running lead generation campaigns for service-area businesses or contractors
Experience owning strategy — not just execution — across multiple client accounts simultaneously
Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign objectives, audience targeting, and placement optimization

Tools You Should Know

Meta Ads Manager (required)

GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM
ClickUp for task management and team communication
AI tools such as Claude for speeding up copy, research, and internal processes




Soft Skills

Strategic thinker who can see the big picture across a portfolio of accounts
Accuracy-first mentality — you proofread, test, and verify before anything goes live
Calm under pressure — you handle errors quickly and professionally
Team-oriented communicator — you ask before you assume
Detail-oriented with systems thinking — you build habits that catch mistakes




SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

description:
About the job

At Paystand, we’re not just another fintech company—we’re trailblazers in decentralized finance (DeFi), transforming how businesses manage their finances. With thriving hubs in Santa Cruz, San Francisco, Austin, Minneapolis, Mexico City, Hermosillo, and Guadalajara, we’re leading a global revolution in financial systems. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years, we’re among the fastest-growing companies reshaping the future of finance.

Our Expanding Ecosystem: Paystand isn’t just a company—it’s a growing global network. With the strategic acquisitions of Teampay, a leader in spend management, and Yaydoo, a top AR and AP platform in Latin America, we’re building an expansive ecosystem designed to revolutionize financial operations and fuel business growth worldwide.

Why Paystand?

What We Do: By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, we digitize receivables, automate financial processes, reduce time-to-cash, lower transaction costs, and unlock new revenue streams for businesses.

Why We Do It: We’re driven by a mission to revolutionize digital payments and decentralize finance, creating a more open, inclusive, and transparent financial ecosystem, starting with B2B payments.

How We Do It: As change-makers in the DeFi movement, we don’t just follow trends—we set them. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of fintech and eager to redefine what financial technology should look like, Paystand is the place where you can make a significant impact.

Join Us: Be part of something bigger. Join Paystand and help us lead the financial revolution.

Role at a Glance

As an Account Executive, this role owns the full sales cycle for Paystand's CFO stack, engaging CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, and Treasury leaders at mid-size and enterprise companies. The role is responsible for creating and closing high-quality revenue opportunities by diagnosing finance pain, quantifying ROI, positioning automation value, and navigating complex buying processes.

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Roma Norte, Mexico City. The role is primarily conducted in Spanish, including day-to-day work and client interactions, but candidates must have advanced professional proficiency in English.

Responsibilities

The following are the primary responsibilities for this role. They may evolve as Paystand's sales strategy, AI-first operating model, and LatAm market priorities continue to mature.


Revenue Ownership & Full-Cycle Execution:
Own the full sales cycle for assigned opportunities, from prospecting and discovery through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Manage inbound and outbound leads generated by SDRs, while proactively identifying and sourcing new business opportunities.
Build and maintain strong pipeline coverage through cold calls, email sequences, LinkedIn, Amplemarket, events, referrals, and targeted account-based outreach.


Consultative CFO-Level Selling:
Conduct high-quality discovery to understand finance pain points, ERP environment, cash flow needs, AR inefficiencies, decision criteria, and buying urgency before moving to demo.
Engage CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, Treasury leaders, and executive stakeholders with strong business acumen and executive presence.
Travel to client sites across the region as needed for in-person demos, executive presentations, relationship building, and negotiation sessions.


Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Value Creation:
Develop tailored commercial proposals, quantify ROI, lead negotiations, and close deals with a focus on long-term customer value and quality revenue.
Continuously improve deal strategy using win/loss analysis, pipeline data, manager coaching, market feedback, and customer insights.
AI-Native Sales Execution:
Use AI tools actively for account research, outreach personalization, call preparation, call analysis, meeting summaries, proposal drafting, objection handling, and deal coaching.
Create reusable AI prompts, templates, talk tracks, and workflows that increase sales productivity while preserving message quality and accuracy.

Requirements

Ideal experience for this role can be gained through professional experience, sales performance, educational background, certifications, or relevant projects.


Professional Background:
2+ years of experience as an Account Executive managing full sales cycles, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, ERP, digital payments, or financial management solutions.
Previous SDR, BDR, or similar sales experience is high valuable. Motivation, business acumen, sales judgment, and ownership matter as much as years of experience.


AI-Native Operating Experience:
Active use of AI tools for sales productivity is expected.
Candidates should be able to describe how they use AI to improve research, outreach, preparation, follow-up, and decision quality.
Market and Industry Knowledge:
Familiarity with financial operations in LatAm, including SAT in Mexico, ERP ecosystems, or finance automation, is a significant advantage.

What We Offer


💵 Competitive base salary + monthly commissions + accelerators.
📈 Stock options / equity participation.
✅ Benefits package above Mexican statutory requirements.
🏥 Major Medical Health Insurance.
🍽️ Complimentary meals provided at the office.
💻 Company provided equipment and tools.
🌎 Opportunity for advancement and growth in a rapidly expanding team.
👨🏻‍🏫 Mentorship, learning, and education programs.
💪🏻 Smart, high-achieving, motivated team that likes to have fun.
🎯 Mission-driven culture, where your work matters.


If you're passionate about driving change in the FinTech landscape and being part of a company that is shaping the future of digital payments, we invite you to explore opportunities with Paystand.

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience manifests in diverse ways, skills are transferable, and passion is a powerful driver. Your journey and skills are unique, and we value the richness that diverse perspectives bring to our team.

More than a resume, we prioritize a genuine commitment, impactful contributions, and the ability to thrive in our dynamic, collaborative environment. We are enthusiastic about providing you with opportunities to learn and grow within this role. If your experience aligns closely with what we're seeking, we encourage you to apply.

We celebrate the belief that diversity in backgrounds and thoughts fuels better problem-solving and fosters more creative thinking. Our commitment to adding new perspectives to the team reflects our dedication to innovation and inclusivity.

Your journey is important to us, and we look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to our team at Paystand. Feel free to reach out; we can't wait to hear from you.

Most of our roles are onsite. Positions that are eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements will be clearly indicated in the job posting.

For roles based in Mexico, only resumes submitted in English will be considered.

About The Job

The YouTube Partner Program engages millions of content creators — a group that’s growing quickly, and will grow even faster in the coming years. The Scaled Partnerships team focuses on driving partner and product success at scale by acquiring, managing, and growing partners. The team spans acquisitions and partnerships to drive outcomes across all partner types and all verticals. The Partnerships team is responsible for managing creators and companies that have reached a certain threshold for strategic importance. Fast-paced, dynamic and proactive, our team goal is to responsibly grow creators and media companies at scale through enriching 1:1 and 1:many engagement, product activations, opportunities, and virtual and in-person workshops.

As a Strategic Partner Manager (SPM), you will manage a portfolio of YouTube creators identified as strategic to our business objectives. You will drive product adoption and optimization across YouTube’s platform priorities while also assessing creators’ needs and goals, crafting a plan to grow their channel, and delivering insights and strategy to enable their success on YouTube. You will deliver against partner performance metrics and core program Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to drive maximum impact.

In this role, you grow in a fast-paced environment, and you are building a working understanding of YouTube internal processes, products, and teams. You support your team in deepening relationships with key partners and creators, helping them optimize and adopt features, enabling YouTube to be successful. You are developing your skills in relationship-building, negotiation, project management, and collaboration, focusing on tasks that contribute to your team's and organization's goals.

Responsibilities


Establish scaled strategic relationships with partners through different engagement types.
Drive product adoption, optimization across YouTube priorities and support creators in their content, monetization and viewership goals.
Ensure your partner portfolio complies with YouTube’s Community Guidelines and M10N policies and support them in navigating YouTube’s support and operations teams.
Engage with and understand the latest features, policies, and platform improvements to help partners succeed.
Project manage initiatives to grow emerging creators, including workshops, events and other scaled initiatives.

description:
About the job

About JC360

JC360 is an Azure-native Workforce Intelligence Platform that helps organizations understand how their workforce operates and identify opportunities to improve productivity, operational efficiency, compliance, and workforce visibility. 

Our platform provides organizations with data-driven insights into workforce activity, productivity, application and technology usage, and operational patterns, helping business leaders make better informed decisions, while reducing the administrative effort required to manage and understand a modern workforce. JC360 is already used by organizations internationally, and we are now expanding our presence in the Mexican market.




We are looking for an experienced Enterprise SaaS Sales Executive who understands the Workforce Intelligence, Employee Monitoring, Workforce Analytics, Productivity Analytics, or related technology market and can independently develop new business opportunities in Mexico.

The successful candidate should have a strong interest in understanding and learning the specific needs, challenges, buying processes, market dynamics of this segment, and be able to translate this knowledge into effective sales strategies and customer conversations.




A Different Approach to Enterprise Sales

This role offers a high degree of autonomy and flexibility and is designed for an experienced sales professional who knows how to generate results.

Rather than following a rigid, predefined sales process or measuring success primarily by the number of calls made or hours spent online, you will have the freedom to determine the approach that works best for you.

This opportunity is particularly well suited to an experienced sales professional who is self-motivated, entrepreneurial, highly independent, and confident in developing their own approach to enterprise sales.




Your Mission

Your primary objective will be to create and close new enterprise business opportunities for JC360 in Mexico.
You will take ownership of the sales process, from identifying potential customers and developing relationships with key decision-makers to demonstrating the platform, managing commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and closing new business.
You will have the freedom to develop the Mexican market in the way you believe will generate the best results.




Key Responsibilities

Identify, develop, and close new enterprise sales opportunities in Mexico.
Build and manage your own sales pipeline.
Identify organizations where Workforce Intelligence, Employee Monitoring, Workforce Analytics, or Productivity Analytics solutions can deliver measurable business value.
Engage with C-level executives and senior decision-makers across Operations, IT, HR, Digital Transformation, Business Transformation, and related functions.
Lead consultative sales conversations, presentations, and product demonstrations.
Manage the full sales cycle from initial engagement through negotiation and closing.
Develop and apply the sales channels and tools you consider most effective.




Sales Experience

We are looking for an experienced sales professional with:

A minimum of 3 years of experience in B2B enterprise sales, business development, consulting, or similar customer-facing commercial role.
A proven track record of generating and closing new business.
A demonstrated history of achieving commercial or sales targets.
Experience managing a sales process from prospecting through negotiation and closing.
Strong consultative selling, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
The ability to independently develop a sales pipeline rather than relying exclusively on company-generated leads.
The ability to work independently and manage your own priorities in a flexible, remote environment.




Preferred Experience

The following experience would be a strong advantage:

Experience selling B2B SaaS solutions to organizations with 500+ employees.
Existing relationships with decision-makers in Operations, IT, HR, Business Transformation, Digital Transformation, or related functions.
An established network within the Mexican enterprise business community.
Proven experience managing enterprise technology sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
Fluency in Spanish and professional working proficiency in English.




The Ideal Candidate

You are likely to be successful in this role if you:

Have experience selling complex B2B technology solutions.
Know how to identify, reach, and influence senior decision-makers.
Are comfortable creating and developing your own sales pipeline.
Value autonomy and flexibility in the way you approach your work.
Are entrepreneurial, commercially driven, and results-oriented.
Are confident experimenting with different sales approaches and channels.
Have the discipline to manage your own time and consistently deliver results.




What We Offer

Freedom and Autonomy

You have the freedom to decide how you work, how you organize your time, and which sales strategies and channels you believe will be most effective.

Remote Flexibility

Work remotely from Mexico with the flexibility to organize your working schedule around your own approach to sales and business development.

Entrepreneurial Opportunity

Play an important role in developing JC360's presence in the Mexican market and contribute to shaping our local sales strategy.

Global Technology

Represent an international Workforce Intelligence platform serving organizations across different markets.

Performance-Based Earning Potential

Competitive compensation with a strong performance-based component linked to successful business development and sales results.




Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates your enterprise sales track record, as these will be important considerations in our selection process.

title: Customer Experience Manager

Direct reports: 3 to 4 (Customer Support Representatives, Accounts Receivable / Disputes Specialist).
Department: Operations, Customer Experience.
Status: Full-time.
We are looking for a Customer Experience Manager to own the post-service side of our business: the moment something goes wrong, and the moment money is owed.
This role leads a small team responsible for two connected functions.
The first is resolving customer issues, including damage claims, refunds, and escalations.
The second is protecting revenue through credit card disputes, accounts receivable, and collections.
Today these responsibilities are split across our Operations team, which has stretched our leadership thin.
You will take full ownership of them.
This is a hands-on management role.
You will coach a team of three to four, but you will also personally handle the hardest escalations and the highest-dollar disputes.
If you like clean processes, direct customer contact, and measurable outcomes, this is a good fit.
Manage and develop a team of three to four specialists across customer support and receivables.
Set daily priorities, monitor queue health, and ensure nothing sits unresolved.
Run regular one-on-ones, handle performance management, and onboard new team members.
Build and maintain response-time and resolution standards, and hold the team to them.
Own the damage claims process end to end: intake, investigation, valuation, settlement, and closure.
Approve refunds and credits within an established authority threshold, and escalate above it.
Serve as the final internal escalation point before the Operations Manager.
Personally handle high-severity, high-value, or reputationally sensitive customer situations.
Coordinate with Pod Leaders and Dispatch to investigate what actually happened on a job.
Oversee credit card dispute and chargeback responses, including evidence packages and rebuttal narratives.
Manage the accounts receivable aging report and drive down days sales outstanding.
Set and enforce the collections cadence, including reminders, escalation steps, and write-off or third-party referral criteria.
Track dispute win rates and identify the operational root causes behind repeat losses.
Report weekly to the Operations Manager on claims volume, resolution time, refund dollars, AR aging, and dispute outcomes.
Identify patterns in complaints and claims, and bring operational fixes to leadership rather than just absorbing the volume.
Document and maintain SOPs, templates, and escalation paths for the team.
Partner with Operations on service-recovery decisions that affect crew or scheduling.
Three or more years in customer support, claims, client services, or collections, with at least one year supervising others.
Demonstrated experience handling escalated customers directly, in writing and by phone.
Working knowledge of credit card dispute and chargeback processes.
Strong written communication, with the ability to build a factual, persuasive case from messy evidence.
Comfort with numbers, including aging reports, resolution metrics, and refund and claim dollar tracking.
Organized and self-directed, able to run a queue without being managed closely.
Experience in moving, logistics, home services, or another operationally complex service business.
Familiarity with claims valuation or insurance and liability concepts.
Experience implementing or improving a support or collections process from scratch.
Proficiency with CRM, ticketing, and payment platforms.
Even-tempered under pressure, and does not take angry customers personally.
Fair but firm, willing to say no to an unreasonable refund request and hold a position on a legitimate debt.
Systems-minded, and fixes the cause rather than the symptom.
Coaches the team rather than doing everything personally.
Learn our service model, common claim types, and current escalation paths.
Meet every team member and understand each person's workload and pain points.
Take over the escalation queue currently sitting with the Assistant to the Operations Manager.
Produce a baseline snapshot of open claims, average resolution time, AR aging, and current dispute win rate.
Establish response-time and resolution standards, and get the team operating against them.
Standardize the claims intake and chargeback rebuttal process with documented templates.
Present a collections cadence and write-off policy to the Operations Manager for approval.
Clear the backlog of aged claims and receivables.
Deliver the first monthly report on claims and revenue-recovery trends, including root-cause findings.
Recommend staffing, tooling, or process changes for the following quarter.

About the job

Position Details:

This position reports to the Operations Manager.
Direct reports: 3 to 4 (Customer Support Representatives, Accounts Receivable / Disputes Specialist).
Department: Operations, Customer Experience.
Status: Full-time.




About This Role:

We are looking for a Customer Experience Manager to own the post-service side of our business: the moment something goes wrong, and the moment money is owed.
This role leads a small team responsible for two connected functions.
The first is resolving customer issues, including damage claims, refunds, and escalations.
The second is protecting revenue through credit card disputes, accounts receivable, and collections.
Today these responsibilities are split across our Operations team, which has stretched our leadership thin.
You will take full ownership of them.
This is a hands-on management role.
You will coach a team of three to four, but you will also personally handle the hardest escalations and the highest-dollar disputes.
If you like clean processes, direct customer contact, and measurable outcomes, this is a good fit.




Team Leadership:

Manage and develop a team of three to four specialists across customer support and receivables.
Set daily priorities, monitor queue health, and ensure nothing sits unresolved.
Run regular one-on-ones, handle performance management, and onboard new team members.
Build and maintain response-time and resolution standards, and hold the team to them.




Customer Support and Claims:

Own the damage claims process end to end: intake, investigation, valuation, settlement, and closure.
Approve refunds and credits within an established authority threshold, and escalate above it.
Serve as the final internal escalation point before the Operations Manager.
Personally handle high-severity, high-value, or reputationally sensitive customer situations.
Coordinate with Pod Leaders and Dispatch to investigate what actually happened on a job.




Revenue Protection and Receivables:

Oversee credit card dispute and chargeback responses, including evidence packages and rebuttal narratives.
Manage the accounts receivable aging report and drive down days sales outstanding.
Set and enforce the collections cadence, including reminders, escalation steps, and write-off or third-party referral criteria.
Track dispute win rates and identify the operational root causes behind repeat losses.




Process and Reporting:

Report weekly to the Operations Manager on claims volume, resolution time, refund dollars, AR aging, and dispute outcomes.
Identify patterns in complaints and claims, and bring operational fixes to leadership rather than just absorbing the volume.
Document and maintain SOPs, templates, and escalation paths for the team.
Partner with Operations on service-recovery decisions that affect crew or scheduling.




Required Qualifications:

Three or more years in customer support, claims, client services, or collections, with at least one year supervising others.
Demonstrated experience handling escalated customers directly, in writing and by phone.
Working knowledge of credit card dispute and chargeback processes.
Strong written communication, with the ability to build a factual, persuasive case from messy evidence.
Comfort with numbers, including aging reports, resolution metrics, and refund and claim dollar tracking.
Organized and self-directed, able to run a queue without being managed closely.




Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in moving, logistics, home services, or another operationally complex service business.
Familiarity with claims valuation or insurance and liability concepts.
Experience implementing or improving a support or collections process from scratch.
Proficiency with CRM, ticketing, and payment platforms.




Who Thrives Here:

Even-tempered under pressure, and does not take angry customers personally.
Fair but firm, willing to say no to an unreasonable refund request and hold a position on a legitimate debt.
Systems-minded, and fixes the cause rather than the symptom.
Coaches the team rather than doing everything personally.




Success in the First 90 Days - Days 1 to 30:

Learn our service model, common claim types, and current escalation paths.
Meet every team member and understand each person's workload and pain points.
Take over the escalation queue currently sitting with the Assistant to the Operations Manager.
Produce a baseline snapshot of open claims, average resolution time, AR aging, and current dispute win rate.




Success in the First 90 Days - Days 31 to 60:

Establish response-time and resolution standards, and get the team operating against them.
Standardize the claims intake and chargeback rebuttal process with documented templates.
Present a collections cadence and write-off policy to the Operations Manager for approval.




Success in the First 90 Days - Days 61 to 90:

Clear the backlog of aged claims and receivables.
Deliver the first monthly report on claims and revenue-recovery trends, including root-cause findings.
Recommend staffing, tooling, or process changes for the following quarter.

Demonstrates proficiency in Google Sheets, CRM tools like Salesforce, and project management software such as Monday.com or Lark to track complex workflows.


Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

About the job

Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will provide category management excellence to clients undergoing procurement diagnostics, value capture waves, or full transformations.

In this role, you will support developing a best-in-class content repository for various categories and ensure consistent delivery and quality to clients.

You will develop sourcing approaches for various categories, drive development of and execute standard analyses across categories to identify savings opportunities, and drive market research and insights. You will help develop capabilities of McKinsey colleagues and clients. You will play a key part in driving process improvement and delivering successful business results. You will contribute to identifying companies that McKinsey can partner with and/or acquire, identifying new solutions, trends, or alternative vendors for us to work with.

You’ll have the opportunity to sharpen your technical skills, develop your knowledge in the procurement and sourcing space and become a skilled practitioner, focused on helping our clients transform their organizations through product portfolio, innovation and design, product optimization, category management and supplier collaboration.

Through this role you will receive distinctive training, apprenticeship, and coaching; work directly with clients and McKinsey CST’s; and have high visibility within the organization including the opportunity to collaborate with entrepreneurial colleagues and senior McKinsey leaders.

You will be based in our Monterrey (Mexico) office as part of our Product Development & Procurement service line. This group blends strategic thinking with hands-on practicality to develop and implement operational strategies that solve our clients’ most critical problems on a global scale.

Product Development & Procurement is a rapidly growing service line that helps organizations unlock growth through product and cost transformations, with an emphasis on sustainability, customer experience, and the latest digital and analytical solutions.

In addition, you will work in cooperation with our worldwide network of consultants to shape McKinsey’s thinking in this area, continuously developing your own knowledge, as well as that of the firm.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor degree in engineering, business, operations or related disciplines with an outstanding record of academic achievement preferred

Must have experience with RFPs, RFQs, supplier selection, contract negotiations, and managing a minimum of a couple million in spend

Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
Exceptional proficiency in Excel & PowerPoint required
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and effectively with people at all levels in an organization
Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing
Willingness to travel

We are a Google Premier Partner agency based in Orange County, California, ranked in the top 3% globally. We recently opened our Guadalajara office in Andares and we are building out the team here.

You will own Meta Ads accounts end to end for US home-services clients. This is a hands-on buying role, not a coordination role. You will be in Ads Manager every day.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Build, launch, monitor, scale and kill Meta campaigns built for lead generation.

Manage daily budget pacing and bid strategy across several client accounts at once.

Test audiences, placements and creative angles systematically, and document what wins.

Brief and QA ad creative with our creative team - hooks, statics, UGC-style video.

Track CPL, cost per qualified lead, lead quality and spend pacing daily, and act on them the same day.

Join calls with US client owners and explain clearly what changed and why.




MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

3+ years hands-on buying inside Meta Ads Manager - you personally in the account, not supervising someone who is.

Lead-generation experience - form fills and phone calls, not ecommerce only.

Strong written and spoken English. You will be on video calls with US business owners.

Located in Guadalajara, or able to reliably work from our Andares office three days per week.

Able to run accounts independently on our systems and tools within two weeks of starting.




NICE TO HAVE

Agency experience running several client accounts at the same time.

Home services or trades clients - roofing, HVAC, plumbing, solar.

Google Ads and Local Services Ads exposure.

GoHighLevel or a similar CRM, call tracking, offline conversion imports.

Meta lead ads, Advantage+ campaigns, Conversions API.




DETAILS

Full-time, hybrid: three days in our Guadalajara (Andares) office, two days remote.

Hiring process: a 15-minute screening call, then a short practical assessment, then a final conversation.

About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we're a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We're hiring an Email & SMS Marketing Contractor to own the lifecycle messaging engine for a fast-growing direct-to-consumer cookware and home goods brand heading into its biggest selling season of the year. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy engagement — you'll audit and optimize the existing Klaviyo flows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment), build new automations to close the gaps in the customer lifecycle, and run a disciplined testing program across subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic. You'll also own the weekly SMS calendar and make sure email and SMS work as one coordinated journey rather than two channels competing for the same inbox. The through-line is holiday readiness: building an August–December testing and optimization roadmap, fixing automation gaps before peak traffic hits, tuning segmentation and cadence to lift repeat purchase rate, and flagging risks like deliverability issues, list fatigue, or flow bottlenecks with enough lead time to actually fix them before Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday shipping deadlines. A strong fit if you're the kind of marketer who QAs every send twice, reads statistical significance properly, and would rather ship five well-documented tests than one big untested swing.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Email Automation & Flow Optimization: Audit, maintain, and optimize existing email automations and flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment — and build new automations to fill gaps in the customer lifecycle.
Testing & Experimentation: Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across subject lines, send times, content, offers, and flow logic/triggers, then recommend and prioritize a testing backlog based on expected impact.
QA & Deliverability: QA every flow for deliverability, rendering, links, personalization, and segmentation accuracy before and during peak season, and monitor flow performance to make data-driven adjustments in real time.
SMS Program Management: Develop and run SMS tests across messaging, timing, frequency, and offers; own and manage the weekly SMS sending schedule and calendar; and keep SMS and email coordinated rather than conflicting or redundant across the customer journey.
Holiday Readiness & Revenue Goals: Build a holiday-specific testing and optimization roadmap for August–December, proactively identify and fix automation gaps before peak traffic hits, and adjust segmentation, targeting, and messaging cadence to support repeat purchase rate and overall revenue goals.
Risk Flagging: Surface deliverability issues, list fatigue, and flow bottlenecks with enough lead time to fix them before key selling periods such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holiday shipping deadlines.
Reporting & Collaboration: Report weekly on test results, flow performance, and SMS program metrics, and partner with creative/design and merchandising teams to keep content and offers aligned with the promotional calendar.




What You Bring

Email Automation Expertise: Proven experience managing email marketing automation in Klaviyo or a similar ESP, with hands-on ownership of lifecycle flows end to end.
SMS Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Klaviyo SMS, Attentive, or Postscript.
Testing & Analytics: A strong understanding of A/B testing methodology and how to read statistical significance, plus an analytical mindset that's comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data to guide decisions.
Segmentation & Lifecycle Strategy: Experience with segmentation strategy and lifecycle marketing, and familiarity with repeat rate, LTV, and revenue-per-recipient as success metrics.
Independent Execution: Comfort working independently in a deadline-driven environment, especially during high-volume holiday periods.
Written Communication: Excellent written communication skills — this is email and SMS copy, after all.




Bonus Points if:

E-commerce/DTC background
Experience with Shopify or similar platforms
Prior experience specifically prepping brands for Q4/holiday peak




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world's best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service

Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client

You've applied, now let's get to work. Here's the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.

title: Legal Assistant
location: Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur, Mexico (Remote)
description:
About the job

The Ledger Law Firm is seeking a highly capable Legal Assistant / Case Manager to join our growing international team. This position will be performed remotely from Mexico and will support our U.S.-based personal injury practice.




We are looking for someone sharp, organized, professional, and emotionally intelligent — someone who can manage details, communicate clearly, and help move injury cases forward with urgency and care.




About The Ledger Law Firm

The Ledger Law Firm is a nationally recognized personal injury law firm representing injured clients throughout the United States, including California, Texas, and Washington. We handle serious injury matters involving car accidents, trucking accidents, premises liability, wrongful death, and other catastrophic injury claims.

Our firm is built on excellence, loyalty, discipline, and client service. We are expanding our Latin American legal team and are looking for outstanding talent to help us continue building one of the strongest plaintiff personal injury firms in the country.




Position Overview

The Legal Assistant / Case Manager will assist attorneys and senior case managers with the daily management of personal injury claims and litigation files. This role requires excellent English, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate professionally with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, and internal team members.

This is a remote position, but it requires a serious professional commitment. We are not looking for someone who simply wants a remote job. We are looking for someone who wants to become part of a high-performance legal team.

Responsibilities

• Communicate with clients regarding case status, treatment updates, documents, and general case questions.

• Assist with opening, organizing, and maintaining personal injury case files.

• Request and follow up on medical records, billing records, police reports, insurance information, and other case-related documents.

• Communicate with medical providers, insurance adjusters, lienholders, and other third parties.

• Track client medical treatment and help ensure clients remain engaged in the process.

• Assist attorneys and case managers with pre-litigation and litigation support tasks.

• Draft, review, and organize correspondence, case summaries, and internal notes.

• Maintain accurate case management records and update files consistently.

• Help identify problems early and escalate urgent issues to attorneys or senior staff.

• Support the firm’s overall mission of delivering excellent client service and strong case outcomes.




Qualifications

• Based in Mexico

• Excellent written and spoken English is required. C1 or C2 English level strongly preferred.

• Law degree, legal studies background, or prior legal experience preferred.

• Experience with U.S. personal injury law, insurance claims, litigation, or medical records is a strong plus.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Strong communication skills and professional judgment.

• Comfortable speaking with clients, providers, insurance representatives, and attorneys.

• Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines without constant supervision.

• Reliable internet connection and quiet professional work environment.

• Strong work ethic, loyalty, and desire to grow with the firm.




Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is intelligent, calm under pressure, responsive, and serious about doing excellent work. You should be able to think ahead, solve problems, and understand that personal injury clients are often dealing with pain, stress, fear, and confusion.

We want someone who can be both compassionate and firm — kind with clients, precise with details, and relentless in follow-up.

This role is especially well-suited for attorneys, law graduates, advanced law students, or experienced legal professionals who want to work with a sophisticated U.S. law firm and develop high-level experience in American personal injury law.




Schedule

Full-time remote position.

The schedule will generally follow U.S. business hours and will be discussed during the interview process.




To Apply respond to this post with your resume & an immediate interview will be setup for qualified candidates.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Business Analyst you would be part of global team. You will work in hybrid model with office in Mexico City and report directly to Manager, Sales Incentive Process Tools and Data.

You will be the support of Anaplan ICM system, standardized global processes and data integration accuracy in/out of Anaplan ICM. Quality of the Anaplan system and process impacts aspects of our business and sales employees including the accuracy and timeliness of sales incentive calculations and reporting.

You will find creative solutions to validate data with technology like Power Platforms and integrations with Anaplan. You will be familiar with the sales incentive plans and administration processes and will develop efficiency changes within global processes

Your Responsibilities


Work with large amounts of data
Define and improve processes for Anaplan data reconciliations to source systems to ensure data accuracy within Anaplan for sales incentive pay and employee SIP reporting
Ensure snapshots from Anaplan GSTO move to ICM including goals, territories, partner functions and other required GSTO data
Support validation of Anaplan sales crediting and focus offering accuracy and completion
Participate in monthly data gathering and maintenance for sales roles where manual data collection is required using tools such as Power BI, power query, power apps.
Research data and integration issues and work with appropriate teams to help resolve and confirm completion
Document global process steps as developed and update
Support and use Agile process, document user stories and acceptance criteria for Anaplan ICM development changes and testing


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree in business, engineering or a technical discipline
Fluency in English


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


2 or more years of relevant experience.
Working knowledge in updating/supporting Microsoft Access database queries (e.g. SQL), Power BI reports, power query, power apps and other Microsoft related tools
Experience with an ERP System, Product Management and CRM Software
Familiarity or background in working with SAP, Anaplan and PBI tools


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
 Our volunteer and donation matching program – We match your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program.
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

title: KYB/KYC Operations Associate, Bridge (CDMX)
skills: Conduct thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews during the onboarding of new users, ensuring the authenticity and accuracy of all customer documentation in compliance with Mexico's regulatory requirements.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of KYC, KYB, and anti-money laundering (AML) regulations specific to the Mexico financial services industry, and apply this knowledge to your daily analyses.
Exercise sound judgment to evaluate complex customer information, make informed decisions on the legitimacy of documentation provided, and determine the appropriate risk profile for each customer.

Handle high-complexity KYC and KYB-related assignments and tasks with a sense of urgency, while promptly resolving incoming requests from internal teams, financial partners, and other external parties.
Adhere closely to process documentation and draft clear, concise investigative summaries and analyses, including the preparation of regulatory reports for submission to the relevant authorities.
Actively participate in building a new team and operational culture focused on robust KYC and compliance practices within the organization.
Leverage your expertise in KYC, KYB, and AML to identify and escalate any suspicious customer activity or high-risk profiles to the compliance team for further investigation and action.

Collaborate cross-functionally with teams such as compliance and fraud to share information and insights that contribute to the overall risk management and mitigation efforts within the Mexican market.
Bilingual in English: Excellent conversational, written, and reading skills.
Professional experience: 2+ years of experience in risk or any type of customer-facing roles within a fast-paced environment.
Resilience and adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in evolving environments, remain composed under pressure, and confidently navigate ambiguity.
Structured mindset: A logical, disciplined approach to problem-solving with a relentless focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
Proactive problem-solver: A self-starter capable of working independently to analyze complex data and make sound, defensible investigative decisions.
Process improvement: The ability to identify operational gaps and proactively implement solutions to enhance workflow efficiency.
Effective communication: Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills to clearly articulate findings and recommendations to internal teams and financial partners.
In-office presence: Full availability to work 100% on-site at our office in Reforma, CDMX.
Startup and tech background: Experience navigating the unique pace and scale of a technology-driven company.
Industry expertise: Deep knowledge of the payments landscape and the fintech industry.
Specialized domain knowledge: A technical background in KYC, KYB, Risk, or Financial Crimes (FC).
Operational agility: Prior experience working within a queue.
description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet.

We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together. We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About Bridge Operations And The Team

As Stripe's user base and global footprint grow dramatically, especially as crypto and stablecoins fundamentally change the way money is transferred, Stripe acquired Bridge to leverage its stablecoin infrastructure for global payments. Stablecoins facilitate faster, cheaper, and more efficient transactions than traditional methods, which creates unique compliance challenges.

The Bridge Operations strategy provides operational leverage and expands Stripe's portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs in this rapidly evolving space. This role will be part of the KYC and KYB Team within the Risk Ops organization in Bridge Operations that is accountable for performing KYC and KYB reviews during onboarding and periodic review.

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who is passionate about fighting risks and solving the puzzle of investigations, is naturally curious, and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and finding creative solutions. You will be responsible for spearheading the organization's KYC and KYB compliance efforts within the Mexican market.

The right candidate for this role will have experience in KYC and KYB compliance, preferably within the fintech or e-commerce space.

About the job

At MongoDB, our Account Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around MongoDB. ADR reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization.

We view our Account Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Account Development Representatives (ADRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at MongoDB.

The Opportunity

Being an ADR is often a first step to jump-starting a career in sales. At MongoDB, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our ADRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers. We invest heavily in the training and development of our team. You will always have the support from our sales enablement org and managers that will maintain 1:1 coaching throughout your career here.

Our ADRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across MongoDB to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mexico City for our hybrid working model.

Day to Day


Identify high-potential businesses that would be a good fit to work with MongoDB across your region
Work with the Sales team to develop and lead inbound and outbound campaigns from idea-generation through to qualified call
Develop strong sales and product knowledge
Interact with IT and business decision makers via telephone and email
Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management
Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team
Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential
Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota
Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business
Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success
