A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals

Desire to work in a fast-paced and high growth environment

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. description:
About the job

Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Who You'll Work With

You will join one our Mexico City office to work in teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.

In this role, you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events in the region. To do so, you will manage and grow a team of Project Managers, Producers, and other types of profiles, while working together with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.

The team you’re about to join (and lead) consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Rocket Internet, Uber, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, Roland Garros.

What You'll Do

As a Regional Manager for Mexico, you will create and lead a team to develop, launch and manage events, from A to Z. You will be responsible for the region’s P&L, team development, development of local connections in the industry and represent Fever across all cities you will be managing. Together with the other departments, you will define the strategy to grow the business in your region and define the scalability of events to all our other markets, working hand in hand with other Regional Managers and the company’s leadership.

In this role, you'll:


Build and manage the team for Mexico (Project Managers, Producers, Location Scouters, etc) that will be generating growth.
Ensure individual team members are effective in achieving their quality and revenue goals on a quarterly basis, by auditing their work and performance on a regular basis
Define the strategy of the region for its growth by ensuring maximum sales performance, customer excellence, and operational quality of our events, to meet quarterly and annual regional goals in all KPIs

Report performance on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis
Provide coaching, mentoring, and feedback to local team members 
Execute detailed analysis of business opportunities and processes
Represent Fever at local events and conversations

MBA from top-tier school preferred
Fluent English & Spanish

Two Travel’s business model revolves around affordable luxury. For many years, concierge services have been looked upon as something for only the rich and famous, but not anymore. What Two Travel has done is figure out a way to add huge value to our clients for only a fraction of their overall trip cost. We make life easier taking care of every aspect of our clients so they have more time to enjoy and explore the city. 

Through our technology, local partnerships, and local employees, we’ve seen consistent growth and now are ready to increase headcount.

About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

This role serves as the business owner and strategic leader of the Walmart Collaborative Ordering capability, with end-to-end accountability for defining the long-term vision, operating model, roadmap, governance, deployment and value realization of one of PepsiCo's most strategic customer collaboration capabilities.

The role is responsible for transforming the replenishment process between PepsiCo and Walmart by integrating collaborative planning, predictive analytics, AI-driven ordering capabilities and digital decision support into a scalable commercial operating model.

Beyond delivering technology, the position defines how Commercial, CPFR, Supply Chain, Data & Analytics and Digital functions collaborate to improve product availability, optimize inventory, increase sales and strengthen strategic customer partnerships.

The position owns capability prioritization, investment recommendations, business cases, customer alignment, operating model evolution and long-term value realization, ensuring the capability becomes a core pillar of PepsiCo's commercial transformation agenda.

Because of its enterprise impact, customer exposure and cross-functional complexity, the role requires senior leadership capable of influencing Directors, Vice Presidents and Global Digital teams while leading multidisciplinary organizations without direct authority.

Your Impact

As Technology Strat & Innov Manager your scope would consist of …


Own the end-to-end Walmart Collaborative Ordering capability, defining its roadmap, governance, operating model and long-term evolution to maximize commercial value. (Accountable for business ownership and capability strategy.)
Lead strategic collaboration with Walmart, aligning business priorities, defining joint initiatives and strengthening collaborative replenishment processes. (Accountable for customer collaboration.)
Define and prioritize business capabilities, translating commercial needs into digital solutions, predictive models and technology investments. (Accountable for capability roadmap and prioritization.)
Drive cross-functional leadership across Commercial, CPFR, Supply Chain, Digital, IT, Finance and Analytics to ensure successful execution and business alignment. (Accountable for enterprise execution.)

needs. Recognizes that while the effect of a single fix may not always be terribly significant, the accumulative effect over time makes each decision extremely

valuable.

INITIATIVE & ADAPTABILITY Does more than is required or expected, not because someone requested it but because it will improve or enhance a product and/or

avoid problems. Plans for upcoming problems or opportunities and takes actions accordingly. Applies original thinking to improve processes, methods, systems, or

services. Deals well with ambiguities, focusing on evaluating a situation, identifying what is and is not a priority, and moving toward the most logical outcome.

stakeholders, building partnerships, leveraging skillsets, and sharing knowledge to achieve a common goal. Creates alignment through mutual accountability,

transparent communications, and the application of change management principles.

description:
About the job

Description

When you join Amazon as an Area Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.

Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. You will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential, As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations.

Job Specifics


 This role is fully onsite and requires flexibility to work and rotate shifts: weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, and Ability to work overtime both in peak season and as needed.
 This role can be hired for any of following locations: Mexico City, Mexico State, Queretaro, Puebla or Morelos.


Key job responsibilities


 Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing
 Analyze and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts
 Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture
 Analyze performance and suggest process improvements to optimize work and improve customer service
 Promote best practice and continuous process improvements across your team in areas like health and safety and productivity
 Collaborate with other managers to standardize shift processes


A day in the life

You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritizing routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.

Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analyzing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

About The Team

Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of direct people management, including performance management and employee development experience
 Bachelor's degree in engineering, commerce, business administration or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon experience
 2+ years of relevant work experience
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience working with KPIs and SLAs
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
 2+ years of logistics operations experience


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
About the job

Director(a) de Gestión y Ejecución Comercial

Buscamos un líder de negocio, no necesariamente un vendedor de carrera, capaz de traducir la estrategia de la compañía en prioridades comerciales y convertirlas en ejecución y resultados.




I. Propósito del Rol

 Buscamos un líder de negocio —no un vendedor de carrera— capaz de traducir la estrategia de la compañía en prioridades comerciales claras y convertirlas en ejecución y rentabilidad. La posición da norte al equipo comercial: define qué debe lograrse y bajo qué parámetros financieros se decide, sin sustituir a los gerentes en la gestión de clientes ni en el "cómo vender".




II. El ADN del Puesto

Primero el negocio: ventas que generan margen y rentabilidad, no volumen por volumen.
Foco 80/20: concentra recursos donde realmente se mueve el resultado.
Autonomía con accountability: empodera sin dejar de medir ni de exigir.
Alta exigencia + alto acompañamiento: exige resultados y respalda al equipo.
Criterio financiero: decide con el P&L en la mano.




III. Responsabilidades Clave

Traducir estrategia en prioridades. Convertir los objetivos del negocio en metas concretas y mantener al equipo enfocado en los clientes, canales y proyectos de mayor impacto.
Instalar disciplina de ejecución. Procesos comerciales repetibles y medibles; seguimiento de prioridades, detección temprana de desviaciones y planes correctivos con responsables y fechas.
Gestionar con criterio financiero. Decidir considerando presupuesto, margen, gasto/inversión comercial y ROI: no solo cuánto se vende, sino cuánto cuesta venderlo y qué rentabilidad deja.
Medir el retorno de la inversión comercial. Evolucionar de lógica de gasto a lógica de inversión; mantener, corregir o eliminar promociones y apoyos según su retorno real sobre el sell-out.
Conectar Ventas con la operación. Alinear demanda, inventarios y capacidad para sostener los objetivos sin sobreinventario.
Liderar y desarrollar al equipo. Exigir, empoderar, acompañar y —cuando el desempeño no mejore tras una oportunidad real— actuar sobre estructura y personas.




IV. Perfil y Experiencia

Líder de negocio con visión integral (ventas, costos, margen, demanda, inventarios) y fuerte capacidad numérica y financiera.
Perfil comercial con marcada orientación financiera, analítica y de procesos.
Pensamiento estratégico con obsesión por la ejecución, la priorización y el sentido de urgencia.
Experiencia dirigiendo gerentes o líderes funcionales, no únicamente vendedores.
Trayectorias válidas más allá de Ventas: Commercial Excellence / Sales Operations, Planeación Comercial o Estratégica, Finanzas Comerciales, Supply Chain u Operaciones con responsabilidad sobre resultados.
Dominio de P&L, presupuestos, KPIs comerciales y ROI de inversiones comerciales.




V. Indicadores de Éxito

VI. Qué NO buscamos (crítico)

 No es un Gerente de Ventas tradicional ni el "vendedor estrella" de la organización. Descartamos a quien: su fortaleza sea administrar clientes personalmente o cerrar negociaciones; persiga ventas sin ver margen ni rentabilidad; evite conversaciones difíciles o tolere el bajo desempeño; necesite controlar cada decisión del equipo; o confunda actividad con resultado




VII. Ofrecemos interesante paquete de compensaciones.

description:
About the job

About the Role:




At TELUS Digital, we help the world’s biggest brands build smarter technology. As a E-commerce Product & Search Relevancy Expert , your mission is to help an AI learn how to suggest the perfect products to online shoppers. You will look at massive catalogs across various industries and decide which items belong together. You act as the "human logic" that ensures a customer sees a matching set or compatible accessories instead of a random, incorrect suggestion.




What You’ll Do:




Create Pairs: Match products based on color, pattern, and style so they are visually consistent.
Check Compatibility: Ensure products actually work together for the same use case. (Example: Matching the right technical gear for specific sub-disciplines like gravel biking vs. road cycling).
Review Metadata: Look at gender, price segment, and seasonality to ensure recommendations are logically and commercially sound.
Maintain Data Integrity: Keep a clean, structured list of matches that follow strict brand and category guidelines.
Category Research: Quickly learn the nuances of new product domains to pick the best matches. (Example: Researching technical differences in skiing, cycling, or gym fitness gear).




Qualification path




Mandatory Qualifications:




Experience: A proven track record in search relevancy, product categorization, or e-commerce content moderation and annotation.
Education: A minimum of a Bachelor's in any field.
Analytical Skills: The ability to learn and differentiate between technical product categories quickly.
Attention to Detail: High sensitivity to visual aesthetics and the ability to spot subtle mismatches in style or price positioning.
Efficiency: Comfortable navigating large datasets and high-volume SKU catalogs while maintaining quality standards.
English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level to navigate technical documentation and product attributes.




Assessment:




In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.




Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community:




Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.
Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.
Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.
Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.
Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.




TELUS Digital AI Community:




Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.




Independent Contractor Relationship:




This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

description:
About the job

About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a Little More


Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word


The Role

Your role will be to boost the growth of TTS in the Latam corridor. You will work to continue launching TTS within various Latam communities in Mexico & Central America, and build a comprehensive, community-oriented growth strategy. While performance marketing is managed centrally, you will lead our local expansion by identifying exactly who our audience follows and trusts. You will conduct deep customer research to understand the emotional side of sending money home; execute high-impact partnerships; and drive boots-on-the-ground awareness to win against our real competition: the in-person remittance counters at Latino supermarkets.

Reporting to our Regional Manager, Latam, you’ll combine great sales and marketing prowess with a data-driven test-and-learn mindset. You’ll be a creative thinker who is always looking for ways to hack growth

The role offers the chance to join a high growth startup and to have a positive impact on the communities we serve. We are looking for a candidate with an immigrant background or a deep, lived understanding of remittance culture. You should have an entrepreneurial spirit, a test-and-learn mindset, and the execution power to drive seasonal campaigns (e.g., Father's Day, back-to-school) from idea to implementation.

Responsibilities


Build trust-based relationships with diaspora communities through in-person and online communications
Conduct customer research with transfer senders on a regular basis
Initiate, negotiate and build partnerships with community associations and organizations
Set up local offline and community-driven awareness campaigns
Source and lead community ambassadors, champions and influencers
Manage customers’ CRM
Optimize Operations with help from Product, Ops, Eng and Support teams
Deepdive into customer pain points and work with the different teams as well as the Country Manager to solve them
Travel to connect with and better understand the Latam diaspora and grow our customer base
Dedicate part of your time to call customers and respond to messages/comments across our our owned media channels
Work with the Country Manager to outline the growth plan for the market, including the growth strategy, monthly budget, targets, CAC, and CRM campaigns


Requirements


Based in Mexico City or NYC.
Relevant experience in high growth-environments (startups, marketing, fintechs); we are flexible on seniority and open to junior or manager level candidates
Exceptional knowledge and networks among the Latam diaspora across [Mexico and Central America]
Strong business development/sales/marketing/analytical background
Experience driving execution-heavy growth initiatives and seasonal community campaigns
Having contacts with Latin influencers and celebrities in [location(s)] is a plus
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Passion for working with and for migrant communities
Resourceful and has the ability to get things done. Also doing “more” with “less”
Fluency in English and Spanish.


Also you are


Outgoing - you love speaking to people and enjoy building meaningful relationships with customers and community members across cultures
Execution oriented - we have an “impact first” philosophy and a lot to be done. You should be able to take an idea to implementation
Mission-Oriented - you are passionate about working with immigrant communities and/or financial inclusion
Flexible - you are comfortable setting your working hours to accomplish your goals, including work commitments on nights and weekends (e.g events or customer meetings)
Organized - you have a system for how you approach your work that can keep you on track in a scrappy startup environment
Driven - you thrive in fast-paced, target oriented environments


Taptap Values 

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

About the job

About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Digital Sharks: Hunting Attention, Converting to Revenue

Marketplace Affiliates Associate (Early Careers)

Team: Global eCommerce, Pure Players — Marketplace Affiliates

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract

Duration: 6 months

Overview

At SharkNinja, we don’t just build products—we create consumer-first experiences that delight millions of customers around the world.

Digital Sharks is our early careers program for the eCommerce Pure Players business — the team responsible for how SharkNinja shows up on the world’s largest marketplaces, including Amazon, Mercado Libre and Takealot. Millions of people discover our products there every day. This program exists to turn that attention into revenue.

We’re looking for a Marketplace Affiliates Associate to join our Pure Players Marketplace Affiliates team and build our affiliate presence on the world’s largest marketplaces.

Affiliate and creator content is one of the fastest growing routes to the marketplace shopper, and one we have barely used outside the US. You will be among the first to run at it seriously in your market — getting content live, learning what works, and writing the strategy off the back of real results rather than assumptions.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is entrepreneurial, creative and comfortable starting from a blank page, and wants to build hands-on experience in affiliate and creator marketing within a fast-paced, global business.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll own a defined market and a measurable business outcome from your first month, while gaining exposure to how a global e-commerce business actually operates.

You’ll


Get 100 pieces of affiliate content live in your market within your first 30-day sprint.
Run tests outside of Creator Connections in the US and through central affiliate go-to-market in your region.
Draw clear implications from the results and write them into our Centre of Excellence playbook.
Identify, contact and onboard creators and affiliate partners in market.
Track performance by format, creator and category, and build a defensible view of what converts.
Work with Sales and Digital Marketing to make sure affiliate traffic lands on pages that are ready to convert.
Prepare recommendations and stakeholder updates for regional and central teams.
Participate in the program operating rhythm, including daily stand-ups, 30-day sprint reviews and weekly Show & Tell sessions where you present your own work.


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, asking questions and working collaboratively to get to a better answer.

You’ll Likely Be


A recent graduate, or in the final year of a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Media or a related discipline.
Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity — this part of the program has no established playbook.
Genuinely interested in creators, content and how people are persuaded to buy online.
Analytical and comfortable working with data to identify trends and support decision making.
A confident communicator who can turn complex information into something clear and actionable.
Proactive, collaborative and eager to learn.
Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Working fluency in English is required.


It Would Be Great If You Also Have


Exposure to affiliate, influencer or creator marketing, including your own content.
An interest in social commerce and creator economics.
Experience using reporting or data visualisation tools.
Familiarity with affiliate tracking or attribution platforms such as Impact, Levanta or Creator Connections.
Additional language skills relevant to your market.


What You’ll Gain

At SharkNinja, you’ll be trusted with meaningful work from day one.

You’ll own a named market and a named business outcome, working alongside experienced commercial leaders on results the business is measured by.

You’ll Benefit From


Ownership of a defined market and a measurable business outcome from your first month.
Mentoring and coaching from an experienced manager, plus a named mentor one level above them.
Direct exposure to the world’s largest marketplaces — Amazon, Mercado Libre and Takealot.
Hands-on experience with AI-native tools, including our Agentic Jailbreak Big Build and APEX agents.
Cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Digital Marketing, Performance Data, Marketplace Affiliates and Media teams.
Visibility with senior leaders through weekly Show & Tell sessions, where you present your own work.
Professional development, networking opportunities and participation in our Early Careers community.


Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

What We Offer

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.

description:
About the job

About MetriSense




MetriSense is a Mexican healthtech startup at pre-Seed stage, a university research spin-off (Tec de Monterrey / University of Houston) developing a point-of-care diagnostic device for metabolic syndrome. We are closing our Seed round and building the founding team.




The role




We are looking for a Chief of Staff to work directly with the CEO as a force multiplier for his execution capacity. This is not an executive assistant role and not a commercial role: it is strategic operations — taking the CEO's objectives and turning them into measurable weekly progress across every front of the company.




You will report directly to the CEO and operate at the intersection of corporate governance, fundraising, scientific-regulatory coordination, and team building.




Responsibilities




Executive cadence: manage the CEO's priority agenda against the company roadmap; prepare and follow up on sessions with co-founders, board, advisors, and investors; ensure every agreement has an owner, a date, and follow-through.
Fundraising ops: maintain the investor CRM, data room, and version control of materials (deck, one-pagers, financial model); coordinate the logistics of the raise and prepare the CEO for every conversation.
Cross-functional coordination: serve as the operational bridge between the CEO and the scientific (CTO, researchers), regulatory, legal, and commercial fronts — track cross-team dependencies and escalate blockers early.
Governance and documentation: own the company's single source-of-truth tracker; prepare minutes, decision memos, and progress reports for shareholders.
Special projects: analysis and execution of direct assignments from the CEO — from market benchmarks to preparing applications for programs and grants.




Who we're looking for




3+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, VC, startup operations, or other high-rigor analytical and execution roles.
A demonstrated ability to run multiple workstreams in parallel with flawless follow-through — this role is measured by what gets closed, not by what gets coordinated.
Excellent executive writing in Spanish and English (we work with U.S. counterparts).
Sound judgment handling confidential information and relationships with shareholders, investors, and academics.
Nice to have: exposure to healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, or regulated environments.
Early-stage mindset: comfort with ambiguity and priorities that shift as new information arrives.




What we offer




- Equity through the company's option plan, with standard vesting.

- Cash compensation.

- Time commitment: part-time with transition to full-time)

- A front-row seat building a health deeptech company from its founding stage, with direct exposure to fundraising, corporate governance, and strategy.

description:
About the job

About Us

We are an entrepreneurial private investment platform acquiring and operating both real estate assets and privately held businesses.

Our real estate strategy focuses primarily on multifamily, industrial, and neighborhood retail properties. Our private equity strategy focuses on established, profitable operating companies across service businesses, healthcare, logistics, distribution, and other fragmented industries.

We move quickly, underwrite rigorously, and value professionals who combine analytical strength with practical judgment, intellectual curiosity, and an ownership mentality.

This is a fully remote position for a professional based in Colombia. The successful candidate must be able to collaborate closely with a U.S.-based investment team and maintain substantial overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Please note: This is not an engineering, appraisal, brokerage, or purely asset-management position. Candidates must have direct transaction experience in private equity, investment banking, real estate investments, corporate development, or another investment-focused organization.




The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Acquisition Associate to lead the evaluation and execution of both real estate and operating-company acquisitions.

The Vice President will work directly with senior leadership and take ownership of opportunities from initial screening through underwriting, due diligence, financing, Investment Committee presentation, closing, and post-acquisition planning.

This role is designed for a transaction-oriented professional who is comfortable building detailed financial models while also communicating with sellers, brokers, investment bankers, lenders, attorneys, accountants, property managers, and operating executives.

The successful candidate must be resourceful, highly organized, commercially minded, and capable of making clear investment recommendations—not simply completing assigned analyses.

Determine which opportunities warrant additional underwriting and senior-management attention
Identify key investment merits, risks, diligence requirements, and potential deal breakers
Prepare clear go, no-go, or pursue-with-conditions recommendations
Challenge assumptions presented by sellers, brokers, investment bankers, lenders, and third-party advisors
Evaluate opportunities based on downside protection, cash-flow durability, growth potential, financing risk, and risk-adjusted returns

Real Estate Underwriting and Valuation

Build, review, and maintain detailed Excel underwriting models
Prepare discounted cash-flow analyses, sensitivity analyses, scenario modeling, financing cases, and equity return waterfalls
Analyze rent rolls, leases, operating statements, trailing financials, budgets, real estate taxes, and capital-expenditure requirements
Evaluate market rents, occupancy, absorption, lease and sales comparables, cap rates, supply pipelines, zoning, and submarket drivers
Calculate and assess cash-on-cash returns, leveraged and unleveraged IRRs, MOIC, debt yield, DSCR, LTV, LTC, and ICR
Evaluate senior debt, mezzanine debt, preferred equity, joint-venture equity, and other capital structures
Review lease provisions, tenant reimbursements, renewal options, tenant improvements, leasing commissions, RUBS, and other property-specific considerations

Private Equity and Business-Acquisition Underwriting

Analyze privately held operating businesses across multiple industries
Build acquisition and leveraged-buyout models, including sources and uses, debt schedules, cash-flow projections, and investor returns
Analyze revenue, gross margin, adjusted EBITDA, SDE, owner add-backs, working capital, capital expenditures, and free cash flow
Evaluate customer concentration, supplier concentration, recurring revenue, employee dependency, cyclicality, and operational risks
Assess historical financial statements, tax returns, budgets, forecasts, and management adjustments
Normalize earnings and identify unsupported, nonrecurring, or questionable add-backs
Evaluate purchase-price structures, seller financing, rollover equity, conventional debt, and SBA financing when applicable
Assist with quality-of-earnings reviews and reconciliation of financial information across multiple sources
Research industries, competitors, market size, growth trends, fragmentation, regulatory considerations, and acquisition opportunities

Transaction Execution

Lead transaction processes from initial evaluation through closing
Coordinate financial, operational, commercial, legal, insurance, environmental, and property-level due diligence
Manage virtual data rooms, diligence request lists, open-item trackers, and transaction timelines
Coordinate with sellers, business owners, brokers, investment bankers, lenders, attorneys, accountants, consultants, property managers, and operating executives
Assist with letters of intent, indications of interest, purchase agreements, lender packages, and financing requests
Track critical transaction milestones and proactively identify delays or unresolved issues
Maintain accurate transaction records, assumptions, correspondence, and supporting documentation
Help ensure that key findings are reflected in transaction structure, pricing, financing, or closing conditions

Investment Committee Materials

Prepare concise, decision-oriented Investment Committee memoranda and presentations
Clearly explain the investment thesis, valuation, business plan, financing structure, projected returns, downside cases, and principal risks
Present model outputs and investment recommendations directly to senior leadership
Distinguish between verified information, management representations, third-party assumptions, and internal estimates
Maintain a clear record of major assumptions and changes throughout the transaction process

Post-Acquisition Planning and Reporting

Translate underwriting assumptions into detailed 100-day post-closing plans
Establish measurable financial, operational, and asset-level priorities
Track actual results against the original underwriting and investment thesis
Identify variances in revenue, expenses, EBITDA, occupancy, rents, capital expenditures, working capital, and cash flow
Create dashboards and reporting tools that highlight material issues and recommended actions
Support portfolio-company and property-level strategic initiatives as needed
Help improve the firm’s post-acquisition monitoring and accountability processes

Artificial Intelligence and Process Improvement

Use Claude, ChatGPT, and other artificial-intelligence tools to improve the speed and quality of investment analysis
Apply AI to review offering memoranda, CIMs, leases, contracts, diligence materials, call transcripts, market reports, and other transaction documents
Develop structured prompts and repeatable workflows for opportunity screening, research, diligence, and investment-memo preparation
Use AI to identify inconsistencies, missing information, unusual financial trends, and potential transaction risks
Build internal templates, checklists, knowledge bases, and standardized investment processes
Verify AI-generated information and never rely on AI conclusions without independent analysis
Stay current with emerging AI tools relevant to private equity, investment banking, real estate, and financial analysis

Minimum Qualifications

3+ years of transaction-oriented professional experience in one or more of the following:
Private equity
Investment banking
Real estate private equity
Real estate acquisitions
Corporate development
Family-office investing
Investment management
Another principal or transaction-focused investment firm
Demonstrated experience underwriting and evaluating acquisitions
Advanced Excel financial-modeling skills
Strong understanding of valuation, cash-flow analysis, capital structures, and investment returns
Experience preparing professional investment memoranda, presentations, or lender materials
Ability to independently review complex transaction materials and identify material risks
Professional working knowledge of Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable AI platforms
Excellent written and spoken English
Strong professional communication skills
Ability to communicate confidently with brokers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, accountants, and senior executives
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
Ability to manage multiple transactions, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
High degree of integrity, discretion, accountability, and professionalism
Must be based in Colombia and able to work with substantial overlap during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Preferred Qualifications

Experience across both real estate and operating-company acquisitions
Experience leading transactions from initial screening through closing
Familiarity with multifamily, industrial, or neighborhood retail investments
Experience evaluating service businesses, healthcare companies, logistics businesses, or distribution companies
Experience reviewing quality-of-earnings reports
Understanding of conventional, commercial real estate, leveraged-buyout, and SBA financing
Familiarity with CoStar, LoopNet, PitchBook, Capital IQ, public-record databases, or comparable research platforms
Experience using CRM systems, pipeline-management tools, and virtual data rooms
Basic experience with Power BI, Tableau, Python, or other data-analysis tools
Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, real estate, business, engineering with substantial transaction experience, or a related field

ICompensation

The position pays $2,000–$3,000 USD per month, based on the candidate’s experience, transaction capabilities, financial-modeling skills, and ability to independently manage investment opportunities.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
skills: Campaign Strategy: Develop and refine our overall Meta Ads approach — including funnel structure, audience strategy, creative direction, and offer positioning — to maximize lead quality and volume across all client accounts.
Creative Strategy: Partner with our creative team to brief ad concepts, identify winning angles, and guide the development of assets that perform — not just look good.
Process Improvement: Identify gaps in our current launch SOPs and workflows, recommend improvements, and help build a scalable system for managing a growing client portfolio.
Performance Analysis: Regularly analyze account-level and portfolio-level trends to surface insights and make strategic recommendations to leadership and Account Managers.
Copy Quality Check: Review all ad copy for accuracy — verify client name spelling, service area cities/regions, tracking phone numbers, and CTA consistency before anything goes live.
Visual Asset Review: Confirm images and videos meet Meta specs, check for pixelation, verify logo clarity, and preview all creative on mobile before launch.
Offer Verification: Confirm all promotions, pricing, and service descriptions match client documentation before going live.
Account & Campaign Setup: Verify you’re in the correct ad account, set the correct campaign objective, and follow our internal naming standards.
Audience Targeting: Build geographic targeting to match client service areas, apply demographic filters aligned with ideal customer profiles, and configure exclusion audiences.
Budget & Scheduling: Set daily/lifetime budgets per client approval, configure correct start/end dates, and align bid strategy with the client agreement.
Tracking Setup: Confirm lead data is flowing correctly into WhatConverts and GoHighLevel (GHL) before launch.
Self Review: You personally verify every checklist item before submission.
Peer Review: A team member reviews the campaign preview.
Manager Approval: Submit the final ad creative to your Manager for sign-off via ClickUp.
Post-Launch Monitoring: Monitor the initial hours after launch for delivery issues, disapprovals, or policy flags; verify ads are spending as expected.
Performance Tracking: Review key campaign metrics regularly and flag anything outside expected ranges to the Account Manager.
Daily & Monthly Audits: Conduct daily performance checks on active campaigns; run full monthly account audits.
Post-Launch Errors: Pause the ad immediately, document the error and its impact, notify your manager quickly, create a corrected version, and file an incident report in the client file.
Client-Reported Errors: Acknowledge promptly, pause affected ads, and provide a corrected timeline to the Account Manager.
3+ years managing Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns
Experience running lead generation campaigns for service-area businesses or contractors

description:
About the job

PLEASE READ FULLY BEFORE APPLYING.




META ADS SPECIALIST — POSITION OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a skilled, strategic Meta Ads Specialist (Media Buyer) to own paid social performance for our contractor client base. You’ll be responsible for both the strategy driving our Facebook and Instagram campaigns and the hands-on execution that makes them convert — generating qualified inbound leads for land clearing, excavation, and related service businesses.

This is not a pure execution role. You’ll bring a strategic perspective to audience targeting, creative direction, funnel structure, and account-level performance — while also maintaining the high execution standards our clients expect. You’ll work within our established launch SOPs as a foundation and be expected to help evolve them over time.




WHAT WE OFFER

Pay Rate: $12-$17 USD hourly

Paid Time Off (PTO): 10 days (80 hours) per year, prorated first year

Paid Holidays: 9 paid holidays per year

Location: Remote – Flexible work environment

Position Type: Full-Time

Hours: Estimated 40 hours/week

Growth and advancement opportunities




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Strategy & Department Ownership

Campaign Strategy: Develop and refine our overall Meta Ads approach — including funnel structure, audience strategy, creative direction, and offer positioning — to maximize lead quality and volume across all client accounts.
Creative Strategy: Partner with our creative team to brief ad concepts, identify winning angles, and guide the development of assets that perform — not just look good.
Process Improvement: Identify gaps in our current launch SOPs and workflows, recommend improvements, and help build a scalable system for managing a growing client portfolio.
Performance Analysis: Regularly analyze account-level and portfolio-level trends to surface insights and make strategic recommendations to leadership and Account Managers.




Pre-Launch Quality Review

Copy Quality Check: Review all ad copy for accuracy — verify client name spelling, service area cities/regions, tracking phone numbers, and CTA consistency before anything goes live.
Visual Asset Review: Confirm images and videos meet Meta specs, check for pixelation, verify logo clarity, and preview all creative on mobile before launch.
Offer Verification: Confirm all promotions, pricing, and service descriptions match client documentation before going live.




Campaign Build & Setup

Account & Campaign Setup: Verify you’re in the correct ad account, set the correct campaign objective, and follow our internal naming standards.
Audience Targeting: Build geographic targeting to match client service areas, apply demographic filters aligned with ideal customer profiles, and configure exclusion audiences.
Budget & Scheduling: Set daily/lifetime budgets per client approval, configure correct start/end dates, and align bid strategy with the client agreement.
Tracking Setup: Confirm lead data is flowing correctly into WhatConverts and GoHighLevel (GHL) before launch.




Three-Point Quality Gate (Required Before Every Launch)

Self Review: You personally verify every checklist item before submission.
Peer Review: A team member reviews the campaign preview.
Manager Approval: Submit the final ad creative to your Manager for sign-off via ClickUp.




Launch Monitoring & Ongoing Optimization

Post-Launch Monitoring: Monitor the initial hours after launch for delivery issues, disapprovals, or policy flags; verify ads are spending as expected.
Performance Tracking: Review key campaign metrics regularly and flag anything outside expected ranges to the Account Manager.
Daily & Monthly Audits: Conduct daily performance checks on active campaigns; run full monthly account audits.




Error Protocols

Post-Launch Errors: Pause the ad immediately, document the error and its impact, notify your manager quickly, create a corrected version, and file an incident report in the client file.
Client-Reported Errors: Acknowledge promptly, pause affected ads, and provide a corrected timeline to the Account Manager.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must-Have Experience

3+ years managing Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns
Experience running lead generation campaigns for service-area businesses or contractors
Experience owning strategy — not just execution — across multiple client accounts simultaneously
Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign objectives, audience targeting, and placement optimization
Familiarity with Meta ad specs across Feed, Stories, and Reels placements
Experience with creative QA processes and pre-launch checklists




Tools You Should Know

Meta Ads Manager (required)
Meta Business Suite
WhatConverts or similar call/lead tracking platform
GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM
ClickUp for task management and team communication
AI tools such as Claude for speeding up copy, research, and internal processes




Soft Skills

Strategic thinker who can see the big picture across a portfolio of accounts
Accuracy-first mentality — you proofread, test, and verify before anything goes live
Calm under pressure — you handle errors quickly and professionally
Team-oriented communicator — you ask before you assume
Detail-oriented with systems thinking — you build habits that catch mistakes




SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Zero campaigns launch with errors, broken links, or incorrect client info
Every campaign passes the three-point quality gate before going live
Post-launch monitoring happens promptly and consistently
Errors (when they happen) are caught quickly, escalated immediately, and documented properly
Our Meta Ads strategy and SOPs improve over time based on your insights
Clients see consistent inbound lead volume and are proud of how their brand is represented

Sporty Group is a consumer internet and technology business with a sports media, gaming, social and fintech platform serving millions of daily active users, run out of hubs in more than 10 countries. We're home to SportyBet, SportyTV, Sporty.com, Football.com and SportyFM, and we're partnered with Real Madrid FC, Michael Essien and Éder Militão.

LATAM is one of our fastest-moving markets, and Customer Success sits at the front of it.

What The Role Looks Like

Our Customer Success team owns every first interaction a user has with us. You'd be resolving queries, complaints and issues across chat, email and phone, educating users on how our products work, and feeding what you hear back to the people who build them.

Day To Day That Means


Resolving issues at first contact (we track FTR/FCR seriously)
Handling outbound and follow-up calls alongside inbound volume
Knowing our products in genuine depth, not script-deep
Escalating priority issues quickly to Ops and your Team Leader
Passing product and market feedback to stakeholders
Keeping clean, accurate customer records
Working with our international CS teams across time zones

1–2 years in customer support, contact centre, or client success
Fluent Portuguese and English (São Paulo) or fluent Spanish and English (Mexico City), spoken and written
Comfortable on the phone with customers, not just on chat
Familiar with a service desk: Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira or similar
Composed under pressure, high volume, demanding users
Willing to work a rotational shift pattern including weekends and public holidays
Online gaming or sports betting experience is a plus, not a requirement


Where

São Paulo or Mexico City. These are in-office roles, so you need to be in one of those cities or ready to relocate at your own cost.

What You Get


Competitive local salary plus quarterly performance bonuses
Local employment contract and benefits package
Top-of-the-line equipment
Annual company off-site
Referral and flash bonuses
A team that promotes from within a lot of our LATAM Team Leaders started as Associates


How This Works

Register your interest and a recruiter reviews it — every profile is read by a person, AI isn't used in our recruitment process. If there's a fit now, we'll be in touch inside 48 hours. If not, you stay in the pool and we'll come back to you when a seat opens in your city.

If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process, tell us.

About the job

Hey there!

At Factorial, we’re looking for a new Inbound Sales Development Representative for the LATAM market to help take Factorial to the next level.

If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, this role is perfect for you. We’re building this business unit from the ground up, which means plenty of opportunities to take ownership, drive initiatives, and create your own processes.

Ready to take on the challenge? 🚀

We believe in developing our people, sharing our culture, and spreading our vision of how Human Resources can make a real impact on organizations around the world.

About The Team 👥

Our Partners team is on a mission to connect businesses with the HR solutions they need to grow — and we’re just getting started. If you love the thrill of building real relationships and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future of HR, this is your place.

The Role 📜


Prospect, develop strategies, and qualify the best leads together with Partners.
Reach out to prospects through high-volume cold calling (60–80 calls per day), networking, email outreach, digital marketing campaigns, and social media engagement.
Build your own strategy to research and analyze prospect information online and leverage it throughout the sales process.
Analyze prospects’ business needs, understand their processes, determine requirements, and identify potential solutions.
Identify new strategic partners and manage the full sales cycle until they join our Partner Program.
Build and maintain strong relationships with potential partners that align strategically with us in the HR and technology space (our partners sell, implement, and support Factorial).
Continuously gather feedback from partners and their clients to identify challenges and opportunities that strengthen our partnerships channel.
Report directly to the Partnership Manager and the Senior Leadership Team.


Your Profile 🤓


Intermediate to advanced English proficiency.
Hunter mindset: driven by success, persistent, and energetic in achieving results.
1+ year of experience in B2B, SaaS, or Tech sales.
1+ year of experience in sales or channel roles, preferably managing a full B2B sales cycle.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability in everything you do.
Detail-oriented, organized, ethical, responsible, and highly self-motivated.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to quickly build rapport with people.


Bonus Points ✅


Experience in startups or high-growth environments.
Knowledge and/or experience in Human Resources, Software, Payroll, and/or the SMB market.
Experience using sales tools such as HubSpot.
Experience working with partnerships and channel sales/distribution is a strong plus.


Factorial bets for potential and growth. We currently evaluate all seniority levels, as we believe diversity and collaboration are the key for rocking the world! If you seek a place to demonstrate ownership of your own success, but you don't meet every point of this Job Description, please, apply anyway!

Benefits 🎉

Perks of Being Part of Our Team!


High-growth, multicultural, and friendly environment.
Language exchange opportunities at Factorial.
Free coffee and tea ☕️
Private health insurance, nutrition, and therapy support.
Wellhub (Gympass) 🧘🏻‍♀️
Hybrid work model and shorter Fridays.
Breakfast and snacks 🥞🍒


About Factorial 🚀

Factorial is an all-in-one HR software company founded in 2016 and one of the fastest-growing companies in the HR tech space. Our mission is to help small and medium-sized businesses automate HR workflows, centralize employee data, and make better business decisions.

Today, we serve thousands of customers in more than 60 countries across multiple industries. We’ve built a diverse and multicultural team of over 900 people across our offices in Barcelona, Brazil, Mexico, and the United States. 🌎🌎

Our Values🫀


We own it: We take responsibility for every project. We make decisions, not excuses.
We learn and teach: We are committed to learning something new every day and, most importantly, sharing that knowledge with others.
We partner: Every decision is a team decision. We trust one another.
We grow fast: We move quickly. We believe the biggest mistake is failing to learn from our mistakes.

About the job

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

You’ll be the face and voice of Deel for our clients, both internally and externally. In this dynamic role, you’ll be responsible for onboarding clients and setting them up for durable relationships with Deel to enable long-term success. You will serve as our client’s trusted advisor by providing strategic guidance during the onboarding phase on operational and product-related issues. Simultaneously, you will be an internal advocate for clients with Deel by championing new products and capabilities to facilitate the expansion of each client’s business with Deel. You will facilitate on-time onboarding through project management of all stakeholders involved.

You are a passionate business builder at heart. You get energized by tackling complex, challenging, often ambiguous problems and driving real impact across a business. You are not afraid to get your hands dirty to deliver projects. You are a talented generalist at home, diving into data for insights, and confident in cross-functional project management with multiple stakeholders. Working with great people is a non-negotiable priority because you thrive in a highly collaborative, high-performance team. If that is you, join our team!

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our Vendor Hub Program team. As Account Manager, you'll work with selected vendors to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for looking after a brand’s product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed monthly reports on performance. You’ll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive category growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical skills as well as relationship management and organizational skills. You will also be comfortable picking up new technologies. You'll be an analytics expert, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions, with the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.

Account Manager are fully involved in the following functions: online marketing, vendor management and in-stock management. Tasks associated with these functions include:


 Online marketing: improving product page data, developing marketing and merchandising plans, improving customer experience onsite, helping generating traffic and sales
 Vendor management: help growing selection of products to sell on Amazon, onboarding new vendors, identifying and resolving pricing issues
 In-stock management: tracking purchase orders, investigating late deliveries, resolving order rejections, working with vendors on PO automation.


About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 2+ years of sales or account management experience
 2+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
 Experience with Excel
 Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience analyzing key open issues and resolution metrics for each of the managed accounts
 Experience in relationship management within technology, start-ups, or SaaS Platforms

AliVet está construyendo el mejor grupo de hospitales veterinarios de México. Integramos hospitales, elevamos su estándar médico y operativo y los convertimos en referentes de sus ciudades.

Marca & contenido

Construir el sistema de marketing de AliVet y convertirlo en una fuente medible de crecimiento.




Mediremos tu éxito por:




* Nuevos clientes y CAC.

* Tráfico y leads generados.

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

The Account Executive (AE) is a highly motivated self-starter who is responsible for developing and closing new business or expanding our footprint with current customers within the SMB business segment. A successful AE is eager to learn, determined to adapt quickly, and comfortable with some ambiguity. AEs are focused on acquiring new customers or selling additional use cases, products and services into existing accounts. This person is accountable for exceeding monthly and quarterly quotas, proactive deal management, forecast accuracy, and driving adoption and usage with customers and prospects in collaboration with internal teams and the broader Docusign partner ecosystem.

Collaborate effectively and engage various pre and post sales resources including Sales Development Representatives, Market Development Representatives, Solutions Engineers, Account Managers, Partner Account Managers, as well as Legal, Security, Professional Services and Customer Support

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Basic

Preferred


Experience managing and closing software sales-cycles 
Demonstrated ability to over-achieve quotas in past positions
Proficient computer application skills, including Salesforce.com, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel
IT industry and multinational environment background
English – intermediate level and above


Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
