description:
About the job

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an independent business, startup, SMB, or enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over 1 million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We'll achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all our growth.

Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of "growing the GDP of the Internet." Stripes leverage understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.

What you'll do

Stripe launched Stripe Delivery Centers—a new global team to design, implement, and grow Stripe operations for the next decade. We are looking for dynamic and curious people who have a passion for solving global user issues, building operations, driving process improvement, and playing a front-line role in building this new operational capability for Stripe and accelerating growth. If you like challenging, scaled problems and are an amazing teammate, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand new team and operational culture for Stripe
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems.
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations.
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes. You are an organized self-starter with a passion for finding solutions to our users' challenges.
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.
You're willing to work a weekend shift pattern (either Sun-Thur (with Fri and Sat off) or Tue-Sat (with Sun and Mon off)). The SDC operates during daytime hours in 9-hour shifts (including 1-hour paid lunch break) scheduled to fall between the hours of 6am and 10pm.



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience in troubleshooting
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

Hey, Hi, Hello! 👋

My name is Connor Wilson. I’m the Founder and CEO of Pilot.

But before I talk about us, I want to talk about you.

If you’re reading this job description, you’re probably either unemployed and need a job…

…or you’re already employed, but for some reason or another…

…you’re here…

…because whether you realize it or not, you’re not as happy as you could be.

There could be a lot of reasons for this. Here’s a few:

🚩 You’re overworked and/or underappreciated
🚩 You lack faith, trust or closeness to your colleagues or leaders
🚩 Your company is bureaucratic, lacks transparency, or makes siloed top-down decisions
🚩 You lack autonomy, freedom, or potential for growth
🚩 You’re bored, aren’t learning or being challenged, or don’t care about what you’re working on or what your company does or who it serves
🚩 Your company has an unhealthy or undesirable culture

We’ve been there.

I’m here to tell you it doesn’t have to be that way.




Why you should work at Pilot 🙋‍♀️

If you think you’d like working at a company whose very purpose is to give you and others the absolute best life possible, in the most fun way possible, working on cool things with cool people, to help people have an awesome time and make memories…

…well then Pilot might just be the place for you.

It’s embedded into who we are. That’s why we have a public 23-page culture code. Read it here to see if we vibe: https://bit.ly/3KmavZF

At Pilot you’ll get…
🌴 A flexible schedule, with unlimited paid vacation (with manager approval/coordination) and competitive pay so you are rewarded for the business you bring in.
🙌 Near total autonomy and freedom. You pick your own projects, set your own goals, and work the hours you want, with who you want. Other than the days we get together in person, you work wherever you like. Our team travels all over the world, and you can too.
🎊 Work with people who all want to be your friend (we actually hang out). Our team is incredibly talented, but we value humility.
🤓 Leaders who own their mistakes (yes, that includes me), actively seek feedback to identify and solve them, and are pretty experienced. You can learn more about me at connorjwilson.com. TL’DR: this isn’t my first startup. My last one, NiceJob, sold for $30M in 2021 after we grew it for 3 years without investors, reaching $3.5M in annual recurring revenue.
🧪 Decisions based on data, not based on that LinkedIn post your manager saw that one time. Everyone at every level is empowered to make decisions because we share everything and have a culture of transparency, trust, and experimentation.
✈️ It’s travel, so it’s super fun. It’s a startup, so it’s super challenging with a huge upside. And it’s social impact focused, so you’ll actually be helping people, not just maximizing profits.
🧳 Paid travel on occasion, for training and research. So far we’ve paid for team trips to and around Thailand, Taiwan, Colombia, Portugal, Spain, Hungary, Turkey, India, San Francisco, Vancouver, Toronto, and more. These have been very valuable for the team and we’ll keep doing them.
🌎 We’re proud to have a diverse team, with plans to become a B-Corp eventually.
⭐ We also have some great employer reviews here: glassdoor.ca/Reviews/Pilot-Reviews-E3311415.htm

Reviews and culture code: Glassdoor | Culture code | About Connor

“Okay, but what even is Pilot?” 🤔

Great question. Glad you asked.

Pilot is multiplayer consumer AI for travel: the free web & mobile app where groups plan, decide, & book trips together.

💸 We’ve raised about CA$2.2M to date, from funds and from angels including the founders of Moment Energy, Nexonia, Farewill, and DayOne, plus an AI engineering leader at Meta.
😎 Today we’re a team of about 10, led by people who all ship code daily and talk to customers weekly. Check out the team at pilotplans.com/careers
🏆 Our product is live (try it at pilotplans.com). We started with the free trip planner, and now we book too, as merchant of record across 3.2 million stays.
🎉 Over 120,000 travelers have used Pilot to help book and plan their trips
⌚ And it seems to be working. After 10 minutes of planning, 60% of users say they’d be very disappointed to lose Pilot, against a 40% benchmark for product-market fit. People who book come back at 50% after 90 days, close to 3x the travel industry average. We’re rated 4.4 on Trustpilot. Most big OTAs sit under 2.
🚀 We’re growing fast. We went from near-zero to a $1.2M gross-booking run rate in six months, on $10,500 of ad spend. We’re live on Google Travel, which is distribution usually reserved for much later-stage companies, and we’ve signed Skyscanner, Viator, GetYourGuide, Tiqets, Omio, Enterprise, and Faye.
🧮 We’re also unusually efficient. Net burn averaged about $14,600 a month in the first half of 2026, roughly 80% below typical for our stage, with a burn multiple of 0.83. Under 1 is top decile. That means new money goes to growth, not survival.

So that’s us. Feel free to learn more about us at: pilotplans.com/careers

The role. The goal. 🛣️

Here’s what we’re looking for from you:

It is very simple. We want someone to own group bookings end to end, and to win more of them. Retreats, conferences, weddings, sports teams, and larger friend and family trips keep finding us on their own, and we have never had anyone dedicated to them. That is what this role is.

Half the job is looking after the groups that come to us. The other half is going and finding more, through business development and marketing. It is some of the best business we get, and nobody owns it yet. You would.

What you’ll be doing and learning 🧑‍💻

Drumming Up New Business

Go and find group business rather than waiting for it to arrive
Build relationships with the kinds of organisations that travel in groups: companies, clubs, teams, event organisers, wedding planners
Work with marketing on campaigns, partnerships, and content aimed at group travel
Follow up with past groups and turn one trip into the next one
Bring us ideas for where group demand is hiding, then go and get it
Owning Group Requests
Respond quickly to group, retreat, and wedding block enquiries
Work out what the group actually needs: dates, size, budget, flexibility, and who makes the call
Put together options and quotes a group can decide from, not a wall of links
Follow up until they decide, without being pushy
Sourcing & Holding Inventory
Source rooms, rates, and holds with hotels and our distribution partners
Negotiate group rates and terms
Get confirmed options into Pilot so the group can plan around them
Keep track of what we are holding and when it expires
Booking & Vendor Operations
Place bookings, confirm them with the property, and keep good records
Get on the phone with hotels and partners when that is what resolves it
Sort out booking errors, availability problems, and special requests
Handle changes and cancellations all the way through to travel
Support During & After the Trip
Be reachable when a group is travelling and something goes wrong
Handle escalations calmly and with urgency
Make sure people feel informed and taken care of
Follow up afterwards and turn a good trip into repeat business
Making It a System
Build the templates, processes, and documentation so the next one is easier
Flag recurring problems to product and engineering
Keep an eye on how the pipeline is converting and what it is worth
Anything else as needed. We are a startup, so this is subject to change!




Treat everything above as a starting point, not a job spec carved in stone. It is not exhaustive, and it will change.




“Should I apply??!??!?” 🤯

First of all, obviously.

It’s easy, and you can do it here: https://forms.gle/D1HrBVbDteJqXwZYA

Second of all, as long as you think you have either the necessary skills, or the ability to learn them very quickly to do this role, you’re good. We care about your ability to execute, not your experience, though it certainly can be an indicator.

That said, the ideal candidate probably has these traits…

Core Traits and Working Style
Calm under pressure and emotionally steady, even when a group of 30 needs an answer tonight
Highly reliable, detail aware, and follows things through to completion
Acts with urgency and does not let issues linger
Comfortable working without perfect information and making good judgment calls
Polite, respectful, and empathetic with guests and partners, while still being firm when needed
Low ego. Focused on solving the problem, not defending themselves
Business Development and Marketing
Comfortable generating business, not just servicing it. Happy to go out and find the next group
Comfortable asking for the business without being pushy
Can negotiate rates and terms with a hotel and hold a position
Has ideas about where demand comes from, and is willing to test them
Motivated by closing and by margin, not just by clearing a queue
Communication and Execution
Very strong written communication. Clear, concise, and human
Comfortable getting on the phone with guests, hotels, and partners
Knows when async is enough and when a call resolves things faster
Able to explain issues and next steps clearly to non-technical people
Availability and Responsiveness
Genuinely available on an on-call basis, including some evenings and weekends when a group is travelling
Comfortable working Pacific time hours for North American groups
Comfortable with fast-moving environments and shifting priorities
Understands group travel is time sensitive and that dates expire
Experience and Background
Prior experience in group sales, hotel sales, events, travel agency work, hospitality, or customer support is strongly preferred
Experience dealing directly with customers or external partners is a plus
Travel or hospitality experience is helpful but not required
Based in or near Guadalajara, and able to be with us in person 1 to 3 times a week

If you meet even 50-70% of these you could be a great fit!

About the job

Comparte tu experiencia e impulsa a la próxima generación de emprendedores

¿Has construido una comunidad en redes sociales? ¿Has desarrollado estrategias digitales para marcas o proyectos? ¿Te apasiona compartir conocimiento y enseñar desde la experiencia?

En Liberu estamos desarrollando un programa de capacitación dirigido a emprendedores del sector de alimentos que buscan fortalecer su presencia en redes sociales, conectar con nuevos clientes y hacer crecer su negocio mediante estrategias digitales.

Para ello, buscamos especialistas con experiencia comprobada que deseen impartir workshops prácticos, dinámicos y basados en casos reales.







¿Qué tipo de perfiles buscamos?

Estamos en búsqueda de profesionales con experiencia comprobable en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

Social Media Management
Planeación Digital
Marketing Digital
Branding Digital
Creación de Contenido
Influencer Marketing
Community Management
Producción de Contenido

También invitamos a postularse a creadores de contenido que hayan desarrollado comunidades sólidas y deseen compartir su experiencia.







¿Qué buscamos en un speaker?

Más allá de la experiencia profesional, buscamos personas capaces de enseñar de forma clara, cercana y práctica.

Valoraremos especialmente perfiles que:

Disfruten compartir conocimiento.
Expliquen conceptos de manera sencilla.
Enseñen a partir de experiencias reales.
Tengan facilidad para hablar frente a grupos.
Inspiren a emprendedores y pequeños negocios.
Promuevan el aprendizaje mediante ejercicios y ejemplos prácticos.

Nuestro objetivo no es ofrecer clases teóricas, sino talleres que permitan a los participantes aplicar lo aprendido desde el primer día.

Revisaremos la experiencia profesional, trayectoria y propuesta preliminar de cada candidato.

Los perfiles preseleccionados participarán en una videollamada para conocer su experiencia, metodología de enseñanza y estilo de comunicación.

Los speakers seleccionados trabajarán junto con el equipo de Liberu para desarrollar y adaptar el contenido definitivo de su workshop, alineándolo con los objetivos del programa.

description:
About the job

Why this role exists




Charles, our founder, spends most of his week talking with the owners of short-term rental property management companies. Five or six of those conversations get recorded every week, and almost nobody sees them. Your job is to change that. You'll take everything he says on camera and turn it into the newsletter, clips, and posts that make him the best-known voice in this industry. He hits record and reviews your drafts once a week. Everything in between belongs to you.

About HostGenius




HostGenius is a private membership network and business operating system for short-term rental property management companies. More than 70 member companies managing about 3,000 properties run on our platform. Charles scaled his own property management company to 160 listings before starting HostGenius, so when he talks about this business, operators listen. We're profitable and growing fast, and this role turns his daily conversations into a growth channel.

What success looks like




A year from now, thousands of US property managers read our weekly newsletter. Clips go up on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube every week, and every word sounds like Charles wrote it himself. He spends under two hours a week on content once the cameras are off. The sales team uses proof clips you found. The ads team runs creative you handed them. When we host an industry event, you stretch one week of recording into three months of material.




What you will own

Turning raw recordings into published content. You pick the moments worth keeping, cut clips with Riverside's Magic Clips, and write the hooks and captions.
Final copy for the weekly newsletter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Our AI pipeline produces first drafts for you. You run it, check it, and edit everything until it sounds like Charles.
The publishing calendar. Everything ships on time every week without anyone chasing you.
The weekly review with Charles. One approval pass. You ship what he approves and rework what he flags.
A weekly scoreboard: what shipped, newsletter growth, engagement from actual property managers, and which clips went to the ads team.
Freelance editors, once long-form YouTube outgrows Magic Clips. They cut, you direct.




Not in scope: paid ads (our Growth Marketing Manager owns Meta), long-form video editing (we will outsource it), and inventing strategy from scratch. The system is already designed. Your job is to run it every week and keep making it better.




What we are looking for




Required:

3+ years running content production end to end for a company, founder, or creator, with published work you can show us
Written English at a native level. You'll be ghostwriting a Canadian founder, and if your copy needs a second edit before it ships, this isn't your role. Finalists complete a paid writing test in his voice.
Good instincts for short-form video. You can listen to an hour of conversation and know which 40 seconds will stop someone scrolling.
The discipline to run a publishing calendar for months without missing a date
At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time
You use AI tools daily for speed, and you catch what they get wrong




Nice to have:

Experience marketing to small business owners, or in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rentals
You've grown a newsletter on beehiiv, HubSpot, Kit, or similar
Podcast or webinar production, or familiarity with Riverside.fm
Enough design sense to make covers and carousels in Canva




Compensation

$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month as a full-time contractor plus up to a 30% annual bonus. This is a long-term role with upside as the media engine grows.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Make sure your resume or profile links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you personally produced. We read every application that includes work samples and skip the ones that don't. Finalists complete a short paid writing test.

About the job

This position ensures seamless coordination between customers, sales and internal teams, facilitates accurate order entry and timely fulfillment, and contributes to maintaining organized, compliant, and accurate internal processes.




Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Duties include, but are not limited to:




1. Customer Order Processing

Receive, review, and validate customer purchase orders to ensure accuracy of pricing, contractual terms, delivery requirements, and compliance with internal policies.
Request and coordinate product allocation, confirm material availability, and enter customer orders accurately into internal systems while monitoring order status through fulfillment.
Proactively track and resolve order delays or discrepancies, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Success teams to align on delivery timelines and customer expectations.
Generate and distribute sales order confirmations to customers, ensuring clear communication of order details and fulfillment milestones.
Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

2. Customer Outbound Logistics

Plan, select, and execute all outbound customer shipments, balancing, cost efficiency, service reliability, and customer-specific delivery requirements.
Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.
Identify recurring logistics challenges and contribute to continuous improvement efforts aimed at enhancing delivery performance, visibility, and overall customer satisfaction.

3. Customer Support

Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and a solutions-oriented approach that reinforces thrust and long-term partnership.

Communicate extensively with customers, carriers, brokers, and internal teams via high-volume email and time-sensitive phone calls, responding promptly to inquiries, issues, and escalation needs related to active orders and shipments.
Prepare, retrieve, and distribute customer-requested documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates, and shipping records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

4. Other

Carry out other duties to support departmental and organizational objectives.

title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
description:
About the job

Company Description 

Saya Biologics is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company in Latin America, focused on reducing the access gap to highly specialized biologic treatments. Through international strategic partnerships, we develop, register, commercialize, and distribute biologic and biosimilar medicines across the region. Our mission is to empower thousands of patients through accessible, innovative, and high-quality treatments. At Saya Biologics, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects with a real impact on people’s lives and work in a collaborative and diverse environment driven by scientific and commercial excellence.







Role Description

As a Commercial Excellence Analyst, you will be responsible for measuring, analyzing, and tracking the performance of the sales force across Saya’s different business units. In your day-to-day work, you will build and maintain dashboards, reports, and commercial trackers to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement in coverage, productivity, frequency, conversion, and commercial efficiency. You will also support commercial operations by tracking relationships with distributors, banks, insurers, hospitals, and other institutional stakeholders, ensuring that information, commitments, and next steps are clear and up to date. You will work closely with the Commercial, Finance, and Launch Excellence teams to standardize KPIs, prepare materials for internal reviews, organize key information, and contribute to a disciplined, agile, and well-documented commercial operation. 

This role is ideal for someone in the early stages of their career who wants to learn how the commercial engine of a growing biopharmaceutical company works, combining data analysis, operational coordination, and administrative support. 

This is a full-time position.







Requirements

• Strong analytical skills to work with commercial data, interpret trends, identify deviations, and generate actionable insights. 

• Commercial skills to understand sales operations, performance indicators, commercial productivity, and relationships with stakeholders such as distributors, hospitals, banks, and insurers. 

• Organizational skills to keep dashboards, reports, trackers, repositories, and commercial documentation up to date and well structured. 

• Communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, follow up on commitments, and present information clearly and in an organized manner.

• High attention to detail and a low margin of error when handling data, reports, and follow-up materials. 

• Proactivity to identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and improvements without waiting to be asked. 

• University degree in Business Administration, Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Health Sciences, or related fields. 

• Recent graduate or up to 2 years of experience in internships, analytical, commercial, administrative roles, or related projects. 

• Solid command of Excel or Google Sheets; experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau, CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Veeva, SAP, and Notion is desirable. 

• Advanced English level for reading and writing; bilingual Spanish-English profile is desirable. 

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate data cleaning, analysis, and report preparation, with human judgment and care for confidential information. 

• Ability to work in a dynamic, hybrid, high-growth environment with autonomy, organization, and a results-oriented mindset.

title: Marketing Tech Ops - GHL Specialist
description:
About the job

GoHighLevel (GHL) Specialist — Remote, Mexico

Harvest Health Marketing, a division of Harvest Company, is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with cash-pay chiropractic clinics. GoHighLevel is the backbone of everything we build for our clients — from lead capture to follow-up automation to appointment booking — and we need someone who knows the platform inside and out.

We are looking for an experienced GHL Specialist based in Mexico who can build complex automations, troubleshoot technical issues, create high-converting landing pages, set up SMS campaigns, manage A2P registration for client phone numbers, and configure accurate ad-platform tracking. This is a technical role that requires precision, problem-solving, and the ability to work closely with a U.S.-based team in real time.

About the Role

You will own the technical buildout and ongoing maintenance of GoHighLevel systems for our chiropractic clinic clients. Every client we onboard needs a fully functional GHL environment — pipelines, automations, landing pages, forms, calendars, SMS campaigns, email sequences, and conversion tracking — built correctly from the start and maintained as the business evolves.

You will work directly with our team to understand each client's workflow and translate that into a GHL build that runs without constant intervention. When things break — and sometimes they do — you will be the person who diagnoses and fixes it quickly.

This role requires daily availability during business hours for team meetings via Microsoft Teams. Strong communication is non-negotiable. If you cannot attend live meetings or communicate clearly in English, this role is not the right fit.

Required Skills & Experience

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:

• 3+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience — not familiarity, actual buildout and management experience

• Proven ability to build complex, multi-step automations including conditional logic, triggers, wait steps, and branching workflows

• Experience building and optimizing landing pages inside GHL — forms, funnels, and conversion-focused design

• Experience setting up SMS campaigns including drip sequences, appointment reminders, and lead follow-up automations

• Direct experience completing A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers — you understand the process, the requirements, and how to troubleshoot rejections

• Hands-on experience setting up Meta Conversions API (CAPI) — you can configure server-side event tracking for Meta/Facebook ads, including deduplication with the pixel and event matching for lead and purchase events

• Hands-on experience setting up offline conversion tracking for Google Ads — you can build and manage offline conversion imports so closed/won leads are matched back to the originating ad click

• In-depth understanding of UTM parameters and source tracking within GHL — you can set up and audit UTM tagging and traffic-source attribution so every lead can be traced back to the ad, campaign, and platform that generated it

• Strong troubleshooting ability — you can diagnose why an automation isn't firing, why a form isn't submitting, or why a message isn't delivering (or why a conversion isn't tracking) and fix it without hand-holding

• Excellent written and spoken English — you will attend daily meetings, communicate with team members, and document your builds clearly

• Fast, stable internet connection capable of supporting daily video calls via Microsoft Teams without interruption

• Availability to attend daily team meetings during U.S. business hours (schedule to be confirmed)

Applications without demonstrated GHL experience will not be reviewed. Be prepared to walk through a build you have completed.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with GHL sub-account setup and white-label agency environments

• Familiarity with Zapier or Make (Integromat) for third-party integrations

• Experience integrating GHL with Meta Lead Ads or Google Ads for automatic lead ingestion

• Background working with U.S.-based digital marketing agencies or healthcare-adjacent businesses

• Understanding of HIPAA-conscious communication practices for medical or healthcare clients




Responsibilities

• Build and configure GHL sub-accounts for new clients including pipelines, stages, tags, and custom fields

• Design and build complex automations for lead follow-up, appointment booking, no-show re-engagement, and nurture sequences

• Build landing pages, opt-in forms, and funnels optimized for patient lead generation

• Set up and manage SMS and email campaigns including A/B testing and performance monitoring

• Complete A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers and manage compliance requirements

• Set up and maintain Meta Conversions API integrations and Google Ads offline conversion imports for client accounts

• Implement and audit UTM parameters and source/attribution tracking in GHL so lead and conversion data ties back to the correct ad campaign

• Troubleshoot automation failures, integration issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform errors quickly and thoroughly

• Document all builds clearly so the team understands what was built and why

• Attend daily team meetings via Microsoft Teams and communicate progress, blockers, and completed work

• Maintain and update existing client GHL environments as strategies evolve




Compensation

• Fixed monthly rate — based on experience and scope of work

• Compensation discussed after skills assessment and initial interview

About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The global ABP Team acts as a critical platform that enables and improves efficiencies and effectiveness across Stripe by providing high-value, high-impact administrative support to leadership. title: Remediation Complaint Analyst
description:
About the job

Workstream: Post-Market Quality Assurance (PMQA) Remediation

Role: Remediation Complaint Analyst

Role Summary

The Remediation Complaint Analyst is part of the PMQA remediation team and supports the retrospective review of historical complaints. This includes assessment of complaints against the criteria prescribed by the applicable retrospective review protocol, documentation of results and escalation of issues identified.

Responsibilities

Perform retrospective review and assessment of intake and complaint records per applicable retrospective review protocols.

Assess complaints to confirm the applicable complaint failure mode has been assigned, and escalate where the event relates to a potential adverse event.

Confirm that complaint investigations are best in class and aligned with requirements.

Confirm that complaints have been closed in a timely manner.

Provide input to the post-market surveillance organization on information gathered from complaint investigations.

Document results in accordance with the applicable retrospective review protocol.

Escalate to remediation clinical specialists or product quality engineers for correction as required.

Support the retrospective review and process remediation team as needed.

Communicate issues to the respective retrospective review lead.

Complete all assigned work in a timely manner.

Support FDA CAPA and intermediate controls as required.

Complete assigned training prior to performing assigned job responsibilities.

Participate in team meetings.

Support team leads and project managers with communication and reports needed for other forums.

Support the PMQA organization and remediation efforts as needed to ensure compliance to regulations and standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher preferred, or an associate degree with five or more years of cradle-to-grave complaint handling experience.

Experience working in a medical device or pharmaceutical regulated environment.

Expertise in 21 CFR 820, 21 CFR 803, ISO 13485 and EU MDR.

Experience reviewing and assessing large quantities of complaints as part of a remediation project.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we’re a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Digital Marketing Assistant (Paid Search) to join a high-volume performance marketing agency managing paid search programs across a portfolio of clients — executing keyword research, launching and optimizing Google and Bing campaigns at scale, tracking keyword positions, and producing templated reports and dashboards. You’ll work within client-defined directives to keep campaigns optimized and reporting accurate, with a strong foundation in Google paid search and the Excel or Google Sheets fluency needed to handle bulk uploads as a core daily task.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Keyword Research & Tracking: Conduct targeted keyword research across brand and non-brand terms and track keyword positions on an ongoing basis.
Campaign Launch & Optimization: Launch new Google and Bing campaigns and execute in-platform optimizations at scale per each client’s directives.
Reporting & Dashboarding: Build and maintain templated reports and dashboards to surface campaign performance clearly and consistently for client and internal stakeholders.




What You Bring

Google Paid Search Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience with Google paid search, including 1+ year with Google Ads Manager/Editor.
Google Ads Platform Knowledge: Basic familiarity with Google Display, Google Tag Manager, and Google Shopping as part of a broader Google Ads ecosystem.
Excel & Sheets Proficiency: Intermediate Excel or Google Sheets skills with comfort handling bulk uploads — this is a core daily task and a required proficiency for the role.




Bonus Points if:

You have basic experience with Google Analytics, Ignite, or a similar analytics platform.
You have experience with YouTube Ads or Microsoft Ads.
You hold a Google Ads certification.
You have experience with SEO.




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren’t just joining a company; you’re joining a movement to redefine how the world’s best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You’ve applied, now let’s get to work. Here’s the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.

Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You’ll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.
Step 4 Match Interview: You’ll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we’re matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it’s the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Sourcing Specialist
description:
About the job

Sourcing Specialist – Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) 

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in human resources? A Sourcing Specialist who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Sourcing Specialist, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) leverages scale and talent to provide high quality, cost effective service to our clients.




ADMX is a member of the Global Delivery Network which has presence across the world with Delivery centers in the United States, Romania, India, Spain, China, and the Philippines. ADMX is in Queretaro, Mexico. We provide consulting services to help our clients achieve a higher level of service in operational efficiency and business value. We are a team of professionals passionate about serving clients with distinction and learning, and we are driven by our purpose: Making an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and society.




The team

Talent team offers HR solutions by tapping into the different aspects of HR policies, to ensure every

professional’s engagement with the organization is meaningful. As part of the Talent Acquisition team, you will work with our business leaders to develop, implement and execute successful recruiting programs and effective reporting and analytics.




Key Roles and Responsibilities 

As a Talent Acquisition Research team, you will collaborate with stakeholders in the Sourcing /

Recruiting / Business groups to research, develop and deliver intelligence thereby enabling the

success of the company and our clients. You may work in any of our businesses involving Consulting.




The Researcher will deliver comprehensive research and on-demand intelligence for a variety of

market and functional specific requests in the Recruitment context. He/she will serve as expert on

direct sourcing strategies, tools, methodologies and practices.

• Partner with aligned stakeholders to create and implement sourcing strategies for active and

future requisitions

• Focus on target companies and industries to identify talent for various recruiting needs

• Administer reactive talent sourcing while driving towards a more proactive talent

• Pursue every available outlet (deep web, databases, networking, internet, job boards, in-house

channels) to find the intelligence/information that is requested

• Execute various types of research requests like talent mapping, market data intelligence,

compensation analysis, name generation etc.

• Recommend tools, channels, and best practices for talent attraction

• Develop holistic talent identification and research strategies to solve the business talent needs

• identify emerging recruiting platforms to optimize sourcing, pipelining and customer

experience

• Research candidates contact information including phone numbers and emails




Qualifications 

Required: 

• Completion of course of study/Egresado in any pertinent field or industry.

• +3 years of experience in research at an IT or consulting firm, or in recruitment within a

corporate environment, including passive candidate identification, market mapping, and

talent pool creation and maintenance.

• Excellent verbal/written communication skills

• Strong analytical and logical reasoning abilities

• Experience in a global company preferred. Strong understanding of a global talent attraction

landscape with emphasis on the MX geography

• Ability to learn market and competitive changes quickly, best-in-class search process, including

candidate research and outreach techniques

• Strong knowledge of recruiting-based websites, applicant tracking systems and creative

sourcing techniques. Candidate identification via Boolean/internet searching.

• Experience creating search strategies, mapping markets and gleaning industry insights

• Hands-on research, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills




Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Mexico at the time of hire; limited sponsorship may be available for this role based on business needs and applicable law.




Preferred 

• Experience with some ERP with the Talent acquisition

• Ability to identify candidates for respective industry/service lines, paper screen candidates,

and propose candidates to the recruiter/business




Our people and culture 

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our client most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.




Professional development 

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer

opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through

mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our

professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.




Accommodations 

We are committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with

disabilities. To request a reasonable accommodation, contact our Talent Relations team at

USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com




All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color,

religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran

status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law

description:
About the job

About Us

Fractal Power is a vertically integrated power company built for the modern grid. We own and operate across the entire stack, combining utility-scale energy storage infrastructure with algorithmic trading and dispatch to deliver power precisely where and when it’s needed most. 




We are backed by the world’s leading infrastructure and deeptech investors, including Riot, Definition, and Worldbuild.




Why Join Us?

Demand for power is growing at the fastest rate since WWII yet supply is stranded behind worsening transmission and interconnection bottlenecks. The new economy requires a new model of power delivery, one that’s vertically integrated, algorithmically operated, and co-located with demand. 




We solve the last-mile infrastructure problem by vertically integrating across the entire value chain of American power - from greenfield development, to algorithmic optimization, dispatch, and power trading across a fleet of distributed resources - allowing us to deliver power where and when it's needed most on the grid. We have the ambition, the team, and the zeal to create the next great power company and we are looking for fanatical people to join us.




Role Overview

You will own the end-to-end delivery of Fractal’s distribution-connected, utility-scale battery energy storage projects in ERCOT, from greenfield site through interconnection, construction, energization, and commercial operation.




You are the single accountable owner for every project assigned to you. You will build and defend the integrated project schedule, manage all pre-NTP development operations, administer the EPC contract, and drive the critical path across land, interconnection, permitting, procurement, engineering, construction, and commissioning. You will hold the project EPC contractor and every other party to their commitments, and you will have broad authority to pull in any resource in the company to keep projects moving.




You will be measured on whether projects reach commercial operation on schedule and on budget. You will operate with extraordinary agency, ownership, and expectations.




Key Responsibilities

Own the schedule, budget, and commercial operation date for every project assigned to you, from site control and interconnection application through energization, commissioning, and COD.
Build and maintain the integrated master schedule for each project, sequencing land, interconnection, permitting, procurement, engineering, EPC construction, and utility work into a single critical path.
Act as the owner-side administrator of the EPC contract: issue and manage work orders, review and negotiate change orders, track milestone completion and payment, and hold contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
Drive permitting and AHJ approvals across counties and municipalities, and coordinate with transmission and distribution utilities, electric cooperatives, and ERCOT through energization and market entry
Maintain a live risk register and a project status report that is the single source of truth on where each project stands, force decisions before they turn into delays, and escalate early with a recommended path
Plan and manage commissioning, energization, and turnover to operations, including as-builts, warranties, spare parts, O&M mobilization, and the handoff of assets into our dispatch and trading operations
Represent Fractal on site and with landowners, contractors, utilities, and local officials, and enforce safety and quality expectations even where the EPC carries execution responsibility
Build Fractal’s project controls and execution playbook




Qualifications

3+ years managing utility-scale energy or infrastructure projects through construction and into operation, at a developer, IPP, owner’s engineer, or EPC contractor.
Demonstrated personal ownership of schedule and budget on projects you drove to completion, with the ability to walk through your critical path, what threatened it, and what you did about it
Command of construction contracts from the owner’s side: EPC scope, work orders, change orders, notices, milestone and completion criteria, warranties, and liquidated damages
Exceptional organization and follow-through. You plan in detail, you track every open item to closure, and nothing handed to another party gets lost

title: AI Creative Account Manager
skills: Own client confidence and satisfaction, using AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working, not an afterthought. Build trusted relationships and communicate before clients need to follow up.

Understand each client's strategy, stakeholders, services, commercial context, audience, creative vision, preferences, and pressure points well enough to represent the account internally and anticipate needs.

Turn the client's creative vision into action across briefs, content calendars, campaigns, and deliverables. Review creative assets critically and give clear feedback that protects the intent while improving the work.
Work out what the client is asking for, what they may really need, and what matters strategically. Turn ambiguity into clear direction, context, owners, dependencies, decisions, and next steps.

Keep delivery coordinated across services, teams, timelines, blockers, and dependencies. Use agents and reusable workflows for preparation, action tracking, planning, research, reporting, and follow-up.

Bring strong account judgment to ambiguous work. Balance the relationship, delivery reality, commercial context, capacity, risk, and long-term account health. Diagnose issues first, then escalate with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

Protect the quality and value of Storm's creative, operational, strategic, and technical services. Challenge work that is weak, off-strategy, unsuitable for the platform, or unlikely to create the intended value, and help get it to the right standard.

Make account health and commitments visible. Surface sentiment, risks, opportunities, scope pressure, decisions, approvals, and follow-ups early, with records that people and agents can pick up and use.
Connect clients with Storm's wider expertise so they experience the depth and connected value of the team.
Spot and develop opportunities from client needs, service gaps, relationship signals, campaign moments, or operational problems, bringing enough evidence and context for the right people to act.

Improve how each account runs through better communication rhythms, reporting, documentation, approved AI workflows, and blocker framing. Coach teammates to bring evidence, what they have tried, options, and a specific ask.
Stay current in account management, social platforms, creative work, and the services around the role. Apply feedback and keep improving the quality, speed, judgment, and reliability of your work.

Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you.
Evidence that you can own client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.

Strong creative and social judgment. You can translate a client's vision into briefs, recognize platform-native ideas, explain why an asset works or does not, and give constructive feedback across copy, design, and video.

Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools and agents in real work, studies, or personal projects: research, meeting preparation, context management, drafting, analysis, action tracking, QA, or workflow improvement, not just quick questions or meeting note summaries.
The judgment to review AI output against client strategy, service quality, commercial context, facts, commitments, and brand standards. You never treat it as finished work.
A systems thinker: you see repeatable account work as a workflow to design and improve, not a list of tasks to grind through.
High agency and ownership. You step beyond the immediate brief, drive improvements to completion, and know when to escalate early.
Commercial awareness and the ability to recognize scope pressure, service gaps, account risk, and useful growth opportunities.
Operational, strategic, and technical curiosity. You understand the work around the creative, ask sharper questions, challenge weak assumptions, and explain tradeoffs plainly.
Comfort with collaborative systems such as Airtable, Monday.com, Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, Teams, or similar tools, plus an appetite to improve them.
Clear written and spoken communication. You make messy situations feel calm and practical and work well asynchronously.
Attention to detail held at speed: names, dates, decisions, dependencies, status, and promises stay accurate.
Enthusiasm for how quickly AI-enabled knowledge work is evolving, with an instinct for what improves client work and what is just noise.
Answer a short set of self-recorded video questions.
Meet with Account Management leadership or our recruitment team.

Complete a short, time-boxed practical task built around a realistic client and creative brief. We'll ask you to assess the work, explain your feedback, and show how you used AI. Your method interests us as much as your output.
Meet with a senior leader for a second interview and discussion of your approach.

About The Role 




We are hiring an Account Manager to grow client confidence, satisfaction, and account value. Our client portfolio includes some of the biggest names in global entertainment, including well-known animation brands, so this role will particularly suit someone who is excited by fandoms and understands why audiences care deeply about particular characters, stories, and worlds. You will combine relationship ownership, commercial awareness, and creative confidence to turn each client's vision into strong social work.




Creative confidence is central. You will not make every asset, but you must translate the client's vision, know what works and what does not on social, and review copy, design, and video with specific feedback the team can act on.

This is not a message-passing role. You will represent the client internally, engage with the quality and value of the work, bring structure to ambiguity, challenge weak scope, and make sure clients know what happens next.




Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.

We're not talking about using AI as a search box or an autocomplete. The person we're looking for treats AI as a capable pair of hands. They delegate whole pieces of work, not just questions. They review what comes back with a sharp, critical eye. And they keep refining how they brief and direct it, so the quality compounds. If you read that and thought "that's just how I work now," this role is built for you.




You'll learn your assigned account deeply: its strategy, services, relationships, commercial context, and the standard the work must meet. From there, you'll use Storm's AI and collaborative tools as part of how you plan, prepare, communicate, coordinate delivery, and follow through. The role remains account management at its core: building trusted relationships, exercising strong judgement, protecting the quality and value of the work, and helping accounts grow.







RESPONSIBILITIES 




What can you expect? 

Own client confidence and satisfaction, using AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working, not an afterthought. Build trusted relationships and communicate before clients need to follow up.
Understand each client's strategy, stakeholders, services, commercial context, audience, creative vision, preferences, and pressure points well enough to represent the account internally and anticipate needs.
Turn the client's creative vision into action across briefs, content calendars, campaigns, and deliverables. Review creative assets critically and give clear feedback that protects the intent while improving the work.
Work out what the client is asking for, what they may really need, and what matters strategically. Turn ambiguity into clear direction, context, owners, dependencies, decisions, and next steps.
Keep delivery coordinated across services, teams, timelines, blockers, and dependencies. Use agents and reusable workflows for preparation, action tracking, planning, research, reporting, and follow-up.
Bring strong account judgment to ambiguous work. Balance the relationship, delivery reality, commercial context, capacity, risk, and long-term account health. Diagnose issues first, then escalate with evidence, options, and a recommendation.
Protect the quality and value of Storm's creative, operational, strategic, and technical services. Challenge work that is weak, off-strategy, unsuitable for the platform, or unlikely to create the intended value, and help get it to the right standard.
Make account health and commitments visible. Surface sentiment, risks, opportunities, scope pressure, decisions, approvals, and follow-ups early, with records that people and agents can pick up and use.
Connect clients with Storm's wider expertise so they experience the depth and connected value of the team.
Spot and develop opportunities from client needs, service gaps, relationship signals, campaign moments, or operational problems, bringing enough evidence and context for the right people to act.
Improve how each account runs through better communication rhythms, reporting, documentation, approved AI workflows, and blocker framing. Coach teammates to bring evidence, what they have tried, options, and a specific ask.
Stay current in account management, social platforms, creative work, and the services around the role. Apply feedback and keep improving the quality, speed, judgment, and reliability of your work.
Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you.




Your Expertise 

Evidence that you can own client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.
Strong creative and social judgment. You can translate a client's vision into briefs, recognize platform-native ideas, explain why an asset works or does not, and give constructive feedback across copy, design, and video.
Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools and agents in real work, studies, or personal projects: research, meeting preparation, context management, drafting, analysis, action tracking, QA, or workflow improvement, not just quick questions or meeting note summaries.
The judgment to review AI output against client strategy, service quality, commercial context, facts, commitments, and brand standards. You never treat it as finished work.
A systems thinker: you see repeatable account work as a workflow to design and improve, not a list of tasks to grind through.
High agency and ownership. You step beyond the immediate brief, drive improvements to completion, and know when to escalate early.
Commercial awareness and the ability to recognize scope pressure, service gaps, account risk, and useful growth opportunities.
Operational, strategic, and technical curiosity. You understand the work around the creative, ask sharper questions, challenge weak assumptions, and explain tradeoffs plainly.
Comfort with collaborative systems such as Airtable, Monday.com, Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, Teams, or similar tools, plus an appetite to improve them.
Clear written and spoken communication. You make messy situations feel calm and practical and work well asynchronously.
Attention to detail held at speed: names, dates, decisions, dependencies, status, and promises stay accurate.
Enthusiasm for how quickly AI-enabled knowledge work is evolving, with an instinct for what improves client work and what is just noise.




What It's Like To Work Here




Modern Tools & A Real AI Stack

You will have modern hardware, approved AI tools, collaboration systems, and support from our AI Operations team. We expect you to use that stack seriously in real work.




Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works

We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.




Team-Based

You will work with an international team of 175+ people across account management, strategy, creative, production, operations, AI, and technology. The best client experience makes that expertise feel connected.




Remote-First & Pacific-Time Aligned

This role is fully remote, but it works Pacific Time hours, generally 9:00am–5:30 pm PT.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS




Apply through our careers site. Any work you want to show us? It's optional but would be a bonus! Anything you think might be relevant.




Answer a short set of self-recorded video questions.
Meet with Account Management leadership or our recruitment team.
Complete a short, time-boxed practical task built around a realistic client and creative brief. We'll ask you to assess the work, explain your feedback, and show how you used AI. Your method interests us as much as your output.
Meet with a senior leader for a second interview and discussion of your approach.

About the job

Google SEO & AI Specialist

Remote — LATAM | Independent Contractor | Mid-Level

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience




Rose Harper Law is scaling its digital presence across four office markets in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania and search is changing faster than most firms can keep up with. We need someone who lives at the intersection of traditional SEO and the new world of AI-driven search (think AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity) to make sure our firm shows up, wins trust, and converts when injured people go looking for help.




About Rose Harper Law




Rose Harper Law, LLC is a bilingual (English/Spanish) personal injury plaintiff firm licensed in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, with offices in Parsippany NJ, Hawthorne NY, Allentown PA, and Hazleton PA. We're a fast-growing, faith-driven, community-rooted practice, and our marketing engine including a distributed LATAM content and social team is a core part of how we reach and serve the communities we work in.




About the Role




Twelve months from now, this role will have measurably grown organic visibility across all our markets and made sure Rose Harper Law is showing up accurately and favorably in AI-generated search answers, not just traditional blue links. You'll work closely with our Digital Content Coordinator and LATAM content/social team, applying both classic SEO discipline and emerging AI/answer-engine optimization (AEO/GEO) practice to a fast-moving, multi-market content operation.




What You'll Do




• Own on-page and technical SEO across roseharperlaw.com and its 13-market city landing pages — audits, on-page fixes, internal linking, schema, and site health.

• Apply AEO/GEO strategies to improve how the firm is represented in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search surfaces.

• Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to identify content gaps and new ranking opportunities across our practice areas and markets.

• Manage and optimize Google Business Profile pages across all four office locations — listings, posts, Q&A, reviews, and local search performance.

• Build and execute a backlink strategy: identify link opportunities, run outreach, and track domain authority and referring-domain growth over time.

• Develop and lead outreach for publication and media relationships — guest posts, local press, and legal directories that build authority and referral traffic.

• Coordinate SEO priorities with our social media team so content, keywords, and publishing calendars are aligned across channels rather than working in silos.

• Partner with our content team to brief, edit, and structure blog posts, YouTube companion content, and landing pages for both traditional and AI search.

• Track rankings, organic traffic, and Domain Rating growth, and report on what's working in plain language leadership can act on.

• Stay ahead of algorithm and AI-search developments and translate them into practical changes to our content and technical setup.




What We're Looking For




Required:




• 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, agency or in-house.

• Experience applying AEO/GEO strategies or otherwise optimizing content for AI-powered search results.

• Strong working knowledge of on-page, technical, and local SEO fundamentals.

• Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

• Track record running backlink/outreach campaigns and building relationships with publications, directories, or media contacts.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; Spanish fluency is a strong plus given our bilingual client base.

• Comfortable working independently, managing your own workload, and meeting deadlines across a distributed team.

• A portfolio or case studies showing measurable organic growth or AI-search visibility gains (required to apply — see How to Apply below).




Preferred (nice to have):




• Experience in legal, professional services, or another regulated/compliance-sensitive industry.

• Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS.




Compensation




Competitive, based on experience. This is an independent contractor position open to candidates residing in Latin America.




How to Apply

Send the following to info@roseharperlaw.com and mcevallos@roseharperlaw.com:

• Your resume.

• A portfolio or case study demonstrating measurable SEO or AI-search results you've driven (required).

• A short written analysis of roseharperlaw.com's current SEO/AI-search visibility, along with a proposed 3-month action plan for how you'd approach the role — we want to see how you think, not a polished agency pitch.

Full-time | Remote (Latin America)

Blue Gems Management is one of Florida's fastest-growing vacation rental management companies. We deliver five-star guest experiences while maximizing homeowner returns through exceptional hospitality, operational excellence, and proactive property care. We move fast, solve problems before they happen, and hold a high standard for service and accountability — and we're building a remote-first team of operators and hospitality professionals across Latin America who take ownership and thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

Our Core Values

These are not posters on a wall. These are how we operate every day, and how we hire.


Ownership. We take initiative and own outcomes end to end.
High Standards. Five-star is the baseline. We sweat the details others skip.
Move Fast. Speed protects revenue and guest trust — we respond and resolve quickly.
Proactive, Not Reactive. We solve problems before they reach the guest.
Accountability & Integrity. We follow through, document clearly, and do it right.



The Role

The Guest Experience Agent delivers consistent, five-star guest communication and support across every stage of the guest journey. You protect revenue, safeguard owner trust, and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly by proactively managing guest needs, coordinating with internal teams, and resolving issues quickly and professionally. This is an execution-focused role that rewards speed, accuracy, emotional intelligence, and strict adherence to SOPs and OTA policies.

What You'll Do


Respond to guest inquiries across all platforms (Guesty, Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, email, phone, messaging apps) fast, within tight response-time targets during your shifts.
Manage check-in and check-out communications for a seamless arrival and departure experience.
De-escalate complaints and deliver thoughtful, policy-aligned resolutions.
Understand and strictly follow OTA rules and policies to avoid penalties, revenue loss, or listing issues.
Manage refunds, additional charges, and claims in line with company policy, and track escalated cases through resolution.
Coordinate with Maintenance, Housekeeping, and Field Operations to resolve guest-related issues.
Confirm cleaning completion before check-in and review cleaner photos for quality assurance.
Schedule maintenance, deep cleans, couch cleans, and carpet cleaning with guests and internal teams as needed.
Maintain and update all required logs daily and accurately — escalated guest, maintenance, claims, pool heating, and inventory.
Keep Notion, Guesty, and OTA listings/messages current, with clear documentation (photos, timestamps, receipts) to support claims.
Provide personalized guest recommendations — local attractions, dining, amenities.
Share guest feedback with cleaners and relevant teams, and flag recurring issues to leadership for process improvement.
Manage calendars to avoid double bookings and maximize occupancy.
Support light administrative and marketing tasks, attend weekly Operations meetings and 1:1s, and take on additional tasks that support company growth.



What We're Tracking


Average guest response time consistently within target
High guest satisfaction scores and positive reviews
Reduction in escalated guest issues and repeat complaints
Accurate, up-to-date logs with minimal errors
Strong OTA account health — no preventable penalties or violations



Who You Are


Fluent, professional English (written and spoken). You'll communicate directly with guests.
Calm, professional, and guest-first under pressure.
Highly organized and detail-oriented.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-volume environments.
A strong written and verbal communicator.
Accountable, reliable, and process-driven — you follow SOPs and keep documentation tight.
Available to align with US time-zone coverage.
Self-directed and dependable in a remote setup — reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet workspace.



Nice to Have


Experience in vacation rental, short-term rental, hospitality, or guest services.
Familiarity with Guesty or a similar PMS.
Experience with OTA platforms (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo) and their policies.
Familiarity with Notion or similar documentation tools.
A background in customer service, de-escalation, or high-volume support.



What We Offer


Fully remote work from anywhere in Latin America.
Holiday pay — double pay on holidays shared between Latin America and the US (e.g., Christmas, New Year's).
Insurance reimbursement — up to $50/month toward personal insurance.
Internet support — up to 50% of your internet costs covered with proof of stable, high-speed access.
Gym membership — up to $50/month reimbursed.
Paid vacation — 1 day earned per month (11 days per year).
Paid sick leave — 6 days per year with proper documentation.
Compensation reviewed after a six-month introductory period, and biannually thereafter.



Compensation

USD $1,000 / month to start. Reviewed after the six-month introductory period, and biannually thereafter.

Guest Experience Manager, Blue Gems Management

READ THIS FIRST




This role has two halves and you have to be good at both. You lead the SEO team, and you also run your own accounts. Most people can only do one of those.
