WHO WE ARE




We’re a digital marketing agency that works exclusively with exterior cleaning businesses (pressure washing, soft washing, window cleaning). We’re at $1.2M in revenue, 150 active clients, and client retention sits at 98 to 99%. Our clients love us, our results are real, and we built that by being obsessively good at one niche.




The SEO function here is not a startup. A team of specialists already executes consistently across 100+ local accounts, backed by a dedicated web and development team that handles the build work, and a client success team that owns the client relationships. The systems, the workflows, and the AI are already built in-house.




What the department does not have is a leader. Right now the founder approves every strategy, catches the problems, and makes the decisions. This role exists to change that.




THE ONE HARD REQUIREMENT




3+ years of hands-on local SEO at an agency, including at least one year with SEO people reporting to you.




Local. Read that again. Local or multi-location SEO for service businesses.




If your background is ecommerce, national, enterprise, or SaaS SEO, this is not a fit and we will not move forward. That is not a judgment on your skill. Enterprise and ecommerce SEO are genuinely hard. They are also a different job. Our world is Google Business Profiles, local pack rankings, service area and city pages, silo structure, citations, and keeping reviews coming in, across 100+ small local businesses in a single niche. A strong enterprise SEO would be starting over here, and would be bored inside a month.




We will not bend on the management year either. Leading three independent SEO specialists is a different skill from being the best specialist in the room. You need to have already had to look at someone else’s audit, decide it is not good enough, and tell them directly. If you have informally mentored people but have never been responsible for someone else’s work, this role will expose that fast.




THE SEAT, HONESTLY




You report directly to the founder. Three SEO specialists report to you. You are the final call on SEO decisions day to day.




You own your team’s standards and their output. You set the priorities, you give the feedback, you decide when work is not good enough, and you have those conversations yourself. The founder signs off on pay and hiring decisions, and he relies on your assessment of your team to make them.




You also carry your own book: 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts, hands-on. Our biggest clients, the accounts at risk, and the ones that just signed. That is on purpose. Your authority here is earned by doing the work, not handed to you with the title, and your specialists will know the difference inside a week.




Roughly how the week breaks down:




• 40% your own book of 10 to 15 accounts

• 25% reviewing the specialists’ work

• 20% leading the team: priorities, coaching, standups, hard conversations

• 10% digging into problems and recoveries across the full 100+ account book

• 5% client calls and strategy on our largest accounts




We are not promising you the Head of SEO role. We are telling you it is genuinely available to the right person, that it means owning the whole function across a larger book and a larger team as we grow, and that we would much rather promote into it than hire it from outside.




WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO




• Own SEO delivery across a 100+ account book. If work is late, wrong, or about to slip, you know before anyone tells you.




• Lead three SEO specialists: priorities, standards, coaching, and direct feedback when the work is not good enough.




• Run your own book of 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts, hands-on.




• Check the specialists’ work before it goes out: audits, on-page changes, content briefs and silos, Google Business Profiles, citations, internal linking.




• Figure out why rankings and local pack positions drop, and own the fix rather than the explanation.




• Approve monthly account strategies and make sure every account has a strategy and a report in the system on time.




• Look at the web team’s work for anything that will hurt SEO. They check their own build. You catch what will cost rankings.




• Work with our Ops and Delivery Manager on anything that crosses between teams, and talk to Client Success directly when an SEO account is in trouble. They hear it from you, not through a middleman.




• Keep the SEO processes and SOPs accurate and useful, and improve them once the system is yours. Documented and actually followed, not written once and forgotten.




• Get on client calls for our largest accounts and the ones in trouble, to defend the strategy and reset expectations. Roughly 10 to 15% of your time.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR




• 3+ years of hands-on local SEO at an agency, with at least one year managing SEO people. Non-negotiable, see above.




• Able to work 9 AM to 5 PM EST, Monday through Friday. Hard requirement.




• Real depth across on-page, off-page, technical, and local: Google Business Profiles, local packs, service area and city pages, silos, schema, internal linking, citations.




• Strong at figuring out what went wrong. Given an account that dropped, you come back with a real explanation of why, then prove it or rule it out. Not a guess, and not a generic checklist.




• You think in systems. When something goes wrong twice, you fix the process instead of the symptom, and you write it down so the next person does not have to work it out again.




• Vocal and proactive. You raise problems early, you propose the fix instead of waiting to be told, you say the uncomfortable thing in the meeting, and you push back on the founder when you think he is wrong. If you avoid conflict, this role will be miserable for you.




• Able to lead people who are used to being left alone. SEO specialists are independent by nature. You have to earn their respect with your work first, then actually direct them.




• Fluent in Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.




• Strong with AI. We use it throughout the agency and expect you to use it to work faster and cleaner, not to think for you. Hands-on experience with Claude is a plus.




• Excellent written and spoken English. A lot of this job is written, and you are in front of our biggest clients some of the time.




• Comfortable in ClickUp, Slack, Loom, and Google Drive.




WHO WILL NOT SUCCEED HERE




Being honest because it saves us both time:




• The manager who can no longer do the work. You run good meetings and a clean board and you cannot audit a site yourself. We already know how that ends.




• The specialist who will not lead. You are excellent working on your own, and you go quiet when a decision or a hard conversation is yours to handle. That is half of this job.




• Ecommerce, national, or enterprise SEO backgrounds. See above.




• People who show up and start rewriting the system in week two.




• People whose strongest skill is interview polish or AI-assisted writing rather than live thinking.




• People who get defensive or go quiet when challenged directly. You will be challenged directly here, often.




• People who need a checklist for every task and reassurance every day.




If any of that is you, this role will make you miserable and you will not last. Please apply elsewhere. We genuinely wish you well.




TOOLS YOU’LL WORK WITH




• Ahrefs

• Google Search Console, Analytics, and Tag Manager

• Claude and our internal AI workflows

• ClickUp

• Slack and Loom

• Google Drive, Sheets, and Docs




COMPENSATION AND TERMS




• Pay: $4,000 to $7,000 USD/month, depending on experience and your ability to lead at a senior level without a long ramp-up period. The top of the range is for someone who can take over the department quickly. Your pay is based on the work you show us, not on what you ask for.




• Hours: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST. Hard requirement. This is a leadership seat, which means being available when your team, the other departments, and our clients are. 




• Location: Fully remote. We hire globally if you can reliably work 9 AM to 5 PM EST. 




• Tools and systems: We provide the tools, the automation, and our internal AI workflows.




• Path to more: Head of SEO as we scale, with the pay and ownership that comes with it.




HOW TO APPLY




We have a structured process, and it is built to reward people who can actually do the work rather than people who interview well.




We will not consider:




• AI-generated applications. We can tell, and we won’t move forward.

• Incomplete applications.




Apply only through this link:




https://hiring.pressurewashingmarketingpros.com/hiring/seo-manager/job-post-6643

description:
About the job

Remote SaaS Sales Representative — BowerBird.io


Location: Remote — Mexico (or other South American countries)




Please note: You must have C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English. Please do not apply unless your English is at this level.




About BowerBird




BowerBird is an Australian online platform that connects architecture and design professionals with journalists so they can get their work published.




We are a fully remote, global team that values excellent work, direct feedback and daily improvement. We work with architects, designers and media professionals around the world, including people from many of the largest and most respected design publications.


About the role




We are looking for an experienced Sales Closer to help architects and designers decide whether BowerBird is right for them.




Your main responsibility will be conducting pre-booked sales meetings via Zoom with prospects who have already expressed an interest in BowerBird.




You will uncover what each prospect wants to achieve, understand what is preventing them from achieving it and show how BowerBird could support their business goals. You will present the platform, recommend the right plan, discuss pricing, handle concerns and ask directly for the sale.




You will also regularly call inbound leads who have engaged with BowerBird but have not yet booked a meeting. These are not random cold calls: they are people who have already shown an interest in what we do. Your job will be to understand why they became interested, determine whether there is a genuine opportunity and book an appropriate sales meeting.




Phone calls are part of this position, alongside email and other follow-up methods. You should be comfortable picking up the phone when it is the most effective way to start a conversation or move a lead forward.


What you will do




Conduct pre-booked sales meetings with architects, interior designers and other design professionals.
Call inbound leads and convert suitable prospects into booked meetings.
Research prospects before each meeting.
Use needs-based discovery to understand each prospect’s business goals and challenges.
Connect BowerBird’s features to specific outcomes rather than delivering a generic demonstration.
Recommend the most suitable subscription plan.
Discuss price confidently and ask directly for the sale.
Explore the real issue when a prospect hesitates.
Agree on clear decision dates and next steps.
Follow up actively by phone and email.
Keep accurate prospect notes, tasks and records.
Review your sales meetings and apply regular coaching.
Work towards individual sales targets.

About you




You will have:




C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English;
proven sales experience with personal responsibility for closing;
experience conducting sales meetings by phone or video;
confidence calling inbound leads;
experience using discovery questions to understand customer needs;
the ability to translate product features into commercial value;
confidence discussing price, handling objections and asking for a decision;
strong follow-up and organisational habits;
the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment;
a genuine interest in architecture, design, media or related creative industries;
the ability to work as an independent contractor while meeting the requirements of your local authorities.




Experience in SaaS, subscription sales, consultative sales, architecture, design, media or public relations will be highly regarded.




Because our prospects are based around the world, your English must be clear, natural and easy for international clients to understand. An accent is not a problem. Clear international communication is essential.


Our skateboarding culture




We like to skateboard. Not literally—that could end badly.




“Skateboarding” is how we describe daily improvement. Within the sales team, this means reviewing meetings, receiving specific coaching and applying one useful change at a time.




You will receive regular coaching and support, but you must genuinely enjoy being coached. We are looking for someone who can receive direct feedback, understand it and change their approach quickly.




This role will not suit someone who avoids phone calls, dislikes direct sales targets or does not want their sales meetings reviewed and coached.


What we offer




A fully remote position.
Pre-booked meetings with prospects who have already expressed interest.
Inbound leads rather than random cold-call lists.
A base payment plus attractive, uncapped commission.
Daily coaching and practical sales support.
The opportunity to work with architects, designers and media professionals worldwide.
A supportive global team.
BowerBird’s Grown-up Leave Program—our version of unlimited leave.
The opportunity to contribute to an Australian technology company working across architecture, design, media and AI.

How to apply




Please follow the link to apply, submit your CV, LinkedIn profile and a thoughtful response, explaining why you want to join BowerBird and why this role suits you.




Your response should help us understand who you are, how you sell and why BowerBird interests you. Generic cover letters or summaries of our website will not help us assess your fit.




Before reaching the interview stage, we recommend exploring BowerBird and listening to at least one episode of the BowerBird Architecture Podcast.




If you are an experienced salesperson who enjoys discovery, closing, phone calls, coaching and continuous improvement, we would like to hear from you.

Persona proactiva, persistente y orientada a resultados, cómoda buscando y contactando clientes todos los días, motivada por un esquema de comisiones.

Formación

Contacto y seguimiento de prospectos por LinkedIn, WhatsApp y correo, y agendado de citas.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About the job

Sales Development Representative (SDR) 

Remote 




About the Company

Hirably is a fast-growing company in the SaaS and embedded payments space, serving the buy-here-pay-here (BHPH) auto industry. 

We help dealers run and collect on their own loan books, and we're profitable and growing quickly. We're hiring an SDR to help us break further into the largest dealers in the market. 




Compensation 

$25,000 MXN net per month, plus uncapped monthly variable tied to the MRR generated from deals you assist in closing. 

Fully remote. 




About the Role

You'll be Hirably's next Sales Development Representative, focused on our largest dealer prospects: BHPH operators running 500+ active loans. You'll report directly to our VP of Revenue, who owns Sales and Marketing and runs weekly 1:1s with this role. You'll have direct access to executive coaching from day one. 




These are family-owned businesses with lean teams, big loan books, and a different relationship with cash flow and collections than a typical SMB. Breaking into this segment takes disciplined, high-volume outbound work, and that's what this role is built around. 




You'll partner directly with our senior account executives, generate qualified demos, hand off opportunities cleanly, and shorten the time from cold outreach to closed-won revenue. You're joining a growing sales team, inheriting a sales engine that already converts well and a CRM operation we're actively tightening in real time. You'll be one of the people putting that discipline into the daily motion, booking qualified meetings, and helping AEs close. 




This is an earlier-stage role for us, with real room to grow. The opportunity to move into a closing seat or hybrid role that blends prospecting with running smaller deals is real, and we'll invest in developing people who earn it. 




Responsibilities 

● Run a high volume of outbound cadences across phone, email, and LinkedIn against a defined portfolio of BHPH dealers running 500+ active loans. 

● Qualify against our ICP before booking demos. A demo that shouldn't have been booked costs the team more than the time it took to book it. 

● Book qualified demos with confirmed dates and pre-demo discovery logged in HubSpot. Maintain a strong show rate through multi-channel confirmation (reminder call/text, day-of confirmation, cell number capture at scheduling). 

● Log everything: activity, calls, demo recordings, and loss reasons. If it isn't in HubSpot, we have no way to know it happened. 

● Support post-demo nurture and multi-threading on live deals, and contribute to competitive intel and loss reason capture. 




Qualifications 

● You can point to real evidence of cold outreach and resilience, whether that's directly carrying an outbound sales quota or something like canvassing, fundraising, telemarketing, or door-to-door sales. 

● You genuinely enjoy making dials and you're phone-first by default. ● You're disciplined in a CRM (HubSpot preferred). 

● You're coachable, and comfortable working through deals one at a time in a weekly 1:1 with our VP of Revenue. 

● You track your own numbers and own them, good weeks and bad ones. The scoreboard doesn't scare you. 

● You write tight and get real energy from picking up the phone. 

● Based in or willing to work Eastern or Central US hours. 

● English Level Required: C1/C2 Preferred Skills 

● BHPH, subprime auto, or auto retail experience. This is a real advantage, but direct industry experience isn't required — genuine curiosity about how dealers run their loan books is. 

● Experience selling to family-owned or owner-operated SMBs. 

● Comfort with longer sales cycles (60-120 days) and multi-threading across 2-4 stakeholders

description:
About the job

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.




About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for an Operations Risk Manager to continue improving our risk management framework and governance structures. You'll use data to track daily risk exposures and support reporting to internal and external stakeholders.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.




What you’ll be doing

Working with the first line of defence to identify, assess, document, and regularly review risks of all types
Coaching the business to design and implement controls
Supporting the development and implementation of operational risk policies, procedures, key indicators, and appetite statement
Developing techniques for quantification of operational risk and resilience, including stress testing and impact tolerances
Taking ownership of the risk incident management process, ensuring recording of risk events, and managing incident reports
Monitoring operational risk against limits and thresholds, producing respective reports to management and other relevant stakeholders
Developing and maintaining risk tools and systems
Monitoring KRI breaches and working with risk owners/group risk team to resolve them within a set timeline
Conducting presentations and workshops on risk identification and mitigation




What you'll need

3+ years of experience in operational risk management within banking or financial services
An understanding of core operational risk concepts
Experience working with local regulators in Mexico
Previous examples of practically interpreting and organising complex matters
To be curious and never accepting of assumptions, with a desire to fully understand how things work
To be organised and have a methodological approach




Nice to have

Experience with operational risk stress testing and quantification







Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

description:
About the job

About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Merchant Risk Analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle currently partners with over 20,000 active merchants to offer their customers the ability to split orders into 4 interest-free payments over 6 weeks. As a Merchant Risk Analyst, you will be responsible for ensuring that none of our merchant partners are exhibiting behaviors that could negatively impact Sezzle or our customers. This means constantly monitoring all of our current merchant partners, as well as declining unsuitable merchants at the time of application. Essentially, it is your job to set and maintain a certain level of excellence for the merchants that Sezzle chooses to partner itself with and offer its services to. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Tuesday through Saturday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a salaried, contractor position. 

What You'll Do: 


Actively analyze merchant applications by evaluating risk scores, products, and policies 
Investigate high-risk merchant account activity to minimize loss from fraud and reputational risks 
Communicate and coordinate processes between teams to refine the merchant approval process
Write and execute queries in MySQL to analyze merchant information and performance metrics 
Analyze merchant reputational risk based on customer NPS reviews
Work as a mediator between the Merchant Success and Support teams to resolve merchant risk-related issues and provide guidance on overall risk tolerance and policy 
Improve current merchant fraud detection framework to find fraud more effectively 
Perform extensive analysis on ways the merchant approval process can be streamlined and automated and challenge the status quo by working collaboratively, as well as independently, on projects focused on improving methods, policies, and internal tools. 


What We Look For: 


Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution 
Minimum 1 year of experience in risk management, fraud or financial crime prevention operations 
Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
Work experience with MYSQL, PostgreSQL 
Attention to detail and ability to multitask 
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills 
Strong business judgment and communication skills 
Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training 
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years of experience in real-world analytical experience in merchant/business fraud and credit risk management, fraud or financial crime prevention operations in e-commerce, banking, fintech or financial institutions is a plus 
Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer


About You: 


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The compensation range for the role is $1,800 - $2,000 USD GROSS monthly as a contractor. Our ranges are very broad to accommodate all types of candidates and encourage growth. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

description:
About the job

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) will make outbound calls to potential clients who have expressed interest in learning more about Docusign or appear to be strong potential customers based upon our general market focus. The SDR qualifies prospective customers through targeted questions about their business strategy then leveraging this information to align and sell Docusign's product offerings. This position spends roughly 80% of the time on the phone prospecting new clients. Sales Development Reps will receive hands-on training with an emphasis on strategic selling and a focus on researching targeted accounts. This position is a great way for individuals to gain in depth experience in a rapidly growing SaaS company.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, SDR.

Make outbound calls to prospects who have expressed interest in learning more about Docusign
Make outbound calls to prospects who are deemed to reside in one of Docusign's core vertical markets
Share information about Docusign and ask questions about the prospect's business intentions
Discern propensity to buy and forward good potential leads to the Sales Account Executives to pursue
Schedule appointments between prospects and Account Executives
Record prospect information in CRM database

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic


BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience


Preferred


Prior experience working in sales
Ability to form strong business relationships
Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Analista de Customer Success - Mexico
description:
About the job

🚀 Somos Inceptia

Cambiamos la manera en que las empresas interactúan con sus clientes usando Inteligencia Artificial conversacional — bots de voz y chat que gestionan cobranzas, ventas y atención al cliente a escala.




🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

Analista de Customer Success — Perfil Técnico

📍 Noroeste de México — Hermosillo, Culiacán o Tijuana · Home office, con residencia en la región




🧙 Acerca del rol

Serás el puente entre nuestros clientes y la plataforma de Inceptia. Tu día a día combina soporte técnico-funcional, optimización de bots y acompañamiento en integraciones, con foco en que cada cliente saque el máximo valor de sus campañas.




No es un rol de soporte reactivo tipo call center: buscamos a alguien que identifique proactivamente oportunidades de mejora, proponga cambios en los flujos conversacionales y se involucre en la implementación junto al equipo de desarrollo.




🙌 Por qué unirte a Inceptia?

• Somos una empresa de Tecnología de IA. Trabajás con modelos de IA conversacional de punta.

• Contrato formal, en nómina y con prestaciones de ley (IMSS, aguinaldo, vacaciones).

• Esquema 100% home office: no necesitás mudarte ni viajar, solo vivir en la región.

• Aprendizaje constante en un producto de IA que está creciendo mes a mes en México y Centroamérica.




📌 Responsabilidades

• Gestionar la configuración y el lanzamiento de campañas de bots de voz y chat para clientes.

• Brindar soporte técnico y funcional ante consultas e incidentes sobre la plataforma.

• Diseñar, modificar y optimizar prompts conversacionales para mejorar el rendimiento de los bots.

• Acompañar a clientes en la integración vía API: explicar el funcionamiento del endpoint, validar payloads, identificar errores de carga y coordinar con desarrollo cuando corresponda.

• Realizar auditorías periódicas de bots para detectar problemas y oportunidades de mejora en flujos, tasas de contacto y resolución.

• Coordinar con el equipo de desarrollo la implementación de cambios en configuraciones de bots y telefonía.

• Documentar configuraciones, procesos y guías de integración para clientes y uso interno.

• Capacitar a usuarios clave de los clientes en el uso de la plataforma.

• Analizar datos de gestión (contactabilidad, estados, resultados) para generar insights y reportes ejecutivos.




✅ Lo indispensable

• Formación técnica: estudiante avanzado (desde 3er año) o egresado de Sistemas, Ingeniería, Informática o afín.

• Perfil analítico y resolutivo: cómodo leyendo documentación técnica, probando cosas y resolviendo problemas sin esperar todo resuelto.

• Conocimiento de APIs REST: lectura de documentación, armado de requests (curl / Postman), interpretación de errores HTTP y JSON.

• Capacidad de leer y escribir scripts básicos (Python, JS u otro lenguaje) — no buscamos un desarrollador full-time, pero sí a alguien que no le tenga miedo al código.

• Buena comunicación, tanto con interlocutores técnicos como de negocio.

• Residencia en Hermosillo, Culiacán o Tijuana (o alrededores).




⭐ Suma, aunque no es excluyente

• Experiencia previa en Customer Success técnico, soporte avanzado o implementación de software (2-3 años es un buen benchmark, pero priorizamos potencial y actitud sobre años exactos).

• Interés o experiencia en prompt engineering: redactar instrucciones para LLMs, ajustar el comportamiento conversacional, probar y evaluar resultados.

• Manejo de alguna herramienta de datos (Power BI, BigQuery, Tableau, tablas dinámicas avanzadas u otra similar).

• Experiencia previa en plataformas de bots, IVR, contact center o cobranzas.

• Conocimiento de telefonía VoIP / SIP.

• Entendimiento de Inglés

About the job

Customer Retention Specialist

Remote – LATAM

About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here—decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

The Role

As a Customer Retention Specialist, you'll play a key role in helping patients stay engaged with their health journey. You'll proactively connect with patients who may be at risk of canceling or pausing their subscription, provide support during retention conversations, and help them understand the value of continuing their treatment.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow a career in Customer Success, Retention, or Healthcare Operations. You'll receive training on our products, systems, and best practices while developing valuable communication and relationship-building skills.

What You'll Do

Proactively reach out to patients who may be at risk of canceling or disengaging.
Handle inbound cancellation and pause requests with empathy and professionalism.
Support patient retention by identifying solutions that meet their needs.
Re-engage paused or inactive patients through phone, SMS, and email outreach.
Educate patients on membership options, program benefits, and available non-clinical resources.
Escalate clinical questions or concerns to the appropriate care team.
Accurately document all patient interactions in the CRM.
Follow established retention workflows, scripts, and best practices.
Meet individual performance goals related to retention, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
Share patient feedback and common cancellation reasons to help improve the overall patient experience.

What You'll Own

DomainScope

Patient Outreach

Contact at-risk patients through phone, SMS, and email

Retention Support

Manage cancellation and pause conversations

Win-Back Campaigns

Re-engage paused and inactive patients

Patient Escalations

Coordinate handoffs to the clinical team when needed

CRM Documentation

Maintain accurate records and follow-up activities

Performance Metrics

Retention, productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction

Patient Insights

Identify trends and recurring feedback

What We're Looking For

Required

0–2 years of experience in customer service, customer support, sales, hospitality, call centers, or another customer-facing role.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and active listening skills.
Comfortable speaking with customers over the phone.
Positive attitude with a genuine desire to help others.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple conversations.
Comfortable learning new systems and following structured processes.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Available to work U.S. business hours.
Basic computer proficiency, including CRM systems or willingness to learn.

Preferred

Experience in a subscription-based or recurring revenue business.
Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar.
Experience in healthcare, telehealth, wellness, or e-commerce is a plus.
Bilingual (English & Spanish) is an advantage but not required.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first few months, you'll:

Build confidence managing retention conversations.
Meet daily outreach and productivity expectations.
Consistently achieve retention and quality goals.
Deliver a positive, empathetic patient experience.
Become a trusted resource for patients throughout their membership journey.

Why LumiMeds

Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
Fully remote role supporting patients across the U.S.
Comprehensive training and ongoing coaching.
Clear career growth opportunities within Customer Success, Operations, and Leadership.
Join a fast-growing health tech startup where your work directly impacts patient outcomes.
Collaborative, supportive, and high-performance culture focused on ownership and continuous improvement.

description:
About the job

Gerente de Suscripción de Daños




📍 Ciudad de México

🏢 Data Right, subsidiaria de Kemah Capital

👤 Reporta a: Head of Underwriting – Miami, Florida

 

Gerente de Suscripción de Daños

América Latina y el Caribe

 

Acerca de Kemah Capital

Kemah Capital es una agencia de suscripción especializada (MGA, por sus siglas en inglés) enfocada en seguros y reaseguros de daños.




Suscribimos riesgos ubicados en Estados Unidos, África, América Latina y el Caribe, en representación de compañías aseguradoras y reaseguradoras de distintos países, incluyendo México, Estados Unidos, el Reino Unido y Bermudas.

 

Descripción de la posición

Buscamos un Gerente de Suscripción de Daños con sólida capacidad analítica y experiencia en la suscripción de riesgos industriales y comerciales.




El candidato ideal deberá contar con un profundo entendimiento de los factores que determinan la rentabilidad técnica, la estructuración de coberturas y la gestión de carteras.




La posición trabajará estrechamente con el equipo de suscripción de Kemah Capital y reportará directamente al Director de Suscripción, con sede en Miami. Sus principales funciones incluirán la evaluación de riesgos, el análisis de exposiciones y de los resultados de modelación catastrófica, así como el desarrollo de estrategias y recomendaciones de suscripción para una cartera de riesgos ubicados en América Latina y el Caribe.




Además de sus responsabilidades técnicas, la persona seleccionada tendrá un papel activo en el desarrollo y fortalecimiento de relaciones con corredores, intermediarios y clientes locales e internacionales. También contribuirá a identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y al crecimiento rentable de la cartera.




La contratación laboral se realizará a través de DataRight, subsidiaria de Kemah Capital en México.




Esta posición está dirigida a profesionales con experiencia en suscripción especializada que deseen asumir mayores responsabilidades técnicas y comerciales dentro de una organización internacional enfocada en seguros y reaseguros patrimoniales.

Evaluar y suscribir riesgos industriales y comerciales mediante el análisis de exposiciones, información técnica, estructuras de cobertura y resultados de modelación catastrófica.
Formular recomendaciones de suscripción alineadas con los objetivos de rentabilidad y el apetito de riesgo de la compañía.
Analizar y negociar términos, condiciones, límites, deducibles y precios.
Gestionar las relaciones con corredores, intermediarios y clientes en México, América Latina y el Caribe.
Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio y al crecimiento rentable de la cartera.
Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de suscripción de Kemah Capital en Estados Unidos.
Supervisar la calidad y consistencia de la información procesada por el equipo de DataRight.
Participar en el análisis de carteras, la revisión de resultados y el desarrollo de estrategias de suscripción.
Colaborar en iniciativas de mejora continua y en proyectos con impacto directo en la rentabilidad, eficiencia y crecimiento del negocio.

 

Perfil requerido

Al menos cinco de experiencia en suscripción de riesgos patrimoniales, preferentemente en seguros o reaseguros de riesgos industriales y comerciales.
Experiencia en compañías aseguradoras, reaseguradoras, agencias de suscripción o corredores especializados en Daños.
Experiencia desempeñando funciones de liderazgo técnico en suscripción.

Atención al detalle, pensamiento crítico y capacidad para trabajar con equipos internacionales.

 

Experiencia y conocimientos deseables

Experiencia en análisis y gestión de carteras.

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

Experience managing external partners and complex relationships.

Structured, proactive, and able to operate with a high level of autonomy.
Strong communication skills and stakeholder management capabilities.
This is a high-impact role with direct exposure to leadership, ownership of meaningful partnerships, and the opportunity to help shape how partnerships contribute to growth and innovation across the brand.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

Win-win Collaboration

About the job

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why This Role Matters

As a Sales Development Representative you will be responsible for creating, identifying, and qualifying new Mid-Market sales opportunities. Your final goal will be to schedule meetings with qualified prospects, and pass them on to our Mid-Market Sales counterparts.

You will be the very first point of contact a potential customer will have with Vonage API and play a vital role not only in generating sales pipeline, but helping us refine sales and marketing strategy based on your interactions and successes with prospects.

There are tremendous growth opportunities within this position and team; you will have a chance to learn and develop skills on B2B technology sales and marketing and more. We are growing rapidly and we expect our SDRs to grow to more senior positions across the organization as we gain experience and achieve higher levels of performance.

description:
About the job

About Skift

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, providing news, research, and events that power smarter decisions across the global travel industry. We bring together our community of subscribers, members, and event attendees who rely on Skift for clarity, insights, and connection in an ever-evolving industry.




Why This Role Matters

At Skift, our relationship with our audience is at the heart of everything we do. Subscribers, members, and event attendees rely on us not just for insight, but for a seamless, professional experience every time they interact with Skift.

The Customer Experience Associate plays a critical role in delivering on that promise. This role is often the first point of contact. The work you do directly impacts customer satisfaction, retention, and trust in the Skift brand. This is also a role with visibility and impact.




The Opportunity

We’re seeking a Customer Experience Associate to join our growing team. This entry-level position is ideal for someone who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and building relationships with our audience across subscriptions, memberships, and events.

This role will be the front line of Skift’s customer experience — supporting users, resolving issues, and ensuring that every interaction with Skift is smooth, professional, and memorable.




Some of What You’ll Do

Customer Support: Manage the customer support inbox and provide timely, thoughtful responses to questions about subscriptions, billing, event access, and membership benefits.
Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve login, access, and account issues across Skift’s digital platforms.
Billing & Payments: Track and follow up on overdue payments, assist with invoicing and renewals, and ensure accurate billing records.
Engagement & Outreach: Call or email event attendees, new subscribers, and members to collect feedback, confirm details, and enhance their experience with Skift.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the subscriptions, events, and membership teams to ensure a seamless customer journey and share insights that improve retention and satisfaction.
Documentation & Process: Maintain up-to-date customer records and contribute to improving internal support processes and resources.




What You’ll Bring

1–3 years of experience in a customer support or customer-facing role
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and empathetic tone.
Proficiency with HubSpot or comparable CRM
Experience with Stripe (required)
Comfort with phone and email outreach; confident speaking with customers and solving problems live.
Attention to detail, follow-through, and strong organizational skills.
Ability to evaluate information, draw conclusions and multitask
Curiosity and enthusiasm for Skift’s mission and the travel and media industries.
Efficient cross-team communication and project management skills
Native-level or near-native English proficiency (written and spoken) is required due to the volume of written communication, documentation, and live collaboration in English




What We Offer

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.
Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence.
Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment.
Competitive compensation and benefits.




How We Work

Skift is a remote-first, globally distributed company. We work asynchronously, value clear communication, and rely on strong documentation and follow-through to stay aligned across time zones.




How To Apply

If this role sounds like a great fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter through our application system. The cover letter is an opportunity to share why you’re interested in this role and how your experience aligns with our work—we value thoughtful applications.




Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including people of color, women, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and those from other underrepresented communities.




Here’s what you can expect next




If you apply and are selected to interview, a Skift team member will reach out to you to schedule a time to connect.

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Technical Account Manager to join our team, focusing on our Simulation customers.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Technical Account Manager for Simulation Customers, you will be a pivotal part of our sales team, leading and executing value-driven engagements with organizations heavily invested in simulation. Your primary goal will be to cultivate productive business relationships, understanding their current simulation landscape and guiding them towards advanced Siemens solutions.

Leveraging insights from PreSales tools, you will collaborate with customers and account teams to define strategic Customer Roadmaps. This will involve identifying "land and expand" opportunities by addressing their simulation challenges, showcasing the value of Siemens + Altair portfolio, and helping them achieve greater efficiency and innovation through our technologies. You will build trust by engaging in strategic conversations about industry trends, technical challenges in simulation, and their specific business needs, ultimately crafting compelling value propositions and business cases


Customer Strategy and Planning:
Identify "land and expand" opportunities with our customers, developing ROI-driven business cases for Siemens technologies.
Guide customers and Account Orchestrators on engagement strategies for enterprise opportunities, particularly those involving complex simulation workflows.
Define strategic Customer Roadmaps, identifying expansion opportunities, and articulate the benefits and cost of ownership of Siemens' advanced simulation solutions to C-suite executives.
Consultative Sales & Opportunity Execution:
Become a trusted advisor to simulation customers, offering thought leadership on industry trends, advanced CAE techniques, and Digital Twin strategies.
Articulate Siemens' vision on Digital Thread adoption, demonstrating how integrated simulation drives competitive advantage and process improvement.
Internal Operations:
Manage software forecast and pipeline for Automotive accounts; contribute to planning and internal reviews.
Communicate sales, presales, industry, and customer needs to internal teams, especially product development and marketing for simulation products.
Knowledge Sharing and Mentoring:
Act as the go-to expert for simulation, creating meaningful and best-in-class value propositions across various Digital Threads (e.g., CAE, FEA, CFD, system simulation).
Improve customer engagement models, business cases, and campaign materials to address Xcelerator opportunities in the simulation market.
Bid Management:
Respond to RFPs/RFIs with Siemens DISW solutions, specifically highlighting our strengths in simulation and how they integrate with broader PLM strategies.

Qualifications: 


 Education and Experience:
 Relevant University degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, Civil, Electrical, etc), or a related technical field
Significant experience in simulation software sales, technical presales, or application engineering, with a strong focus on CAE, FEA, CFD, or system simulation.
Experience with various simulation platforms and an understanding of competitive landscapes.
SaaS Sales experience is a plus.
 Advanced English Communication (written and verbal)
Deep understanding of simulation methodologies and applications across industries.
 Good Knowledge of the Following Skills:
Industry knowledge in domains heavily reliant on simulation (e.g., Automotive, Aerospace, Industrial Machinery)
 MS Office
 CRM Software, especially SFDC (desired)
 Presentation and Storytelling
 Teamwork & Collaboration
 Negotiation and Influencing
 Conflict Management
 Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving
 Growth Mindset and Self Development
 Business and Commercial Acumen
 Customer Centricity
 Sales Planning
 Suspect Identification and Development
 Additional (extras) Basic Knowledge of the Following Skills:
 Siemens Solutions and / or equivalent Competitor Software Solutions relevant to the industry.


Scope:


Work with large customers and prospects, primarily those with significant simulation needs or current investments in simulation technologies.
Work within multiple Digital Threads, with a strong emphasis on CAE/Simulation.
Establish and maintain effective relationships with Local Senior Account Orchestrators and Sales Leaders.
Establish and maintain customer relationships up to senior management level.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Why us? 

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

description:
About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

About the job

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Are you looking to join a forward-thinking sales organization with strong earning potential and long-term career growth?

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Thomson Reuters, you will be responsible for generating qualified sales opportunities through outbound prospecting. You will engage decision makers in the US market, uncover business needs and pain points, and set value-focused appointments for Account Executives.

This role is ideal for commercially driven professionals who thrive in structured environments, enjoy complex B2B conversations, and want to build a long-term career in sales.

About The Role

In this opportunity as a Sales Development Representative, you will:


Prospect for new sales opportunities, develop a pipeline, & closes opportunity or may not execute renewal contracts.
Identifies upsell and cross-sell opportunities and passes them to an appropriate resource. 
Hit or exceed your monthly and annual targets and maintain consistently strong performance at 100% of your YTD goals. 
Work closely with the Sales Representatives assigned to you to align prospecting strategies and coordinate efforts with Training, Marketing, and Account Management teams.
Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline using a structured outbound sales process.
Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities within CRM and sales tools.
Develop strong product knowledge to clearly articulate business value to US-based customers.


About You

You’re a fit for the role if your background includes:


Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent work experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
2+ years of B2B work experience in prospecting, sales, lead generation or preferred experience in software/SaaS market. 
Excellent verbal and written English communication.
Demonstrated ability to communicate professionally and influence over the phone, email and video
Strong interpersonal skills (personable and professional)
Ability to handle and overcome objections with confidence
Comfort working in quota-driven and KPI-based environments
Commitment to a schedule that coincides with the customer’s workday 
Intermediate computer skills and ability to navigate software programs, including CRM systems and tools.
Previous experience working with the US market (preferable but not mandatory)


Compensation: Base salary and a variable compensation that is directly related to your success.

To apply, please upload your updated resume in English. 

Location: CDMX

What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive the adoption of JoVE products at universities and colleges in Mexico. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever and strives to succeed and grow with the company. If you're eager to advance your career in sales and grow with a dynamic team, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

As a Digital Customer Success Associate, you’ll learn how to manage self-service customers, ensuring they effectively use our digital products. You’ll engage with customers via email, handle tickets, join meetings (English required), and perform upsells or cross-sells to increase customer value.

title: Customer Service
description:
About the job

Customer Service (Latin America Market)




Job Responsibilities




1. Responsible for handling online inquiries and after-sales services for users in the Latin America market (Portuguese/Spanish-speaking regions), and responding to and resolving user issues in a timely manner.

2. Provide users with business support for registration, login, recharge, withdrawal, event participation, account abnormality and other issues through channels such as in-app online customer service and email.

3. Follow up on issues reported by users, collaborate with teams such as operations, risk control, and technology to handle them, and promptly update users on the processing progress.

4. Responsible for the daily service and maintenance of VIP users and high-value users in the Latin America region, so as to improve Customer Satisfaction Score and Retention Rate.

5. Collect and organize user feedback, analyze frequent issues, and continuously optimize customer service narratives and the Knowledge Base.

6. Conduct preliminary identification of account anomalies, violations, fraud risks and other such issues, and escalate them for handling in a timely manner in accordance with the established procedures.

7. Familiarize yourself with the platform's products, campaign rules and operation policies, and provide users with a professional, accurate and efficient service experience.

8. Complete other relevant work assigned by the department.




Requirements




1. College degree or above, with no restrictions on major.

2. Proficiency in Spanish as a working language, with the ability to independently communicate with users; basic communication skills in both Chinese and English are preferred.

3. Candidates with experience in overseas internet, social entertainment, gaming platforms or customer service-related fields are preferred.

4. Possess good service awareness, communication skills and adaptability, and be able to properly handle user complaints and unexpected issues.

5. Proficient in using office software such as Office, with fast typing speed, and capable of efficiently handling multi-threaded inquiries.

6. Meticulous and conscientious in work, strong sense of responsibility, with good team spirit and execution ability.

7. Able to accept a shift work system (including shifts on night shifts, weekends and holidays).




Priority Criteria




- Has customer service experience in the LATAM market, and is familiar with the user characteristics of countries including Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile and others.

- Familiar with the culture of LATAM regions and users' communication habits.

- Have customer service experience on overseas social media, LIVE and entertainment platforms.

- Experience in using CRM customer service system.




We expect you to have




- User-centric service awareness.

- Good cross-cultural communication skills.

- Strong capability in problem analysis, coordination and resolution.

- Able to adapt to the pace of overseas business and a fast-changing work environment

title: TikTok Shop - Creator Marketing & Operations Specialist - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a marketer with an analytical mind and creative to work on our creator ecosystem. You will be a strategic and executing part of the go-to-market of the program. Focusing on analyzing channels and communities to understand what creators need at every stage of their journey. You will also design and produce the marketing pieces that accelerate their growth, grow our own channels, and maintain a close relationship with the community. You will work directly with the Creator Marketing Lead and with stakeholders in Brand Marketing, Operations, Partner Management and regional teams. 

Responsibilities: 
- Co-design the affiliate program marketing strategy
- Identify growth levers, communication gaps and opportunities per segment 
- Translate channel and community performance findings into creative briefs
- Build message frameworks by creator journey stage - from awareness to discovery - and land them on concrete pieces with measurable results
- Produce the marketing pieces that execute the strategy with creative quality and branded voice.
- Design and run marketing experiments with clear metrics before scaling.
- Coordinate with freelancers, agencies and the internal design/video team to ensure timely deliverables 
- Manage the monthly editorial calendar of campaigns and communication, aligned to the program's milestones, e-commerce seasons (Hot Sale, Buen Fin, etc.) and the creator's journey.
- Adapt global/regional materials to the context of the Mexican market

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience in growth marketing, content marketing, brand, digital agency, creator/influencer marketing, CRM or similar roles 
- Hands on experience in production + data, focused on social networks and creators.
- Storytelling and copywriting.
- Knowledge of TikTok and content creators.
- Ability to produce content yourself when needed
- Experience with creative tools.
- Intermediate or above English

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in creator economy, MCN, affiliate programs, influencer agency or e-commerce brand.
- Background in growth marketing, performance marketing or CRM 
- Experience operating branded accounts on TikTok.
- Experience with SQL, Looker, Table or equivalents 
- Experience with email marketing / CRM platforms

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy.
