description:
About the job

Enrollment Specialist - Inside Sales, Healthcare Financing




About United Credit




United Credit helps healthcare providers grow their practices by making patient financing simple.




Unlike single-lender financing companies, United Credit gives providers access to multiple financing options through one application, helping more patients get approved while allowing providers to offer financing that fits a wider range of credit profiles. Our merchant partners rely on us not just for financing, but for responsive service, industry expertise, and a true partnership focused on helping their businesses grow.




We’re a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company where ideas become action quickly. We value accountability, collaboration, and people who take ownership of their work. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and making a measurable impact every day, you’ll fit right in.




Position Summary




The Enrollment Specialist is responsible for generating new merchant enrollments by engaging healthcare providers, qualifying opportunities, guiding practices through the enrollment process, and creating a seamless onboarding experience. Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role serves as the first impression of United Credit and plays a critical role in growing our provider network. This is a high-activity, performance-driven inside sales role focused primarily on new enrollments, with a secondary responsibility of reactivating assigned accounts.




Essential Responsibilities




● Own the entire enrollment pipeline from initial outreach through underwriting approval.

● Work consumer-sourced leads where a patient has inquired about financing through United Credit but their provider is not yet enrolled: proactively contact the provider by phone and email, let them know a patient is actively seeking financing, and pitch enrollment in the United Credit platform.

● Make outbound calls daily and respond to inbound leads in a timely manner, maintaining high speed-to-lead standards since providers can choose a competitor within minutes.

● Focus on reaching decision-makers (owners, office managers, providers) and qualify opportunities through meaningful conversations that lead to next steps.

● Consistently overcome objections from providers currently using competitors such as Cherry, CareCredit, Proceed Finance, and HFD.

● Guide providers step-by-step through the enrollment process, including sending the digital enrollment link and clearly communicating required documents (driver’s license, proof of banking, 3 months of bank statements, and medical/business license).

● Ensure all documentation is accurate and complete, then submit applications and move accounts to underwriting for approval.

● Create urgency around provider onboarding to reduce enrollment cycle time.

● Set qualified appointments for Business Development Managers, confirm attendance, and position calls as valuable (training, growth, increased approvals).

● Complete 5-10 meaningful follow-ups daily on incomplete enrollments, missing documents, and no-response prospects, maintaining persistence without being pushy.

● Collaborate closely with Business Development Managers to ensure a seamless transition after activation.

● Contact assigned accounts to reintroduce United Credit, highlight program improvements, and encourage submission of new applications.

● Log all activity in Salesforce with detailed notes and next steps, and keep a clean, prioritized pipeline while managing multiple accounts simultaneously.

● Set and meet weekly and monthly enrollment and appointment targets, contributing to overall loan volume growth.

● Perform other duties as assigned.




Performance Metrics (KPIs)

● Calls: 50+ daily

● Talk Time: 2+ hours daily (live conversations only; voicemail/hold time does not count)

● Live Conversations: 8-12 per day

● Appointments Set: 2-4 daily, 10-20 per week

● Follow-Ups: 5-10 daily

● New merchant enrollments and enrollment cycle time

● Enrollment-to-activation conversion rate




What Success Looks Like

● You build trusted relationships with healthcare providers.

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and keep your pipeline moving.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● Strong phone presence with the ability to drive high call volume and meaningful talk time.

● Consultative, relationship-driven sales approach rather than a transactional one; comfort with solution selling.

● Excellent follow-up discipline and a sense of urgency, given how quickly providers can choose a competing financing option.

● Ability to manage and prioritize a multi-account sales pipeline independently.

● Comfort working in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with documentation.

● Coachable, consistent, and self-motivated, even on slow days.

● Healthcare sales, medical sales, or patient financing experience is a strong plus.




Required Equipment & Work Environment

● A reliable, fully functional computer capable of supporting daily business applications and video conferencing.

 ● High-speed, stable internet connection suitable for uninterrupted voice and video communications.

 ● A dedicated, quiet workspace where you can work remotely without interruptions or excessive background noise during business hours.

 ● A professional work environment that allows you to conduct phone and video conversations clearly and confidentially.

 ● Ability to maintain a consistent and reliable remote work setup throughout scheduled working hours.




Work Location & Hours

● Fully remote position open to Mexico candidates.

● Full-time.

Desarrollar, implementar y optimizar contenidos digitales que contribuyan a mejorar el posicionamiento orgánico de los diferentes sitios web de Grupo Coppel, analizando el posicionamiento de la marca y la competencia en buscadores como Google, Bing, Yahoo, entre otros, con la finalidad de impulsar la venta de productos y servicios financieros en los diferentes canales digitales de la empresa.

productos y servicios de la empresa, en los principales buscadores, como Google, Bing, Yahoo, entre otros.

rankings en buscadores de Coppel , Afore Coppel, BanCoppel, Fundación Coppel, Blog de Coppel (MejoraTuVida.com), Coppel Argentina y micrositios comerciales.

Paid Media y al momento de que un posible cliente busque un producto en el catálogo, se abarque mayor área en la primer página de resultados en Google, Bing, Yahoo, etc.

• Diseñar e implementar estrategias de posicionamiento para Afore Coppel y BanCoppel, a fin de contribuir al alcance de generación y adquisición de clientes nuevos online.

YouTube, para atraer mayor tráfico orgánico a los canales digitales.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Global Business Services’ (GBS) Business Practices team establishes and manages policies and processes for the GTM motion, including deal policy, approval and revenue contracting processes, and other deal related operations (e.g. misbilling, deal support models, etc). The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users, and cross-functional teams. GBS’s priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations. This role sits within Global Business Practices’ Business Practices team, responsible for establishing, managing, and improving policies and processes to improve deal quality and velocity for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Our Business Practices Program Managers are focused on solving GTM’s deal lifecycle challenges to create scalable and efficient deal policies and processes in support of commercial activities. We are looking for a strong program manager who can independently own clearly-scoped workstreams, collaborate effectively across teams, and is building toward progressively larger program responsibility. The ideal candidate will: (1) have deal policy or process experience in a technology or GTM environment, (2) have strong communication skills to work collaboratively across functions, and (3) be comfortable working independently while partnering with management at key decision points.

Responsibilities


Own and drive discrete deal lifecycle program workstreams end-to-end, coordinating cross-functional support needed to deliver projects on time and within scope
Maintain and improve internal GBS program documentation, ensuring methodologies, processes, and operational playbooks are accurate, accessible, and continuously updated to support team knowledge and continuity. 
Structure and execute a repeatable communications process for the GBS team, ensuring consistent, timely, and audience-appropriate messaging across internal stakeholders.
Support change management activities including stakeholder engagement, engaging champions, messaging and communication planning, and enablement delivery
Develop strong collaborative relationships with key stakeholders across Stripe across levels and functions
Prioritize among various projects and synthesize data to guide/support strategy and decision, with manager input
Prepare data-driven analyses and briefs to support senior stakeholder recommendations and decisions



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


2–3 years of experience in program management, business operations, deal operations, or a related discipline
Demonstrated ability to independently apply AI tools to core job responsibilities, proactively identify opportunities to improve workflows using AI, and support teammates in adopting AI-driven processes.
Works well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment
The ability to diagnose, simplify and structure problems and solutions while having command of “the details”
Enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality 
Strong analytical, presentation, and communication skills; comfortable working with cross-functional stakeholders and presenting data-driven insights and recommendations.
Comfort with Excel and/or Google Sheet for analyzing large datasets
Prior experience with Salesforce, CPQ, Deal Approval, Contract Lifecycle Management tools



Preferred Qualifications


Comfort operating with incomplete data and adapting / re-prioritizing activities as business needs change
Deep problem solving and analysis experience (solving business problems - commercial, operational, financial) in a sales-oriented environment
A growth mindset and innate curiosity where every interaction is an opportunity to learn and improve (yourself, and those around you)
You demonstrate leadership qualities throughout your work – taking ownership of challenges, selflessly supporting your colleagues, and setting the standard for quality in your deliverables
Prior experience with payments and/or SaaS 



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

title: International Sales Representative
description:
About the job

Acerca de WIN SOURCE




WIN SOURCE – Donde comienza el suministro

Fundada en 1999, WIN SOURCE ayuda a los fabricantes a asegurar componentes electrónicos críticos y a construir cadenas de suministro más resilientes en un mercado global cada vez más complejo , con el apoyo de un equipo global de más de 450 empleados.




A través de NEXUS™, nuestra plataforma inteligente para la cadena de suministro, y nuestra red mundial de capacidades de abastecimiento, inventario y logística, ayudamos a los clientes a tomar decisiones de abastecimiento más inteligentes, fortalecer la continuidad del suministro y responder con confianza a los desafíos cambiantes del mercado.




En la actualidad, WIN SOURCE presta servicios a clientes de todo el mundo a través de operaciones estratégicamente ubicadas en Asia, Europa y Norteamérica, instalaciones certificadas y un firme compromiso con la calidad, la fiabilidad y la excelencia operativa.




Acerca del puesto

El puesto de Representante de Ventas Internacionales en WIN SOURCE está diseñado para profesionales de ventas que desean desarrollar una carrera a largo plazo en el desarrollo de negocios B2B globales y soluciones para la cadena de suministro de componentes electrónicos.




En este puesto, te centrarás en el desarrollo de clientes, el apoyo en solicitudes de cotización y presupuestos, el seguimiento de oportunidades y la comunicación con los clientes, ayudándoles a abordar la disponibilidad de componentes, la presión de los plazos de entrega, las transiciones del ciclo de vida y otros desafíos de la cadena de suministro. Esta posición va más allá de la venta de productos; te ayuda a comprender las necesidades de adquisición y cadena de suministro de los clientes y a generar valor a través de las capacidades globales de abastecimiento y suministro de WIN SOURCE.




Trabajando en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de ventas, aprovisionamiento, logística y calidad de WIN SOURCE, irás adquiriendo gradualmente experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de clientes internacionales, mercados de componentes electrónicos y soluciones para la continuidad del suministro.




Responsabilidades clave

●Desarrollar y mantener relaciones con clientes nuevos y existentes en los mercados asignados.

●Identificar posibles oportunidades de negocio mediante estudios de mercado, desarrollo de clientes, plataformas del sector y un seguimiento constante.

●Brindar soporte durante todo el proceso de ventas, incluyendo la comunicación con el cliente, la gestión de solicitudes de cotización, la preparación de presupuestos, el seguimiento de pedidos y la coordinación de entregas.

●Colaborar con los equipos internos de abastecimiento, logística y calidad para ayudar a los clientes a abordar la escasez de productos, las transiciones del ciclo de vida, los riesgos de fin de vida útil, la presión de los plazos de entrega y los desafíos de costos.

●Mantener información precisa sobre los clientes, actualizaciones de oportunidades, registros de cotizaciones y datos de CRM para respaldar el desarrollo de clientes a largo plazo.

●Desarrollar continuamente el conocimiento del producto, la conciencia del mercado y las habilidades de comunicación con el cliente para fortalecer la capacidad de ventas en la industria de componentes electrónicos.

●Brindar apoyo en reuniones con clientes, actividades de marketing y ferias internacionales según sea necesario.




¿Por qué unirse a WIN SOURCE?

En WIN SOURCE, tu trabajo crea valor más allá de las transacciones individuales. Tendrás la oportunidad de:

●Desarrolla o impulsa tu carrera en ventas internacionales en el centro de la cadena de suministro global de componentes electrónicos.

●Descubra cómo las empresas manufactureras abordan las decisiones de adquisición y abastecimiento, y cómo se resuelven los verdaderos desafíos de la cadena de suministro más allá de las ventas transaccionales.

●Adquiera experiencia en mercados de electrónica avanzada como el industrial, el automotriz, el médico, la infraestructura de IA y otros sectores de rápido crecimiento.

●Aproveche la red global de abastecimiento de WIN SOURCE, su experiencia en el mercado y el apoyo de equipos multifuncionales para ofrecer soluciones que van más allá de la distribución tradicional.

●Siga una trayectoria profesional clara, desde la ejecución de ventas hasta la gestión de cuentas, el desarrollo del mercado regional y funciones de gestión comercial más amplias.




Lo que buscamos

●1-2 años de experiencia en ventas B2B, gestión de cuentas, desarrollo de negocio o funciones comerciales afines, con una capacidad demostrada para desarrollar clientes e impulsar el crecimiento del negocio.

●Se valora mucho la experiencia en componentes electrónicos, semiconductores, distribución de productos electrónicos, servicios de fabricación electrónica (EMS) o cadenas de suministro de fabricación.

●Sólidas habilidades de comunicación, negociación y para establecer relaciones, con capacidad para comprender las necesidades del cliente y ofrecer soluciones que aporten valor.

●Mentalidad orientada al cliente, con una sólida visión comercial y capacidad para gestionar oportunidades a lo largo de todo el ciclo de ventas.

●Pasión por las ventas internacionales y el desarrollo de negocios, con una mentalidad proactiva, un fuerte sentido de la responsabilidad y el impulso para crear valor a largo plazo en un entorno global.




Beneficios y desarrollo profesional

En WIN SOURCE, apoyamos a las personas que desean aprender, crecer y generar valor en los negocios internacionales.




Ofrecemos:

●Salario base competitivo con incentivos basados en el rendimiento, lo que brinda a los profesionales de ventas motivados la oportunidad de aumentar su potencial de ingresos.

●Formación sistemática en ventas, desarrollo del conocimiento del producto y experiencia práctica en los mercados globales de electrónica.

●Oportunidades para colaborar con clientes internacionales, cuentas estratégicas y equipos internos experimentados.

●La oportunidad de ayudar a resolver problemas reales de los clientes relacionados con el suministro de componentes, la continuidad del suministro y el crecimiento del negocio.

●Oportunidades para participar en exposiciones internacionales, reuniones con clientes y actividades comerciales globales según sea necesario.

●Un entorno de trabajo multicultural y colaborativo con equipos repartidos por Asia, Europa y Norteamérica.

●Trayectoria profesional: Representante de ventas → Especialista en ventas / Supervisor de ventas → Gerente de ventas → Gerente regional de ventas → Gestión global de ventas




Únete a WIN SOURCE

¿Estás listo para impulsar tu carrera en ventas internacionales y marcar la diferencia en la cadena de suministro global de electrónica?




Postúlate hoy mismo y únete a WIN SOURCE: donde comienza el suministro.

Envía tu solicitud a través de LinkedIn o remite tu currículum a:

careers@win-source.net




Sigue a WIN SOURCE en LinkedIn para conocer las últimas novedades de la empresa, información relevante del sector y oportunidades laborales.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About the job

About Alibaba.com

Alibaba.com is one of the world’s leading B2B e-commerce platforms, connecting businesses around the globe and helping small and medium-sized enterprises grow through digital trade.

We are expanding our sales team in Mexico City and looking for ambitious, resilient, and results-driven sales professionals to help grow our business across the Americas, with a strong focus on the United States.




About the Role

As a Bilingual Outbound Sales Development Representative, you will be responsible for identifying and contacting potential business customers, qualifying their needs, and booking demos for our US-based sales team.

This is a high-volume outbound calling role. You will spend most of your day calling business owners and decision-makers, introducing Alibaba.com, qualifying interest, and creating qualified sales opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who is energized by phone-based sales, comfortable with rejection, and motivated by daily activity targets, pipeline creation, and performance-based results.




What You Will Do

• Make high-volume outbound calls to potential business customers, primarily in the US market.

• Contact business owners and decision-makers to introduce Alibaba.com and identify potential sellers.

• Qualify leads based on business needs, interest level, and fit for Alibaba.com membership.

• Book qualified demos and meetings for the US sales closing team.

• Follow up consistently through phone, email, and other approved outreach channels.

• Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, lead status, and next steps.

• Work closely with the sales team to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and demo show-up rates.

• Meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly targets for outbound activity, qualified leads, and booked demos.




What We Are Looking For

• Previous experience in outbound sales, cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, lead generation, business development, or call center sales.

• Strong comfort with making a high volume of outbound calls every day.

• English proficiency at B2 level or above; C1 preferred.

• Ability to speak professionally and confidently with US-based business owners and decision-makers.

• Resilient, persistent, and motivated by targets and performance metrics.

• Strong listening skills and ability to quickly identify customer needs.

• Organized and disciplined in tracking follow-ups and sales activity.

• Experience selling to SMBs, merchants, manufacturers, exporters, distributors, or business owners is a plus.

• Interest in e-commerce, international trade, or digital business is a plus.







What Success Looks Like

• You consistently complete daily outbound call targets.

• You generate qualified leads and book demos for the US sales team.

• Your booked demos have strong show-up and conversion quality.

• You are comfortable hearing “no” often and continuing with energy and professionalism.

• You improve your pitch, objection handling, and qualification skills over time.




Why Join Us

• Build international B2B sales experience with customers across the Americas.

• Work with Alibaba.com, a globally recognized B2B e-commerce platform.

• Develop outbound sales, lead generation, and business development skills.

• Join a growing Mexico City team supporting expansion in the US market.

• Be part of a performance-driven environment where results and ownership are recognized.

Graduate/Post-Graduate, major in Medical Laboratory Technology or related.

Profession

Relevant Professional Category

2 or more years of clinical application experience in IVD products (CLIA, Biochemistry) companies or their distributors, or with clinical laboratory working experience. Be familiar with IVD products detection principles, testing process and application service activities.

Experienced in delivering application trainings of IVD products to distributors or end-users.

Experienced in on-site technical support, such as troubleshooting，performance verification.

Language Skill

With customer management and distributor management experience is preferred.

Good in both written and spoken English

Computer Skill：

Familiar with Computer and Office Software ( Word, Excel and PPT)

Primary Responsibilities And Contribution

Post-Sale Support

Customer Management

1、Perform post-sale demos to the customers to develop product understanding and applications knowledge, provide Installation trainings and advanced trainings. Help customers to understand all the functions of the products and make best use of it.

2、Complete all planned customer visits on time, especially the VIP customers, collecting customer complaints and requirements. Summarize and analyze customer requirements for future product development and upgrade.

3、Help customers and distributors to solve the IVD product issues, response in time. Ensure customers satisfy about our product and application service.

Distributor Management

1、Explain HQ application service policy and service strategy to distributors.

3、Train the distributor’s team for better product demo to end users. Plan and organize local trainings to distributors to enhance their application service ability.

4、Monitor distributors’ application service performance and give suggestions and help to improve it.

5、Provide suggestions for the development of distributor’s application team.

Other Activities

Monitor competitor’s product performance and customer requirements, share business opportunities to sales team.

Have a close watch of competitor’s application service activities, make sure our application service is equal or better than theirs.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Being customer obsessed and data driven is what drives this role. We’re looking for individuals who can empathize with users, and work towards making their everyday lives easier. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. The role will require rotational working hours to ensure smooth operational running of the 24/7/365 real-time set up, and collaboration with a global team. This role directly powers a critical live customer-facing product safety product, which forms the foundation for multiple other safety features. You would be the expert at risk identification, for all our customers using our safety products. You would also work closely with the Research & Development teams, to power our in-house Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence models, by generating high quality training datasets. This requires an understanding of data requirements, data definitions, edge-cases, tooling and review processes. In addition to that, you would also work closely with the Product team to run proof of concepts and experiments, which guide the direction of our Safety product suite, particularly in the areas of risk identification, mitigation, and reduction. You would also contribute toward analyzing data to improve the user experience for our customers. You’ll work a regular five‑day schedule, including day, evening and/or overnight and weekend shifts as part of a rotation. Overnight (11pm - 7am for example) shifts include enhanced compensation where applicable.

What You'll Do


Review and analyze live videos captured by Motive's dashcam for risk identification, based on the known risk factors combined with the contextual knowledge which would vary from case to case.
Adhere to the established guidelines and protocols for annotation to ensure consistency and reliability of data.
Ensure timely delivery of accurate data as per SLAs.
Consistently strive to enhance the annotation procedures and play a role in shaping the team's best practices through active participation.
Exhibit flexibility and adaptability in taking on new responsibilities beyond the scope of the defined job description, showcasing a proactive and versatile approach to work.


What We're Looking For


Preferably, a Bachelors in Computer Science, IT, Management or related field.
Detail oriented and organized, with a growth mindset.
Thinks, designs and executes keeping customers at the center of the solution.
Interested in learning about the annotation landscape and application of AI/ML in the trucking industry.
Ability to work collaboratively, in a 24/7/365 set up, with strong context in between them.
The position requires working day, evening and overnight shifts and weekends, while maintaining a standard five-day work week overall.
Good communication skills, oral and written.
Ability to work on multiple projects and tools, and switch context in between them.

Identificar patrones característicos en casos típicos y proporcionar retroalimentación al equipo de estrategia de riesgo para optimizar las reglas.

description:
About the job

Lifecycle Marketing & CRM Associate (Email & SMS Automation)

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Reports To: VP of Growth & Customer Experience / Head of Growth

About The Company

We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based precision medicine and longevity company helping men and women optimize their health through personalized care, advanced diagnostics, hormone optimization, metabolic health, weight management, and evidence-based treatment plans.

We operate a direct-to-consumer, subscription-based telehealth model, which means the patient relationship doesn't end at the first purchase — it begins there. Refills, adherence, re-testing, and long-term engagement are central to both patient outcomes and the business. Owned channels are how we stay in that relationship at scale.

About The Role

This role exists to build and run the day-to-day email and SMS automation that keeps our patients engaged from first touch through long-term retention.

You'll work under the direction of our growth team, who set the lifecycle strategy and priorities. Your job is to bring those programs to life in HubSpot: building the workflows, setting up the segments, scheduling the sends, running the tests, and reporting on how everything performs. Where the strategy is defined, you own the execution.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their lifecycle marketing career who is strong in HubSpot, highly organized, and wants to grow into broader ownership over time. You'll get direct exposure to how a subscription healthcare business drives retention and lifetime value, with a clear path to expand your scope as you demonstrate results.

Key Responsibilities

Email & SMS Automation (Execution)


Build and maintain automated email and SMS workflows in HubSpot based on defined lifecycle plans
Set up trigger-based flows tied to patient behavior and lifecycle stage
Schedule and deploy campaign and automated sends accurately and on time
Quality-check every send for correct segmentation, links, personalization, and timing


Lifecycle Program Support

Build and maintain the workflows behind our core lifecycle programs, including:


Lead nurture and pre-purchase follow-up
Welcome and patient onboarding
Checkout and cart abandonment recovery
Subscription enrollment and refill reminders
Retention, win-back, and reactivation flows
Cross-sell and upsell sequences across care categories


Segmentation & List Management


Build and update audience segments based on behavior and lifecycle stage
Maintain list hygiene, suppression rules, and preference/unsubscribe management
Help keep CRM data clean and organized


HubSpot Day-to-Day Management


Handle day-to-day setup and maintenance of workflows, lists, and properties in HubSpot
Keep the automation environment organized and well-documented
Monitor deliverability and flag issues to the growth team


Testing & Reporting


Execute A/B tests on subject lines, content, timing, and cadence as directed
Build and maintain performance reports on opens, clicks, conversions, and revenue by send
Track lifecycle KPIs (retention, subscription conversion, LTV) and surface insights and patterns


Compliance (Support)


Follow established guidelines for CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and SMS consent
Keep consent, preference, and unsubscribe handling accurate
Flag any messaging or compliance concerns to the growth and clinical teams


Cross-Functional Coordination


Coordinate with Creative on assets and copy
Work with Growth on campaign timing and funnel handoffs
Check details against the real patient journey with Customer Experience and Clinical


Required Qualifications


1-3 years in email marketing, lifecycle marketing, CRM, or marketing automation
Hands-on experience building workflows and automations in HubSpot
Familiarity with both email and SMS execution
Solid understanding of segmentation, list hygiene, and deliverability basics
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong quality-control habits
Comfortable reading performance data and reporting on results


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in DTC, subscription, e-commerce, or telehealth
HubSpot certifications (Marketing Hub, Marketing Automation)
Basic email HTML and template editing
Exposure to healthcare, wellness, or other regulated messaging environments


Ideal Candidate Profile

You Are


Highly organized and detail-oriented — you double-check your work before it ships
Genuinely strong in HubSpot and eager to deepen that expertise
Reliable and self-directed on execution once priorities are set
A clear communicator who asks good questions and flags issues early
Data-curious — you like seeing how a send performed and what it means
Early in your career and motivated to grow into broader lifecycle ownership


Why Join Us

This is a chance to build real lifecycle marketing skills inside a fast-growing subscription healthcare company. You'll work directly with growth leadership, own the execution of programs that drive patient engagement and retention, and have a clear runway to take on more as you prove yourself.

If you're strong in HubSpot, sweat the details, and want to grow into a lifecycle marketing career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Ejecutivo de Onboarding de Marketplace
description:
About the job

Objetivo general del puesto:

Ejecutar acciones dirigidas a la búsqueda, adquisición y onboarding de nuevos Sellers estratégicos rentables y con una amplia oferta de catálogo, así como relevantes en otros Marketplaces a nivel mundial, por medio de la implementación de estrategias en las categorías a su cargo, brindando las herramientas necesarias para que los Sellers estratégicos puedan operar de forma exitosa en el Marketplace de Coppel.




Responsabilidades:

• Asegurar e implementar negociaciones con Sellers estratégicos en OnBoarding, para establecer una estrategia de catálogo y precio que ayude a apalancar la venta, oferta y rotación del inventario de solo Sellers estratégicos.

• Asegurar el desempeño (performance) de cada uno de los niveles comerciales, operativos, de embarque y niveles de servicio hacia el Cliente final de cara a las métricas de nuestro Marketplace, siendo clave para evaluar y calificar el desempeño de un Seller para ser administrado por un Líder de Marketplace o a un esquema sin asesoramiento.

• Participar en la planeación anual de Onboarding la cual se estructura mediante herramientas específicas para realizar estrategias de acuerdo a la temporalidad del año (como paid media y tendencias de mercado) de acuerdo a herramientas de medición (Nubimetrics, Real Trends, AMVO, Euromonitor, Statista, Wiser) con el objetivo de definir la mejor oferta de acuerdo al complemento de 1P (eCommerce) y 3P (Marketplace).

• Colaborar en la visión de crecimiento de eCommerce (incremento de % de participación de venta en el Grupo) por medio del fortalecimiento del Marketplace, volviendolo un jugador relevante para la aportación de la venta a nivel Grupo.

• Evaluar las necesidades existentes y potenciales de los Sellers, adecuando la estrategia de onboarding a los requerimientos de ventas, inventarios y promociones con el objetivo de incrementar el número de Sellers activos, el catálogo de productos y el volumen de ventas.

• Impulsar la estrategia de reclutamiento de nuevos vendedores para el marketplace de Coppel, manteniendo contacto con nuevos prospectos a través de visitas presenciales, llamadas, videollamadas, con el objetivo de presentar y promover los beneficios del modelo operativo comercial, así como tomar decisiones acerca del ingreso de vendedores estratégicos que contribuyan directamente a las metas de crecimiento del negocio.

• Supervisar todo el proceso de onboarding del vendedor, desde el primer contacto hasta que su tienda se encuentre lista para operar en la plataforma (proceso de alta y capacitación) actuando como el contacto principal, con el objetivo de garantizar la integración adecuada del vendedor al marketplace de Coppel.

• Proponer vendedores potenciales a través de la participación en eventos de marketplace y/o eCommerce para incrementar la oferta y artículos para el catálogo del Marketplace de Coppel.

• Contribuir al cumplimiento de metas, por medio del monitoreo del desempeño del equipo y ajuste de estrategias por categoría que lleven al negocio hacia los estándares de servicio establecidos.

• Proponer mejoras al proceso de onboarding a través de la identificación de cuellos de botella, para reducir tiempos de activación y capacitación de los vendedores.

Licenciatura en Negocios Internacionales, Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Finanzas, Informática, Economía, Comercio Internacional o Ingeniería Industrial.




Certificados o licencias complementarias:

Metodologías de trabajo ágil: Kanban Boards.

About Spotlight Media

Spotlight Media is a leading TikTok Shop Partner agency, scaling some of the most recognizable brands in the new age of social commerce. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t believe in cookie-cutter playbooks- every strategy we craft is custom-built to unlock our clients’ full potential on TikTok Shop. We’ve guided brands through the full funnel- from launch to scaling into the millions in GMV-and we’re just getting started.

We believe the future of e-commerce is social. That’s why we’re building a team of high-agency individuals who thrive on ownership, autonomy, and speed. Spotlight is not just a place to execute campaigns-it’s a blank canvas where ambitious people can build real leverage, take on increasing responsibility, and grow into senior operators quickly. Our culture is high-performing, entrepreneurial, and unapologetically ambitious.

Join us, and you’ll have the trust, resources, and runway to redefine what’s possible for the world’s leading brands.

The Role

We are hiring a Creator Campaign Coordinator to support the execution of paid creator campaigns across our portfolio of TikTok Shop brands. Working closely with our US-based Creator Management team, you will coordinate the day-to-day operations of creator partnerships throughout the full campaign lifecycle — from identifying and engaging creators through contracting, onboarding, content delivery, and campaign close-out.

This role is central to how our campaigns run: brands entrust us with significant budgets each month, and the coordinator's work ensures every campaign is fully staffed, every creator is supported, and every deliverable is completed on schedule. It is a high-volume, detail-driven position best suited to someone who has managed paid creator collaborations professionally and enjoys being the person who keeps everything moving.

We are specifically looking for candidates with prior experience at an influencer marketing, UGC, creator management, or talent agency, where they personally coordinated paid creator partnerships end to end.

Key Responsibilities


Identify and evaluate creators for paid campaigns based on brand fit, content quality, and campaign requirements
Manage creator outreach and follow-up communications across email, SMS, and social channels until each campaign is fully staffed
Administer creator agreements and onboarding, including contract delivery, signature collection, and documentation
Coordinate product logistics with participating creators and confirm receipt ahead of production timelines
Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for creators during active campaigns, providing timely, professional support
Track contracted deliverables from kickoff through final posting, proactively following up to keep campaigns on schedule
Support creator payment workflows, ensuring documentation is accurate and submitted on time
Maintain accurate, up-to-date campaign records and provide regular status reporting to the Creator Management team

2+ years of experience at an influencer marketing, UGC, creator management, or talent agency, with direct, hands-on responsibility for paid creator collaborations
Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of concurrent creator partnerships without losing track of details or timelines
Excellent written and verbal English (C1 or above); all creator and internal communication is conducted in English
Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
A professional, relationship-oriented communication style — able to hold creators to deadlines and quality standards while maintaining strong working relationships
Proficiency with spreadsheets, project trackers, and CRM or creator-management platforms
Availability to work hours aligned with US Eastern Time


Preferred


Experience with TikTok Shop, affiliate marketing, or social commerce
Familiarity with creator discovery and campaign management platforms
Experience supporting US beauty, personal care, or CPG brands

A seat at one of the fastest-growing agencies in social commerce, working with leading US brands

title: Coordinadora de marketing digital
description:
About the job

HiperTexto Netizen, https://hipertexto.com.co 

 

CONVOCATORIA LABORAL EN MÉXICO

COORDINADORA DE MARKETING DIGITAL




La posición es responsable de la ejecución y el desempeño de los canales digitales de las librerías online Tinta y Sol (México) y Librería de la U (Colombia), cubriendo todo el embudo —alcance, consideración, conversión y fidelización— a través de pauta digital, contenido, e-commerce, canales B2B y relación con editoriales [CM1] y de marketplaces y actividades de marketing en la república mexicana. Se busca un perfil con capacidad de ejecutar estrategia, contenido visual y operación de forma simultánea, persona activa y con un amplio nivel de comunicación y relaciones públicas, con enfoque comercial.




Alcance regional: el foco prioritario es el crecimiento del mercado mexicano, donde la persona opera desde Ciudad de México. De forma complementaria, produce y adapta contenido, campañas y activaciones para la operación de Colombia, en coordinación con el equipo de Bogotá, aprovechando el catálogo y las alianzas editoriales compartidas entre ambos países.




 Salario:

 A convenir (según experiencia y competencias)

 Vinculación:

 Inmediata

 

2. Alcance de la responsabilidad

La estrategia de marketing, la identidad de marca y la aprobación de planes, presupuestos y piezas corresponden a la Dirección de Marketing. Dentro de ese marco, el cargo responde directamente por:

● El cumplimiento de las metas de venta, tráfico y conversión asignadas a los canales digitales bajo su gestión, con apertura por país.

● La entrega puntual del plan de medios, el calendario de activaciones y las piezas creativas para su aprobación, con la anticipación que defina la Dirección de Marketing.

● La ejecución fiel y oportuna de todo lo aprobado: que cada campaña, publicación y envío salga en la fecha, el canal y las condiciones acordadas.

● El desempeño diario de las campañas ya aprobadas: optimización de pujas, audiencias y distribución del presupuesto autorizado para maximizar el ROAS.

● La integridad operativa de los canales: exactitud de precios y fichas, disponibilidad publicada, reputación de vendedor en marketplaces y tiempos de respuesta al usuario[CM3] .

● El reporte de resultados en la periodicidad definida, incluyendo la explicación de las desviaciones y la propuesta de acciones correctivas.

Requieren aprobación previa de la Dirección de Marketing: la estrategia y el plan de medios, el monto y la reasignación del presupuesto de pauta, las piezas y copy antes de su publicación, los precios y descuentos promocionales, y cualquier acuerdo comercial con editoriales o aliados.




3. Funciones principales

Estrategia y pauta digital

● Proponer la estrategia de marketing 360º para los canales digitales bajo su gestión —con prioridad en México y participación en la operación de Colombia— y ejecutarla una vez aprobada.[CM4] 

● Planear, briefar y optimizar campañas de pauta en Meta Ads (Instagram / Facebook) y Google Ads dentro del presupuesto autorizado, con seguimiento de CPC, CPM, ROAS, CTR y CPA, gestionando cuentas y audiencias diferenciadas por país.

● Construir y someter a aprobación el calendario mensual de activaciones para ambos mercados, cruzando datos de venta, tráfico y tendencias culturales y editoriales, y respetando los calendarios propios de cada país (ferias, temporadas académicas y fechas comerciales).

Contenido y redes sociales

● Gestionar las redes sociales orgánicas —Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn y YouTube—: calendario, publicación y análisis de desempeño por canal y por país.

● Crear y editar contenido visual y gráfico (piezas de feed, stories, reels y banners) con ejecución directa, no únicamente brief a diseño.

● Producir contenido para la operación de Colombia y adaptar a México el contenido generado en Bogotá, cuidando la localización de tono, referencias culturales, moneda y disponibilidad de catálogo en cada país.

● Redactar copy y conceptos creativos con storytelling editorial.

● Gestionar el e-mail marketing: segmentación de bases, diseño HTML responsive y pruebas A/B de líneas de asunto.

E-commerce

● Administrar la experiencia de usuario e interfaz del e-commerce en Magento: fichas de producto, categorías, banners, navegación y checkout.

● Crear y publicar contenido directamente en los sitios de México y Colombia: novedades, destacados, promociones y páginas de campaña.

● Ejecutar SEO de producto, categoría y blog, con fundamentos de GEO/AEO (contenido optimizado para respuestas generadas por inteligencia artificial).

Marketplaces

● Gestionar los canales marketplaces de ambos países —MercadoLibre México y Colombia, Amazon y Buscalibre—: publicaciones, posicionamiento en búsqueda, precios y reputación de vendedor.

● Vigilar la consistencia de precio, disponibilidad y ficha entre los marketplaces y las tiendas propias de cada mercado.

Canal B2B y alianzas

● Gestionar estrategias de venta B2B dirigidas a instituciones académicas, bibliotecas, empresas y regalos corporativos, en México y Colombia.

● Administrar la relación con editoriales y clientes aliados, llevando las negociaciones de contenido promocional y condiciones comerciales conjuntas hasta su aprobación, y coordinando la ejecución de las campañas co–branded.

● Aprovechar las alianzas editoriales regionales para lanzar campañas simultáneas en los dos países cuando el catálogo y los derechos lo permitan.

WhatsApp y punto de venta

● Ejecutar campañas de fidelización y conversión vía WhatsApp: notificaciones, seguimiento y atención postventa.

● Apoyar los materiales , activaciones de punto de venta y apoyo en ferias del libro cuando aplique.[CM5] 

Analítica y conocimiento de mercado

● Cruzar datos de ventas (ERP e inventario), analítica web (GA4) y tendencias del mercado editorial para detectar oportunidades y anomalías, para México, debe ser coordinado con la Gerencia de Distribución Internacional.[CM6] 

● Conectar el catálogo con los momentos culturales relevantes de cada país, a partir de un conocimiento sólido de libros, autores, géneros y tendencias de lectura.

● Reportar los KPI de negocio con apertura por país: ventas, tráfico, conversión, CAC, ROAS, ticket promedio y open rate.

● Identificar qué campañas y aprendizajes de un mercado son replicables en el otro, y proponer su adaptación.




4. Perfil profesional requerido

Formación académica

Obligatorio: Licenciatura concluida en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

● Mercadotecnia o Marketing Digital

● Comunicación, Publicidad o Diseño de la Comunicación Gráfica

● Administración de Empresas o Negocios Internacionales

● Letras, Edición o carreras afines al sector editorial y cultural




Experiencia laboral

Mínimo 2 años —idealmente entre 2 y 4— de experiencia comprobable en:

● Marketing digital en e-commerce, retail o sector editorial y cultural.

● Gestión de pauta en Meta Ads y Google Ads con manejo directo de presupuesto.

● Administración de catálogo, categorías y fichas de producto.

● Gestión de marketplaces —MercadoLibre, Amazon, Buscalibre.

● Gestión de redes sociales orgánicas multicanal y creación de piezas listas para publicar.

● Deseable: haber trabajado con más de un mercado de Iberoamérica o con equipos distribuidos en distintos países.




5. Competencias y habilidades

Técnicas

● Pauta digital: Meta Ads y Google Ads

● Magento: administración de catálogo y contenido

● Google Analytics 4

● Herramientas de email marketing (Connectif, Klaviyo, Mailchimp o similares)

● Diseño y edición de contenido visual: Canva, Figma o Adobe (Photoshop / Illustrator)

● SEO de producto, categoría y blog; fundamentos de GEO/AEO

● Manejo de marketplaces y herramientas de gestión de publicaciones

Transversales

● Pensamiento analítico y estratégico, con decisiones basadas en datos cruzados

● Sensibilidad editorial y cultural, con capacidad de storytelling

● Autonomía en la ejecución y disciplina para trabajar dentro de lineamientos aprobados: perfil híbrido estratega, creativo y operativo

● Responsabilidad sobre resultados: capacidad de explicar desviaciones y proponer correctivos sin esperar a que se los pidan

● Habilidad de negociación y relacionamiento con editoriales y aliados comerciales

● Comunicación directa y orientación a resultados

● Gestión del tiempo y trabajo en equipo, con capacidad de operar dos mercados en paralelo sin perder foco en las prioridades de México

● Sensibilidad para leer las diferencias culturales y de consumo entre México y Colombia

● Interés genuino por los libros, los autores y las tendencias de lectura

 

6. Condiciones de trabajo

● Modalidad: Híbrido con mayor enfoque en Home Office

● Horario: Tiempo completo, con disponibilidad en horarios de oficina (GMT–6) y para reuniones con el equipo de Bogotá (GMT–5)

● Herramientas: Accesos y licencias provistos por la compañía. Equipo de cómputo portátil de su propiedad (Windows o Mac)

● Presupuesto: Ejecución del presupuesto de pauta aprobado por la Dirección de Marketing

Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About the job

We're a growing CPA / performance-marketing agency based in Mexico City. We've moved past

our early stage — steady client base, healthy inbound — and now we're building a repeatable

outbound engine. We're looking for a Business Development Representative to own the top of

our funnel: find the right prospects, open conversations, and book qualified meetings. You

bring the pipeline; the founder closes.

Heads up. This is a hunter role. Most of your outreach will get a "no" — we're looking for

someone who bounces back and keeps going.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Run outbound prospecting across email, LinkedIn, and calls to a curated target list

• Qualify inbound leads and route the good ones into booked meetings

• Book qualified discovery calls for the founder to close

• Keep the CRM clean and current — every contact, deal, and stage logged

• Nurture warm leads over longer cycles until they're ready to talk

• Report on pipeline metrics weekly: activity, meetings booked, conversion




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A hunter's mindset: resilient, persistent, comfortable with rejection and volume

• Fluent English (client-facing with US / international clients); native or fluent Spanish

• Strong written and verbal communication

• Discipline with CRM and data — you keep your pipeline tidy without being told

• Self-starter, coachable, and eager to grow toward closing

• 1+ year in outreach, sales, partnerships, or a comparable people-facing role (influencer or

partner outreach counts)




NICE TO HAVE

• Experience at an agency, in B2B sales, or in CPA / affiliate / performance marketing

• Familiarity with a CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive) and outreach tooling

• A track record of hitting activity or meeting targets




COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS

• Location: Mexico City, remote / hybrid, with hours overlapping US time zones

• Competitive base + uncapped commission (per qualified meeting + closed-deal bonus)

• Direct work with the Founder, real ownership, and a fast path toward closing.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE · FIRST 90 DAYS

• 10 qualified meetings booked per month (ramping ~4 → 7 → 10 over the first three months)

• CRM 100% clean and current

• Measurable contribution to growing the client base from 2 to 5+

description:
About the job

Description

The LATAM CFX team is looking for a talented, smart, and entrepreneurial Business Intelligence Analyst (BA) to help us build an exceptional Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX) in the complex and exciting Concessions (NCRC) and Returns Experience (RCX) space to support LATAM fast-paced growth.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst (BA) in this team, you will be responsible for driving and building data & analytics solutions to identify, prevent, anticipate, solve for customer pain points, network defects, abuse behaviors, policy and catalog gaps, and opportunities throughout the purchase and post-purchase journey in MX and BR.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst (BA), you'll be at the heart of Amazon's data-driven culture, building programmatic and analytics solutions that power intelligent business decisions and solve opportunities about concessions, returns experience & policies, operating procedures, network and product/program's logic. Your insights will shape strategy, drive customer satisfaction, and drive business growth and profitability across one of Amazon's most critical areas.

You will partner closely with MX/BR NCRC & Returns PMs, BIE Leads and Engineers, Operations Managers, and IES BIE/Applied Scientists to solve business problems and should be skilled at translating complex or ambiguous problem statements into analytic requirements.

Additionally, you will act in an analytic consultative capacity and can both articulate the “so-what” of your analytic results and model potential/real outcomes of proposed solutions to senior leadership.

A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business and make data-driven conclusions and programmatic solutions with direct impact in Amazon's profitability. They will be comfortable with ambiguity and learning new analytical skills, while working in a fast-paced dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Insights and Solutions

You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping journey.

Spearhead business intelligence & data analytics initiatives that directly impact Amazon's profitability.

You develop advanced analytical tools and models to uncover hidden business opportunities.

Present compelling insights, business models, programs, workflows, policies recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decisions.

Innovate with Advanced Analytics

Harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI to generate business impact

Lead data-driven discussions with Product and Operations teams to accelerate growth and solve for leakages

Pioneer new methodologies in returns experience, abuse and defect analytics, setting industry standards

Create intuitive and automated analytical tools that transform complex data into clear, actionable insights

Continuously innovate and simplify tools and processes, maximizing impact

Influence Through Communication

Craft compelling narratives from data, influencing key stakeholders

Develop effective metrics that shape the future of Amazon's purchase, delivery and returns experience

Collaborate across teams to drive adoption of data-driven strategies

About The Team

Joining the CFX team means partnering with a dynamic and creative group who set a high bar for innovation and success in a fast-paced and changing environment.

We are looking for a leader with super-powers in analytics and getting things done (a not-that-frequent combination!).

Basic Qualifications


 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
 Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
 Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
 Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)


Preferred Qualifications


 Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
 Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
 Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

description:
About the job

Internship Opportunity - Music Marketing - LATAM




About Those Days




Those Days is a creative marketing company helping artists, brands, and cultural organizations earn attention online.




We build campaigns across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, creator communities, fan pages, AI content, and digital culture.




Today we work primarily with the music industry. Over time we’ll apply the same creative and marketing systems to brands, sports, tourism, film, and other industries.




We’re a small team building from the ground up. That means everyone has ownership, moves fast, and helps shape how the company operates.




The Role




We’re looking for our first Campaign Manager.

Your job is simple: make sure every campaign gets delivered at the highest possible standard.




You’ll coordinate creators, editors, designers, AI operators, and clients while keeping projects organized, moving, and on schedule.




You’ll work closely with the founders to turn ideas into systems, improve workflows, and help build the operational backbone of the company.




You’ll be solving problems every day, improving processes, and helping build a company from scratch.




Responsibilities




* Own the planning and execution of marketing campaigns from start to finish.

* Build and manage relationships with creators, fan pages, community admins, editors, and other digital partners.

* Continuously grow and organize our network across genres, countries, platforms, and online communities.

* Identify emerging trends, fandom behaviors, and cultural moments that can become marketing opportunities.

* Develop creative activation ideas that feel native to each artist, community, and platform.

* Coordinate campaign execution across internal and external collaborators.

* Maintain direct communication with clients, providing updates and ensuring projects move forward smoothly.

* Review campaign performance, document learnings, and improve future executions.

* Help design better workflows, systems, and AI-powered processes as the company grows.

* Take full ownership of your projects and operate with a high level of independence.




What We’re Looking For




* Passionate about music, internet culture, and how content spreads online.

* Deep understanding of fandoms, niche communities, memes, and digital behavior.

* Strong creative instincts and the ability to generate organic marketing ideas.

* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

* Highly independent, proactive, and comfortable making decisions without constant direction.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.

* Experience working with creators, fan communities, influencer marketing, community management, social media, or digital marketing.

* Curious about AI and excited to integrate new tools into everyday work.

* No specific degree required. We care much more about your experience, curiosity, and ability to execute.




You’ll thrive in this role if you: 




* Naturally notice trends before they become mainstream.

* Spend time exploring TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Discord, or emerging platforms because you genuinely enjoy it.

* Like building relationships and becoming part of different online communities.

* Enjoy turning creative ideas into structured execution.

* Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

* Want to build something for the long term.




How to Apply




Send to felipe@thosedays.co




* A short introduction about yourself.

* Something you’ve built or worked on that you’re proud of (personal projects are absolutely welcome).

* Why you want to join Those Days.




We’re much more interested in your curiosity, initiative, and creativity than in your CV.

About the job

Responsibilities

About the team

TikTok Shop's Governance and Experience (GNE) is a global team that safeguards trust across our e-commerce marketplace — for buyers, sellers, and creators alike. We set the policies and rules that help sellers and creators grow in a fair, thriving ecosystem, detect and prevent fraud and abuse, and design the service and experience that resolve issues and build lasting trust with our customers. Partnering closely with business, product, engineering, and legal teams — and increasingly harnessing AI to govern and serve at scale — our work is what lets buyers shop with confidence, sellers and creators grow sustainably, and the business scale worldwide.

We're looking for passionate, curious people who care deeply about user experience and thrive on complex, high-stakes challenges. If you want your ideas to matter and your work to drive real impact, join us in building the future of e-commerce.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

What's this role about?

The Governance team builds a thriving, safe, and fair marketplace ecosystem on TikTok Shop — shaping the policies, programs, and risk controls that help sellers and creators grow responsibly. As a Governance Intern, you'll work on real projects with the [Region] team and get first-hand exposure to how a global platform designs and enforces its rules at scale, including with AI.

Examples Of What You'll Work On


 Assist in research on market regulations, industry practices, and emerging risks.
 Support data checks and analysis to monitor governance metrics and identify trends or root causes
 Help review real cases to surface insights that inform policy and enforcement improvements
 Support AI-assisted governance workflows: e.g. helping test prompts and evaluate the quality of AI-assisted outcomes
 Help prepare documentation, reporting, and cross-team communication for governance programs.


Qualifications

 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Science, Law/Public Policy, or related fields.
 Able to commit to a full-time internship of at least 3 months (please state your availability in your resume)
 Professional proficiency in English and Spanish
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable working with data
 Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment


Preferred Qualifications


 Comfort using AI tools in daily work is a plus; SQL/Python is a plus

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Business Analysis — Query production data directly. Build the dashboards the team and clients need: volumes, error rates, processing times, cost per document. Turn a vague client question into a defined analysis, and the analysis into a one-paragraph recommendation.

Documentation & Internal Knowledge — Own Notion as a real system. Capture what lives only in founders' heads and Slack threads: client configs, deployment quirks, decisions and why. Keep runbooks current as the product changes. Build onboarding paths. Make the knowledge base AI-usable so Claude can actually answer from it.

Spanish and professional English.

Spot the AI-generated application in five seconds, and the quiet great candidate everyone else filtered out. Own onboarding end-to-end.
QA & Product Quality — Daily smoke tests before client deployments (manual today, eating founder time: you take it over, then help kill it with automation). Bug tickets a dev can fix with zero follow-up questions. Regression checklists per release. Test AI outputs, not just buttons — extraction accuracy, matching quality, the places where an LLM is confidently wrong. That last part is the hard part and the most valuable.
Business Analysis — Query production data directly. Build the dashboards the team and clients need: volumes, error rates, processing times, cost per document. Turn a vague client question into a defined analysis, and the analysis into a one-paragraph recommendation.
Documentation & Internal Knowledge — Own Notion as a real system. Capture what lives only in founders' heads and Slack threads: client configs, deployment quirks, decisions and why. Keep runbooks current as the product changes. Build onboarding paths. Make the knowledge base AI-usable so Claude can actually answer from it.




The Bar

You work with Claude every day and you're good at it. Not "I've tried ChatGPT." Real prompts, small tools, your own job automated. We'd rather hire someone who automated a boring weekly task than someone with a perfect CV who never has.
You understand the business logic
You are efficient in execution
You're allergic to knowledge living in one person's head. You write it down without being asked.
You're autonomous. Ambiguous problem, two good questions, then go.




Must-Have

Top-tier business or engineering school. We care about the reasoning ability, not the diploma — if you got there another way, show us !
~2 years in ops, consulting, QA, recruiting, analyst, or PM-adjacent work.
Daily AI tool use, with specific examples of what you built.
Spanish and professional English.
Notion power user. Obsessed with structure — nothing falls through the cracks.




Nice-to-Have

French · tech recruiting - knowledge base built from scratch · insurance, fintech, or B2B SaaS · a working mental model of how LLMs fail.




How We Work

Real ownership, no process for its own sake. If a request conflicts with common sense, you push back and propose better. Reproduce before you report. 




Success
Pipeline always current; founders stop chasing candidate status.
Pre-deployment testing systematic and no longer costing a founder their morning.
Bugs caught internally, not by the client.
Anyone gets a data answer in a day instead of guessing.
New hires onboard from documentation, not from a founder's calendar.




How to Apply

CV + 5 lines max: one task you automated or made dramatically faster with an AI tool. What it was, what you built, what changed. → tanguy.moutte@mincaai.com

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Permanent

If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. As the clinical and advanced therapy part of UPS Healthcare, we reach patients faster, with greater scalability and access to new pathways throughout the supply chain. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.
