description:
About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we're a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We're hiring a Marketing Tagging QA Specialist (LATAM candidate) to own analytics governance and tagging operations end-to-end for a fast-growing fintech platform operating in a highly regulated environment — building intake procedures for analytics platform requests, driving cross-functional QA and approval workflows for event deployment across ad platforms including Google and Meta, developing end-to-end event activation playbooks, and supporting audit and compliance documentation processes including SOX and P2S reviews.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Intake Procedure Development: Own the development and internal adoption of intake procedures for analytics platform requests, including Google Tag Manager event setup and deployment workflows
Cross-Functional QA & Approval: Manage and continuously improve cross-functional processes for the approval, QA, and deployment of tracking events across ad and analytics platforms
Event Activation Playbooks: Track and create end-to-end playbooks for event activations across ad platforms including Google and Meta, standardizing workflows from request intake through deployment and QA sign-off
Compliance & Audit Support: Prepare documentation and manage requests for audit and compliance reviews, coordinating required changes for regulatory frameworks including SOX and P2S
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with analytics, compliance, and marketing stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely execution of tagging, event tracking, and cross-functional approval processes




What You Bring

Google Tag Manager Expertise: Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager including event setup, QA, and troubleshooting across web and campaign properties
Customer Data Platform Knowledge: Understanding of customer data platforms such as mParticle or similar tools and how they integrate with ad platforms for event tracking and data activation
Audit & Compliance Experience: Prior experience supporting audit-related workflows with comfort managing compliance-sensitive, documentation-heavy processes in regulated environments
Process Documentation & Standardization: Demonstrated ability to document and operationalize repeatable workflows through playbooks, intake procedures, and QA checklists
Cross-Functional Communication & Mindset: Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with a process-driven orientation, sharp attention to detail, and proven ability to identify gaps, propose improvements, and thrive in fast-paced, highly regulated environments with evolving requirements




Bonus Points if:

You have familiarity with additional analytics platforms such as GA4 or Adobe Analytics
You have prior experience supporting privacy or compliance initiatives in a regulated industry
You have an understanding of MarTech tools and trends
You have knowledge of marketing campaign activation processes within platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, or LinkedIn Ads




Salary Range: $8.00 - $9.00 per hour (Final offer based on skills and experience matched to role requirements)




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world's best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You've applied, now let's get to work. Here's the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we'll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.
Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You'll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.
Step 4 Match Interview: You'll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we're matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it's the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We've got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you're 100% ready.
Step 6 Client Interview: You'll meet the client to discuss how you'll help them scale and succeed. Bring your metrics and be on your A-game — this is your last chance to make a great first impression!




Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant!




GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT 

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

The Jr. Content Designer is a specialist role focused on the creation and adaptation of print, digital, and motion content materials. This position requires a solid understanding of design principles and proficiency in creative software to develop high-quality visual assets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for producing production-ready graphics, supporting the development of creative concepts, and adapting existing brand assets to meet business, customer, and consumer needs. Working within established creative processes, the Jr. Content Designer will ensure all deliverables are visually compelling, aligned with brand guidelines, and executed with accuracy and consistency.

Your Impact

As a Jr. Content Designer, your responsibilities will include:


Support brainstorming sessions and contribute to concept development.
Design and execute low-complexity creative projects from concept to completion.
Create engaging visual presentations for internal Marketing initiatives.
Develop a variety of visual assets, including graphics, mockups, photo retouching, and other creative materials.
Adapt key visuals and existing brand assets for digital advertising, point-of-sale (POS) materials, and other consumer touchpoints.
Prepare print-ready artwork and production files as required.
Ensure all deliverables align with brand standards and maintain visual consistency across channels.
Manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
Incorporate feedback effectively and continuously improve creative, technical, and design skills.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For? 

Education


Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Digital Art, Visual Communication Design, or a related field.


Experience & Skills


1+ year of experience in a design role (agency or in-house environment preferred); recent graduates with relevant hands-on experience are encouraged to apply.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator, with basic knowledge of print design and/or motion graphics.
Advanced English and Spanish communication skills, both written and spoken.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn and grow in a collaborative creative environment.


Portfolio


Portfolio should demonstrate design fundamentals across academic, personal, freelance, or professional projects.
Candidates should showcase projects that include multiple touchpoints, such as social media assets, POS materials, digital banners, or campaign adaptations.
The portfolio should reflect strong visual execution, attention to detail, and the ability to apply design concepts across different formats.
Experience working with consumer-facing brands is desirable.


 If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.

We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.

A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle. 
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others. 


 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

Define test mechanics—what will be tested, how variations will differ, which audiences are included, and what success looks like
Build and configure Adobe Target experiences with precision, including targeting logic, traffic allocation, and tracking parameters
Validate measurement design—confirm that KPIs are properly instrumented in Adobe Analytics and will actually capture what matters
Develop test variations working closely with designers and developers, ensuring variations accurately test the intended hypothesis

Own test operations within our established processes—execute Development and/or QA validation handoffs, actively monitor test performance and flag issues, drive tests through launch and closure, and hold to sprint timelines and SLAs
Configure analytical dashboards in Adobe Analytics to monitor test performance and enable real-time visibility into results
Conduct pre-test analysis using Adobe Analytics to establish baselines and inform test calibration
Build and document test plans— clearly capture aligned hypothesis, specify measurement parameters and KPI tracking, and ensure alignment between strategy and execution
Identify and surface execution considerations early (traffic volume, audience overlap, measurement gaps, test conflicts) so they can be addressed before launch
Maintain clear documentation so test logic is transparent and results can be reliably interpreted
Work closely with the Sr Manager of Optimization to ensure test plans align with strategy and measurement is sound
Document test results, and support post-test analysis and results interpretation
Support Learning Repository updates and stakeholder shake-outs as needed

Hands-on experience executing web testing using Adobe Target or an equivalent platform (e.g., Optimizely, Visual Web Optimizer, etc) —you've built and troubleshot A/B tests, multivariate tests, and segment-based experiences at scale
Hands-on experience with web analytical tools such as Adobe Analytics—you can navigate dashboards, understand event tracking, build custom segments, and interpret test results reliably
Front-end development background with working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—you understand how variations are built and can communicate technical requirements clearly to developers
Strong understanding of testing methodology including statistical significance, sample sizing, and test duration—you know why these details matter
Analytical and data-driven mindset—you think critically about problem statements and measurement design; you ask clarifying questions when something seems unclear
Accountability and ownership—you track details meticulously and own test quality end-to-end; you escalate blockers rather than letting them slide
Cross-functional collaboration—you partner effectively with Product Managers, UX, Development, and Analytics teams; you communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences
Proactive problem-solving—you anticipate issues, surface them early, and propose solutions rather than waiting to be told what to do

Intellectual curiosity—you're genuinely interested in understanding customer behavior and business context; you ask "why" questions about the tests we run

Interest in how AI and automation can enhance testing and optimization work
Energetic and forward-thinking; comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
Collaborative mindset; you thrive working with diverse teams toward shared goals
Growth-oriented; you're eager to develop deeper expertise in optimization and digital strategy
Embraces change and is energized by new ideas and technologies

Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. About the job

Ecommerce Paid Media Creative Strategist 

Remote | Full-Time | Fluent English Required

Time: 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (Hours are flexible, we care about performance not clocks).

Salary: Starting at approximately $2,000 USD/month + performance-based bonuses




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand creating sunglasses that solve problems. Our products include tangle-free aviators, floating sunglasses, foldable pocket shades, mood-boosting lenses, UV400 protection, and other functional designs.




We are a lean, fast-moving e-commerce company selling through Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, wholesale, affiliates, influencers, and other channels. We move quickly, test constantly, and value ownership, initiative, and measurable results.




About the Role

We are looking for a Creative Paid Media Strategist who understands how to turn creative into business results.




You will connect marketing, creative, paid media, copywriting, website conversion, and customer psychology. You will guide strategy, develop ideas, identify what is working and what is not, and turn products, customer problems, and business goals into creative that drives attention, clicks, conversions, and revenue.




You need to recognize strong creative, identify what is missing, explain how to improve it, and execute when necessary instead of simply delegating.




Your Primary Mission

Turn products, customer insights, marketing goals, and performance data into creative strategies that capture attention, communicate value, create desire, and drive measurable e-commerce growth.




Customer Insight → Strategy → Concept → Copy → Production → Launch → Analysis → Optimization.




What You Will Do

1) Paid Media Creative Strategy

Develop creative strategies for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google, and other relevant platforms.
Identify marketing angles for products, promotions, launches, and customer segments.
Develop concepts based on customer pain points, product benefits, offers, and business goals.
Create briefs outlining the target customer, hook, message, visual direction, and desired action.
Recommend the footage, visuals, copy, demonstrations, and assets needed to execute each concept.
Develop variations to test hooks, angles, messages, formats, and calls to action.
Review ads and identify opportunities to improve attention, engagement, and conversion.




2) Creative Concepts, Hooks & Angles

Develop concepts based on customer behavior, product benefits, trends, and performance data.
Create different marketing angles based on customer motivations.
Develop hooks that create curiosity, communicate a problem, generate emotion, or introduce a compelling benefit.
Create educational, lifestyle, emotional, comparison, demonstration, and direct-response concepts.
Turn reviews, complaints, questions, and objections into creative opportunities.
Research competitors and identify creative gaps and opportunities.
Continuously bring new ideas to the team.




3) Copywriting & Marketing Messaging

Develop and improve paid ad copy, video hooks, on-screen text, headlines, and calls to action.
Turn product features into clear customer-focused benefits.
Create messaging that addresses customer objections, frustrations, desires, and reasons not to purchase.
Identify when copy is vague, generic, unclear, or focused only on product features.
Write or improve product, promotional, landing page, email, SMS, and campaign messaging.
Develop messaging variations to test different motivations, benefits, emotional appeals, urgency, and calls to action.




4) Video & Visual Creative Direction

Review video concepts and edits to determine whether they communicate the intended marketing message.
Evaluate whether the opening seconds capture attention and encourage continued viewing.
Guide editors on hooks, pacing, storytelling, messaging, product demonstrations, and calls to action.
Identify when a video looks polished but does not communicate a clear problem, benefit, or reason to purchase.
Provide specific feedback explaining what should change and why.
Recommend the footage, visuals, sound, text, and creative elements needed.
Direct UGC-style, influencer-style, product-focused, founder-led, educational, and direct-response creative.




5) Website & Landing Page Conversion

Review the customer journey from advertisement to landing page, product page, and checkout to identify conversion problems.
Identify disconnects between advertising messages and the experience customers receive after clicking.
Recommend improvements to headlines, product messaging, visuals, demonstrations, page structure, and calls to action.
Make product benefits, features, use cases, and solutions clearer.
Recommend A/B tests for copy, imagery, videos, product positioning, and calls to action.
Identify customer objections that are not clearly addressed on the website.




6) Email, SMS & Lifecycle Marketing

Develop creative concepts for promotional emails, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and retention initiatives.
Review messaging to ensure customers understand the offer, product benefit, and reason to act.
Write or improve subject lines, headlines, body copy, calls to action, and promotional messaging.
Develop messaging for welcome, abandoned cart, retention, product education, and promotional campaigns.
Align email and SMS messaging with paid media, website, and broader campaign strategy.
Use customer pain points, benefits, reviews, and objections to develop stronger lifecycle marketing.




7) Performance & Creative Testing

Analyze CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, retention, watch time, thumb-stop rate, engagement, and revenue.
Identify which hooks, messaging angles, benefits, visuals, and formats perform best.
Translate performance data into recommendations for future creatives.
Develop tests for hooks, messaging, visual styles, video structures, offers, and calls to action.
Identify which concepts should be scaled, improved, retested, or discontinued.




8) Research & Marketing Opportunities

Research reviews, complaints, questions, comments, and customer service conversations for creative insights.
Identify recurring customer problems, frustrations, desires, objections, and purchasing motivations.
Analyze competitor advertising, messaging, and creative strategies.
Research relevant advertising, consumer, cultural, and platform trends.
Use research to develop new hooks, angles, product messaging, and campaign concepts.




9) Campaigns & Product Launches

Develop campaign concepts, creative angles, hooks, copy, and visual direction.
Determine the assets required across advertising, website, email, SMS, and social media.

Fully remote role with flexible working hours focused on performance and results.
Approximately $2,000 USD/month + performance-based bonuses.
Compensation growth based on performance, responsibility, and measurable impact.
Direct collaboration with the Founder and leadership team.
High ownership over creative strategy and marketing direction.
Opportunity to influence the growth of a global e-commerce brand.
Free TopFoxx products.
Paid time off and company holidays.
Growth opportunities into Senior Creative Strategist, Head of Creative Strategy, Creative Director, Head of Growth or Marketing Director.




How to Apply

Send your resume and portfolio or relevant work examples to recruiting@topfoxx.com




Please include examples of paid advertising, creative strategy, copywriting, ad concepts, landing page improvements, creative testing, or e-commerce growth work.




If you understand that great creatives are not just about looking good, but about capturing attention, communicating value, creating desire and driving action, we would love to hear from you.

description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Associate Consultant Intern, Marketing Services, Internship Program 2027 - Mexico City, Mexico

Associate Consultant Intern - 2027

At Mastercard, our Advisors & Consulting Services (ACS) group helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.

Make an Impact as an Associate Consultant Intern

As an Associate Consultant Intern, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through taking ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality and more.

As An Associate Consultant Intern, You Will


 Participate in volunteer and team building experiences
 Gain exposure to our leadership team through networking sessions and speaker series
 Begin to build relationships with clients to understand their business needs, seek strategic solutions and guide impactful decisions
 Grow by receiving hands-on mentorship from an experienced management team.
 Have an opportunity for meaningful contributions
 Collaborate with colleagues across different areas of the organization and gain exposure to business development, account management, and product management



We are looking for passionate and talented professionals, who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business need. We are recruiting for four career tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.

Marketing


 Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.
 Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?
How can a large financial institution best execute on a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?



Bring your Passion and Expertise

We Recruit For And Value The Following Core Competencies


 Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.
 Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks).
 Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.
 Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.
 Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.
 Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.
 Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.
 Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Qualifications

Undergraduate expected graduation between August 2027 and December 2027

Outstanding record of academic achievement

Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities

Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills

Ability to communicate ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and the local office language(s)


 Program starting in January 2027 (part-time / Hybrid Model)



Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
About the job

Job Summary

EL EQUIPO

Formarás parte del equipo de Marketing Digital, encargado de diseñar, ejecutar y optimizar campañas pagadas en plataformas digitales para impulsar la presencia de la marca y maximizar el rendimiento de inversión. Es un área dinámica y estratégica que conecta creatividad con análisis de datos.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO

Estamos buscando un Analista Administrativo para Marketing Digital que apoye en la gestión y control de campañas pagadas en redes sociales y plataformas como Google Ads, Meta Ads, etc. Este rol es clave para garantizar la correcta ejecución de las campañas, el seguimiento de presupuestos y la generación de reportes que permitan tomar decisiones informadas, contribuyendo a la eficiencia y transparencia de las inversiones en medios digitales.

Es un momento emocionante para unirse al equipo, ya que estamos fortaleciendo nuestra presencia digital y optimizando procesos para lograr mayor eficiencia y resultados. Si te interesa el marketing digital y quieres desarrollar tu carrera en un entorno innovador, esta oportunidad es para ti.

LO QUE HARÁS


Revisar las redes sociales donde se activan campañas pagadas para asegurar su correcta ejecución.
Tomar capturas de pantalla de las campañas activas y generar reportes de realización.
Acceder a plataformas como Google Ads para extraer datos y elaborar reportes de rendimiento.
Llevar el control de gastos de campañas vs presupuesto diario y mensual.
Verificar que las facturas correspondan a los montos presupuestados para evitar errores y sobregastos.
Consolidar información en reportes administrativos para el equipo de marketing.
Colaborar con el equipo de marketing digital para optimizar procesos de control y seguimiento.
Mantener actualizados los registros de inversión y resultados de campañas.
Apoyar en la preparación de presentaciones y reportes para reuniones internas.
Interactuar con áreas de finanzas y proveedores para la validación de facturación.
Cumplir con estándares de precisión y tiempos de entrega en todos los reportes.


LO QUE NECESITAS SABER (o HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS)


Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas (o carrera afín).
Interés en marketing digital y disposición para aprender sobre campañas pagadas.
Conocimientos básicos de herramientas digitales (Google Ads deseable).
Manejo de Excel y habilidades para análisis de datos.
Inglés básico (lectura y comprensión).
Capacidad para trabajar con presupuestos y reportes financieros.
Deseable experiencia previa en áreas administrativas o control presupuestal.


Tú (behavioural Skills)


Atención al detalle y enfoque en la precisión.
Organización y capacidad para manejar múltiples tareas.
Proactividad para aprender y adaptarse a nuevas herramientas.
Trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva.
Compromiso con la integridad y la confiabilidad en la información.


VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una posición única para cumplir con esa visión.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

Nuestra Labor Se Guía Por Nuestros Valores


Fiabilidad: Entendemos que los fanáticos y clientes dependen de nosotros para hacer posible sus experiencias en eventos en vivo, y nosotros dependemos los unos de los otros para lograrlo.
Trabajo en equipo: Creemos que el logro individual es insignificante en comparación con el éxito que se puede lograr en equipo.
Integridad: Estamos comprometidos con los más altos estándares morales y éticos en nombre de los innumerables socios y partes interesadas que representamos.
Sentido de pertenencia: Estamos comprometidos a construir una cultura en la que todas las personas puedan ser su yo auténtico, tengan voz igualitaria y oportunidades para prosperar.


OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES

Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. description:
About the job

TikTok Shop Growth Manager




EVMT Brands | Remote | Full-time | 2,000-2,500/month USD + Performance BONUS

EVMT Brands makes liquid chalk, the grip product trusted by 250,000+ athletes across powerlifting, CrossFit, climbing, and calisthenics. Amazon is locked in. TikTok Shop is wide open. We need someone to light the fuse.




We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who has done this before, knows what a winning TikTok Shop affiliate program looks like, and can walk in on day one and build it. This is your chance to own the channel, own the results, and build something that matters.




You will take full ownership of the program. We currently run the channel through an agency; your job is to take it over and bring it fully in-house, with the agency supporting the transition.




What Winning Looks Like

Six months in: a creator army of quality affiliates posting regularly, average GMV per video climbing, fulfillment rates above 50%, and a GMV Max library that actually delivers. You will have built the outreach process, the content standards, the re-engagement system, and the weekly reporting cadence from scratch. The program runs because of you..




Your Playbook

One Thing:

Turn liquid chalk creators into a high-converting TikTok Shop sales machine.




Own These First:

Run targeted creator outreach in Euka across all creator tiers, prioritizing signals that predict performance: niche fit, engagement quality, and posting consistency. Volume matters, but the goal is creators who actually post and convert.
Build and enforce a content standard: every video in GMV Max has a hook in the first 3 seconds, a product demo, proof, and a CTA, no exceptions
Analyze performance data to identify growth opportunities, propose experiments, and build a roadmap to scale TikTok Shop profitably.
Keep creators engaged: re-engagement flows for non-posters, posting deadlines, follow-up DMs, and accountability
Drive GMV Max performance: improve delivery rate, average GMV per video, and overall affiliate-attributed sales month over month
Manage and hold external agencies accountable through KPIs, testing plans, and performance reviews.




Daily and Weekly Hustle:

• Run outreach campaigns, review performance, kill what is not working, scale what is

• Review every creator video before it enters GMV Max, approve, reject, or provide exact feedback and hook scripts

• Track the full sample funnel: applications, approvals, delivered, fulfilled, videos posted

• Report weekly to the founder with clean numbers and clear recommendations

• Own the creator CRM, accurate status on every creator at every stage




Who You Are

• You have built a TikTok Shop affiliate program before and have the results to prove it. We want to see numbers: before and after GMV, creator pool size, fulfillment rates.

• You have owned a channel or program yourself, not run one piece of it inside a bigger team. When you describe your results, "I" should be doing most of the work in the sentence, not "we".

• You have managed 100+ creator relationships simultaneously and kept them moving

• You understand TikTok GMV Max deeply: how the delivery algorithm works, what makes a video clear the bar, how to build a library that performs

• You have built outreach processes from scratch, not just inherited someone else's system

• You know what a good hook looks like and can write one yourself

• Experience with Euka, JoinBrands, or similar creator outreach platforms

• Strong written English for creator DMs, hook scripts, and briefs

• Data-driven: comfortable in Google Sheets and AI tools, clean data entry is non-negotiable

• You do not wait to be told what to do. You identify the problem and fix it.

• Detail-oriented with a structured process for A/B testing. Design and prioritize structured experiments across creator outreach, content angles, incentives, product selection, and GMV Max strategy.




Bonus:

• Background in fitness, sports, or health categories on TikTok Shop

• Experience working directly with founders or small teams




Work Setup

Remote, full-time (Philippines or Latin America preferred)
40 hours per week, Monday through Friday
US Pacific Time business hours overlap required
Full-time and exclusive: no concurrent clients or side projects
Start date: as soon as possible




Compensation

2,000-2,500/month USD + Performance Bonus tied to affiliate GMV




This role grows: we plan to launch our second brand on TikTok Shop and expand both brands to Meta and Instagram. Deliver on TikTok, and the role becomes social commerce across two brands, with compensation revised upward as scope grows.




Why EVMT

The product is proven. The Amazon business is real. TikTok Shop is the next chapter and it is wide open. You will have direct access to the founder, a real budget, and full ownership of the channel. No bureaucracy. No hand-holding. Just a big opportunity and the trust to run with it.

We are not filling a seat. We are finding the person who builds this.

Shortlisted candidates will receive four short written questions before any interview.

About the job

Descripción de la empresa Despacho Contable es una empresa dedicada a ofrecer servicios integrales de contabilidad, asesoría fiscal y administración a pequeñas y medianas empresas. Trabajamos de forma cercana con nuestras clientas y clientes para ayudarles a tomar decisiones informadas y mejorar la salud financiera de sus negocios. Apostamos por la innovación en procesos y el uso de herramientas digitales para ofrecer un servicio ágil y transparente. Valoramos el trabajo en equipo, el aprendizaje continuo y la orientación al cliente como pilares de nuestro crecimiento.

Descripción del puesto En el puesto de Clientes marketing te encargarás de diseñar y ejecutar acciones de marketing orientadas a atraer, fidelizar y potenciar la relación con la cartera de clientes del Despacho Contable. En tu día a día realizarás campañas de comunicación digital, elaborarás contenidos para redes sociales y email marketing, y colaborarás en la creación de estrategias para mejorar la experiencia de las personas clientes. También analizarás datos de mercado y de comportamiento de clientes para proponer mejoras en los servicios y apoyar al equipo de ventas. About the job

Test Coordinator




We're looking for a proactive, community-minded professional to help run the day-to-day operations of our Game Tester platform. In this multi-faceted role, you'll support tester communities across Discord, email, and in-platform channels, review and refine test submissions to ensure quality standards are met, and act as a key point of contact for clients — guiding their testing requirements and helping troubleshoot issues when submissions fall short. You'll balance hands-on ownership with cross-functional collaboration, working closely with support, community, and client teams to keep testing running smoothly, testers engaged, and clients confident in the value we deliver.




Please note this is a temporary 6-month contract with possibility for extension or permanent employment.




What You Will Do:




Test Coordination

Review and test each submission for approval.
Monitor and manage live test invites.
Cooperate directly with clients to deliver the best results for their needs.
Own and manage designated client accounts as required.
Manage and support testers during testing phases.
Create Discord servers or channels to account for test needs.




Tester Reviews

Review and rate all tester feedback submitted on the platform.
Regularly review testers for promotion or demotion in our VIP programme.
Create guidance and best practice documentation for testers.
Revoke tester feedback and issue warnings for poor behaviour on platform.




Community Management

Engage with community directly to keep discussion active and heathy.
Moderate discussion and enforce server rules.
Work with helper and moderation volunteers.
Set up and organise social events, competitions, and game nights.
Set up and award winners of weekly giveaways.
Announce new updates and features, engaging the most interest as possible.




Social Media

Monitor game release dates and supply information to colleagues for creation of launch trailers.
Scour social media looking for developers attempting to recruit for play tests to introduce ourselves.




Please note: This list is not exhaustive, and your day-to-day responsibilities will likely adapt and change over time depending on business needs and resources.




To Be Successful You Will Have:

1+ years experience with community management and/or coordinating events on schedule and within scope.
Outstanding communication and writing skills, including ability to ask questions or share information with clarity and brevity.
Fluency in English is mandatory.
Coordination skills, business acumen, and the ability to work with lots of moving pieces.
Passion about our customers, our technology, and our people.
Analytical/problem solving skills, demonstrated success in driving complex programs .
Be a motivated self-starter.




What Game Tester needs…

Our primary focus is on providing the best possible service to every developer and publisher that uses our platform. This has meant a never-ending review of our platform and processes. Always looking to improve the way things are done, reduce unnecessary workload and ultimately make the best possible platform for our partners.

We are a small team in a large organization where every single employee has a huge impact on the success of our platform. For this reason, we need self-starters and self-thinkers. Someone that can identify pain-points and propose solutions. You will need to be highly adaptable as our business grows and be willing to offer your support where it is most needed at all times.

You will be joining us for a roller coaster journey where your passionate commitment and contribution will be a key pillar in our long-term success, leading to many opportunities for growth in our business.

If you have what it takes, we would love to talk!




What you can expect in return:

The opportunity to work with world-leading companies, opening the door to limitless opportunities.
Working with a Forbes-listed World-Leader in “Best Remote employer”, “Top employer of Women” and “Top employer for Diversity”.




About Us

Lionbridge Games help our customers deliver the seamless experience they envision to any audience around the world, without compromise. Our team of global gamers helps developers, publishers and platform-holders complete thousands of game audio, localization, testing and other player experience projects on time and on budget. Learn more at games.lionbridge.com.

The successful candidate will have to pass a criminal background check to Lionbridge’s satisfaction. A criminal record does not constitute an automatic bar to employment at Lionbridge, and the nature of the job, the seriousness of the crime and date of the conviction will be considered.




Breaking Barriers. Building Bridges.

title: Team Lead, Agency Growth Sales, SpLATAM - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the team:
TikTok's Agency Sales team is at the forefront of connecting agencies of all sizes with TikTok's creative ecosystem — helping them unlock performance, build compelling narratives for their clients, and grow sustainably on the platform. Our team operates at the intersection of business strategy, product expertise, and client partnership.

The LATAM Agency team is a high-growth, high-impact environment where no two days are the same. We move fast, think big, and win together.

About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to head our Agency Sales function across Latin America. This is a player-coach role: you will manage and mentor a team of Agency Partner Managers while also owning strategic relationships with our most critical agency partners in the region.

You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, developing the agency ecosystem, and representing TikTok as the go-to performance and brand-building platform for agencies across Brazil & SpLATAM markets including Mexico, Colombia, Argentina. You will be a key voice in shaping regional strategy, go-to-market motions, and long-term agency enablement programs.

This role requires an experience leader with deep knowledge of the LATAM agency landscape, a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, and the ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams in a hyper-growth environment.

In-Office Policy - We are currently working in the office 4x a week in Polanco and will be moving to full-time, 5 days in-office by September 2026.

*Please submit your resume in English in order to be considered*

Responsibilities:
1) Team Leadership & People Development
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Agency Partner Managers across region, fostering a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, creativity, and commercial rigor.
- Set clear team objectives, track performance against KPIs, and provide structured feedback and development plans to support individual growth.
- Recruit, onboard, and retain top commercial talent as the team scales.
- Serve as a role model for consultative selling, strategic account management, and cross-functional collaboration.

2) Revenue & Business Growth
- Own and drive the team's revenue targets across the SMB agency segment in LATAM, with accountability for both top-line growth and portfolio health metrics.
- Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic agency partnerships — including independent agencies, regional networks, and in-market holding company affiliates.
- Architect and execute scaled engagement models that allow the team to grow agency revenue efficiently across a large and diverse book of business.
- Build and manage a robust pipeline of new agency acquisition opportunities, translating market trends into actionable growth strategies.

3) Agency Partnerships & Enablement
- Build deep, strategic relationships with C-level and high-level stakeholders at top agencies 
- Lead executive business reviews (QBRs) and joint business planning sessions with key agency partners to align on growth roadmaps and investment strategies.
- Develop and oversee structured agency education and certification programs, ensuring partners are fluent in TikTok product solutions, creative best practices, and full-funnel strategies.
- Champion TikTok's value proposition externally, representing the platform at industry events, agency summits, and partner forums across the region.

4) Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
- Serve as the primary voice-of-the-market for LATAM agency insights, providing structured feedback to Product, Marketing, and Operations to shape platform priorities and scaled solutions.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Global Sales Excellence, Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Ops to design and execute regional go-to-market initiatives.
- Develop data-driven strategic narratives and market analysis to inform leadership decisions and regional investment priorities.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Years of experience in digital advertising, media sales, or agency partnerships, with at least 3 years in a team leadership or management role.
- Deep, firsthand knowledge of the LATAM agency ecosystem — including the leading independent agencies, regional holding company structures, and the key decision-makers shaping client investment across major markets.
- Demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue targets and growing complex, multi-stakeholder agency relationships in a fast-paced commercial environment.
- Proven ability to coach and develop commercial talent, with experience building and scaling high-performing sales teams.
- High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-speaking markets".
- Strong command of the digital advertising ecosystem — including performance marketing, programmatic, social, and full-funnel planning — with the ability to credibly advise high-level agency leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience at a social media, digital platform, or ad tech company, ideally working directly with or within agencies at a leadership level.
- Familiarity with TikTok's advertising solutions, including TikTok for Business, Shop Ads, and performance-based products.
- Knowledge of auction-based and programmatic ad products, and experience translating product complexity into commercial narratives for agency audiences.
- Experience designing and leading scaled agency enablement programs such as certification tracks, partner academies, or structured QBR frameworks.
- Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-suite stakeholders both externally (agency partners) and internally (TikTok leadership).
- Passion for TikTok's mission and a genuine curiosity about creator culture, short-form content trends, and the evolving role of social commerce in LATAM.
- Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building from the ground up, iterating quickly, and driving clarity in ambiguous, high-growth environments.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Sales Development Representative - Mexico City
skills: Maximize opportunities for partners and BDMs by generating leads and converting prospects into customers.
Maintain technical knowledge of the Geotab ecosystem and act as the subject matter expert to help partners and prospects better understand the solutions available to their customer base.
Interact with prospective customers via inbound and outbound channels, including live chat and website submissions, to engage prospects and successfully demonstrate Geotab's capabilities.
Effectively communicate and coordinate to set appointments for Business Development team members, ensuring a smooth handover to the appropriate team.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all interactions and lead status in Geotab's CRM (Salesforce) while upholding organizational SLAs on inbound requests.
Collaborate with Sales, BDM, and Marketing teams to provide feedback on campaigns, sales strategies, and lead generation activities.
Strive to meet and exceed both personal and team goals in net subscriptions while building company credibility, brand value, and trust within the assigned business channel.
1-3 years of experience in technical sales; understanding of fleet management and telematics preferred, with channel sales experience or knowledge an asset.
Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and work experience may be substituted.
Strong customer service orientation with excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to develop rapport with potential customers.
Understanding of sales techniques and methods used for lead qualification, with the ability to align product pitches to partner needs and core business objectives.
Strong aptitude for understanding technical and business requirements, with the ability to translate technical solutions to meet customer needs.
Technical competence using software programs including Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and CRM tools such as Salesforce.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously; entrepreneurial mindset with comfort working in a flat organization.
The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only
description:
About the job

Who We Are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who You Are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking an Inbound Sales Development Representative who will develop sales activity within assigned segments through inbound prospecting, synergizing with the Marketing and Events teams to pinpoint and cultivate prospect opportunities for strategic follow-up, and nurturing potential customers who have shown an interest in our solutions before handing them over to the appropriate team. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Do:

As an Inbound Sales Development Representative, your key area of responsibility will be qualifying inbound leads, making initial contact with prospects, gathering detailed customer information, nurturing leads through regular follow-up, scheduling appointments with the appropriate sales team members, and maintaining accurate CRM records. You will need to work closely with Geotab's Sales, Business Development, and Marketing teams to provide feedback on campaigns, sales strategies, and lead generation activities.

To be successful in this role you will be a customer-centric communicator with strong listening skills and excellent verbal and written communication abilities. In addition, the successful candidate will have a strong sales and technical aptitude, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, maintain CRM accuracy, and translate technical solutions to meet customer needs.

How You'll Make An Impact:


Maximize opportunities for partners and BDMs by generating leads and converting prospects into customers. 
Maintain technical knowledge of the Geotab ecosystem and act as the subject matter expert to help partners and prospects better understand the solutions available to their customer base.
Interact with prospective customers via inbound and outbound channels, including live chat and website submissions, to engage prospects and successfully demonstrate Geotab's capabilities.
Effectively communicate and coordinate to set appointments for Business Development team members, ensuring a smooth handover to the appropriate team. 
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all interactions and lead status in Geotab's CRM (Salesforce) while upholding organizational SLAs on inbound requests. 
Collaborate with Sales, BDM, and Marketing teams to provide feedback on campaigns, sales strategies, and lead generation activities.
Strive to meet and exceed both personal and team goals in net subscriptions while building company credibility, brand value, and trust within the assigned business channel. 


What You'll Bring To This Role:


1-3 years of experience in technical sales; understanding of fleet management and telematics preferred, with channel sales experience or knowledge an asset. 
Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and work experience may be substituted. 
Strong customer service orientation with excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to develop rapport with potential customers. 
Understanding of sales techniques and methods used for lead qualification, with the ability to align product pitches to partner needs and core business objectives. 
Strong aptitude for understanding technical and business requirements, with the ability to translate technical solutions to meet customer needs. 
Technical competence using software programs including Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and CRM tools such as Salesforce. 
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously; entrepreneurial mindset with comfort working in a flat organization. 


If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.:

Why Job Seekers Choose Geotab:

Flex working arrangements

Home office reimbursement program

Baby bonus & parental leave top up program

Online learning and networking opportunities

Electric vehicle purchase incentive program

Competitive medical and dental benefits

Retirement savings program


The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only


How We Work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Click here to read our Privacy Notice.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

This role will be part of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Team within the Financial Crimes organization in SDC that is accountable for monitoring, investigating, and reporting suspicious activity indicative of money laundering and other financial crimes.

What you’ll do

We're looking for someone who is passionate about financial crimes and solving the puzzle of investigations, is naturally curious, and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and finding creative solutions. You will be responsible for reviewing and dispositioning Transaction Monitoring alerts, conducting AML Investigations, and drafting and filing Suspicious Activity reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Report (STRs) with various Financial Intelligence Units.

Responsibilities


Conduct AML Investigations from beginning to end, including conducting transaction analysis and open-source and public records research in various jurisdictions.
Document in detail the rationale for the investigative process and recommendations of each review.
Draft and file Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with various Financial Intelligence Units.
Maintain operational excellence across various workstreams.
Review and disposition Transaction Monitoring alerts.
Demonstrate sound judgment and an ability to navigate non-binary, high-risk decisions.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Strong English written and verbal capabilities;
2+ years of analytical or investigative experience, preferably within the financial crimes, AML, risk, threat analysis, or fraud fields.
Strong research, writing, and analytical skills.
Ability to demonstrate an understanding of financial crime typologies and patterns utilized to exploit financial institutions.
Ability to synthesize large amounts of information such as transaction data and identify key trends. 
Ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources to determine a course of action for a matched case.



Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge and experience in the payments and fintech industry.
Previous experience working in a Compliance function.
ACAMS or similar certification.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.

We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. You’re the growth engine for the pods. In the core business, this work splits across product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle teams; here, it’s one person doing all of it — finding the message that lands, filling the early-access pipeline, and turning a working product into paying customers. You’ll set positioning, generate demand, and own the funnel from first touch to renewal, working hand in hand with Pod Founders who are selling as they build. This is a blank-page job: most pods start with no category, no audience list, and no playbook, and you’ll build all three. The role reports to the President, Foundry, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Marketing leadership.

What You’ll Do


Own positioning and messaging. Craft the value proposition, naming, and packaging input for products customers have never heard of, and maintain messaging frameworks by segment across K12, higher education, and business and government.
Run go-to-market and launch. Own go-to-market readiness for pilots, early access, and general availability — timelines, channels, pricing input, and the launch assets that carry the story.
Build the demand engine. Generate pipeline through campaigns, audience building, early-access recruiting, and the top of the funnel that feeds the Founder’s selling.
Drive content. Create the collateral, digital content, and customer-facing assets that build demand and make the differentiation obvious.
Be the market and customer expert. Become the go-to expert on the portfolio’s customers and competitors, and feed that insight back into product and pricing.
Own lifecycle and adoption. Once customers land, drive adoption, expansion, and retention with consistent, value-based messaging.
Measure and adjust. Track funnel and campaign performance against pipeline and revenue, and change course fast when the numbers say so.


What You’ll Need


Five or more years in product, portfolio, or growth marketing, ideally in ed tech or a related industry, with new-product launches under your belt.
A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.
Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.
Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.
The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.
A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.


This Role Isn’t For Everyone

You should probably pass if:


You want to own one slice — just messaging, or just campaigns — and hand off the rest.
You need an established brand and a built-in audience to market into. Here you build the category.
You measure success by impressions and activity rather than by pipeline and revenue.
You want a large marketing organization with clear lanes. This is one person, broad scope, and fast.


Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:


Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.
Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.
Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.
Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support
Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth
The technology and tools you need to do your best work 
Motivosity employee recognition program
A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection


We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.

description:
About the job

About Us

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.




The Opportunity

We’re looking for a strategic, data-savvy Branded Content Research Editor to join Skift Studio, our in-house branded content division. This role is ideal for a versatile storyteller who straddles pre-sale ideation and post-sale production—combining quantitative research design, editorial writing, client strategy, and live event moderation. You will help top travel brands tell compelling stories with data, harnessing AI tools (like Claude and ChatGPT) responsibly to accelerate workflows while maintaining a strict human-first perspective. This is a fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in Latin America.




Why This Role Matters

Skift Studio delivers best-in-class multi-platform programs—combining intelligence, research, event experiences, and advertising—for Skift’s commercial partners. As Branded Content Research Editor, you own the research engine and narrative voice behind these commercial campaigns. By translating complex quantitative data and sponsor briefs into authoritative reports, high-impact articles, and dynamic stage discussions, you directly shape how major brands speak to the global travel industry. Your work ensures that sponsor-funded content carries the same sharp, indispensable rigor as our mainline journalistic coverage.




Some of What You’ll Do

Quantitative Research Design & Execution (Core)

Design and manage sponsor-funded quantitative research projects end-to-end—including writing survey questionnaires, coordinating executive panel recruitment, cleaning/analyzing datasets, and translating findings into sponsor-facing insights.
Collaborate closely with the sales team on pre-sale ideation to pitch research-led proposals that differentiate Skift Studio’s commercial offerings.

Content Production & AI Workflows (Core)

Write and/or manage freelance talent developing sponsored content programs across formats, including short-form articles, long-form reports, insight decks, spoken presentations, and video scripts.
Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate early-stage ideation, outline drafting, interview prep, and desk research while strictly upholding Skift Studio's editorial standards, originality, and fact-checking.

Client Strategy & Event Moderation

Handle day-to-day interactions with sponsors to review deliverables, incorporate feedback, keep tight timelines on track, and ensure maximum content visibility across platforms.
Research, script, and moderate partner events in both live and virtual formats—including sponsored Skift Summit/Forum talks, custom panel discussions, and webinars.
Collaborate with the internal studio team to continuously refine and evolve our product suite and research-based formats.

Your New Role:
The Business Analyst is responsible for the planning and execution throughout the lifecycle of one or more software solutions within the business domain. This includes creating and prioritizing product and business requirements and working closely with business and technology teams to ensure business stakeholder and end user satisfaction goals are met. He or she will create and develop requirements and concepts for product enhancements in support of business and technology needs. This position provides a wide variety of services to our business users including business analysis and quality assurance, in support of strategic and tactical planning of systems features / functionality as well as day to day business operations. The role also entails Project Management for software releases and managing of SOX processes and documentation.




Your Role Accountabilities:

Serve as primary contact for the business for the support of system functionality, business process and workflow and react to emerging or changing revenue opportunities and industry trends.
Lead proof-of-concept priority projects related to new or adjusted business processes to satisfy industry or business adjustments. 
Participate in assessment and feasibility studies of available technologies and recommend solutions.
Manage business and functional requirements for one or more business solutions related to Content Rights, Scheduling, Traffic, Presentation and Reconciliation operations.
Manage relationships with multiple business organizations, global technology groups and 3rd party software vendors including: facilitating requirement and design workshops, reviewing designs, test plans and test cases; reviewing vendor deliverables and schedules; managing quality or delivery issues with the vendor; coordinating end user testing and sign-off for in-house and vendor deliverables.

Functional Testing

Perform functional testing and document workflow and configuration changes related to system and process adjustments based on Proof-of-concept outcomes or business requirements.

Training

Assist in the design, delivery, and improvement of in-house training programs and related courseware.

Compliance and Standards

Ensure compliance with Warner Bros. Discovery Software Development Lifecycle documentation and mandated compliance requirements for all application changes.

General

Work independently under minimal supervision.




Qualifications & Experiences:

Excellent problem solving and analytical skills

Our client is a U.S.-based e-commerce agency that manages and supports Amazon brands across a variety of consumer product categories, including apparel, skincare, sleepwear, beauty, food, jewelry, and other physical goods.
