We will count on you to:


Lead end-to-end development, governance and approvals process for all social media programs and campaign content ensuring every activation aligns to brand standards, best practices and commercial priorities.
Responsible for development and social activation of Marsh brand partnerships, translating enterprise investments into high-impact content and campaigns that strengthen visibility, engagement and brand authority.
Accountable for Marsh’s Instagram channel strategy, content and performance, shaping how the brand shows up on one of the firm’s highest-growth and highest-visibility platforms.
Core member of Marsh brand reputation and crisis management team, balancing speed, governance and executive risk mitigation in high-pressure moments. Own daily brand and crisis monitoring through use of technology and hands-on across different social media platforms, bringing together findings, insights and recommendations for stakeholders.
Lead weekly team meetings between social media and marketing stakeholders to discuss priorities, review programs in development and/or active and align on actions, creating a collaborative and transparent working culture together.
Contribute to presentations, scorecards and KPIs to measure social media and strategic marketing programs effectiveness.
Contribute to strategic projects as a part of the enterprise social media team focused on continuous growth and innovation.


What you need to have:


Must have a minimum of two years B2B social media experience, with demonstrative knowledge of LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.
Strong time-management and organizational skills, problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.
Proven ability to work both in a team setting as well as independently driving programs, with strong communications skills.
Demonstrated ability to build a social media campaign from brief through to final social assets and post copy, demonstrating understanding of and application of social media channel best practices.


What makes you stand out:


Strong understanding and application of B2B social media content strategy, platform algorithms, and expertise in interpreting social media performance/delivering recommendations
Expertise with brand and crisis management across platforms including Instagram, Facebook and Reddit
Demonstrable skills with social media employee advocacy across LinkedIn is a plus


Why join our team:


We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Multimedia Designer/AI Artist
description:
About the job

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About The Role

Monks is seeking a visionary AI Specialist to join our specialized team. We manage a complex product account requiring expertise far beyond typical social media marketing. This is a hybrid role demanding both technical proficiency and creative strategy.

You will be the bridge between cutting-edge AI developments and engaging social content. Your focus will be on anticipating the future of LLM’s by exploring the current AI landscape, utilizing APIs and coding knowledge to experiment and prototype. Your work will not only keep our social channels ahead of the curve but will also educate our internal teams and our external audience of AI enthusiasts.

Responsibilities

Technical Foresight & Landscape Analysis. Actively monitor developments from Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic to anticipate upcoming AI features. Maintain deep knowledge of the broader AI landscape to provide strategic insights.

Advanced Content Creation & Prototyping. Create compelling social content for X and Instagram targeted at AI enthusiasts. Design and execute complex prompts and utilize API’s to prototype internal tools, test new capabilities, and produce unique images, videos, and copy.

Internal Training & Enablement. Serve as the go-to AI expert, bridging the knowledge gap within the organization. Develop and lead training sessions for creative, strategy, and design teams on new and upcoming AI features.

Playbook Development & Documentation. Document internal use cases and build comprehensive playbooks on how to integrate AI tools (including the Google Work Suite) effectively across the company's strategy, creative, and operations departments.

Education & Demystification. Be a key part of our strategy to demystify AI. For external content, break down the prompts and the technical details (including API usage when relevant) in an engaging, easy-to-understand way.

Client-Facing Engagement. You may also be called upon to engage directly with clients, leveraging your AI expertise to collaboratively problem-solve and educate them on efficient prompting techniques, ensuring they can maximize the utility of AI tools.

About You

Technical Proficiency (Required): Proven experience in coding and hands-on proficiency in working with AI/ML APIs. You must be comfortable exploring technical documentation and building or testing tools.

A Master of Prompts & AI Ecosystems: A proven ability to get extraordinary results from generative AI tools. You must be "in the weeds" with current LLM’s.

A Natural Trainer and Explainer: Excellent at translating complex, technical concepts into simple, engaging language. You must have a passion for training others and documenting processes.

Social Savvy (Niche Expertise): Deep understanding of what resonates with the AI enthusiast community on platforms like X, and the ability to advise copywriters on relevant technical trends.

A Creative Problem-Solver: You love a challenge and enjoy figuring out how to use new technology, including APIs, to solve creative problems, build internal tools, and optimize workflows.

At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

skills: Grow and diversify the Mexico supply base to improve competitiveness and optimize cost for purchased components and services.Manage new supplier onboarding and certification, ensuring suppliers meet required eligibility and assessment standards.
Lead sourcing program management activities for Mexico-built vehicles (“Mx to Mx” program management), aligning sourcing timing and deliverables with vehicle program milestones.
Support other buyers and global commodity teams by providing Mexico market intelligence and local supplier options to achieve best-cost outcomes.
New Supplier Identification & Development (Mexico Focus)
Proactively identify, screen, and qualify potential Mexico-based suppliers aligned to commodity strategy and manufacturing footprint needs.
Build and maintain a robust pipeline of candidate suppliers through market research, industry networks, plant/cluster mapping, and collaboration with internal stakeholders.
Engage potential investors/suppliers to develop Mexico commodity capability where gaps exist (localization opportunities, new capacity, or technical capability expansion).
Coordinate supplier discovery activities (intro meetings, RFIs, NDA initiation, capability reviews) and maintain supplier profiles and documentation.
Supplier Eligibility / New Supplier Assessment Leadership
Lead the Supplier Pre-Assessment Process (SPA) to evaluate suitability of supplier manufacturing locations for specific programs and material groups.
Initiate and coordinate New Supplier Assessment requests, ensure required forms/data are complete, and archive/retrieve assessment results per work instruction.

Partner with Supplier Quality and Engineering to ensure assessments cover core quality planning and execution controls (e.g., process control, PFMEA, control plan alignment, containment, escalation, LPA).
Drive closure of assessment findings with suppliers (action plans, timing, follow-up validations), escalating risks as needed.
Coordinate the financial assessment of new suppliers.
Sourcing Execution & Commercial Management
Manage resourcing/sourcing activities from source package creation through execution, including RFQ coordination, supplier communications, and recommendation preparation.
Support negotiations and develop sourcing recommendations consistent with governance and delegation of authority (DoA), partnering with regional/global stakeholders.
Coordinate cross-functional inputs required for supplier selection (engineering feasibility, capacity, logistics flows, program timing, risk assessments).
Program Management for Mexico Vehicle Production Sourcing
Perform purchasing program management activities for vehicles produced in Mexico by coordinating sourcing deliverables, timing, and readiness gates across multiple commodities and plants.
Track sourcing milestones and ensure supplier industrialization plans align with program requirements (tooling readiness, PPAP timing, launch support).
Provide regular status reporting and risk/issue management to stakeholders (constraints, timing conflicts, open actions).
Cost Competitiveness & Support to Other Buyers
Support other buyers and commodity teams in identifying cost-effective Mexico-based suppliers, including local representation for global teams without Mexico presence.
Contribute to cost reduction initiatives for direct material by identifying localization/resourcing opportunities and supporting implementation with plant and purchasing teams.
Provide Mexico supplier market benchmarks, should-cost inputs (where available), and commercial insights to improve negotiation outcomes.
Bachelor’s degree (Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, or related).
3 years experience in automotive purchasing/sourcing and supplier management (direct materials strongly preferred).
Strong English proficiency (written and spoken).
Proven ability to lead cross-functional workstreams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with quality system expectations used in supplier assessments (e.g., PFMEA/control plan discipline, containment, LPA concepts).
Program management experience supporting vehicle programs or industrialization/launch readiness.

About the job

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Zoho CRM Expert based in Mexico.

This is a remote contract opportunity for a Zoho CRM Expert responsible for optimizing CRM systems, improving business processes, and enabling teams to make better use of customer data. The role focuses on configuring, customizing, and maintaining Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin environments to support sales, marketing, and customer service operations. You will help streamline workflows, automate processes, and ensure accurate data management across platforms. This position is ideal for a CRM specialist who enjoys solving technical challenges and creating efficient digital solutions. You will collaborate with international teams and contribute to improving customer journeys through data-driven insights. The role offers flexibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to work on impactful CRM transformation projects.

Accountabilities

As a Zoho CRM Expert, you will manage the configuration, optimization, and ongoing improvement of CRM platforms to ensure smooth operations and effective user adoption. You will work closely with stakeholders to enhance workflows, maintain data quality, and provide actionable insights through reporting and automation.


Configure, customize, and maintain Zoho CRM modules, including fields, layouts, permissions, workflows, automations, and dashboards.
Manage Zoho Bigin pipelines, teams, roles, and workflows while supporting integrations with other tools.
Maintain CRM data integrity through cleaning, deduplication, imports, exports, synchronization, and regular audits.
Create reports and dashboards to monitor lead generation, sales pipelines, and customer lifecycle performance.
Train users, support CRM adoption, and develop documentation and best-practice guidelines.
Troubleshoot system issues and manage access controls, permissions, and security settings.
Ensure CRM processes align with privacy and data protection requirements.


Requirements

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin, with the ability to configure systems, improve workflows, and support users in adopting efficient CRM practices. You should combine technical expertise with strong analytical thinking and a proactive approach to problem-solving.


Demonstrable experience with Zoho CRM and Zoho Bigin setup, customization, workflows, and automation.
Strong data management skills, including record maintenance, data hygiene, synchronization, and integrations.
Ability to build effective dashboards, reports, and analytical insights from CRM data.
Experience supporting users, delivering training, and creating process documentation.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
Proactive mindset with the ability to identify improvements and optimize processes.
Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Additional fluency in German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, or another major language is preferred.

High level of autonomy within a digital-first working environment.

Join the LEGO Group as a Digital Merchandiser and help drive eCommerce growth across LATAM. In this role, you'll optimize product content, improve discoverability, and collaborate with top retailers to deliver an outstanding online shopping experience. It's a chance to make a real impact in a fast-paced, creative environment!


Core Responsibilities

e-Merchandising (50%)



Create, maintain, and optimize product content (images, copy, BTC content, video, etc.) based on performance metrics, SEO best practices, and other insights.  Monitor digital shelf quality for continual optimization of content – adhering to retailer requirements. 
Accountable for product launches at eCommerce retailers across LATAM – planning and implementing product launches with all applicable selling information and enhanced content. Bring forward ideas to improve this process.

Digital Marketing (25%)

Carry out After Action Reviews for B2B Marketing Implementation with customers to help refine our digital spend.

Play your part in our team succeeding

As a Digital Merchandiser, you will contribute to the growth of the eCommerce business by providing digital merchandising support to our eCommerce retailers. This includes improving discoverability, online search rankings, conversion, and the overall shopper experience.

Hands-on experience in digital merchandising within eCommerce.

Retail eCommerce platforms experience – Familiarity with e-commerce platforms is a bonus!

About the job

We are looking for an organized, digitally capable, and detail-oriented Junior Account Executive to join our agency.




This position combines digital campaign coordination with direct support for one of the agency’s Partners in managing the processes, deliverables, and daily requirements of selected accounts. The ideal candidate enjoys organizing information, preparing professional materials, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring projects move forward efficiently.




Key Responsibilities




Support the coordination, execution and monitoring of digital campaigns.
Track account deliverables, approvals, budgets, timelines, and pending actions.
Coordinate materials with Account, Creative, Content, and Performance teams.
Prepare campaign reports and monitor basic performance metrics.
Maintain project trackers, briefs, meeting notes, files, and administrative documentation.
Prepare presentations, proposals, reports, and other account-related documents.
Coordinate account calendars, meetings, agendas, reminders, and follow-up actions.
Conduct research, summarize information, and translate ideas into clear documents, presentations, and action plans.
Follow up with internal teams, clients, and external stakeholders.
Work closely with an agency Partner to maintain visibility and continuity across assigned accounts.




Candidate Profile




1–3 years of experience in digital marketing, account coordination, project operations, or a similar agency role.

Basic knowledge of digital campaigns and platforms such as Meta Ads or Google Ads.

Strong organizational, communication, presentation, and document-formatting skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain close follow-up, and collaborate with senior team members.

Proactive, accountable, detail-oriented, and interested in developing a career within a marketing agency.




Required Tools




Proficient use of Google Workspace, including Sheets, Docs, Slides, Drive, Calendar, and Gmail.

Working proficiency in Canva, Gamma, and NotebookLM for presentations, visual materials, research, summaries, and project documentation.

English Proficiency

Desired English level: TOEIC score of 730 or equivalent working proficiency.




Work Model




This is a hybrid position combining remote work with scheduled in-office collaboration. On-site attendance may be required for meetings, presentations, planning sessions, or specific project needs.

Candidates should be comfortable working in a dynamic agency environment, adapting to shifting priorities, and supporting the effective management of multiple account processes.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr



Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities worldwide
We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact. 
We employ just over a thousand team members across five countries and we want to employ over 5,000 people by 2027, if not sooner

LET'S START WITH OUR VALUES



Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY
We do our best work by being CURIOUS
We grow by remaining DYNAMIC
Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE 
At the heart of great partnerships, we'll always find EMPATHY

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE



As a Customer Specialist, you will serve as the primary point of contact for participating salons and distributors in the client's Sustainable Beauty Partner rewards program, independently resolving inquiries for a portfolio of approximately 4,000 salons and 20 distributors across the US and Canada. 


You will exercise proactive, independent critical thinking to determine appropriate solutions, and deliver white glove, VIP level support to high end beauty salons, with personalized, empathetic written communication tailored to each partner rather than templated responses. You will also ensure timely support, accurate program maintenance, and seamless coordination across internal teams and external partners.


WHY DO WE WANT YOU



We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate about helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic, and Authentic.


WHAT WILL YOU DO


Interact with customers to provide and process accurate, valid, and complete information with the highest degree of empathy, courtesy, and professionalism
Independently resolve inquiries and account, order, and program related issues for approximately 4,000 participating salons and 20 distributors across the US and Canada, exercising sound, proactive judgment rather than defaulting to escalation
Deliver white glove, VIP level support to high end beauty salons in the program, crafting personalized and empathetic written communication for each interaction
Perform problem tracking and ensure that issues are properly prioritized, documented, tracked, and resolved, including order, account, and program related issues
Ensure proper and timely escalation of genuinely complex or sensitive issues to meet internal and external expectations, including troubleshooting and escalating technical issues as needed
Support the returns process, including tracking returns and reviewing and updating account records accordingly
Manage partner redemption opportunities and reporting, including tracking status and ensuring timely completion
Build and maintain Excel based reporting for redemption tracking and program performance, ensuring accuracy for internal and client facing use
Maintain and update program materials, such as order forms and product information, including managing product transitions and communicating availability timelines
Support administration of program tracking initiatives, including compiling submissions and coordinating communications with participating partners
Act as a point of expertise on program structure, redemption processes, and partner accounts, supporting teammates and contributing to continuous process improvement
You are expected to deliver service excellence and maximize customer satisfaction
Work with the client team to stay updated on product and service knowledge

WHAT WE'LL LIKE ABOUT YOU




 YOU ARE...


Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
An analytical and critical thinker, with an eye for even the most minute of details
Passionate about client satisfaction
A self starter, comfortable making independent decisions and exercising judgment without close supervision


YOU HAVE...


3+ years of customer service experience (email, phone, or chat support), including experience managing multiple systems, platforms, and priorities simultaneously, ideally including support for high touch, VIP, or premium client segments
Strong knowledge of cloud based applications (Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs) and MS Office applications, including proficiency in Excel for building and maintaining reporting
Excellent reading comprehension, and verbal, and written communication skills
Strong and effective phone contact handling skills along with strong organizational and administrative skills and attention to detail
An ability to understand and communicate complex ideas to customers, both verbally and in written form
Knowledge and experience with CRM is a plus (e.g., Salesforce)
Aptitude to quickly learn and navigate new technology, systems, and applications, as this role requires working across multiple platforms (e.g., order management, CRM, IT ticketing, and event coordination tools)
The ability to accept feedback gracefully and with an open mind
Solid understanding of Customer Experience best practices, with demonstrated ability to independently resolve complex or sensitive inquiries using sound critical thinking and minimal supervision
Customer orientation and ability to adapt and respond to different types of characters

description:
About the job

About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves. Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what's next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Instagram | TikTok | Culture page

Role Mission

Manage day-to-day social media activity with a strong focus on community engagement and real-time conversations.

It requires a deep understanding of online audience behavior and the ability to translate it into relevant and authentic content. A strong connection to digital culture and experience engaging with diverse communities, including LGBTQ+ audiences, is essential to ensure respectful and effective communication.

,

Key Responsibilities


Manage the day-to-day social media presence.
Plan and update the content calendar.
Create and publish brand-aligned content.
Monitor relevant trends and conversations.
Engage with the audience (comments and messages).
Identify real-time engagement opportunities.
Escalate sensitive topics with sound judgment.
Collaborate with internal teams (creative, strategy, media).
Support paid media amplification.
Analyze performance and optimize the strategy.


Skills & Experience


2+ years of experience in social media management and/or community management
Previous experience working in agencies or fast-paced environments
Strong writing skills and ability to adapt tone depending on context, audience, and platform
Deep understanding of internet culture, platform behaviors, and online communities
Experience managing conversations in real time, including sensitive or high-context topics Ability to identify trends early and act quickly without losing brand consistency Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple workstreams


Benefits


Work your way — Flexible schedule, hybrid work, and the opportunity to work up to 3 weeks a year from any SAMY office around the world.
Time that matters — Celebrate your birthday with a day off, plus company holidays on December 24th and 31st to recharge.
Grow with us — Global mobility opportunities, mentorship, parenthood support, and a transparent performance-driven compensation framework.
Be part of the journey — Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.
Remote Role
Location: Mexico


The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder? Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We're not looking for people who think the same, we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Be Kind — because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

Go Beyond — because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together — because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey — because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It — because real impact starts with accountability.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it's what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier-free environment where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to thrive. And if you need support or adjustments along the way, we'll make sure you have what you need to do your best work.

description:
About the job

Business Development Representative — Financial Institutions

Location: United States — Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: Competitive base salary plus performance-based commissions

Company: QUASH.ai

About QUASH.ai

QUASH.ai is an AI-powered credit intelligence company helping financial institutions improve credit underwriting, fraud detection, and financial inclusion.

Our solutions combine alternative data, predictive scoring, decision engines, and artificial intelligence to help banks, credit unions, fintechs, and lenders make faster and more accurate decisions—particularly for consumers and small businesses with limited traditional credit history.

We are looking for a highly driven Business Development Representative who can identify financial institutions, engage the right decision-makers, conduct effective discovery calls, and consistently generate qualified sales opportunities for our commercial team.

The Role

The primary objective of this position is to generate at least 15 qualified sales opportunities per month following completed discovery calls.

This is not simply an appointment-setting role. The Business Development Representative will be expected to research accounts, identify relevant stakeholders, lead initial discovery conversations, understand the institution’s challenges, and determine whether there is a genuine opportunity for QUASH.ai.

The ideal candidate understands how financial institutions evaluate and purchase credit underwriting technology and is comfortable discussing solutions such as:

Credit risk scores
Alternative data
Credit decision engines
Automated underwriting
Financial inclusion
Fraud detection
Predictive analytics
Lending technology
AI-powered credit intelligence

The candidate will use sales automation, marketing automation, CRM, and generative AI tools to build scalable prospecting workflows across calls, email, SMS, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

Key Performance Objective

The main performance target for this role is:

Generate a minimum of 15 qualified sales opportunities per month after completing discovery calls.

A qualified opportunity should:

Be with a bank, credit union, fintech, lender, or relevant financial-services organization.
Include an appropriate decision-maker, influencer, or internal champion.
Have a clearly identified business challenge or use case.
Demonstrate potential interest in QUASH.ai’s credit underwriting, fraud, alternative-data, or decisioning solutions.
Have an agreed next step with the QUASH.ai sales team.
Be properly documented and accepted as qualified within HubSpot.

The position includes:

A competitive base salary.
Variable compensation for achieving the monthly qualified-opportunity target.
Additional commission when an opportunity generated by the representative becomes a closed customer.

Because enterprise financial-services sales cycles may take several months, closed-business commissions will remain attributable to the representative even when the contract closes after the initial meeting, typically around three months later or according to the company’s commission plan.

Responsibilities
Research banks, credit unions, fintechs, lenders, and other target financial institutions.
Build and manage targeted account and prospect lists.
Identify credit, risk, underwriting, lending, fraud, innovation, data, and technology decision-makers.
Conduct outbound outreach through calls, emails, SMS, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.
Respond to and qualify inbound leads.
Lead initial discovery calls with prospective customers.
Understand each prospect’s current underwriting process, data sources, challenges, priorities, and technology environment.
Clearly present QUASH.ai’s value proposition and relevant use cases.
Determine whether a prospect meets the criteria for a qualified sales opportunity.
Schedule and coordinate follow-up meetings with account executives, product specialists, or company leadership.
Build multichannel prospecting and follow-up sequences using sales automation tools.
Use generative AI tools such as Claude to automate research, messaging, personalization, follow-up, and workflow creation.
Develop scalable outreach processes combining email, SMS, calls, LinkedIn, and automated follow-ups.
Maintain accurate account, contact, activity, and opportunity information within HubSpot.
Manage pipeline stages, tasks, notes, follow-ups, and reporting within the CRM.
Track performance against activity, discovery-call, qualified-opportunity, and revenue targets.
Collaborate with sales and marketing to improve targeting, messaging, campaigns, and conversion rates.
Provide feedback regarding lead quality, customer objections, competitive solutions, and market trends.
Represent QUASH.ai professionally in all customer and industry interactions.
Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate combines financial-services sales experience, strong discovery skills, commercial judgment, and the ability to use technology to generate pipeline efficiently.

The candidate should:

Have experience selling technology, software, data, or analytical solutions to financial institutions.
Understand the structure and decision-making process of banks, credit unions, fintechs, or lenders.
Be comfortable speaking with executives and senior professionals in credit, risk, lending, underwriting, fraud, innovation, technology, and data.
Be capable of independently leading an effective discovery call.
Know how to identify business problems, ask relevant questions, and qualify opportunities.
Have strong written and verbal communication skills.
Be persistent, organized, accountable, and highly focused on measurable results.
Be comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Be able to manage a high volume of prospecting and follow-up activities.
Understand that success is measured by qualified pipeline creation, not only outreach activity or meetings scheduled.
Be comfortable using data and technology to continuously improve prospecting performance.
Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

Selling to banks, credit unions, fintechs, or consumer lenders.
Selling credit underwriting or lending technology.
Credit risk scores or scoring models.
Alternative data solutions.
Automated decision engines.
Loan origination or decisioning platforms.
Credit bureau, identity, fraud, or data-enrichment products.
Predictive analytics or machine-learning solutions.
Financial inclusion or thin-file credit products.
SaaS or enterprise technology sales.
Business development within financial services.
Conducting discovery calls with senior financial-services professionals.
Building relationships with credit, risk, lending, fraud, or technology executives.

Experience in these areas is highly valuable but not required if the candidate can demonstrate a strong ability to learn the market and consistently generate qualified opportunities.

Technology and Automation Skills

The successful candidate should be comfortable using technology to create repeatable and scalable business-development workflows.

Relevant experience may include:

HubSpot CRM.
Sales engagement platforms.
Marketing automation tools.
Email sequencing tools.
Automated dialing or calling platforms.
SMS outreach tools.
LinkedIn prospecting tools.
Lead-enrichment and contact-data platforms.
Workflow automation tools.
Generative AI platforms such as Claude.
AI-assisted research, personalization, messaging, and follow-up.
CRM reporting, dashboards, and pipeline management.

The candidate should be able to use these tools to:

Research and prioritize accounts.
Identify the correct decision-makers.
Personalize messages at scale.
Automate multichannel outreach.
Create call, email, and SMS sequences.
Generate relevant follow-up content.
Maintain accurate CRM records.
Track performance and optimize conversion rates.

We are not looking only for someone who can manually call through a list. We are looking for someone capable of building a scalable, intelligent, and technology-enabled pipeline-generation system.

Qualifications
Demonstrated experience in business development, inside sales, enterprise sales, or sales development.
Experience conducting discovery calls and qualifying B2B opportunities.
Strong communication, active-listening, and presentation skills.
Ability to understand and explain technical or analytical products.
Experience using CRM and sales automation tools.
Strong organizational and pipeline-management skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate across sales, marketing, product, and leadership teams.
Goal-oriented mindset with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding performance targets.
Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, finance, communications, technology, or a related field is preferred but not required.
Compensation

This is a fully paid position that includes:

Competitive base salary.
Monthly or quarterly variable compensation tied to qualified-opportunity generation.
Performance compensation for achieving or exceeding the target of 15 qualified opportunities per month.
Additional commission for opportunities that convert into closed business.
Potential for increased responsibilities and compensation based on performance.

The final compensation package will depend on the candidate’s experience, network, financial-services knowledge, and demonstrated ability to generate qualified pipeline.

Why Join QUASH.ai

This role offers the opportunity to join a growing AI and fintech company developing a new generation of credit intelligence products.

The successful candidate will work directly with senior leadership and have the opportunity to:

Sell innovative AI-powered solutions to financial institutions.
Help define and improve QUASH.ai’s U.S. go-to-market strategy.
Build scalable outbound and marketing-automation workflows.
Develop relationships with leaders across credit, risk, fraud, lending, and financial technology.
Earn meaningful performance-based compensation.
Grow into a senior business-development, account executive, or commercial leadership position.

About the job

About PayJoy

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.

This role

As the Credit Line Growth Analyst, you will drive sales performance by bridging training, content creation, and data analytics. In this role, you will own the end-to-end enablement process—designing and delivering impactful training programs, collaborating across PayJoy departments, and analyzing sales performance data to turn complex insights into actionable growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities


Sales Enablement & Content Design: Design and deliver training, onboarding, tools, and collateral for internal teams, partners, and store advisors. 
Commercial Productivity: Collaborate with sales teams to identify knowledge gaps among clients and staff. 
Commercial Support & Issue Resolution: Channel commercial needs to the corresponding areas (operations, product, support, training) and follow up on incidents.

Data Analytics & Reporting: Analyze sales data at scale (KPIs, KBIs, KKIs, KSIs), measure the ROI of initiatives and promotions, and present clear, actionable reports for decision-makers.

1-2 years in Sales or Marketing areas. Finance and Startup experience is a plus. 
High capacity for organization, communication, and relationships

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by proposing enhancements to test frameworks test data management and automation desk processes that strengthen overall verification and validation capabilities.

Align daily testing activities with company objectives of delivering safe reliable and efficient automotive solutions demonstrating how thorough verification and validation supports customer trust and positive societal impact.


Qualifications

Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Python Bash and CAPL scripting through practical experience building data driven test scripts custom utilities and interface modules that support complex automotive testing.
Hold proven experience in designing and implementing test framework architectures that emphasize reusability modularity and scalability ideally within automotive or embedded systems environments.
Show solid understanding of automotive verification and validation methodologies including requirement based testing system integration testing and regression strategies focusing on safety and reliability.

About the job

Representante de Desarrollo de Negocios — Programa de Evaluación de 60 Días

Modalidad: Remota

Oportunidad de contratación: Al generar al menos 10 reuniones calificadas en un mes, la persona pasará automáticamente a una posición de tiempo completo con salario base.

Acerca de QUASH.ai

QUASH.ai es una empresa de tecnología financiera e inteligencia artificial que ayuda a instituciones financieras a tomar decisiones de crédito más rápidas, inclusivas y precisas.

Nuestra tecnología combina datos alternativos, analítica predictiva y automatización con inteligencia artificial para ayudar a los prestamistas a identificar oportunidades que los modelos tradicionales de crédito pueden dejar fuera.

Buscamos a una persona recursiva, con madera comercial y mentalidad orientada a resultados, que sepa encontrar prospectos, iniciar conversaciones y generar oportunidades comerciales calificadas.

Esta no es una posición tradicional con salario fijo desde el primer día. Es una oportunidad basada en desempeño, diseñada para alguien que quiera demostrar sus capacidades y obtener una posición de tiempo completo a través de resultados medibles.

Programa de Evaluación de 60 Días

El período inicial estará dividido en dos etapas:

Primer mes — Aprendizaje y construcción

Las soluciones y productos de QUASH.ai.

Nuestros mensajes comerciales y procesos de ventas.

Segundo mes — Ejecución y generación de reuniones

Identificación de cuentas objetivo.

Coordinación de reuniones calificadas para el equipo de ventas.

description:
About the job

1.) Introduction

Job Title: Social Media Content Manager (Video Editing & Short-Form Content)
Work Hours/Schedule: Part-Time (20 hours/week), flexible time slots, Central Time (CST) alignment
Location: Remote, Latin America preferred




2.) Overview

Sitting on a camera roll full of raw footage and know exactly how to turn it into content people actually stop and watch? This role hands you the keys to a brand's entire social presence right as it starts to scale.

This is a distilled spirits import and distribution company based in Texas, founded in 2025, that brings artisanal, handcrafted agave spirits to the U.S. market. The brand identity is rooted in something real: rural, cultural, handcrafted, and authentic, not luxury gloss. It's a lean, founder-led operation currently distributing one brand, with three more landing over the coming months and expansion into New York and California already underway.

This is the ground floor. You would be the person shaping how the brand shows up online, taking raw video and photos from events and tastings and turning them into scroll-stopping posts across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. The founder is hands-on and wants a real creative partner, someone scrappy who brings ideas to the table, not someone waiting to be told what to do. If you live on social media, know what makes content work, and want real ownership over a brand's growth from the start, this is your seat.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Edit raw video and photo content from events and tastings into polished, publish-ready posts using professional tools like Adobe Premiere or Final Cut Pro
Produce around 3 posts per week, primarily short-form video, across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok (with YouTube Shorts as a secondary channel)
Generate original content ideas, scripts, and creative angles to help the brand stand out
Direct the founder on the specific shots, footage, and content needed to bring ideas to life
Research competitor and influencer accounts to spot what's working and adapt winning strategies
Own content planning and stick to a consistent posting timeline
Join regular morning check-ins with the founder to align on daily tasks and priorities




4.) Must-Have Requirements

Proven experience managing social media content, ideally for a growing or small brand
Video editing proficiency with professional tools (Adobe Premiere, Final Cut Pro, or similar) beyond basic in-app editors
Strong working knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
Excellent written English for captions and content
A creative, self-directed thinker who can independently generate content ideas and ways to stand out
Portfolio of previous social media or video editing work




5.) Nice-to-Have Requirements

Familiarity with agave spirits or the broader beverage/spirits industry
Comfort researching and learning niche or specialty products independently
Experience working with small or founder-led brands




6.) Why Join Us

This is a chance to own a brand's entire social presence from the very beginning, not to be one voice among many, but the person who builds it. You would work directly with a founder who values initiative, creativity, and people who take real pride in their work over polished corporate types who just follow orders. The brand is growing fast, with new product launches and expansion into new states already in motion, so there's genuine room for this role to grow in scope as the business scales. If you want the freedom to experiment, throw out bold ideas, and actually see your work move the needle on a brand's growth, this is the kind of seat that lets you do it.

About the job

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Are you looking for a Digital Specialist role that allows you to enhance marketing strategy and shape creative solutions? If so, this Digital Marketing Manager role could be an excellent opportunity to consider.

As a Digital Marketing Manager, you will lead an integrated set of digital, multi-channel marketing functions to rapidly and efficiently respond to business needs.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


Monitor the external digital landscape in the pharmaceutical industry evaluating new trends and crafting a long-term vision for the company
Provide inputs to stakeholders on Multi-Channel (MC) initiatives including comparing/contrasting company MC vision with competitors and mobilizing stakeholders to take necessary actions, trainings and plans
Identify MC opportunities for each brand giving inputs to MC Area Management and generating best practices for Local Operating Company (LOC).

Coach brand managers and generate best practice MC programs focusing on the global MC priorities
Develop ways of working, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and capability trainings for Multi-Channel Marketing (MCM)
Leverage MC analytics and performance measurement by monitoring monthly MC performance figures
Define lead and lag Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and set MC targets for tracking performance vs target
Routinely communicate MC performance outcomes with marketers and support them based on outcomes 
Align with the global team members on performance KPIs and analyze Return on Investment (ROI) calculation



Why you?

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


Bachelor’s degree
3 years of experience in business intelligence or insights
3 years of experience in digital marketing
Project management experience in a commercial setting



Preferred Qualifications:

MBA
Deep understanding of multi-channel marketing strategies
Ability to influence without authority
Strong verbal and written communication skills



Why Haleon?

Our Win as One Framework is a simple, stretching definition of our future direction. It includes our purpose, ambitions, strategic drivers, and behaviours that will enable us to Win as One. This framework guides our decision-making, strategy, and culture. The successful candidate will demonstrate the following capabilities:


Consumer first, always: Engage key business counterparts and operational stakeholders to deliver operational execution of Haleon strategies related to eCommerce activities, always putting the consumer first.
Collaborate for impact: Establish and maintain relationships with critical groups to ensure customer knowledge is utilized to inform and deliver on the eCommerce roadmap, collaborating for impact.

2026-08-24

description:
About the job

SOBRE EFEX




EFEX es una institución financiera regulada que opera el corredor de pagos entre México, Estados Unidos y el resto del mundo. Nuestros clientes son empresas que le pagan a proveedores en el extranjero, cobran a clientes fuera de México, administran tesorería en varias divisas o recibieron inversión extranjera.




Operamos cuatro líneas de negocio: transferencias internacionales, transferencias masivas, cobranza internacional en moneda local y cuentas empresariales multi-divisa. Enviamos pagos a más de 140 países, cobramos localmente en más de 24 y operamos en once divisas.




Estamos autorizados por la CNBV como transmisor de dinero y cumplimos con la regulación de FinCEN en Estados Unidos. Nos respaldan PayPal Ventures, Franklin Templeton, Floodgate, 500 Startups y Nido Ventures. Tenemos oficinas en Ciudad de México, Monterrey, Guadalajara, Querétaro, Tijuana y Palo Alto.




Lo que vendemos es simple de explicar: el nivel de sofisticación financiera de un corporativo grande, sin la complejidad de operar con varios bancos.




SOBRE EL PUESTO




Vas a ser el primer contacto de EFEX con empresas mexicanas de comercio exterior. Tu trabajo es encontrar a las que están perdiendo dinero en cada pago al extranjero, entender cómo operan hoy y llevarlas a una conversación con un especialista.




No cierras contratos en este puesto. Abres conversaciones con áreas de finanzas (que es la parte más difícil del ciclo comercial) y trabajas junto a un especialista que se encarga del cierre.




RESPONSABILIDADES




Contactar por teléfono a alrededor de 50 empresas al día. Los leads los provee el equipo de Growth: no inviertes tu tiempo construyendo listas.
Conversar con dueños de negocio, direcciones de finanzas, contraloría y tesorería para entender cómo pagan y cobran al extranjero hoy, y qué les cuesta.
Calificar la cuenta: identificar volumen real de pagos internacionales, divisas involucradas y fricción con su banco actual.
Usar herramientas de IA para investigar la cuenta antes de llamar, preparar el abordaje y dar seguimiento. Es parte del método de trabajo del equipo.
Agendar la junta y hacer el traspaso al especialista con el contexto completo.
Mantener el registro en el CRM al día.




PUEDE QUE ENCAJES SI




Tienes licenciatura, titulada o pasante, en finanzas, contaduría, derecho, relaciones internacionales, comercio internacional, economía, administración o carrera afín.
Has trabajado antes en empresas formales.
Tienes experiencia en ventas, o un gusto genuino por vender. Cualquiera de las dos funciona.
Te interesan los temas bancarios y de divisas. No necesitas dominarlos, pero sí tener curiosidad real por cómo una empresa mueve su dinero: tipo de cambio, tesorería, banca empresarial, comercio exterior.
Te sientes a gusto trabajando con IA. Si ya usas Claude, ChatGPT o Gemini, mejor. Si no, con disposición a aprenderlas es suficiente: aquí se usan a diario.
Estás cómodo con el teléfono y con el volumen. Este puesto es de llamadas todos los días.
Lees inglés a nivel intermedio o avanzado.
Trabajas con orden: registras, das seguimiento y no dejas cabos sueltos.
El "no" no te desarma. Vas a escuchar varios antes de cada "sí".




No pedimos experiencia previa en fintech ni en banca. Eso se aprende aquí.




SUMAN PUNTOS




Experiencia previa como SDR, en telemarketing, call center o cobranza.

Conocimiento de comercio exterior, aduanas, logística o banca empresarial.

Haber trabajado con HubSpot o cualquier otro CRM.




COMPENSACIÓN




Sueldo base de USD competitivo, según experiencia. El pago es en dólares.
Adicionalmente, comisión por cada cliente que llega a realizar su primera transferencia fondeada. La comisión escala con el tamaño de la cuenta y no tiene tope superior. No existe cuota mínima que alcanzar antes de cobrarla: se paga desde el primer cliente.




LOGÍSTICA




Ubicación: Ciudad de México, esquema híbrido.

Pago en dólares.

Jornada completa.




CÓMO APLICAR




Envía tu CV por mensaje directo en LinkedIn o aplica en la vacante. Las dos rutas llegan al mismo lugar.




Si quieres agregar contexto a tu postulación, cuéntanos en un párrafo cuál es la conversación más difícil que has tenido que iniciar con un desconocido y cómo la abriste. Es opcional, y lo leemos.




Te recomendamos aplicar aunque sientas que no cumples con todos los puntos de la lista. Preferimos conocerte y evaluarlo juntos.

description:
About the job

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! 

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader that helps businesses accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable Unified Communications, Contact Center Applications, and Communications APIs.

Why this role matters:

Are you ready to be a pivotal force in scaling Vonage's ambitious growth across the dynamic markets of Mexico and the broader Americas region?

We are on the lookout for a highly accomplished and dynamic Talent Acquisition Partner, based in Mexico, to champion our hiring across a broad range of technical and nontechnical functions. This is more than a recruitment role; it’s a strategic partnership where you will directly shape the future of our API/CPaaS business by attracting and securing top-tier talent.

If you are passionate about building high-performing, high-impact teams and want to be part of a global brand making significant waves in the communications space, we invite you to join our journey.

Your responsibilities;

Strategically partner with hiring managers to translate team goals into high-impact, data-driven hiring strategies.
Design and execute innovative sourcing campaigns to attract and secure the industry's most sought-after talent.
Proactively build a robust pipeline of exceptional candidates, driving engagement through direct sourcing, strategic referrals, and long-term talent relationship building.
Elevate the candidate experience to world-class standards, acting as a supportive guide and brand ambassador to secure top-tier hires.
Serve as a trusted advisor to HR and business leaders, leveraging market expertise to influence and inform critical talent decisions.
Drive the full offer negotiation and closing process, ensuring a seamless transition from candidate to high-performing team member.
Champion data-led recruitment, providing key stakeholders with actionable insights to continuously optimize talent acquisition performance and impact.

What you will bring:

Required:

Proven experience in hiring top-tier talent across a broad range of technical and nontechnical functions.
Proven experience in a global setting, partnering with international Hiring Managers to secure top talent in Mexico
Strong stakeholder management skills – you know how to build trust, communicate clearly, and influence with impact
Natural curiosity around all things AI and automation and the impact it can have on Talent Acquisition.
Solid track record of managing the full recruitment lifecycle – from crafting smart sourcing strategies and engaging passive talent, to driving seamless offer processes.
Confident in handling pipeline management and maintaining high standards of data integrity, while regularly providing stakeholders with meaningful, data-driven updates.
Strong experience in using LinkedIn Recruiter to identify and engage top candidates
Since we are an international company, we need someone who is fluent in English

Experience we consider a plus:

Experience hiring within a SaaS or cloud communications company.
Experience across the broader Americas region, especially for technical and nontechnical roles would be a massive advantage.
A genuine passion for writing clear, compelling, and inclusive job descriptions that attract the right people.
Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar applicant tracking systems.
 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

title: Business Development Sales Lead For Entrepreneur Community
skills: “Give More, Get More:” We believe in abundance, where collective growth and success are not just dreams but realities.
The Group Comes First: Our strength lies in unity, celebrating our achievements as a collective triumph.
What Would Mom Say: We operate with ethics, respect, and kindness—non-negotiable values.
Like-minded & Driven: Ambition, resilience, and the pursuit of excellence mark our shared journey.
Show Up: Every interaction is a chance to inspire, learn, and make a difference.

Actively source and identify qualified prospects through events, social outreach, referrals, and your existing network in the ecommerce space, Amazon sellers, DTC, Shopify operators, TikTok Shop brands, and adjacent founders who meet the MDS criteria.
Run outbound campaigns and personalized outreach to engage high-potential founders who haven’t yet heard of MDS or haven’t applied, moving them from awareness to conversation.
Work collaboratively with our Head of Membership Growth Manager on shared pipeline, prospect intel, and outreach strategy, coordinating so the team is covering the right people without overlap.
Bring new segments and opportunities to the team’s attention when you spot a pocket of high-quality founders worth pursuing. You contribute ideas, not just execution.

Own your discovery calls end to end from booking through close. You qualify, you present the value of MDS authentically, you handle objections, and you guide the right founders through the application.
Hold real conversations, not scripted pitches. MDS members are accomplished founders who will see through a canned approach immediately. You ask good questions, listen well, and assess fit honestly.
Maintain a consistent call volume that supports hitting your monthly targets. You manage your own time and pipeline to ensure you always have enough qualified conversations in motion.
Follow up persistently and personally with prospects who are interested but not yet ready. You don’t let warm leads go cold because of poor follow-through.
Represent MDS at industry events and tradeshows (Amazon Accelerate, Prosper Show, SellerCon, ShipBob Summit, and similar) as a relationship-builder and pipeline generator.
Convert in-person conversations to pipeline entries with same-day GHL logging and a follow-up action in place for every qualified contact before you leave the event floor.
Attend MDS events as a participant and connector building relationships with current members and identifying referral opportunities from within the community.
Flag events worth attending that aren’t yet on the team’s radar based on what you’re seeing in the market. You are a source of field intelligence, not just a field executor.

Maintain your own pipeline in Go High Level with clean data, accurate stages, and timely follow-ups. The team should be able to look at your pipeline at any moment and know exactly where things stand.
Execute multi-channel follow-up sequences (email, SMS, personal outreach) that keep qualified founders engaged without being pushy or generic.
Track your own conversion metrics at every stage, call-to-application rate, time to close, win/loss reasons, and use that data to sharpen your own approach over time.

Build a visible presence in the ecommerce founder ecosystem through social content, event attendance, and genuine relationship-building so that qualified founders know who you are before you ever reach out.
Collaborate with marketing when relevant on content or campaigns that generate awareness among target founder segments. You contribute your perspective; they handle execution.

Bring founder insights back to the team from your calls and events, what objections are coming up, what founders care about, what’s changing in the market. You are a front-line source of intelligence.
3+ years in sales, business development, or a community-facing role with a demonstrable track record of hitting individual targets. Not a team average, your own number.

Direct ecommerce experience either running your own brand, working at an ecommerce company, or in an adjacent industry (agency, SaaS, 3PL, platform) with deep and genuine exposure to sellers. You know this world.
Working knowledge of Amazon, DTC, Shopify, and TikTok Shop at the level where you can hold a real strategic conversation with a seven-figure seller without needing anything explained.
Demonstrated track record of closing high-ticket memberships, partnerships, or B2B deals. We want specifics: who you sold to, what the deal size was, and what your conversion rate looked like.
Hands-on CRM experience ideally in Go High Level or equivalent. You know how to run your own pipeline, not just work leads handed to you.
Charismatic and naturally relational, people enjoy talking to you and remember you after one meeting. You are genuinely curious about other people’s businesses and it shows.
Self-directed and accountable with the discipline to generate your own pipeline and hit targets without needing constant direction or oversight.
Comfortable traveling regularly to events and representing MDS on the ground.
Valid US Visa required. This role involves occasional travel to US-based MDS events and gatherings. Candidates must hold a valid US Visa at the time of offer.
An existing network within the Amazon, Shopify, or TikTok Shop seller community, people who know you and would take your call. This is a meaningful accelerator in this role.
Personal experience as an ecommerce seller or brand operator. Lived experience is the fastest shortcut to credibility with our ideal member.
A personal brand or growing presence in the ecommerce space through social content, podcast appearances, or community involvement.
Experience with membership communities, masterminds, or high-ticket group offers so you understand the value proposition intuitively and can articulate it without a script.
Experience with multi-channel outreach sequences including email, SMS, and social DMs in a coordinated, personalized way.

Annual bonus pool participation, contingent on year-over-year growth in Membership Income (MI) and maintaining a 75% average in defined KPIs. Bonus accrues yearly: 50% paid at year-end, remainder paid mid-year following.
Team member referral bonus: $750 to $2,500 for successful hires referred, contingent on both parties remaining employed at least six months.
Spot bonuses awarded at the executive team’s discretion for exceptional performance, a landmark close, or a high-impact event result.

Global Work Flexibility: Our ‘office’ is wherever you are, offering unparalleled flexibility to work from home, a café, or while traveling, as long as you’re aligned with Eastern Time for core hours (10:00–3:00 PM EST).
Outcome-Driven Work Culture: At MDS, we prioritize results over rigid schedules. Manage your day according to your own rhythm, focusing on outcomes, not hours.

Autonomous Time Management: We trust you to strike the perfect balance between work and personal life. We do not track time off; we take company-wide breaks at major holidays and have a monthly Friday off.

Elite Networking Opportunities: Engage with over 700 leading e-commerce entrepreneurs in our network. These interactions are more than networking—they are invaluable learning experiences and the chance to forge lasting industry connections.
Exclusive Event Access: Represent MDS at exclusive, high-profile events as the primary face of our community. These are gateways to new relationships, cultures, and a global professional network.
Dynamic Community of Innovators: Immerse yourself in an environment brimming with driven, like-minded professionals who push each other to grow.
Continuous Professional Development: Stay at the forefront of ecommerce trends and acquisition strategy within our ever-evolving community.
Impactful Work: Your role at MDS determines who gets to be part of this community. That’s a real responsibility—and a genuinely fulfilling one.

About the job

About The Role

We are hiring a Business Development Lead to join the MDS membership sales team as a dedicated new business hunter. You will work alongside our Head of Membership Growth Manager, focused on one thing: finding and closing the right founders into MDS.

This is an individual contributor role. Your job is to prospect, build relationships, host events, run discovery calls, and convert qualified ecommerce founders into MDS members. You will be out at events, active in the community online, and on the phone, generating your own pipeline and working leads from first contact to closed application.

This is a commission-driven role with a real earnings opportunity. A strong performer who hits their stride will earn $10,000–$15,000/month between base and commission, with no ceiling on the upside.

A representative scenario: you’re at Prosper Show, spend two days working the floor and attending the evening dinners, come back with 15 solid contacts logged in GHL, book 5 discovery calls in the following week, and convert 2 into active applications. Our commitment is unwavering: to keep MDS at the forefront of thought leadership and trailblazing innovation in the industry while helping support our members’ success in their respective businesses.

MDS stands as a beacon for over 700 e-commerce entrepreneurs, generating a staggering 12 billion dollars on Amazon. It’s a melting pot where innovation, networking, and collaboration are not just buzzwords, but a way of life. Our members, ranging from successful CEOs to visionary leaders, thrive in an ecosystem rich in knowledge, insights, and strategic partnerships.

Maintain your own pipeline in Go High Level with clean data, accurate stages, and timely follow-ups. The team should be able to look at your pipeline at any moment and know exactly where things stand.
Execute multi-channel follow-up sequences (email, SMS, personal outreach) that keep qualified founders engaged without being pushy or generic.
Track your own conversion metrics at every stage, call-to-application rate, time to close, win/loss reasons, and use that data to sharpen your own approach over time.


Community Presence & Personal Brand


Build a visible presence in the ecommerce founder ecosystem through social content, event attendance, and genuine relationship-building so that qualified founders know who you are before you ever reach out.
Collaborate with marketing when relevant on content or campaigns that generate awareness among target founder segments. You contribute your perspective; they handle execution.
Bring founder insights back to the team from your calls and events, what objections are coming up, what founders care about, what’s changing in the market. You are a front-line source of intelligence.


Qualifications

Required


3+ years in sales, business development, or a community-facing role with a demonstrable track record of hitting individual targets. Not a team average, your own number.
Direct ecommerce experience either running your own brand, working at an ecommerce company, or in an adjacent industry (agency, SaaS, 3PL, platform) with deep and genuine exposure to sellers. You know this world.
Working knowledge of Amazon, DTC, Shopify, and TikTok Shop at the level where you can hold a real strategic conversation with a seven-figure seller without needing anything explained.
Demonstrated track record of closing high-ticket memberships, partnerships, or B2B deals. We want specifics: who you sold to, what the deal size was, and what your conversion rate looked like.
Hands-on CRM experience ideally in Go High Level or equivalent. You know how to run your own pipeline, not just work leads handed to you.
Charismatic and naturally relational, people enjoy talking to you and remember you after one meeting. You are genuinely curious about other people’s businesses and it shows.
Self-directed and accountable with the discipline to generate your own pipeline and hit targets without needing constant direction or oversight.
Comfortable traveling regularly to events and representing MDS on the ground.
Valid US Visa required. This role involves occasional travel to US-based MDS events and gatherings. Candidates must hold a valid US Visa at the time of offer.


Preferred


An existing network within the Amazon, Shopify, or TikTok Shop seller community, people who know you and would take your call. This is a meaningful accelerator in this role.
Personal experience as an ecommerce seller or brand operator. Lived experience is the fastest shortcut to credibility with our ideal member.
A personal brand or growing presence in the ecommerce space through social content, podcast appearances, or community involvement.
Experience with membership communities, masterminds, or high-ticket group offers so you understand the value proposition intuitively and can articulate it without a script.
Experience with multi-channel outreach sequences including email, SMS, and social DMs in a coordinated, personalized way.


Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: base + commission, uncapped. Strong performers can expect to earn $10,000-$15,000/month when exceeding targets.

Bonus Opportunities


Annual bonus pool participation, contingent on year-over-year growth in Membership Income (MI) and maintaining a 75% average in defined KPIs. Bonus accrues yearly: 50% paid at year-end, remainder paid mid-year following.
Team member referral bonus: $750 to $2,500 for successful hires referred, contingent on both parties remaining employed at least six months.
Spot bonuses awarded at the executive team’s discretion for exceptional performance, a landmark close, or a high-impact event result.


Benefits


Global Work Flexibility: Our ‘office’ is wherever you are, offering unparalleled flexibility to work from home, a café, or while traveling, as long as you’re aligned with Eastern Time for core hours (10:00–3:00 PM EST).
Outcome-Driven Work Culture: At MDS, we prioritize results over rigid schedules. Manage your day according to your own rhythm, focusing on outcomes, not hours.
Autonomous Time Management: We trust you to strike the perfect balance between work and personal life. We do not track time off; we take company-wide breaks at major holidays and have a monthly Friday off.
Elite Networking Opportunities: Engage with over 700 leading e-commerce entrepreneurs in our network. These interactions are more than networking—they are invaluable learning experiences and the chance to forge lasting industry connections.
Exclusive Event Access: Represent MDS at exclusive, high-profile events as the primary face of our community. These are gateways to new relationships, cultures, and a global professional network.
Dynamic Community of Innovators: Immerse yourself in an environment brimming with driven, like-minded professionals who push each other to grow.
Continuous Professional Development: Stay at the forefront of ecommerce trends and acquisition strategy within our ever-evolving community.
Impactful Work: Your role at MDS determines who gets to be part of this community. That’s a real responsibility—and a genuinely fulfilling one.

About the job

Descripción del puesto

El Project Manager es el líder del proyecto y el principal responsable de la implementación exitosa de la solución de imágenes satelitales en las operaciones del cliente. Su rol es garantizar que la tecnología aportada por NAX se adapte a los procesos internos del cliente, demostrando su valor y maximizando su utilidad a lo largo del tiempo.




Descripción general del puesto


El Project Manager coordina todas las fases del proyecto, trabajando estrechamente con el cliente para asegurarse de que la tecnología se adapte a sus necesidades y que se utilice de manera eficiente para obtener el máximo valor. About the job

About Manifest

Manifest is a tech-enabled immigration law firm reshaping how legal services are delivered. Our mission is to make the immigration process faster, smarter, and more accessible for millions of people navigating one of life's most complex systems. Traditional immigration law is built on opacity, billable hours, and outdated communication. Manifest is different. We combine top-tier legal talent with modern technology to create a transparent, efficient, human-centered experience—and a trusted platform that enterprises rely on for critical, global workforce decisions. We're not building a better firm. We're redefining what a modern legal services platform can be.

About The Team

You'll join a tight-knit revenue team that treats sales like product development — constantly iterating on our advisory methodology to better serve clients navigating complex immigration decisions. We act as trusted advisors, not closers, helping clients understand their options with genuine expertise. We work closely with Legal, Marketing, and Product, and we care deeply about transforming how people experience immigration services.

What You'll Do

This role owns net-new revenue for Manifest's talent immigration clients. Day to day, you will:


Engage founders, engineers, and individuals navigating the immigration system to diagnose needs, map requirements, and architect solutions
Build trust-based relationships with prospective clients alongside Marketing, Product, and Operations — the decision to hire an immigration attorney is a serious one
Plan and manage accounts with structured discipline across complex customer groups


What We're Looking For


1+ years of SDR, sales, or client-facing experience
Background engaging individuals around complex, high-consideration decisions — legal, financial, healthcare, or similar
Confident leading high-stakes, high-trust conversations
Strong EQ and a natural ability to build relationships across a range of people
Organized and methodical, with the ability to run cross-functional programs end-to-end


This is for you if...

You're energized by relationships over pipelines, equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing tactically, and motivated by building something new rather than selling something established.

This is not for you if...

You're uncomfortable with accountability, high-stakes conversations, or the emotional weight of guiding people through life-changing decisions — and you're not driven to hit aggressive revenue targets while doing it.
