Recibir feedback, aplicar aprendizajes y mejorar continuamente la calidad, criterio y velocidad de edición.







✅ Lo que buscamos:

Experiencia práctica editando videos con herramientas como Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut o equivalentes.
Buen criterio para seleccionar clips, música, efectos, transiciones, textos y recursos visuales.
Capacidad para mantener la atención mediante ritmo, estructura, hooks, open loops, storytelling y edición enfocada en retención.
Comprensión básica de cómo se estructura un video publicitario o de venta.
Creatividad, adaptabilidad y atención al detalle.
Capacidad de investigación y benchmarking.
Organización y disciplina para manejar archivos, versiones y entregables.
Buena comunicación y disposición para colaborar con diferentes equipos.
Apertura para recibir feedback y hacer iteraciones sin tomarlo de forma personal.
Mentalidad de crecimiento, curiosidad y compromiso con mejorar constantemente.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma, cumplir fechas y comunicar bloqueos a tiempo.







⭐ Será un plus 

Experiencia editando anuncios para ecommerce o marcas de belleza, skincare, bienestar o consumo.
Conocimientos de performance marketing y métricas creativas.
Experiencia trabajando con contenido UGC, testimoniales, demostraciones de producto y videos verticales.
Interés por el storytelling, la psicología de ventas y la estrategia creativa.




📍 Modalidad: Remota (Latinoamérica)

⏰ Jornada: Tiempo completo

💰 Compensación: $180 USD por semana + bonos por desempeño

https://fm.skindion.mx/talento?source=LinkedIn&vacante=Editor%20de%20Video%20y%20Contenido%20Creativo%20-%20LATAM&id=109

About the job

Job Title: Business Development Manager

Department: Sales

By fusing Artificial Intelligence with Extended Reality (XR), we turn expert know-how into simulations, AR field guidance, and real competency data for enterprises worldwide. Backed by a 25-year heritage serving 4,400+ organizations across 80+ countries, our mission is to democratize expertise and make it available to everyone, everywhere.

Summary

EON AI Ventures is seeking experienced professionals to drive the global expansion of its AI-powered Work Intelligence platform. This role focuses on identifying, developing, and closing enterprise and government opportunities. We welcome business development professionals with a proven track record selling technology solutions into large organizations, who are eager to grow their portfolio by representing a global AI leader.

Develop and execute strategies to expand EON AI Ventures' enterprise customer base across industrial and government markets worldwide.

Documented success selling to large organizations and consistently achieving sales of over USD 300,000 annually.
Strong command of consultative and solution-selling approaches within complex, multi-stakeholder accounts.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to build and maintain high-value client relationships at the executive level.
Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently.

A bachelor's degree or higher required.

Preferred Attributes

Passion for emerging AI and XR technologies, workforce transformation, and digital innovation.
Experience building or managing reseller and channel partnerships.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter, along with any additional relevant materials.




EON AI Ventures is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

description:
About the job

Remote | Full-Time Contract | United States or Latin America




$2,500–$4,000 USD/month | 40 hours/week




Are you the person who notices the typo everyone else missed? Do broken links, inconsistent branding, awkward copy, or a button that doesn’t work immediately catch your attention?

We’re looking for a Marketing QA Specialist to be the final set of eyes on client-facing marketing work before it goes live.




You’ll review everything from landing pages and paid ads to SEO content and videos, making sure the finished product is accurate, polished, functional, and ready for the client.

This isn’t primarily a design or copywriting position. You won’t be expected to create everything yourself. Instead, you’ll help make sure the work our teams create meets the standard our clients expect.




What You’ll Do

You’ll work across several areas of digital marketing and collaborate with SEO, paid media, creative, web, and video teams. Your responsibilities will include:

Reviewing landing pages for spelling, grammar, layout, functionality, branding, and overall quality
Testing links, buttons, forms, phone numbers, calls to action, and mobile responsiveness
Reviewing paid advertising copy for accuracy, clarity, formatting, messaging, and alignment with client offers
Checking SEO content and on-page assets for readability, professionalism, and client requirements
Reviewing client videos for visual and audio quality, captions, branding, messaging, transitions, and calls to action
Comparing completed work against briefs, brand guidelines, approved messaging, and client feedback
Catching inconsistencies, missing information, unsupported claims, and other issues before they reach the client
Giving clear, actionable feedback so teams know exactly what needs to be corrected
Tracking revisions and confirming corrections have been completed before final approval
Maintaining QA checklists and helping identify recurring quality issues




You’ll Be a Great Fit If...

You have an eye for details that other people tend to miss, but you can also explain why something needs to be fixed.

We’re looking for someone with excellent written and spoken English, strong grammar and communication skills, and experience reviewing digital marketing assets, websites, content, creative work, or other client-facing deliverables.

You should be comfortable working with several projects and deadlines at once, giving constructive feedback, and working independently in a remote environment.

Familiarity with SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, landing pages, websites, and marketing videos is especially valuable.




Experience with tools such as ClickUp, Slack, and Google Workspace, structured QA processes, or conversion-focused landing pages is a plus.




What Success Looks Like

You’re catching mistakes before the client does.

Client-facing work consistently looks polished and professional, teams receive feedback they can act on quickly, and reviews are completed on time without slowing down production.

Over time, you’ll also help identify patterns and recurring issues so we can improve the process—not just fix the same mistakes again and again.

Schedule & Compensation




This is a full-time contract position working 40 hours per week. Your eight-hour daily schedule will fall within the 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Central Time business window.




The position is fully remote and open to qualified candidates located in the United States or Latin America.




Compensation: $2,500–$4,000 USD per month, based on experience and qualifications.




Ready to Apply?

We’d love to hear from people who genuinely enjoy finding the little things that make a big difference.




When applying, tell us a little about your experience reviewing marketing, creative, web, or client-facing work—and what makes you great at catching issues before they become problems.

description:
About the job

Description

Everyone on our team has a meaningful impact on product features, new directions in music streaming, and customer engagement. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a talented and passionate UX Designer to play a vital role in shaping the products and services for Amazon Music. Our ideal candidate has the ability to delight customers with their user-centered product design work, by solving customers’ problems and tapping into customers’ love and passion for music.

Key job responsibilities


 Lead UX design for projects across platforms that touch numerous aspects of the Amazon Music experience.
 Run the full experience design process (i.e., discovery, research, concept development, wireframes, high-fidelity mocks) with a particular focus on customer mindsets, complex interaction solutions, user flows, and end-to-end customer journeys.
 Work from high-level requirements, ask the right questions, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to gather all relevant information to guide design direction.
 Quickly iterate on multiple design explorations to arrive at simple, but robust solutions, accounting for complex requirements.
 Validate designs through research and testing.
 Design for current experiences while also envisioning and creating new experiences for future features.
 Stay current on emerging UX and digital behavior trends, music and design innovations, and broader technological shifts, as well as identify opportunities to incorporate best current thinking into product designs.
 Collaborate on and present work to a range of stakeholders – executives, engineers, product managers, business leaders, researchers, other UX and visual designers.


A day in the life

As UX Designer on this team, you will help define, build, and deliver customer-facing experiences and tools, as well as delightful fan experiences from discovery and research to concept development, wireframes, and high-fidelity cross-platform mocks. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization, working from high-level requirements to define product design flows, interactions, and content strategies. You will incorporate best current thinking into product designs, while also envisioning and creating new experiences for future features. To be successful you must be collaborative, customer-focused problem solver with clear design chops, an excitement for applying data, and an ability to communicate your ideas effectively. Being a big music fan is a plus.

About The Team

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners across different tiers of service. Join us for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale.

Basic Qualifications


 2+ years of design experience
 Have an available online portfolio
 Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar
 Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in a highly agile environment
 Experience working in a collaborative multi-disciplinary team and working directly with developers for implementation of designs
 Experience in usability testing

description:
About the job

Job Purpose

A personality that shines, the ability to adapt to any situation and make people feel at ease. These are a few of the qualities we’re looking for in our cabin crew.

As the face of Emirates, you’ll be the person customers turn to for help and direction when they fly with us, so you need to be friendly, observant and able to provide the right support.

Being a member of the cabin crew is so much more than a service role - safety is our highest priority. You’ll need to lead confidently and take control when it comes to managing aircraft services, security, and safety procedures. This comes from the world-class learning experience our crew receive at our state-of-the-art facility in Dubai.




Qualifications & Experience




Here are some other things we look for in our cabin crew:

You’ve had more than a year’s experience in hospitality/customer service
You have a positive attitude and the natural ability to provide excellent service in a team environment, dealing with people from many cultures
Your minimum qualification is high school graduate (Grade 12)
You need to be fluent in written and spoken English
You’re at least 160cm tall and can reach 212 cm while standing on tiptoes, to enable you to reach emergency equipment on all aircraft types
No visible tattoos while you’re in Emirates cabin crew uniform (without covering them with bandages or cosmetics)
As Emirates cabin crew, you’ll be based in Dubai and will need to meet the UAE's employment visa requirements




Aside from the requirements of the role, you should be determined to always perform to the highest standards, focus on being solution oriented, and be able to manage a demanding work schedule. You should have the ability to deliver an authentic experience to our customers. You’ll be culturally aware and reflect the Emirates personality - professional, empathetic, progressive, visionary and cosmopolitan.




Salary & Benefits




Your pay is made up of three components:

a fixed basic salary,
an hourly pay for operated flights and
an overseas meal allowance.




Basic salary = AED 4,980 / month,

Flying Pay = AED 69.60 / hour based on avg. 80-100 hours / month,

Average Total Pay = AED 11,244 / month (~USD 3,100, EUR 2,600 or GBP 2,280)

* These are approximate numbers for Grade II (Economy Class).




Meal allowances for night stops are credited to the salary in arrears the following month.

Hotel accommodation as well as transport to and from the airport is provided by the company.




Join Emirates as cabin crew and enjoy a competitive, tax-free salary, flying pay, profit share, and concessional travel. Benefit from comprehensive relocation support to help you settle in Dubai, along with free accommodation and transportation. You will also receive excellent medical, life, and dental insurance, and more. Additionally, your friends and family can enjoy discounted flights, creating lasting memories together.

As a Visual QA, you’ll be responsible for defining and executing testing strategies to ensure the highest level of quality across digital assets — including banners, images, and video content. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and engineering teams to identify visual inconsistencies, usability issues, and brand deviations before final delivery.

Review and test a wide range of digital assets (banners, images, videos, and more) with exceptional precision and attention to detail.

Collaborate with designers, producers, and developers to resolve visual and technical issues efficiently.
Review specifications, brand guidelines, and design documents to anticipate potential quality risks.
Maintain fluent use of content Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems for organizing, retrieving, and tracking digital content.
Troubleshoot issues within the DAM system and suggest process improvements.
Create and maintain comprehensive QA documentation, test plans, and visual validation checklists.
Support overall operational efficiency by suggesting process improvements in testing and bug management workflows.
Work hands-on with Photoshop, Adobe Premiere, Sketch, and other creative tools to validate and analyze visual deliverables accurately.



Requirements



3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Testing, preferably within creative production, digital advertising, or post-production environments.
Strong understanding of graphic design principles and familiarity with tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Media Info, Frame.io, Photoshop, Adobe Premiere, and Sketch.
Hands-on experience with QA methodologies, testing processes, and bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Trello, or similar).Advanced attention to visual detail, with the ability to identify subtle inconsistencies across formats and platforms.
Proven ability to create, execute, and manage QA test plans for large-scale or complex campaigns.
Strong collaboration skills; able to work cross-functionally with design, production, and technology teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish fluency is a plus.
Proficiency in documentation creation, workflow mapping, and delivering training to larger groups.Highly organized, proactive, and self-sufficient — capable of owning multiple QA tracks simultaneously.
Based in Mexico City, with availability to work from the office three days per week.Proficient in English communication.

Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. title: TikTok Shop Creator & Affiliate Manager
skills: Run each brand's Discord as its named voice — minimum 3 posts a week (at least one you write yourself), plus a weekly creator call breaking down the top videos and why they worked.

Send at least one personal 1:1 message per brand per day — creators who just posted, creators close to a bonus tier, creators who've gone quiet — and give every creator who makes a good video or sale a real relationship and a Discord invite within 48 hours.

Deliver two "inspo drops" a week per brand: find the converting format (on TikTok, the brand's Meta ads, Instagram, or adjacent brands) and hand creators the hooks, scripts, and do's/don'ts — designed and digestible in Reacher or Canva, not a wall of text.
Drive creator activation: run bounties tied to specific formats, re-engage quiet creators, and work the "sampled but never posted" list every week until it shrinks.
Onboard paid and retainer creators with real energy so they understand what they signed up for and don't quietly hit the minimum — with retainer creators posting within 7 days of sample arrival.
Set brand voice and sampling direction for the approvals team, recommend where the GMV floor should sit based on real post rates, and flag broken inputs loudly and early.
File one report per brand every Sunday: what's live, what's blocked, the numbers, and what you're changing.
Real TikTok Shop operating experience — affiliate programs, creator sampling, commission structures, and campaigns. You should be teaching us the platform, not learning it on our time.
Proven experience managing a creator community at scale (Discord or similar) as a named human, not an announcement bot — with a specific story about how you got creators to actually post.
Genuine creative instinct for short-form: you can look at a video and say why it converted.
Strong written English and the judgment to write in a brand's voice.
Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini to move faster on lists, briefs, and research.
Clear, consistent communication and reliable weekly reporting.
Must be located in an EST timezone country (e.g., Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Ecuador, Panama) and able to overlap U.S. business hours.
Not a coordination or mass-announcement job — if your instinct on a slow week is another blast to the whole channel instead of opening DMs one at a time, this isn't the fit.
Not a role where you wait for a task list every morning — you own your brands and drive the cadence yourself.

Not measured on activity for its own sake — hitting cadence while creator volume stays flat is not success. The cadence exists to move volume, and noticing when it isn't working and changing it is part of the job.

Your entire job comes down to one number: how many creators post a good video each week. You'll be the person creators know by name — telling them exactly what to make, noticing when someone goes quiet, and keeping the community energized. Someone else owns the backend, ad spend, and outreach automation; you own the relationships and the content direction. You'll work day-to-day in Reacher (or a close equivalent), TikTok Affiliate Center, Discord, Notion, and Canva.

Strong pluses: You've been a TikTok Shop creator yourself; existing relationships with affiliates or retainer-tier creators; experience in beauty, personal care, wellness, or supplements; on-camera comfort to make the hard video yourself when you need to prove a format works.

About the job

Overview

We're looking for a customer-centric Shopify Ecommerce Experience Coordinator to join our client's team. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies. We're in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.

Our client is a fast-growing, natural personal-care brand with a high-traffic Shopify storefront and a rapidly expanding retail presence. What’s in it for you?

Learn and evolve your skills using the latest and greatest technology tools in a rapidly growing company.
Learn from the best people around you. We constantly challenge the status quo and invent new ways of building a great product.
100% remote. Work anywhere, whether it is remotely in the comfort of your home, in a shared co-working space, in an RV on the beach, or while being a nomad in another country.
Work on challenging problems, innovate, and positively impact many people's lives while having fun doing it.

Experience with SEO best practices.

What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. That’s where we bring the best engineering practices, strong architecture, the latest technologies, and consistent processes to help companies scale.




What is the length of your engagements?

Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.




What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 55+ engineers going to 75+ by the end of the year. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.




What happens if the engagement is completed?

Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current engagement is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.

Client First: we only win when our clients win. We treat client challenges as our own.

Quality: we’re passionate about achieving quality outcomes by applying meticulous attention to detail.

About the job

About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)


So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About the Role: 

We’ve rebuilt core consumer finance products from scratch, loans, credit cards, and car finance, delivering money to customers in minutes instead of days. We are now launching our credit card product in Mexico and building our founding local team.

Customer support is critical to our success. Many of our customers are entering the formal financial system for the first time, and the way we support them matters deeply.

We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent to help deliver an excellent, friendly, and trustworthy experience to our credit card customers in Mexico.

This is a junior, hands-on role focused on answering customer questions, resolving issues, and guiding customers through our product and processes. You’ll be on the front lines of customer interaction, helping people understand their credit card, payments, balances, and next steps.

You don’t need to build tools or write code, but you do need to be empathetic, detail-oriented, reliable, and eager to learn. Many of the questions you handle will not yet be automated, and your work will directly help us improve our product and processes over time.

What You’ll Do

 Answer Customer Questions
Respond to customer inquiries via chat, email, and eventually phone.
Help customers understand their credit card, balances, due dates, payments, and app features.
Provide clear, friendly, and accurate answers using internal tools and knowledge bases.
Escalate complex or sensitive cases when needed.
 Resolve Issues with Care & Accuracy
Help customers troubleshoot common issues (payments, transactions, account access).
Follow defined processes to resolve issues correctly and safely.
Identify when something doesn’t look right and raise it to the appropriate team.
Always prioritise customer trust, clarity, and compliance.
 Learn the Product Deeply
Become an expert in our credit card product, app flows, and customer policies.
Stay up to date with changes to features, processes, and FAQs.
Use internal documentation and tools to provide consistent answers.
 Improve Support Quality Over Time
Flag recurring customer issues or unclear processes to your manager.
Suggest improvements to FAQs, help articles, or canned responses.
Help identify questions that could eventually be automated.
Contribute feedback from real customer conversations to Product and Operations.


Required
What We’re Looking For

Strong written communication skills in Spanish (English is a plus).
High empathy and a genuine desire to help people.
Attention to detail and ability to follow processes carefully.
Comfort using digital tools (support platforms, internal dashboards, messaging tools).
Reliability, ownership, and professionalism.
Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-moving environment.


Nice to Have

Previous experience in customer support, call centres, or service roles.
Experience supporting financial products (banking, credit cards, lending).
Comfort handling sensitive or emotional customer situations.
Basic familiarity with mobile apps or fintech products.


The Type of Work You’ll Be Doing

Handling customer questions that are not yet automated.
Providing clear explanations and guidance to customers.
Documenting interactions accurately in our support systems.
Following internal policies related to security, compliance, and customer data.
Working closely with Operations and Product teams by sharing customer feedback.
Helping ensure customers feel supported, informed, and respected.


How You’ll Contribute To Lendable

Customer Trust: You help customers feel confident using their credit card.
Quality: You deliver accurate, friendly, and consistent support.
Learning: You continuously improve your understanding of the product and processes.
Feedback: You bring real customer insights back to the team.

What Success Looks Like

Customers feel heard, helped, and respected.
Issues are resolved correctly and efficiently.
Escalations are handled appropriately.
Support interactions are well-documented.
Common customer issues are clearly identified and shared with the team.

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive



Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our programmatic practice, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside. You'll partner with leading B2B and ecommerce brands to build media strategies that go beyond the traditional Google and Meta mix, using channels like Connected TV, programmatic display, online video, native, and emerging opportunities to drive measurable business growth. You won't just be running campaigns; you'll be the strategic partner helping clients answer bigger questions around audience strategy, incrementality, measurement, and long-term growth. The tactical craft matters, but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping full-funnel media strategies that influence pipeline, customer acquisition, and lifetime value. If you're excited by solving complex business challenges, thinking beyond platform best practices, and helping shape the future of programmatic media, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager (Programmatic), you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across programmatic platforms.
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About the job

Overview

About the Role & Team

The Audience Development Specialist will be responsible for building, maintaining, and improving audience databases to support event recruitment across North America. This includes identifying the right audience profiles based on event criteria, sourcing new contact data, cleaning and validating existing records, and supporting outreach efforts to maximize registrations and attendance. This role requires strong research skills, data accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to work closely with event, marketing, and audience development teams.

What You’ll Do

Audience Recruitment & Event Support


 Identify and recruit the right target audience for North America events based on event objectives, target job titles, industries, company types, geographies, and other attendee criteria. 
 Support attendee acquisition efforts for webinars, virtual events, in-person conferences, executive roundtables, and custom event programs. 
 Execute audience invitation activities through approved outreach channels, including email campaigns, phone outreach, LinkedIn research, and other relevant methods. 
 Assist in driving event registration and attendance by ensuring the right audience is invited in a timely and targeted manner. 
 Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand event requirements and audience priorities for each campaign. 
 Monitor recruitment progress and provide updates on audience coverage, gaps, and opportunities. 


Data Research & New Audience Sourcing


 Research and identify new audience data based on event-specific requirements and target profiles. 
 Build and expand prospect lists using internal databases, market research, online resources, professional platforms, and other approved data sources. 
 Source net-new contacts and companies that align with event targeting criteria across the US and broader North America region. 
 Continuously explore new channels and methods for audience discovery and data acquisition. 
 Ensure sourced data is relevant, complete, and aligned to campaign goals before it is added to the database. 


Data Cleaning, Validation & Database Management


 Clean and maintain existing audience databases to ensure accuracy, completeness, and usability. 
 Validate contact records regularly, including names, job titles, company information, email addresses, phone numbers, and relevant segmentation fields. 
 Remove duplicate, outdated, or invalid records and update existing data as needed. 
 Segment and organize audience data based on campaign needs, such as industry, function, seniority, region, and event interest. 
 Conduct ongoing data hygiene activities to improve database health and outreach effectiveness. 
 Support periodic audits of audience records and recommend improvements to data quality processes. 


Reporting & Collaboration


 Track recruitment activity, list-building progress, database updates, and audience quality metrics. 
 Prepare simple reports and summaries on sourcing activity, invitation coverage, record validation, and campaign readiness. 
 Work collaboratively with the Audience Development Manager, US, and relevant internal teams to improve recruitment strategies and database quality. 
 Share feedback and insights from audience engagement and sourcing trends to help refine future targeting efforts. 
 Maintain clear documentation of work completed, sources used, and status of audience development activities. 
 Sending confirmations mails to qualified registrations, decline mails to non qualified registrations, manage registrations lists, recruitment for additional event in event format like 1:1 meetings, lunch & dinner events. 


What You Bring


 Experience in outbound calling, telecalling, telesales, or customer outreach in a professional or BPO/call centre environment. 
 Comfortable making a high volume of calls daily and maintaining a professional, persuasive tone throughout. 
 Experience building, updating, and maintaining contact databases or prospect lists. 
 Ability to research and source contacts online using tools like LinkedIn, Google, or similar platforms. 
 Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and record hygiene. 
 Good written and verbal communication skills in English — ability to send follow-up emails or messages where needed. 
 Proficient in MS Excel or Google Sheets for data entry, list management, and basic tracking. 
 Ability to manage a high call volume independently, prioritise tasks, and meet daily or weekly targets. 
 Experience with CRM tools or contact management platforms is an advantage. 
 Prior exposure to B2B environments, events, or professional audiences is a plus but not required. 

Technical Skills


 Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including: 
 sorting and filtering large datasets 
 VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP 
 PivotTables 
 duplicate identification and removal 
 data validation 
 basic formulas and reporting 
 Experience using CRM systems, marketing databases, event platforms, or spreadsheet-based tracking tools is preferred. 
 Familiarity with LinkedIn and other business research tools for audience identification is an advantage. 


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

About the job

Hi! 👋 I’m Alexis, Manager of Client Onboarding. I was born and raised in Argentina 🇦🇷 and joined WeTravel in March 2023 as an Account Manager. In October 2024, I had the exciting opportunity to start and lead our newly created Onboarding department!

Our team’s mission is to help new customers get up and running with WeTravel quickly and effectively. We empower our client’s businesses to grow while taking the load off our Sales team. We love helping people succeed and making the transition to WeTravel smooth, impactful, and efficient!

We’re looking for a motivated, curious, and independent individual to join our team and help shape the future of travel tech. If you thrive in cross-functional environments, enjoy working with teams and clients across the globe, and are excited to make a real difference…this could be the perfect role for you!

How We Work

Our Onboarding team supports new customers right when they need it most. We help our clients get started by migrating important content like reservation details, photos, pricing information, tour descriptions, and more. We also provide personalized trainings to make sure every new customer feels completely confident using the WeTravel platform.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Account Management, Product, and our customers. Our team is involved across the entire journey, jumping in wherever we can to provide support and make things easier. Please note that business travel is a possibility for this role (1-2 times per quarter) as-needed for on-site client onboarding projects.

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

You Should Apply If You


Are fluent in English (bonus points for other languages!)
Are passionate about educating customers and colleagues, performance improvement, and commercial success.
Are organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Are comfortable being in a customer facing role + tasks that require attention to detail.
Have great project management skills, juggling multiple projects at the same time and managing multiple stakeholders (and their expectations!)
Enjoy doing onsite visits to clients and helping them get set up for success!

Have experience in travel tech or SMB-focused SaaS.
Are familiar with HubSpot, Slack, Confluence, Loom.
Have a teaching background, or Onboarding, Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation roles.
Have experience designing and implementing best practices and processes.


You Might Not Be The Right Fit If You


Prefer roles that are mostly reactive or lack a customer facing interaction.
Are uncomfortable doing sometimes repetitive tasks without losing focus.
Are not comfortable working across different time zones with minimal supervision.


On a Weekly Basis You Will Find Yourself


Partnering with sales teams to get them (and our customers) set up for success.
Finding possible pain points and/or red flags and addressing them before they actually happen.
Build trips, migrate participants, deliver training directly with the customer to ensure they are properly set-up.
Managing multiple projects at the same time and making sure none of them are left forgotten or fall through the cracks.
Leading each project and taking full ownership of each project to do what you were approached to do and more! There’s always extra value we can add to the table!

Generous "Time to Recharge" policy — enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

• Clearly explain reasoning and logic in notebooks or other suitable formats.

• Work with JSON-based data and ensure outputs are accurate and well-organized.

• Use Python scripting (as needed) to support data exploration, validation, and reproducible analysis.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience as a technical content writer, analyst, or software developer.

• Strong technical writing skills with experience producing clear, accurate, and structured content.

• Comfort working with data formats like JSON and interpreting datasets.

• Working knowledge of Python for data exploration/validation (not a core engineering role).

• Familiarity with notebooks and/or scripting workflows to support analysis and documentation.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the transformation of AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence. Equal Opportunity Employer:

description:
About the job

Buscamos a una persona, grupo empresarial o socio adquirente que compre Alerta Patitas, asuma su dirección como CEO y lidere su siguiente etapa de crecimiento comercial.

Alerta Patitas es un ecosistema pet-tech completo, operativo y con monetización validada. La parte tecnológica ya está desarrollada, estable y funcionando. La oportunidad no consiste en construir un producto desde cero, sino en adquirir una plataforma existente y escalar lo que ya funciona.

Actualmente contamos con:

• 55.000 descargas

 • 37.000 usuarios registrados

 • Aproximadamente 800 usuarios activos diarios

 • 10.000 mascotas registradas

 • 75 suscriptores en la aplicación móvil

 • 10 negocios suscritos y pagando por nuestro SaaS

 • Cerca de 45.000 seguidores entre TikTok e Instagram

 • Más de 2.500 mascotas adoptadas

 • Aproximadamente 80 adopciones nuevas cada mes

Alerta Patitas comprende un ecosistema tecnológico completo:

Aplicación móvil para Android y iOS

Más de 66 pantallas con red social para mascotas, adopciones, alertas de mascotas perdidas, cuidado y salud, recetas, historial médico, recordatorios, inteligencia artificial, reservas, pagos, suscripciones, crowdfunding y conexión con negocios pet.

SaaS para negocios de mascotas

Plataforma para veterinarias, groomers, hoteles, guarderías, veterinarios a domicilio y paseadores, con agenda, clientes, mascotas, historias clínicas, recetas, hospitalizaciones, cirugías, inventario, punto de venta, finanzas, cierre de caja, staff, roles, reservas web, consentimientos digitales y facturación electrónica.

El SaaS está conectado directamente con la aplicación móvil, permitiendo que los negocios administren su operación y, al mismo tiempo, se relacionen con los clientes que utilizan Alerta Patitas.

Otros activos incluidos

• Backend, bases de datos e infraestructura

 • Portal independiente para anunciantes

 • Motor de campañas publicitarias y estadísticas

 • Super Admin y CRM comercial

 • Motor de pagos y suscripciones

 • Marca registrada

 • Código fuente y documentación

 • Redes sociales y comunidad

 • Usuarios, suscriptores y clientes activos

 • Compañía legalmente constituida en Ecuador y sin deudas

Las principales líneas de monetización ya están implementadas y validadas mediante suscriptores móviles, negocios SaaS de pago, planes anuales, publicidad, pagos y otros modelos integrados en el ecosistema.

Lo que buscamos

Buscamos un perfil con capacidad empresarial y comercial para:

• Adquirir Alerta Patitas y asumir su propiedad

 • Liderar la estrategia comercial y financiera

 • Crear los equipos de ventas, marketing, soporte y capacitación

 • Escalar la captación de negocios SaaS

 • Expandir la plataforma en Ecuador y otros mercados

 • Administrar las líneas de monetización existentes

 • Construir alianzas estratégicas y nuevas fuentes de ingresos

El comprador no necesita ser desarrollador. La plataforma tecnológica ya está construida y se entregará con su código, infraestructura y documentación.

Sí necesita contar con experiencia empresarial, capacidad de ejecución y capital propio o acceso comprobable a financiamiento para concretar la adquisición y operar la siguiente etapa.

Modalidad de la oportunidad

• Adquisición del ecosistema completo

 • Incorporación inmediata como propietario y CEO

 • Proceso sujeto a reunión, revisión de información y due diligence

 • Precio y condiciones disponibles para candidatos calificados

 • Periodo de transferencia y acompañamiento técnico incluido en la negociación

Esta oportunidad es adecuada para empresarios, operadores tecnológicos, grupos corporativos, family offices, inversionistas, search funds o ejecutivos que quieran adquirir una empresa existente en lugar de comenzar una desde cero.

Para participar, envía por mensaje privado:

Tu experiencia empresarial o ejecutiva.
Empresas o proyectos que hayas administrado.
Experiencia en ventas, tecnología, SaaS o expansión comercial.
Capacidad o estructura prevista para financiar la adquisición.
Razón por la que consideras que puedes llevar Alerta Patitas al siguiente nivel.

No buscamos un CEO empleado. Buscamos al próximo propietario y CEO de Alerta Patitas.

title: Customer Service Representative I
description:
About the job

¿Listo para impulsar tu carrera a nivel global?

Deja tu huella en una de las empresas líderes en pagos. Buscamos un Representante de Servicio al Cliente I para unirse a nuestro equipo de ventas en constante evolución y contribuir a dar forma al futuro del comercio global.

Responderá a las consultas de los clientes por teléfono, correo electrónico, SMS y chat para resolver problemas de acuerdo con los estándares de servicio de la organización. Recibirá y/o realizará llamadas telefónicas, principalmente rutinarias, aunque puede requerir desviarse de las pantallas, guiones y procedimientos estándar. Atenderá consultas, pedidos, necesidades de servicio y quejas de los clientes por teléfono, respondiendo cuando corresponda o derivándolos a las áreas técnicas/de servicio. Mantendrá un conocimiento detallado y actualizado de los productos y servicios de la empresa/cliente asignado. Analizará las necesidades de servicio al cliente para comunicarlas a los departamentos de servicio y técnicos, cuando corresponda. Se requiere habilidad para manejar un sistema computarizado de ingreso de datos u otras aplicaciones relevantes.

Sus responsabilidades

Resolverá solicitudes básicas o de nivel 1 relacionadas con pagos y cuentas, incluyendo, entre otras, activaciones de tarjetas, pagos y actualizaciones de nombre y dirección para titulares de tarjetas (clientes) de 1 a 2 clientes asignados de la empresa. Proporcionará respuestas estandarizadas o predefinidas utilizando interfaces gráficas de usuario (GUI) sencillas y fáciles de usar para los sistemas del cliente, así como la documentación y los procesos establecidos. Ingresará los datos necesarios en los sistemas y bases de datos proporcionados por el cliente. Determinará las causas básicas de los problemas de los clientes utilizando un árbol de decisiones proporcionado por el cliente y escalará o remitirá las quejas y solicitudes no resueltas a representantes de servicio al cliente con más experiencia o a los departamentos designados para su posterior investigación y resolución.

Comenzará a adquirir conocimientos básicos y a familiarizarse con los productos, políticas y procedimientos de un número limitado de clientes, así como a comprender las directrices y el cumplimiento normativo de la asociación, consultando frecuentemente manuales en línea y la capacitación específica del cliente necesaria para resolver las consultas de los titulares de tarjetas.

¿Qué aportará?

Minimo bachillerato o equivalente

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

The Onboarding Specialist role

As our Customer Implementation/Onboarding Specialist, you provide software training to our hotel customers across Mexico via screen share, chat, and phone. You'll use an engaging and informative style to ensure our customers learn how to use the products and benefit from all its features.

We provide you with product and internal software training and pair you with a seasoned buddy to perform mock training before we have you training our customers.

All we ask of you is amazing, go-getting attitude and your passion for providing and striving for a positive customer experience (this we can't train!).

Qualify customer requirements, identify the appropriate set up requirements and prepare the customers for core product implementation

description:
About the job

We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Sales

Our Sales teams help to deliver Reckitt's purpose by building shared success with our customers, making access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment possible in-stores and online. Within Sales, we're focused on achieving outperformance across all of our channels, operating in highly competitive categories. This focus results in a dynamic, fast paced environment where cross functional teams are encouraged to collaborate to achieve success. We have around 10,000 sales people across the world, within market roles and ranging in areas like Field Sales, Key Accounts, Trade Marketing and Category Development.

About The Role

Dive into the dynamic world of trade marketing with Reckitt and be at the forefront of driving growth and elevating brand presence. As a Channel, you will build and execute go-to-market strategies that resonate with our trade channels and customers. This role is your opportunity to bring creativity and analytics together, influencing sales and creating lasting impacts on the market. Embrace the opportunity to leave a distinctive mark on our business, driving both our growth and yours.

Your responsibilities


 Solid background in trade marketing, sales or marketing with a proven track record of crafting compelling trade strategies.
 Insight driven with a strong understanding of trade channels and consumer behaviour.
 Excellent ability to analyse data and translate it into actionable strategies.
 Creative thinker with a results-driven mindset and ability to adapt to market shifts. - Effective communicator and influencer, adept at stakeholder engagement and negotiation.
 Proficient in using Syndicated Data (e.g., Nielsen / IRI) and tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant category management software.


The experience we're looking for


 Solid background in trade marketing, sales or marketing with a proven track record of crafting compelling trade strategies.
 Insight driven with a strong understanding of trade channels and consumer behaviour.
 Excellent ability to analyse data and translate it into actionable strategies.
 Creative thinker with a results-driven mindset and ability to adapt to market shifts. - Effective communicator and influencer, adept at stakeholder engagement and negotiation.
 Proficient in using Syndicated Data (e.g., Nielsen / IRI) and tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, and relevant category management software.


The skills for success

Trade Marketing, Field sales; Field sales management, Ecommerce, Analysing sales and Ecommerce data, Leadership skills, Consumer Insights; Shopper Insights; Customer Insights; Category Analysis, Collaboration and partnership skills; Influencing, Consultative Selling, Customer strategy; Channel strategy, Sales strategy development, Perform product planning, financial accumen, commercial accumen, Sales negotiation, P&L Management, Strategy Execution, Operational Excellence.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

description:
About the job

🚀 Certificación y Bolsa de Trabajo: Asistente Operativo de Shopify (100% Remoto)




¿Te apasiona el mundo del E-Commerce pero te falta la experiencia técnica para aplicar a vacantes internacionales?

En Sinergia Humana GlobalHub hemos cambiado las reglas del reclutamiento. No estamos publicando una vacante tradicional, estamos abriendo las puertas a nuestra Bolsa de Talento Privada. Nuestros clientes (E-commerces en el sector Retail) buscan constantemente talento organizado para operar sus tiendas, y nosotros nos encargamos de evaluar tu perfil, formarte técnicamente y conectarte con ellos.




🎯 ¿Cómo funciona nuestro proceso?
Postulación Inicial (Sube tu CV): El primer paso es compartirnos tu experiencia. Queremos evaluar tu capacidad organizativa y atención al detalle antes de avanzar.
Fórmate y Certifícate: Si tu perfil hace match con nuestros valores, te daremos acceso a nuestra certificación intensiva "Fundamentos de Shopify" (pago único de $97 USD). Aquí aprenderás exactamente cómo operar una tienda real desde cero.
Entra a la Bolsa de Talento Activa: Al aprobar la evaluación final del curso, tu perfil ingresa automáticamente a nuestra base de datos exclusiva de talento verificado y listo para operar.
Conecta y Trabaja: Te conectamos con las vacantes operativas de nuestros clientes internacionales, donde el estándar de compensación es de $1,350 USD mensuales.




💼 El rol para el que te estamos preparando

Una vez dentro de la bolsa de talento y asignado a un cliente, tus responsabilidades 100% remotas serán:

Gestión de Catálogo: Subir nuevos productos, redactar descripciones claras y subir fotografías optimizadas.
Organización: Mantener las colecciones, categorías y etiquetas de la tienda perfectamente actualizadas.
Control de Pedidos: Revisar las compras diarias y asegurar que las tarifas de envío y los pagos se procesen correctamente.
Mantenimiento Visual: Aplicar cambios básicos en el diseño, como actualizar banners o colores de temporada.




🧠 ¿Para quién es esta oportunidad?
Personas con mentalidad resolutiva, excelente ortografía y extremo cuidado por el detalle.
Profesionales que buscan transicionar al trabajo remoto internacional y necesitan la capacitación técnica exacta que piden las empresas.
No se requiere experiencia en programación ni código; buscamos excelencia operativa.




⚖️ Transparencia Total

Queremos ser 100% claros desde el día uno: nuestra evaluación de talento no tiene costo, pero el acceso a la certificación técnica tiene un valor de $97 USD. Este pago cubre el costo de tu educación en nuestra plataforma y tu certificado oficial. No estás pagando por un empleo, estás invirtiendo en educación superior estructurada que te da un pase directo a entrevistas con clientes reales que pagan en dólares.




¿Listo para dar el primer paso? Sube tu CV actualizado a nuestro Portal de Talento para iniciar tu proceso: 👉 [https://sinergiaglobalhub.com/v2talento/]




Nota: Una vez que analicemos tu perfil, nuestro equipo te enviará las instrucciones para acceder a la certificación.

description:
About the job

At Paystand, we’re not just another fintech company—we’re trailblazers in decentralized finance (DeFi), transforming how businesses manage their finances. With thriving hubs in Santa Cruz, San Francisco, Austin, Minneapolis, Mexico City, Hermosillo, and Guadalajara, we’re leading a global revolution in financial systems. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for five consecutive years, we’re among the fastest-growing companies reshaping the future of finance.

Our Expanding Ecosystem: Paystand isn’t just a company—it’s a growing global network. With the strategic acquisitions of Teampay, a leader in spend management, and Yaydoo, a top AR and AP platform in Latin America, we’re building an expansive ecosystem designed to revolutionize financial operations and fuel business growth worldwide.

Why Paystand?

What We Do: By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, we digitize receivables, automate financial processes, reduce time-to-cash, lower transaction costs, and unlock new revenue streams for businesses.

Why We Do It: We’re driven by a mission to revolutionize digital payments and decentralize finance, creating a more open, inclusive, and transparent financial ecosystem, starting with B2B payments.

How We Do It: As change-makers in the DeFi movement, we don’t just follow trends—we set them. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of fintech and eager to redefine what financial technology should look like, Paystand is the place where you can make a significant impact.

Join Us: Be part of something bigger. Join Paystand and help us lead the financial revolution.

Role at a Glance

As a Junior Account Executive, this role owns the full sales cycle for Paystand's CFO stack, engaging CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, and Treasury leaders at mid-size and enterprise companies. The role is responsible for creating and closing high-quality revenue opportunities by diagnosing finance pain, quantifying ROI, positioning automation value, and navigating complex buying processes.

Responsibilities

The following are the primary responsibilities for this role. They may evolve as Paystand's sales strategy, AI-first operating model, and LatAm market priorities continue to mature.


Revenue Ownership & Full-Cycle Execution:
Own the full sales cycle for assigned opportunities, from prospecting and discovery through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.
Manage inbound and outbound leads from SDRs while proactively sourcing net-new opportunities across Northern LatAm and adjacent markets.
Build and maintain strong pipeline coverage through cold calls, email sequences, LinkedIn, Amplemarket, events, referrals, and targeted account-based outreach.


Consultative CFO-Level Selling:
Conduct high-quality discovery to understand finance pain points, ERP environment, cash flow needs, AR inefficiencies, decision criteria, and buying urgency before moving to demo.
Engage CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, Treasury leaders, and executive stakeholders with strong business acumen and executive presence.
Travel to client sites as needed for in-person demos, executive presentations, relationship building, and negotiation sessions.


Deal Strategy, Negotiation & Value Creation:
Develop tailored commercial proposals, quantify ROI, lead negotiations, and close deals with a focus on long-term customer value and quality revenue.
Continuously improve deal strategy using win/loss analysis, pipeline data, manager coaching, market feedback, and customer insights.
AI-Native Sales Execution:
Use AI tools actively for account research, outreach personalization, call preparation, call analysis, meeting summaries, proposal drafting, objection handling, and deal coaching.
Create reusable AI prompts, templates, talk tracks, and workflows that increase sales productivity while preserving message quality and accuracy.

Requirements

Ideal experience for this role can be gained through professional experience, sales performance, educational background, certifications, or relevant projects.


Professional Background:
1+ years of experience as an Account Executive managing full sales cycles, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, ERP, digital payments, or financial management solutions.
Previous SDR, BDR, or similar sales experience is high valuable. Motivation, business acumen, sales judgment, and ownership matter as much as years of experience.


AI-Native Operating Experience:
Active use of AI tools for sales productivity is expected.
Candidates should be able to describe how they use AI to improve research, outreach, preparation, follow-up, and decision quality.
Market and Industry Knowledge:
Familiarity with financial operations in LatAm, including SAT in Mexico, ERP ecosystems, or finance automation, is a significant advantage.

What We Offer


💵 Competitive base salary + monthly commissions + accelerators.
🍽️ Free daily lunch at the office
📈 Stock options / equity participation.
✅ Benefits package above Mexican statutory requirements.
🏥 Major Medical Health Insurance.
💻 Company provided equipment and tools.
🌎 Opportunity for advancement and growth in a rapidly expanding team.
👨🏻‍🏫 Mentorship, learning, and education programs.
💪🏻 Smart, high-achieving, motivated team that likes to have fun.
🎯 Mission-driven culture, where your work matters.


If you're passionate about driving change in the FinTech landscape and being part of a company that is shaping the future of digital payments, we invite you to explore opportunities with Paystand.

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience manifests in diverse ways, skills are transferable, and passion is a powerful driver. Your journey and skills are unique, and we value the richness that diverse perspectives bring to our team.

More than a resume, we prioritize a genuine commitment, impactful contributions, and the ability to thrive in our dynamic, collaborative environment. We are enthusiastic about providing you with opportunities to learn and grow within this role. If your experience aligns closely with what we're seeking, we encourage you to apply.

We celebrate the belief that diversity in backgrounds and thoughts fuels better problem-solving and fosters more creative thinking. Our commitment to adding new perspectives to the team reflects our dedication to innovation and inclusivity.

Your journey is important to us, and we look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to our team at Paystand. Feel free to reach out; we can't wait to hear from you.

For roles based in Mexico, only resumes submitted in English will be considered.
