title: Customer Service Lead
skills: Be the warm, human presence for every student who reaches out. Whether they're confused, frustrated, or just need information, they leave the conversation feeling heard, helped, and genuinely cared for. That's the bar for every single interaction.

Own customer service end-to-end. You are the entire CS function. There's no team beneath you or alongside you in this function; you are the one who does the tickets, drives the strategy, and reports on results. You'll collaborate daily with colleagues across engineering, product, and operations via Slack and team meetings, but within customer service itself, you're it

Handle the full range of student needs: subscriptions, refunds, deferrals, payment issues, and coaching requests with warmth and accuracy. You use excellent judgement, you know when to go above and beyond for a student and when to hold the line.

Make the AI agent smarter over time: refine knowledge base articles, improve automations, so routine questions are handled well automatically and your attention goes to the conversations that benefit from an even more personal touch.

Spot the patterns: When the same friction keeps appearing, document it clearly and bring it to the program experience and engineering teams. You're often the first person to see what's breaking for students upstream.
Keep SOPs and playbooks alive so the function has institutional memory (processes, decision-making guidelines, tools), not just you.

Report on key metrics and share insights with the team regularly. What you see in conversations is some of the most valuable signals in the business, and since you own this function entirely, you're also the one who brings it to the table.
Experience with a customer support platform (Intercom or similar) and the ability to hit the ground running
Fluent English (C1–C2 level), with excellent written communication and no grammar mistakes.

Power user of AI, you reach for AI naturally in your own work, use it to speed up writing, problem-solving, and repetitive tasks, and you're curious and open enough to engage with new tools as the team builds them
Comfortable configuring and adapting existing tools (Intercom) or similar and building no-code automations (Airtable, Zapier)
Experience with Stripe, Paythen, Customer.io

You're warm, conversational, and genuinely empathetic; that's just how you move through the world. You have a deep love for treating people with care and kindness, and get real satisfaction from helping people solve their problems and advocating for their needs.

You take ownership. When something lands in your lap, you treat it as yours. You don't wait to be told what to do and you don't let things fall through the cracks. If something is broken, you make sure you fully understand the problem and you stay on it until it's resolved.
You move fast and you close loops. Every open thread has a next step. Students and teammates don't have to wonder what's happening, you've already told them.
You think in patterns and root causes. Each conversation matters, and so does what it tells you about what's happening across many conversations. You're not satisfied solving the same problem twice.

You're comfortable with AI, and curious about it. You reach for AI naturally in your own work to speed things up and solve problems. As the team builds shared AI tools, you're eager to use them and give honest feedback on what's working and what isn't. When you figure out a better way to do something, you share it with the team to help them level up too.
You back up your instincts with numbers. You track your metrics, spot trends, and turn numbers into something actionable.
Competitive salary: $3,000 to $4,000 USD per month
100% remote position, work from anywhere
Local benefits through an Employer of Record (Remote), varying by country
Shape the role as you go. You'll drive the shift toward AI and self-service, not just watch it happen.
Early access to AI tools the company is actively building for the team
A team that takes care of its people the way it asks you to take care of students
Opportunities for learning and professional development.

About the job

Location: Latin America or South Africa

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (Must cover 7:00am–1:00pm Pacific Time. The remaining hours are flexible, with occasional exceptions during peak periods) 




Only English CVs will be accepted.




Retalent Agency is a global remote recruitment agency that connects talented professionals like you with top companies in e-commerce, marketing, and tech. Since 2019, we’ve helped hundreds of candidates from Latin America, Eastern Europe, Asia, and South Africa land full-time remote roles with international teams.

When you apply through Retalent, you’re not just applying for a job; you’re stepping into a community of growing businesses and ambitious professionals.

Let us help you find the right opportunity to grow your career from anywhere in the world.




Our Client:




Most communication training teaches you what to do differently. Our client teaches you something most programs don’t touch: a genuine shift in how you feel when speaking. You learn to communicate clearly, confidently, and naturally, to be yourself when it matters most. Their method is live, game-based, and coached, and students regularly say the experience changed their lives.

They've built something that actually works, in a space full of things that don't. No scripts, no surface-level fixes, just a genuine, immersive experience that treats the root cause, not the symptoms. Their mission is simple: to help people feel at ease in every interaction.

They are a small, fully remote team who care deeply about every person they work with, not just in their training sessions, but in every touchpoint along the way. They believe that great communication changes lives, and they're looking for people who want to be part of making that possible.




In This Role, You’ll:




You’ll bring warmth, kindness, and genuine empathy to every student who reaches out, so they walk away from a support conversation thinking "This company is different. I didn’t expect to feel this taken care of."

You'll also drive how this work evolves. You'll refine the knowledge base, improve the automations, and make the AI agent smarter over time. The better you make the systems, the more your time goes to the conversations that genuinely need a human.

You won't be doing this alone. Our client is actively building out student self-service tools and smarter AI support, and you'll inherit systems being purpose-built for you to succeed.

You'll own the entire Customer Service function on the Operations team, working closely with program experience, program execution, and engineering to turn frontline insights into real improvements. 

Our client is a remote, growing team of ~15 across the US, Europe, and India, working with individual professionals and teams at well-known companies.




What You'll Be Doing




Be the warm, human presence for every student who reaches out. Whether they're confused, frustrated, or just need information, they leave the conversation feeling heard, helped, and genuinely cared for. That's the bar for every single interaction.
Own customer service end-to-end. You are the entire CS function. There's no team beneath you or alongside you in this function; you are the one who does the tickets, drives the strategy, and reports on results. You'll collaborate daily with colleagues across engineering, product, and operations via Slack and team meetings, but within customer service itself, you're it 
Handle the full range of student needs: subscriptions, refunds, deferrals, payment issues, and coaching requests with warmth and accuracy. You use excellent judgement, you know when to go above and beyond for a student and when to hold the line.
Make the AI agent smarter over time: refine knowledge base articles, improve automations, so routine questions are handled well automatically and your attention goes to the conversations that benefit from an even more personal touch.
Spot the patterns: When the same friction keeps appearing, document it clearly and bring it to the program experience and engineering teams. You're often the first person to see what's breaking for students upstream.
Keep SOPs and playbooks alive so the function has institutional memory (processes, decision-making guidelines, tools), not just you.
Report on key metrics and share insights with the team regularly. What you see in conversations is some of the most valuable signals in the business, and since you own this function entirely, you're also the one who brings it to the table. 




What You’ll Bring:




Must-haves:

Experience with a customer support platform (Intercom or similar) and the ability to hit the ground running 
Fluent English (C1–C2 level), with excellent written communication and no grammar mistakes.
Power user of AI, you reach for AI naturally in your own work, use it to speed up writing, problem-solving, and repetitive tasks, and you're curious and open enough to engage with new tools as the team builds them
Comfortable configuring and adapting existing tools (Intercom) or similar and building no-code automations (Airtable, Zapier) 




Nice-to-haves:

Experience with Stripe, Paythen, Customer.io




Who You Are




You're warm, conversational, and genuinely empathetic; that's just how you move through the world. You have a deep love for treating people with care and kindness, and get real satisfaction from helping people solve their problems and advocating for their needs.
You take ownership. When something lands in your lap, you treat it as yours. You don't wait to be told what to do and you don't let things fall through the cracks. If something is broken, you make sure you fully understand the problem and you stay on it until it's resolved.
You move fast and you close loops. Every open thread has a next step. Students and teammates don't have to wonder what's happening, you've already told them.
You think in patterns and root causes. Each conversation matters, and so does what it tells you about what's happening across many conversations. You're not satisfied solving the same problem twice.
You're comfortable with AI, and curious about it. You reach for AI naturally in your own work to speed things up and solve problems. As the team builds shared AI tools, you're eager to use them and give honest feedback on what's working and what isn't. When you figure out a better way to do something, you share it with the team to help them level up too.
You back up your instincts with numbers. You track your metrics, spot trends, and turn numbers into something actionable.




What’s In It for You:




Competitive salary: $3,000 to $4,000 USD per month 
100% remote position, work from anywhere
Local benefits through an Employer of Record (Remote), varying by country 
Shape the role as you go. You'll drive the shift toward AI and self-service, not just watch it happen.
Early access to AI tools the company is actively building for the team
A team that takes care of its people the way it asks you to take care of students
Opportunities for learning and professional development.

title: Control-M Customer Success Specialist - Mexico
skills: Drive customer adoption and value realization throughout the customer lifecycle by executing Customer Success motions and engagement plans.
Develop and execute adoption plans, workshops, webinars, health reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing guidance on Control-M best practices, architecture, operational excellence, and modernization initiatives.
Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify risks, accelerate customer outcomes, and improve customer health.
Deliver technical advisory sessions focused on solution adoption, operational optimization, governance, automation, and business value realization.
Support customers during implementations, upgrades, migrations, SaaS transitions, and strategic transformation projects.
Conduct technical reviews and adoption assessments to identify opportunities for increased utilization and business impact.
Leverage customer telemetry, product usage data, and Gainsight insights to drive proactive engagements and recommend adoption actions.
Collaborate with Product Management, Support, Professional Services, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and improve customer outcomes.
Identify growth and expansion opportunities through increased adoption of Control-M capabilities and communicate business leads to Sales teams.
Minimum 3 years of experience working with Control-M or comparable enterprise workload automation and scheduling solutions.
Hands-on experience administering, supporting, implementing, or consulting on Control-M environments, including on-premises and/or SaaS deployments.
Strong knowledge of Control-M version 9.x environments, preferably 9.18, 9.19, 9.20, 9.21, 9.22 and newer releases.

Experience with Control-M capabilities such as APIs, Workload Change Manager (WCM), Managed File Transfer (MFT), Workload Archiving, forecasting, monitoring, high availability, and enterprise scheduling.
Practical experience performing upgrades, migrations, implementations, and supporting enterprise-scale production environments.
Working knowledge of enterprise databases including Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of integrations across cloud platforms, DevOps toolchains, ERP applications, data platforms, automation frameworks, and enterprise application ecosystems.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, consulting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business objectives into technical recommendations.
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at multiple organizational levels.
Experience using Customer Success methodologies and platforms such as Gainsight is preferred. Control-M certifications are considered strong advantages.
Fluency in Spanish is required.

About the Job




About Us




VT Markets is an award-winning multi-asset brokerage trusted by over 3 million traders in over 160 countries with 450 employees - and growing. Our platform allows traders to trade anytime, anywhere, supporting them in their journey to build a safe financial future.

We are looking for a creative, agile, and technically savvy Video Producer (Multimedia) in LATAM to join our marketing and content powerhouse. In the fast-paced world of FX CFDs trading, market-moving news happens in seconds. You will be the engine behind our brand’s visual identity, taking complex financial market concepts and translating them into dynamic, accessible, and high-impact video and audio content.




You will work hand-in-hand with our Social Media Manager, Financial Analysts, and Marketing Managers to pitch, produce, and distribute content that educates our community and builds brand authority. title: Gerente superior de marketing
description:
About the job

Objetivo del puesto

Incrementar el tráfico, la conversión y las ventas de las tiendas Game Planet mediante estrategias de marketing retail, una experiencia de compra diferenciada y la generación de ingresos publicitarios y promocionales con fabricantes y publishers de la industria de videojuegos.

En Game Planet buscamos a un líder de marketing con sólida experiencia en retail y tiendas físicas, visión comercial, capacidad de negociación y experiencia dirigiendo equipos. La posición combina estrategia de marketing, experiencia en tienda, ejecución comercial y monetización de activos publicitarios.

Responsabilidades principales

Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de marketing para la red de tiendas físicas de Game Planet.

Desarrollar iniciativas para incrementar tráfico, conversión, ticket promedio, frecuencia de visita y ventas comparables.

Crear y administrar el calendario comercial anual: temporadas, lanzamientos, preventas, promociones, eventos y fechas clave.

Traducir los objetivos comerciales en campañas, promociones y experiencias concretas para el consumidor.

Trabajar transversalmente con Operaciones, Comercial, Compras, E-commerce y Dirección General.

Experiencia y ejecución en tienda

Definir y supervisar el layout comercial, la distribución de categorías, exhibiciones y espacios promocionales.

Desarrollar estándares de visual merchandising, señalización, comunicación visual y materiales para punto de venta.

Mejorar continuamente la experiencia del cliente y generar razones para entrar, comprar y regresar.

Diseñar recorridos, zonas de experiencia, activaciones y exhibiciones que impulsen el descubrimiento de productos.

Asegurar la correcta implementación de campañas y lineamientos de marca en todas las sucursales.

Supervisar la calidad de la ejecución mediante visitas periódicas y mecanismos de comprobación.

Relación comercial con fabricantes y publishers

Desarrollar y fortalecer la relación con Nintendo, Microsoft, PlayStation y la red de publishers con la que trabaja Game Planet.

Presentar el media kit de Game Planet y comunicar el valor de sus activos físicos y digitales.

Negociar inversiones de marketing, presupuestos cooperativos, campañas pagadas, patrocinios, lanzamientos y activaciones.

Comercializar escaparates, cabeceras, exhibiciones, pantallas, materiales en punto de venta, eventos, contenidos y canales propios.

Desarrollar propuestas comerciales personalizadas y negociar precios, alcances, entregables, calendarios y condiciones.

Dar seguimiento a órdenes de compra, contratos, facturación, cobranza y control de presupuestos.

Coordinar la ejecución interna de cada campaña y asegurar el cumplimiento de los compromisos adquiridos.

Elaborar evidencias, reportes fotográficos, resultados y comprobaciones profesionales para cada socio comercial.

Identificar nuevas oportunidades de monetización y ampliar los productos incluidos en el media kit.

Medición, gestión y liderazgo

Establecer indicadores de tráfico, conversión, ventas, rentabilidad, retorno de inversión e ingresos por socios comerciales.

Analizar resultados por tienda, categoría, campaña, fabricante y publisher.

Elaborar reportes ejecutivos para Dirección General y presentar aprendizajes y propuestas de mejora.

Administrar el presupuesto de marketing y priorizar iniciativas con base en impacto comercial.

Dirigir, desarrollar y evaluar al equipo de marketing.

Coordinar agencias, diseñadores, productores, instaladores y proveedores de materiales y activaciones.

Perfil requerido

Licenciatura en Marketing, Mercadotecnia, Administración, Comunicación, Diseño Comercial o carrera afín.

Experiencia comprobable en posiciones gerenciales de marketing dentro de empresas de retail y tiendas físicas.

Experiencia liderando equipos y coordinando proyectos con múltiples áreas.

Dominio de visual merchandising, trade marketing, experiencia del cliente y ejecución en punto de venta.

Experiencia incrementando tráfico, conversión y ventas en sucursales físicas.

Experiencia negociando presupuestos de marketing, campañas cooperativas, patrocinios o espacios publicitarios.

Capacidad para desarrollar y presentar media kits y propuestas comerciales.

Experiencia integral en negociación, facturación, ejecución, medición, comprobación y cobranza de campañas.

Inglés profesional para reuniones, negociaciones y presentaciones con socios internacionales.

Competencias clave

• Visión comercial

• Negociación

• Orientación a resultados

• Liderazgo de equipos

• Pensamiento estratégico

• Alta capacidad de ejecución

• Sensibilidad por la experiencia del cliente

• Capacidad analítica

• Comunicación ejecutiva

• Organización y seguimiento

• Construcción de relaciones

• Afinidad con tecnología y videojuegos







Indicadores clave

Crecimiento del tráfico, conversión, ventas, ticket promedio y frecuencia de compra.

Ingresos negociados, facturados y cobrados con fabricantes, publishers y socios comerciales.

Rentabilidad y retorno de inversión de campañas y promociones.

Calidad y puntualidad de la ejecución y las comprobaciones.

Cumplimiento del presupuesto de marketing y satisfacción de los socios comerciales.

Posición 100% presencial 7am a 4pm en las oficinas corporativas de Game Planet en Santa Fe.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Una posición estratégica con impacto directo en el crecimiento de Game Planet.

Reporte directo a Dirección General.

Relación con las principales marcas y publishers de la industria de videojuegos.

Autonomía para desarrollar propuestas comerciales y nuevas fuentes de ingresos de marketing.

Sueldo y prestaciones competitivas, de acuerdo con la experiencia del candidato.

description:
About the job

Remote SaaS Sales Representative — BowerBird.io


Location: Remote — Mexico (or other South American countries)




Please note: You must have C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English. Please do not apply unless your English is at this level.




About BowerBird




BowerBird is an Australian online platform that connects architecture and design professionals with journalists so they can get their work published.




We are a fully remote, global team that values excellent work, direct feedback and daily improvement. We work with architects, designers and media professionals around the world, including people from many of the largest and most respected design publications.


About the role




We are looking for an experienced Sales Closer to help architects and designers decide whether BowerBird is right for them.




Your main responsibility will be conducting pre-booked sales meetings via Zoom with prospects who have already expressed an interest in BowerBird.




You will uncover what each prospect wants to achieve, understand what is preventing them from achieving it and show how BowerBird could support their business goals. You will present the platform, recommend the right plan, discuss pricing, handle concerns and ask directly for the sale.




You will also regularly call inbound leads who have engaged with BowerBird but have not yet booked a meeting. These are not random cold calls: they are people who have already shown an interest in what we do. Your job will be to understand why they became interested, determine whether there is a genuine opportunity and book an appropriate sales meeting.




Phone calls are part of this position, alongside email and other follow-up methods. You should be comfortable picking up the phone when it is the most effective way to start a conversation or move a lead forward.


What you will do




Conduct pre-booked sales meetings with architects, interior designers and other design professionals.
Call inbound leads and convert suitable prospects into booked meetings.
Research prospects before each meeting.
Use needs-based discovery to understand each prospect’s business goals and challenges.
Connect BowerBird’s features to specific outcomes rather than delivering a generic demonstration.
Recommend the most suitable subscription plan.
Discuss price confidently and ask directly for the sale.
Explore the real issue when a prospect hesitates.
Agree on clear decision dates and next steps.
Follow up actively by phone and email.
Keep accurate prospect notes, tasks and records.
Review your sales meetings and apply regular coaching.
Work towards individual sales targets.

About you




You will have:




C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English;
proven sales experience with personal responsibility for closing;
experience conducting sales meetings by phone or video;
confidence calling inbound leads;
experience using discovery questions to understand customer needs;
the ability to translate product features into commercial value;
confidence discussing price, handling objections and asking for a decision;
strong follow-up and organisational habits;
the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment;
a genuine interest in architecture, design, media or related creative industries;
the ability to work as an independent contractor while meeting the requirements of your local authorities.




Experience in SaaS, subscription sales, consultative sales, architecture, design, media or public relations will be highly regarded.




Because our prospects are based around the world, your English must be clear, natural and easy for international clients to understand. An accent is not a problem. Clear international communication is essential.


Our skateboarding culture




We like to skateboard. Not literally—that could end badly.




“Skateboarding” is how we describe daily improvement. Within the sales team, this means reviewing meetings, receiving specific coaching and applying one useful change at a time.




You will receive regular coaching and support, but you must genuinely enjoy being coached. We are looking for someone who can receive direct feedback, understand it and change their approach quickly.




This role will not suit someone who avoids phone calls, dislikes direct sales targets or does not want their sales meetings reviewed and coached.


What we offer




A fully remote position.
Pre-booked meetings with prospects who have already expressed interest.
Inbound leads rather than random cold-call lists.
A base payment plus attractive, uncapped commission.
Daily coaching and practical sales support.
The opportunity to work with architects, designers and media professionals worldwide.
A supportive global team.
BowerBird’s Grown-up Leave Program—our version of unlimited leave.
The opportunity to contribute to an Australian technology company working across architecture, design, media and AI.

How to apply




Please follow the link to apply, submit your CV, LinkedIn profile and a thoughtful response, explaining why you want to join BowerBird and why this role suits you.




Your response should help us understand who you are, how you sell and why BowerBird interests you. Generic cover letters or summaries of our website will not help us assess your fit.




Before reaching the interview stage, we recommend exploring BowerBird and listening to at least one episode of the BowerBird Architecture Podcast.




If you are an experienced salesperson who enjoys discovery, closing, phone calls, coaching and continuous improvement, we would like to hear from you.

Description

CoinFlip is a global digital currency platform company focused on providing consumers with simple and secure access to buy and sell cryptocurrency. The company operates the world's largest network of cryptocurrency kiosks by transaction volume, with more than 5,500 kiosks across 49 U.S. states, Puerto Rico, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Italy, Panama, Brazil, Mexico, and Spain. CoinFlip’s digital currency kiosks make buying and selling major cryptocurrencies accessible for consumers who wish to purchase digital currency using cash.

CoinFlip also operates CoinFlip Preferred, a personalized over-the-counter service that provides investors with custom, white-glove support for their cryptocurrency transactions. In 2022, CoinFlip launched CoinFlip Ventures, an investment group offering coaching, funding, and networking support to early-stage crypto and web3 projects. We also offer the CoinFlip Crypto Wallet, a self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet available for iOS and Android devices.

CoinFlip was founded in 2015 by Daniel Polotsky, Kris Dayrit, Alan Gurevich, and Ben Weiss. Headquartered in Chicago, CoinFlip placed in the top 500 on the 2021, 2022, and 2023 Inc. 5000 list, and on the 2022 and 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500, was named the 2021 and 2022 #1 fastest-growing company in Chicago by Crain's, ranked in Chicago Tribune’s Top Workplaces in 2021 and 2022, and was awarded the 2021 and 2022 Stevie ® Awards for Customer Service. To learn more about CoinFlip and how to get started on your digital currency journey, visit www.CoinFlip.tech.

About the job

Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

The Role

Apollo.io is seeking an Account Advocate located in Mexico City to play a critical role in shaping our billing and retention experience at scale. This role represents the highest level of domain expertise and operational ownership within the Account Advocate function, responsible for solving the most complex customer, billing, and revenue-impacting challenges.

As an Account Advocate, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence, owning high-risk scenarios and driving systemic improvements across retention, billing accuracy, and customer trust. You will partner closely with Team Leads, Finance, Support, Product, Sales, and Customer Success to reduce churn, improve operational consistency, and elevate the customer experience.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, owns outcomes end-to-end, and elevates the performance of others through expertise, mentorship, and operational leadership.

Responsibilities

Customer Retention & Revenue Impact


Own the most complex, high-risk cancellation, downgrade, and billing escalation cases.
Lead strategic retention efforts for at-risk accounts, balancing customer empathy with policy and revenue considerations.
Identify churn drivers and recurring billing friction, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
Deliver measurable retention impact through targeted save strategies, credits, or remediation plans.


Operational & Domain Leadership


Act as the subject-matter expert for billing, renewals, refunds, and subscription lifecycle workflows.
Define and improve operational standards, playbooks, and escalation paths across Account Advocates and Billing Advocates.
Own high-visibility cross-functional initiatives that improve billing accuracy, reduce escalations, or lower cost-to-serve.
Ensure audit readiness, data quality, and consistency across billing decisions and documentation.


Cross-Functional Influence


Partner with Finance, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve systemic issues affecting renewals and customer trust.
Represent the voice of the customer in pricing, packaging, and policy discussions.
Influence product and process roadmaps using quantified churn, refund, and escalation insights.


Mentorship & Organizational Impact


Mentor and coach Account Advocates and Billing Advocates through case reviews, knowledge shares, and shadowing.
Serve as a trusted advisor to Team Leads on complex scenarios and judgment calls.
Raise the bar for quality, empathy, and ownership across the function without formal people management authority.


Required

Skills & Qualifications


3+ years of experience in customer-facing SaaS roles (Support, Renewals, Billing Operations, Customer Success).
Demonstrated success owning complex billing, retention, or churn-prevention scenarios.
Proven track record of driving cross-functional improvements without people management responsibility.
Strong experience working with billing systems, CRMs, and subscription tooling.


Preferred


Experience influencing pricing, packaging, or policy decisions.
Exposure to churn analytics, VOC programs, or revenue operations.
History of mentoring senior ICs or serving as a domain owner within a support organization.


We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for discovering, incubating, and educating e-commerce creators, with a focus on helping vertical creators improve their sales performance. You will collaborate closely with industry teams to match high-potential creators with quality content formats, including short videos and live streaming. Additionally, you will support major campaigns, marketing initiatives, and creator education efforts by providing relevant content and guidance. A key part of your role will be working with the content moderation team to educate creators on platform policies and ensure compliance.

KittySpout is looking for experienced Customer Support Agents to join our team on an hourly contract basis — starting within the next 1–4 days!




We're working through a high volume of tickets and need proven, fast, experienced agents who can jump in immediately with minimal ramp-up. You'll manage customer interactions across Email, and turn frustrated customers into brand advocates with fast, empathetic, effective solutions.




To be clear upfront: this is hourly contract work, 30–40+ hours per week for the next several weeks. If you perform at a high level, there is a real opportunity to convert into a permanent full-time position on the team.




We're looking for someone with 3+ years of high-volume e-commerce support experience, excellent English, and hands-on experience with subscription-related tickets (cancellations, saves, refunds, failed payments). The ideal candidate has worked at DTC brands, understands first-contact resolution, and can handle heavy volume without sacrificing quality or brand voice. Speed is the single most important trait for this role.


Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.


What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring — even for contract roles.

We are a fast-moving, data-driven team with no corporate politics. Everyone is hands-on, and if something needs doing, you do it — regardless of whether it's "in your job description." We value speed, ownership, and people who overdeliver without being asked. This is not a 9–5 corporate role, and this role in particular exists because we're in a high-volume period: we need someone who sees a full queue as a challenge to beat, not a reason to stress.




The right person for this role is fast, self-directed, and reliable. You'll get clear policies, macros, training and a well-organized helpdesk — and then we'll trust you to run your queue without hand-holding. You won't be micromanaged, and you won't be waiting around for approvals. Support is the voice of our brand, and we treat great agents accordingly: your CSAT and resolution numbers get seen, and strong performance here is the direct path to a permanent full-time seat on the team.

Our core values: Work Smart. Overdeliver. Speed is King. Better Every Day.




Key Objectives

Resolve a high volume of tickets (100+ tickets per day) while maintaining a friendly, helpful tone.
Handle subscription tickets — cancellations, saves, refunds, failed payments — confidently and according to policy.
Apply problem-solving principles to resolve shipping, product, and technical issues autonomously.
Operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your queue efficiently to meet SLA deadlines without hand-holding.
Hit the ground running in Richpanel and Shopify from day one — this is not a "learn on the job" situation given the timeline.
Ensure every interaction meets our quality standards, minimizing follow-ups and escalations.
Maintain clear, proactive communication with the operations team to report recurring product issues or shipping delays.


Requirements

Fully remote.
Available to start within 1–4 days and commit 30–40+ hours per week for the next several weeks.
Fluent English, written and spoken — professional or native level. This is non-negotiable.
3+ years of Customer Support experience for DTC e-commerce brands.
Proven hands-on experience with Richpanel (this is our helpdesk) and Shopify. Gorgias/Zendesk experience is a plus, but Richpanel proficiency means you start faster.
Direct experience handling subscription-related tickets (billing, cancellations, saves, chargebacks).
Speed & Accuracy: fast typing, comfortable navigating multiple tabs/tools simultaneously.
No issue working overtime or weekends when needed — we're in a high-volume period and that's exactly why this role exists.
Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.




KPIs You Will Own

Daily Ticket Quota: consistent resolution of 100+ assigned tickets per day.
Average Response Time: under 1 hour during shift.
CSAT Score: maintain 4.8/5.0 or higher.


This Role Is Not For You If

You are a perfectionist who spends 20 minutes drafting a single email. With 100+ tickets a day, success demands efficiency — macros/templates combined with quick personalization.
You thrive on frequent meetings and constant collaboration. This is a high-autonomy, heads-down role where you work the queue independently for most of your shift.
You struggle with fast-paced changes. Policies and promotions can change overnight, and you must pivot and learn new protocols instantly without frustration.
You can't start this week. We are onboarding immediately — if your earliest start is 2+ weeks out, this isn't the right posting for you.


How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

We are moving extremely fast on this role. The process: submit the application, and if you're a strong fit we'll reach out within 24 hours for a single interview covering technical skills (mock tickets) and culture fit. We aim to have you onboarded and working tickets within 1–4 days of applying. We pride ourselves on timely responses — we won't leave you hanging.

Once you start, we'll define your KPIs and targets together, so there's zero ambiguity about whether you're doing a good job.


Compensation

USD $7–$9 per hour, based on experience and expertise. 30–40+ hours per week to start. Top performers have the opportunity to convert to a permanent full-time role.

title: Founding GTM Lead
description:
About the job

Who we are

REXX Studio is a venture studio that builds tech companies for legacy, underserved industries, and pre-sells the concepts directly to PE firms before they're fully built. REXX comes in as co-founder and first allocator on every company, so they have real skin in each bet.




Role Summary

You are the studio's full-funnel commercial operator. Your primary job is to go close - in person, on camera, or at the door, wherever the deal requires. For every venture in the early GTM phase, you are the first salesperson on the ground. You also build the outbound infrastructure and sales playbooks that founders inherit as they scale, and you run structured outreach to surface the domain experts who become REXX's next EIRs.




Key Responsibilities

● Act as the primary salesperson for each venture during the early GTM phase until the EIR is fully ramped

● Show up in person wherever the deal requires - travel, door-knock, and close without hesitation

● Prospect, sequence, follow up, and close deals personally through direct outreach

● Record every customer interaction to build reusable sales playbooks for incoming founders

● Run structured outreach to identify domain experts and potential EIR candidates for the studio

● Own early GTM for REXX Studio itself - outreach, positioning, and inbound interest generation




Requirements & Background

● Background in business, marketing, or roles involving direct selling and client acquisition

● Has closed deals where the answer started as a no

● Experience building outbound systems using tools like Apollo, Clay, or Instantly

● Fluent in both Spanish and English

● Relentless and high-output - willing to do the unglamorous, repetitive work of early sales

● Equally strong on camera and in person - can represent a brand credibly in any room

● Low ego, high ownership - the closer who also documents everything so others can replicate it

● AI-native approach to prospecting and sequencing to maximize human closing time

About the job

Creative Designer & Multimedia Specialist - Remote




Our client is a boutique hospitality group that also supports an international humanitarian foundation, and is looking for a Creative Designer & Multimedia Specialist to serve as the visual voice for both.




This isn't an entry-level role, and it isn't a narrow, single-format one either. One day you're designing a luxury property brochure, the next you're building a donor impact report. You'll move fluidly between graphic design, executive presentation design, video production, and brand management, using modern AI-assisted workflows to work faster without ever letting the work look automated.




What You'll Do:

Design social media graphics, digital ads, brochures, print materials, signage, and infographics
Build executive-quality presentations (PowerPoint & Google Slides) for investor, board, and donor decks, treated as a core part of this role, not an occasional task
Produce promotional videos, property tour content, fundraising videos, event recaps, and short-form social video
Maintain visual consistency across both organizations: typography, color, templates, and brand guidelines
Partner directly with executive leadership, marketing, and sales on one side, and fundraising and nonprofit leadership on the other




Compensation:

$1,800–$2,800 USD/month, depending on the experience you bring (Independent Contractor)
Fully remote, open to candidates in LATAM




What We're Looking For:

A strong portfolio is the main qualifier for this role — company size and years of experience matter far less than the range and quality of your work
Fluent in English (written and verbal)
Comfortable moving between a premium hospitality tone and a humanitarian, trust-building tone, without losing quality or nuance in either
Real range across formats: graphic design, presentation design, and video/motion, not just one
Strong command of composition, typography, visual hierarchy, color theory, and real brand thinking
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, Figma, and motion graphics tools; executive-level PowerPoint/Slides
Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Firefly, Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Veo, Canva AI, ElevenLabs, Descript, etc.) as part of a normal workflow

Hospitality or nonprofit experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.




How You'll Work:

You'll receive clear direction on objectives, priorities, and deadlines, then have real autonomy to determine your own creative approach. This role is collaborative on concepts and hands-off on execution, with final creative sign-off retained by leadership. We value self-management and on-time delivery over endless refinement.




How to Apply:

Please complete our short application form, which includes a link to your portfolio: https://forms.gle/LbztoepQG9oBXFVa9 




This role is recruited by Remote Hire 4U on behalf of a confidential client. The company name will be shared with candidates who advance in the process.

Liderarás la estrategia de crecimiento de un holding con empresas de salud, bienestar y tecnología, trabajando directamente con los fundadores para convertir oportunidades de negocio en resultados medibles.




No buscamos un director de marketing.

Este no es un cargo para administrar campañas, revisar piezas creativas o coordinar calendarios de contenido. Es un cargo para alguien que entiende el negocio, identifica oportunidades, toma decisiones con datos y convierte estrategias en crecimiento comercial.

Cada empresa tiene un mercado diferente, un cliente diferente y retos diferentes, por eso buscamos una persona que disfrute construir, experimentar y escalar negocios.




Lo que esperamos de ti

Diseñar estrategias de crecimiento adaptadas a cada empresa del holding.
Construir sistemas de adquisición de clientes que puedan escalar.

✔ Te sientes cómodo trabajando donde muchas cosas todavía no existen.

✔ Puedes pasar de la estrategia a la ejecución sin perder velocidad.

✔ Has trabajado en startups, empresas de alto crecimiento o has construido un negocio propio.

✔ Te gusta resolver problemas de negocio, no únicamente problemas de marketing.

title: Logistics Tracking Coordinator (Remote)
description:
About the job

Location: Remote — Latin America (open to candidates in Colombia, Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, and nearby countries)

Schedule: Full Time, aligned to U.S. Eastern business hours

Compensation: $7 to $10 per hour, based on experience and country




About ATC

ATC is a fast paced transportation and logistics company specializing in freight coordination, dispatch, and brokered transport. We are growing our air cargo business, moving imports, exports, and domestic and international airport shipments, and we are building a structured, high accountability operations team to keep every shipment on track.




Position Overview

The Logistics Tracking Coordinator owns the day to day follow up on our air cargo shipments. As we take on new airport customers, this role makes sure nothing slips through the cracks between our team, the local carriers, the airlines, and our customers. This is a remote, high volume, follow up heavy position built around consistent communication, careful record keeping, and reliability. You will report to the Operations and Billing team and work closely with our controller to take follow up work off their plate.




We keep our shipments centralized in our logistics platform, so you will have a clear view of what is moving and where follow up is needed. Training on our systems and processes is provided.




Key Responsibilities

Carrier & Airline Coordination

• Follow up with local carriers picking up and delivering air cargo to and from airlines at airports, both domestic and international.

• Confirm that carriers have received the paperwork we send and have everything they need to move each shipment.

• Coordinate pickup and delivery appointments and confirm dates with carriers and airlines.




Tracking & Documentation 

• Monitor active shipments in our logistics platform (TMS) and keep status updates accurate and current.

• Obtain proof of delivery (POD) documents and send them to customers promptly.

• Keep clear, accurate notes on every carrier and customer interaction so the whole team has full visibility at any time.

• Gathering final charges after completed deliveries




Customer Communication

• Provide timely status updates to customers on pickups, deliveries, and any exceptions.

• Send and manage a high volume of follow up emails with carriers, airlines, and customers throughout the day.

• Escalate delays or issues to the team with full context so they can be resolved quickly. 




Qualifications

• Fluent, professional English, written and spoken. You will be emailing carriers and customers constantly.

• Strong follow up discipline and a real sense of urgency. You chase items down until they are resolved and do not let them sit. 

• Highly organized and detail oriented, with disciplined note taking and record keeping.

• Reliable and responsible, with consistent availability during U.S. business hours.

• Comfortable managing a large volume of email and juggling several shipments at once.

• A quiet remote work setup with reliable internet and a computer.




Preferred but not required

• Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, air cargo, or a 3PL back office.

• Familiarity with a TMS or logistics dashboard. We provide training on our system, so this is a plus, not a must.

Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you’re choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — it’s still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. 
Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. 
Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. 


In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

We are building a world-class social team.

As Ambassadors Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to turn creator content into views that scale. Those views then help drive new customer sign-ups.

You’ll deliberately build a roster designed to go viral rather than just have a CRM full of names.

You'll brief all ambassadors on two flagship campaigns, the Oral Wegovy pill and the lower-BMI demographic, leveraging their reach to establish Bolt as the UK's number one destination for oral Wegovy. You’ll help us reach communities we currently under-index with.

You'll partner with our creative leads to keep every piece of content compliant while still giving creators room for diverse, human storytelling. You’ll send feedback the other way to the creative team on what’s working organically and what’s not.

If you really nail the role, you’ll be a leading candidate for future senior Social roles.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you'll work async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you're around until midday Pacific Time for calls as needed.

You'll report directly to Erin (Viral Social Lead).

Marie Boes (AI Growth Lead)

We’re Angel Host, a Canadian-based, data-driven, and tech-enabled vacation rental performance company that helps property managers and owners worldwide outperform their markets. By taking care of pricing, reservations, channel marketing, and guest services, we enable our clients to focus on growing their business while maximizing the performance of their property portfolio and reducing their day-to-day workload.

Does our mission resonate with you? Are you looking to work in a fast-paced, fun, and flexible environment with unlimited opportunities for growth and learning? Does being part of a rapidly growing startup, surrounded by talented people from around the world, sound exciting? If so, keep reading!




The position: Guest Services Agent – LATAM (English/Spanish), Pacific Time Evening Shift, 25 hrs/week

As a Guest Services Agent, you’ll be responsible for delivering exceptional online service to guests from their very first inquiry until they leave a review.

This role covers our evening shift, including the daily handover between our Mexico and Europe teams. Because of this, you’ll need to make confident decisions, solve problems independently, and remain calm under pressure.

You’ll be joining an international Guest Services team spread across multiple countries and time zones, working together to support more than 500 properties around the clock.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. We believe every guest deserves a welcoming, caring, and personalized experience, while every property owner deserves a partner they can trust to protect their business and reputation.




Specifically, we need you to:




Respond promptly in writing or by phone call to guest inquiries in English and Spanish, researching the best solutions whenever needed.
Handle a high volume of guest communications through our Property Management System (PMS) and automation softwares.
Resolve guest issues before, during, and after their stay by coordinating with property owners and local property managers.

Process payments for additional services, damage claims, and refunds when applicable.
Think creatively and proactively to ensure outstanding guest experiences while protecting our clients’ interests.
Respond professionally to post-stay guest reviews and dispute them if needed.




Is this job for you? Well, it is if you:




Have experience in Guest Services, Hospitality, Travel, Tourism, Customer Support, or another client-facing role involving chat, email, or written communication.

Have excellent judgment and remain calm under pressure. This shift often requires resolving guest issues independently during the daily handover between our Mexico and Europe teams.
Bring a positive attitude and enjoy contributing to a collaborative, supportive team environment.
Take initiative and naturally look for ways to improve processes rather than waiting to be told what to do. The phrase “that’s not my responsibility” doesn’t exist in your vocabulary.
Have strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively.
Enjoy learning and using new technologies.
Can comfortably multitask while maintaining attention to detail.
Experience with Guesty and HubSpot is a plus.
Love working with people and being part of an amazing team.




What’s in it for you?

We believe that attracting exceptional people means offering an exceptional work environment. While we’re passionate about our work, we also value balance, flexibility, and making time for the things that matter most.

As our Guest Services Agent, you’ll receive:

Competitive salary for a 25-hour/week schedule, with annual salary reviews and opportunities for career growth.
Paid vacation plus all national holidays.
25-hour/week schedule consisting of 5-hour shifts, based on Pacific Time, typically between 5:00 PM and 12:00 AM PT. Weekend availability is required.
The freedom to work remotely from anywhere with a reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace.

About the job

Role Overview:

As a Marketing Specialist, you will be focused on leveraging marketing tactics and channels to create demand and leads to support the company’s highest goals. This will be done through a combination of creating & executing multichannel marketing strategies. This person will be required to execute marketing efforts by the direction of the head of marketing to achieve the team’s most important number (MIN).




This role requires a scrappy and experienced professional who is willing to execute elements of each campaign. This means they are capable of rolling up their sleeves and solving capacity problems themselves either by writing copy, editing a workflow, peeking into analytics, or directing an agency/vendor to get a job done. We know that not all functions of marketing can be done by one person - even the most amazing marketing specialist, but this role particularly requires a person who can execute certain tactics themselves when necessary to get results.




Outcomes

1. Execute High-Impact Webinars That Drive MQL Growth and Engagement

Why this matters: Webinars are one of Rotate Digital's highest-leverage tools for attracting, warming, and converting moving company owners into qualified leads. Execution quality directly impacts how the industry perceives us and how many new MQLs enter the pipeline every month.

How success looks:

Webinars (monthly) are planned, promoted, and executed on time with zero dropped balls 🎯
Registrant counts are consistently hitting or exceeding the monthly target
New MQLs generated from each webinar are tracked, segmented, and handed off intentionally
Post-webinar follow-up is structured, timely, and drives continued engagement
The webinar experience feels polished, professional, and worth showing up for
Every webinar produces repurposable content that feeds other channels




2. Own the MQL Journey and Drive Intentional Nourishment That Moves People Toward Sales

Why this matters: Rotate Digital has over 800 qualified contacts sitting in the MQL list at any given time. Right now, most of them are floating in an ocean with no current. Without intentional nourishment, these people time out after 90 days and disappear without ever talking to sales. Owning this journey means owning a huge piece of the pipeline. 🌊

How success looks:

Every MQL has a clear, documented experience from entry to exit
MQLs are receiving intentional, valuable touchpoints throughout their 90-day window
Engagement rates on MQL communications are tracked and improving over time
New MQLs (especially first-time webinar registrants) are identified, flagged, and personally touched by sales
The MQL list is growing month over month and contributing to booked sales conversations
Nobody is timing out without having experienced real value from Rotate Digital

Important KPIs:

MQL to Opportunity Rate
Time to SQL
Unsubscribe/Opt-out Rate
Time-Out Rate




3. Maintain a Consistent, Intentional Organic Social Media Presence That Builds Brand Authority

Why this matters: Organic social is Rotate Digital's testing ground and trust-builder. It keeps us top of mind for the moving company owners already in our ecosystem, attracts new ones, and feeds the paid ads engine with proven content. If we're not showing up consistently, we're invisible. 📱

How success looks:

A minimum of 3 posts per week are going out across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok
Content is intentional, on-brand, and focused on value, not just filling a calendar slot
Follower counts, views, and engagement are tracked weekly and trending in the right direction
Organic content directly informs what gets tested in paid ads
There is always a content calendar in place at least 2 weeks ahead, no scrambling at the end of the month
Content feels cohesive across all channels and clearly represents who Rotate Digital is




Capabilities:

Technical skills: Extensive ability to leverage and use Hubspot for marketing metrics, customer engagement, and all marketing activities.
Story Telling: Ability to take the wins from our company for our clients and create urgency & desire in our prospective clients i.e. tell stories through testimonials that create urgency and lead people to become clients.
Organizational Skills: You are capable of managing multiple projects and tasks across our core marketing activities, all while keeping this very organized and up to date.
Strong Attention to Detail: You have a natural ability to care about quality and having things done well and done right. You may consider yourself a perfectionist or not, but you want to get things as close as possible when your name is on the work. This attention to detail spans from content in an email to the editing of a video ad or testimonial.
Ownership: You take ownership of each task and project and see it through to completion and the desired result/outcome. You go further to put your stamp of approval on all work going out. Double-checking work is commonplace, but relying on others to catch mistakes and uphold quality is not.
Great Time Management: You easily adapt to different types of workloads, adjust to unexpected changes, and manage multiple tasks or projects simultaneously. You should be able to handle multiple responsibilities across our core marketing activities with quality and the appropriate velocity.
Strong Communication and Collaboration: You need strong communication and collaboration skills to work across sales, marketing, and client success team members daily. You will also need to be able to write and convey intentional, clear, and personalized messages to clients and prospects.




Duties:

Work closely with our sales team to increase the effectiveness of lead generation
Report on KPIs and metrics weekly
Keep Hubspot organized for all teams to leverage it better
Report on marketing qualified leads to the head of marketing for end-of-month reporting and tracking over time.




Compensation

We pay you for the value you have and create at Rotate Digital.

Pay range is dependent on experience.

$1,500 to $2,500 USD monthly salary
Annual pay raise increase based on tenure (8%)
Paid Time-Off




How to Apply

Do you feel like you would love this role and excel in creating extreme value by being in this position? If so here is how to apply:

At Rotate Digital, we strongly believe that actions speak louder than words. With that in mind, this application will also be the first test of your technical expertise and problem-solving skills. To complete this application successfully and move on to the next step in the hiring process, set aside enough time to approach this first application the same way you would a final interview. You will be asked highly technical questions and asked to provide solutions to real-life problems that come with this role. You will also be asked to record a video, so have a camera and a microphone ready.
Completing the application form fully with all the questions answered is mandatory, and an incomplete application will not be considered.
From our end, we promise to review every single candidate in detail and carefully consider all the applicants.
Ready? Use the Apply link to go to our internal Careers page and start the application process there.
You’ll hear from us if we want to move forward in the application process. Please allow us up to two weeks to review your application, as we want to make sure we carefully consider your replies.
Any questions, just reach out

Contribute search and social expertise to broader media planning and business-review discussions.

Collaborative approach and experience working effectively across disciplines and teams.

description:
About the job

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.

About The Company

Our client is a fast-growing marketing consultancy and growth agency specializing in the medical aesthetics and regenerative medicine sector. Operating globally across the US, UK, Australia, and beyond, the team helps premium clinics and MedSpas transition from inconsistent results to predictable, $100K+ monthly revenue. By moving beyond traditional lead generation, they implement comprehensive growth frameworks that optimize high-ticket patient acquisition, sales conversion systems, and client retention strategies for treatments like body sculpting, injectables, and advanced laser therapies.

As a performance-driven scale-up, the company is dedicated to solving the complex operational and marketing challenges faced by modern aesthetic practices. The team fosters a results-oriented and innovative environment, focusing on delivering measurable impact through structured systems rather than generic advertising. This is an opportunity to join a strategic, forward-thinking organization that is redefining how premium health and beauty businesses scale their operations in a competitive international market.

Job Summary

Most agencies stop caring once the lead lands. We don't. At this company, we recognize that the gap between an interested lead and a paid deposit is where high-ticket aesthetics is truly won or lost. We have world-class lead generation and robust systems; what we need is a dedicated CRO Lead to own the "click-to-booking" journey. You will turn anecdotal feedback into a systematic conversion machine, acting as the bridge between creative intelligence and bottom-line results. If you thrive on watching session recordings, debunking objections, and proving your hypotheses with hard evidence, this is the role where you can truly own the funnel.

Requirements


Demonstrable CRO Experience: A proven track record of running tests, predicting outcomes, and measuring results
High-Ticket Lead Gen Expertise: Experience optimizing landing pages and forms specifically for high-intent, considered purchases
Behavioral Tool Proficiency: Mastery of session recording tools, heatmaps, and funnel analytics to draw qualitative conclusions
Cultural Alignment: Strong understanding of the American consumer mindset, particularly regarding trust, proof, and high-ticket service expectations
Timezone Alignment: Ability to work primarily within USA business hours to collaborate effectively with the team and partner clinics
Data-Driven Communication: Expert written and verbal English with the ability to present data-backed findings confidently to stakeholders
Nice-to-Haves
Industry Background: Previous experience in MedSpa, aesthetics, or healthcare lead generation
Platform Knowledge: Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)
Sales Insight: Experience reviewing sales or setter calls to extract conversion bottlenecks
Portfolio Management: Experience managing conversion performance across 20+ simultaneous client accounts


Benefits

🌎 Fully remote work environment

🚀 Career growth opportunities in a fast-scaling agency

🎯 Performance-based incentives

📈 Long-term stability and high-level strategic ownership

🧠 Collaborative culture with top-tier marketing talent

description:
About the job

¿Estás buscando profundizar tus habilidades técnicas y construir una base sólida para una carrera actuarial? ¿Disfrutas trabajar con datos, resolver problemas y apoyar a un equipo que brinda conocimientos a los clientes? Este podría ser tu próximo paso.

Este es un puesto híbrido basado en nuestra oficina de Ciudad de México. Disfrutarás de la flexibilidad de trabajar tanto de manera remota como presencial después de un período inicial de capacitación, mientras construyes conexiones con colegas globales en un espacio dinámico en nuestro Centro de Capacidades Globales (GCC).

Cómo será tu día a día

Desempeñarás un papel clave en la preparación, validación y organización de datos que respaldan nuestras herramientas actuariales, modelos y entregables para los clientes. Trabajando estrechamente con colegas actuariales senior, ayudarás a garantizar que los datos que alimentan nuestros análisis sean precisos, completos y estén listos para usar.

Algunas De Tus Responsabilidades Incluirán


Importar y organizar grandes conjuntos de datos de múltiples fuentes (archivos de censo, reclamaciones, primas, etc.)
Realizar limpieza, validación y conciliación de datos para asegurar la calidad de los mismos.
Preparar archivos de entrada estandarizados para modelos y herramientas actuariales, siguiendo plantillas y requisitos de datos establecidos.
Utilizar funciones avanzadas en MS Excel para transformar datos crudos en entradas estructuradas y listas para el modelo.
Ayudar con las verificaciones de calidad en datos y exhibiciones utilizadas en informes financieros y materiales para clientes.


Cómo esta oportunidad es diferente

Este puesto está diseñado como un sólido punto de entrada técnico al trabajo actuarial en salud, con un fuerte enfoque en datos, la base de todo análisis actuarial. Obtendrás experiencia práctica trabajando con los mismos conjuntos de datos y herramientas que utilizan los actuarios senior para fijación de precios, reservas e informes financieros, aprendiendo cómo los datos de alta calidad fluyen en modelos como los de “Incurred But Not Paid” (IBNP), modelos de Valor Actuarial y herramientas de precios.

Habilidades y experiencia que te llevarán al éxito

Estamos buscando candidatos que sean detallistas, curiosos y motivados para construir una carrera en trabajo actuarial y basado en datos.

Experiencia


Generalmente de 1 a 3 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, informes, apoyo actuarial o un rol cuantitativo relacionado.
Dominio de Microsoft Excel, incluidas fórmulas, búsquedas, limpieza de datos y tablas dinámicas básicas.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal para explicar problemas y hallazgos de datos claramente.
Fluidez en inglés a nivel B2-C1 (o equivalente) es requerida para trabajar eficazmente con equipos globales.


Educación

Título universitario en Ciencias Actuariales, Matemáticas, Estadística o campos relacionados.
