description:
About the job

Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $607,000 - $789,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $607,000 - $744,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

We are posting this role as Customer Support Specialist, which is the more standard market title. At Edstruments, our customers are called partners, so internally you will hear this role referred to as Partner Support Specialist (or PSS). Same role, different vocabulary. We default to “partner” language throughout our team, our tools, and our documentation, and your day-to-day will use that language too.




About Edstruments

Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.




Role Overview

The Customer Support Specialist will be the first line of defense on chat and email, helping our partners resolve technical and administrative issues, ensuring smooth communication, and troubleshooting challenges. You will manage incoming chats and emails, track tickets, and ensure partner needs are met efficiently. The role also involves vendor outreach, administrative tasks, and product setup for new clients. You handle most questions yourself by checking our documentation and Slack history first, escalate with what you have already tried and found, and keep partners and teammates updated without being asked. Over time, you will have opportunities to take on more advanced roles as you grow with the company.




Key Responsibilities
First-Contact Resolution: Independently troubleshoot and resolve partner inquiries, checking our documentation and Slack history before escalating, ensuring a 70% first-contact resolution rate for partner inquiries. [Within the first 3 months of joining].
Response Time: Respond to partner inquiries within 5 minutes for chats and 3 hours for emails during your regular business hours. [Ongoing].
Ticket Management: Manage support conversations in Intercom and track work on Trello cards to ensure all issues are resolved promptly. Close 90% of inquiries within 48 hours.
Client Onboarding: Assist with the initial setup of our systems when a new client onboards to ensure successful data syncs with a 90% success rate.
Vendor Outreach & Admin: Provide support with vendor outreach and administrative tasks, as needed. [Ongoing].
Collaboration: Work with the Partner Success and Product teams to communicate findings from partner interactions and ensure partner needs are addressed. [Ongoing].




Key Outcomes
Achieve a 4.5/5 satisfaction rating or higher for partner support interactions (chat/email).
Close 90% of support tickets within 48 hours of receiving inquiries.
Ensure 90% success rate for assigned client onboarding tasks.
Own inquiries end to end: resolve the majority independently and close the loop with the partner, escalating only with clear context on what you’ve already tried.




Must-Have Qualifications
2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a related role.
Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn and troubleshoot software-related issues.
Experience with support and ticketing tools (Intercom, HubSpot, or similar) and a proven ability to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information clearly to non-technical users.
Strong attention to detail and excellent time management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to research answers, draft partner replies, and work faster.
Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision: you find answers, make a judgment call, and proactively communicate status without being chased.




Preferred Qualifications
Experience in customer support for SaaS platforms or other software solutions.
Experience in vendor outreach or administrative tasks.
Background in the education or nonprofit sectors is a plus.




Logistical Notes

This is a 100% remote role with a flexible start date, but availability during US Pacific Time business hours (8 am - 5 pm) is required.

Edstruments does not and will not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender orientation, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status in any of its hiring decisions or other activities.




Compensation

The salary range for this role is $1,000-$2,000/month.

Why Edstruments?

Mission-Driven Work: Work with a team passionate about improving financial processes for K12 and nonprofit organizations.
Growth Opportunities: We offer potential for career advancement and development as the company scales.
Remote Flexibility: Join a 100% remote team with a flexible start date.

About the job

Ready to take your career global?

Marketing in Global Payments is more than campaigns and content. It is how we shape perception, build trust, and drive growth across a fast-moving global payments landscape. As a Marketing Specialist you will help bring our products, services, and channels to life in ways that connect with clients and unlock new opportunities.

What You’ll Own


 Shape marketing programs that drive measurable growth, turning strategic goals into campaigns and initiatives that strengthen brand awareness and commercial performance across products and channels
 Create compelling marketing content and messaging that elevates our brand, ensuring consistency across digital, social, and promotional channels while improving engagement and market perception
 Influence go-to-market strategy for products and launches, translating business direction into clear positioning and marketing plans that support successful adoption and growth
 Drive execution of integrated marketing initiatives across teams and partners, ensuring alignment between sales, product, and communications to deliver consistent market impact
 Strengthen how we measure marketing performance and return on investment (ROI), using insights to improve campaign effectiveness, budget use, and future decision making
 Build trusted relationships across internal teams and external partners, improving collaboration and unlocking more effective marketing delivery across complex initiatives
 Improve marketing processes and execution standards, identifying smarter ways of working that increase speed, consistency, and quality of output across campaigns
 Support strategic growth priorities through clear, audience-focused storytelling, helping translate business goals into communications that influence customers and stakeholders


What You Bring


 Experience in marketing, advertising, or digital communications, with the ability to turn strategy into clear, high-impact execution
 Strong understanding of marketing channels and campaign delivery, including digital, social, email, and content-led programs
 Ability to simplify complex ideas into clear, engaging messaging, tailored for different audiences and business needs
 Experience working with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, and external partners in a fast-paced environment
 Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to measure marketing performance and use insights to improve outcomes
 Confidence working with marketing tools and platforms, such as automation tools and CRM systems (for example Salesforce or similar platforms)
 A proactive, curious approach, with a focus on improving how marketing creates impact and drives growth


It’s a bonus if you have


 Experience in the payments or financial services industry, with an understanding of how products and clients operate in this space
 Exposure to marketing agencies or client services environments, where you’ve managed multiple stakeholders and fast-moving priorities
 Familiarity with marketing automation or CRM-driven campaign execution, helping you connect data, targeting, and performance more effectively


About The Team

You will join a collaborative marketing team working closely with sales, product, and business leaders. Together, you will turn strategy into clear, compelling storytelling that strengthens our brand and supports growth across regions and channels. Every idea you shape helps move Global Payments forward in a competitive, evolving market.

This is your opportunity to influence how we show up in the market, strengthen how we communicate value, and help scale marketing impact across the business. You will work in an environment that values ownership, creativity, and continuous improvement as we evolve how commerce works globally.

In this role, you’ll own how marketing ideas become real impact, from shaping campaigns and messaging to strengthening brand consistency and measuring what drives results. You’ll create clarity in how we communicate, influence how we position our solutions, and help unlock growth across products, channels, and partnerships.

Our Perks - What We’ll Bring For You

We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life, and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.

A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution

Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business

Access to learning, development and on-the-job experiences that expand your expertise

A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter

Time to give back through community and charity initiatives

A global employee assistance programme to support your wellbeing

Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative — always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

Diversity and EEO Statements 

Global Payments is an organization that stands against racism, intolerance and injustice in all its forms — one that respects, honors and celebrates the diversity of our team members and the differences among us. Our commitment to fostering a company culture that values and respects Inclusion and Diversity is steadfast. Standing together as one company, we will continue to work to drive positive change for the communities in which we live and work and stamp out injustice.

Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. Global Payments provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by law. Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.

title: Global Brand Operations Specialist
description:
About the job

一、岗位职责（Position Summary）

我们正在寻找一位兼具品牌意识与数字营销能力的品牌运营专员，负责品牌内容运营、品牌资产建设及数字营销项目执行，持续提升品牌影响力、专业信任度及市场获客能力。

该岗位前期将参与海外品牌及数字化运营项目，在实践中系统学习品牌管理、数字营销及项目运营，并逐步承担品牌策划、品牌资产建设及重点品牌项目运营工作。

________________________________________

二、岗位职责（Key Responsibilities）

（一）品牌内容运营与品牌资产建设（约35%）

负责品牌内容策划、运营及品牌资产沉淀，包括但不限于：

• 产品价值主张（Value Proposition）梳理与内容表达 

• 产品介绍、宣传资料、销售工具包策划与优化 

• 临床案例、专家观点、白皮书等专业内容整理 

• 官网文章、行业文章、品牌宣传内容策划 

• 品牌信息屋（Brand Messaging）、FAQ、品牌内容库建设 

• 持续沉淀品牌案例、品牌故事及可复用品牌资产 

能够将专业医疗内容转化为客户易理解、易传播、具有品牌价值的内容。

________________________________________

（二）品牌数字化运营（约30%）

负责品牌数字化运营及基础营销工作，包括：

• 官网内容运营及维护 

• SEO（Search Engine Optimization） 

• GEO（Generative Engine Optimization） 

• AI搜索内容优化 

• Landing Page内容优化 

• 网站数据分析及持续优化 

协助提升品牌官网流量、搜索排名及内容质量。

________________________________________

（三）品牌传播项目运营（约20%）

参与重点品牌项目的整体传播与运营，包括：

• 新品上市 

• 学术合作 

• 临床案例 

• KOL合作 

• 公益项目 

• 展会传播 

• 品牌Campaign 

协助制定传播计划，完成内容策划、项目执行、传播复盘及品牌资产沉淀。

________________________________________

（四）数字营销与增长支持（约15%）

协助开展数字营销项目，包括：

• Google Ads 

• Meta Ads 

• LinkedIn Ads 

参与广告素材准备、数据监测、Lead Tracking、MQL统计及营销数据分析，持续提升市场获客效率。

________________________________________

三、任职要求（Requirements）

教育背景

本科及以上学历。

市场营销、品牌传播、新闻传媒、英语、国际商务、生物医学工程、口腔医学、医疗器械等相关专业优先。

________________________________________

工作经验

2年以上品牌运营、数字营销、品牌传播或海外市场相关工作经验。

具有以下行业经验优先：

• 医疗器械 

• 数字化口腔 

• 生物科技 

• 医疗健康 

• SaaS 

• 高科技ToB企业 

________________________________________

专业能力

能够独立完成品牌内容策划及英文内容输出。

熟悉以下部分工作内容：

• 官网运营 

• SEO / GEO 

• 社交媒体运营 

• 内容营销 

• Google Analytics 

• Search Console 

了解Google Ads、Meta Ads、LinkedIn Ads等数字营销工具。

英语可作为工作语言，具备良好的英文写作能力。

________________________________________

四、我们更看重以下能力（Core Competencies）

1、品牌意识（★★★★★）

能够理解品牌定位及品牌价值。

能够判断内容是否符合品牌调性。

能够从客户视角思考品牌传播，而不仅仅完成内容制作。

________________________________________

2、主动思考能力（★★★★★）

能够主动发现品牌传播机会。

能够主动提出品牌传播建议。

能够围绕业务目标思考品牌价值，而不是等待任务安排。

________________________________________

3、Storytelling能力（★★★★☆）

能够将专业技术、产品特点、临床数据及案例转化为客户易理解、愿传播的品牌内容。

________________________________________

4、数字营销能力（★★★★☆）

具备一定数字营销思维。

能够根据数据不断优化内容及运营策略。

________________________________________

5、项目管理能力（★★★★☆）

能够同时推进多个项目。

具备较好的时间管理、沟通协调及跨部门协同能力。

能够主动推进项目，而不是等待安排。

________________________________________

五、加分项（Nice to Have）

具有海外留学或海外工作经历。

熟悉欧美市场文化及商业环境。

具有Google Ads、Meta Ads、LinkedIn Ads实操经验。

具有Canva、Figma、Adobe系列设计工具或视频剪辑工具使用经验。

熟悉ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Midjourney等AI工具，并能够应用于品牌内容生产及数字营销。

具有品牌战略、品牌咨询、品牌管理相关学习经历或项目经验。

具有Vibe Coding、No-code工具使用经验者优先。

________________________________________

六、我们希望你成为这样的人

我们寻找的，不仅是一位能够完成品牌运营工作的同事，更是一位具有品牌经营意识和成长潜力的人。

希望你：

• 对品牌建设充满兴趣； 

• 乐于研究客户、市场及产品； 

• 愿意主动发现问题并推动解决； 

• 能够持续沉淀品牌资产，而不仅完成一次传播； 

• 愿意通过实践逐步成长为能够独立负责品牌板块的品牌经理。 

________________________________________

七、你将在这里获得什么

• 深度参与全球品牌建设及数字化营销实践； 

• 系统学习品牌战略、品牌管理及品牌运营方法论； 

• 与产品、销售、研发、学术及国际团队紧密协作； 

• 参与国内外重点品牌项目及新品上市；

Role Overview




We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Roof Drafter to join our growing team and help us build the future, one roof at a time. In this role, you will translate architectural blueprints and field measurements into precise, actionable roofing plans. description:
About the job

Job Description

Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses. This includes the management of our relationships across the globe with both the millions of merchants who accept American Express, as well as our partners in countries and territories that deliver card acceptance, issuance and innovation.

The Marketing Analyst, Digital Platforms & Experiences position is part of the Global Network & Partner Services (GNPS) organization within the Global Merchant & Network Services business group. GNPS drives scale and relevance for the Enterprise by partnering with financial institutions that issue cards and/or acquire merchants on the American Express network.

Through the GNPS partnerships we offer exciting and innovative products and benefits in GNPS countries, improving merchant coverage, strengthening the value proposition, and amplifying the American Express brand.

The GNPS Product & Marketing (P&M) team is a dynamic global marketing organization with responsibility to deliver:


Product & Product Marketing: competitive product strategy and product & campaign delivery in GNPS countries
Partner & Customer Experience: infrastructure for value add and compliant experiences
Brand Management: Protect and engage Amex Brand; increase Amex and GNPS Brand awareness in GNPS countries


The Marketing Analyst, Digital Platforms & Experiences sits within the GNPS Product & Marketing (P&M) team and plays a critical role in bringing the best of the American Express Network to customers around the world through digital solutions. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Digital Platforms and Experiences, the successful candidate will have knowledge of digital platform and product delivery, as well as partner and stakeholder management within complex, cross-functional environments.

Responsibilities


Manage the end-to-end delivery of strategically important solution with GNS partners, including integrations with Enterprise Loyalty platforms
Coordinate with external partners (banks, technology vendors), to ensure deliverables are completed on time, to standard, and in alignment with business goals
Partner with vendors to create features and capabilities which support strategic business priorities
Oversee application management processes in compliance with American Express technology, governance and risk requirements


Qualifications


Motivated to learn about the broader payments industry
Interest in emerging technology solutions
Driven to achieve outcomes and deliver positive change
Able to lead projects and workstreams
Skilled at managing stakeholders
Clear communicator
Advanced English level


About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

title: Nights Transportation Assistant
description:
About the job

Position Description

Nights Transportation Assistant | Remote | Full-Time | Monday – Friday, 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM CST

White Star Logistics is growing rapidly and remains committed to sustained expansion. As part of this growth, the organization has set a milestone of delivering 1,000,000 loads. Achieving this goal requires a Nights Transportation Assistant capable of coordinating cross-border freight and maintaining the carrier capacity and documentation accuracy needed to scale accordingly.

This position carries significant coordination and compliance responsibility: preparing and auditing cross-border documentation, dispatching loads with consistency, and serving as the go-to connection between carriers, customers, and internal teams overnight. This role is intended for a motivated, detail-driven transportation professional, someone who will help protect the carrier network and compliance standing necessary for the company's next phase of growth.

Candidates with a demonstrated record of managing cross-border freight documentation and thriving in a fast-paced, overnight environment, and who are ready to take ownership as part of a growing team, are encouraged to apply.

We Are Looking For:

• 3 years of freight brokerage experience – Candidates know cross-border freight operations thoroughly and bring a proven track record.

• Bilingual fluency – Fluent in English and Spanish, both verbal and written.

• Documentation expertise – Hands-on knowledge of Carta Porte, DODA, and related customs documents.

• Multitasking skills – Thrives when managing multiple active loads and exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• TMS platform experience – Comfortable maintaining accurate, audit-ready shipment records.

• Strong communicator – Clear, confident, and able to build trusted carrier relationships.

• Independent operator – Comfortable owning the overnight shift with no one else online.

What You Will Do:

• Coordinate and dispatch loads – Intra-U.S. and cross-border, including drayage, transloads, and door-to-door moves, with sound carrier sourcing, rate negotiation, and load coverage.

• Prepare and audit documentation – BOLs, Carta Porte, DODA, Commercial Invoices, and customs entries, catching issues before they become a customs hold.

• Manage overnight exceptions – Serve as the overnight point of contact for internal teams, carriers, and clients, managing detentions, delays, and escalations with confidence.

• Build and protect carrier capacity – Maintain trusted carrier relationships to protect coverage during peak or disrupted lanes.

• Maintain TMS records – Keep shipment records accurate, current, and audit-ready.

• Track U.S. domestic freight – Monitor and communicate shipment status across U.S. domestic freight alongside cross-border loads.

Qualifications:

• 1–3 years of 3PL brokerage experience – Required, with a proven track record in the industry.

• Bilingual fluency – Ability to communicate in English and Spanish via phone and written documentation.

• Cross-border documentation expertise – Carta Porte, DODA, and related customs entries.

• Strong work ethic – Drive and focus to own the shift independently overnight.

• TMS platform experience – Prior hands-on use of a transportation management system preferred.

• Freight mode experience – FTL, intermodal, or drayage preferred.

Core Values:

• Own It – We take responsibility for outcomes, not excuses.

• Find a Way – We are resourceful, resilient, and solution-oriented.

• Protect All Stakeholders – We protect customers, employees, carriers, vendors, and the company.

• Communicate Early – We communicate proactively, particularly when issues arise.

• Excellence Through Growth – We continuously pursue improvement across our team, ourselves, and our service.

• Develop People – We believe our greatest contribution is helping people realize more than they believed possible.

Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

description:
About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Customer Impact sits at the intersection of customer experience and engineering accountability. As an Associate on the Bug Review team, you will investigate flawed user experiences, verify and escalate bugs through structured cross-functional workflows, and drive visibility on open platform issues so resolution doesn't stall. Bug Review is the triage layer to separate signal from noise, ensuring Engineering receives verified, credible escalations instead of a flood of unvetted reports.

The Bug Review Associate is the front line of that triage layer. You'll investigate incoming bug reports, verify reproducibility and impact, and manage tickets through their Jira lifecycle, turning raw customer signal into evidence Engineering can act on. This is a high-volume, detail-driven role: you'll work a defined queue of tickets each day, applying consistent investigation standards so that what reaches our Sr. Specialists and Engineering is already vetted.

Because many of the reports you're investigating come from riders or drivers who had a genuinely bad experience, this role also requires direct, empathetic communication with customers. You're often the person following up on an issue that upset them.

This role is part of a new HQ Associate model based in Mexico, built to bring bug review in-house with tighter tooling access, stronger quality control, and closer partnership with the broader teams. Associates report directly into the Customer Impact structure.

Investigate and triage incoming bug reports against defined criteria (reproducibility, severity, customer impact)

About the job

Job Description

About GMNS Products (formerly, Network & Acquirer Solutions)

GMNS Products (formerly, NAS) is leading the effort to modernize our acquiring ecosystem and strengthen regulatory and controls across GMNS. GMNS Products is leading the modernization of American Express’s acquiring ecosystem while strengthening regulatory, control, and compliance execution across GMNS. As part of this transformation, we are standing up a centralized PMO to manage a high volume of control and compliance mandates and convert fragmented demand into a disciplined, transparent operating model.

Responsibilities

Role Summary

Reporting to the Director, Digital Product Operations — PMO, Mandates, the Manager, Digital Product Operations will play a critical role in operating and scaling the mandates PMO. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day intake, analysis, tracking, and reporting of control and compliance requests, ensuring high data quality, execution discipline, and stakeholder transparency.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role requiring strong organizational skills, attention to detail, comfort with technical and regulatory requirements, and the ability to partner effectively across Product, Technology, Compliance, Control Management, and Delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

Mandates Intake & Operational Management


 Manage the day-to-day intake and triage of incoming mandates (control, compliance, regulatory, and high-priority asks).
 Ensure requests are properly documented, categorized, and routed using established PMO standards.
 Maintain a high-quality, up-to-date inventory of mandates, owners, dependencies, and status.


Prioritization & Execution Support


 Apply defined prioritization frameworks to score and sequence requests.
 Support the Director in preparing recommended delivery waves and capacity views.
 Track progress against agreed timelines and surface risks, delays, or conflicts early.


Reporting & Governance


 Own recurring operational reporting, including dashboards, trackers, and status summaries.
 Prepare clear, accurate materials for leadership reviews, Steering Committees, and working sessions.
 Maintain the PMO “single source of truth” for mandate status, milestones, and KPIs.


Cross-Functional Coordination


 Partner closely with Compliance, Control Management, Legal, Product, Technology, and Delivery teams to validate requirements and confirm execution plans.
 Coordinate across teams to resolve data gaps, clarify ownership, and manage handoffs.
 Support escalation management by ensuring issues are clearly framed and evidence-based.


Process & Tooling Enablement


 Help implement and refine PMO tools, templates, and workflows.
 Identify process inefficiencies and recommend pragmatic improvements.
 Ensure adherence to PMO standards and operating rhythms.


Continuous Improvement


 Track throughput, cycle times, and backlog trends.
 Support retrospectives and lessons-learned exercises.
 Contribute ideas to improve predictability, transparency, and stakeholder experience.


Qualifications

Required Experience & Skills


 Strong experience in program, project, or operations management within a complex, matrixed organization.
 Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume workstreams with precision and discipline.
 Comfortable working with control, compliance, regulatory, or risk-driven initiatives.
 High attention to detail with strong organizational and follow-through skills.
 Solid technical fluency — able to understand requirements, dependencies, and delivery constraints.
 PowerPoint and Excel skills; able to produce clean, accurate reporting materials.
 Effective communicator who can work confidently with cross-functional partners.


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in payments, merchant acquiring, or financial services.
 Familiarity with PMO, portfolio, or workflow tools (e.g., JIRA, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, or similar).
 Prior experience supporting senior leaders or PMOs in a governance or operations role.


Behavioral Traits & Culture Fit


 Execution-oriented and reliable; delivers consistently and accurately.
 Comfortable operating in ambiguity while following defined frameworks.
 Collaborative, responsive, and service-minded toward stakeholders.
 Proactive problem solver with a continuous-improvement mindset.


About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:


Competitive base salaries

About the job

About Rankist

Rankist is a Swiss Shopify growth agency. We work exclusively with brands in regulated and complex verticals: CBD, hemp, pouches, supplements, and other categories that most agencies stay away from. Our team of 15+ specialists covers SEO, CRO, Klaviyo email marketing, paid ads, and creative, all on Shopify.

We are now hiring a Paid Ads Specialist (Paid Social & Paid Search) to own Meta and Google Ads for our client portfolio.

The Role

You will run paid social and paid search campaigns — Meta Ads and Google Ads — across our client portfolio. You know the policies, you know the workarounds inside the rules, and you know how to keep accounts alive while spending real budget profitably.

Ad Platforms

Meta — must-have
Google Ads — important
Snapchat Ads & TikTok Ads — important
Criteo & Natives — a big plus

We run ads across Meta, Google Ads, Snapchat, TikTok, Criteo, Natives, and Mantis Ads.

What you will do

Plan, launch, and scale paid social and paid search campaigns (Meta and Google Ads) for Shopify brands in regulated verticals
Build compliant ad accounts and creative that pass review without compromising performance
Manage Business Manager structures, domain verification, pixel and Conversions API setup, and feed compliance for Google Shopping where applicable
Recover and reinstate disabled accounts
Communicate directly with clients in clean, professional English
Work closely with our designers and Klaviyo team so paid traffic and email work as one funnel
Report on ROAS, CAC, blended performance, and incrementality in language clients understand

What we need from you

Minimum 3 years hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads, with a meaningful portion of that spend in regulated categories (CBD, nicotine, supplements, gambling, crypto, or similar)
Deep knowledge of Meta Business Manager, Google Ads policy, account warm-up strategies, agency ad accounts, and reinstatement processes
Strong written and spoken English — you will talk to clients directly
Comfortable working independently and owning the outcomes of your accounts
Available during European business hours for at least 4 hours of overlap per day

Nice to have

Proven track record of scaling at least one brand past EUR 100k per month in ad spend or revenue while staying profitable
Experience with Shopify and Klaviyo
Understanding of Conversions API setup via Shopify or GTM server-side
Experience with TikTok Ads or Reddit Ads in regulated verticals
German, Spanish, or Portuguese language skills

Compensation

Base salary depends on your experience, location, and the level of ownership you can take from day one. We pay fairly and we pay on time, every time. On top of base, we run a performance bonus tied to client results: the better your accounts perform, the more you earn. We discuss exact numbers in the second interview once we understand each other's expectations.

What you get

Full-time remote position. Work from anywhere in the world.
Direct work with the founder and a small senior team
No micromanagement. Real ownership of accounts and budgets.
Long-term position. We are looking for someone who grows with us for years.

Send your application to hello@rankist.ch with the subject line "Paid Ads Specialist Application".

A short summary of one regulated vertical campaign you ran. What was the product, what was the ad spend, what was the result, and what was the hardest policy or compliance problem you solved.
Your monthly salary expectation in EUR.

About the job

On behalf of our joint venture company




We are assisting our joint venture partner in filling this role. Please note that the joint venture company will manage all interviews and make the final hiring decision.




Job Responsibilities

1. Manage daily store operations across cross-border e-commerce platforms, including Mercado Libre, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Walmart.




2. Conduct product listing creation and optimization (title, keywords, images, product descriptions, etc.) to continuously improve product exposure and conversion rates. Possess solid awareness and practical capabilities in keyword layout and conversion improvement.




3. Oversee the entire order fulfillment process, including shipment arrangement, logistics tracking, and exception handling, to ensure timely and accurate order delivery.




4. Resolve after-sales issues such as customer inquiries, complaints, returns and exchanges, so as to improve store ratings and overall customer satisfaction.




5. Regularly analyze sales performance, traffic data and competitor dynamics, and propose targeted operational optimization strategies.

7. Collaborate closely with warehouse, logistics and supply chain teams to ensure stable inventory management and smooth shipment operations.




8. Keep updated with the latest platform rules and policy changes, adjust operational strategies timely, and effectively reduce platform violation risks.




9. Learn and proficiently operate the company’s ERP system (professional training will be provided by the company).




Job Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of cross-border e-commerce operation experience, familiar with the operation procedures of Mercado Libre, Amazon, TikTok Shop or Walmart. Candidates with Mercado Libre and Amazon operation experience are highly preferred.




2. Familiar with the full-cycle e-commerce operation workflow, including product listing, pricing strategy, inventory management, order delivery, after-sales service and return processing.




3. Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in International Trade, Marketing or related fields are preferred.




Technical & Soft Skills

1. Proficient in Excel (VLOOKUP, PivotTables and other common functions) with basic data analysis capabilities to support operational decision-making.




2. Skilled in using Canva or similar graphic design tools for basic image editing and product picture optimization.




3. English language proficiency is a plus.

description:
About the job

Posición presencial en Guadalajara.




En Métrica Móvil estamos armando el motor comercial de la operación en occidente desde cero. Ya tenemos producto (telemetría, videotelemática y soluciones de gestión de flotas), y ahora falta la pieza que abre cuentas, empuja el deal y lo cierra en el occidente del país. Ese eres tú.




Al inicio no vas a esperar a que te lleguen leads servidos. Vas a salir a buscar negocio con tus propios contactos y tu propia lectura del mercado regional, mientras la maquinaria de SDR termina de arrancar en los próximos meses. Es una posición para alguien que sabe abrir puertas, no solo administrar un inbox.




¿Por qué buscamos este rol?

La operación en occidente creció y ya no basta con atender lo que cae. Se separó la parte gerencial y administrativa (que hoy tiene otra persona) para dejar este puesto 100% enfocado en desarrollo de negocio y cierre. Es un rol comercial puro, sin la carga gerencial que tenía antes: tú vendes, tú cierras, tú haces crecer la cartera de la región.




¿Qué hay para ti?

Vas a tener ownership real de la cartera de occidente. No entras a heredar un pipeline lleno ni a ejecutar el playbook de alguien más; entras a construirlo. Eso significa que tu criterio pesa: cómo priorizas cuentas, cómo abres una flotillera, cómo estructuras una propuesta de telemetría, es tuyo.

Vas a vender un portafolio sólido (telemetría, videotelemática, hardware y software de gestión de flotas) en una empresa estructurada, no en un experimento. Si vienes de un player grande donde vendías el mismo tipo de solución pero con menos margen de maniobra, aquí te vas a remangar y vas a ver el impacto de tu trabajo directamente en la cuenta.

Y trabajas de la mano del SDR desde el día uno: conforme esa parte madure, vas a recibir oportunidades calificadas mientras tú te concentras en cerrar. Es una posición pensada para que crezcas con la operación regional.

Prospectar y abrir cuentas B2B en la región occidente.
Vender telemetría, videotelemática y soluciones de gestión de flotas a áreas de logística y transporte.
Estructurar propuestas y cerrar negocio de punta a punta, del primer contacto a la firma.
Trabajar en conjunto con el SDR, dando seguimiento y convirtiendo las oportunidades que se generen.

Identificar y calificar empresas flotilleras y compañías con operación logística relevante en la región.




Equipo y reportes

Reportarás directamente a la dirección de la operación. Trabajarás de cerca con el área administrativa y operativa que da soporte a la gestión de cuentas. Es un equipo comercial en formación, así que tu forma de trabajar deja huella en cómo se construye.

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico's Media Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Brand Specialist, you'll own selected brands to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Specialist, Customer Success

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Specialist, Customer Success for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues 
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization 
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


* Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

¿Por qué unirte a IGNO?

No solo vendemos software; impulsamos la transformación digital real. En IGNO, te integrarás a un equipo de expertos certificados donde tu impacto trasciende las cuotas: ayudarás a empresas a navegar su evolución tecnológica, optimizando procesos y generando un ROI medible. Active Prospecting & Cold Outreach: LinkedIn, correo, llamadas, referidos, eventos.

No es gestionar el proyecto: la ejecución es de Delivery.

CARRERAS PARA SONREÍR

Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea.

description:
About the job

Embajador Universitario - Mexico¿Qué es Nodi?

Nodi es una plataforma de reclutamiento impulsada por inteligencia artificial que ayuda a empresas y talento a conectarse de una forma más eficiente. 

Para las empresas, Nodi funciona como un sistema de IA para reclutamiento end-to-end: automatiza la búsqueda de candidatos, la evaluación de talento y la gestión del proceso de contratación, permitiendo que los equipos encuentren y contraten mejores perfiles de forma más rápida. 

Para candidatos, Nodi funciona como un agente de carrera impulsado por IA. El agente entiende el perfil, experiencia, intereses y objetivos profesionales de cada persona, y busca oportunidades relevantes en el mercado según sus preferencias. En lugar de pasar horas buscando empleos y postulando a oportunidades que no encajan, Nodi ayuda a cada persona a descubrir las oportunidades correctas y la acompaña durante su desarrollo profesional con recomendaciones y feedback para mejorar su perfil. 

Nuestra misión es conectar al mejor talento con las mejores oportunidades profesionales.

¿Qué es un Embajador Nodi?

Un Embajador Nodi es la cara de Nodi dentro de su universidad: la persona que acerca la plataforma a sus compañeros y construye una comunidad de talento alrededor de nuevas oportunidades profesionales. No es solo compartir un link; es ayudar a que más estudiantes conozcan herramientas que les permitan descubrir oportunidades, mejorar sus perfiles profesionales y conectarse con empresas que buscan talento. Es, además, un acelerador de carrera para quien lo asume: acceso directo a fundadores y reclutadores, una credencial real para su CV y la experiencia de liderar un proyecto de principio a fin.

¿A quién buscamos?

Buscamos estudiantes universitarios con iniciativa, curiosidad y ganas de construir algo desde cero. Alguien que no espera a que las oportunidades lleguen, sino que busca cómo crearlas para sí mismo y para su comunidad. Idealmente, eres alguien que:

Es estudiante universitario activo, preferiblemente de una carrera relacionada con tecnología, ingeniería, ciencias, negocios o áreas afines.
Tiene interés por startups, tecnología e innovación, y curiosidad por conocer cómo se están construyendo las empresas del futuro.
Es una persona muy proactiva: identifica oportunidades, propone ideas y ejecuta sin necesitar que le digan cada paso.
Tiene facilidad para conectar con personas y construir comunidades dentro de su universidad.
Está motivado por ayudar a otros estudiantes a encontrar mejores oportunidades profesionales.
Tiene buena comunicación y presencia en redes, grupos estudiantiles o comunidades universitarias.



No buscamos únicamente a alguien con muchos seguidores o experiencia previa. Buscamos a alguien con energía, iniciativa y ganas de hacer que las cosas pasen.

¿Qué hace un Embajador Nodi?

Como Embajador Nodi, serás responsable de construir presencia y comunidad de Nodi dentro de tu universidad. Tus principales responsabilidades serán:

Organizar al menos 1 activación por semestre en tu universidad: puede ser un taller, charla, evento con estudiantes, colaboración con un club, alianza con una organización estudiantil u otra iniciativa que acerque Nodi a más talento.
Compartir oportunidades y contenido de Nodi: distribuir materiales, publicaciones y recursos que te proporcionaremos a través de grupos universitarios, redes sociales y comunidades relevantes.
Conectar estudiantes con oportunidades profesionales: ayudar a que más estudiantes creen su perfil en Nodi y descubran oportunidades laborales relevantes para sus objetivos de carrera.
Identificar comunidades clave dentro del campus: conectar con clubes, profesores, centros de estudiantes y espacios donde se reúnen estudiantes interesados en tecnología, innovación y desarrollo profesional.
Recolectar feedback de estudiantes: entender qué necesitan los jóvenes profesionales, qué oportunidades buscan y cómo podemos mejorar la experiencia en Nodi.
Participar en reuniones mensuales con el equipo de Nodi y otros embajadores: compartir avances, recibir apoyo y coordinar nuevas iniciativas.



Tu objetivo será simple: ayudar a que más estudiantes de tu universidad tengan acceso a mejores oportunidades profesionales y las herramientas necesarias para avanzar en sus carreras.

IncentivosIncentivo monetario

Los Embajadores Nodi reciben incentivo monetario por cierto número de candidatos con perfil completo conseguidos a través de su link de referido.

Beneficios para tu carrera

Además del incentivo monetario, ser Embajador Nodi te da acceso a cosas que el dinero no compra y que un estudiante normal no consigue:

Acceso directo a fundadores y reclutadores de la red de Nodi: mentoría, office hours y networking real.
Credencial verificable de "Embajador Nodi" y badge para tu LinkedIn.
Carta de recomendación firmada por el equipo de Nodi para los mejores embajadores.
Trato prioritario para tu propio perfil y para el de tu comunidad dentro de la plataforma.
Experiencia real de liderazgo y marketing liderando la comunidad de Nodi en tu universidad: justo lo que pesa en un CV.
Comunidad privada con el resto de embajadores y el equipo de Nodi.

description:
About the job

Fractional Growth Marketer — Fintech & SaaS

Contract Opportunity | 20 Hours per Week | Remote

Hourly Rate: $28–$42 USD, based on experience







About ATQLeads

ATQLeads is a U.S.-based Go-to-Market execution company that helps organizations design, build, and operate scalable growth systems.

We combine strategy, technology, AI-enabled workflows, and specialized GTM talent to help our clients execute across demand generation, marketing operations, sales development, automation, and revenue growth.




Through the ATQ Certified Operator Network, we identify, evaluate, and deploy experienced GTM professionals into client engagements based on their expertise, industry experience, technical capabilities, availability, and fit for each mission.




Operators in the network may receive access to ongoing client opportunities, ATQ training and certification programs, performance coaching, community support, and potential pathways into longer-term or full-time roles.







The Opportunity

ATQLeads is seeking an experienced Fractional Growth Marketer to support a U.S.-based SaaS company serving the financial services industry.




This is a remote contract engagement requiring approximately 20 hours per week.

The ideal candidate has experience developing and managing multi-channel growth campaigns for B2B SaaS companies, particularly those selling to:

Banks
Credit unions
Financial institutions
Financial services executives
Enterprise and mid-market buying committees




You will be responsible for connecting campaign strategy, messaging, content, nurture, paid media, webinars, landing pages, and performance insights into one coordinated growth system.




This is not a role focused only on producing marketing assets. You will be expected to understand the complete acquisition funnel, identify conversion opportunities, run structured experiments, and continuously improve campaign performance.







Key Responsibilities







Campaign Strategy and Messaging

Own the messaging angle and creative strategy for active campaigns.

Every campaign should launch with:

A clear growth hypothesis
A defined target audience
A relevant value proposition
A coordinated campaign message
Measurable conversion objectives




You will continuously refine messaging based on campaign data, market feedback, and audience engagement.







A/B Testing and Conversion Optimization

Develop and manage an ongoing experimentation program across active campaigns.

You will test elements including:

Subject lines
Value propositions
Calls to action
Creative concepts
Landing-page copy
Audience segments
Campaign offers
Nurture messaging




Winning variants should be documented, applied across channels, and scaled.







Funnel Audit and Ongoing Optimization

Begin the engagement by conducting a complete audit of the existing marketing and sales funnel.

Map conversion performance across the buyer journey, including:

First touch
Content engagement
Landing-page conversion
Lead capture
Nurture engagement
Sales activation
Meeting booked




Identify the most important drop-off points and develop an ongoing optimization plan to improve conversion at each stage.







Nurture Segmentation and Activation

Build tailored nurture journeys for different audience and account segments.

Create activation campaigns that move leads through the sales cycle using relevant content, timely messaging, and clear next steps.




Segmentation may include factors such as:

Institution type
Account size
Buyer persona
Engagement level
Campaign source
Funnel stage
Product interest







Webinar Planning and Execution

Own webinar campaigns from initial concept through post-event conversion.

Responsibilities include:

Topic selection
Audience definition
Registration-page messaging
Email promotion
LinkedIn promotion
Session structure
Speaker coordination
Attendee nurture
Post-event follow-up
Conversion reporting




Webinars should be managed as pipeline-generation programs rather than standalone events.







Content Amplification

Transform executive thought leadership and long-form content into coordinated campaign assets.

Repurpose content across:

Email campaigns
LinkedIn posts
Nurture sequences
Landing pages
Webinar promotions
Campaign messaging
Sales enablement assets




The objective is to maximize the reach, relevance, and commercial impact of every core content asset.







Landing-Page Creation and Optimization

Create dedicated landing pages for priority campaigns, including:

Webinars
Reports and downloadable resources
Product or solution campaigns
Account-based marketing initiatives
Lead-generation offers




Continuously improve landing-page conversion based on traffic, engagement, and conversion data.







Programmatic Display Strategy

Lead the setup and ongoing management of programmatic display campaigns.

Working alongside a GTM Engineer, you may help coordinate the synchronization of CRM contact lists into platforms such as RollWorks or Demandbase.




You will be responsible for:

Defining audience segments
Developing campaign messaging
Directing creative concepts
Coordinating campaign launches
Reviewing engagement data
Ensuring display campaigns reinforce broader GTM initiatives







Cross-Channel Campaign Alignment

Serve as the connective layer across active growth channels.




Ensure that outbound sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, company-page content, nurture tracks, webinars, landing pages, and display advertising communicate a consistent message to the same audience.




Prospects should experience one coordinated campaign across multiple touchpoints rather than a collection of disconnected marketing activities.







Performance Analysis and Feedback Loops

Review campaign performance weekly using available analytics dashboards and CRM insights.

You will be expected to:

Interpret campaign and funnel data
Identify patterns and conversion opportunities
Scale successful campaigns
Adjust underperforming campaigns
Recommend when campaigns should be discontinued
Translate findings into the next campaign cycle




Every campaign should generate learnings that improve future execution.







Required Experience

Demonstrated experience in B2B growth marketing
Experience working with SaaS companies
Experience marketing to banks, credit unions, financial institutions, or similar financial-services audiences
Strong understanding of B2B campaign strategy and demand generation
Experience building and optimizing multi-channel campaigns
Experience with email marketing, nurture programs, webinars, landing pages, and content distribution
Strong understanding of funnel analytics and conversion optimization
Experience developing messaging for complex products and senior business audiences
Ability to work independently in a fractional or consulting environment
Strong written and verbal English communication skills







Preferred Experience

Experience using HubSpot
Experience with account-based marketing
Familiarity with RollWorks, Demandbase, or similar ABM platforms
Experience collaborating with GTM Engineers, sales teams, executives, and content specialists
Experience marketing technology or software solutions to regulated industries
Familiarity with AI-assisted marketing and campaign analysis
Experience working with U.S.-based companies and stakeholders







What Success Looks Like

Within the first phase of the engagement, the Growth Marketer should be able to:

Complete a structured funnel and campaign audit
Establish clear campaign hypotheses and performance benchmarks
Improve alignment across active marketing channels
Launch or optimize segmented nurture journeys
Introduce a consistent A/B testing process
Develop a measurable webinar and content-amplification engine
Identify the highest-impact conversion opportunities
Establish a weekly campaign feedback loop




Longer-term success will be measured through improvements in engagement, conversion rates, qualified pipeline creation, meeting generation, and the overall efficiency of the growth system.







Engagement Details

Engagement Type: Independent contractor
Commitment: Approximately 20 hours per week
Location: Remote

description:
About the job

About Us

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.




The Opportunity

We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Advertising Sales Coordinator to join Skift and drive the day-to-day execution of our sales operations. This role is ideal for an operational professional who thrives on owning repeatable processes and ensuring digital systems run flawlessly. You will take charge of contracts, CRM data, lead management, and pipeline support, building a deep familiarity with Skift's sales engine. If you are a proactive problem-solver looking for a role with a clear path toward greater ownership over time, this is your moment. We are looking for candidates based in LATAM.




Why This Role Matters

Reporting to the Sales Operations Manager, you are the operational backbone of Skift’s Branded Sales team. By owning the day-to-day execution of contracts, lead management, and CRM administration, you free up leadership to focus on high-level strategy, systems, and cross-functional governance. Working closely with Sales, Studio, Product, and Finance, your meticulous attention to detail ensures that our commercial engine runs smoothly, discrepancies are caught early, and revenue is tracked accurately.




Some of What You’ll Do

Contract Administration & Deal Execution

Generate standard sponsorship agreements, insertion orders, and order forms using approved templates, ensuring all information is complete and consistent.
Manage the full signature routing process, follow up on outstanding agreements, and ensure executed documents are properly saved in the contract repository.
Update deal status across HubSpot, Actuals, and prospect trackers, proactively escalating redlines or complex nonstandard terms to the Sales Operations Manager.

CRM & Lead Management

Maintain impeccable data hygiene in HubSpot by completing routine updates, data cleanup, deduplication, and quality checks.
Review and vet inbound leads, assign them to the appropriate sales representatives, and maintain trackers to monitor response status and conversion rates.
Flag high-value, unclear, or suspicious inquiries, and assist with targeted prospect and audience list development.

Pipeline & Digital Campaign Support

Reconcile routine discrepancies between contracts, HubSpot, and internal trackers, actively monitoring deals as they move from verbal agreement to closed-won.
Prepare accurate data for monthly revenue reconciliation, recurring pacing, and campaign reports.
Support digital campaign execution by assisting with creative collection, quality assurance, and proof-of-performance reporting for newsletter and podcast sponsorships.

Process Documentation & Cross-Team Coordination

Document recurring workflows, update instructions as processes evolve, and support the onboarding of new team members.
Coordinate routine operational requests across Sales, Studio, and Finance, constantly identifying repetitive tasks or process gaps that can be improved.




What You’ll Bring

1–3 years of experience in sales coordination, sales operations, or a similar administrative support role.
CRM Fluency: Hands-on experience working in a CRM (HubSpot is highly preferred), with a strong grasp of data cleanup, pipeline management, and lead routing.
Operational Rigor: Exceptional attention to detail and strong spreadsheet skills, allowing you to manage multiple deadlines, complex workflows, and detail-heavy business records simultaneously.
Proactive Communication: Clear written and professional follow-up skills. You are comfortable communicating with clients, recognize when to escalate an issue, and never let details paralyze your execution.
Adaptability: A calm demeanor when priorities shift, a receptiveness to feedback, and the ability to learn systems quickly in a remote work environment.
Bonus: Experience with PandaDoc (or similar e-signature platforms), familiarity with commercial tools (Apollo, Basecamp), or prior exposure to sponsored content, media, and digital advertising.




Success Metrics

Operational Accuracy: Contracts, CRM updates, and lead management are handled accurately, on time, and with pristine attention to detail.
Process Autonomy: Reliable, independent execution of daily sales ops tasks and workflows within the first 6–12 months.
Proactive Problem Solving: Errors, discrepancies, and missing data are caught early and escalated appropriately before they impact the pipeline or billing.
Seamless Collaboration: The establishment of strong, trusted working relationships across the Sales, Studio, Product, and Finance teams.




What We Offer

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.
Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence.
Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment.




How We Work

Skift's culture is diverse, cohesive, and full of people who love what they do and bring the best of themselves to work. We are remote but very connected and caring about each other.




How To Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. PLEASE SEND US A COVER LETTER ALONG WITH YOUR RESUME sharing why you’re interested and how your experience aligns with Skift's mission.

Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world. We welcome applicants from all life experiences and encourage members of traditionally underrepresented backgrounds to apply.




Here’s what you can expect next

If selected to interview, a Skift team member will reach out to schedule next steps.
