description:
About the job

Responsibilities
About the team:
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time 

About the role:
TikTok is seeking Agency Solutions Managers to support our strategic Holdco agency partners and be based out of the Mexico City office. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in digital advertising and a proven ability to drive both operational excellence and commercial growth to unlock new business. The candidate will have operational knowledge of agency dynamics and experience dealing with key stakeholders across media planning, programmatic trading, and digital buying teams. A proven track record in scaling client investment and elevating campaign performance is a must.

Above all, the candidate will have an established track record of building strong relationships across key stakeholders, acting as a dedicated in-house expert and a bridge between the agency and TikTok. The role will involve working cross-functionally with members of the TikTok sales, product, and support organizations with the intent of leading end-to-end client engagement, from technical troubleshooting and campaign activation to education and strategic upselling. You’ll bring a creative mindset, detail-oriented focus, and strategic acumen in your approach to identifying new business opportunities, accelerating product adoption, and building long-term business partnerships.

Responsibilities:
- Identify and drive revenue opportunities: Act as an in-house expert within strategic Holdco agencies to capture new opportunities, seek out strategic partnerships, and proactively hunt for new client briefs to expand the business portfolio. 
- Provide consultative support and elevate trader proficiency: Offer strategic media solutions and campaign optimization guidance, while designing and leading ongoing training sessions to improve media buyer expertise and optimize campaign delivery rates. 
- Deliver strategic insights and execute upselling: Analyze platform data to provide proactive audience targeting recommendations, while creating compelling post-sale propositions to actively recommend premium supply and diverse ad formats. 
- Lead technical troubleshooting: Act as the primary technical liaison for the agency to swiftly resolve campaign delivery issues and creative moderation escalations. 
- Drive product adoption: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to structure and execute operational initiatives focused on accelerating new feature adoption, beta support, and API integrations. 
- Streamline campaign activation: Remove operational friction during the setup and launch phases to ensure the seamless activation of new advertisers. 
- Ensure customer success: Deliver the highest level of sales and operational customer service, providing agile, on-demand support for specialized client requests while keeping clients informed of the latest platform products and developments.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Years of digital advertising and client-facing roles experience.
- Years of Ad Agency experience or similar role.
- Expert knowledge of social media, mobile apps, and digital and mobile marketing.
- Proven experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers and formulate enablement recommendations.
- Excellent oral and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with technical and non-technical business owners with advanced English skills.
- Strong ability to own relationships with programmatic trading desk managers and engage with multiple customer organizational levels to understand business objectives and a team player and collaborator.
- Knowledge of the self-serve platform, auction, and biddable form of digital advertising buying.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in e-commerce, omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing, or online advertising.
- Familiarity with advertising APIs, measurement pixels, and advanced performance marketing metrics.
- Proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales goals and winning the support of key stakeholders.
- Ability to perform well in a rapidly changing environment.
- Passion for TikTok marketing, and up for the challenge of building something from the bottom up.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Work Schedule: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST | Sat–Sun 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM EST

Compensation Range: $1,000 - $1,500 USD/month based on experience

A direct-to-consumer telehealth company in the health optimization space is looking for a Customer Support Concierge to serve as the front line of the patient experience and ensure every customer feels supported from first inquiry through ongoing treatment.

The business delivers modern, physician-guided therapy through a fully remote, tech-enabled model, coordinating directly with pharmacy partners to fulfill patient treatment plans. The team is lean, venture-backed, and building its customer experience function from the ground up.

title: Salesperson
description:
About the job

Remote Closer (Mexico). Inbound Calls Only. $40,000 to $72,000+ USD We're hiring 3 to 4.


What this is: Authorify is a 17-year-old US company that helps American real estate agents win listings with published books. Our webinar funnel puts 5 to 6 booked appointments a day on your calendar. No cold calls and no lead hunting. You show up on Zoom and close annual memberships that average $3,000 USD, mostly paid in full on the call.




What it pays: $2,000 USD a month guaranteed for your first 60 days while you ramp up. After that, $1,000 a month base plus a 6% commission on the cash you collect on paid-in-full sales, moving up to 8% when you convert higher. When you convert 20 of every 100 booked meetings into sales and collect $30,000 or more, you make the higher commission. Payment plans and discounts pay a lower commission percentage (4%), and we tell you that here because we would rather you know everything now than be surprised later. Add a monthly contest and a weekly prize wheel on top of your regular commissions. Realistically, in your first year you should make $40,000 to $50,000 USD, and strong closers track $70,000 and up. We will show our sales teams numbers in the interview.




What it's like to work here: we hold a daily role-play huddle, one proven script that converts about 30% for our best closer, and every call is recorded and scored by AI, both to coach you and to make sure every customer hears the same offer. If you want to freelance your own sales process, this is not your team. If you want a machine that feeds you and coaching that sharpens you, it is.




Who should apply: You should apply if you have 2 or more years of closing high-ticket phone or Zoom sales in fluent English, with verifiable numbers, and are available during US Eastern hours. Mexico City or Guadalajara preferred, but anywhere in Mexico or LATAM will be considered.




How our hiring process works: Apply, and if you are qualified, we will email you a short script within one business day. We will provide easy-to-follow instructions so you can record a 60-second video of yourself delivering the script in English and send it back within 48 hours. No video, no interview. Good videos get scheduled for an interview within one business day. If we like each other, we can have you hired within a week. We move at a closer speed.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Communicate resolutions to end users in English
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from ground up and make a real impact on the future organization 
Be a part of building a brand new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You have business proficiency in written and spoken English 
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving
You might have prior experience in customer service or internal/external user facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you are an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross team collaboration and support
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off; the SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support 
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 
Familiarity with SQL and ability to use template or premade SQL queries as part of investigations



Applicants are personally responsible for obtaining and maintaining the right to work in Mexico.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

Principal Function: The Order Fulfillment Specialist - Customer Success plays a critical role in efficiently receiving, reviewing, and processing all inbound customer purchase orders. This position ensures seamless coordination between customers, sales and internal teams, facilitates accurate order entry and timely fulfillment, and contributes to maintaining organized, compliant, and accurate internal processes.




Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Duties include, but are not limited to:




1. Customer Order Processing

Receive, review, and validate customer purchase orders to ensure accuracy of pricing, contractual terms, delivery requirements, and compliance with internal policies.
Request and coordinate product allocation, confirm material availability, and enter customer orders accurately into internal systems while monitoring order status through fulfillment.
Proactively track and resolve order delays or discrepancies, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Success teams to align on delivery timelines and customer expectations.
Generate and distribute sales order confirmations to customers, ensuring clear communication of order details and fulfillment milestones.
Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

2. Customer Outbound Logistics

Plan, select, and execute all outbound customer shipments, balancing, cost efficiency, service reliability, and customer-specific delivery requirements.
Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.
Identify recurring logistics challenges and contribute to continuous improvement efforts aimed at enhancing delivery performance, visibility, and overall customer satisfaction.

3. Customer Support

Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and a solutions-oriented approach that reinforces thrust and long-term partnership.
Act as an extension of the Sales team by supporting customer requests, identifying upsell or follow-on order opportunities, and ensuring seamless handoffs between Sales and Operations.
Communicate extensively with customers, carriers, brokers, and internal teams via high-volume email and time-sensitive phone calls, responding promptly to inquiries, issues, and escalation needs related to active orders and shipments.
Prepare, retrieve, and distribute customer-requested documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates, and shipping records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

4. Other

Carry out other duties to support departmental and organizational objectives.




Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty according to the requirements of the Company. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities.




Company-Related Competencies: To perform their jobs successfully, all employees working in the St. Louis Group should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Ethics – Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works ethically and with integrity; Upholds Company values.

· Professionalism – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for personal actions; Follows through on commitments.

· Problem Solving – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

· Written and Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and obtains clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings; Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Reads with the ability to interpret written information.

· Teamwork – Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others’ views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone’s efforts to succeed.

· Adaptability – Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.




Job-Related Competencies – To perform this job successfully, employees in this job should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Quality and Quantity – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality; Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly but efficiently.

· Customer Service – Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

· Dependability – Follows instructions; Responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.

· Organizational Support – Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization’s goals and values; Benefits organization through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.

· Attendance/Punctuality – Is consistently at work and is on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.




Education and/or Experience: Bachelor's Degree and two-years related experience and/or training in an corporate office setting; or equivalent combination of education and experience.




Other Skills and Abilities: The following skills and abilities are either required or desired.

· Computer software skills including: Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel), Adobe, and Slack messaging software are required. The ability to quickly adapt and embrace new software is required.

· The ability to develop positive working relationships and interact effectively with vendors, brokers, customers, and colleagues is required.

· The ability to effectively listen and communicate orally and in writing is required.

· The ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously is required.

· The ability to prepare reports and forms is required.

· The ability to follow all established protocols, guidelines, and departmental policies is required.

· The ability to work alone with minimum supervision and with others in a team environment is required.

· A working knowledge of standard office practices and the ability to apply such knowledge to a variety of interrelated processes, tasks, and operations is required.

· The ability to operate a computer, printer, telephone/switchboard, calculator, postage meter, copy machine, scanner, fax machine, shredder, and other office equipment is required.

· The ability to speak, read and write in English is required. Spanish is desired.

· The ability to occasionally travel out-of-town on Company-related business and/or to attend conferences and trainings, is desired.

description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.

We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.

Location: These opportunities are available in the APAC and AMER regions and are remote positions.

The role entails:


Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
Customer interactions and support to your team: resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.
Team management: passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. 
Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.



What We Are Looking For In You


Excellent academic results at school and university
Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject
Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
Experience growing and developing a CSM team
Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events



Nice-to-have Skills


Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.



What We Offer You

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.


Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
Priority Pass for travel



About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

description:
About the job

Business Process Analyst

Location: Ciudad de México, Miguel Hidalgo







Role Summary




As a Business Process Analyst, you will leverage technology to streamline and improve supply chain and manufacturing business processes within the Global Information Technology (GIT) team, reporting directly to Sr. Manager, Global App - Supply Chain . You will provide essential SAP and business process knowledge for the analysis, design, and development of cross-functional applications while delivering daily IT support according to standard operating procedures and Global SLAs. This position offers an exciting opportunity to identify, assess, and implement value-adding technologies and project management frameworks to solve complex procedural problems. By driving system reliability and cross-functional collaboration, you will directly support critical business priorities and digital transformation initiatives across the division




Responsibilities

At Adyen, our sales teams take initiatives, allowing them to make an impact from day one and we highly encourage working as a team because winning is more important than ego. Adyen is the place where sales mavericks can take flight.

Being able to tell stories is fundamental to how we operate. Our team is fantastic storytellers when speaking to prospective and current clients to foster excitement about our product and strengthen customer relations. We are looking for a sales manager who will succeed aboard the Adyen rocket ship and take our current successful momentum to the next level of growth through the acquisition of new (Enterprise) merchants in Mexico.

Sounds exciting? Keep reading!

What You’ll Do


Own the sales cycle with our largest merchants - from the prospecting stage to closing deals;
Creatively drive innovation for merchants in retail, digital, platforms, and financial services;
Become an expert in selling Adyen's world class financial solutions;
Partner with technology leaders and solution providers while working closely with our Sales Support, Implementation and Account Management teams.


Who You Are


You have high levels of energy, love networking, connecting and thrive in hands-on environments;
Proven experience in an enterprise sales role (3+ years) selling complex solutions; preferably in Payments, Financial Technology or SaaS;

Working in the financial space against large banking institutions is a challenge, so these individuals should be prepared to educate and pitch transparently with a consultative approach;
You speak native in Spanish and are fluent in English for business communication.


Ready to meet us?

If you are excited about this role, apply by clicking the link below. We can’t wait to meet you!

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

description:
About the job

Who we are:

Four years ago, Dragonfruit set out to bring together some of the most talented visual storytellers, viral video strategists, and big-name clients, to change the way we create and consume on YouTube.




The result has been bigger than we could have imagined, having generated over a billion organic views and hundreds of millions of subscribers for creators like MrBeast, Ali Abdaal, Neil Patel, Chris Williamson, Codie Sanchez, and orgs like Y Combinator, e.l.f beauty, WHOOP, ClickUp, Linktree, Center for Humane Technology & more.




Unlike other social media agencies or YouTube businesses, Dragonfruit refuses to celebrate a “creator economy” that trades viewers’ time and attention for rapid-fire dopamine entertainment.




Instead, we want to lead a global movement to make YouTube a more valuable and educational place for all people; where views and subscribers are never an end in and of themselves, but rather a means of increasing human flourishing; where viral-educational YouTube channels not only bolster awareness and impact for our client's brands, but also create genuine value in viewers’ lives.




Dragonfruit's Mission

Dragonfruit exists to help the world’s most important ideas travel farther. We partner with experts, educators, scientists, founders, and creators to turn deep knowledge into media people actually want to watch, share, and act on. In a world where attention is often optimized for noise, we’re building a company that rewards clarity, substance, and human impact — combining creative judgment, production craft, and AI-powered systems to help better information reach more people. Our mission is to build the creative infrastructure for a healthier, more thoughtful internet.




The Role

As a YouTube Producer at Dragonfruit, your strength is operational excellence. You will own the integrity of our production operating system. That includes maintaining task hygiene in trhoughout our Production System, enforcing documentation standards, auditing workflows for breakdowns, and continuously improving throughput, clarity, and predictability.




This is a systems-first production role. While you will collaborate with Creative Directors, your primary responsibility is designing, maintaining, and optimizing production workflows across multiple accounts. This role is 10–20% creative alignment and 80–90% operational execution, systems thinking, and technical project management.




Day-to-day, you’ll own the production process across 3-5 client accounts and manage 400+ videos in active production at once. That means allocating editors, anticipating bottlenecks and acting as a trusted partner to clients—guiding timelines, deliverables, and approvals while communicating with empathy, clarity, and authority.




This role is about powering the heartbeat of the most influential YouTube channels in the world. Our clients reach tens of millions of viewers every month, shaping conversations in business, personal & professional development, health & wellness, and beyond. As a Producer, you’re not just managing deadlines—you’re ensuring the ideas that matter most get delivered to the world at scale.




In practice, that makes you one of the most pivotal players in Dragonfruit’s journey to become the most prestigious YouTube agency on the planet. Your work will fuel the growth of channels that are redefining what YouTube can be.




What you can expect:

An exciting startup culture – work cross-functionally, wear several hats, and occasionally work long hours, during evenings, and/or weekends. We are a hungry and ambitious group of people trying to accomplish something large and challenging and we’re looking for folks who are enthusiastic and willing to do what is required to reach their goals

LocalEyes collaborates closely with clients to develop custom video solutions tailored to their goals and audiences. The agency emphasizes a smooth, enjoyable production experience, guiding clients through every step of the process. Applicants can expect to work with a team of talented creatives committed to delivering impactful and well-crafted video content.




The role




This is not a cold-outbound BDR seat. You'll work our existing client base - hundreds of past accounts with proven spend - and our warm referral network. Re-engagement sequences, referral follow-through, review requests, and job-change signals (a past contact lands a new role → you run the play that week, while the window is open).




Repeat and referral business is over half our revenue and closes at twice the rate of new business. The pipeline exists. Your job is to book it - carefully, personally, every week.




What makes this seat different from a BDR job




Zero cold calling, zero cold lists. Every contact already knows us or was sent to us
A finite list, not an infinite one. You can't burn through this pool - every message has to land, which means personalization is the job, not a step you skip at volume
Craft over spray. Target lists, messaging, and sequences are built with our senior team; you execute them with judgment and tell us when a play isn't working




What you'll do




Run structured re-engagement sequences to past clients (email, LinkedIn, phone) - personalized to their history with us
Book discovery calls onto our sales team's calendars - your one number: 3-4 booked calls/week, ramping to 5
Act on job-change and buying signals within days
Follow through on referral introductions and review requests after projects wrap
Keep HubSpot clean: every touch logged, every account status current
Bring pattern feedback to a weekly senior-team review - what's resonating, what's not




What you won't do




Sell, negotiate, or close - our Executive Producers and AE take every meeting you book
Own accounts or design strategy - senior team owns targets and messaging; you own execution quality and the booking number
Cold prospect or build lists from scratch




You're a fit if you have




1-3 years in an ADR/BDR/SDR or appointment-setting seat with a booked-meetings quota you can prove - account development or customer-marketing experience is a strong plus
Excellent written English - you'll message US executives daily, referencing real relationship history
Discipline at volume with care: 60-70 quality touches a day against a list that has to last
HubSpot (or similar) fluency: sequences, tasks, logging
Reliable remote setup, 4+ hours of overlap with US Pacific
A verifiable record of doing what you said, when you said - we check references on the numbers you give us




What success looks like




Week 2: ramped on sequences, first booked calls on the board
Week 4: 3+ booked calls/week, sustained
Week 8: 5/week - the pipeline is predictable because of you




Comp + structure

Full-time, $2k-$3k/month USD base + per-held-meeting bonus
Paid 30-day trial period with clear pass criteria - you'll know exactly what the bar is on day one
Growth opportunities

About the job

🌎 Location: Fully remote (LATAM or North America time zones, within 3 hours of Mexico City)




🏆 Strong communication skills in English




About Meaningful




Meaningful (M8L) is a growing and remote-first growth and product studio! We partner closely with early-stage and scaling startups, helping companies grow their visibility and revenue through SEO, content, Webflow, Framer, and go-to-market execution—without the overhead of traditional agencies.




About us: www.m8l.com




Our leadership brings serious Silicon Valley and LATAM experience:




CEO Orlando Osorio: Consulted for 100+ startups including unicorns like CloudKitchens and BetterUp, angel-backed by Michael Seibel (ex-CEO of Y Combinator)
CTO Alberto Sadde: Led engineering at AI-powered companies serving Fortune 100 clients, Oxford PhD dropout who chose to build in the startup world
Web & Growth Director Ana Alida Abdala (Ali): Scaled Konfío (Mexican unicorn) from 50 to 1,000+ employees, performance marketing expert with deep martech capabilities




We're intentionally small: a 45-person team of specialists who've worked with companies like Raycast, CloudKitchens, NameCheap, Klar, Platzi, SamCart, Kueski, Cashea, and Endeavor.




For every client, 1–2 directors are deeply involved to provide hands-on guidance and support.




We're deeply embedded in the tech ecosystem:




Official host of Growth Conference → growthconf.com
Continuous builders: supervisible.com, savedtask.com
Angel investors & LPs: 0bs, Nascent, 500, Rainforest
Mentors at Endeavor and 500 Startups




The Mission

We're looking for someone who lives in the data and can prove, not guess, what moves conversion. You'll own the experimentation roadmap for our clients: forming sharp hypotheses, designing rigorous tests, and reporting results, including the honest "inconclusive", with full statistical confidence. This is a skeptical, analytical role, not a design or copy role.


What You'll Own

Mine analytics and user research to find friction points worth testing
Write clear hypotheses and prioritize a live test backlog
Design experiments: define sample size, success metric, and test structure before launch
Analyze results for statistical significance and turn them into client-ready findings
Defend or kill a test on the numbers alone, live, in front of a sharp client
Train the broader team on CRO fundamentals, hypothesis writing, and how to read test data


What You'll Need

Strong, hands-on background in A/B testing, you've run tests in the past
Comfort with experiment design and statistics: significance, sample size, multi-variant judgment
Analytics depth (GA4, segmentation) and research tooling (heatmaps, session recordings)
Ability to set up tracking/QA so a test actually measures what it claims to measure
Professional English, you'll present findings directly to clients


Nice to Have

Background in paid/performance marketing
CRO certifications or structured training (e.g. CXL)
Familiarity with Webflow, Framer or similar platforms, enough to understand what's testable


What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited at least one client's analytics setup, shipped your first properly-powered test, and can walk a client through a result; win, loss, or inconclusive, leaning heavily on your quantitative and qualitative results.


Where We See This Person Coming From

Paid / performance marketer who lives close to data and understands significance instinctively
Data or web analyst with strong segmentation and reporting skills, ready to grow into hypothesis-driven work
Growth or product manager with a data-driven track record and genuine analytical curiosity

ADVISORS & CONSULTING SERVICES

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. Our Advisors & Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.

The Advisors & Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy & Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Marketing consultants lead the strategy development and implementation of campaigns and engagements for clients. They use customer data to provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, evaluating campaign results and adapting the approach to optimize marketing performance.

Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. description:
About the job

Embajador Universitario - Mexico¿Qué es Nodi?

Nodi es una plataforma de reclutamiento impulsada por inteligencia artificial que ayuda a empresas y talento a conectarse de una forma más eficiente. 

Para las empresas, Nodi funciona como un sistema de IA para reclutamiento end-to-end: automatiza la búsqueda de candidatos, la evaluación de talento y la gestión del proceso de contratación, permitiendo que los equipos encuentren y contraten mejores perfiles de forma más rápida. 

Para candidatos, Nodi funciona como un agente de carrera impulsado por IA. El agente entiende el perfil, experiencia, intereses y objetivos profesionales de cada persona, y busca oportunidades relevantes en el mercado según sus preferencias. En lugar de pasar horas buscando empleos y postulando a oportunidades que no encajan, Nodi ayuda a cada persona a descubrir las oportunidades correctas y la acompaña durante su desarrollo profesional con recomendaciones y feedback para mejorar su perfil. 

Nuestra misión es conectar al mejor talento con las mejores oportunidades profesionales.

¿Qué es un Embajador Nodi?

Un Embajador Nodi es la cara de Nodi dentro de su universidad: la persona que acerca la plataforma a sus compañeros y construye una comunidad de talento alrededor de nuevas oportunidades profesionales. No es solo compartir un link; es ayudar a que más estudiantes conozcan herramientas que les permitan descubrir oportunidades, mejorar sus perfiles profesionales y conectarse con empresas que buscan talento. Es, además, un acelerador de carrera para quien lo asume: acceso directo a fundadores y reclutadores, una credencial real para su CV y la experiencia de liderar un proyecto de principio a fin.

¿A quién buscamos?

Buscamos estudiantes universitarios con iniciativa, curiosidad y ganas de construir algo desde cero. Alguien que no espera a que las oportunidades lleguen, sino que busca cómo crearlas para sí mismo y para su comunidad. Idealmente, eres alguien que:

Es estudiante universitario activo, preferiblemente de una carrera relacionada con tecnología, ingeniería, ciencias, negocios o áreas afines.
Tiene interés por startups, tecnología e innovación, y curiosidad por conocer cómo se están construyendo las empresas del futuro.
Es una persona muy proactiva: identifica oportunidades, propone ideas y ejecuta sin necesitar que le digan cada paso.
Tiene facilidad para conectar con personas y construir comunidades dentro de su universidad.
Está motivado por ayudar a otros estudiantes a encontrar mejores oportunidades profesionales.
Tiene buena comunicación y presencia en redes, grupos estudiantiles o comunidades universitarias.



No buscamos únicamente a alguien con muchos seguidores o experiencia previa. Buscamos a alguien con energía, iniciativa y ganas de hacer que las cosas pasen.

¿Qué hace un Embajador Nodi?

Como Embajador Nodi, serás responsable de construir presencia y comunidad de Nodi dentro de tu universidad. Tus principales responsabilidades serán:

Organizar al menos 1 activación por semestre en tu universidad: puede ser un taller, charla, evento con estudiantes, colaboración con un club, alianza con una organización estudiantil u otra iniciativa que acerque Nodi a más talento.
Compartir oportunidades y contenido de Nodi: distribuir materiales, publicaciones y recursos que te proporcionaremos a través de grupos universitarios, redes sociales y comunidades relevantes.
Conectar estudiantes con oportunidades profesionales: ayudar a que más estudiantes creen su perfil en Nodi y descubran oportunidades laborales relevantes para sus objetivos de carrera.
Identificar comunidades clave dentro del campus: conectar con clubes, profesores, centros de estudiantes y espacios donde se reúnen estudiantes interesados en tecnología, innovación y desarrollo profesional.
Recolectar feedback de estudiantes: entender qué necesitan los jóvenes profesionales, qué oportunidades buscan y cómo podemos mejorar la experiencia en Nodi.
Participar en reuniones mensuales con el equipo de Nodi y otros embajadores: compartir avances, recibir apoyo y coordinar nuevas iniciativas.



Tu objetivo será simple: ayudar a que más estudiantes de tu universidad tengan acceso a mejores oportunidades profesionales y las herramientas necesarias para avanzar en sus carreras.

IncentivosIncentivo monetario

Los Embajadores Nodi reciben incentivo monetario por cierto número de candidatos con perfil completo conseguidos a través de su link de referido.

Beneficios para tu carrera

Además del incentivo monetario, ser Embajador Nodi te da acceso a cosas que el dinero no compra y que un estudiante normal no consigue:

Acceso directo a fundadores y reclutadores de la red de Nodi: mentoría, office hours y networking real.
Credencial verificable de "Embajador Nodi" y badge para tu LinkedIn.
Carta de recomendación firmada por el equipo de Nodi para los mejores embajadores.
Trato prioritario para tu propio perfil y para el de tu comunidad dentro de la plataforma.
Experiencia real de liderazgo y marketing liderando la comunidad de Nodi en tu universidad: justo lo que pesa en un CV.

description:
About the job

About the job




🌎 Location: Fully remote (LATAM or North America time zones, within 3 hours of Mexico City)




🏆 Strong communication skills in English




About Meaningful




Meaningful (M8L) is a growing and remote-first growth and product studio! We partner closely with early-stage and scaling startups, helping companies grow their visibility and revenue through SEO, content, Webflow, Framer, and go-to-market execution—without the overhead of traditional agencies.




About us: www.m8l.com




Our leadership brings serious Silicon Valley and LATAM experience:




CEO Orlando Osorio: Consulted for 100+ startups including unicorns like CloudKitchens and BetterUp, angel-backed by Michael Seibel (ex-CEO of Y Combinator)
CTO Alberto Sadde: Led engineering at AI-powered companies serving Fortune 100 clients, Oxford PhD dropout who chose to build in the startup world
Web & Growth Director Ana Alida Abdala (Ali): Scaled Konfío (Mexican unicorn) from 50 to 1,000+ employees, performance marketing expert with deep martech capabilities




We're intentionally small: a 45-person team of specialists who've worked with companies like Raycast, CloudKitchens, NameCheap, Klar, Platzi, SamCart, Kueski, Cashea, and Endeavor.




For every client, 1–2 directors are deeply involved to provide hands-on guidance and support.




We're deeply embedded in the tech ecosystem:




Official host of Growth Conference → growthconf.com
Continuous builders: supervisible.com, savedtask.com
Angel investors & LPs: 0bs, Nascent, 500, Rainforest
Mentors at Endeavor and 500 Startups







We're looking for a Video Content Creator who can own video content end-to-end, from the first idea to the final export. This isn't a pure editing role: you'll come up with concepts, write scripts and hooks, and then bring them to life in the edit. Most of what you'll make is short-form (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) for clients across LATAM and the US, with real opportunity to grow into long-form work like podcasts and YouTube.

You won't be handed a folder of footage and a brief every time. Often you'll be the one deciding what the video should even be, the concept, the hook, the structure, before a single clip gets cut.




What you'll do

Ideate. Come up with content concepts tailored to each client's brand, audience, and the platform it's going on, not generic templates.

Script. Write scripts, hooks, and shot lists that are built for retention, not just information.

Edit. Turn raw footage, client-recorded or your own, into polished, platform-native content.

Guide recording. For most clients, you won't be on camera yourself. You'll write clear shot lists and prompts so clients can record themselves well, and coach them on what "good raw footage" looks like.

Occasionally record. For a handful of clients, you may record voiceover or on-camera segments yourself when it's the right fit.

Stay current. Keep a pulse on short-form trends, formats, and platform changes, and bring new ideas to the team proactively.




What we're looking for
A portfolio that shows range across the full process, concept, script, and edit, not just clean cuts on someone else's footage.
Strong instincts for what makes short-form content get watched to the end: hooks, pacing, retention.
Excellent written English. Scripts need to land with US audiences even when you're not the one on camera.
Comfortable in standard editing tools (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar). Motion graphics skills are a plus, not a requirement.
Experience creating your own content, a personal channel, TikTok, or Instagram presence, is a strong signal, even if it's small.
Bonus: experience recording your own voiceover or on-camera content, podcast production experience, or bilingual (Spanish/English) fluency.




What's different about this role vs. a typical editor job

This role is built around judgment as much as execution. We're not looking for someone who can just "cut well", we want someone who understands why one hook works better than another, who can defend a creative choice with a result, and who's excited to own that thinking instead of waiting to be told what to make.

Meaningful (M8L) is a growing and remote-first growth and product studio! We partner closely with early-stage and scaling startups, helping companies grow their visibility and revenue through SEO, content, Webflow, Framer, and go-to-market execution—without the overhead of traditional agencies.

Official host of Growth Conference → growthconf.com
Continuous builders: supervisible.com, savedtask.com
Angel investors & LPs: 0bs, Nascent, 500, Rainforest
Mentors at Endeavor and 500 Startups




About the role




We're looking for someone with real design taste and UX judgment who can lead a small creative team, a designer and a Webflow (or Framer, or other similar tool) developer, to ship landing pages and websites our clients are proud of. This is a craft and storytelling role: you care whether a page looks and reads great, and you own that bar end to end.




What You'll Own

Lead the design and build of landing pages and websites for growth marketing clients
Direct a designer and a Webflow developer, holding the line on taste and messaging quality
Make final calls on UX, layout, and visual direction across projects
Partner directly with the client to shape or sharpen their positioning and value prop when it isn't already clear, most clients don't walk in with this solved
Write first-pass copy for the pages you lead (AI-assisted is expected), then refine it with the client, we typically don't have a dedicated writer on these engagements
Own client reviews and presentations for creative work
Use data directionally: you ask "did this work?" but aren't necessarily running formal statistical tests




What You'll Need

Strong design taste and UX instincts, with a portfolio or track record to show it
Experience directing designers and/or developers, not just executing individually
Platform awareness, comfortable working in or briefing Webflow (or similar)
Strong judgment on landing pages, websites, and overall user experience
Professional English, you'll present work directly to clients
Comfort with core positioning and messaging fundamentals, enough to guide a client who hasn't defined their value prop yet

Nice to Have

Basic GA4 fluency and an intuitive sense for what drives conversion
Agency or client-services experience managing scope and timelines




What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've led at least one landing page or site through design and build, kept the designer and developer aligned on a shared bar of quality, and had a client tell you the result looks and reads great.




Where We See This Person Coming From

Designer with a strong messaging instinct, ready to own the client and the project
Brand, content, or product marketer with sharp taste and positioning sense
Web developer with genuine design taste looking to grow into client-facing leadership

About The Role And Team

Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. In this role, you will own the growth and success of a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, acting as their primary advisor to unlock the full potential of the Uber Eats platform. It is a high-stakes environment where your ability to build long-term partnerships directly impacts the livelihood of local businesses and Uber's mission to move the real world.

The work is fast-paced and requires a grit-based mindset; you will deal with shifting priorities, handle tough negotiations, and build lasting partnerships. We are looking for resourceful owners who are energized by the complex reality of Account Management and can stay resilient through the inevitable "no" to find creative solutions for our partners. If you thrive on autonomy and are motivated by seeing the tangible impact of your work on the community, this is where you will grow.

description:
About the job

¿Tu sueldo actual no compensa las horas que le das a tu trabajo?

Si sientes que trabajas tiempo completo pero vives con la cabeza en otro lado —pensando en lo que no estás cobrando, en el tiempo que no estás recuperando, en la vida personal que sigue esperando— esta vacante es para ti.

No te pedimos que renuncies hoy. Te proponemos algo distinto: pruébalo primero.

Descripción del puesto

Como Asociado Agente de Seguros Online en APERFÍN Apertura Financiera, socio comercial de AXA Seguros, asesorarás a personas interesadas en contratar seguros a través de canales digitales (teléfono, videollamada, chat y correo electrónico).

Tu día a día incluirá analizar las necesidades de cada persona, presentar opciones de seguros adecuadas, elaborar propuestas y acompañar el cierre de la contratación de manera 100% online. También darás seguimiento a tu cartera de clientes, resolverás dudas postventa y colaborarás en la identificación de nuevas oportunidades comerciales. Participarás en sesiones de formación continua sobre productos, herramientas digitales y normativa del sector asegurador.

Esta posición está diseñada como una puerta de entrada flexible, pensada tanto para quien busca su próximo paso profesional como para quien hoy tiene un empleo de tiempo completo pero no encuentra en él la compensación ni el equilibrio que busca.

Así funciona el modelo:

Inicias en modalidad de medio tiempo, compatible con tu trabajo actual si lo tienes. Durante los primeros 90 días recibirás capacitación estructurada, acompañamiento personalizado y una metodología de trabajo probada —sin improvisación, paso a paso— para construir tu cartera de clientes desde cero.

El reto es simple de entender y honesto de plantear: que al cierre de esos 90 días, tu actividad como asesor de seguros esté generando un ingreso comparable al que hoy percibes en tu empleo de tiempo completo. Si lo logras, el siguiente paso es tuyo: dedicarte por completo a esta carrera, con el control de tu tiempo y tu crecimiento en tus propias manos.

Es un modelo remoto, lo que te permite trabajar desde cualquier ubicación con buena conexión a internet, y organizar tus horas alrededor de tu vida —no al revés.

Requisitos

Tener residencia permanente dentro de la República Mexicana.
Aptitudes sólidas de comunicación y habilidades para la escritura clara y persuasiva en entornos digitales.
Capacidad analítica para interpretar necesidades de seguros, realizar comparativas de productos y apoyar la toma de decisiones de la persona cliente.
Experiencia en investigación y búsqueda de información para mantenerte actualizado sobre productos, condiciones y tendencias del mercado asegurador.
Interés y capacidad para la formación continua, tanto para aprender como para compartir conocimiento con el equipo.
Manejo fluido de herramientas ofimáticas, CRM y plataformas de comunicación online (videollamadas, chat, correo).
Orientación a resultados, organización del tiempo en entorno remoto y enfoque claro al servicio de la persona cliente.
Disponibilidad de medio tiempo para iniciar, con apertura a escalar a tiempo completo conforme tu cartera crece.
Se valorará experiencia previa en seguros, banca, ventas online o atención al cliente, así como conocimientos básicos de productos de AXA Seguros.

¿Para quién es esta vacante?

Para quien busca activamente su próximo empleo y quiere construir algo propio, no solo ocupar una posición.

Para quien hoy tiene trabajo de tiempo completo, pero siente que el sueldo no corresponde al esfuerzo, que no hay margen para crecer, o que la vida personal quedó relegada a los fines de semana.

Para quien está dispuesto a invertir 90 días de disciplina y aprendizaje a cambio de la posibilidad real de diseñar su propio horario, su propio techo de ingreso y su propio equilibrio.

title: Sales Closer - Bilingual (English + Spanish)
company: The Limitless Agent Company | Real Estate Marketing | PayPerClose Leads | Founder: Oswaldo Gutierrez
description:
About the job

💰 High Ticket Closer B2B — Bilingual (English + Spanish)




We're NOT looking for a "fat cat" closer who waits for perfectly warmed-up laydowns to fall onto their calendar.




We're looking for a hunter — a bilingual A-tier B2B closer with verifiable proof of $100K+ cash collected in high-ticket sales, who runs discovery calls, closes inbound demos, and generates their own pipeline on the same day. If "cold calling is beneath me" is in your vocabulary, this seat isn't yours.




🏢 WHO WE ARE




Silva Media is a rapidly scaling bilingual (Spanish/English) real estate marketing agency serving 70+ active agents across the United States.




We install a predictable client acquisition machine backed by a performance guarantee most agencies wouldn't dare make: 12 closings in 12 months, or the client doesn't pay.




We're on a wartime mission to hit $100K/month by Q3 2026. Nobody in the Latino real estate marketing space is doing what we do. Zero competition in Spanish. This is a blue ocean — and we intend to own it.




🎯 THE ROLE




You sit on Silva Media's elite remote sales team. You take discovery calls, run demos, and close inbound leads — AND you self-generate pipeline when the calendar isn't full. This is a hybrid seat: closer + hunter, not pure inbound.




You report to Jimmy E. Silva (Sales Leader & Face of Brand) and roll up to Oz Gutierrez (Founder & Architect). You're in the morning sales huddles. You roleplay daily. You drop your ego at the door and you let the founders coach you directly.




Your first 30 days are a 100% commission-only trial — 10% of cash collected. The bar: maintain a ≥25% close rate on qualified demo calls. Hit it, you unlock a ~$1,000 USD/month base + 10% commission. Miss it, the seat goes to someone who can.




🏆 WHAT YOU OWN




• Inbound closing. Run discovery → demo → close on qualified leads pre-booked into your calendar via Mia (our bilingual AI) and Silva Media's marketing engine. You convert.

• Pipeline self-generation. When inbound is light, you hunt — manual follow-up, outbound prospecting, re-engaging stale leads. You don't wait for the marketing team to refill your calendar.

• EOD discipline. Sales Tracker updated daily without prompts. KPIs visible. Compliance is non-negotiable.

• Morning huddles + roleplay. Every day. You show up, you roleplay, you take direct coaching from Jimmy and Oz.

• Founder escalations → zero. Issues get surfaced and solved at your level. Leadership shouldn't have to touch your pipeline week-over-week.




📊 HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED




• Close rate ≥ 25% on qualified demo calls (Phase 1 trial gate)

• Cash collected per month (the only number that pays you)

• Show-up rate on booked discovery calls

• Pipeline self-generated — outbound activity logged daily

• Founder escalations → Zero




✅ WHO THIS IS FOR




• Bilingual (Spanish/English) — fluent and professional in both, non-negotiable

• Verifiable $100K+ cash collected closing high-ticket B2B (agency / SMMA / coaching / consulting)

• Comfortable taking discovery calls AND closing — hybrid mindset, not "pure closer"

• You self-generate pipeline when inbound is light. You don't wait.

• You update your EOD/Sales Tracker daily without being asked

• Coachable. Ego-free. You roleplay every morning and welcome direct founder feedback

• Full-time availability — no side hustles, no second jobs competing for your attention

• Comfortable with the 30-day 100% commission-only trial structure

• Hunter mentality. You want a permanent seat on a scaling team, not a quick paycheck.




🚫 THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF




• You think cold calling, manual follow-up, or outbound prospecting is "beneath you"

• You need a guaranteed base salary on Day 1 to feel safe

• You can't actually show proof of $100K+ cash collected

• You're running 3 other side hustles and call this "another stream"

• You need daily motivation or hand-holding

• You're uncomfortable being directly coached by founders

• You hate tracking your numbers and would rather "just close"




🛠 TECH STACK




GoHighLevel · ClickUp · Cole Gordon Sales Tracker · Grain · Slack · Loom · Assistable (Mia AI)




💰 COMPENSATION




$2,000–$5,000+ USD/month OTE · Full-time · Remote · LATAM




Phase 1 (Days 1–30): 100% commission-only trial. 10% of cash collected. Must maintain ≥25% close rate on qualified demo calls.




Phase 2 (post-trial, KPI passed): ~$1,000 USD/month base + 10% commission. Base scales with individual performance. Realistic OTE $2K–$5K+/month.




📩 HOW TO APPLY




Submit a Loom video (5 minutes max) answering:




1. Walk us through your sales background — name, where you're from, and the agencies/companies where you've collected cash closing high-ticket B2B.

2. The Proof: show us your numbers. Walk through how you've personally collected $100K+ (or $500K+ if you're at the senior tier) in cash from high-ticket B2B sales. Screen-share, screenshots, pipeline review — make it tangible.

3. The Reality Check: tell us about one deal you almost lost and how you saved it, AND one deal you actually lost and what you learned from it.

4. Your commitment: are you fully available for full-time work, with no side hustles competing for your time? And are you 100% comfortable with the 30-day commission-only trial structure?

5. Why Silva Media? Why this role? Why you over 100 other applicants?




No Loom = no interview. No exceptions.




📋 Apply here: https://forms.clickup.com/9014256354/f/8cmn8q2-3154/7GJYCU50IZE84P1SVX

description:
About the job

Social Media & Content Manager Remote | Full-Time

About Us

We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering personalized hormone therapy, weight loss, longevity, and wellness programs for both men and women. Operating as two distinct but complementary brands — one focused on women's wellness, one on men's — we combine data-driven diagnostics with science-backed therapies, all delivered virtually and shipped directly to patients. With no membership fees, no hidden costs, and a dedicated health coaching model, we are redefining how people access proactive, root-cause healthcare.

About The Role

We have built a compelling product and a loyal patient base. The opportunity in front of this role is to turn that momentum into a growing, engaged community across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube — for two distinct audiences simultaneously.

This role exists because social media is one of the most powerful acquisition and retention channels in DTC health and wellness, and we are ready to invest in it intentionally. The person in this role will own content strategy and community engagement across both brands, ensuring the voice, tone, and messaging feel human, credible, and differentiated from the sea of generic wellness content.

This is not a post-and-schedule role. It requires someone who understands how to build trust with a health-conscious audience, can navigate content sensitivities around prescription products, and knows how to turn comment sections into conversion opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Planning


Develop and maintain monthly content calendars for both brands across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube
Identify content themes, campaign concepts, and platform-specific strategies aligned with product launches, seasonal trends, and audience interests
Stay current on relevant trends, platform changes, and cultural conversations — and identify when and how the brands should participate

Role Description




This is a full-time, remote Freight Dispatcher position with We R Logistics LLC, a company based in Austin, Texas. This role is fully remote, and candidates are not required to live in Austin.

The Freight Dispatcher will coordinate daily truck schedules, search for and assign loads, negotiate rates, and monitor shipments to help ensure on-time pickups and deliveries. Daily responsibilities include communicating with drivers, brokers, customers, and carriers, resolving scheduling or route issues, and keeping dispatch systems updated with accurate load information.

The role also involves handling inbound and outbound calls, providing timely shipment updates, managing load documentation, and addressing service concerns. At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are


We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. 
Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities
About the Team:
Creators are the heart and soul of TikTok. Our team's mission is to facilitate our Creator community's growth and development, drive high-quality content production and increase creator engagement and product adoption through brand opportunities and education programs. 

We are looking for a Creator Branded Content Associate on a temporary basis to cover a project. 

Key Responsibilities:
- Creator Recruitment & Pipeline Management: Proactively identify and invite cross-vertical creators to participate in key monetization programs and opportunities. Own participation volume targets and ensure a healthy, engaged creator pipeline across programs.
- Deal Fulfillment Support: Serve as a bridge between creators and service providers during the deal fulfillment cycle — confirming creator interest, communicating advertiser purchase intent, and coordinating backup candidates when fulfillment issues arise. Escalate follow-ups strategically, prioritizing outreach for creators who remain unresponsive after product-side attempts.
- Branded Content Solutions: Explore and develop alternative product mechanisms to complement the programs in partnership with internal product and monetization teams.
- Creator Education & Quality: Design and deliver creator education initiatives — including webinars and structured content reviews — focused on raising content quality standards and program performance.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, sales, and operations teams to align on program goals, surface creator feedback, and contribute to continuous improvement of program mechanics.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications: 
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Experience in creator management, influencer marketing, or a similar role within a digital platform or agency environment.
- Familiarity with branded content ecosystems and creator monetization mechanics (e.g. sponsored content, brand deals, performance-based incentives).
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage creators professionally and represent advertiser needs clearly.
- Data-informed mindset — comfortable tracking participation metrics and drawing actionable insights from program results.

Preferred Qualifications: 
- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple recruitment and fulfillment workflows simultaneously.
- Collaborative and proactive, with a bias toward problem-solving when fulfillment challenges arise.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

Content Manager

La misión de un content, community es construir una comunidad digital en las redes sociales de la marca, siguiendo y respetando la estrategia de esta, pero también proponiendo ideas que ayuden a construir marca, sigan las tendencias en redes sociales y generen valor hacia el seguidor.

- Adaptabilidad y flexibilidad

Descripción del puesto:

En Lemon & Morgan Head Hunter buscamos para nuestro cliente, una empresa mexicana especializada en la fabricación de pines, medallas, monedas conmemorativas y artículos metálicos personalizados, una persona para la posición de Tornero Convencional.




Esta posición es para alguien preciso, cuidadoso y con experiencia real en el manejo de torno convencional. Buscamos una persona que entienda que tornear no es únicamente retirar material: es fabricar piezas con medidas exactas, respetar tolerancias y asegurar que cada componente funcione correctamente dentro del proceso de producción.




Responsabilidades

Operar torno convencional para la fabricación y ajuste de piezas metálicas.

Fabricar piezas pequeñas y de precisión conforme a medidas, muestras o planos.

Realizar trabajos de cilindrado, refrentado, barrenado, roscado, desbaste y acabado.

Fabricar, ajustar y reparar pernos, bujes, ejes, punzones, matrices, cuños y componentes para troqueles.

Detectar desviaciones y realizar los ajustes necesarios antes de liberar una pieza.

Apoyar en la reparación y mantenimiento de herramientas y componentes de producción.

Mantener el torno, las herramientas y el área de trabajo en condiciones adecuadas de operación, limpieza y seguridad.




Requisitos

Experiencia previa indispensable como tornero convencional.

Experiencia comprobable en fabricación de piezas metálicas de precisión.

Dominio de operaciones básicas y avanzadas de torno convencional.

Manejo de vernier, micrómetro y herramientas de medición.

Conocimiento en materiales, herramientas de corte, velocidades y avances.

Deseable experiencia en fabricación de troqueles, matrices, moldes, cuños, punzones o componentes similares.

Alto nivel de precisión, responsabilidad, concentración y cuidado por los detalles.




Ofrecemos

Sueldo mensual de $15,000 libres.

Horario de lunes a viernes de 8:30 a.m. a 6:30 p.m.

Trabajo presencial en la zona de Vallejo, Ciudad de México.

Empleo estable y de tiempo completo.

Oportunidad de integrarte a una empresa mexicana especializada en productos metálicos personalizados.

Desarrollo de experiencia en fabricación de piezas para pines, medallas, monedas y artículos conmemorativos.




¿Por qué postularte?

Porque podrás integrarte a una empresa Estable especializada, donde la calidad del trabajo del tornero impacta directamente en la precisión de los moldes, troqueles, cuños y componentes utilizados en la producción.




Es una posición ideal para una persona que busca estabilidad, que disfruta trabajar con medidas exactas y que quiere aplicar su experiencia en la fabricación de piezas pequeñas y de alta precisión.

Postúlate si cuentas con experiencia previa indispensable en torno convencional, y puedes garantizar piezas precisas, funcionales y bien terminadas.
