description:
About the job

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As a Creator Agent for a new venture within Toptal, you will work directly with the General Manager and the Operations Director to onboard, coach, and accelerate the growth of our Content Creator users. You will join an execution-driven team building a new business unit from zero. Your mindset must be that of a builder, not just a coach.

This role has two core missions:


 Deliver hands-on creator growth: You will coach creators 1-to-1 to grow their audience, increase their engagement, and monetize their content. You will analyze their entire content plan end-to-end. You will challenge them with personalized weekly tasks that improve key metrics such as click-through-rate, retention rate, followers growth, and engagement rate. Once creators reach strong traction, you will also identify new revenue opportunities and activate brand deals. 
 Build the foundations of the Creator Agent function: As our first full-time Creator Agent, you will design, test, and refine the methodologies that power our coaching model. You will transform your learnings into structured playbooks, training materials, and repeatable processes that will allow us to scale a high-performing agent team. 


This is not a passive coaching position. You will think like a strategist, operate like a creator, and build like an early-stage founder. You must be able to analyze performance data, communicate clearly, and move quickly.

The ideal candidate is a senior creator strategist with real, proven experience growing accounts on YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok. You understand how content scales, why packaging matters, and how to push creators to become consistent, professional, and commercially ready.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.


Conduct creators onboarding, assess performance, and identify growth opportunities across platforms. 
Provide 1-to-1 coaching focused on improving content strategy, packaging, and execution (from scripting to community building). 
Define weekly goals and metrics that drive measurable growth. 
Guide creators toward professional publishing standards and consistent audience development. 
Support creators in preparing for monetization and activate brand opportunities when appropriate. 
Design, test, and refine the coaching methodologies that will scale the Creator Agent function. 
Convert insights into structured playbooks, templates, and training materials for future agents. 
Partner with the Operations Director to strengthen creator success processes and growth frameworks. 
Collaborate with marketing, product, and partnerships teams on creator-facing initiatives. 
Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm shifts, and best practices to update our approach continuously. 
Exercise discretion and independent judgment. 


In the first week, expect to:


Study the Creator onboarding guide to understand the core levers that drive growth on YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. 
Shadow real creator calls to learn how we onboard clients and how agents deliver feedback on content, strategy, and packaging. 
Review internal examples of strong creator diagnostics and session flows to understand our quality bar. 
Start building your own approach for analyzing creators during onboarding sessions. 


In the first month, expect to:


Work cross-functionally with our support team to improve your clients’ visual quality and editing quality. 
Start working with 1-5 clients by identifying their growth opportunities, providing actionable feedback, and giving them clear weekly tasks that drive metric improvement. 
Start drafting your methodology playbook to guide your client meetings, analyze performance, and structure a repeatable coaching rhythm. 


In the first three months, expect to:


Take full ownership of tracking, measuring, and driving progress for your client portfolio. 
Manage around 15 creators with a consistent coaching rhythm that includes goals, metric reviews, tailored feedback, and next steps. 
Build the first complete version of the Creator Agent playbook based on your learnings from real clients. 
Identify patterns across creators and propose scalable solutions, templates, and frameworks. 


In the first six months, expect to:


Guide at least one creator from zero monetization to first revenue. 
Demonstrate consistent metric improvement across your creator portfolio. 
Build the first version of a repeatable coaching model with templates and scorecards. 
Identify the core traits that predict creator success and use them to refine how we assess and coach creators. 
Mentor incoming agents and help set the performance bar for the function. 


In the first year, expect to:


Scale multiple creators to consistent monetization. 
Recognize the traits and behaviors that consistently predict creator growth, and use these insights to improve how we select and coach creators. 
Establish the operating system for the Creator Agent team including training standards and core frameworks. 
Mentor incoming agents and help set the performance bar for the function. 


Qualifications and Job Requirements:


A bachelor’s degree is required. 
Proven experience growing social media accounts on YouTube, Instagram, and/or TikTok. 
Strong understanding of content strategy fundamentals: ideation, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and retention, conversion, and community building. 
Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into clear, actionable guidance. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
Experience in roles that require coaching, advising, or client accountability. 
Ability to break down creative work into structured frameworks and teachable steps. 
Strong organizational discipline to manage around 10 creators weekly. 
Availability to work in the Americas time zone. 
Familiarity with creator monetization and brand partnerships is a plus. 


Bonus points if you:


Are a creator with +50k followers/subscribers on Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok. 
Have monetized your own content through different sources, including brand deals, affiliate marketing, platform payouts, and selling products/services to your own audience. 
Are familiar with doing paid social campaigns.

title: Business Analyst
description:
About the job

Somos una consultora de ciencia de datos e inteligencia artificial. Ayudamos a empresas a aumentar ventas, reducir costos y mejorar métricas de negocio con soluciones de IA: sistemas de recomendación, modelos predictivos y soluciones agénticas con LLMs. Nos diferenciamos porque hacemos que las cosas pasen: entendemos el negocio, piloteamos, implementamos y monitoreamos. No nos quedamos en la PPT.




Buscamos a una persona con visión de negocio y suficiente literacy técnica de IA para guiar las mejores soluciones.

¿Disfrutas escuchar a un director de tecnología, mapear cómo funciona realmente su negocio, identificar dónde la inteligencia artificial puede mover métricas, y luego conversar con un equipo técnico para co-diseñar la solución?

Este rol fue diseñado para ti.




Eres la persona que entiende el negocio del cliente a profundidad, mapea sus procesos, identifica dónde la IA agrega valor real, y guía a nuestro equipo técnico sobre qué construir y por qué. Eres el par de conversación de un director general y, al mismo tiempo, alguien que sabe lo suficiente de agentes, RAG y LLMs para retar y orientar al equipo de ciencia de datos.




Qué harás

En lo estratégico y de negocio (≈60% del rol)

§ Conducir conversaciones con directores y líderes funcionales del cliente como su par: identificando dolores reales, oportunidades y casos de uso de alto impacto.

§ Mapear procesos de negocio As Is y diseñar el To Be con maestría — usando Lucidchart, BPMN, Miro o equivalentes — de forma que cualquier persona pueda entender el cambio que se está proponiendo.

§ Construir el business case: cuantificar el impacto esperado, definir KPIs de valor (ventas, costo, tiempo, NPS) y de adopción (uso real de la solución), y dar visibilidad ejecutiva del avance.

§ Traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos accionables, claros y medibles para el equipo técnico.

§ Acompañar la adopción: asegurar que las soluciones no solo se entreguen, sino que el cliente las use y midan su impacto.




En lo técnico (≈40% del rol)

§ Guiar al equipo de ciencia de datos en la elección de la solución correcta: ¿esto es un problema para un agente, varios agentes, RAG, un modelo predictivo, o realmente no necesita IA?

§ Retar arquitecturas propuestas con preguntas inteligentes: precisión esperada, latencia, costo, riesgos, evaluación.

§ Validar que las entregas técnicas cumplan con los KPIs definidos y con criterios de calidad acordados.

§ Mantener tu conocimiento al día en herramientas y frameworks de IA, especialmente en el espacio agéntico, para tomar mejores decisiones de diseño.




Lo que buscamos en ti

§ 3+ años en roles de consultoría, business analysis o product management en proyectos de tecnología, ciencia de datos o transformación digital.

§ Experiencia probada mapeando procesos de negocio: levantamiento As Is, diseño de To Be, identificación de puntos de fricción y oportunidades. Esto debe ser una de tus fortalezas, no algo que has hecho de pasada.

§ Capacidad para sentarte con un director general como su par — sin perderte ni intimidarte — y salir de la junta con claridad sobre los siguientes pasos.

§ Manejo de herramientas de modelado y documentación: Lucidchart, BPMN, Miro, Notion, Confluence, Excel.

§ Experiencia previa en al menos uno de estos sectores: retail / e-commerce, servicios financieros, farmacéutica, telecomunicaciones, educación.

§ Has estado dentro de mínimo 2-3 proyectos reales de IA, ciencia de datos o ML — no necesariamente como builder, pero sí lo suficientemente cerca para entender qué se construye y por qué.

§ Dominio conceptual sólido del espacio de IA generativa: sabes qué es un agente, cuándo conviene uno o varios, qué hace RAG vs. fine-tuning, qué son embeddings y vectores, y cómo se evalúa un modelo LLM. Si no manejas estos conceptos, este rol todavía no es para ti.

§ Bases técnicas para conversar con desarrolladores: SQL básico, lectura de código Python, entendimiento de APIs y Git.

§ Conocimiento funcional de Power Automate, Power Apps y Dataverse: para qué sirve cada herramienta y cómo aplicarlas al diseño de soluciones de automatización (no se requiere perfil de desarrollo).


§ Curiosidad genuina por el negocio. Disfrutas entender cómo gana dinero un cliente y dónde están sus apalancamientos.

§ Empatía. Entiendes qué necesita realmente la gente — cliente, equipo y dirección — más allá de lo que dice en la primera junta.

§ Aprendizaje rápido. Cuando hay algo que no sabes, no te paralizas: investigas, preguntas, prototipas mentalmente.

§ Priorización. Distingues lo importante de lo urgente y lo de alto impacto de lo decorativo.

§ Resolución. Cuando algo se atora, lo destrabas tú o consigues a quien lo destrabe.




Qué ofrecemos

§ Compensación competitiva alineada a tu nivel y experiencia.

§ Bonificación anual por resultados.

§ Prestaciones superiores a las de Ley en México.

§ Modelo de trabajo flexible.

§ Proyectos retadores con clientes de varias industrias.

§ Aprendizaje continuo.




Cómo aplicar

Si esto te resuena y quieres ser parte de una consultora que está creciendo rápido y con propósito, escríbenos a hello@phiqus.com con tu CV y, si puedes, un párrafo corto contándonos sobre algún proyecto donde hayas mapeado procesos para una solución de IA o datos.




¿Conoces a alguien que le quede como anillo al dedo? Compártele está vacante.

Las mejores contrataciones siempre vienen por referidos.

description:
About the job

Solo Media Group · Part-time contractor · Remote




## The role

We're a Shopify Platinum Partner agency, and we want to be the answer AI engines give when a founder asks "who should I hire to migrate my store to Shopify Plus?" You'll write the website content — service pages, blog, FAQ — engineered to get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews for the queries our buyers actually type.




You don't need to be an AI-search expert yet. You need to be a genuinely strong writer who understands ecommerce. We have the AEO strategy (target queries, content formats, topic map) — we'll teach you the optimization; you bring the writing.




## What you'll do

- Write clear, authoritative website content: service pages, blog posts, FAQ entries

- Structure content for AI citation — direct answers, specific numbers, named experience, clean formatting (we'll show you the patterns)

- Turn our real work (migrations, builds, retention wins) into content that demonstrates expertise without pitching

- Cover the buyer questions that matter: choosing a Shopify agency, migration realities, Plus for scaling brands, B2B/wholesale

- Keep a consistent voice: calm, authoritative, plain-spoken — useful to a founder, never hypey




## What you need

- Excellent writer — clear, structured, edits own work, zero fluff

- Ecommerce fluency — you understand DTC/Shopify brands and the problems they face

- Ability to write with authority on technical topics without overcomplicating

- Reliable, self-directed, communicates cleanly async

- Willing to learn AEO/GEO — curious about how AI search picks sources




## Nice to have

- Prior SEO or content-marketing experience

- Familiarity with Shopify specifically

- Any exposure to AEO/GEO or how LLMs cite sources




## How this works

- Part-time contract, remote, flexible hours

- Starts with a defined content build (core pages + first blog/FAQ set), then reassess for ongoing

- You'll work from our AEO strategy doc and brand voice guide — you're not starting from a blank page




## To apply

Send 2-3 writing samples (ecommerce or technical/B2B preferred) and one paragraph: pick any Shopify agency and describe, in plain terms, why a $10M brand should hire them. We're reading for clarity and authority, not length.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
skills: Job Title: Operations & Content Specialist (GoHighLevel & Design Focus)
Work Schedule: 30 hours/week to start, with potential to expand to 40 hours/week
Location: Remote – Open to all LATAM countries
Time Zone: High Pacific Time overlap required; must provide live evening webinar tech support.
Compensation: $8–$10/hour USD + performance bonuses + additional pay for evening webinar support (Estimated monthly: $1,040–$1,300 based on 30 hours/week)
Overview

Our client is seeking a fast-moving, proactive Operations & Content Specialist to serve as the marketing engine and tech backbone for two expanding brands: an established mortgage company and a rapidly growing coaching platform.

Important Note: This is not an Executive Assistant or a passive administrative role. The client already has an executive assistant handling calendar management and scheduling. Instead, this role requires a technical builder and visual creator who can build funnels, manage complex pipelines, design marketing assets, and handle tech customer support completely independently. The ideal candidate has digital marketing agency experience, is a native GoHighLevel user, and possesses a strong design eye.
Key Responsibilities
GoHighLevel System Execution: Build, test, and manage custom landing pages, registration forms, triggers, tags, and automated email/SMS workflows inside GoHighLevel (GHL).

Agency & Meta Ads Collaboration: Act as the primary internal contact for the client's external Meta Ad agency; ensure ad links are working, webhooks match, lead data maps correctly into GHL pipelines, and tracking tags are functioning properly.
Canva & Content Design: Independently design high-quality, visually polished social media graphics, slide decks, onboarding materials, and digital marketing assets inside Canva.

Client Onboarding & Support: Own the customer service and onboarding lifecycle for new members joining the coaching program; handle onboarding tech setups, distribute access tokens, and resolve account access issues.
Live Webinar Technical Operation: Take full ownership of live webinar tech logistics (Zoom management, chat moderation, link drops, troubleshoot attendee login failures in real-time under pressure).
Funnel Quality Assurance: Constantly audit, monitor, and stress-test active marketing funnels, checkout pages, and campaign links to eliminate broken user paths before traffic hits them.
AI Workflow Optimization: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, specialized agents) to draft high-converting email copy, brainstorm marketing workflows, and optimize administrative efficiency.
What We’re Looking For
Proven GoHighLevel Expertise: Non-negotiable, hands-on experience building forms, landing pages, and marketing automations within GHL.
Strong Portfolio: A visible, diverse digital design portfolio or Canva sample collection showcasing social media graphics, client assets, or presentation decks.

Agency-Bred Agility: Past experience working inside a fast-paced digital marketing agency or SaaS environment is highly preferred; you must be comfortable managing multiple moving marketing pipelines.
Technical Problem Solving: Strong capability to diagnose and fix broken links, webhook delays, or automation drops without needing instructions or oversight.
Exceptional Written English: Flawless communication skills to confidently interface with high-paying coaching clients and resolve support tickets professionally via email/chat.
AI Literacy: Advanced prompting skills with Claude and ChatGPT to augment marketing text asset development and workflow setup.
Equipment & Availability: Reliable high-speed internet, capable hardware, and availability to support live evening webinars seamlessly.
Why Join Us
Direct opportunity to scale hours and take on high-level growth responsibilities as marketing funnels scale.
Performance-based bonuses directly tied to pipeline performance and webinar success metrics.
Fully remote, autonomous work environment with exposure to cutting-edge digital marketing structures.

Design-to-Code Familiarity: Experience working within modern creative workflows, specifically familiarity with Figma and Figma-to-HTML automation plugins.

Deliverability Best Practices: Strong understanding of email deliverability, bounce management, suppression logic, and opt-out compliance. Experience with deliverability tools like Validity is highly preferred.

Workflow & QA: Strong attention to detail with a systematic, objective approach to pre-deployment QA.

THE ROLE 

This is an opportunity to join to nearshore production hub in Mexico City as CRM Campaign Manager— executing the email campaigns that drive enrollment across a healthcare education institutions.

Based in Mexico City, you'll be one of three Campaign Managers— translating campaign strategy into precise, technically accurate email executions at high volume and pace. Every campaign you build feeds that intelligence loop. 

We support flexible working and are open to different arrangements. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the process. 

The CRM Campaign Manager is responsible for the hands-on execution of multi-channel campaigns (Email and SMS) across the company's enrollment marketing programs. You build, test, schedule, and deploy campaigns within the company's Marketing Automation Platform (Oracle Eloqua), ensuring it works seamlessly with the core CRM (Salesforce). You will translate segmentation logic, personalization specifications, and content briefs from the CRM Strategist into fully built, QA-checked, deployment-ready campaigns. WHAT YOU'LL DO
Campaign Execution: Build, test, and deploy omnichannel campaigns (Email and SMS) across education institutions natively within Oracle Eloqua. Follow campaign briefs, audience segmentation specs, and content guidelines provided by the CRM Strategist.
Platform Orchestration: Manage campaign setup including audience list imports, segmentation application, dynamic content configuration (e.g., by program, degree level, or student milestone), and A/B 
Agile QA & Approvals: Execute pre-deployment QA including seed list testing, cross-client rendering checks, link validation, and content accuracy. Enforce a strict "correctness only" review tier to prevent late-stage subjective wordsmithing and maintain a "pace over perfection" standard for deployment.
Deployment Management: Manage campaign scheduling and deployment, including time zone management across the company's US-based student audiences.
Data & CDP Alignment: Support the CRM Strategist by leveraging segments mapped from the Customer Data Platform (Hightouch) and Salesforce stage/disposition funnel data to ensure the right message hits the right audience.
Performance Monitoring: Monitor campaign performance post-deployment, utilizing tools like Validity for deliverability and inbox placement. Flag delivery issues, bounce rates, or unsubscribe spikes immediately.
Process & Documentation: Maintain campaign documentation, build logs, audience specs, test results, and deployment records.
Reporting Support: Contribute to campaign performance reporting by compiling execution data to support Power BI dashboard analyses and the CRM Strategist's optimization loop.
WHAT YOU BRING
3+ years of hands-on experience building, segmenting, and deploying complex email and SMS campaigns in an enterprise Marketing Automation Platform. Deep technical proficiency in Oracle Eloqua is strictly required.
Ecosystem Knowledge: Strong understanding of how Marketing Automation Platforms (Eloqua) integrate with enterprise CRMs (Salesforce) and Customer Data Platforms (Hightouch CDP).
Technical Campaign Proficiency: Advanced skills in native audience segmentation, dynamic content configuration, personalization variables (CDOs), and A/B test configuration within Eloqua.
Design-to-Code Familiarity: Experience working within modern creative workflows, specifically familiarity with Figma and Figma-to-HTML automation plugins.
Deliverability Best Practices: Strong understanding of email deliverability, bounce management, suppression logic, and opt-out compliance. Experience with deliverability tools like Validity is highly preferred.
Additional Stack Experience: Familiarity with Movable Ink (for dynamic email widgets) and Power BI (for data visualization) is a strong plus.
Project Management Savvy: Experience working in enterprise intake and project management tools (Workfront, Monday.com, OMG) and comfortable managing a high volume of concurrent campaigns across different brands.
Workflow & QA: Strong attention to detail with a systematic, objective approach to pre-deployment QA.
Communication: Professional proficiency in English; Spanish proficiency is an advantage for the Mexico City hub role. Experience working in distributed teams and cross-location workflows.

• Help ensure client communications are timely, professional, and organized.

• Conduct data analysis and prepare performance reports for clients and leadership.

• Assist in sales enablement efforts through strategic planning, tool setup, and content alignment.

• Provide direction or oversight on SEO, social media management, paid digital spend, and general web technologies.

• Help connect marketing performance insights to strategic client recommendations.

• Have a solid understanding of how the CRM works and how information is organized.

• Set up and monitor basic automated tasks and simple processes in the CRM.

• Keep the database clean, organized, and up to date.

• Create easy-to-understand reports and dashboards to show overall progress.

• Ability to translate complex data and client needs into clear, actionable plans.

Support the field sales team by analyzing data, providing insights, managing tools, and optimizing sales strategies to enhance overall performance and achieve sales targets.

Training & Support

Effective underwriting helps protect the financial stability of the company minimizing the risk of large claims of defaults.

That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

About the job

Overview

 CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT 

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity 

Are you passionate about supply chain, analytics, and solving complex business challenges?

Join the Integrated Supply Chain Planning (ISCP) team supporting Frito-Lay North America (FLNA), one of PepsiCo's largest and most dynamic businesses. In this role, you'll help ensure products flow efficiently across plants, distribution centers, and mixing facilities, supporting product availability for millions of consumers.

As an ISCP Planning Analyst, you'll work at the intersection of planning, replenishment, inventory management, and data analytics. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, leverage advanced planning systems, and use data-driven insights to support critical supply chain decisions that drive service and operational excellence.

This is an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build expertise in Supply Chain Planning while gaining exposure to a large-scale manufacturing and distribution network.

Support supply replenishment and inventory planning activities across the Frito-Lay US network.

Partner with planning teams, distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and headquarters stakeholders to improve processes, service levels, and system performance.
Monitor service and inventory metrics, identify trends, and recommend actions to address potential gaps and opportunities.
Participate in planning discussions and operational reviews, helping drive supply chain continuity and customer service excellence.
Utilize tools such as SAP, planning systems, and reporting dashboards to support decision-making and operational execution.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning processes, system health, and overall network performance.


Qualifications

Fluent English communication skills (written and verbal).
1–3 years of experience in Supply Chain Planning, Demand Planning, Replenishment Planning, Logistics, Operations, or related areas.

Familiarity with planning or ERP systems such as SAP is preferred.
Availability to work a standard Monday–Friday schedule from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Operations, Analytics, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.

title: Trafficker Digital Jr.
description:
About the job

En WTF advertising estamos creciendo y buscamos a un crack de la pauta digital. Si te apasiona la estrategia, los datos y optimizar presupuestos ¡este puesto es para ti!

Buscamos

un perfil con la capacidad de proponer, desarrollar, configurar y optimizar

campañas digitales, principalmente en Meta

Ads, Google Ads y Programmatic.

Suma muchos puntos si además manejas plataformas como TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads,

Pinterest Ads, etc.




¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

Estrategia y ejecución: diseño, configuración y optimización diaria de campañas en diversas plataformas

digitales.

Monitoreo: gestión, control y optimización eficiente de presupuestos asignados.

Análisis: identificación de tendencias de mercado, comportamiento de audiencias y análisis de datos duros.

Reporting: creación y presentación de reportes de resultados claros, accionables y enfocados en KPI's

de negocio.




¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Educación: Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Diseño o carreras afines.

Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia (comprobable) gestionando campañas digitales.

Herramientas clave: Dominio de Meta Business Suite, Google Ads (MCC) y Google Analytics.

Técnica: Conocimiento sólido en la creación de UTMs, implementación de píxeles, conversiones API y taggeo de eventos.

Certificaciones: Deseable contar con certificaciones vigentes de Google Search y Meta Blueprint.

Soft Skills: Creatividad para diseñar estrategias innovadoras, excelente capacidad de análisis y un fuerte espíritu de trabajo en equipo.




¿Qué ofrecemos en WTF advertising?




Sueldo: $16,000 MXN libres mensuales.

Esquema de trabajo: Formato híbrido (4 días presenciales / 1 día remoto).

Horario: Lunes a jueves de 10:00 a.m. a 5:00 p.m. y viernes de 10:00 a.m. a 2:00 p.m.

Prestaciones y beneficios: Vacaciones superiores a la ley.

Cursos y capacitaciones constantes para que sigas creciendo profesionalmente.

Ubicación: Prolongación Paseo de la Reforma #1232, planta baja, Lomas de Bezares, CDMX.

About the job

About Smart Capital Center

 

Smart Capital Center is an AI-powered platform built for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) investment and financial management in the U.S. market.

 

Our platform combines real-time data intelligence, workflow automation, and AI-driven insights to support underwriting, asset management, and portfolio analytics for institutional real estate firms.

 

We operate at the intersection of AI, finance, and commercial real estate, helping investment teams work faster, make smarter decisions, and scale operations more efficiently.

 

As we continue growing, we are looking for a highly capable Marketing Specialist to help expand our digital presence, strengthen brand visibility, and support content and growth initiatives across multiple channels.




The Opportunity

This is a hands-on marketing role for someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, creative, and excited to work in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

 

You will work closely with leadership and operations teams to execute digital marketing initiatives, manage content workflows, improve online visibility, and support the company’s growth strategy.

 

This role is ideal for candidates who learn quickly, enjoy working with modern AI tools, and want to build real-world experience in technology-driven marketing operations.

 

We are looking for people who move fast, communicate clearly, take ownership, and consistently deliver high-quality work.




What You’ll Actually Do

Content & Social Media Management

Create, schedule, and publish content across multiple social media platforms
Maintain consistent brand messaging and professional communication standards
Support audience engagement, comments, and community interaction management
Coordinate content calendars and publishing schedules




SEO, GEO & Website Content

Support keyword optimization, search visibility, and content performance initiatives
Assist with website content organization and updates

Assist with online reputation building and brand positioning efforts
Support press release distribution and article publication workflows
Help identify opportunities for industry exposure and recognition




AI-Assisted Marketing Operations

Use AI tools to improve content production, workflow efficiency, research, and marketing execution
Continuously explore and adopt new AI-driven marketing workflows
Support automation and operational improvements across marketing functions




Reporting & Performance Tracking

Track content performance and engagement metrics
Prepare marketing reports and operational updates
Monitor growth trends and campaign performance across channels




Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for highly capable, execution-focused individuals who are proactive, adaptable, and eager to grow.




Requirements

Strong English communication skills (C1/C2 proficiency required)
Tech-savvy with strong digital literacy
Fast learner with a strong willingness to adopt new tools and systems
Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day workflows
Strong organizational and multitasking skills
Excellent attention to detail and execution quality

Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-performance environment




Preferred Skills

Experience with social media management platforms
Familiarity with SEO and digital marketing concepts
Experience using AI tools for content creation, research, or workflow optimization
Basic experience with website content management systems is a plus
Experience with Canva, analytics tools, or content scheduling tools is a plus

You struggle with organization and multitasking
You prefer slow-paced or highly structured environments

description:
About the job

About us




Glitch is an AI-native ads platform based in Dublin, Ireland. The platform runs Google Ads Search across a growing book of client accounts, with a specialist ad operations team working alongside it. The book keeps growing, so we are adding an Ad Operations Specialist to build and optimise accounts to a consistent standard.




The role

This is a full time contract role. You will own the day-to-day build and optimisation work on live Google Ads Search accounts. Our service is Search only, brand and non-brand prospecting, so you can go deep on one discipline instead of spreading thin across channels. The platform creates the campaign builds and a house optimisation playbook defines the process, so your job is to execute it precisely and improve accounts on the numbers. You report to the Head of Ad Operations & Optimisation.




What you will do

Review the platform's campaign creation. Review the campaign builds the Glitch platform creates: ad groups, phrase and exact keywords, negatives, and responsive search ads. Run the launch QA checklist in Google Ads Editor and fix anything that needs it before it goes live.




Optimise live accounts for conversions. Work live accounts towards target CPA and CPL following the house optimisation playbook: search terms audits, negative keyword work, budget and bid changes. Every decision is conversion-first, not vanity-metric-first.




Log platform bugs clearly. When you spot a bug or an anomaly in the Glitch platform, log it with clear reproduction notes so the product team can find and fix it fast.




Recommend strategy improvements with evidence. Read the account data and flag what should change. Bring the recommendation and the evidence behind it, not a hunch.




Write client-facing performance summaries. Produce performance summaries and reports as needed, written clearly enough for a non-technical business owner to understand what happened and what comes next.




What we need
2+ years hands-on Google Ads Search experience managing live budgets, not just observing accounts
Proficiency in Google Ads Editor for building and bulk-editing campaigns
Conversion tracking literacy: conversion actions, and the basics of tCPA and tROAS bidding
Process discipline: you follow the launch QA checklist exactly and you document your work
English fluency, written and spoken




Nice to have
Multi-account or client-service background, for example experience at an agency managing several accounts at once
Google Ads certification is a plus




Location and hours

The role is fully remote working US hours. 




Compensation

$1500 to $2000 per month depending on experience




Hiring process
Application review
A short, practical Google Ads task
Interview with the Head of Ad Operations
2nd interview with senior management
Offer




How to apply

Send your resume along with a cover letter outlining why you think you would be a great fit for the role.

description:
About the job

About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)


So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About The Role
We're looking for a hands-on, customer-empathetic Credit Supervisor to own credit management, credit limit increases (CLI), and collections for our Mexico Credit Card. This is a founding role: you will build these frameworks and processes from the ground up.

The Lenda credit card is a mobile app–first product targeted at the credit builder segment in Mexico. We empower customers to access the formal financial ecosystem and build their credit profile over time, while offering a flexible and responsible line of credit tailored to their needs.

What makes this role different from a traditional credit management role is that you think about the customer experience as a credit lever. In a mobile-first, credit builder product, how customers experience the card — activation flows, payment reminders, limit increase offers — directly drives delinquency and engagement. You will work closely with Product and Operations to ensure the customer journey and credit performance reinforce each other.

We are looking for builders and doers that get things done.
In practice, this means being equally comfortable:


Defining and managing CLI eligibility, timing, and quality assurance
Designing collections strategies that balance recovery with customer empathy
Diving into portfolio metrics, roll rates, and delinquency trends
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows that influence credit behavior
Coordinating with Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Customer Support
Driving operational excellence and automation within credit management processes
Having a deep understanding of how post-acquisition performance impacts our P&L


What You'll Be Responsible For
This role will cover all aspects of credit management and collections for our Mexico Credit Card, including:


Owning portfolio performance post-acquisition: delinquency rates, roll rates, loss curves, profitability
Designing and continuously improving the CLI framework — eligibility, timing, sizing, and quality assurance
Building and leading the collections strategy: early-stage treatments, communication flows, escalation paths, recovery rates
Monitoring management KPIs: DPD buckets, NPL rates, recovery rates, CLI uptake and performance
Identifying behavioral signals that predict delinquency and building proactive intervention strategies
Collaborating with Product on customer-facing flows (payment reminders, activation nudges, CLI offers) that influence credit behavior
Supporting customers experiencing financial difficulty with responsible, empathy-driven solutions
Working with Data Science to build and refine behavioral scoring and collections models
Ensuring compliance with Mexican financial regulations for collections and customer treatment
Improving operational efficiency through automation and tooling


You will have the freedom and responsibility to shape how credit is managed in Mexico from the ground up.

How You'll Work
Credit leaders at Lendable work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Compliance, and Growth to ensure strong portfolio health and sustainable expansion.

It's your job to:


Connect customer behavior patterns to portfolio risk outcomes
Prioritize interventions based on impact on delinquency and profitability
Balance commercial objectives with fair, empathy-driven customer outcomes
Experiment with new collections treatments, measure, and iterate quickly


We encourage all our teams to think big, act fast, and continuously improve.

Experience
You have a solid background in credit management, collections, or consumer lending. You're hands-on, customer-centric, and comfortable moving between strategy, execution, and analysis. Ideally, you bring:


Proficiency in English and Spanish
Solid understanding of credit management fundamentals: delinquency curves, roll rates, vintage analysis, recovery rates, P&L impact of collections
Experience in credit card or consumer lending portfolio management
Experience designing or managing collections strategies (early, mid, and late stage)
Comfort with SQL — you can independently query portfolio data to monitor performance and investigate anomalies
Experience leveraging AI tools to run analyses and drive faster decisions
Strong customer empathy — you understand that collections is a customer experience problem, not just a financial one
Good at communicating to different stakeholders
Strong ownership mentality and accountability for portfolio performance
Agency: you move fast, iterate based on feedback, and proactively flag issues before they escalate
Bonus: Experience thinking about UX or customer journey in the context of credit outcomes (activation, payment behavior, engagement)
Bonus: Experience in credit builder, thin-file, or underbanked segments
Bonus: Some experience on Fraud (especially first-party fraud in collections contexts)
Bonus: Experience in start-up/scale-up environments, credit cards, or fintech
Bonus: Familiarity with Mexican financial regulations for collections (CONDUSEF, CNBV)


The type of work you'll be doing

Own and drive credit management performance, strategy, and execution
Define and monitor KPIs related to delinquency, collections, CLI performance, and profitability
Lead CLI quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives
Design and iterate on collections communication flows and treatment strategies
Collaborate with Data Science to refine behavioral scoring and collections models
Develop internal credit monitoring dashboards and reporting frameworks

Liaise with Operations and Customer Support to ensure smooth credit and collections workflows
Build internal tools to automate manual work and make processes more efficient

Champion data-driven decision-making, measuring outcomes, and iterating quickly based on learnings

title: Coordinador(a) de Operaciones y Experiencia del Cliente
description:
About the job

Sobre Xcape




Xcape Tours es un operador turístico premium en rápido crecimiento en la República Dominicana, especializado en ofrecer experiencias inolvidables en excursiones compartidas, grupos pequeños y tours privados. Atendemos a viajeros de todo el mundo a través de nuestro sitio web y de las principales plataformas de viajes, incluyendo Viator, GetYourGuide, Airbnb Experiences y otras.




A medida que continuamos creciendo, buscamos una persona organizada, proactiva y orientada al servicio al cliente que nos ayude a coordinar nuestras operaciones diarias y a brindar una experiencia excepcional a cada uno de nuestros huéspedes.




Esta es una posición con modalidad remote-first, que ofrece excelentes oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento profesional. 




Sobre el Puesto 




El Coordinador(a) de Operaciones y Experiencia del Cliente será responsable de garantizar la correcta ejecución de nuestras excursiones diarias mediante la coordinación de reservas, transporte, comunicación con los clientes y la logística operativa.




Trabajando directamente con el Fundador de la empresa, serás el principal punto de contacto entre los huéspedes, choferes, guías, suplidores y los diferentes equipos internos para asegurar que cada experiencia se desarrolle de manera eficiente desde el momento de la reserva hasta la finalización del servicio.




Esta posición es ideal para una persona que disfrute resolver problemas, trabajar en un entorno dinámico y ofrecer un servicio al cliente de primer nivel. 




Responsabilidades Principales 




Reservas y Servicio al Cliente 




● Responder de manera oportuna a las consultas de los clientes a través de WhatsApp, correo electrónico, teléfono, chat del sitio web, Airbnb y mensajería de las diferentes OTAs.

● Gestionar nuevas reservas, modificaciones, cancelaciones y solicitudes especiales.

● Enviar confirmaciones de reserva, instrucciones de recogida, recordatorios e información sobre las excursiones.

● Coordinar números de habitación, lugares de recogida, restricciones alimenticias y necesidades especiales de los clientes.

● Resolver inquietudes y situaciones de los clientes de manera profesional antes, durante y después de cada tour.

● Dar seguimiento a los huéspedes una vez finalizada su experiencia y motivarlos a dejar reseñas en línea. ● Mantener altos estándares de tiempo de respuesta y satisfacción del cliente. 




Operaciones y Logística de Tours 




● Coordinar la programación diaria de excursiones y la logística operativa.

● Confirmar diariamente las reservas y los manifiestos de pasajeros.

● Programar y confirmar guías, choferes, proveedores de transporte y suplidores.

● Verificar horarios de recogida, requisitos de acceso a hoteles y puntos de encuentro.

● Monitorear las recogidas activas y las salidas de las excursiones.

● Coordinar cambios operativos de última hora y resolver incidencias con rapidez.

● Comunicar actualizaciones operativas a huéspedes y suplidores.

● Asegurar que todas las excursiones se ejecuten conforme a los estándares y procedimientos establecidos por la empresa.

● Apoyar las iniciativas de control de calidad y mejora continua de las operaciones. 




Gestión de Reservas y OTAs 




● Administrar las reservas provenientes de Viator, GetYourGuide, Airbnb Experiences y otras plataformas de reservas.

● Actualizar disponibilidad, horarios e información de las reservas.

● Supervisar la exactitud de las reservas y detectar posibles inconsistencias.

● Responder los mensajes de clientes enviados a través de las OTAs.

● Ayudar a mantener actualizada la información operativa y el contenido de las diferentes plataformas




Operaciones de Airbnb 




● Coordinar la comunicación con los huéspedes antes y durante cada estadía.

● Programar servicios de limpieza y mantenimiento.

● Asegurar que las propiedades estén listas para recibir a los huéspedes.

● Apoyar los procesos de check-in, check-out y la resolución de incidencias.

● Monitorear las reseñas de los huéspedes y colaborar con la gestión de la reputación de las propiedades. 




Apoyo Administrativo 




● Mantener registros precisos de las reservas.

● Actualizar hojas de cálculo, reportes e información operativa.

● Dar seguimiento a cancelaciones, reembolsos e incidencias operativas.

● Preparar resúmenes operativos diarios.

● Apoyar la documentación de procesos y las iniciativas de mejora continua.

● Utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial y soluciones digitales para mejorar la eficiencia operativa. 




Perfil del Candidato




Buscamos una persona que cuente con:




● Excelente dominio del inglés y del español, tanto oral como escrito.

● Sólidas habilidades de servicio al cliente.

● Excelentes capacidades de organización y planificación.

● Capacidad para gestionar múltiples tareas y establecer prioridades.

● Alto nivel de atención al detalle.

● Buen manejo de herramientas informáticas, incluyendo Google Workspace y Microsoft Office.

● Actitud positiva, iniciativa y disposición para aprender continuamente.

● Se valorará experiencia previa en turismo, hotelería o servicio al cliente, aunque no es un requisito indispensable. 




¿Por Qué Unirte a Xcape Tours? 




● Trabajar directamente con el Fundador de la empresa.

● Formar parte de una empresa turística en rápido crecimiento.

● Disfrutar de una posición completamente remota.

● Adquirir experiencia en operaciones turísticas, servicio al cliente, gestión de reservas y administración de negocios.

● Aprender a utilizar herramientas tecnológicas líderes en la industria e Inteligencia Artificial.

● Construir una carrera profesional a largo plazo con oportunidades reales de crecimiento a medida que la empresa continúa expandiéndose. 




Información Adicional 




Esta es una posición con modalidad remote-first. Los candidatos deberán contar con una conexión estable a internet, un espacio de trabajo profesional en casa y la capacidad para desempeñarse de manera independiente. Como empresa en crecimiento, las responsabilidades de este puesto podrán evolucionar con el tiempo. Además de las funciones descritas anteriormente, la persona seleccionada podrá asumir otras tareas, proyectos especiales o responsabilidades relacionadas que le sean asignadas, de acuerdo con la naturaleza del puesto y las necesidades operativas de la empresa. Creemos firmemente en desarrollar el talento interno y promover a nuestros colaboradores siempre que sea posible. Esta posición ofrece una trayectoria clara de crecimiento profesional hacia roles de supervisión y gerencia a medida que Xcape Tours continúa expandiéndose.

title: Account Manager
description:
About the job

RTD (ready-to-drink) a base de mezcal, actualmente en lanzamiento comercial simultáneo en Ciudad de México, Los Cabos y Miami/Florida. La marca está construyendo su equipo comercial de campo desde cero. Formará la unidad comercial que abrirá y sostendrá el mercado de CDMX




El Account Manager recibe las cuentas que el Sales Rep ha abierto y cerrado, y a partir de ese momento es el responsable de la relación comercial: seguimiento, reposición, fidelización y crecimiento de la cartera. Su trabajo garantiza que lo que el Sales Representant conquista, la marca lo retiene y lo hace crecer.




Este perfil vive en la relación. Conoce a los compradores por nombre, entiende sus ciclos de reposición, anticipa sus necesidades y asegura que la marca de seltzers mantenga presencia activa en cada punto de venta ganado.







Canales de responsabilidad

• Off-trade: gestión activa de cuentas ya abiertas en tiendas especializadas, licorerías y supermercados.

• Distribuidores: seguimiento a los acuerdos cerrados por el Sales Rep, asegurando cumplimiento de volúmenes, condiciones y presencia de producto.




Zonas de cobertura

• Roma, Condesa y Juárez.

• Polanco, Lomas y Santa Fe.




Responsabilidades principales

• Recibir el handoff formal de cuentas cerradas por el Sales Rep con toda la información comercial relevante.

• Dar seguimiento periódico a cada cuenta activa: visitas de reposición, verificación de exhibición, resolución de incidencias.

• Mantener comunicación constante con compradores y responsables de categoría en los puntos de venta.

• Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de la cartera existente: nuevos SKUs, ampliación de exhibición, activaciones en punto de venta.

• Gestionar y dar seguimiento a los acuerdos con distribuidores activos: pedidos, entregas, cumplimiento de condiciones pactadas.

• Detectar señales de riesgo en cuentas (disminución de pedidos, problemas de rotación, cambio de compradores) y escalar a Dirección Comercial.

• Reportar de forma periódica estado de cartera, métricas de retención y oportunidades identificadas a Dirección Comercial.

• Coordinar con el Sales Rep para asegurar que los traspasos de cuentas sean ordenados y completos.

title: Analista Jr. de Nuevos Negocios
skills: Mantener organizada la documentación de decisiones de cada iniciativa: qué se decidió, por qué y bajo qué supuestos.
Redactar los primeros borradores de entregables clave como PRD, BRD y Service Blueprint para la revisión del Gerente.
Dar seguimiento a las dependencias entre decisiones dentro de un mismo proyecto y alertar cuando algo se construye sobre un supuesto no validado.
Realizar benchmarking de mercado y competencia para nutrir la fase de Discovery y validar mecánicas propuestas.
Apoyar en modelos financieros preliminares (inputs, escenarios simples, sensibilidad básica).
Calcular y refinar los KPIs de la iniciativa.
Ejecutar un gap analysis periódico para contrastar lo planeado contra el avance real.
Dar seguimiento al plan de trabajo de la etapa de diseño y a los hitos comprometidos.
Coordinar directamente con las áreas dueñas de cada dominio (Legal, Finanzas, Tecnología, Sales) para cerrar pendientes de documentación, sin necesidad de que el Gerente medie cada intercambio.
Preparar y documentar minutas de las revisiones periódicas de avance y supuestos abiertos.
1 a 2 años de experiencia mínima en consultoría, banca, análisis de negocio/producto, estrategia o roles similares.
Licenciatura en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Negocios o carrera afín.
Redacción clara y estructurada: Habilidad indispensable y no negociable, dado el gran peso del componente documental.
Rigor documental: Entender que una decisión no está cerrada hasta que queda registrada con su razonamiento y sus supuestos, no solo el "qué".
Tolerancia a la ambigüedad: Capacidad de tomar una conversación sin resolver y convertirla en una decisión documentable mediante un pensamiento estructurado y lógico.
Autonomía calibrada: Equilibrio para no quedarse trabado esperando instrucciones, pero tampoco avanzar a ciegas sobre un supuesto sin verificar.
Comunicación cross-funcional fluida: Facilidad para interactuar con múltiples áreas de forma directa y autónoma.
Deseable: Manejo de herramientas de documentación estructurada (Notion, Confluence o similar) y familiaridad con metodologías de Discovery y diseño de soluciones.
Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado.

SOBRE EL ROL 📊




Buscamos un@ Analista Jr. de Diseño de Negocio para integrarse al área de Estrategia. En esta posición, trabajarás en modalidad de apoyo directo con el Gerente de Nuevos Negocios. Tu propósito principal será convertir oportunidades de negocio validadas, en soluciones bien diseñadas, documentadas y trazables, listas para pasar a la etapa de Implementación.




Este no es un rol de ejecución de proyectos ni gestión de equipos de desarrollo, sino un rol de estructuración de decisiones. Actuarás como un puente clave, interactuando de forma autónoma con diversas áreas (Legal, Finanzas, Tecnología, Sales) para asegurar que cada decisión quede registrada con su razonamiento y sus supuestos.







RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE 📈




Estructural y Documentación de decisiones (~50%)

Mantener organizada la documentación de decisiones de cada iniciativa: qué se decidió, por qué y bajo qué supuestos.
Redactar los primeros borradores de entregables clave como PRD, BRD y Service Blueprint para la revisión del Gerente.
Dar seguimiento a las dependencias entre decisiones dentro de un mismo proyecto y alertar cuando algo se construye sobre un supuesto no validado.

Soporte Analítico (~20%)

Realizar benchmarking de mercado y competencia para nutrir la fase de Discovery y validar mecánicas propuestas.
Apoyar en modelos financieros preliminares (inputs, escenarios simples, sensibilidad básica).
Calcular y refinar los KPIs de la iniciativa.
Ejecutar un gap analysis periódico para contrastar lo planeado contra el avance real.

Coordinación y Seguimiento (~30%)

Dar seguimiento al plan de trabajo de la etapa de diseño y a los hitos comprometidos.
Coordinar directamente con las áreas dueñas de cada dominio (Legal, Finanzas, Tecnología, Sales) para cerrar pendientes de documentación, sin necesidad de que el Gerente medie cada intercambio.
Preparar y documentar minutas de las revisiones periódicas de avance y supuestos abiertos.




LO QUE BUSCAMOS 🔍




1 a 2 años de experiencia mínima en consultoría, banca, análisis de negocio/producto, estrategia o roles similares.
Licenciatura en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Economía, Negocios o carrera afín.
Redacción clara y estructurada: Habilidad indispensable y no negociable, dado el gran peso del componente documental.
Rigor documental: Entender que una decisión no está cerrada hasta que queda registrada con su razonamiento y sus supuestos, no solo el "qué".
Tolerancia a la ambigüedad: Capacidad de tomar una conversación sin resolver y convertirla en una decisión documentable mediante un pensamiento estructurado y lógico.
Autonomía calibrada: Equilibrio para no quedarse trabado esperando instrucciones, pero tampoco avanzar a ciegas sobre un supuesto sin verificar.
Comunicación cross-funcional fluida: Facilidad para interactuar con múltiples áreas de forma directa y autónoma.
Deseable: Manejo de herramientas de documentación estructurada (Notion, Confluence o similar) y familiaridad con metodologías de Discovery y diseño de soluciones.
Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado.







NUESTRA CULTURA 💡




En Nexxia creemos que el talento se potencia cuando las personas pueden ser auténticas, sentirse valoradas y encontrar espacios donde sus ideas, experiencias y perspectivas realmente importan.

Nos apasiona construir equipos diversos porque sabemos que la innovación nace cuando nos atrevemos a pensar diferente, aprender unos de otros y colaborar con un propósito común. Por eso, impulsamos una cultura donde el respeto, la confianza y la cercanía son parte de la experiencia de cada persona.

Nos enorgullece crear un entorno en el que todos puedan desarrollarse, generar impacto y disfrutar el camino mientras construimos juntos prosperidad sostenible a través del conocimiento.

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly




Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand—we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we're investing in a new capability: an AI-powered Consumer Intelligence Hub that continuously transforms consumer signals into better business decisions.

Rather than relying on traditional research, we're building a proprietary intelligence system that combines first-party data, social conversations, creator communities, AI and strategic thinking to guide Product, Brand, Growth and Retail.

We're looking for someone to lead that capability.




The Opportunity




This is not a traditional Consumer & Market Insights role.

You won't spend your time commissioning surveys and writing research reports.

Instead, you'll build and own Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence function, working at the intersection of consumer understanding, AI and business strategy.

Your mission is simple: Turn consumer signals into better business decisions.

Working alongside an external AI Intelligence Architect and the executive team, you'll help build one of the first AI-native Consumer Intelligence capabilities in beauty.




Key Responsibilities




Build Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Framework




Define and continuously refine Sarelly's proprietary consumer taxonomy.
Organize consumer signals around business questions rather than platforms.
Ensure our AI systems are trained to identify meaningful consumer patterns instead of simply reporting data.
Continuously improve the quality and relevance of our intelligence model.




Define the AI Intelligence Architect




You'll lead the building of the technical infrastructure: 

Define how raw consumer data should be categorized and tagged.
Brief AI workflows and prompting frameworks.
Validate AI outputs
Identify new data sources that should be integrated into the system.




Translate Intelligence into Business Recommendations




You'll synthesize consumer intelligence into executive recommendations.

Your recommendations will directly influence:

Product Innovation
Franchise Development
Marketing
Creator Strategy
CRM
Retail




What Success Looks Like




Identify emerging consumer needs before competitors.
Translate consumer language into stronger messaging.
Identify product innovation opportunities earlier.
Improve creator selection and content strategy.
Make faster, evidence-based business decisions.




Become the Internal Expert on Latina Consumers




Help Sarelly develop the deepest understanding of Latina beauty consumers in the industry.

This includes understanding differences across:

Cultural identities
Heritage groups
Beauty routines
Consumer language
Shopping behaviors
Generations
Geographic markets
Emerging cultural trends

Rather than treating the Latina consumer as one audience, you'll help us understand the nuances that drive relevance.




Build a Learning Organization




Champion a culture of curiosity across the company. Help teams move from reporting observations to generating insights and making better business decisions.




Required Experience




2-3 

years in Consumer Insights, Innovation.
Experience working with multicultural or diverse consumer audiences.
Strong qualitative and strategic thinking skills.
Experience translating consumer research into business recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish.




Preferred Experience




Strong preference for candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

Beauty or personal care
Consumer packaged goods
Creator economy
Community-led brands
Consumer innovation
Consumer segmentation
U.S. Hispanic / Latina consumers
Mexican and U.S. markets

Experience across different Latina sub-communities and target demographics is highly valued.




AI Requirements (Must Have)




We are intentionally building an AI-native Consumer Intelligence function.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be highly AI-literate.

You should be comfortable:

Working daily with Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools.
Developing prompts and AI workflows.
Validating AI-generated insights.
Using AI to accelerate research and synthesis.
Rethinking traditional research methods through AI rather than simply replicating existing processes.

Curiosity about AI and willingness to experiment are essential.




Skills




Consumer research
Strategic thinking
Hypothesis generation
Pattern recognition
Cultural analysis
Storytelling
AI literacy
Project management
Cross-functional collaboration




Mindset




We're looking for someone who:

Is endlessly curious about people.
Naturally connects dots that others miss.
Questions assumptions before accepting them.
Loves experimenting with AI.
Enjoys building systems, not just reports.
Thinks like a strategist, not only a researcher.
Wants to help build a capability that doesn't yet exist.




Why Join Sarelly?




This is a rare opportunity to build the Consumer Intelligence function from the ground up.

Rather than inheriting traditional research processes, you'll help define how AI and human judgment work together to create a structural competitive advantage for one of the most culturally relevant beauty brands in the market.

About the job

Description

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including Twitch and Prime Video ADs—leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions. Amazon Adapt deploys highly skilled, hyper-agile talent that ensures customers can continue to invest in their partnerships with Amazon Advertising, uninterrupted. The program ensures that the high bar for customer service, strategic partnership, and revenue attainment is maintained during these coverage gaps.

As a member of the Amazon Adapt team, you will have the opportunity to work on a range of client businesses. This enables Adapt team members to experience high-velocity exposure to teams across the organization and to clients across different verticals. From day 1, Adapt team members must use their experience to earn trust with multiple stakeholders and take command of a new leadership role within a team. As a member of the Adapt team you will use your experience and vast knowledge in an array of work scenarios that affect internal stakeholders and clients. Adapt team members are decisive, knowledgeable, and use high judgement. The Adapt role will give you a chance to Learn and be Curious and the autonomy to own projects that will help you advance your career at Amazon. The Adapt team prioritizes flexibility, and hires for both 40 and 30 hour work weeks. If you are ready to make an immediate impact, embrace change, and accelerate your career at Amazon, come join us!

Key job responsibilities


 You deliver revenue while managing complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue
 You grow existing client revenues that may expand regionally
 Become an expert on Amazon solutions and adapt recommendations based on advertiser needs
 You are able to solve ambiguous problems and identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks
 You leverage your mastery of media and communications to develop annual brand plans and campaign media plans
 You create and/or identify new insights based on multiple first-party and third-party research.
 You educate customers based on customized insights
 You provide in-depth data analysis to develop actionable insights and recommendations for future campaigns
 This is a client facing role and requires up to 20% domestic travel as needed or 1x per month on average. Global travel may be required up to 2 times annually.


A day in the life

As an Sales Account Manager on the Adapt team, you will work with internal customers to create and execute advertising strategies while driving incremental revenue. You will rotate across teams and verticals to cover open books of business due to leaves of absence and use your experience and vast knowledge in an array of work scenarios to drive value for internal stakeholders and clients. You will consult the client to define goals and work backwards to develop a curated advertising strategy to achieve it. You use complex, data-driven insights to enrich advertisers' understanding of their campaigns, objectives and even business. Internally you work closely with Sales, Creative, Product, and other internal partner teams to drive advertiser success.

About The Team

Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions or gaps in business needs. Amazon Adapt deploys highly skilled, hyper-agile talent that ensures customers can continue to invest in their partnerships with Amazon Advertising, uninterrupted. The program ensures that the high bar for customer service, strategic partnership, and revenue attainment is maintained during these coverage gaps.

Learn more about the Adapt team by hearing from our leaders here - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QzzMRk7LQCA.

 Experience in a client-facing role including but not limited to digital marketing, analytics or equivalent
 Experience in account management, brand management, performance marketing, digital marketing, sales or consulting

description:
About the job

WHO WE ARE

At Kidoz, we build privacy-first technology that helps brands and app developers connect with mobile audiences in a way that’s safe, thoughtful, and effective. We focus on contextual advertising - not tracking people or collecting personal data - because we believe relevance shouldn’t come at the expense of trust.

 

We’re a growing, globally distributed team of builders and problem-solvers who care about doing things the right way. Our platform reaches hundreds of millions of users each month, and we’re proud to work with partners who value both performance and responsibility. If you’re excited about modern adtech with strong principles and real impact, you’ll feel at home here.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You'll be responsible for driving programmatic growth and troubleshooting across Open Market and YouTube discovery, while supporting the broader AdOps team in delivering campaigns with strong performance and accuracy. You'll also maintain a proactive, collaborative relationship with the tech team, providing whatever support they need to keep integrations and delivery running smoothly.

 

This role:

• Partners with the Head of Programmatic and cross-functional teams to execute high-impact campaigns, consistently exceeding client KPIs while delivering premium account support.

• Designs and executes A/B tests across diverse programmatic platforms to uncover performance blockers, working closely with tech teams to resolve them.

• Maintains proactive communication with the technical team to unlock blockers in our programmatic ecosystem and troubleshoot new verticals to grow.

• Sets up campaigns within SSP platforms such as Pubmatic, Xandr, and others, to maximize traffic to the accounts that need it.

• Develops, implements, and A/B test programmatic in-app ad campaigns on both Kidoz and DV360/CM360 platforms.

• Escalates campaign blockers immediately to ensure all deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

• Produces reports that show campaign performance and results to share internally and externally with clients.

 




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST YEAR




In your first 6–12 months, success in this role looks like:

Consistent A/B testing across programmatic campaign types to identify and drive growth in new verticals.
Smooth, well-documented pathways that unblock incremental revenue in Open Market campaigns and YouTube discovery.
Strong support to the Programmatic AdOps team in successfully delivering campaigns for Key Accounts.
Strong internal communication with the tech team to build confidence in campaign execution.
Clear and consistent reporting on campaign results and optimization strategies.
Contribution to improved operational processes and QA standards within AdOps.

 




WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

You’re analytical, detail-oriented, and highly organized. You thrive in fast-paced AdTech environments and are comfortable balancing technical troubleshooting with partner-facing communication. You’re proactive in identifying issues and confident collaborating across technical and commercial teams.

 

You have:

• Experience managing programmatic Open Market and other campaign types within a digital advertising or AdTech environment.

• Hands-on experience working with SSP platforms and ORTB integrations.

• Open market monetization knowledge from the supply side.

• Experience with YouTube monetization through DV360 or Google Ads.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across live campaigns.

• Expertise in interpreting complex performance data, with a specialized ability to troubleshoot the root causes of discrepancies and implement effective optimizations.

• Comfort working with technical tools, dashboards, and analytics platforms.

• Strong communication with both technical and commercial stakeholders.

• Experience managing Jira or similar ticketing systems.

• Comfort working cross-functionally across AdOps, Sales, Tech, and Data teams.

• Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) - this is essential for daily collaboration across our distributed team.

 




HOW WE OPERATE

We work in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where priorities can shift. We value clear communication, ownership, and people who are comfortable balancing structure with flexibility. 




GOOD TO KNOWS

• This is an independent contractor engagement at a full-time capacity.

• You must be based in and working out of Eastern Time (EST - UTC-3 to UTC-5).

• Full professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.

• Kidoz is a globally distributed team - you’ll collaborate regularly with teammates across Europe and the West Coast.

• Experience in ad tech or familiarity with advertising technology is essential for this role.

• This role comes with meaningful ownership and room to shape how we work, not just follow existing playbooks.




COMPENSATION

You’ll be joining as an independent contractor at a full-time capacity. Compensation is competitive and based on experience and scope of responsibility. We pay fairly, transparently, and in line with the impact you have. We review compensation regularly and aim to grow roles and rewards as the company grows.





OUR HIRING PROCESS




We try to keep our hiring process straightforward, thoughtful, and human. For this role, you will have:

• Round 1: An initial conversation with our team.

• Round 2: An interview with the hiring manager and a cross-functional partner.

• Round 3: A practical scenario-based discussion.

• Round 4: A final conversation with senior leadership.

 

We value clear communication and aim to move efficiently while making sure there’s mutual alignment on both sides.
