About the job

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About The Business Development Executive Role...

The Business Development Executive will be focused on closing new business. You will plan and prioritize business development activities to achieve company revenue goals and sales targets for defined regions. You will develop and implement innovative commercial strategies to maximize results and support business growth. Ideally, you will leverage existing industry contacts to increase SiteMinder’s client base and brand coverage in the assigned territory.

What You Have...


Experience in new business acquisition, preferably in the SaaS (software-as-a-service) space, managing the full sales cycle

About the job

Título: Analista de Relaciones Laborales

Ubicación: Ciudad de México, Santa Fe

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, impulsando contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio.

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU. Nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente.

¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo dinámico!

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Analista de Relaciones Laborales para integrarse al equipo de Recursos Humanos.

El área de Relaciones Laborales es responsable de asegurar el cumplimiento de la normatividad laboral vigente, brindar soporte en procesos de bajas de personal y colaborar en la atención y seguimiento de temas sindicales y administrativos relacionados con los colaboradores de la compañía.

Sobre ti

Buscamos a una persona organizada, analítica y con alta atención al detalle, capaz de manejar información sensible con confidencialidad e integridad. Serás responsable de apoyar en procesos laborales y administrativos, asegurando el cumplimiento de la Ley Federal del Trabajo, políticas internas y procesos relacionados con relaciones laborales y sindicales.

Dar seguimiento a procesos de bajas de personal conforme a la normatividad laboral vigente. 
Apoyar en negociaciones y seguimiento con representantes sindicales. 
Participar en investigaciones internas relacionadas con denuncias y conflictos laborales.

En TelevisaUnivision valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros colaboradores. Creemos que un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional es fundamental para el éxito. Por ello ofrecemos prestaciones de ley y beneficios superiores que impulsan el crecimiento personal y profesional de nuestro talento.

description:
About the job

Description

Are you excited about driving impactful creative programs that elevate the Amazon Music

brand and customer experience? Are you driven by the challenge of building and

optimizing end-to-end program management frameworks to streamline creative

workflows and unlock efficiencies? Do you want to hone your skills in enabling and

improving processes alongside a global team of content creators and design experts? If so,

the Amazon Music Design & Creative Operations team is looking for a talented, passionate

Creative Operations Manager with a track record of strategic program delivery, cross-

functional collaboration, and process improvement to support the Brand & Creative

Strategy team.

Key job responsibilities


 Support team of brand strategists and copywriters in capacity planning across campaigns, creative and internal team needs
 Help maintain creative brief templates and intake processes
 Track and manage project timelines
 Support Copywriters and Strategists in workflow management
 Assist in coordination between internal teams and external partners
 Help track costs and budget on behalf of team
 Support implementation of content development workflows
 Maintain process documentation and knowledge repositories
 Help identify opportunities for workflow improvements
 Follow and promote best practices in copy and strategy operations
 Support workflows for internal initiatives and larger campaigns
 Help maintain creative review and approval processes
 Track creative versions and marketing asset iterations
 Assist in creative resource allocation
 Build relationships with creative and marketing partners


A day in the life

We're growing quickly and hiring the best talent to drive our creative vision forward. This

is an exciting opportunity to join our Amazon Music Design and Creative Operations team

as a Creative Operations Manager managing work within our Brand Creative Copy &

Strategy space. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and optimizing key

programs that span creative marketing, product and brand strategy launches. You will

serve as a central creative operational hub, building the frameworks, governance

structures, and cross-functional collaboration mechanisms required to successfully deliver

strategic creative initiatives.

About The Team

The Design and Creative Operations team is an embedded within the overall Design

organization, striving and focusing on operational excellence across all business verticals

within Amazon Music. The Design and Creative Operations team is responsible for

establishing the end-to-end workflow and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for

creative collaboration with all marketing, product, and partner design teams. We set the

standard for the process, earning trust with all partners, biasing for action when working

within tight parameters, and using sound judgment to make decisions in areas of ambiguity

or uncharted territories. Importantly, Design and Creative Operations also play a key role

in high-level reporting, defining and tracking key performance metrics, and maintaining

comprehensive documentation on our operational processes and best practices. They

partner closely with our counterparts in Brand Creative and Brand Strategy, along with

R&B and Product Design to launch bar-raising experiences across events, livestreams,

features, promotions and the product itself.

Basic Qualifications


 Knowledge of the workflow within a marketing, production, or creative department or company
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
 Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
 3+ year of experience in creative production, program coordination, or similar role


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience and understanding of the workflow within a marketing, production, or creative department or company
 Experience in Adobe Creative Suite applications, with high proficiency in Adobe WorkFront
 Workflow and process optimization through AI tooling

to jobs@arcticfever.co

Your mission is to train Large Language Models (LLMs) to master Python—not just for syntax, but for complex data science, automation, and machine learning workflows. You will join an elite group of engineers dedicated to ensuring that AI can write, debug, and optimize Python code that is secure, efficient, and enterprise-ready. Algorithmic Instruction Tuning: Create and refine complex Python challenges to teach LLMs how to walk through "Chain-of-Thought" (CoT) reasoning for data structures and algorithms.
Logic & Security Auditing: Perform rigorous code reviews on AI-generated Python scripts, ensuring they follow PEP 8 standards and are free from security vulnerabilities or logical fallacies.
Data Engineering for SFT: Develop and optimize Python scripts to clean, structure, and augment massive datasets used for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).
Scientific & ML Library Validation: Evaluate how models utilize advanced Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn, ensuring high-fidelity mathematical and data outputs.

Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or Applied Mathematics.

Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory to assist in localized technical documentation and Pythonic prompt engineering.
English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to collaborate with our global engineering leads and navigate technical PEP documentation.
Problem-Solving Mindset: A passion for clean code and a "Senior Specialist" mentality toward automated outputs.







Assessment:




In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.







Payment:




Currently, pay rates for experts range from $12 - $20 USD per hour

Our Payment terms are defined for each project.







Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community:




Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.
Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.
Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.
Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.
Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.







Equal Opportunity:

description:
About the job

Why join us? 

Our purpose is design for the good of humankind. It’s the ideal we strive toward each day in everything we do. Being a part of HermanMiller means being a part of something larger than your work team, or even your brand. We are redefining modern for the 21st century. And our success allows HermanMiller to support causes that align with our values, so we can build a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful future for everyone.

Proceso de ventas en córner de PH para Herman Miller.

¿Como cerrar una venta?


- Conoce tu producto. 


El primer paso es conocer a la perfección la propuesta de valor, lo que vamos a proporcionar al cliente y lo que ofrecemos en el mercado.

El conocimiento del producto y la marca en general determinará la eficacia del argumentario de venta, lo que llevará al cliente a creerse o no las ventajas que ofrece.


- Prospección de clientes. 


En este punto nos ayudamos de todas las herramientas mercadológicas y publicitarias que tiene ya dispuestas Herman Miller en México y el mundo, así como El Palacio de Hierro, para generar ese flujo de gente tanto en las tiendas como en nuestros corners, sin embargo, depende de nosotros mantenerlos en optimas condiciones visuales para atraer a esos clientes que ya están en la tienda. El display es muy importante para que eso suceda, todos los días al llegar a nuestro corner debemos revisar todo aquello que pudiera estar dejando de ser atractivo para nuestros clientes. De igual forma nuestra imagen personal debe ir acorde con lo que tanto Herman Miller como el Palacio de Hierro quieren proyectar a sus clientas ya que somos la imagen de los mismos antes esos clientes.


- El primer contacto. 


El primer contacto es muy importante para que el cliente adquiera una buena impresión de la marca, lo que debemos vender son dos cosas básicas:


La idea de la marca y no solo el Producto. 
A nosotros mismos como profesionales expertos y eficientes. Debemos transmitir que creemos en los valores de la marca y el producto que ofertamos. 


Siempre que un cliente se acerque al corner de Herman Miller el promotor debe recibirlo con un saludo que indique al cliente que esta siendo bienvenido al corner y que se le va a atender como se merece, el cliente con ello percibirá la disponibilidad de nuestra parte para asesorarlo en su proceso de selección.


- Establecer las necesidades. 


Debemos conocer las necesidades de tus Clientes, pero haciendo que sean ellos mismos quienes nos las digan. Tenemos que conocer sus inquietudes. Interesarnos por ellos de verdad y descubrir que es lo que realmente quieren comprar.


- Presentar el producto acorde a sus necesidades. 


En este punto es donde ponemos en practica lo aprendido en el punto uno, ya que sin primero conocer bien nuestra marca y nuestro producto y sin entender cuál es la principal propuesta de valor que tenemos, en este punto no vamos a conseguir una respuesta positiva de nuestro cliente.

Cualquier presentación debe seguir etapas planificadas, guiando al Cliente paso a paso hasta que llegue a entender lo que nuestro producto puede hacer por él.

La presentación del producto conforma la imagen mental que tiene el cliente potencial de nosotros y el producto. Debemos emplear lenguaje en positivo y ser convincentes.


- Cerrar la venta. 


A nuestros Clientes les tiene que resultar fácil decir SI gestionando correctamente sus objeciones. Ayúdales a tomar la decisión que antes has tomado por ellos. Nuestra misión principal en este terreno es conseguir ventas.

Una vez cerrada la venta…

En Herman Miller utilizamos diversos formatos de apoyo para realizar una venta, todos ellos deben estar en tu bandeja de entrada de tu correo electrónico, ya sea para descargarlos y usarlos en el día a día, o algunos que se alimentan únicamente abriendo el link en el correo electrónico para, una vez abierto, ingresar los datos solicitados.


- Formato de ventas y Formato de facturación y entrega de producto (Carta Porte). 


Estos dos formatos deberás descargarlos a tu computadora y tenerlos a la mano ya que los necesitaras siempre que cierres una venta, ambos de llenan con los datos de tu cliente, así como con los datos del articulo que vendiste y también datos del cobro que encontraras en el ticket de PH.

Una vez recabados los datos en ambos formatos, deberás solicitarle a tu cliente que te firme los dos formatos. Por lo que puedes recabar los datos en tu computadora, después imprimirlos y pedir que los revisen y los firmen, o bien imprimirlos y llenarlos a mano y después recabar la firma.

Con estos formatos pedirás a uno de los vendedores de El Palacio de Hierro, que te ayuden con el cobro del producto, y después de que el cobro quede listo le debes pedir al vendedor de PH una copia del ticket de venta.

Tu te quedaras con los formatos firmados y con la copia de el ticket, el cliente únicamente se llevará su ticket de PH original. Deberás escanear estos formatos junto con el ticket de PH ya que posteriormente los vas a necesitar en otra plataforma. Te sugiero que los guardes en una carpeta con el nombre de tu cliente ya que en ella agregaras también otros documentos.


- Formato de stock de Excel. 


En tu correo electrónico buscaras el formato de stock el cual deberás abrir en la liga.

Una vez abierto, en la parte inferior izquierda, te colocaras en la pestaña “ventas” e ingresaras toda la información que te solicitan los campos. Esto registrara la venta en dicho formato, descontando del stock la pieza que vendiste para de esta forma llevar un control del mismo.


- Formato de Pipeline. 


También en tu correo buscaras dicho formato, abres en la liga, y se desplegara otro formato en Excel. En el mismo, una vez que corrobores que te encuentras en la pestaña de data, ingresaras todos los datos que te solicita, algunos van a tener que quedar en blanco ya que son datos que tendrás hasta después, estos los completaras días después que se genere dicha información. (Proyecto, Acknow).


- Formato de reconocimientos. 


De igual forma que los dos anteriores, deberás abrir la liga que desplegara otro formato de Excel el cual llenaras en el apartado de tu tienda, con la información que te solicita dicho formato.


- Pocca. 


Enseguida de estos formatos, ingresaras a la pagina de intranet de POCCA con tu usuario y contraseña y en la parte superior izquierda seleccionaras la opción clientes, esto desplegara una pantalla donde te aparecerá una opción de buscar clientes, en ella ingresas el nombre de tu cliente, si este ya esta registrado te aparecerá y puedes pasar al siguiente punto de generar el proyecto, de no ser así, deberás ingresar al cliente primero.


 Ingresar al cliente. 


Una vez que el buscador no arrojo ningún resultado, seleccionaras la opción crear nuevo, y desplegara un formato que deberás llenar con los datos recabados de tu cliente en el formato de ventas. Una vez ingresados los datos, en la parte inferior seleccionaras “Enviar a autorización” y esperaras a que sea autorizado.


 Ingresar el proyecto. 


Una vez que ingresaste a tu cliente y fue autorizado, volverás a POCCA a ingresar el proyecto.

En la parte superior izquierda, seleccionaras la opción proyecto y en la siguiente pantalla seleccionaras la opción Crear nuevo.

Te pedirá crear un nombre, este deberá contener los datos de tu venta siguiendo el ejemplo que te pongo a continuación:

JUAN PEREZ SANCHEZ. 1 AERON B GRAFITO VINIL. 20% BUEN FIN. PHGUADALAJARA. STK

Enseguida abrirá otro formato que deberás llenar con los datos que te pide. En el apartado de facturación seleccionaras el nombre de RAFAEL ARZOZ GUTIERREZ.

Y en la sección Monto del proyecto te solicitara tres valores, estos los conseguirás en tu PDF que generaras en otro programa denominado “2020 Worksheet”.

Una vez ingresado todo lo mandaras a autorización.


 Ingresar la orden. 


Por ultimo en POCCA, una vez te autorizaron el proyecto, deberás ingresar la orden, para ello debes ingresar a tu proyecto autorizado, y en la parte superior veras un icono con la leyenda “Crear Orden”, seleccionamos ese icono, y nos desplegara una primera pantalla en la que ingresaremos el nombre de la orden, el cual puede ser el mismo que se utilizó para el proyecto.

Después de ello te abrirá otro formulario en el que llenaras los datos que te pide, ingresaras tu SIF y PDF de 2020 y al igual que el proyecto, mandaras a autorización.


- 2020 Worksheet. 


En este programa crearas tu pedido. Ingresaras con el usuario y contraseña que se te asignen, abrirás una hoja en blanco una vez dentro, y el catálogo en otra, después en el catalogo buscaras el articulo que vendiste, lo copiaras y lo pegaras en tu hoja en blanco.

Una vez que tengas tu pieza, te vas a la opción “Apply Schedule” y seleccionaras el código asignado para ese mes en curso. Después de ello colocaras el margen que te arrojo tu venta, el cual puedes calcular con una tabla de Excel. Y por último colocaras STK o HMI según sea el caso en la casilla correspondiente. Cuando tengas todo esto vas a la opción de Export SIF con la que crearas el SIF para tu orden, y después en la opción de crear informe seleccionaras “Estándar Finance”, con la que crearas tu PDF para tu orden.


- DASS. 


Cuando ya tienes tu proyecto en POCCA autorizado, así como tu orden autorizada, deberás ingresar a DASS para subir dicho proyecto y que sea programado para entrega.

El link lo encontraras también en tu correo, al abrirlo desplegara un formulario con datos del proyecto los cuales debes ingresar siempre y cuando este autorizado y sea una pieza con la que se cuenta en stock, al ingresarlos también deberás señalar la fecha de entrega no menor a 48 horas después del día en que lo ingresas en CDMX, o si fuera para Mty o Guadalajara seleccionaras “waiting for someone else”.

Deberás acordar con tu cliente el día de entrega para que al momento de que lo visiten pueda recibir.

¿Como realizar un cambio?

Si tu cliente después de algunos días, en los que tu ya tienes tu proyecto y tu orden autorizados o en espera de autorización únicamente, te pide hacer un cambio, deberás primero:


 En Palacio de Hierro cobraras la diferencia, haciendo una devolución y después generando un nuevo ticket con el total de la nueva compra, para que el cobro no quede separado en dos tickets (compra inicial + diferencia) si no que sea un solo ticket con el total de la nueva pieza. 
 Pedirás el formato de Excel de cambio de montos el cual deberás llenar con la información que te solicita dicho formato (montos anteriores, nuevos montos, diferencia). 
 En 2020 deberás generar tu nuevo SIF y PDF para que con ello ingreses la información del Excel de cambio de montos. 
 En POCCA ingresa a tu orden, selecciona cancelar orden, y ingresa las opciones que te solicita para después seleccionar solicitar autorización, para que esa cancelación de orden te sea autorizada. 
 Mandaras un correo a Alberto Medina pidiéndole que te desautorice el proyecto para modificar los montos del proyecto inicial y así poder ingresar los nuevos montos, en este correo adjuntaras el formato de Excel de cambio de montos que llenaste anteriormente y se lo enviaras una vez tengas cancelada tu orden. El proyecto no se puede cancelar solo desautorizar. 
 Una vez desautorizado, modificaras los montos por los de tu nuevo proyecto, indicados en tu nuevo SIF, y volverás a mandar a autorización el proyecto indicando en Observaciones que fue un cambio de montos por cambio de articulo a solicitud del cliente. 
 Después de que el proyecto sea autorizado vas a crear una nueva orden con los nuevos montos y a la cual le vas a cargar tu nuevo SIF y PDF. Una vez hecho esto los demás pasos siguen como en una venta normal. 


¿Cómo realizar una devolución?

Deberás mandar un correo a Alberto Medina y a Cony en el que expliques el motivo de la devolución con copia a Esperanza, adjuntando el ticket de cobro de Palacio de Hierro y el formato de venta, después de ello, esperaras una respuesta en la que se te dirá si se autoriza o no dicha devolución.

Una vez autorizado, únicamente cancelaras la orden en POCCA, ya que el proyecto no se puede cancelar.

En Palacio de Hierro pedirás también autorización al jefe de piso, te preguntara que, si la marca ya te lo autorizo, y una vez autorizado también por él, pedirás a un vendedor que lleve a cabo la devolución a tu cliente.

Una vez realizada, pídele al vendedor una copia del comprobante antes de darlo al cliente, y esa copia escanéala y mándala a Alberto y a Cony en otro correo.

En el formato de Stock de Excel debes cambiar el status de la venta a cancelado.

Who We Hire?

Simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities. HermanMiller is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities.

MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers_help@millerknoll.com.

description:
About the job

Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

We're Hiring: Support Agent – Candlelight Mexico 

 📍 On-site in Mexico City | Part.Time 20h/week (Monday-Thursday)

We’re looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Support Agent/ Administrative & Operations Assistant to join our Candlelight team—working behind the scenes to bring magical experiences to life across the Mexican region, while being based in Mexico City.

This role focuses on ensuring that all administrative, documentation, and operational processes behind our events run smoothly. You will play a key role in managing event-related documentation, tracking contracts and signatures, coordinating logistics, and supporting basic financial administration tasks.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, hands-on, comfortable taking ownership of tasks, and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.

What You’ll Do

📄 Documentation & Administrative Management


Manage and maintain organized records of event documentation, contracts, permits, and signed official documents
Coordinate signature collection and follow up with stakeholders on pending documentation
Prepare documentation for event execution and shipment when required
Ensure accurate filing, tracking, and proper record-keeping across administrative processes


💰 Finance & Operational Admin Support


Register and organize supplier invoices
Support tracking of payments related to vendors, permits, and administrative services
Maintain organized records for financial documentation and reconciliation


🤝 Internal Coordination


Maintain visibility across tasks, deadlines and project progress
Support communication between stakeholders involved in operational workflows


What You Bring


You live in Mexico City and are legally eligible to work here
You speak Spanish fluently & advanced English (B2 level).
Experience in structured operations, support or admin roles
Strong attention to detail, process orientation and follow-through
Comfort using Google Sheets or Excel (intermediate level or higher)
A team-first mindset, clear communicator and proactive problem-solver
Ability to juggle tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment


Nice to Have


Background in events, production or the music industry
Experience in administrative-heavy environments
Familiarity with tools like Airtable, Notion, Monday, or similar


Why Join Us?


40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
Work in a location in the heart of Mexico City
Help shape the backstage of magical concert experiences
Learn about event production, internal workflows and scalable operations
Room to grow and take on new challenges as the team evolves
Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!


We welcome people from all walks of life—if this role excites you and you’re motivated to learn and contribute, we want to hear from you.

This role is located in Mexico City.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

About the job

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE, PLEASE SUBMIT AN UPDATED RESUME TRANSLATED TO ENGLISH

Role Overview

As an Associate, Marketing, you are a sharp, detail-oriented, and adaptable marketing mind dedicated to scaling our growth engine across multiple high-impact acquisition channels. You support the execution, optimization, and expansion of our customer acquisition programs, balancing hands-on operations within our affiliate networks, direct mail campaigns, and paid social initiatives. You collaborate closely with internal growth squads to recruit partners, coordinate multi-channel assets, and ensure our performance ecosystem runs with maximum efficiency. You combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to help execute campaigns that scale, resolve workflow blockers quickly, and deliver measurable enrollment growth. Your ability to understand channel dynamics, flex into emerging media, and drive measurable outcomes helps expand some of our most strategic acquisition pipelines.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our service professionals (our Pros). Our success is their success.

What You Do Each Day


Research and identify potential affiliate partners, creators, and platform influencers to grow and diversify our acquisition footprint

2+ years of experience in performance marketing, digital acquisition, or multi-channel growth environments

A sharp, proactive marketing mindset that prioritizes core business data and campaign execution metrics over rigid channel boundaries
Exceptional attention to detail combined with the organizational agility to manage multiple asset-heavy projects simultaneously
Natural adaptability and eagerness to flex across diverse digital and physical acquisition channels as growth priorities evolve
A natural curiosity backed by action; you are multi-dimensional (volunteering, creative outlets, side projects, hobbies, athletics), with a proven ability to successfully start over, learn from scratch, and thrive in new environments

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

About the job

Ciudad de México, Santa Fe

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, impulsando contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio.

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU. Nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente.

¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo dinámico!

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Analista para el área de Finanzas / GBS.

El área de Order to Cash es responsable de gestionar y dar seguimiento a la recuperación de cuentas por cobrar del mercado de Estados Unidos, asegurando el correcto control de cobranza, conciliaciones, aclaración de disputas y registro contable de los pagos recibidos. Trabajamos de manera cercana con clientes, agencias y equipos internos para garantizar procesos eficientes y oportunos dentro del ciclo Order to Cash.

Sobre ti

Buscamos a una persona organizada, analítica y orientada al seguimiento, con habilidades de comunicación y servicio al cliente. Serás responsable de gestionar cuentas por cobrar del mercado estadounidense mediante seguimiento continuo con clientes, conciliaciones y coordinación con áreas internas para asegurar la recuperación oportuna de los saldos pendientes.

Tu día a día


Gestionar la recuperación de cuentas por cobrar vencidas y por vencer correspondientes al mercado de Estados Unidos. 
Dar seguimiento a pagos pendientes mediante llamadas, correos electrónicos y envío de recordatorios de pago a clientes. 
Coordinar con el área de Ventas la revisión y seguimiento de saldos vencidos por cliente. 
Realizar conciliaciones con agencias de publicidad para identificar pagos programados y facturas en disputa. 
Dar seguimiento y resolución a disputas relacionadas con facturación y cobranza en conjunto con Ventas y clientes. 
Solicitar y recuperar comprobantes de pago de clientes del mercado estadounidense. 
Mantener actualizada la información de contacto y gestión de la cartera de clientes. 
Elaborar y enviar estados de cuenta a agencias y clientes directos. 
Registrar contablemente la cobranza realizada dentro del ERP correspondiente. 
Apoyar en actividades administrativas y operativas relacionadas con el proceso Order to Cash (O2C). 


Tú deberás tener


Licenciatura concluida en áreas Económico-Administrativas o afín. 
Inglés avanzado (nivel C1). 
Experiencia mínima de 1 año en posiciones similares de cobranza, cuentas por cobrar o procesos O2C. 
Deseable experiencia dando seguimiento a clientes en inglés. 
Manejo de Microsoft Office y Excel. 
Conocimiento en sistemas ERP, facturación y herramientas de gestión de cobranza. 
Capacidad de organización, seguimiento y atención al detalle. 
Habilidades de comunicación efectiva y negociación. 
Actitud de servicio y trabajo colaborativo. 
Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y gestionar múltiples cuentas simultáneamente. 


Beneficios

En TelevisaUnivision valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros colaboradores. Creemos que un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional es fundamental para el éxito. Por ello ofrecemos prestaciones de ley y beneficios superiores que impulsan el crecimiento personal y profesional de nuestro talento.

Nuestro objetivo es crear un entorno laboral que fomente la productividad, la creatividad y el desarrollo continuo.

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

TelevisaUnivision es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados serán considerados para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, nacionalidad, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

description:
About the job

Sabemos o que é preciso para levar a UPS para o futuro - pessoas com uma combinação única de competência e paixão. Se você tem as qualidades e a motivação para liderar você mesmo ou equipes, há funções prontas para cultivar suas habilidades e levá-lo(a) para o próximo nível.

Descrição Do Cargo

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. As the clinical and advanced therapy part of UPS Healthcare, we reach patients faster, with greater scalability and access to new pathways throughout the supply chain. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Tipo De Colaborador

Permanente

A UPS tem o compromisso de oferecer um local de trabalho no qual não aja discriminação, assédio e retaliação.

description:
About the job

Description

Are you a UX/UI-minded content strategist who thrives on turning complex information into simple, conversion-driven experiences? Are you energized by the challenge of helping small and medium businesses in Mexico discover the tools they need to grow? Do you want to own the digital front door for one of the fastest-growing seller marketplaces in Latin America?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, consider joining the Mexico Marketplace team as a Content and Website Manager.

What You Will Do?

This role owns the end-to-end content experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, the primary destination for prospective sellers exploring how to sell on Amazon Mexico. The mission is clear: make it effortless for potential sellers to find, understand, and act on the information they need to start their business on Amazon.

You will combine UX/UI expertise with content strategy and data analysis to continuously improve the site experience. You will track free search sources to understand how sellers discover the site, then optimize every touchpoint from first click to completed registration.

To succeed, you will need to think like a designer, write like a marketer, and measure like an analyst, all while collaborating across a diverse set of internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

UX/UI Strategy and Execution: Own the information architecture, page layouts, and user flows on vender.amazon.com.mx. Ensure every page delivers a clear value proposition, intuitive navigation, and a frictionless path toward seller registration. Conduct usability reviews, propose wireframes, and work with design resources to implement improvements.

Content Management at Scale: Plan, create, publish, and maintain site content including landing pages, educational modules, FAQs, and program explainers. Ensure content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with active seller programs and promotions.

Free Search Source Tracking: Monitor organic traffic performance across Google and AI-powered search surfaces. Identify keyword opportunities, track ranking changes, and coordinate content updates to maximize discoverability without paid spend.

Conversion Optimization: Own the visitor-to-registration funnel. Design and run A/B tests on layouts, copy, and CTAs. Analyze drop-off points, recommend improvements backed by data, and report on conversion metrics to leadership.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with Program Managers, Product Managers, and Commercial teams. Translate business priorities, new program launches, and policy changes into user-friendly site content within rapid turnaround cycles.

Performance Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track organic traffic, conversion rates, content freshness, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights to stakeholders with clear recommendations for next steps.

What We Are Looking For

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Demonstrate

A strong UX/UI foundation: experience with wireframing, prototyping, user research, and usability testing.

A true hands-on approach to content creation and site management, comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the CMS daily.

The ability to translate complex business and program information into simple, action-oriented content that converts.

A data-driven mindset: comfort defining KPIs, running experiments, interpreting analytics, and presenting results.

Strong internal customer service focus, able to interface at all levels of the organization, from operational teams to senior leadership.

A solutions-oriented approach: comfortable identifying problems and driving appropriate fixes without waiting for direction.

Bias for action, strong work ethic, and desire to achieve excellence in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Enthusiasm for collaborative work and a drive to create a positive, high-performance team culture.

Success in this role requires influential partnership with Program, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure vender.amazon.com.mx delivers the best possible experience for potential sellers in Mexico. If you are passionate about using design thinking and content strategy to change the trajectory of small businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the content strategy and UX/UI experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, ensuring prospective sellers in Mexico can easily discover, understand, and act on the information needed to start selling on Amazon.

Design and maintain site user flows, page layouts, and information architecture. Conduct usability reviews and implement improvements that reduce friction in the seller registration funnel.

Plan, publish, and update site content (landing pages, FAQs, educational modules) in coordination with Program, Product, and Commercial teams. Ensure all content reflects current programs and promotions within 48 to 72 hours of changes.

Track and analyze free search traffic sources. Identify organic keyword opportunities, monitor ranking performance, and optimize content for discoverability across search engines and AI-powered surfaces.

Run A/B tests on layouts, messaging, and CTAs. Measure conversion at each funnel stage, report findings to stakeholders, and implement data-backed improvements.

Partner cross-functionally to translate complex business requirements into clear, conversion-oriented site experiences. Serve as the primary point of contact for all content and UX requests related to the Mexico seller acquisition site.

Maintain performance dashboards covering organic traffic, conversion rates, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights with actionable recommendations.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing organic traffic dashboards, identifying which pages are gaining traction and where drop-offs occur. You then jump into the CMS to publish updated landing page content requested by the Program team. Mid-morning, you join a sync with Product Managers to align on an upcoming registration flow change and plan the corresponding site updates. After lunch, you review A/B test results, document findings, and share recommendations with the Commercial team. Your customer is the prospective seller in Mexico who needs a clear, frictionless path from search result to completed registration.

About The Team

The Seller Marketing Team owns the full marketing funnel for Amazon Mexico's seller ecosystem. The mission: make Amazon the first choice for every business in Mexico looking to sell online. The team attracts potential sellers, converts them into registrations, and keeps them engaged and growing. This means working across awareness, acquisition, and retention, always with a bias toward experimentation and measurable impact. The culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and seller-obsessed. Team members take ownership of outcomes end-to-end and partner across product, program, and commercial functions to deliver results

Basic Qualifications


 Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML
 Experience in A/B testing
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
 Bachelor's degree
 Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, Axure, Keynote, and InVision
 Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields
 Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams
 Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
 Experience with a variety of design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Fireworks, Visio, Axure, and Dreamweaver
 3+ years of editor, content strategist, technical writer, or content developer experience

About the job

Overview

About the Role & Team

The Intern will be part of a team responsible for developing market data collection, data research. This will be done by developing models based on historical information that is then verified through telephone interviews and secondary sources. The activities are highly quantitative in nature and requires someone who is looking to further develop their expertise in market sizing and forecasting. We are looking for individuals who are team players and want a professional experience that will give them knowledge of the IT industry.

What You’ll Do


 Primary research: Identify contacts, Schedule interviews, Participate in the interviews with the analyst, Price Collection and others 
 Perform secondary research: Analyst reports, News (Clipping), Financial reports 
 Support the lead analyst with modeled tracker data for market players: Leveraging all the desk research available. 
 Learn the basic tools for the research process: Ferda, KMLA, databases, flat files 
 Support the analyst developing charts, figures, research presentations and quantitative models, work with regional teams. 


What You Bring


 Accounting, Administration, Social Sciences, Mathematics, Engineering (Industrial or Systems with Admin) or Economics background, students in their last 18 months. 
 Be a confident PowerPoint and Excel user to maintain and upgrade Excel-based tools that support various stages of the research. 
 Be able to work independently as well as a team member with other analysts 
 Organizational skills to meet research objectives on tight deadlines 
 Possess a strong interest in learning about the IT industry 
 Highly ethical individual 
 Extremely detail oriented 


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

description:
About the job

EL EQUIPO




El equipo de Marketing Digital es el motor creativo y estratégico que posiciona los eventos en las plataformas más relevantes. Diseñamos campañas digitales que generan awareness, tráfico y conversión, trabajando de la mano con promotores y plataformas globales.




DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO




Como Trafficker Digital, serás responsable de implementar y dar seguimiento a campañas en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify y TikTok, asegurando que cada acción esté alineada con la estrategia y el presupuesto aprobado. Tu rol será clave para maximizar el impacto de nuestras campañas y garantizar resultados medibles.

Estamos en un momento emocionante: la industria del entretenimiento en vivo está creciendo y Ticketmaster lidera esta transformación con estrategias digitales innovadoras. Este puesto te permitirá trabajar con grandes marcas, plataformas globales y eventos que marcan tendencia.







LO QUE HARÁS




Implementar campañas digitales en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify, TikTok y plataformas de Programatic.
Monitorear y controlar la correcta ejecución de campañas según presupuesto y estrategia.
Elaborar reportes de desempeño y gasto de campañas digitales.
Analizar métricas en tiempo real para realizar ajustes y optimizar resultados.
Dar seguimiento a solicitudes de promotores para asegurar cumplimiento de fechas y materiales.
Presentar resultados y cierres de campañas a clientes internos y externos a nivel internacional, Ticketmaste Global, por lo que hablar inglés es indispensable.
Interactuar con ejecutivos de plataformas digitales para resolver dudas y explorar mejoras.
Colaborar con áreas internas para validar estrategias y garantizar la correcta implementación.




LO QUE NECESITAS SABER (o HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS)




Licenciatura en Comunicación, Marketing, Publicidad o afín.
Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en implementación de campañas.
Dominio de plataformas Paid Media (Meta Ads, Google Ads, Spotify, TikTok, Programatic).
Conocimiento en Google Analytics y herramientas de medición.
Inglés B2-C1, indispensable.




TÚ (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

Te apasiona el marketing digital y las tendencias en redes sociales.
Actúas con enfoque en resultados y atención al detalle.
Colaboras activamente con otros equipos y clientes.
Tienes capacidad de análisis y toma de decisiones.
Te adaptas a entornos dinámicos y trabajas bajo presión.










VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de

entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es

conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de

herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una

posición única para cumplir con esa visión.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

Nuestra labor se guía por nuestros valores:

Fiabilidad: Entendemos que los fanáticos y clientes dependen de nosotros para hacer posible sus experiencias en eventos en vivo, y nosotros dependemos los unos de los otros para lograrlo.
Trabajo en equipo: Creemos que el logro individual es insignificante en comparación con el éxito que se puede lograr en equipo.
Integridad: Estamos comprometidos con los más altos estándares morales y éticos en nombre de los innumerables socios y partes interesadas que representamos.
Sentido de pertenencia: Estamos comprometidos a construir una cultura en la que todas las personas puedan ser su yo auténtico, tengan voz igualitaria y oportunidades para prosperar.




OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES




Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. Nos importa el talento, y alentamos las postulaciones de personas sin importar su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, edad, estado de discapacidad o responsabilidades familiares.

About the job

Remote | Medical Aesthetics Marketing | 30-35 Client Portfolio

If you think your job ends when someone clicks an ad, this isn't for you.

We need someone who obsesses over the entire journey: Ad → Landing Page → Email/SMS → Booking → Treatment. We don't celebrate leads. We celebrate people walking through the door.







The Role

You're a full-stack marketer who's deep in Meta and Google ads but understands how everything connects. You can write killer ad copy, optimize a landing page, fix a broken funnel, and explain strategy on a client call.

You'll manage paid advertising for 30-40 medical spa clients and drive the strategy for your portfolio with the support of an Account Manager.







What You Actually Do

Lead Strategy

Run weekly internal team meetings - what's working, what's not, what to test
Analyze full funnel performance: ads, landing pages, follow-up, bookings
Make calls on when to scale, pivot, or pause

Execute Campaigns

Build and optimize Meta and Google campaigns daily
Write ad copy that converts
Test creative angles, audiences, offers, landing pages
Optimize for bookings and treatment rates, not just leads

Think Full Funnel

Fix broken landing pages that aren't converting
Design email/SMS sequences that drive bookings
Understand consumer psychology: What makes someone book their first Botox?
Connect ad spend to actual practice revenue

Collaborate

Partner with Account Manager on client strategy
Join client calls when performance needs strategic intervention
Spot upsell opportunities

✅ Expert in Meta ads, strong in Google Ads - with 3+ years experience and proven results

✅ Understand full-funnel marketing (not just traffic)

✅ Comfortable on client calls explaining strategy

✅ Lead meetings with clear POV, not just data dumps

✅ Collaborate with designers like a creative director

✅ Constant learner who studies competitors and tests new approaches

✅ Care about business outcomes (bookings) not vanity metrics (leads)

What We DON'T Want

❌ Media buyers who optimize in a vacuum

❌ Order-takers waiting to be told what to do

❌ Specialists who can't see the bigger picture







About Tier3 Media

We're a digital marketing agency exclusively serving 100+ medical spas nationwide. We're growth partners who understand the aesthetics industry deeply.

What we offer: Ownership over your portfolio, clear growth path, cutting-edge tools, remote flexibility, competitive pay

description:
About the job

Company Description Click Seguridad Jurídica, SAPI DE CV, SOFOM ENR is a fiduciary institution registered with the Comisión Nacional para la Protección y Defensa de los Usuarios de Servicios Financieros (CONDUSEF). The organization is formed by professionals with extensive experience in fiduciary and financial services. It focuses on providing fiduciary services that help guarantee payment obligations and credits. The company offers comprehensive advisory support for the implementation and establishment of trusts, with personalized attention and tailored solutions. Its mission is to protect clients’ security and interests in every engagement.

Role Description The Compliance Officer is a full-time, on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing compliance programs to ensure adherence to applicable financial, fiduciary, and consumer protection regulations. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring regulatory changes, conducting compliance risk assessments, reviewing and approving internal policies and procedures, and performing periodic audits of operations and documentation. The Compliance Officer will investigate and address potential compliance issues, prepare reports for senior management, and coordinate with legal and operational teams to remediate findings. The role also involves training employees on regulatory requirements, promoting a culture of ethical conduct, and serving as a key point of contact for regulatory inquiries and inspections.

Qualifications

Strong expertise in compliance management, with demonstrated experience in developing, implementing, and monitoring Compliance Management frameworks.
In-depth knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements applicable to financial services, including SOFOME, local financial regulations, consumer protection standards, trusts, and trustees.
Excellent analytical skills to assess compliance risks, interpret complex regulations, and translate them into practical controls and procedures.
Clear and effective communication skills to prepare reports, deliver training, and collaborate with cross-functional teams and regulatory bodies.
Solid understanding of finance, including fiduciary structures, credit operations, and risk management in financial institutions.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field; advanced certifications in compliance or risk management are an advantage.
Proven experience in a compliance, risk, or regulatory role within financial services or fiduciary institutions.
High level of integrity, attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
Proficiency in relevant office and compliance tools; familiarity with Spanish-language regulations and documentation is highly beneficial.

IDC, a global leader in technology market intelligence, is seeking a market researcher to join our team. This role requires a mix of analytical abilities, attention to detail, proficiency in research methodologies, alongside excellent communication skills to convey complex information effectively.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in interpreting data, staying abreast of IT market trends and events, supporting their team with in-depth research, and working collaboratively to meet research objectives.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in supporting the authorship and delivery of IDC’s market intelligence products and services in a rapidly evolving information technology landscape. The role will focus on utilizing the latest market research methodologies and tools to uncover relevant data from internal and external data sources and synthesizing into market research content assets.

What You’ll Do


 Support IDC’s market research agenda by conducting in-depth primary and secondary research into IT markets and their impact on industries, namely energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing. 
 Have in-depth knowledge/experience and understanding in energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing business operations, either through working in these industries or executing consulting/research engagements 
 Track, monitor, and identify IT industry developments to identify and report on market shifts, patterns, and anomalies. 
 Collaborate with internal subject matter expert analysts to achieve research goals and produce deliverables efficiently. 
 Participate in ongoing professional development and contribute to team knowledge sharing. 
 Synthesize raw data into information and meaningful insights and deliver tailored content components and assets that address key business requirements. 
 Contribute to the creation of written research studies and presentations summarizing findings for internal and external stakeholders 


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree required; (business, economics, management information systems, technology marketing, product management or related field).
2-3 years of experience in market research, consulting, or analysis, ideally in the information technology sector, with knowledge in the energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing domain, with a flair toward writing research content.
Previous experience in roles such as market intelligence or competitive intelligence is preferred.
Outstanding written and strong verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with and across teams globally.
Experience with office productivity tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Some experience with any AI tools such as MS CoPilot, Google Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT, or other similar tools.
A strong interest in the IT market, including, but not limited in topics such as AI and data management, cloud platforms, security, enterprise applications, enterprise infrastructure, devices, networking, telecommunications, application development, and services.
Understanding and interest in the application of information technology to industry use cases.
Flexibility to work both independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.
Professional fluency in English.
Hybrid job, 2 times per week at the office.


Preferred Attributes


Experience working with or for technology vendors, IT distributors, or in a market research/consulting firm.
Experience working in or analyzing emerging markets within the technology sector.
Knowledge of business models, go-to-market strategies, and technology adoption patterns in enterprise IT.
Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new marker research methods and tools, analytical mindset, and a collaborative, supportive approach to teamwork.


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

description:
About the job

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To


Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available;Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.


What are we looking for?


Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

description:
About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

TopFoxx | Remote | Full-Time

 

Location: Remote (must work U.S. East Coast hours).

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Hours are flexible. We care about performance, not clocks.

Salary: $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.

Language: Perfect written and spoken English is required (this is non-negotiable), along with a deep understanding of U.S. culture, slang, and social media behavior.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned fashion startup reinventing the sunglasses industry with solution-oriented designs and bold branding. Since 2016, we have grown from a bootstrapped e-commerce brand into a global business serving hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by an engaged community of influencers and creators.

We are not here to follow trends. We create them. Our sunglasses are tangle-free, floatable, foldable, shatter-resistant, and sustainably made, and we are just getting started.

We are a small, lean, founder-led team of fewer than ten people, with only about three of us on marketing. That means there is nowhere to hide and no one to pass the work to. Everyone wears multiple hats, owns real outcomes, and what you build genuinely moves the company. We do not do slow. We move fast, we pivot often, and we only hire A-players who treat the business like their own.




The Role

You will be the main one. This is the person who owns influencer and affiliate marketing end to end at TopFoxx. You are not waiting for a manual or a list of tasks. You are expected to bring the strategy, bring the ideas, and then execute them yourself, fast.

This space changes daily. New creators, new trends, new platform rules. You have to move quickly, test constantly, double down on what converts, and cut what does not. We are not looking for someone who only posts and reports. We are looking for a real executor who is proactive, creative, and obsessed with one thing above all: profitable, converting partnerships.

This is a big opportunity, and we want to be honest with you: it is also real work. We already have a large base of affiliates and creators, but your job is to grow it, activate it, and make it far more profitable. This is not a coast-along role. You will be building, pushing, and problem-solving every single day. For the right person, that is exactly the appeal.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct path into leading the influencer marketing function as it scales.




Why This Is Worth It

Here is the honest pitch. This is not a maintenance job and it is not busywork. Influencer and affiliate marketing is one of the biggest growth levers we have, and we believe this channel can become a multi-million dollar engine for TopFoxx. We are looking for the person who can build that.

We reward outcomes, not hours. If you can show us you can grow this and drive real, profitable revenue, you grow with it. That means a clear path into leadership and compensation that reflects the results you create. The ceiling here is high for someone who actually delivers, and you will be able to point to a business you helped build, not just tasks you completed.

If you want to be a small piece of a big machine, this is not it. If you want real ownership, real upside, and to look back in a year knowing you built something that matters, keep reading.




1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Program (Your Primary Focus)

This is the heart of the role and where most of your time and energy goes. The big one is affiliate. Your job is to make sure the affiliates are converting, the program is profitable, and the numbers in TikTok Shop Seller Center are strong and trending up.

Own TikTok Shop Seller Center day to day. Live in the dashboards, know your numbers cold, and make sure performance is healthy across GMV, conversion, and orders.
Make the affiliate program profitable. Track and grow GMV, revenue per creator, sample-to-sales ROI, and commission costs. Protect margin. Every dollar of product and commission has to earn its return.
Build and manage a pipeline of hundreds to thousands of active TikTok Shop affiliates, and keep them actually posting and selling, not just signing up.
Recruit high-converting creators and live sellers who know how to talk about product and drive sales, not just collect free samples.
Go live and sell yourself. You will host TikTok Lives, get on camera, and sell the glasses directly. Then you bring affiliates on, show them how it is done, and coach them to do the same.
Coordinate TikTok Live schedules with strong sellers, secure Spark Ads permissions, and optimize listings and content angles for maximum GMV.
Watch performance weekly. Scale top converters aggressively, and cut low performers fast.
Keep the data honest. No padded numbers, no inflated reporting. Decisions are only as good as the data behind them.




2. Instagram Influencers

Instagram is the second pillar. Here we work on gifting and affiliate only, so your skill is finding the right people and getting them to convert without a paid budget.

Source Instagram influencers who can actually sell, creators who understand product and know how to drive their audience to buy, not just post a pretty photo.
Run gifting-only and affiliate-only collaborations, and move creators from one gift to repeat posting to consistent affiliate sales.
Rebuild our existing relationships. We have lists of past and dormant influencers. A big part of this role is reigniting those relationships and turning old contacts back into active, converting partners.
Build genuine, consistent relationships so TopFoxx stays top of mind, through thoughtful, regular touchpoints across Instagram and DMs.




3. LTK, Affiliate Platforms & Onboarding Calls

The third pillar is affiliate-driven platforms like LTK, and just as important, getting on calls with creators. This role is not behind a screen all day. You have to be outgoing and genuinely good at talking to people.

Recruit and activate creators on LTK and other affiliate networks (Amazon, affiliate links) who are still actively driving commission-based sales.
Run weekly onboarding calls. You will be on calls regularly, onboarding new influencers, walking them through the program, and getting them excited and set up to post.
Get on calls and close collabs. Be confident and persuasive, build rapport quickly, and convince creators to say yes to working with us, often with gifting only.
Understand creator psychology and motivate influencers to post consistently through relationship, community value, and a clear win for them.




4. Strategy, Reporting & Full Influencer Marketing Scope

Because you own this function, you also handle everything a strong e-commerce influencer marketing lead would handle. Study what bigger e-commerce brands do, then adapt the best of it to a lean, fast-moving team.

Build the strategy. Bring a clear point of view on where influencer and affiliate marketing is going and how TopFoxx wins, then put it into action.
Plan and execute campaigns tied to product launches, holidays, seasonal moments, and major sales events (BFCM, summer, new drops).
Manage content calendars, gifting coordination, sample sends, and follow-ups so nothing slips.
Build weekly performance reports that connect activity to revenue, and use them to decide what to scale and what to kill.
Create simple SOPs, trackers, and playbooks as you go, so the program is repeatable and scalable as the team grows.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and product teams to keep messaging aligned, and step in on urgent launch-related projects when needed.
Stay ahead of trends, new creators, and new affiliate opportunities before competitors do.
Help with wider marketing as needed. With a team this small, marketing is just three people and everyone pitches in. From time to time things will come up across other marketing areas and departments that need a hand. We need someone proactive and solution-oriented who brings energy, jumps in, and helps build this with us rather than sitting idle.




Who You Are

Proactive: You see the gap and fill it. You bring the plan, you do not wait to be told.
A real executor: You move fast, ship daily, and adapt as things change hour to hour.
Analytical and profit-obsessed: You can read a Seller Center dashboard, understand ROI and margin, and turn data into decisions.
Persuasive and outgoing: You love talking to creators, you are comfortable on camera and on calls, and you can sell the partnership and the product.
Relationship-driven: You are a natural connector who builds loyalty and keeps partners coming back.
Organized under pressure: You can juggle hundreds of moving pieces without dropping the ball.




Required Experience & Skills

2+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, preferably in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce / DTC.
Expert, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center mechanics and affiliate programs.
Proven track record of generating real sales through gifting-only or zero-budget strategies.
Comfort with LTK, Amazon, and other affiliate platforms.
Comfortable on camera and hosting TikTok Lives to sell product directly.
Perfect written and spoken English, and a strong understanding of U.S. culture and digital trends. This is genuinely important.
KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.




What You Get

Salary of $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.
A fully remote role on a fast-moving global team.
Real ownership of the influencer and affiliate function, with a path into leadership as it scales.
PTO including vacation, holidays, sick, personal, and mental health days.
Free TopFoxx products and partner brand perks.

About the job

Hello! 👋🏽

At Factorial we're looking for a new Onboarding Specialist for the LATAM Market to help us boost the company to the next level. 🦄

Ready to be part of the challenge?🚀

The Role 📜

As an Onboarding Specialist, you will play a critical role in shaping the first experience our customers have with Factorial. This is not just implementation — this is where customers decide to fully adopt and believe in our product.

You will be responsible for leading end-to-end onboarding processes, ensuring customers successfully implement Factorial and adapt it to their internal HR and operational workflows.

⚠️ Note: This is not an HR onboarding role — it is a consultative, client-facing role that is part of our post-sales process.

One of your biggest challenges will be to deeply understand each client’s processes, identify gaps, and translate their needs into a scalable and effective setup within Factorial — making them feel confident they made the right decision.

What will you be doing:


Own and lead the onboarding journey for new LATAM customers from kickoff to full activation

Identify risks, blockers, and opportunities early, coordinating with internal teams (Product, Support, Sales) to resolve them
Collect and structure customer feedback, turning insights into actionable improvements for Product and CX

Strong ownership & problem-solving mindset: You take full responsibility for your clients’ onboarding success. You proactively identify challenges, align stakeholders, and ensure solutions are implemented — making the client feel you’ve got their back at all times.
Consultative & analytical thinking: You are able to deeply understand client processes and translate them into structured, scalable solutions within the platform.
Customer-centric mindset: You know this is a critical moment in the customer journey, and you focus on delivering an experience that builds trust, engagement, and long-term retention.
Fast learner & product-driven: You quickly become an expert in the product, stay up to date with new features, and feel empowered to ask questions and challenge the status quo to improve how we work.
