title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
About the job

Acerca de Emeritus

En Emeritus creemos que los líderes construyen del mundo un lugar mejor. Nuestra misión es democratizar el acceso a educación de clase mundial, colaborando con las mejores escuelas de negocio del planeta — MIT Sloan, Columbia Business School, Tuck School of Business, entre otras. Ofrecemos cursos, certificados y maestrías en inglés, español, mandarín y portugués, impactando a más de 300,000 estudiantes en +100 países.




Acerca del Puesto

El Marketing Automation Specialist será el arquitecto de los flujos de comunicación digital que guían a los prospectos desde el primer intento de contacto hasta la inscripción en programas de Emeritus. Esta persona será responsable de diseñar, implementar y optimizar journeys automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, gestionar campañas multicanal (email y WhatsApp), y medir el impacto de cada acción con KPIs claros.

El rol requiere una mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados: entender el origen y comportamiento de los prospectos, explorar patrones de interacción, detectar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para maximizar la tasa de inscripción.




Funciones Principales

1. Diseño e Implementación de Flujos Automatizados

• Mapear y comprender las fuentes de prospectos (paid media, orgánico, referidos, alianzas) y sus comportamientos para diseñar customer journeys relevantes.

• Diseñar, construir y lanzar flujos automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio) alineados a cada etapa del funnel.

• Definir lógicas de segmentación, personalización y ramificaciones basadas en comportamiento (aperturas, clics, formularios, tiempo en el funnel).

• Proponer y desarrollar nuevas automatizaciones para mejorar la conversión y la eficiencia operativa del equipo.

• Coordinar con redactores y diseñadores para solicitar los copies y materiales necesarios para cada flujo.




2. Gestión de Campañas y Envíos

• Ejecutar campañas automatizadas y envíos manuales (email y WhatsApp) garantizando correcta segmentación, personalización y calendarización.

• Configurar templates responsivos y asegurar su correcta renderización en múltiples clientes de correo.

• Dar seguimiento a indicadores clave: open rate, CTR, entregabilidad, tasa de bajas y conversión.

• Generar insights accionables a partir del análisis de resultados para iterar y mejorar campañas de forma continua.




3. Medición, Análisis y Optimización con KPIs

• Definir y monitorear KPIs de cada flujo automatizado: tasa de apertura, tasa de conversión por etapa, costo por lead calificado, tiempo promedio en el funnel.

• Generar reportes periódicos de desempeño de campañas y journeys con análisis comparativo.

• Proponer y ejecutar pruebas A/B (asunto, copy, horario de envío, CTA) para optimizar resultados.

• Identificar cuellos de botella en los flujos y proponer mejoras basadas en datos para incrementar el número de inscritos.

• Colaborar en la construcción de dashboards de seguimiento con el equipo de BI o Performance.




4. Gestión de Landing Pages y Contenido

• Desarrollar y publicar landing pages en Contentful (CMS), asegurando alineación con lineamientos de marca y objetivos de conversión.

• Coordinar la correcta implementación de materiales digitales (banners, formularios, UTMs).

• Colaborar en la generación de contenido para campañas (email, WhatsApp, LP) con enfoque en conversión.




5. Coordinación y Trabajo en Equipo

• Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para alinear flujos con objetivos comerciales.

• Apoyar en la ejecución de materiales y campañas para lanzamientos de nuevos programas.

• Gestionar solicitudes derivadas de flujos automatizados (leads, materiales, LPs) con agilidad y criterio.

• Participar activamente en reuniones de planeación, retrospectivas y sesiones de mejora continua.




KPIs de Éxito del Rol

KPI / Métrica Objetivo / Referencia

Tasa de apertura de emails ≥ 25% promedio en flujos clave

Click-Through Rate (CTR) ≥ 3% en campañas de nurturing

Tasa de conversión por etapa del funnel Mejora trimestral sostenida

Número de inscritos generados por flujos automatizados Meta definida por campaña/programa

Entregabilidad de emails ≥ 95% (spam rate < 0.1%)

Tiempo de implementación de nuevos flujos < 5 días hábiles para flujos estándar

Uptime de journeys activos 99% sin interrupciones no planificadas

NPS interno (satisfacción de equipos

colaboradores) ≥ 4/5 trimestral




Requisitos del Candidato

Educación y Experiencia

• Licenciatura en Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Sistemas o afín.

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en Marketing Automation, CRM o Email Marketing.

• Experiencia comprobable con Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder).

• Experiencia en diseño y análisis de flujos de comunicación automatizada orientados a conversión.




Habilidades Técnicas

• Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio — nivel avanzado.

• Conocimiento de AMPscript o SQL para personalización dinámica de contenido (deseable).

• HTML y CSS para maquetación de emails responsivos.

• Manejo de plataformas de mensajería: WhatsApp Business API o similares.

• CMS: Contentful o equivalente para gestión de landing pages.

• Dominio de MS Office / Google Workspace; Excel avanzado para análisis de datos.

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (lectura de documentación técnica y comunicación con equipos globales).




Competencias Clave

• Pensamiento analítico y orientado a datos — toma de decisiones basada en métricas.

• Visión de funnel — capacidad de entender el recorrido del prospecto de inicio a fin.

• Atención al detalle — cero errores en envíos masivos y configuración de journeys.

• Proactividad — capacidad de identificar oportunidades de mejora sin esperar instrucciones.

• Trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con áreas multidisciplinarias.

• Autogestión y manejo del tiempo en modalidad 100% home office.

• Orientación a resultados — enfoque constante en incrementar el número de inscritos.




Deseable (Nice to Have)

• Certificación en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist o Marketing Cloud Consultant).

• Experiencia en sector EdTech o empresas de suscripción con funnels de conversión complejos.

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you’ll be the vital link between ICEYE’s SAR satellite capabilities and our customers across the LATAM region — ensuring every order, from submission to final delivery, runs smoothly and every customer interaction leaves a lasting impression.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world’s largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. About the job

Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $510,000 - $612,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $510,000 - $587,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America's most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn't, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we've built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they're proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You'll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.

Working Within Our Values:

At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.

Your focus of responsibilities will be: 


Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You're responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.
Client: Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we're addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.
People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.
Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We're committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you'll familiarize yourself with Thrive's tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you'll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You'll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you'll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
You've managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You've resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

The Opportunity

Your Impact

Give support to the sales team with information, inputs and dashboards, in Excel, Power Bi and other platforms for decision making, additionally calculate the budget and the variable bonus of the sales team according to the coverage of their quotas. Always look for ways to add value to the reports that are currently delivered, with improvements and automation.

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For? 


Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent Bachelors’ degree 
1 - 2 years of relevant professional experience
Customer focused, adaptable, strong follow up and organizational skills
Clear Communication to all stakeholders (internal and external)
Proficient in full suite of Microsoft Suite of products: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook

Fluent English oral and written communication skills


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.

We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.

description:
About the job

We're looking for a generalist who can sit at the intersection of three disciplines — operational rigor, product clarity, and AI-powered execution. Most companies hire three different people for this. We believe the right Jr. hire can grow into all three with a highly trainable profile.

If you get excited mapping a messy business process, then immediately think about how to automate half of it with AI tools — read on.




Responsibilities

📋 Business Operations
Process Mapping: Interview stakeholders to document how things actually work today (not how they're supposed to).
SOP Creation: Write clear, versioned standard operating procedures that non-technical teammates can follow.
Standardization: Identify inconsistencies across teams and propose unified workflows.
Implementation: Roll out new processes, gather feedback, and iterate until adoption sticks.

🎯 Product Thinking
Problem Framing: Translate vague pain points into scoped problem statements before jumping to solutions.
Prioritization: Use lightweight frameworks (impact vs. effort, RICE, etc.) to decide what to build next.
Requirements: Write clear briefs — user stories, acceptance criteria, success metrics.
Feedback Loops: Talk to internal users after shipping. Measure whether the tool actually helped.
Customer Centric Design: Demonstrate that can understand and layout user workflows and activities to translate into comprehensive processes.

🤖 AI Engineering & Adoption
Tool Exploration: Stay current with the AI ecosystem and evaluate new tools weekly.
Prompt Engineering: Design and iterate on LLM prompts to power internal automations.
Lightweight Builds: Use low-code/no-code platforms (Replit, Retool, Base 44) to ship working prototypes fast.







Qualifications

Must-Haves
High curiosity: You explore new tools before being asked to. You have a list of things you're currently learning.
Structured thinking: You can take a chaotic conversation and distill it into a clear, written summary.
Bias for documentation: You write things down. SOPs, meeting notes, decision logs — it comes naturally.
Hands-on AI experience: You have used low code/no code platforms (Replit, Base 44, or similar) to build or automate something real — not just ChatGPT prompts.
Self-management: You hit deadlines without reminders. You flag blockers early.
Advanced English: Comfortable reading technical docs and writing clearly for global audiences.

Technical Baseline (Jr. Level — we'll help you grow)
Familiar with REST APIs — you can read documentation and make a working call.
Exposure to databases or spreadsheets as data sources.
Basic prompt engineering: you know that system prompts, temperature, and output formatting matter.

Bonus Points
Have built any kind of functional prototypes used for real purposes, real users will be a great extra.
A GitHub repo, Notion workspace, or live demo of something you built or documented from scratch.
Experience writing SOPs or process docs in a previous role or internship.
Exposure to product frameworks: Jobs-to-be-Done, user story mapping, OKRs.
Any experience with workflow automation tools.

description:
About the job

Customer Success Specialist




Acerca de Aldea

Aldea es una plataforma para la gestión y administración de centros educativos. Hoy ayudamos a más de 400 centros (kínderes, guarderías, primarias, centros de terapia, idiomas y deporte) a optimizar su comunicación, administración y procesos pedagógicos.

Nuestra misión es simplificar la operación de los centros educativos, reduciendo su carga administrativa y mejorando la comunicación con padres de familia, para que directores y maestros puedan enfocarse en lo más importante: la educación de los niños.




➡️ ¿Te apasiona esta visión?

¡Genial! Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo y creemos que esta oportunidad puede ser lo que estás buscando. Únete a una empresa 100% mexicana con presencia local y un producto diseñado para las necesidades de miles de centros en Latinoamérica.




➡️ Descripción del puesto

Como Customer Success Specialist, tu misión será asegurar que los centros educativos tengan la mejor experiencia posible con nuestra plataforma. Serás responsable de gestionar una cartera de centros educativos, asegurando su correcta incorporación, adopción y crecimiento dentro de la plataforma Aldea.

Este no es un rol únicamente reactivo: buscamos a alguien que gestione de forma proactiva la relación con sus clientes, identifique riesgos de churn y detecte oportunidades de expansión.

Tu principal objetivo será maximizar la retención, el uso de la plataforma y el crecimiento de tus cuentas.

Realizar onboarding de nuevos clientes mediante videollamadas.
Gestionar cartera de clientes, construyendo relaciones a largo plazo.
Dar seguimiento continuo para asegurar adopción y uso activo de la plataforma.

Recopilar feedback de clientes y compartirlo con Producto y Desarrollo.

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

description:
About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across voice, email, and enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z and Base10 with over $60M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments - where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist, your mission is to connect the dots between user needs, data insights, and product capabilities to help our customers unlock value. You’ll dive deep into our customer operations, partner directly with end users and decision-makers, and shape how HappyRobot’s technology is applied to their most critical challenges.

At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You Will Do


Partnering with customers to understand their workflows, goals, and pain points—often embedding directly with their teams.
Collaborating with Forward Deployment Engineers to scope, prototype, and deliver solutions powered by HappyRobot’s platform.
Identifying and interpreting key datasets that drive customer decision-making, and working to integrate them into robust, scalable pipelines.
Designing and refining user workflows that solve meaningful problems and scale across teams and functions.
Leading training and onboarding sessions, ensuring new users are set up for success and our tools have lasting impact.
Presenting findings and strategy to stakeholders at all levels—from frontline operators to executives.
Driving customer expansion by scoping new use cases and shaping how we grow our footprint within organizations.


Why join us?


Opportunity to work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors.
Rapidly growing and backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, and Base10.
Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.
Work With the Best - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the job

About the Role

As a Travel Designer, you are responsible for transforming each member's travel dreams, preferences, and aspirations into exceptional, tailor-made journeys that feel effortless, thoughtful, and deeply personal.

Working within a Pod that operates as a business unit, you will combine curiosity, creativity, commercial awareness, and outstanding communication skills to design experiences that delight members while contributing to the Pod's commercial success.

You will report directly to the Experience Manager, who provides your day-to-day leadership, sets priorities, and supports your performance and professional growth.

You will partner closely with the Travel Design Lead, who is responsible for establishing travel design standards, coaching the team, and ensuring every itinerary and proposal consistently meets the quality standards.

You will also collaborate closely with the Destination Team, leveraging their expertise to create exceptional journeys while contributing your own insights and feedback to continuously improve destination knowledge, experiences, and recommendations.

Together, you will collaborate across the Pod to deliver the level of personalization, attention to detail, commercial impact, and service excellence.

 




Your Areas of Ownership




Member Understanding

● Collaborate closely with the Experience Manager to develop a deep understanding of each member's travel style, preferences, priorities, and aspirations.

● Demonstrate curiosity by asking the right questions and proactively seeking the context needed to design highly personalized journeys.

● Translate member profiles and insights into thoughtful recommendations that accurately reflect each member's needs, preferences, and expectations.

● Apply empathy, active listening, and exceptional attention to detail to ensure every itinerary feels personal, relevant, and carefully crafted.

● Demonstrate sound judgment by delivering recommendations that are accurate, relevant, and fully aligned with the member's needs, budget, preferences, and expectations.

 

Travel Design Excellence

● Design highly personalized journeys that combine creativity, attention to detail, and operational feasibility.

● Craft itineraries that reflect each member's lifestyle, interests, and travel aspirations.

● Work closely with the Destinations team to combine destination expertise with member insights, creating thoughtfully curated journeys that feel authentic, personalized, and truly exceptional.

● Deliver proposals that feel unique, thoughtful, and tailored to every member.

● Balance inspiration with practicality while maintaining Essentialist's standards of quality and luxury.

● Partner with the Travel Design Lead to continuously elevate the quality, creativity, and consistency of every itinerary and proposal.

● Continuously expand your destination knowledge and seek inspiration to create unforgettable travel experiences.

 

Commercial Impact

● Contribute to revenue growth by identifying opportunities to enrich every itinerary with meaningful experiences and additional services.

● Support trip conversion through timely responses, thoughtful recommendations, and compelling travel proposals.

● Balance creativity with commercial awareness, ensuring recommendations deliver value for both the member and the business.

● Recognize opportunities to surprise and delight members while strengthening long-term loyalty.

 




Destination Collaboration 

● Build strong relationships with the Destination Team to continuously deepen your destination knowledge.

● Partner closely with Destination Specialists to ensure every itinerary reflects local expertise, operational feasibility, and the highest quality standards.

● Share feedback on destinations, suppliers, and experiences to help continuously improve recommendations and travel content.

● Proactively identify gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement and collaborate with the Destination Team to strengthen future itineraries.

● Contribute to building and evolving destination's knowledge by sharing learnings and insights from your member interactions.

 

Operational Excellence

● Respond promptly to member requests and internal priorities, maintaining speed without compromising quality.

● Manage multiple trips simultaneously while consistently meeting turnaround expectations and service standards.

● Translate member needs into clear, structured, and actionable plans for the Operations team.

● Build accurate, complete, and operationally feasible itineraries by working closely with the Destination Team and leveraging their expertise.

● Maintain exceptional attention to detail across every stage of the travel design process, ensuring every proposal meets the quality standards.

 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

● Partner closely with your Experience Manager, Operations Executives, Travel Design Lead, and Destination Team to deliver exceptional member experiences.

● Collaborate with the Destination Team to ensure every itinerary reflects local expertise, operational feasibility, and the highest quality standards.

● Proactively share feedback, identify gaps, and suggest improvements to destination content, supplier recommendations, and travel experiences, helping continuously strengthen the destination knowledge.

● Maintain clear, proactive, and accurate communication with the Operations Executives, ensuring all information is transferred seamlessly to enable flawless trip execution.

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

About the Role

VIAS is looking for a Growth Marketing Specialist to help drive pipeline growth across key Business Units by turning strategy into high-impact execution.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional marketing role for someone who can translate technical solutions into compelling campaigns, content, and digital experiences that generate demand. You will work across multiple channels and initiatives, including email, social media, landing pages, webinars, events, outbound support, and performance tracking.

You will also be expected to use AI tools confidently and practically to improve the speed, quality, and scale of marketing execution. We are looking for a marketer who combines strong execution skills with commercial thinking, digital fluency, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across different parts of the business.




Role Objective

Drive pipeline growth by translating technical solutions into high-performing marketing programs across assigned Business Units. This role connects strategy to execution across campaigns, content, events, digital channels, and reporting, ensuring marketing initiatives are aligned to revenue goals and delivered effectively.




Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation and Campaign Execution

Execute marketing campaigns across assigned Business Units, ensuring strategy is translated into coordinated, multi-channel execution. Support campaign planning, manage timelines, and ensure campaigns launch on time with consistent messaging across all channels.

Help deploy and optimize campaigns across email marketing, social media, web and landing pages, outbound sequences, webinars, and event follow-up. Coordinate with internal stakeholders from each Business Unit to align priorities, messaging, launches, and deadlines.




Content Development and Channel Adaptation

Create, adapt, and repurpose content for different formats and channels, ensuring technical solutions are communicated clearly and effectively to the right audiences.

Develop content for email campaigns, LinkedIn and other social channels, landing pages, website content, webinars, and outbound support. Adapt messaging appropriately for each channel while maintaining consistency with campaign objectives and brand positioning.

Work with external design and video partners to brief, coordinate, and deliver campaign assets.




Webinar, Event, and Content Series Support

Support the planning and execution of strategic marketing initiatives such as webinars, industry events, customer events, podcast episodes, and technical content series.

Coordinate timelines, materials, logistics, follow-up communications, and content distribution to ensure these initiatives contribute to lead generation and pipeline development. Help connect each initiative to the wider campaign flow, including promotion, registration, follow-up, nurturing, and post-event repurposing.




Podcast and Repurposed Content Execution

Support the production and promotion of podcast episodes and technical content series, including scheduling, content preparation, and post-launch distribution.




Turn long-form content into a consistent stream of campaign assets, including social posts, email content, blog content, landing page copy, and outbound support messaging, maximizing content value across channels.




CRM, Attribution, and Performance Support

Support the accuracy and effectiveness of campaign tracking and marketing reporting by helping maintain clean data and strong attribution practices across CRM and campaign platforms.




Help maintain CRM data accuracy in Zoho, ensure correct campaign attribution, support lead tracking and reporting, and build simple dashboards or reporting views to monitor campaign performance. Analyze results and identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, conversion rates, and overall campaign effectiveness.




Lead Scoring, Segmentation, and Intent Data Support

Support the refinement of lead scoring and segmentation practices by working with Marketing and Sales to improve lead quality and campaign relevance.

Help align MQL criteria with Sales, analyze engagement behavior, and use tools to improve targeting, sequencing, and prioritization based on intent and engagement.




AI-Enabled Marketing Execution

Use AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of marketing execution across content creation, campaign ideation, research, segmentation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.




Apply AI to repurpose technical content, support message testing, accelerate research and summarization, improve campaign productivity, and identify opportunities for smarter automation across the marketing function. Use good judgment to ensure outputs remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with brand and business goals.




What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently turning strategy into execution across multiple Business Units, keeping campaigns and content moving, and helping Marketing contribute more effectively to pipeline growth.

A strong performer in this role will launch campaigns on time, deliver high-quality content across channels, improve the connection between campaigns, events, and follow-up, contribute to better reporting and attribution discipline, and use AI to increase productivity without compromising quality.




KPIs

Performance in this role will be measured through a combination of business impact and execution quality, including pipeline contribution, campaign delivery, content output, conversion performance, event and webinar contribution, and CRM/reporting accuracy.

Key measures include marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced pipeline, campaign launch timeliness, number of campaigns executed across assigned Business Units, content pieces delivered per campaign, social media consistency aligned to campaign activity, lead-to-MQL conversion, MQL-to-SQL conversion, landing page conversion rates, leads generated from webinars and events, post-event follow-up performance, attribution accuracy, and reporting completeness.




Required Experience and Skills

We are looking for a marketer with a strong mix of execution, content development, campaign coordination, commercial thinking, and digital fluency.

You should bring experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or campaign execution. You should be comfortable creating and adapting content across email, social, web, and event-related formats, and confident managing campaigns from planning through launch and follow-up.




You should also have experience working across multiple stakeholders and priorities, familiarity with CRM and campaign reporting tools, and strong organizational skills with close attention to detail. An analytical mindset is important, along with the ability to interpret campaign results and identify improvement opportunities.

Practical experience using AI tools to improve marketing execution, content production, research, segmentation, and performance analysis is required.

Experience with platforms such as Mailchimp, Zoho, LinkedIn, IA for lead generation and ZoomInfo will be a strong advantage.




Preferred Background

Experience in technical, engineering, industrial, software, or solutions-based B2B environments would be highly valued. Experience supporting webinars, events, podcasts, or technical content series is also a plus.

Candidates who thrive in lean, fast-moving environments and are comfortable taking ownership across a broad marketing scope will be especially well suited to this role.




Who You Are

You are a proactive marketer who knows how to make things happen. You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution and can keep multiple projects moving without losing attention to detail. You are commercially minded, organized, curious, data-aware, and confident working with technical subject matter.

You are also comfortable using AI as a practical tool to improve how marketing gets done. You do not wait for perfect conditions to execute. You bring structure, momentum, and ownership.




Additional Requirements:

Must be based in Mexico

Valid visa required for occasional travel to the United States and Canada

100% proficiency in English (written and reading comprehension required)

Why Join VIAS

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in a marketing team that is closely connected to business growth. You will work across multiple Business Units, contribute directly to pipeline development, and help shape how modern marketing execution scales through better processes, stronger content, smarter campaigns, and effective use of AI.




If you are looking for a role where you can combine campaigns, content, digital execution, performance awareness, and business impact in a hands-on B2B environment, this role offers real scope and visibility.

About the job

About Us

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

We are not a fund. We are a club. No blind pools, no lock-ups, no marketing dressed up as deal flow. Every member chooses what they back, and we handle everything else - sourcing, diligence, SPV formation, legal, reporting, and the live community that makes the whole thing run.

What You Will Do:

The CRM Coordinator is the operational backbone of our member and prospect pipeline. You will own the integrity and performance of our CRM - ensuring every contact, deal stage, and communication touchpoint is accurate, timed, and purposeful.

This is not a data-entry role. We need someone who understands why the data matters, takes ownership of process breakdowns before anyone else notices them, and continuously improves how we track and engage our community. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations to ensure no relationship falls through the cracks.

About the job

About United Credit




United Credit helps healthcare providers grow their practices by making patient financing simple.




Unlike single-lender financing companies, United Credit gives providers access to multiple financing options through one application, helping more patients get approved while allowing providers to offer financing that fits a wider range of credit profiles. Our merchant partners rely on us not just for financing, but for responsive service, industry expertise, and a true partnership focused on helping their businesses grow.




We’re a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company where ideas become action quickly. We value accountability, collaboration, and people who take ownership of their work. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and making a measurable impact every day, you’ll fit right in.




Position Summary




The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving growth within an assigned portfolio of healthcare providers. Through consultative account management, strategic business reviews, staff training, performance analysis, and relationship development, the BDM helps providers increase financing utilization, improve patient conversion, and maximize the value of their partnership with United Credit. Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role is about growing and protecting an existing book of business, not new-account hunting.




Essential Responsibilities




● Conduct business reviews with assigned merchants using Salesforce dashboards and portfolio analytics to identify growth opportunities.

● Identify underperforming accounts and develop action plans to increase funded volume and merchant activation.

● Train providers and office staff on financing best practices, patient conversation scripts, and program utilization.

● Increase merchant activation and application utilization across the assigned territory.

● Analyze funding trends within the portfolio and recommend strategies to improve loan volume and share of wallet.

● Establish and maintain executive relationships with owners, providers, office managers, and practice administrators.

● Educate merchants on UC programs, benefits, rates, and compliance requirements to ensure a high level of program knowledge.

● Protect merchant retention by proactively identifying competitive threats and addressing provider concerns before they become churn risk.

● Collaborate with Enrollment Specialists to ensure a smooth merchant handoff after activation.

● Partner with Operations to resolve merchant issues quickly and maintain a high standard of merchant satisfaction.

● Introduce program changes and enhancements to assigned accounts, including new lender additions, pricing tiers, or platform features.

● Maintain working knowledge of the patient and healthcare financing industry, including competitor offerings (Cherry, CareCredit, Proceed Finance, HFD, Alphaeon, and similar providers), so you can speak credibly to how United Credit compares.

● Represent the company at industry trade shows and meetings, as needed.

● Perform other duties as assigned.




Performance Metrics (KPIs)

● Monthly funded loan volume within assigned portfolio

● Active merchant percentage

● Merchant utilization rate (applications per active merchant)

● Merchant retention and reactivation

● Share of wallet within assigned accounts

● Business reviews completed

● Training sessions conducted

● Salesforce activity completion




What Success Looks Like

● You build trusted relationships with healthcare providers.

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and identify growth opportunities within your portfolio.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● 2+ years of account management, portfolio management, or relationship management experience required; experience in healthcare sales, patient financing, medical sales, or practice development is a strong plus.

● Excellent phone and communication skills (50+ calls per day, 2+ hours of talk time daily).

● Consultative selling and solution-selling skills, with the ability to build and execute account growth plans rather than simply respond to requests.

● Ability to handle provider communications in a friendly, professional, and timely manner across phone, email, and text.

● Ability to be both a team player in a collaborative environment and an independent contributor.

● Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt as the competitive landscape shifts.

● Strong time management and territory management skills.

● Expert use of computers and typing, with knowledge of Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.

● Fluent, professional-level written and verbal English skills.

● Work experience utilizing Salesforce or a comparable CRM, including dashboards and portfolio analytics.

● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field, preferred.




Work Location & Hours

● Fully remote position open to international candidates, with preference for Mexico-based candidates.

● Full-time.

About the job

Enrollment Specialist - Inside Sales, Healthcare Financing




About United Credit




United Credit helps healthcare providers grow their practices by making patient financing simple.




Unlike single-lender financing companies, United Credit gives providers access to multiple financing options through one application, helping more patients get approved while allowing providers to offer financing that fits a wider range of credit profiles. Our merchant partners rely on us not just for financing, but for responsive service, industry expertise, and a true partnership focused on helping their businesses grow.




We’re a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company where ideas become action quickly. We value accountability, collaboration, and people who take ownership of their work. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and making a measurable impact every day, you’ll fit right in.




Position Summary




The Enrollment Specialist is responsible for generating new merchant enrollments by engaging healthcare providers, qualifying opportunities, guiding practices through the enrollment process, and creating a seamless onboarding experience. Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role serves as the first impression of United Credit and plays a critical role in growing our provider network. This is a high-activity, performance-driven inside sales role focused primarily on new enrollments, with a secondary responsibility of reactivating assigned accounts.




Essential Responsibilities




● Own the entire enrollment pipeline from initial outreach through underwriting approval.

● Work consumer-sourced leads where a patient has inquired about financing through United Credit but their provider is not yet enrolled: proactively contact the provider by phone and email, let them know a patient is actively seeking financing, and pitch enrollment in the United Credit platform.

● Make outbound calls daily and respond to inbound leads in a timely manner, maintaining high speed-to-lead standards since providers can choose a competitor within minutes.

● Focus on reaching decision-makers (owners, office managers, providers) and qualify opportunities through meaningful conversations that lead to next steps.

● Consistently overcome objections from providers currently using competitors such as Cherry, CareCredit, Proceed Finance, and HFD.

● Guide providers step-by-step through the enrollment process, including sending the digital enrollment link and clearly communicating required documents (driver’s license, proof of banking, 3 months of bank statements, and medical/business license).

● Ensure all documentation is accurate and complete, then submit applications and move accounts to underwriting for approval.

● Create urgency around provider onboarding to reduce enrollment cycle time.

● Set qualified appointments for Business Development Managers, confirm attendance, and position calls as valuable (training, growth, increased approvals).

● Complete 5-10 meaningful follow-ups daily on incomplete enrollments, missing documents, and no-response prospects, maintaining persistence without being pushy.

● Collaborate closely with Business Development Managers to ensure a seamless transition after activation.

● Contact assigned accounts to reintroduce United Credit, highlight program improvements, and encourage submission of new applications.

● Log all activity in Salesforce with detailed notes and next steps, and keep a clean, prioritized pipeline while managing multiple accounts simultaneously.

● Set and meet weekly and monthly enrollment and appointment targets, contributing to overall loan volume growth.

● Perform other duties as assigned.




Performance Metrics (KPIs)

● Calls: 50+ daily

● Talk Time: 2+ hours daily (live conversations only; voicemail/hold time does not count)

● Live Conversations: 8-12 per day

● Appointments Set: 2-4 daily, 10-20 per week

● Follow-Ups: 5-10 daily

● New merchant enrollments and enrollment cycle time

● Enrollment-to-activation conversion rate




What Success Looks Like

● You build trusted relationships with healthcare providers.

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and keep your pipeline moving.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● Strong phone presence with the ability to drive high call volume and meaningful talk time.

● Consultative, relationship-driven sales approach rather than a transactional one; comfort with solution selling.

● Excellent follow-up discipline and a sense of urgency, given how quickly providers can choose a competing financing option.

● Ability to manage and prioritize a multi-account sales pipeline independently.

● Comfort working in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with documentation.

● Coachable, consistent, and self-motivated, even on slow days.

● Healthcare sales, medical sales, or patient financing experience is a strong plus.




Work Location & Hours

● Fully remote position open to international candidates, with preference for Mexico-based candidates.

● Full-time.

About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly




Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand—we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we're investing in a new capability: an AI-powered Consumer Intelligence Hub that continuously transforms consumer signals into better business decisions.

Rather than relying on traditional research, we're building a proprietary intelligence system that combines first-party data, social conversations, creator communities, AI and strategic thinking to guide Product, Brand, Growth and Retail.

We're looking for someone to lead that capability.




The Opportunity




This is not a traditional Consumer & Market Insights role.

You won't spend your time commissioning surveys and writing research reports.

Instead, you'll build and own Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence function, working at the intersection of consumer understanding, AI and business strategy.

Your mission is simple: Turn consumer signals into better business decisions.

Working alongside an external AI Intelligence Architect and the executive team, you'll help build one of the first AI-native Consumer Intelligence capabilities in beauty.




Key Responsibilities




Build Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Framework




Define and continuously refine Sarelly's proprietary consumer taxonomy.
Organize consumer signals around business questions rather than platforms.
Ensure our AI systems are trained to identify meaningful consumer patterns instead of simply reporting data.
Continuously improve the quality and relevance of our intelligence model.










Define the AI Intelligence Architect




You'll lead the building of the technical infrastructure: 

Define how raw consumer data should be categorized and tagged.
Brief AI workflows and prompting frameworks.
Validate AI outputs
Identify new data sources that should be integrated into the system.










Translate Intelligence into Business Recommendations




You'll synthesize consumer intelligence into executive recommendations.

Your recommendations will directly influence:

Product Innovation
Franchise Development
Marketing
Creator Strategy
CRM
Retail










What Success Looks Like




Identify emerging consumer needs before competitors.
Translate consumer language into stronger messaging.
Identify product innovation opportunities earlier.
Improve creator selection and content strategy.
Make faster, evidence-based business decisions.










Become the Internal Expert on Latina Consumers




Help Sarelly develop the deepest understanding of Latina beauty consumers in the industry.

This includes understanding differences across:

Cultural identities
Heritage groups
Beauty routines
Consumer language
Shopping behaviors
Generations
Geographic markets
Emerging cultural trends

Rather than treating the Latina consumer as one audience, you'll help us understand the nuances that drive relevance.




Build a Learning Organization




Champion a culture of curiosity across the company. Help teams move from reporting observations to generating insights and making better business decisions.




Required Experience




2-3 

years in Consumer Insights, Innovation.
Experience working with multicultural or diverse consumer audiences.
Strong qualitative and strategic thinking skills.
Experience translating consumer research into business recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish.










Preferred Experience




Strong preference for candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

Beauty or personal care
Consumer packaged goods
Creator economy
Community-led brands
Consumer innovation
Consumer segmentation
U.S. Hispanic / Latina consumers
Mexican and U.S. markets

Experience across different Latina sub-communities and target demographics is highly valued.




AI Requirements (Must Have)




We are intentionally building an AI-native Consumer Intelligence function.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be highly AI-literate.

You should be comfortable:

Working daily with Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools.
Developing prompts and AI workflows.
Validating AI-generated insights.

Curiosity about AI and willingness to experiment are essential.

This is a rare opportunity to build the Consumer Intelligence function from the ground up.

The old model, broken manual follow-up loops, reps buried in busywork, is being replaced by a closed-loop system that handles the grind, so sales reps can focus on what they do best: selling and closing. Dealerships grow. The category is moving fast, and this team is right at the centre of it.




This is a pivotal moment. The company is transitioning from build mode to scale mode, and the category around AI-driven automotive sales infrastructure is exploding. If you want to join a team that's already delivering real results and help take it to the next level, the timing couldn't be better.




In This Role, You’ll:




Be the hands-on content creator behind the company’s organic social presence. Your day-to-day is the full content creation loop: editing footage, writing copy, publishing across platforms, engaging the community, and learning from the data to make the next piece better. You’ll also contribute to the editorial direction alongside the Director of Media.

Content Creation (~75%)

Editing raw footage into scroll-stopping short-form social media content, this is the bulk of the role

Video editing proficiency: you can take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging short-form content

Copywriting ability for hooks, captions, scripts, and CTAs

You’ve never edited short-form video for social media or feel uncomfortable in an editing-heavy role

About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.






About the Role


JumpCloud is building an AI-first GTM engine designed to scale pipeline generation through automation, intelligent workflows, and operational leverage. This role will focus on the next evolution of outbound execution by combining AI, automation, data orchestration, and modern GTM tooling to build scalable outbound systems that improve efficiency, personalization, and pipeline generation.




This is a hands-on builder role focused on deploying production-ready workflows, not just experimenting with AI tools. You will partner closely with Marketing, Sales Development, and Operations leadership to create agentic outbound programs that connect data, AI, sequencing, enrichment, and engagement systems into a unified outbound motion.




You will help operationalize how modern outbound gets built at scale.







What You'll Be Doing:


Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity.







Core Objectives:Build Agentic Outbound Systems



Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration






Operationalize AI at Scale





Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools






Improve Outbound Efficiency





Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability






Accelerate Pipeline Generation





Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration






Ship Fast and Iterate





Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact







We're Looking For:


A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals.




Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity.







Required Qualifications:


GTM Systems & Operations








Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms.








Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms.








Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management.








In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency.









AI & Automation








Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation.








Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems.








Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes.








Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus.









Builder Mentality








Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration.








Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly.








Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale.









Cross-Functional Collaboration








Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly.








Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.









Operating Style








Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action.








Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve.








Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact.


















Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. 




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.
