About the job

About Skift

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.




Why This Role Matters

Reporting to the Ad Operations Manager, the Campaigns Operations Coordinator plays a key role in the day-to-day administration and execution of Skift’s advertising and sponsorship campaigns.

By working closely with Sales and Creative teams, this role ensures campaigns are set up accurately, launched on time, and tracked with care. Your attention to detail and organized approach directly supports campaign delivery and advertiser satisfaction.




The Opportunity

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and organized professional with experience in digital campaign administration and ad operations support.

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with ad platforms and internal systems, communicates clearly across teams, and takes pride in keeping campaigns running smoothly from setup through completion.




Some of What You’ll Do

Campaign Setup & Administration

Support the end-to-end setup and trafficking of direct-sold digital campaigns in Google Ad Manager
Enter and maintain line items, targeting parameters, creative uploads, and placements accurately
Conduct pre-launch quality checks to ensure campaigns are configured correctly before going live

Campaign Monitoring & Reporting

Track daily pacing and flag delivery issues or discrepancies to the appropriate team members
Pull and organize campaign performance data to support regular reporting
Maintain accurate records of campaign status, delivery, and changes throughout the flight

Technical & Operational Support

Assist with implementation and QA of third-party tags, pixels, and UTM parameters
Follow and uphold naming conventions and reporting hygiene across all campaigns
Support newsletter sponsorship deployment (HubSpot preferred) and podcast ad operations
Help coordinate retargeting campaign setup under the guidance of senior team members

Cross-Team Coordination

Communicate with Sales and Creative teams to gather campaign assets and resolve setup questions
Support delivery data verification for billing and invoicing purposes
Escalate technical issues or platform discrepancies to the appropriate internal contacts




What You’ll Bring

2–3 years of experience in ad operations, campaign coordination, or digital media administration
Working knowledge of Google Ad Manager (required)
Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as targeting, pacing, impressions, and creative specs
Experience with third-party tag implementation and tracking pixels is a plus
Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
Clear communicator who can follow processes and flag issues proactively
Able to manage multiple tasks and campaigns simultaneously in a remote work environment




Success Metrics

Accurate and timely campaign setup with minimal errors
Campaigns launched on schedule with all assets and tracking in place
Consistent and organized campaign records and reporting hygiene
Proactive communication with team members when issues or gaps are identified
Reliable support for delivery data and invoicing alignment




What We Offer

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company
Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence
Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment




How We Work

Skift is a remote-first, globally distributed company. We value clarity, accountability, and strong documentation to stay aligned across time zones.




How To Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter sharing why you’re interested and how your experience aligns with Skift.

Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world.

If selected, a Skift team member will reach out to schedule next steps.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Whether we are recruiting the next great candidate for our company, building out new programs, or refining our current operations, Employee Success is passionate about the design, development and delivery of a world-class employee experience, which allows Salesforce to deliver a world-class customer experience in the market.

About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across voice, email, and enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z and Base10 with over $60M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments - where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

At HappyRobot, our partners are a core growth engine — but only if we're rigorous about which opportunities we chase and disciplined about setting partners up to win.

We're looking for a Partnerships Strategy & Enablement Lead to build the system that turns raw partner-sourced opportunities into a prioritized, well-scoped pipeline, and to build the enablement that lets partners qualify, sell, and deploy on their own.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of strategy, commercial structuring, and partner operations. You'll be the person who decides what's worth pursuing, builds the case for it, and makes sure it actually gets delivered.

What We're Looking For


1–3 years of experience in Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Operations, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Chief of Staff, or a high-growth startup
Exceptional structured problem-solving skills
Highly analytical with strong Excel / Google Sheets modeling abilities

Strong project management and organizational skills
High ownership mentality — you naturally take responsibility beyond your job description
Comfortable working with senior executives
Extremely curious and fast learner

What You'll Do


Partner directly with the Head of LATAM on the region's highest-priority strategic initiatives — market research, competitive analysis, business cases, and financial models to support expansion into new markets, customers, and partnerships
Build and continuously improve LATAM's operating cadence: dashboards and reporting across sales, deployments, customers, recruiting, and operations, plus the documentation, processes, and playbooks that let the team scale
Drive cross-functional execution — coordinating Sales, Deployments, Engineering, Marketing, Recruiting, and Finance to move initiatives from idea to execution, unblock dependencies, and keep the team focused on what matters most
Support enterprise GTM and customer projects, including account strategy, opportunity sizing, customer discovery, ROI analysis, and executive-ready materials

Why join us?


Opportunity to work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors

Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of projects and ship fast
Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup
Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, vision coverage
Work With the Best - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it's not "your job." If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don't wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for "just fine." We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it's a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody's watching.

We are "majos"

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. "Majo" is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We're building something ambitious, and it's easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We're running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; 'exceptional performance is the passing grade.' Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that's how we win.

First-Principles Thinking 

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don't copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It's how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
About the job

Junior Strategist 

Remote · Reports to Pod Leader/YouTube Strategist

Knwn Local 

Apply now: https://righteous-chestnut-b59.notion.site/dbf353fd5db582eca4790187f228454a?pvs=105




About Knwn Local: We build organic content brands for real estate agents. YouTube channels, email newsletters, social content. Full service, done for you. We work with 100+ agents across North America and we are scaling fast. Our clients close $10M to $1B+ in sales a year and many of them call their channel the best marketing investment they have ever made. We are scaling from 100 clients toward 300, then 1,000+, and the team has grown past 65 people on the way there.




Role: The Jr. Strategist exists because a Pod Leader cannot run 15+ channels alone. The ideas have to be found, the briefs have to be built, and the scripts and thumbnails have to be reviewed before anything reaches a client. That is this role.




You work directly under a Pod Leader who owns the client relationship, leads the strategy calls, and has final say on everything. Your job is to own the work that makes their job possible. The stronger your briefs, the sharper your reviews, and the more you understand each client, the better the pod performs.




This is also a team role. You are working alongside writers, editors, and designers who are all building toward the same goal. How the content performs is tied to what you bring.




Responsibilities

Handle ideation for 15+ channels. Research ideas, find outliers, write title options, build the thumbnail concept and direction, write the logline, and complete the video outline.
Review every script before it reaches a client. Check the hook, the CTAs, and the conclusion. If something is off, fix it or flag it clearly.
Review every thumbnail before it is finalized. Evaluate the concept, the strategy, and whether it earns the click. If the direction is wrong, say why.
Be on every client call with your Pod Leader. Take real-time notes, add ideas into Notion as the conversation happens, and have a clean action item list ready when the call ends.
Show up to team meetings knowing your numbers and ready to contribute.




Results

60%+ of all ideas for your team are created by you
90%+ of ideas you create are approved by the Pod Leader on the first pass
90%+ of scripts reviewed before they reach a client
90%+ of thumbnails reviewed before they ship
Brief quality improves consistently over time, tracked through Pod Leader feedback




Requirements

Built and managed content across multiple channels or clients simultaneously, where the details were yours to get right
Developed a repeatable ideation process using data, not just gut feel -- can walk through how they find outlier ideas and what makes them confident in one
Reviewed creative work (scripts, thumbnails, or similar) before it reached an audience and caught problems others missed
Worked inside a team-based production environment where missing a deadline affected other people downstream
Can demonstrate a real understanding of YouTube: how videos get traction, what makes a hook land, and how a video generates a lead




Who This Is For: This role is genuinely creative. You are coming up with ideas for 15+ channels every month and those ideas have to keep working for each client over time. You are not just generating volume. You are staying curious about what is performing, watching what other channels are doing, and bringing back ideas that are actually good.




You also have to be organized. There is a lot of independent work here and none of it waits for someone to remind you. You are tracking briefs, reviews, and deadlines across multiple clients at once.




If you like doing deep research, get genuinely excited about finding a concept you know is going to work, and can keep that level of attention across a full client load, this role will feel like a good fit.




It's not for you if you need a lot of direction to get started, want to be making final decisions right now, or do not want to work closely as part of a team.




Schedule: Monday through Friday, core hours aligned with 8am to 5pm Eastern. Some client calls may require flexibility within that window. (Some hours are flexible based on timezone)




Location: Fully remote. Open to candidates internationally




Compensation: $36,000 to $42,000 base salary depending on experience. Reviewed annually. Compensation grows with performance. We are building a performance model where hitting your numbers and continuing to take on more gets rewarded directly. All positions start with a 30 to 90 day paid trial.




Our Core Values

Relentless Curiosity - Learning never stops. You enjoy growth personally and professionally.
Kind Candor - Honest feedback both internally and externally is a gift we gladly receive.
Extreme Ownership - Be the type of person people can always count on, both internally and externally.
Operational Excellence - Be the person who spots what is broken and makes it better.




How to Apply: 

Apply here: https://righteous-chestnut-b59.notion.site/dbf353fd5db582eca4790187f228454a?pvs=105




Pay $36K to 42K USD a year

- Planificar y lanzar campañas de email alineadas con la estrategia comercial y el calendario de la marca.

- Marca sólida y en crecimiento, con alto volumen de datos y margen de optimización.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

At DiDi, we are building something special, and we want the world to know it. We believe in creativity, connection, and the power of a killer digital strategy. We’re looking for a creative, internet-obsessed, and driven Social Media Intern to join our Regional Social Media Marketing team.

If you live on TikTok, know exactly why a specific audio is trending, and understand how community drives brand loyalty, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

In this role, you'll be...

As our Social Media Intern, you won't just be fetching coffee or scheduling boring posts. You will be in the driver’s seat of our community presence, helping us scale our hyper-local footprints and collaborating with incredible creators. You will work closely with our core marketing team and external agency partners to turn big ideas into viral realities.

Key Responsibilities


Community Management: Be the voice of our brand. You’ll engage with our followers, spark conversations, and turn casual scrollers into brand evangelists.
Influencer Marketing Management: Source, approve and review local and macro-influencers. You'll manage the outreach pipeline and ensure creators deliver content that hits the mark in partnership with our influencer agency. 
City-Based Campaigns: You will assist in brainstorming and executing hyper-targeted, city-specific campaigns to build local buzz and offline-to-online engagement.
Agency Coordination: Act as a bridge between our internal team and our paid media agency. You'll help coordinate our boosting/paid social efforts to ensure our top-performing organic content gets the budget it deserves.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Unapologetic Passion: You genuinely love social media and influencer culture. You understand the nuances of different platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) and what makes content shareable.
A Creative Mindset: You can spot trends before they hit the mainstream and know how to adapt them to a brand voice.
Organization Skills: Juggling multiple influencers and city campaigns requires a sharp eye for detail and great time management.
Analytical Curiosity: Note: While basic knowledge of social analytics is a massive plus to help us track our social media impact, it is not mandatory. We are more than happy to teach you the ropes if you bring the data-curious mindset!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

About The Job

Are you passionate about transforming customer data into meaningful consumer experiences? As a Product Owner – CRM & Customer Data, you will lead the strategy and evolution of critical marketing technology products that power customer engagement, personalization, identity management, and data activation across digital channels.

In this role, you will own the roadmap, backlog, and value realization of CRM, Customer Data Platform (CDP), and Identity Management capabilities. Working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, you will help create seamless, trusted, and personalized consumer experiences while enabling scalable growth through first-party data.

You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders across marketing, digital, analytics, technology, privacy, and customer engagement teams to ensure data-driven capabilities deliver measurable business impact.

About You What You’ll Do


Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for CRM, Identity Management, and CDP platforms. 
Prioritize features, enhancements, and user stories that maximize business value and customer outcomes. 
Drive consumer data unification, segmentation, profile orchestration, and activation initiatives. 
Collaborate with technical and business teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality digital solutions. 
Establish and monitor key product and data quality metrics, including profile accuracy, match rates, completeness, and activation readiness. 
Support customer lifecycle, retention, and personalization use cases through trusted first-party data strategies. 


About You

You are a customer-focused product professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and turning data capabilities into tangible business outcomes. You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and can effectively navigate cross-functional environments where business, technology, and privacy considerations intersect.

Must-Have Qualifications


Experience leading digital products as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Sr. Product Analyst, Martech Product Owner, or similar role. 
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, backlog management, prioritization, and user story development. 
Hands-on experience with Customer Data Platforms, particularly Treasure Data CDP or similar solutions. 
Solid understanding of CRM ecosystems, consumer engagement programs, customer lifecycle management, and personalization strategies. 
Knowledge of identity management concepts, including profile unification, identifiers, account linking, and recognition models. 
Familiarity with customer data architectures, event-driven data models, and digital activation ecosystems. 
Experience working with tools such as Jira and Confluence. 


Nice-to-Have Qualifications


Understanding of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, or Tag Commander. 
Exposure to Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe DAM, Salsify, or related digital experience platforms. 
Knowledge of APIs, data integrations, governance frameworks, and access management principles. 
Experience working within first-party data, consent-aware marketing, and privacy-conscious digital environments. 
Portuguese language skills. 


What Makes You Successful


Strong business acumen and customer-centric mindset. 
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills. 
Ability to balance technical, commercial, and compliance considerations. 
Analytical thinking with a focus on measurable outcomes. 
Comfortable working in dynamic, cross-functional, and fast-paced environments. 
Proactive, structured, and accountable approach to product ownership. 


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Marketing, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.

About Us

At Danone Mexico, we work with a deep conviction people's health and the health of the planet are connected. Under our global vision One Planet. One Health., we build a healthier future through food and beverages that are part of the daily lives of millions of families worldwide.

In Mexico, with more than 15,000 employees, 35 plants, and over 100 distribution centers across the country, we are a diverse and highly committed community driving iconic brands such as Danone, Activia, Oikos, Danonino, Bonafont, and Silk. Every person who joins us brings a key piece to continue evolving and innovating.

At Danone, you will find an environment where you can grow with purpose and be authentic. We value what each person contributes, and it is this combination of experiences, talents, and perspectives that strengthens our culture and drives us to achieve extraordinary results. Here, you will have the freedom to propose, create, and bring ideas to life that generate real impact.

We foster your development through continuous feedback, clear objectives, agile methodologies, and learning tools designed to accelerate your professional growth. We want you to move forward with confidence and find a path that inspires you. Your well-being is also fundamental to us. That’s why we offer flexible benefits, comprehensive health programs covering physical, emotional, and financial well-being, support platforms, exclusive discounts, and benefits above the legal requirements—supporting you at every stage of your life.

We are proudly a B Corp certified company, reflecting our commitment to responsible practices, conscious decisions, and a positive impact on people, communities, and the planet.

If you are looking for a place where you can contribute, grow, and be part of a community driven by purpose, we invite you to explore our opportunities and discover for yourself everything you can build at Danone. Your next big professional step could start here.

description:
About the job




About the Company




The Integration Business Analyst supports the design and delivery of enterprise integrations between Salesforce and internal or external systems. This role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to define integration requirements, document system interactions, and ensure reliable data flows across platforms. The Integration Business Analyst will help translate business needs into clear technical requirements that support scalable and secure integrations using modern platforms such as Salesforce APIs, Azure services, API Management (APIM), and event-driven architectures. This role operates within an AI-assisted development environment leveraging Copado DevOps and Copado AI Agents, ensuring that AI-generated integration designs and development plans align with business requirements, enterprise architecture standards, and platform best practices.




About the Role




Integration Requirements & Analysis




Gather and document requirements for integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems.
Facilitate discovery sessions with business and technical teams to understand system interactions, data exchange needs, and business workflows.
Define data flows, transformation logic, field mappings, and error-handling requirements.
Document integration requirements including API specifications, message formats, and system dependencies.




Responsibilities




Integration Solution Support
Collaborate with architects and engineers to design integration solutions using technologies such as:
Salesforce APIs
Azure API Management (APIM)
Azure Integration Services
REST and event-based integrations
Assist in defining integration patterns including real-time, near real-time, and batch processing models.
Ensure integrations align with enterprise security, governance, and data management standards.
Azure & API Management Collaboration
Support integration solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure services, including:
Azure API Management (APIM)
Azure Functions
Azure Logic Apps
Azure Service Bus and event messaging
Document API interactions, endpoint behaviors, authentication requirements, and service dependencies.
Assist in defining API contracts, request/response structures, and integration error-handling models.
AI-Assisted Development Collaboration
Work with development teams using Copado AI Agents to generate integration plans and development recommendations.
Validate AI-generated integration designs to ensure they align with business requirements and system architecture.
Provide oversight and business context to guide AI-assisted solution development.
DevOps & Agile Delivery
Support backlog refinement and prioritization for integration initiatives.
Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria defining integration behaviors and system interactions.
Collaborate with development teams operating within Copado DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment processes.
Testing & Validation
Support integration testing and validation activities.
Develop test scenarios to ensure data integrity, system behavior, and error handling across integrated platforms.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders.
Documentation & Governance
Maintain integration documentation including:
System architecture diagrams
Data flow diagrams
API documentation
Integration runbooks
Support change management and communication related to integration deployments.







Qualifications




Experience working as a Business Analyst supporting enterprise system integrations
Strong understanding of API-based integration patterns and data mapping
Experience documenting integration requirements, system interactions, and interface specifications
Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies




Required Skills




Experience with Salesforce platform integrations
Experience with Microsoft Azure integration services
Familiarity with:
Azure API Management (APIM)
Azure Functions
Azure Logic Apps
Azure Service Bus
Experience working within Copado DevOps or CI/CD environments
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as Copado AI Agents
Salesforce certification, such as Salesforce Business Analyst or Administrator




Preferred Skills




Success in this role is defined by the ability to clearly define integration requirements, support scalable system interactions, and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable integrations across Salesforce and enterprise platforms.

About the job

Company Description

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the change to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch!

Job Description

The Supply Chain Planner — Customer & Procurement manages material flow across the North American supply chain on behalf of Bosch customers, plant operations, and internal logistics. Depending on business needs and team structure, this role may be assigned to one or both of the following tracks: Passthrough (Customer) Planning or Procurement (Raw Material) Planning. Planners are expected to develop competency in both areas over time, enabling organizational flexibility as business requirements evolve.

Assignment Note: Individual planners will be designated to a primary track based on team structure and business need. This JD covers both tracks to support role mobility and cross-training across the planning organization.

Track A: Customer & Passthrough Planning

Procure finished goods from global Bosch supplying plants → Manage warehouse inbound → Fulfill OEM/Tier 1 customer demand

A1. Inbound Planning & Procurement from Bosch Supplying Plants


Generate and manage purchase orders and delivery schedules to global Bosch supplying plants based on customer demand and inventory targets.
Maintain 24+ months of rolling demand visibility in SAP and/or Kinaxis Maestro to support long-range capacity planning at supplying plants.
Coordinate with supplying plants on allocation priorities, capacity constraints, shortages, engineering changes, and EOP transitions.
Monitor inbound order confirmations and proactively escalate mismatches between confirmed and required quantities.
Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.


A2. Warehouse Coordination (Summerville, SC & Laredo, TX)


Coordinate inbound receipts, inventory positioning, and stock availability across North American warehouse locations.
Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.


A3. Customer Management & Order Fulfillment


Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.


Track B: Procurement & Raw Material Planning

Translate production demand into supplier orders → Ensure uninterrupted material supply → Protect manufacturing continuity

B1. MRP-Driven Procurement Planning


Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.


B2. Supplier Coordination & Order Management


Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.


B3. Production Supply & Shortage Management


Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.

Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.

Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.


Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.

title: IT Business Analyst
description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:

The IT Business Analyst is responsible for the planning and execution throughout the lifecycle of one or more software solutions within the business domain. This includes creating and prioritizing product and business requirements and working closely with business and technology teams to ensure business stakeholder and end user satisfaction goals are met. They will create and develop requirements and concepts for product enhancements in support of business and technology needs. This position provides a wide variety of services to our business users including business analysis and quality assurance, in support of strategic and tactical planning of systems features / functionality as well as day to day business operations. The role also entails Project Management for software releases and managing of SOX processes and documentation.

Your Role Accountabilities:


●Collaborate with key business stakeholders to generate business requirements based on use cases/user stories. Prioritize and scope based on business input and ROI.
● Lead collaboration with the global teams to assure incorporation of global requirements for enhancements when prioritized and justified related to regional requirements. Assure no negative impact to global regional workflows.
● Collaborate with internal engineering, vendor engineering, internal technical teams and external technical teams to assure vendor and technical designs cover mandatory business requirements.
● Serve as primary contact for the business for the support of system functionality, business process and workflow and react to emerging or changing revenue opportunities and industry trends.
● Lead proof-of-concept priority projects related to new or adjusted business processes to satisfy industry or business adjustments.
● Participate in assessment and feasibility studies of available technologies and recommend solutions.
● Manage business and functional requirements for one or more business solutions related to Ad Sales Deals, Ad Sales Contracts, Linear and Digital booking and tracking, Content Rights, Scheduling, Traffic, Presentation and Reconciliation operations.
● Manage relationships with multiple business organizations, global technology groups and 3rd party software vendors including: facilitating requirement and design workshops, reviewing designs, test plans and test cases; reviewing vendor deliverables and schedules; managing quality or delivery issues with the vendor; coordinating end user testing and sign-off for in-house and vendor deliverables.

Functional Testing
• Perform functional testing and document workflow and configuration changes related to system and process adjustments based on Proof-of-concept outcomes or business requirements.

Training
● Provide a walk thorough of new functionality including both system functionality and region-specific recommended configuration and workflow. Train the trainer.
● Assist in the design, delivery, and improvement of in-house training programs and related courseware.

Compliance and Standards
● Ensure compliance with Warner Bros. Discovery Software Development Lifecycle documentation and mandated compliance requirements for all application changes.

General

● Work independently under minimal supervision.

Qualifications & Experiences:
• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent degree/work experience
• Experience supporting technology solutions in a Media industry organization
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience with mid to large-scale software development projects – understanding all phases of systems development
• Strong prioritization and organization skills
• Strong presentation and communication skills; excellent listening skills, ability to interface with business customers at all levels of the organization
• Strong project management skills
• Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
• Excellent people skills – negotiation, conflict resolution, providing direction and focus
• Ability to work on multiple projects at one time with minimal supervision and to ensure that overall priorities are being met
• Proven ability to successfully operate within, and contribute to, a high growth, entrepreneurial, fast paced business and matrix environment.

Preferred qualifications
• Experience in Air-Time Sales, Business Intelligence, and Audience Research business areas and respective applications desirable
• Formal Business Analysis Training desirable




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

About the job

Who We Are

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.


Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.


A Day In The Life

As the Measurement & Ad Operations Lead, you are responsible for the technical execution and quality control of measurement across all digital marketing channels. You ensure that tracking, tagging, integrations, and offline conversion pipelines are implemented accurately and aligned with each client’s Measurement Framework.

You partner closely with Paid Media, Data Engineering, and Applied Analytics to ensure platforms are receiving the right signals, conversion actions are firing correctly, and performance data is trustworthy. You proactively diagnose tracking issues, maintain compliance standards (including HIPAA where applicable), and ensure that marketing data flows cleanly from user interaction to CRM to ad platforms.

This is a hands-on execution role with ownership over implementation quality, documentation, and operational stability across accounts.

Responsibilities


Own implementation of online tracking across all digital channels (Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, DSPs, SEO, etc.)
Build and maintain GTM containers, pixels, server-side tracking configurations, and event schemas

Gestionar y administrar bajo el enfoque de sourcing estratégico el proceso de compra de equipos (mayor/menor), insumos o servicios, requeridos para las unidades de negocio de Walmart Centroamérica, logrando las mejores oportunidades de abastecimiento y en cumplimiento con los requerimientos del negocio, bajo condiciones del mejor costo total de la adquisición, alta calidad, conveniente tiempo de entrega y un buen servicio post-venta, en apego a las políticas y normas establecidas por la organización, y las definidas por Cumplimiento y Anticorrupción.

Tener dominio y un control de la cartera de proveedores a su cargo, a través de un detalle básico (información general, descripción de la Compañía, segmentos de la industria, países en los que opera, principales competidores, fortalezas y debilidades), con el fin de tener la información disponible para gestionar cualquier negociación que se requiera.
Realizar un análisis de los costos totales de propiedad (TCO) que se acumulan después de la compra y durante el curso de su uso, a través de análisis con los stakeholders, los usuarios y con el mercado, lo cual permitirá tomar una decisión integral sobre la mejor compra.
Garantizar la búsqueda de nuevos proveedores para identificar aquellos potenciales, asegurando la transparencia, un entorno justo y competitivo y facilitar una conversación objetiva en el equipo.
Desarrollar los criterios de evaluación acorde a los requisitos de la estrategia establecida por el Área, con el fin de evaluar de forma objetiva cada negociación.
Establecer un forecast anual de ahorros / beneficios esperados de la categoría, y dar seguimiento a la ejecución y alcance a tiempo de los mismos, a través de un reporte mensual el cual permite demostrar la creación de valor de las compras en resultados financieros.
Asegurar un control absoluto de su categoría, así como la calendarización de proyectos permanentes y temporales, para garantizar la ejecución en tiempo y en regla de toda gestión de compra.

Licenciatura concluída en áreas comerciales o administrativas, o carrera fin.

Experiencia: 3 años de experiencia en ejecución de compras acorde a la categoría asignada, negociación con proveedores y manejo eficiente de presupuestos.

Conocimientos técnicos: Excel avanzado, SAP Ariba, Power BI, SICI, deseable IA.

Ingles intermedio.




En Walmart de México y Centroamérica estamos comprometidos con una cultura de pertenencia, por lo que buscamos incorporar el mejor talento basándonos en competencias, habilidades y potencial; no discriminamos por ningún motivo, incluyendo género, edad, origen étnico, apariencia física, estado civil, condiciones de salud por VIH o cualquier enfermedad, situación socioeconómica, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género por ello durante el proceso de atracción y selección no solicitaremos información personal, fotografías o análisis clínicos de ningún tipo. description:
About the job

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About Dynamic Revenue Plus (DR+)

Dynamic Revenue Plus (DR+) is SiteMinder’s powerful, intelligent add-on designed to help our existing hotel customers master their pricing and distribution strategy with confidence. DR+ uses real-time market data, demand trends, and competitor insights to recommend optimal room rates, enabling hotels to react faster, make smarter pricing decisions, and significantly improve profitability—all directly within the integrated SiteMinder platform.

About the Revenue Growth Consultant (DR+) role

We are seeking commercially-minded individuals with deep, hands-on hotel revenue management experience who are ready to transition into a consultative technology sales career.

Your primary mission is to be the domain expert in the sales team, engaging existing SiteMinder customers to educate them on the value of adopting DR+. This role is focused on selling value and strategic outcome, not just features. You will be leveraging your operational knowledge to conduct highly credible, solution-focused conversations that demonstrate how DR+ solves real-world hotel pricing challenges.

What You Will Do...


Consultative Upselling: Proactively reach out to existing SiteMinder customers (warm leads) to initiate in-depth, consultative discussions regarding their current revenue management strategies, pain points, and commercial goals.
Value Demonstration: Conduct compelling, data-driven product demonstrations and presentations that clearly articulate how DR+ enhances pricing strategies, improves yield, and delivers a strong Return on Investment (ROI).
Expert Education: Utilise your hands-on hotel revenue management background to serve as a credible expert, educating hoteliers on best practices and how DR+ integrates with their commercial strategy to remove guesswork and spreadsheet reliance.
Full Sales Cycle Management: Own the end-to-end upsell sales cycle within your defined territory, managing opportunities from initial qualification and discovery through negotiation, contract closing, and ensuring a smooth activation handoff to the Customer Success team.

title: Gerente de Marketing y CRM
description:
About the job

City Storage es una plataforma integrada de inversión, desarrollo y operación de autoalmacenaje, en plena fase de expansión en Ciudad de México.




Buscamos un Gerente de Marketing Digital que sea responsable end-to-end del proceso de generación, prospección y conversión de leads — desde la estrategia de campañas hasta la coordinación diaria con el equipo de ventas.




Este es un puesto operativo y estratégico a la vez: la persona ideal diseña el proceso de prospección, lo implementa en HubSpot, y monitorea su desempeño con datos — no solo ejecuta campañas.




Responsabilidades




Gestión del CRM HubSpot

- Ser el responsable directo de la administración del CRM HubSpot: configuración, calidad de datos, automatizaciones y reportes

- Asegurar que cada lead generado, sin importar el canal de origen, quede correctamente registrado y trackeado en el pipeline

- Mantener la higiene de datos del CRM y capacitar al equipo de ventas en su uso correcto




Diseño e Implementación del Proceso de Prospección

- Definir el proceso end-to-end de prospección de leads: desde la captura hasta la cita agendada con el equipo de ventas

- Implementar ese proceso dentro de HubSpot mediante flujos de trabajo, etapas de pipeline y automatizaciones

- Documentar el proceso para que sea replicable conforme se abran nuevas sucursales




Monitoreo y Contacto de Leads

- Supervisar el flujo de leads digitales desde su generación (campañas pagadas y orgánicas) hasta su clasificación por nivel de interés

- Contactar leads directamente o coordinar al equipo que lo haga, y agendar citas para el equipo de ventas

- Dar seguimiento a leads no contactados o estancados en el pipeline para evitar fugas de oportunidades




Campañas Digitales — Pagadas y Orgánicas

- Monitorear y coordinar las campañas digitales pagadas (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) en todas las sucursales activas con consultores externos

- Supervisar la estrategia de contenido orgánico y calendario editorial en redes sociales

- Analizar el desempeño de cada canal y reasignar presupuesto según resultados de conversión, no solo de alcance




Coordinación de Diseño Creativo

- Coordinar al consultor externo de diseño creativo para asegurar que el material de campañas esté alineado con la estrategia comercial y la identidad de marca

- Dar retroalimentación basada en datos de desempeño, no solo en preferencia estética

- Gestionar tiempos de entrega y prioridades creativas según el calendario de campañas




Dashboards, Metas y KPIs

- Diseñar y mantener dashboards de prospección que muestren el embudo completo: leads generados, contactados, citas agendadas, visitas y cierres

- Definir metas mensuales de prospección por sucursal y por canal, en conjunto con el equipo de ventas y operaciones

- Reportar resultados semanalmente a la dirección, identificando cuellos de botella en el embudo




Requisitos

- 3+ años de experiencia gestionando campañas digitales pagadas (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) con responsabilidad sobre presupuesto y ROI

- Experiencia comprobable usando HubSpot u otro CRM como herramienta central de gestión de leads — no solo como repositorio de contactos

- Experiencia diseñando o mejorando procesos de prospección de ventas, idealmente con automatizaciones

- Capacidad analítica: cómodo leyendo dashboards, definiendo KPIs y tomando decisiones basadas en datos de conversión, no solo de alcance o impresiones

- Experiencia coordinando proveedores o consultores externos (diseño, pauta, contenido)

- Español nativo o fluido; inglés profesional para trabajar con sistemas y reportes




Deseable

- Experiencia en real estate, o negocios con ciclo de venta corto y alto volumen de leads

- Certificaciones en Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, o HubSpot Academy

- Experiencia gestionando marketing para múltiples sucursales o ubicaciones simultáneamente




Cómo aplicar




Además de aplicar por LinkedIn, envía un correo a reclutamiento@citystorage.mx con el asunto 

"Gerente Marketing – [Tu Nombre]" adjuntando tu CV más reciente y respondiendo estas 2 preguntas breves (no hace falta carta de presentación formal, buscamos claridad y sustancia):




1. Describe brevemente un proceso de prospección o pipeline que hayas diseñado o mejorado 

 desde cero (no solo ejecutado).

2. ¿Qué automatización o flujo de trabajo has construido en un CRM? (ej. secuencias de 

 seguimiento, scoring de leads, alertas)




Candidatos que no envíen estas respuestas podrían no ser considerados en la primera ronda.




Palabras clave: Marketing Digital, HubSpot, CRM, Growth Marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Lead Generation, Marketing Automation, Real Estate, Self Storage

Communication & Alignment: You translate Salesforce platform constraints (limits, callout/identity constraints, packaging realities) into plain language for non-technical PMs and client stakeholders, and keep engineering, PM, and design aligned on decisions and status.

Apex (triggers, services, async, test classes) and governor-limit-aware design.
Flows — record-triggered and screen flows — as a first-class automation tool.

You own the Salesforce build end to end and keep it aligned with the surrounding integration and infrastructure layers.

You take architectural direction and turn it into shipped, production-grade Salesforce metadata — objects, Record Types, Flows, Apex, LWC, permission model, and managed-package configuration (DocuSign eSignature). You also hold the technical relationship with the integration microservices and cloud platform that read from and write to the org: you don't build those daily, but you define the contracts, guard the data model, and make sure a schema or automation change never blindsides them.

Here is the truth: this is a Salesforce Platform (Core/CRM) role. We're looking for a builder who lives in the Salesforce org — declarative and programmatic — and who is senior enough to own the platform-level decisions that everything else depends on.

RESPONSIBILITIES:


Salesforce Delivery Ownership: You own the "how" of the Salesforce build — data model, automation (Flows + Apex), UI (LWC/screen flows), permission sets, Record Types, and packaging — from detailed technical design through deployment. 
Platform-Level Design Authority: You are the guardian of the org's data model and automation architecture. Schema changes, sharing/visibility, and process design go through you, and you keep them coherent as the solution grows. 
Engineering Rigor & Quality: You enforce production-grade Salesforce standards — Apex test coverage ≥ the org bar, FLS/sharing correctness, governor-limit awareness, and metadata/CLI-based deployment (SFDX/`sf`). 
Integration Contract Ownership: You define and protect the API/data contracts between Salesforce and the backend integration services (identity validation, CRM sync, e-signature, and the SFCC B2B commerce component). You coordinate — not necessarily hand-build — the non-Salesforce layers, ensuring changes stay backward-compatible. 
Proactive Risk Management: You surface dependencies, scope creep, and technical debt before they block delivery — especially coupling between the org schema, its automations, and the services that consume them — and bring solutions, not just problems. 
Communication & Alignment: You translate Salesforce platform constraints (limits, callout/identity constraints, packaging realities) into plain language for non-technical PMs and client stakeholders, and keep engineering, PM, and design aligned on decisions and status. 
Engineering Leadership & Mentorship: You lead and mentor Salesforce (and adjacent) engineers through technical reviews, coaching, and hands-on support, fostering a psychologically safe, high-accountability, high-quality culture. 


REQUIREMENTS: 


Proven Salesforce Technical Leadership: A significant track record (Senior/Lead level) delivering complex Salesforce Platform (Sales/Service Cloud, Core CRM) projects and supporting them in production. You can take a vague goal and turn it into shipped, stable org configuration and code. 
Deep Salesforce Platform Expertise (hands-on):
Apex (triggers, services, async, test classes) and governor-limit-aware design. 
Flows — record-triggered and screen flows — as a first-class automation tool. 
LWC for custom UI where declarative isn't enough. 
Data model & security: custom objects, Record Types, permission sets/permission-set groups, FLS, sharing. 
Deployment & ALM: SFDX source format, metadata/CLI deployment (`sf`), sandboxes, change/branching strategy, CI-based deploys. 
Integration surface: REST/Apex callouts, Connected Apps & OAuth 2.0 (incl. M2M client-credentials), Platform Events/outbound patterns. 
Integration & Cloud Awareness (coordinate, not necessarily build): Enough fluency in API-based integrations and a cloud/microservice backend (Node/NestJS on AWS is the current stack, including an SFCC B2B commerce component) to own the contracts and reason about the end-to-end flow. Deep AWS/Terraform/backend build experience is a plus, not a requirement. 
Multi-Workstream & Multi-Party Delivery: Comfortable running structured build and live operational/support work in parallel, and aligning technical direction across agency, client, and corporate platform teams within a controlled, security-gated environment. 
Communication: Excellent English (written and verbal); Spanish strongly preferred for day-to-day work with a Chile-based client and team. 
People Leadership & Mentorship: Proven experience leading and mentoring engineers through coaching, technical guidance, and constructive feedback. 


NICE TO HAVE:


Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, App Builder, and/or an Architect-track credential. 
Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) / high-coverage delivery as a working practice. 
DocuSign eSignature for Salesforce (or comparable managed-package e-signature) configuration experience. 
Domain exposure to financial services, credit bureau, or identity/KYC onboarding flows, and comfort in regulated / enterprise-security contexts (VPN, corporate proxies, restricted egress, DevSecOps gates). 
Familiarity with Node.js/NestJS, AWS (ECS Fargate), Terraform, Okta/SSO, and Jenkins/Bitbucket CI/CD as the surrounding platform. 
CMS-driven frontends (Next.js / Contentful) exposure.

description:
About the job

About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About The Role

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Communications, the Corporate Communications Channels Specialist is primarily responsible for the creation and distribution of internal and external communications to team members, customers and other external stakeholders. They are also responsible for creating and maintaining suitable contact databases and producing analytics that report on channel performance.

This person develops positive, collaborative relationships with functional leaders and SMEs as well as the rest of the Corporate Communications team to develop and deliver communications and improve channels in order to support business priorities and objectives.




What You Will Do

Be an expert resource for the Corporate Communications team on the key channels used to create and distribute communications: ChangeEngine (external SAAS comms platform) and Navigator (internal SharePoint) – supporting colleagues in processing updates and suggesting improvements
Plan, write, edit and deliver impactful content that supports agreed business priorities and objectives and which is delivered through approved channels both internally and externally
Ability to utilize Company-issued and approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support productivity, efficiency, and quality of work, while maintaining accountability for all AI-generated outputs.
Ensure that customer and site communications are sent as per agreed timetable and reflect commitment to flawless execution regarding accuracy, relevance and audience.
Maintain and own contact databases to ensure that information remains accurate – accessing internal systems as needed to pull contact information and ensure that any updates are flowed through to central database
Manage communications calendar for internal and external (customer and site) comms
Provide regular analytic reports to measure effectiveness of communications – making recommendations based on results




Decision Making and Influence

Apply knowledge and experience to advise Corporate Communications colleagues and other stakeholders on communication approaches and best practice. Advise colleagues on lead times required to support comms distribution timelines and prioritization requirements.

Apply critical thinking skills to provide logical and informed recommendations to the business.




Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree (ideally in Communications, Journalism or Marketing) or equivalent work-related experience
Minimum of three years working in a corporate communications or marketing communications role with experience of delivering communications programs
Experience owning/managing CRM and contact database to ensure that audience details are accurate and up to date
Experience of supporting senior and SME stakeholders – demonstrate an ability to influence and challenge in order to deliver beneficial outcomes. Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, Microsoft SharePoint and external marketing CRM/comms delivery platforms
Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills. Great time-management, decision making and organizational skills also essential
Team oriented person with a “can do” attitude and excellent relationship-building skills
Ability to juggle multiple priorities and work to shifting deadlines with urgency and pace
Ability to utilize Company-issued and approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support productivity, efficiency, and quality of work, while maintaining accountability for all AI-generated outputs




Desired Qualifications

Experience of working across multiple time zones and geographies in a highly matrixed organization is highly desirable along with experience of being part of a virtual team
Knowledge of GDPR and data protection




Why Signant Health?

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.

title: Agency Growth Manager (Premium) - TikTok LIVE
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Introduction
The livestream industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become the next growth driver for TikTok global business. It also brings great joy to users globally and it creates a new channel for our creators to show themselves.

Responsibilities
Creators are at the center of our operations. Through professional agencies and MCNs in the content business, especially those that specialize in livestreaming, we are building scale and democratization of the livestreaming business. In this role of Agency Growth Manager, you will carry out two main sets of responsibilities that will drive business growth in a sustainable way:
1. Agency Management
 - Design TikTok LIVE LATAM's agency growth strategy for recruiting, retaining, and helping agencies scale up in their business on the platform. 
 - Design agency's benefit system and growth program to incentivize better performance and sustainable revenue growth.
 - Conduct day-to-day management directly with agency managers and their creators to materialize and iterate the strategic programs to deliver business results. Provide additional support to agencies and their creators for the needs related to content and platform guidelines. 
 - Build LIVE showcases with successful agencies and increase the positive impact of working with the platform in the agency community.
 - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams to carry out in-app and out-of-app campaigns and drive participation and results from agency creators.
 - Monitor results metrics for agency growth and performance, and conduct regular analysis to generate operational insights for improvement.
2. Agency Education and Capacity Building
 - Design LIVE's agency empowerment program with practical tips and know-how about how to scale up agency's operation and revenue potential with a focus on agency professionalization.
 - Facilitate business and industry knowledge transfer from top agencies to emerging agencies, learn from global best practices and localize the expertise to educate local agencies on how to scale.
 - Share the platform know-how on content tips and trends to agencies to improve their creators' LIVE performance and revenue generation.
 - Conduct training to agencies for the above mentioned topics, leveraging different tools and social platforms.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above.
- More than 2 years of working experience relates to creator management, especially managing influencer agencies and/or MCNs.
- Candidates who are sensitive to cultural trends, possess a good understanding of the content industry, creator economy and business acumen on newly emerged industries are preferred. 
- Professional, patient, and skillful communication with talents/influencers. 
- Result-oriented and data-driven operation.
- Proficient in both verbal and written English and Spanish due to communication with global team in English and local team in Spanish

Preferred Qualifications
- Candidates who are used to work with, or have connections with modeling, content, media, TV, celebrities, and livestreaming platforms. 



About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About the job

Job Summary

EL EQUIPO

El equipo de Marketing Digital es el motor creativo y estratégico que posiciona los eventos en las plataformas más relevantes. Diseñamos campañas digitales que generan awareness, tráfico y conversión, trabajando de la mano con promotores y plataformas globales.

Como Trafficker Digital, serás responsable de implementar y dar seguimiento a campañas en plataformas como Meta, Google, Spotify y TikTok, asegurando que cada acción esté alineada con la estrategia y el presupuesto aprobado. Tu rol será clave para maximizar el impacto de nuestras campañas y garantizar resultados medibles.

Estamos en un momento emocionante: la industria del entretenimiento en vivo está creciendo y Ticketmaster lidera esta transformación con estrategias digitales innovadoras. Este puesto te permitirá trabajar con grandes marcas, plataformas globales y eventos que marcan tendencia.

VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de

entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es

conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES

Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo.
