description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe is investing in building out its Global Professional Services team to actively engage all customers from Fortune 100s to startups to help accelerate their adoption of Stripe capabilities. The team is responsible for ensuring that our customers deploy quickly with high quality integrations. It then partners closely with front line developers and technical leaders to ensure our customers continue to derive strategic value from Stripe and grow with us as our respective product portfolio expands. In addition, as we master the craft of deployment services, help build the asset and strategy that will enable us to scale through our partner ecosystem.

The Stripe Accelerate is a 3-month offering that unlocks access to a team of Stripe experts to help the user through every step of the implementation. This is included as part of Stripe solution, at no extra cost to our users. Accelerate Onboarding Managers provide prescriptive guidance and planning for the user’s onboarding journey. Onboarding Specialists provide product workshops, best practices, regular check-ins, and technical Q&A. This offering is targeted at Startup and SMB users.

A Few Key Features Of Accelerate Include


Specialized experts: Accelerate experts provide experience helping customers integrate Stripe technology in thousands of projects.
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, email Q&A to help unblock your team. 
Product workshops and training for fraud and dashboard



What you’ll do

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users. 
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Stripe implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.
Troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions to ensure a smooth onboarding process.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address user queries and concerns.
Maintaining accurate records of user interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Anticipating and addressing potential technical challenges during the onboarding process. Proactively propose improvements.
Offering guidance on best practices, product features, and account setup to ensure user success.
Continuously updating knowledge of Stripe's products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Advanced English proficiency- fluent in written and spoken. 
2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments. 
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. 
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions. 
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders. 



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Experience delivering live technical training to users. 
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.

We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in policy-constrained wellness, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (including GLP-1s and research peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products.




We are more than an agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization.

Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships.




Why This Role Exists




The Media Buyer, Paid Social is responsible for bringing growth strategies to life through exceptional execution on Meta.




Working closely with a Growth Strategist, you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns that drive profitable growth for our clients. You’ll combine strong platform expertise with analytical thinking to make informed optimization decisions, uncover opportunities through data, and continuously improve campaign performance.




This role is ideal for someone who enjoys executing at a high level, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in operational excellence.




Working in Complex Advertising Environments




Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.

Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.




Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.




We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.




What You’ll Own




Campaign Execution & Optimization
Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients.
Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures.
Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability.
Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals.
Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges.




Performance Analysis
Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms.
Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance.
Understand why creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights.
Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators.
Prepare performance updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and client-facing meetings.




Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Growth Strategists to execute paid media strategies across assigned accounts.
Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities.
Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities.
Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities.
Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates.




What Success Looks Like




Successful Media Buyers consistently:

Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail.
Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing.
Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality.
Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams.
Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence.
Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time.




What You Bring to the Table




Required




3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands.
Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.
Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets.
Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices.
Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands.
Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed.
Experience working successfully in a remote environment.
Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.




Preferred




Experience working with third-party attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar.
Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness.
Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat.
Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics.
Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives.




Who Thrives at Lucyd




Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution.




They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. They thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and embrace continuous learning as advertising platforms evolve.

Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

The Business Development Executive will be focused on closing new business. You will plan and prioritize business development activities to achieve company revenue goals and sales targets for defined regions. What You Have...


Experience in new business acquisition, preferably in the SaaS (software-as-a-service) space, managing the full sales cycle

Self-motivation and resilience to show up each day and give your best

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We're going to achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way, and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all of Stripe's growth.

Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of "growing the GDP of the internet." Stripes leverage their understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.

What you'll do

The role of Ops Associate can be interpreted as a Stripe "athlete" that will engage in either internal-facing or external-facing (e.g., support, risk) workflows, or both. OA roles will be highly operational in nature and will largely be aligned with case-level or process-type work. OAs will work on workflows which are considered to be "medium complexity" or sensitive in nature, therefore requiring internal Stripe-level systems and tools access, meaning that it cannot be outsourced. As the SDC matures and capability is established, we can expect the complexity of work at SDC to increase, and additionally aspire to drive improvements in the work we are responsible for.

Responsibilities


Deliver exceptional Stripe experience by efficiently and accurately resolving issues across social media platforms (e.g., X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and others)
Help resolve issues that are escalated via social media, including technical product questions, and work to prevent those issues from happening again
Partner with internal teams across Stripe (e.g., Comms, Incident Ops, Risk), serving as the ultimate escalation point for high-stakes user issues and proactively initiating incident reports with a user-first mindset
Coordinate executive escalations from Stripe's leaders with other teams
Contribute to and manage new programs focused on improving the Stripe user experience
Identify operational process gaps and initiate continuous improvements to accelerate global scale while delivering an exceptional experience for Stripe users
Be part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have experience with social media support or an interest in resolving user issues through those channels (e.g., Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook).
You have prior experience in customer support and external user-facing operations.
You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems, leveraging a process-oriented approach and a curiosity for technical products.
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.
You're willing to work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off in lieu. The SDC operates during daytime hours in 9-hour shifts (including 1-hour paid lunch break) scheduled to fall between the hours of 6am and 10pm.



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives
Prior experience or technical proficiency with Sprinklr will be an added advantage.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

The Finance team keeps Revolut moving with clarity and confidence. From accounting to strategic support, they work across the business to assess risk, guide decisions, and drive growth. Their insight shapes everything from daily operations to long-term plans and plays a key role in how we scale.

We're looking for a Functional Business Analyst to support the implementation and extension of our Axiom platform to meet global regulatory obligations and business needs.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing


Extending Axiom solution coverage to support new geographies, products, and reporting obligations
Translating business objectives into high-quality business requirements and functional specifications
Documenting end-to-end delivery processes and preparing detailed playbooks for scalable solutions
Performing user acceptance testing (UAT), including preparing test cases and validating results
Supporting global regulatory reporting teams with queries related to EBA reporting (e.g., CoRep, FinRep)
Building relationships with stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Engineering teams
Conducting gap analyses to identify risks and root causes, escalating issues as necessary


What You'll Need


Expertise with Axiom platform
Hands-on experience with SQL for data analysis and report validation
Knowledge of financial products, including a detailed understanding of trade/transaction lifecycles and regulatory requirements
Experience documenting business requirements and writing functional specifications
Expertise in regulatory reporting, particularly EBA reporting frameworks like CoRep and FinRep
A track record of performing UAT, preparing detailed test cases, and working with developers and business users to ensure a smooth implementation
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across multiple time zones
The ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment


Nice to have


Familiarity with Axiom's role in regulatory reporting
Experience supporting global finance systems in a fintech or regulated financial institution
Knowledge of regulatory reporting outside EMEA


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

The position of Commercialization Projects Material Planner reports directly into the Commercialization Manager. Material Supply Assurance: ensure timely delivery of materials and resolve supply chain issues.

Supplier Management

Financial Management


Monitor working capital tied up in inventory and implement strategies to optimize cash flow.

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

About the job

Acerca de Babel Audio: Babel Audio se asocia con las principales empresas tecnológicas para recopilar datos de voz de alta calidad que entrenan modelos de IA de vanguardia. Trabajamos con miles de participantes en todo el mundo para capturar conversaciones humanas auténticas, con el fin de que la IA pueda comprender y comunicarse con las personas de manera más efectiva.




Acerca del puesto: Babel Audio busca actores y actrices de voz hispanohablantes con experiencia profesional para un proyecto de interpretación en solitario. Tus actuaciones se utilizarán para entrenar sistemas de IA en la comprensión y expresión de emociones humanas. Es un trabajo interpretativo y orientado al personaje que requiere verdadero oficio, y hemos estructurado este proyecto para reflejarlo.




Recibirás un guión y un resumen de escena, estudiarás el contexto emocional y darás vida a una interpretación fiel al personaje y al momento. Las escenas son específicas y emocionalmente ricas. Podrías interpretar a:

Una novia que se despide de su familia con el corazón lleno de emoción
Un padre que sostiene a su recién nacido por primera vez, desbordado de sentimiento
Un pastor que divisa un lobo a lo lejos y se pone en alerta para proteger su rebaño
Un médico que, con el corazón encogido, debe comunicar el fallecimiento de un paciente a su familia
Un corredor que, tras años de entrenamiento, se acerca a la meta completamente emocionado

Fluidez para hablar español con nivel nativo
Experiencia profesional en actuación de voz, doblaje, narración, grabación de audiolibros o similar
Capacidad para ofrecer interpretaciones vocales expresivas y envolventes en distintos estilos y registros emocionales
Comodidad para interpretar un resumen de escena y trabajar de forma independiente con mínima dirección

About the Role: Babel Audio is seeking professional Spanish-speaking voice actors for a solo performance project. About the job

EL EQUIPO

El equipo de Universe forma parte del ecosistema de Ticketmaster y está enfocado en ofrecer soluciones innovadoras de venta de boletos para eventos de admisión general, complementadas con estrategias de marketing digital que impulsan el alcance, engagement y conversión de nuestros clientes.

DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO

Buscamos un Ejecutivo/a de Servicios Digitales para Universe, nuestra plataforma enfocada en eventos de admisión general, que combine la venta de boletos con soluciones estratégicas de marketing digital. Esta posición será responsable de asesorar a clientes (promotores, venues y organizadores) para maximizar el desempeño de sus eventos a través de herramientas digitales y acompañamiento consultivo.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en un puesto que combina tecnología y marketing digital impactando directamente en la venta de boletos y en la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

Asesorar a clientes sobre el uso las soluciones de marketing digital de para maximizar la venta de boletos.

VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una posición única para cumplir con esa visión.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES

Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. Nos importa el talento, y alentamos las postulaciones de personas sin importar su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, edad, estado de discapacidad o responsabilidades familiares.

PRÁCTICAS DE CONTRATACIÓN

La descripción del puesto anterior ha sido diseñada para indicar la naturaleza general y el nivel del trabajo realizado por los empleados dentro de esta clasificación. No está destinada a contener ni a interpretarse como un inventario exhaustivo de todas las funciones, responsabilidades y cualificaciones requeridas para los empleados asignados a este puesto.

Las políticas de contratación de Ticketmaster están diseñadas para incorporar a las personas más calificadas disponibles de manera oportuna y eficiente. Ticketmaster puede utilizar todos los medios disponibles, incluyendo la promoción interna, referencias de empleados, publicidad externa, agencias de empleo, reclutamiento por internet, ferias de empleo, reclutamiento universitario y head hunters. Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

In this proactive role, you will take ownership of our clients' local search ecosystems, blending traditional Local SEO strategies with cutting-edge Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). You will ensure our clients not only rank on Google but also appear prominently in AI search engines, chat assistants, and local map packs.

As Visual Merchandiser LATAM, based in Polanco, Mexico City, you will bring your unique strengths to the LATAM Visual Merchandising Department, helping us elevate the customer experience and support business performance across the region. Using your creativity, commercial sensibility, guest understanding, and passion for product, you will transform stores and windows into stages that celebrate ZEGNA’s creative direction and brand DNA, while ensuring alignment with global visual merchandising standards.

Actively communicate guest insights, product feedback, and key store updates within the team to help ensure guest satisfaction and support business goals.


Who You Are

This is how you show up:


You bring solid experience in retail visual merchandising, with a proven ability to execute and maintain premium brand presentation standards.
You can transform conceptual ideas into practical and impactful visual solutions.
You demonstrate a genuine passion for luxury, product storytelling, and brand excellence, with exceptional attention to detail and a hands-on approach.

NATURALLY IN ZEGNA

Our vision

We're building the one system that runs it all — every conversation, every channel, every lead, powered by AI. Base360 is on a mission to become the operating system that B2C brands everywhere run their business on. We're early, we're moving fast, and we're looking for people who want to help build something huge from the ground up.

We're looking for Growth Marketers to help Base360 reach the B2C brands who need us — and turn attention into signups, leads, and customers. We're channel-agnostic about how you do it: you might go deep and own a single channel, or stay broad and run across several. Paid ads, SEO, outbound, content, lifecycle, funnels — wherever your instincts pull you, we want people who can find what works and make it grow.

This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial role. You won't be one cog in a giant machine — you'll be trusted to experiment, learn fast, and build the growth engine as you go.

What You'll Do


Own a growth channel end to end — or run across several — setting the strategy, running the campaigns, and answering for the results.
Generate leads and drive signups — build and run the motions that fill the pipeline, from paid and SEO to outbound and referral.
Run experiments fast — test hooks, audiences, funnels, and offers; kill what doesn't work and scale what does.
Use AI everywhere it gives you an edge — for research, copy, targeting, automation, and speed.
Build funnels and landing pages that convert, and obsess over the numbers behind every step.
Work closely with the founder on positioning, messaging, and where to point the growth firepower next.
Track everything — you live in the data and can tell a clear story about what's working and why.


Who You Are

About the job

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

The Account Executive (AE) for Small-to-Medium Business is a highly motivated self-starter who is responsible for developing and closing new business or expanding our footprint with current customers within the SMB business segment. A successful AE is eager to learn, determined to adapt quickly, and comfortable with some ambiguity. AEs are focused on acquiring new customers or selling additional use cases, products and services into existing accounts. This person is accountable for exceeding monthly and quarterly quotas, proactive deal management, forecast accuracy, and driving adoption and usage with customers and prospects in collaboration with internal teams and the broader Docusign partner ecosystem.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sales Manager, SMB.

Responsibility


Drive success of the company's goals and objectives through achieving individual sales quotas
Build and manage a sales pipeline through prospecting efforts in the assigned territory within the SMB or Mid-Market segment
Develop and deliver customized sales presentations and products demonstrations, by phone and via online demo
Craft and negotiate enterprise level proposals and contracts
Forecast sales activity and revenue achievements accurately through proper use of sales tools
Collaborate effectively and engage various pre/post sales resources including Sales Development Representatives, Market Development Representatives, Solutions Engineers, Account Managers, Partner Account Managers, as well as Legal, Security, Professional Services and Customer Support
Travel as necessary, typically 10%


Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

In Office: Employee works from the physical workspace 100% of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

Preferred


Experience managing and closing software sales-cycles
Demonstrated ability to over-achieve quotas in past positions
Proficient computer application skills, including Salesforce.com, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

About the job

💸 Up to USD 50,000 salary on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote role with working hours aligned to US Eastern Time.

🤝 Account-management role with real responsibility for client operating clarity, stakeholder context, and systems/process handoffs.

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Modern hardware, AI-enabled workflows, Airtable/no-code tools, and collaborative team support.

🏋️ ♀️ Access to benefits (country dependent 🌎 )




Who We Are 




At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.




Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.




Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!




About The Role 




We are hiring an account manager to own the client operating rhythm around Storm Ideas' Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design work.




This is a high-accountability client relationship role. You will be responsible for keeping client context, stakeholder needs, open questions, risks, follow-ups, and next steps clear across work that is often messy, fast-moving, and operationally complex.




The role exists because this kind of client work fails when account knowledge lives in scattered notes, private conversations, vague update loops, or one person's head. Your job is to turn that into a clear operating rhythm that clients trust and internal teams can actually use.




You will not personally build every system. You will be expected to understand the client problem, ask sharper questions, spot weak scope, maintain account context, prepare for the right conversations, and make sure Storm is solving the right thing in the right order.




AI is not an optional productivity trick in this role. You should be actively trying to become excellent at using AI tools, reusable workflows, and account-context systems to prepare better, move faster, remember more, and give clients a sharper experience.

This is also a relationship role in the real sense. Clients should like working with you. They should feel you understand them, enjoy the conversation, trust your follow-up, and want you involved when things are unclear.




If you are looking for a relationship-only account role where someone else owns the operational detail, this is not it. If you are looking for a pure project management or builder role with limited client responsibility, this is not it either.




RESPONSIBILITIES 




What can you expect? 

Own the account context for selected Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design clients: stakeholders, priorities, history, open questions, risks, decisions, and follow-ups.
Run the client operating rhythm so meetings, updates, actions, blockers, decisions, and handoffs do not drift or depend on memory.
Turn vague client requests into clear next steps, questions, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
Become highly capable with AI tools and workflows for account management: meeting preparation, account research, stakeholder mapping, summarisation, action tracking, client-ready drafting, QA, and reusable account memory.
Use AI to make your client work sharper, not just faster. The standard is better context, better questions, better follow-up, and fewer things slipping through gaps.
Make clients feel well looked after: clear communication, good energy, strong follow-up, useful questions, and the confidence that you are properly on top of their account.
Write clear client-ready summaries that make messy work understandable without overpromising or hiding uncertainty.
Maintain stakeholder maps, account notes, decision logs, follow-up trackers, and reusable context so Storm can manage the relationship professionally.
Work closely with Account Management, Creative Operations, AI Operations, and technical colleagues to keep client work moving.
Understand creative and operational workflows well enough to challenge weak assumptions, ask practical questions, and explain tradeoffs in plain English.
Spot when a client ask is really a workflow, visibility, approval, stakeholder, or operating-rhythm problem.
Help internal teams avoid overbuilding, underscoping, or saying yes before the client need is clear.
Improve the way account knowledge is captured, summarised, shared, and reused over time.

Demonstrable experience owning client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.
Strong written and spoken English. You can make a messy situation feel clear, calm, and practical.
High agency. You do not wait for every next step to be handed to you, but you know when to escalate early.

We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We're hiring a CRM & Lifecycle Marketer to own lifecycle and retention messaging for a fast-growing multi-location car wash membership brand scaling subscription MRR across the US — building segmentation frameworks, executing behavior-triggered campaigns, and running a disciplined holdout-based testing program across email and SMS to protect and grow membership revenue.

Testing & Measurement: Run A/B and multivariate testing programs with 80/20 holdouts; measure incremental lift, retention rates, and revenue-per-send to continuously refine campaign performance.
Automation & Tooling: Build and QA complex automated flows in Rinsed or a comparable platform; leverage connected data sources — including Looker, Snowflake, and Twilio — for analysis and execution; apply AI tools where appropriate for segmentation, copy, and reporting.
Copy & Creative: Write clear, on-brand email and SMS copy that drives member action; maintain messaging consistency across all lifecycle touchpoints and collaborate with Paid and Creative teammates on promotional comms.




What You Bring

Lifecycle Strategy: Proven experience designing and executing onboarding, cancel-save, win-back, and pre-dunning journeys with a focus on protecting and growing subscription MRR end to end.
Segmentation & Personalization: Hands-on experience building behavioral and transactional audiences; comfortable managing suppression logic, price-increase cohorts, and exclusion audiences at scale.
Experimentation: Disciplined approach to A/B and holdout-based testing; reads incrementality and retention lift rather than vanity metrics to measure true campaign impact.

Copy & Messaging: Strong written skills for email and SMS copy that is clear, on-brand, and action-oriented; able to adapt tone for different audience segments and promotional moments.




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world's best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You've applied, now let's get to work. Here's the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we'll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.

Step 4 Match Interview: You'll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we're matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it's the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We've got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you're 100% ready.

Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant!




GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

About Us - Malvern Panalytical, Micromeritics And SciAps.

Together we are a powerful and highly complementary combination of market leading technologies.

We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. We are their partners in discovery.

Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our leading technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure.

Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. Our leading technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity.

SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.

We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are more than 2,500 employees in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, all committed to delivering expert and responsive customer support.

title: Digital Growth Specialist
description:
About the job

El propósito central del puesto es liderar y unificar la identidad de marca de la empresa en canales digitales y físicos, asegurando consistencia visual, narrativa y comercial. Además, debe articular la comunicación a lo largo del embudo de marketing -atracción, consideración, conversión y retención- para maximizar el retorno de inversión publicitaria, reducir costos de adquisición y fortalecer la retención de clientes.

Responsabilidades principales

· Gestionar agencias externas: supervisar la agencia creativa en conceptos, master graphics y parrillas de contenido; coordinar a la agencia de performance para alinear piezas pagadas con segmentaciones tácticas y optimizar CAC, CPA y ROAS.

· Custodiar la identidad de marca: garantizar el cumplimiento del Brand Book en redes sociales, sitio web, e-commerce y email marketing, además de coordinar su actualización junto con diseño gráfico.

· Coordinar contenido audiovisual: planear, guionar, grabar y editar videos para TikTok, Reels y YouTube Shorts, cuidando que cada pieza refuerce el mensaje central de marca: "Refacciones sin Vueltas".




Estrategia de journeys y embudo

Manejo de tres journeys según el nivel de relación con la marca. 

Para nuevos clientes, la prioridad es adquirir mediante anuncios segmentados, landing pages con disponibilidad inmediata, incentivos de primera compra y encuestas postentrega. 

Para clientes con una o dos compras, el enfoque se desplaza a retención temprana mediante retargeting, onboarding por email, carritos abandonados vía email/WhatsApp y campañas de cross-sell o up-sell. 

Para clientes recurrentes, quienes concentran una parte crítica de los ingresos, la estrategia se basa en comunicación directa, alertas de stock, CRM, checkout express, líneas de crédito, programas VIP y logística prioritaria.




Segmentos clave y enfoque de comunicación

· Flotilleros: buscan reducir tiempos muertos y mejorar rentabilidad; requieren mensajes de eficiencia operativa, inventario en tiempo real, facturación consolidada y suministro programado.

· Revendedores: necesitan margen y rotación; se atienden con promociones por volumen, catálogos interactivos, lanzamientos anticipados y pre-órdenes.

· Hombre-camión: enfrenta desconfianza en pagos digitales, fraudes y costos de envío; requiere transparencia, seguridad, pagos flexibles, testimoniales y evidencia visual de originalidad.

· Refaccionarias y talleres: necesitan identificar piezas exactas y agilizar devoluciones; se proponen guías técnicas, infografías, tutoriales y herramientas de autogestión.

Saya Biologics is a Pan-American, agile, and digitally native biopharmaceutical company working to make the global pharmaceutical standard accessible in Mexico, Latin America, and soon, the United States. In 2025, Saya ranked #1 in biologics submissions to COFEPRIS (the Mexican Federal Commission for Protection against Sanitary Risks) and among the top 10 in generics and biosimilars.




Objectives

Design websites, execute campaigns, and propose ideas for Saya Biologics' image and digital presence, ensuring visual and editorial consistency across external channels.

Create and manage content for social media (primarily LinkedIn) and other digital channels that reinforce Saya's positioning as an agile, digitally native biopharmaceutical company focused on accessibility.

Use of tools such as Claude Design, WhatsApp for Business, Notion, Gemini, or other similar platforms.

Operate an editorial calendar with a marketing focus (audiences, messaging, formats, timing, owners, and approvals) to communicate launches, partnerships, and corporate milestones.

Coordinate with Marketing, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs to ensure scientific accuracy, compliance, and strategic alignment. Use artificial intelligence tools safely and effectively to maximize productivity and content quality, always respecting company standards.




Activities




Brand & Creative Direction

Design, execute, and propose strategic plans to position Saya's image on digital channels: look and feel, templates, recurring formats, and visual guidelines applied to posts and materials.




Content Strategy & Production

Design and publish content for social media (primarily LinkedIn) that communicates company milestones, product launches, and strategic alliances.




Digital Marketing & Distribution

Manage the editorial calendar: define objectives per piece/campaign, messages, formats, timing, owners, approval workflow, and publication.




PR & Media (Support)

Coordinate, along with the external PR agency, support for media opportunities when applicable: materials, message alignment, and internal validations.




Internal Coordination

Work closely with the Marketing Manager to align content with marketing strategy and launches.




Use of AI and Digital Tools

Leverage AI tools (Notion AI, internal agents, content generation tools) to accelerate drafting, trend analysis, and content optimization.




AI Red Lines: Do not use AI for medical/regulatory content without review; do not publish AI-generated content without human editing; do not share confidential information with external tools.




Monitoring and Analysis

Track mentions of Saya in media and social networks.

Identify trends and opportunities in the biopharmaceutical ecosystem in Mexico and Latin America.




Agency Management

Develop strategic briefs aligned with the launch roadmap and corporate priorities.




Education

University degree in Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field.




Desired:

Demonstrable experience or interest in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology sector.

Portfolio demonstrating the ability to create engaging and professional content.




Desired:

Previous experience in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or B2B sectors.

Experience working with AI tools for content creation.

Experience in media, journalism, or press relations.

Advanced English (reading and writing; many reference materials are in English)

description:
About the job

We are posting this role as Customer Support Specialist, which is the more standard market title. At Edstruments, our customers are called partners, so internally you will hear this role referred to as Partner Support Specialist (or PSS). Same role, different vocabulary. We default to “partner” language throughout our team, our tools, and our documentation, and your day-to-day will use that language too.




About Edstruments

Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.




Role Overview

The Customer Support Specialist will be the first line of defense on chat and email, helping our partners resolve technical and administrative issues, ensuring smooth communication, and troubleshooting challenges. You will manage incoming chats and emails, track tickets, and ensure partner needs are met efficiently. The role also involves vendor outreach, administrative tasks, and product setup for new clients. You handle most questions yourself by checking our documentation and Slack history first, escalate with what you have already tried and found, and keep partners and teammates updated without being asked. Over time, you will have opportunities to take on more advanced roles as you grow with the company.




Key Responsibilities
First-Contact Resolution: Independently troubleshoot and resolve partner inquiries, checking our documentation and Slack history before escalating, ensuring a 70% first-contact resolution rate for partner inquiries. [Within the first 3 months of joining].
Response Time: Respond to partner inquiries within 5 minutes for chats and 3 hours for emails during your regular business hours. [Ongoing].
Ticket Management: Manage support conversations in Intercom and track work on Trello cards to ensure all issues are resolved promptly. Close 90% of inquiries within 48 hours.
Client Onboarding: Assist with the initial setup of our systems when a new client onboards to ensure successful data syncs with a 90% success rate.
Vendor Outreach & Admin: Provide support with vendor outreach and administrative tasks, as needed. [Ongoing].
Collaboration: Work with the Partner Success and Product teams to communicate findings from partner interactions and ensure partner needs are addressed. [Ongoing].




Key Outcomes
Achieve a 4.5/5 satisfaction rating or higher for partner support interactions (chat/email).
Close 90% of support tickets within 48 hours of receiving inquiries.
Ensure 90% success rate for assigned client onboarding tasks.
Own inquiries end to end: resolve the majority independently and close the loop with the partner, escalating only with clear context on what you’ve already tried.




Must-Have Qualifications
2+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a related role.
Strong technical aptitude and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn and troubleshoot software-related issues.
Experience with support and ticketing tools (Intercom, HubSpot, or similar) and a proven ability to resolve customer issues in a timely manner.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present technical information clearly to non-technical users.
Strong attention to detail and excellent time management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to research answers, draft partner replies, and work faster.
Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision: you find answers, make a judgment call, and proactively communicate status without being chased.




Preferred Qualifications
Experience in customer support for SaaS platforms or other software solutions.
Experience in vendor outreach or administrative tasks.
Background in the education or nonprofit sectors is a plus.




Logistical Notes

This is a 100% remote role with a flexible start date, but availability during US Pacific Time business hours (8 am - 5 pm) is required.

Edstruments does not and will not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender orientation, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status in any of its hiring decisions or other activities.




Compensation

The salary range for this role is $1,000-$2,000/month.

Why Edstruments?

Growth Opportunities: We offer potential for career advancement and development as the company scales.
Remote Flexibility: Join a 100% remote team with a flexible start date.

description:
About the job

TikTok Shop & Influencer Marketing Manager

TopFoxx | Remote | Full-Time

 

Location: Remote (must work U.S. East Coast hours).

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Hours are flexible. We care about performance, not clocks.

Salary: $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.

Language: Perfect written and spoken English is required (this is non-negotiable), along with a deep understanding of U.S. culture, slang, and social media behavior.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned fashion startup reinventing the sunglasses industry with solution-oriented designs and bold branding. Since 2016, we have grown from a bootstrapped e-commerce brand into a global business serving hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by an engaged community of influencers and creators.

We are not here to follow trends. We create them. Our sunglasses are tangle-free, floatable, foldable, shatter-resistant, and sustainably made, and we are just getting started.

We are a small, lean, founder-led team of fewer than ten people, with only about three of us on marketing. That means there is nowhere to hide and no one to pass the work to. Everyone wears multiple hats, owns real outcomes, and what you build genuinely moves the company. We do not do slow. We move fast, we pivot often, and we only hire A-players who treat the business like their own.




The Role

You will be the main one. This is the person who owns influencer and affiliate marketing end to end at TopFoxx. You are not waiting for a manual or a list of tasks. You are expected to bring the strategy, bring the ideas, and then execute them yourself, fast.

This space changes daily. New creators, new trends, new platform rules. You have to move quickly, test constantly, double down on what converts, and cut what does not. We are not looking for someone who only posts and reports. We are looking for a real executor who is proactive, creative, and obsessed with one thing above all: profitable, converting partnerships.

This is a big opportunity, and we want to be honest with you: it is also real work. We already have a large base of affiliates and creators, but your job is to grow it, activate it, and make it far more profitable. This is not a coast-along role. You will be building, pushing, and problem-solving every single day. For the right person, that is exactly the appeal.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct path into leading the influencer marketing function as it scales.




Why This Is Worth It

Here is the honest pitch. This is not a maintenance job and it is not busywork. Influencer and affiliate marketing is one of the biggest growth levers we have, and we believe this channel can become a multi-million dollar engine for TopFoxx. We are looking for the person who can build that.

We reward outcomes, not hours. If you can show us you can grow this and drive real, profitable revenue, you grow with it. That means a clear path into leadership and compensation that reflects the results you create. The ceiling here is high for someone who actually delivers, and you will be able to point to a business you helped build, not just tasks you completed.

If you want to be a small piece of a big machine, this is not it. If you want real ownership, real upside, and to look back in a year knowing you built something that matters, keep reading.




1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Program (Your Primary Focus)

This is the heart of the role and where most of your time and energy goes. The big one is affiliate. Your job is to make sure the affiliates are converting, the program is profitable, and the numbers in TikTok Shop Seller Center are strong and trending up.

Own TikTok Shop Seller Center day to day. Live in the dashboards, know your numbers cold, and make sure performance is healthy across GMV, conversion, and orders.
Make the affiliate program profitable. Track and grow GMV, revenue per creator, sample-to-sales ROI, and commission costs. Protect margin. Every dollar of product and commission has to earn its return.
Build and manage a pipeline of hundreds to thousands of active TikTok Shop affiliates, and keep them actually posting and selling, not just signing up.
Recruit high-converting creators and live sellers who know how to talk about product and drive sales, not just collect free samples.
Go live and sell yourself. You will host TikTok Lives, get on camera, and sell the glasses directly. Then you bring affiliates on, show them how it is done, and coach them to do the same.
Coordinate TikTok Live schedules with strong sellers, secure Spark Ads permissions, and optimize listings and content angles for maximum GMV.
Watch performance weekly. Scale top converters aggressively, and cut low performers fast.
Keep the data honest. No padded numbers, no inflated reporting. Decisions are only as good as the data behind them.




2. Instagram Influencers

Instagram is the second pillar. Here we work on gifting and affiliate only, so your skill is finding the right people and getting them to convert without a paid budget.

Source Instagram influencers who can actually sell, creators who understand product and know how to drive their audience to buy, not just post a pretty photo.
Run gifting-only and affiliate-only collaborations, and move creators from one gift to repeat posting to consistent affiliate sales.
Rebuild our existing relationships. We have lists of past and dormant influencers. A big part of this role is reigniting those relationships and turning old contacts back into active, converting partners.
Build genuine, consistent relationships so TopFoxx stays top of mind, through thoughtful, regular touchpoints across Instagram and DMs.




3. LTK, Affiliate Platforms & Onboarding Calls

The third pillar is affiliate-driven platforms like LTK, and just as important, getting on calls with creators. This role is not behind a screen all day. You have to be outgoing and genuinely good at talking to people.

Recruit and activate creators on LTK and other affiliate networks (Amazon, affiliate links) who are still actively driving commission-based sales.
Run weekly onboarding calls. You will be on calls regularly, onboarding new influencers, walking them through the program, and getting them excited and set up to post.
Get on calls and close collabs. Be confident and persuasive, build rapport quickly, and convince creators to say yes to working with us, often with gifting only.
Understand creator psychology and motivate influencers to post consistently through relationship, community value, and a clear win for them.




4. Strategy, Reporting & Full Influencer Marketing Scope

Because you own this function, you also handle everything a strong e-commerce influencer marketing lead would handle. Study what bigger e-commerce brands do, then adapt the best of it to a lean, fast-moving team.

Build the strategy. Bring a clear point of view on where influencer and affiliate marketing is going and how TopFoxx wins, then put it into action.
Plan and execute campaigns tied to product launches, holidays, seasonal moments, and major sales events (BFCM, summer, new drops).
Manage content calendars, gifting coordination, sample sends, and follow-ups so nothing slips.
Build weekly performance reports that connect activity to revenue, and use them to decide what to scale and what to kill.
Create simple SOPs, trackers, and playbooks as you go, so the program is repeatable and scalable as the team grows.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and product teams to keep messaging aligned, and step in on urgent launch-related projects when needed.
Stay ahead of trends, new creators, and new affiliate opportunities before competitors do.
Help with wider marketing as needed. With a team this small, marketing is just three people and everyone pitches in. From time to time things will come up across other marketing areas and departments that need a hand. We need someone proactive and solution-oriented who brings energy, jumps in, and helps build this with us rather than sitting idle.




Who You Are

Proactive: You see the gap and fill it. You bring the plan, you do not wait to be told.
A real executor: You move fast, ship daily, and adapt as things change hour to hour.
Analytical and profit-obsessed: You can read a Seller Center dashboard, understand ROI and margin, and turn data into decisions.
Persuasive and outgoing: You love talking to creators, you are comfortable on camera and on calls, and you can sell the partnership and the product.
Relationship-driven: You are a natural connector who builds loyalty and keeps partners coming back.
Organized under pressure: You can juggle hundreds of moving pieces without dropping the ball.




Required Experience & Skills

2+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, preferably in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce / DTC.
Expert, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center mechanics and affiliate programs.
Proven track record of generating real sales through gifting-only or zero-budget strategies.
Comfort with LTK, Amazon, and other affiliate platforms.
Comfortable on camera and hosting TikTok Lives to sell product directly.
Perfect written and spoken English, and a strong understanding of U.S. culture and digital trends. This is genuinely important.
KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.




What You Get

Salary of $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.
A fully remote role on a fast-moving global team.
Real ownership of the influencer and affiliate function, with a path into leadership as it scales.
PTO including vacation, holidays, sick, personal, and mental health days.
Free TopFoxx products and partner brand perks.

About The Position

Holafly is on the hunt for top-tier talent to assist in the global growth of our Affiliate Program. We partner up with a variety of third-parties, and establish a long-term, performance-based partnership with them in order to drive sales to Holafly.Your mission as a Digital Account Executive is to drive growth through strategic affiliate partnerships and campaigns. Leveraging your travel industry expertise, you will create data-driven campaigns to promote travel products and services, maximizing revenue and aligning with business goals. By managing affiliate relationships and tapping into regional trends, you’ll expand our brand presence and deliver measurable results in the Hispanic team.

Responsibilities Of The Role


Identify and actively recruit new affiliate partners and revenue drivers Own a curated portfolio of up to 80–100 affiliate partners, building individual account plans and executing quarterly growth roadmaps for them.
Build and maintain high-value relationships with top affiliate partners through structured touchpoints (QBRs, MBRs, planning & feedback sessions), acting as a strategic growth partner rather than a transactional account manager aiming for long term relationships.
Proactively monitor and optimize affiliate partner performance against key metrics (Revenue, ROAS and AOV), identifying growth opportunities and flagging risk signals such as declining output, fraud or partner inactivity
Develop and execute revenue acceleration plays including seasonal activations, exclusive deals, volume-based commission structures and cross-sell opportunities across geographies.
Ensure affiliate compliance with company policies and brand guidelines across all online channels.
Identify and pursue strategic opportunities to grow Holafly's market presence through high-quality affiliate partnerships.


Qualifications


Experience: 3+ years in Affiliate Marketing, influencer relations, or strategic partnerships
Demonstrated track record of building and nurturing strategic, revenue-driving partnerships across global markets.
Language: Native or bilingual in Spanish to lead negotiations in key global markets & professional level in English
Data Analysis: Strong ability to extract insights using Excel and Google Analytics to drive partnership growth
Background in managing large-scale performance campaigns in Spanish market
Existing network within the tech or travel industry
Bachelor's degree in Digital Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Solution-focused, dynamic, proactive, and ambitious.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Excellent project and time management skills.


Extras


Technical or digital marketing certifications are a plus.
Technical Stack: Proficiency with the Impact platform or similar platforms and a strong command of SEO tools (specifically Ahrefs)


Perks And Benefits


Full Remote Freedom: Work from anywhere with a setup that supports your lifestyle
Flexibility: Results-oriented culture with flexible working hours to ensure work-life harmony
Growth Budget: Dedicated funds for your continuous professional development
Competitive Package: Performance-based bonuses and generous Paid Time Off (PTO)


During a trip to Thailand, Pedro and Lidia, the founders of Holafly, experienced the frustration of not having an internet connection.

Inspired by their own experiences, they came up with a simple but brilliant idea: why not allow travellers to buy data plans for any destination from their home country?

Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do.

We love our work and we do it with pride. Stay connected wherever you go.

Micromeritics manufactures systems for the characterization of particles, powders, and porous materials for a wide- range of end markets including catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery. SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment. SciAps is the Center of Excellence for our handheld instruments.

We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado

Vision: Every seller is loved by the buyers they serve (#saleslove)
