title: Business Campaign Strategy Intern
skills: Analyze campaign performance data and generate weekly dashboards and insights that identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities, contributing to a 10–20% improvement in campaign KPIs.

Support the planning and execution of cross-channel acquisition and retention campaigns (in-app, push, SMS, paid social), coordinating with product, operations, and creative teams to ensure timely launches and consistent messaging.
Build and maintain audience segmentation and targeting logic using customer and driver behavioral data to improve precision targeting and lift conversion rates by testing new segment strategies.
Develop A/B test plans and track results for creative, channel mix, and incentive structures, documenting learnings and recommending scalable changes to reduce CPA and increase LTV.
Prepare concise business-facing reports and presentation decks that translate campaign findings into actionable recommendations for regional managers and senior stakeholders.
Monitor campaign budget spend and pacing, flagging risks and proposing reallocation strategies to maximize ROI while ensuring compliance with local market guidelines.
Assist in local market research and competitive benchmarking to adapt global campaign frameworks to regional behaviors and regulatory constraints, ensuring relevance and compliance.
Last years of bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using Excel, SQL, or analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau) to manipulate datasets and derive actionable insights.
Proactive, collaborative attitude with experience working in cross-functional teams and the adaptability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership, able to manage campaign tracking, budget pacing, and documentation for multiple regional pilots concurrently.
description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a BC (Business Campaign) Campaign Strategy Intern at DiDi, you will support the design, execution, and performance analysis of marketing and activation campaigns that drive driver and rider acquisition, retention, and platform engagement across multiple regions. description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Graduate Partner Marketing Manager, you aren’t just running campaigns; you are architecting the strategic relationships that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with the titans of tech:


Public cloud: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle.
Silicon: NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD.
Global hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo.



Early careers & growth

We are specifically looking for recent graduates who are serious about their success and ready to make a global impact. At Canonical, we prioritize talent and potential over years of experience; we will teach you the technical and commercial nuances of the open-source world through our structured career journey program. You will gain experience working with top tier talent and with multiple enterprise technologies. If you have the drive and a high standard for excellence, we provide the platform for you to become a world-class marketing leader.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region and will report to the Partner Marketing Team Manager.

Your impact


Architect joint success: Build high-velocity go-to-market plans with global partners, moving from initial messaging to full-scale pipeline generation.
Launch at scale: Lead integrated campaigns, industry announcements, and product launches that reach everyone from developers to C-suite decision-makers.
Creative packaging: Translate cutting-edge tech in the open-source world into educational and marketing content that resonates.
Ecosystem evolution: Shape and scale our partner programs to keep pace with an ever-expanding network of hardware vendors, software vendors, and channel resellers.



What We’re Looking For


The marketing basics: You understand how marketing works (especially within enterprises) and have familiarity with common marketing platforms, social media, and business technology.
The relationship builder: You can navigate complex and dynamic organizations and build lasting rapport.
The analytical thinker: You obsess over value and use data to decide which experiments to scale and which to iterate.
The self-starter: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and aren't afraid to "roll up your sleeves" to get a project across the finish line.



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.


Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events



About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues 
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization 
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support 
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an E-commerce Simulation Expert to work on a contract basis. • Background in scenario design and user behavior modeling, preferably in retail, consumer goods, or related domains.

• Attention to detail and a quality assurance mindset to maintain high standards in synthetic data generation and simulation environments.

• Self-directed work style with ability to manage multiple asynchronous tasks and deliver consistent, high-quality output under defined deadlines.

This role offers the chance to contribute directly to the development of frontier AI systems by leveraging real-world e-commerce expertise. skills: Experience with tools like Helium 10, Data Dive, or Jungle Scout.
Familiarity with Amazon's A+ Content and Brand Store modules.
Experience across multiple categories or markets.
description:
About the job

Brainlabs is the media agency built to answer one question: what's actually driving profit? Founded in 2012 by Daniel Gilbert, we were built by engineers before we were a media agency. Today, 1,000+ Brainlabbers across five continents use our proprietary agents, built on 32 media tools and over 2,500 logged experiments, to help brands connect every channel they plan and buy to one thing: the bottom line.

The role

Brands live and die by their product pages. A great product with poor content gets buried. A well-optimized listing with clear titles, strong keywords, and accurate attributes climbs. This role

owns that gap.

As a Content Optimization and Catalogue Management Specialist, you'll be responsible for how our clients products show up, get found, and convert on Amazon and Mercado Libre. That means writing and refining listings, managing catalogue health, and building the kind of organic visibility that doesn't disappear the moment ad spend drops.

You'll work directly with client teams and internal strategists to keep catalogues clean, content sharp, and rankings moving in the right direction.

What will you do?

Your day-to-day breaks into two connected areas.

Content Optimization

Content optimization is where you drive organic performance. You'll conduct keyword research, write and update product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend attributes. You'll audit existing content against platform best practices and identify gaps before they become ranking problems. You'll test copy variations and track what actually moves the needle.

Catalogue Management

Catalogue management is where you keep the operation running. You'll handle the publication and maintenance of product listings, manage bulk uploads and flat files, resolve listing errors

and suppressed ASINs or items, and keep content synchronized across multiple accounts and categories. When something breaks, you figure out why and fix it.

Beyond those two pillars, you'll monitor organic ranking performance, report on content health metrics, and bring recommendations that are grounded in data, not guesswork.

What are we looking for?

Experience

Around three years working in content optimization and/or catalogue management on Amazon and/or Mercado Libre. You understand how these platforms rank organic results and you've

influenced those rankings for real brands.

Platform Fluency

You know Seller Central and Vendor Central. You've worked with Mercado Libre item publication flows. Flat files, bulk uploads, listing errors, and suppressed items are familiar

territory, not new concepts.

Keyword and SEO Fundamentals

You know how to research, prioritize, and place keywords in a way that platforms reward. You understand the difference between what drives impressions and what drives conversions.

Analytical Mindset

You read performance data and draw conclusions from it. If organic rankings drop, you have a process for diagnosing why. If a content change works, you can explain what it did and why it helped.

Attention to Detail

Catalogue work is unforgiving. A wrong attribute, a missing image, a misformatted file: these things cause real problems. You catch errors before they ship.

English Proficiency

You're comfortable reading, writing, and communicating professionally in English. You'll work with international teams and documentation.

Nice to Have


Experience with tools like Helium 10, Data Dive, or Jungle Scout.
Familiarity with Amazon's A+ Content and Brand Store modules.
Experience across multiple categories or markets.



What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.

About the job

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Google Ads / PPC Specialist!

Note To Applicants


Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America. 
Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered. 
Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority. 
Interview Policy: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools during interviews are strictly prohibited. 
Note: As part of the final stages of our hiring process, candidates may be asked to provide professional references for a reference check. If hired, you may also be asked to update your LinkedIn profile :)


The Role

We’re hiring a hands-on Google Ads / PPC Specialist focused on lead generation through paid search. The goal is simple: turn high-intent searches into phone calls and booked appointments, not clicks or impressions.

This is not e-commerce or ROAS optimization on product catalogs. Success here means driving lower cost per lead, higher lead volume, and stronger lead quality across home services and local service industries such as HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, and healthcare.

You’ll own your accounts end to end — from audits and campaign builds to optimization, scaling, and performance storytelling. You’ll collaborate closely with a copywriter (ads), a web/UX team (landing pages), and account managers (client context and communication).

What You’ll Own


Audit, build, manage, and scale Google Ads campaigns (Search, Local Services Ads / Google Guaranteed, Performance Max, 
Display, and remarketing) across multiple accounts
Improve performance by reducing cost per lead while increasing lead volume and quality
Manage keyword strategy, including match types, search term analysis, negative keywords, and continuous optimization to eliminate wasted spend
Own conversion tracking integrity using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and call tracking tools (e.g., CallRail or similar), ensuring accuracy before optimization
Close the loop with CRM data by feeding qualified leads and booked jobs back into Google Ads via offline conversion imports
Manage bidding strategies and budget allocation to maximize lead efficiency
Align landing pages with ad intent to improve conversion rates (in collaboration with web/UX teams)
Continuously test ad copy, landing pages, bidding strategies, and audiences
Report performance clearly to stakeholders and proactively flag risks or performance shifts
Use AI tools daily to accelerate analysis, reporting, and optimization workflows


The Hard Parts (Read Before Applying)


We prefer candidates self-selecting out if the environment is not a fit:
Lead generation is different from e-commerce. This role focuses on lead quality, not purchase ROAS. Interpreting lead quality requires deeper judgment than transaction-based metrics
Full ownership role. You will both execute campaigns and own outcomes — there is no separate team running accounts for you
Multiple accounts, fast pace. You’ll manage several clients simultaneously, each with different seasonality patterns and performance dynamics
Client communication under pressure. You’ll handle questions when lead volume fluctuates or costs rise, and must be able to explain performance clearly and calmly
Tracking accuracy is critical. Incorrect tracking invalidates all optimization work — validation is a core responsibility


How You’ll Be Measured


Cost per lead (CPL) — reduction and stability across accounts
Lead volume and quality — increased number of qualified leads (calls, booked appointments, form fills)
Client retention — accounts remain due to consistent performance
Account health — clean structure, accurate tracking, proper negatives, and well-documented changes


Who You Are

This role is a strong fit if you:


Have 3+ years of experience managing Google Ads / paid search with measurable results
Can independently audit accounts and prioritize fixes with clarity
Have scaled budgets while maintaining cost-per-lead targets
Have deep expertise in Search campaigns (match types, search term mining, negatives, bidding strategies)
Have experience with Local Services Ads (Google Guaranteed), including setup, optimization, and lead dispute handling
Have implemented and managed conversion tracking (GA4, GTM, call tracking) independently
Have experience feeding offline CRM conversions back into Google Ads (closed-loop attribution)
Are highly data-driven and continuously testing new approaches
Communicate performance clearly and confidently in client-facing settings
Use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT or similar) as part of your daily workflow
Are fluent in professional English and comfortable working with U.S.-based teams and clients


Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 5 PM U.S. Central Time.

Compensation: USD salary

Location: 100% remote opportunity

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

description:
About the job

Lazer is a world-class digital product studio composed of 180+ senior engineers and designers with backgrounds from companies like Apple, Google, Coinbase, and more. With our product experience, we have designed, engineered, and grown products from $0 to $200M in revenue.

Clients seek out our help because we have the talent to deeply understand their needs and provide industry, technical, or product insights that are uniquely valuable to their efforts. Our clients range from early-stage startups and venture studios to recognizable retail brands and exciting enterprises. Some of our notable clients include Google, Shopify, Coinbase, Alchemy, Hinge, OVO, Polymarket, and more.

We are a remote-first organization headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with employees worldwide. We believe in providing the best experience possible for all Lazerites by fostering a strong community through regular events, company vacations, competitive compensation, unlimited PTO, and more!

Join Lazer and help us solve problems and build the next generation of products!

Lazer Commerce is a specialized team within Lazer focused on crafting scalable, high-performing commerce experiences across the Shopify ecosystem. We partner with forward-thinking brands and agencies to design and implement custom storefronts, headless architectures, and robust backend integrations. From theme development to complex ERP and OMS workflows, our engineers bring deep expertise in Shopify, modern frameworks, and commerce infrastructure to help clients launch, scale, and optimize their digital retail experiences.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape, define, and deliver large-scale Shopify commerce experiences for leading brands.

In this role, you’ll bridge the gap between strategy, delivery, and technology — translating discovery insights into actionable roadmaps and ensuring every project delivers measurable value.

Please Note: This is a Contract position (hourly rate). We welcome applications from across the globe, but our preferred candidates should be able to have a meaningful overlap with Eastern Standard Timezone (EST).

Who You Are


You have 3+ years of experience in Product Management or similar roles (Business Analyst, Product Owner), ideally within a brand, agency, or consultancy environment.
You have a proven track record of delivering large-scale digital commerce projects, including platform migrations from legacy systems like SFCC, Magento, or Hybris to modern SaaS ecosystems.
You’re deeply familiar with Shopify Plus and the broader commerce technology stack — from ERP and OMS to PIM, CRM, CDP, and payments.
You thrive in enterprise stakeholder environments, collaborating confidently with C-suite, product, and engineering teams.
You’re fluent in agile delivery practices (Scrum, SAFe) and discovery frameworks, with a structured yet flexible mindset.
You’re an exceptional communicator and facilitator who can bring clarity, alignment, and focus to complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
You combine technical literacy (APIs, integrations, architecture fundamentals) with strong commercial acumen, always focused on ROI and client value.
You’re analytical and detail-oriented, comfortable defining and tracking KPIs that measure success and impact.
You’re adaptable and thrive in ambiguity — driving clarity, protecting scope, and helping teams deliver meaningful results.


Bonus Points If You Have


Experience supporting multi-market or international merchants.
Familiarity with CRO, experimentation, and analytics tools.
Experience building or scaling a product management practice within an agency.


What You'll Do

Discovery & Scope Definition


Lead client discovery sessions post-sale to understand business goals, customer journeys, and operational processes.
Partner with Technical Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Delivery Managers to define clear project scope and alignment.
Translate discovery findings into a product vision, measurable objectives, and an agreed scope baseline.
Support decision-making around change requests, scope variations, and timeline impacts, balancing commercial, technical, and client needs.


Backlog & Roadmap Management


Build and maintain a structured product backlog — defining epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria with clarity and priority.
Facilitate trade-off discussions with client and internal teams, ensuring alignment with scope and outcomes.
Own the roadmap and prioritization process for migrations, new builds, and optimization projects.


Collaboration & Execution


Work closely with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, and Engineers to ensure delivery aligns with defined goals.
Provide continuous product context during sprints, removing ambiguity and safeguarding scope boundaries.
Support UAT and client enablement before and after releases.


Value Realization & Optimization


Focus on KPIs tied to conversion, AOV, retention, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Review delivered functionality with clients, recommending iterative improvements while maintaining scope discipline.
Act as a strategic product partner, driving growth and long-term value for enterprise Shopify clients.


Agency & Practice Building


Help establish Product Management as a discipline within the agency — building frameworks for discovery, documentation, and delivery.
Mentor peers in product-led, scope-driven thinking across teams.
Contribute to agency thought leadership, developing case studies and best practices for enterprise commerce.


What Success Looks Like


Discovery and requirements gathering produce clear, aligned, and agreed-upon scopes.
Delivery teams operate with clarity and confidence, minimizing scope creep and misalignment.
Change requests are transparent and data-driven, with well-communicated trade-offs.
Clients experience measurable business impact and trust in our delivery.
Product Management becomes a recognized pillar that elevates delivery quality and client success.


AI in our hiring process

We use AI to help us review and shortlist applications based on job-related criteria. A human hiring manager always makes the call on who moves forward. As a company that builds with AI every day, we're all for candidates using it too — just be upfront about how it helped.

Why Work With Us


🚀 Accelerate Your Growth: Work across multiple industries and cutting-edge projects with a team that ships fast.
💥 Maximum Impact: Shape the future of the tech industry by helping ambitious projects reach their potential.
🏅 True Ownership: Everyone ships code and has real autonomy with minimal meetings.
💡 Continuous Learning: Be part of a team of senior engineers and designers who love learning and knowledge sharing.


Why This Might Not Be For You


🤖 You Resist Modern Tools: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to build rapidly and focus our energy on solving the most complex, high-impact challenges for our clients.
🏗️ You Crave High Structure: We thrive in an autonomous, fast-moving environment, which means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity.
😴 You Prefer Conventional Careers: Our consulting approach involves varied projects and direct client interaction — it's not for everyone.
1️⃣ You Like Staying in One Lane: Our projects require adapting to different tech stacks and modern tooling quickly.


Benefits & Perks


🌐 Work From Anywhere: Choose your workspace — all you need is strong wifi and a passion for building!
🧘‍♂️ Work / Life Balance: We believe in our team’s ability to have it all; a great career, and time to unplug and live…you know...life.

title: Digital Marketing Analyst
description:
About the job

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

NEOGEN Digital Marketing Analyst support our LATAM digital marketing team. The responsibilities will include social media management for our LATAM accounts, it is Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram; execute campaign strategies and create marketing digital assets as email templates, forms, and landing pages on Eloqua (marketing automation), SEO, website optimization and maintenance. This role will also be responsible for assign new leads to sales representant on Salesforce CRM; collect and analyze data from social media, google and Eloqua for digital reports.

The Marketing Automation Specialist is responsible for creating and developing content for forms, landing pages, and email templates within Eloqua, supporting website design, development, and planning, and executing marketing campaigns across multiple digital channels. This role manages lead generation and lead routing processes, supports content ecosystem administration through platforms such as Bynder and Seismic, and monitors marketing KPIs and campaign performance to optimize results.

The position requires maintaining consistency and compliance with brand guidelines, messaging, and approved materials, using only content validated by marketing, technical, and legal stakeholders to ensure traceability and compliance. The incumbent is also responsible for keeping Quality Management System (QMS) documentation up to date, contributing to preventive actions and continuous process improvements, and maintaining an organized and compliant work environment.

In alignment with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards, the employee is expected to use all applicable personal and collective protective equipment, maintain an appropriate workstation, take active breaks, and manage workloads to support personal health and performance.

The successful candidate demonstrates and embodies Neogen's Pillars of Trust—Openness, Honesty, Credibility, Respect, and Service—through all actions, behaviors, and communications. They communicate effectively, actively listen, lead by example, foster teamwork and trust, make timely decisions, solve problems efficiently, and drive performance through accountability, productivity, and innovation. They also understand their role within the broader organization and remain curious about how their work contributes to business success.

Qualifications include a college degree, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, with at least one year of relevant experience (two years preferred). Candidates should possess knowledge of marketing principles, Microsoft Office applications, CRM systems, and marketing automation platforms, with experience in Eloqua and Salesforce preferred. Additional expertise in digital marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, UX/UI design, SEO, SEM, marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, and reporting is highly desirable. An intermediate to advanced level of English is required.

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

description:
About the job

About Klar

Let’s start with the basics! Klar is a Mexican fintech whose mission is to democratize and revolutionize how financial services are delivered in Mexico — especially since half of the population still doesn’t have a bank account. Since our launch in 2019, we’ve served more than 7 million users with a growing suite of debit and credit products, and the future is brighter than ever.

Today, we’re not only scaling our consumer business, but also building Klar Empresas (B2B) from the ground up — a new division focused on empowering Mexican SMEs with the financial tools, capital, and services they need to grow. This is an exciting new chapter where we get to design and build from scratch while leveraging the trust and scale of Klar’s platform.

We are also proud to have been certified as a “Great Place to Work” in Mexico — something we’ve worked hard to achieve and will continue to build on.

Our people

If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team which is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here!

Our values


Ownership - We own our successes & our failures as a team.
Excellence - We do everything to the best of our ability & always seek to achieve a new level of excellence in our work.
Inclusion - We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture.
Customer Obsession - We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers & it’s always at the forefront of our decisions.
Klarity - We communicate clearly & with authenticity. It’s in our name & it’s what we do.


The position and your daily adventures

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to execute, optimize, and scale paid acquisition campaigns across Google, Meta, and other performance platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves data, experimentation, and turning budgets into measurable growth.

You will own the day-to-day operation of performance campaigns, continuously improving CAC, ROAS, and funnel conversion, working closely with creative, analytics, and growth teams. You’ll be part of a high-performance team managing a US$2M+ monthly budget.

What you can expect:


Reporting: Create weekly and ad-hoc performance reports. Make financial analysis of campaign spend.
Own campaign tracking, attribution setup, and pixel/event health.
Operate and optimize paid campaigns: Constant monitoring and daily adjustments of paid ads campaigns on Google, Facebook and new channels.
Launch new campaigns, ad sets, creatives, and targeting strategies
Monitor performance daily and implement data-driven optimizations.
Run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and funnels.
Collaborate with creative and product teams to improve conversion.
KEY KPIs: New users and approved credit lines, Cost per Acquisition (CpA), and ROAS. 


What we are looking for:


Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Digital Transformation Engineering, (or similar) with an orientation to data analysis.
2+ years hands-on experience running performance campaigns on: Meta and Google.
Strong analytical skills, comfort working with performance dashboards and experience with SQL.
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and attribution tools.
Ability to do Data-driven decision-making.
High ownership, attention to detail, and execution speed.
Advanced English level.
Experience in fintech, apps, or subscription products is a plus.


Our offer to you:


Competitive salary based on performance and experience
Chance of earning Klar stock options
15 days of paid vacation per year; plus extended maternity and paternity leaves
Vacation premium
Food vouchers
30 days of Christmas bonus
Medical Insurance
Computer devices
Well hub subscription to offer mental and physical health 
Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions 
A modern centrally located office in Mexico City with free drinks, snacks, and regular social events
International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people
A world-class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in


Klar is a safe place for everyone!

We trust our highly skilled and diverse team, and we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for new talents to flourish. We value diversity and welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation and identity.

Should you require any accommodations through the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know how we can help!

description:
About the job

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced, technically sharp marketing lead for Shopify's 3P Shop Campaigns program. You will own performance, experimentation, and scaling of our Google product advertising portfolio (Performance Max, Shopping, Search Ads), with the opportunity to expand into additional emerging channels over time.

This is not a typical paid media role. You will operate at the intersection of marketing, product feeds, and engineering. A significant part of your work involves managing campaigns with aggressive ROAS targets and expanding the product catalog that powers our ads: millions of merchant products flowing through feed pipelines, eligibility filters, and Google review processes. You will partner closely with engineering and data science teams on catalog health, conversion signal infrastructure, and measurement rigor.

The right person combines hands-on feed/shopping campaign experience with the strategic ability to manage a channel portfolio against efficiency targets, design high-velocity experiments, and communicate performance and trade-offs clearly to leadership.

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a collaborative Growth team that values creativity, experimentation, and impact. With access to significant budgets, a strong data-driven culture, and exposure to cross-functional experts, you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your performance media craft, while directly contributing to scaling our business.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio & Campaign Management


Own day-to-day operations of our Google product advertising program (Performance Max, Shopping, Search Ads & more), managing campaigns against revenue ratio and efficiency targets globally.
Design and execute high-velocity testing pipelines across bidding strategies, campaign structures, audiences, creative, and landing pages.
Over time, extend ownership to additional emerging channels as the portfolio evolves, managing a tiered channel strategy with structured experiments and clear kill criteria.



Catalog & Feed Management


Own the health and growth of the product catalog that powers all advertising: eligibility rules, feed quality, Google Merchant Center policies, and disapproval resolution.
Monitor catalog coverage and identify scaling levers, including eligibility filter tuning, MCA suspension reduction, and feed enrichment opportunities.
Partner with product and engineering teams on catalog pipeline improvements and product vetting automation.



Conversion Signals & Measurement


Partner with engineering to maintain and improve conversion signal pipelines, ensuring signal quality, match rates, and attribution accuracy.
Work with data science on incrementality measurement, attribution model calibration, and valuation frameworks that inform spend allocation decisions.
Monitor signal health (click ID coverage, event volumes, platform-reported vs. internal attribution gaps) and escalate anomalies.



Cross-Functional & Communication


Work with creative strategy to develop effective product advertising programs across the funnel.
Actively communicate program performance, financial health, and strategic trade-offs to marketing leadership and finance stakeholders.



Qualifications


A successful track record managing SEM and product-feed-based advertising campaigns at scale (Shopping, Performance Max, or equivalent), with demonstrated ability to hit efficiency targets.
Direct experience with product feed management and merchant center operations: feed diagnostics, disapproval resolution, eligibility optimization, and catalog scaling.
Experience with SQL. You may not be able to write complex queries from scratch, but you have a high-level understanding of databases and how to query them.
Working knowledge of conversion tracking infrastructure: server-to-server signals, click ID mechanics, attribution windows, and how signal quality affects platform bidding.
Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams on technical marketing problems (feed pipelines, attribution, measurement frameworks).
Ability to design structured experiments with clear hypotheses, kill criteria, and measurement plans.
Strong stakeholder communication skills: you can translate technical performance data into clear narratives for marketing leadership and finance.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and can navigate through ambiguity and work with minimal guidance.



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:


Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
Bring critical thought and opinion
Put AI agents and tools to work on the tasks they're built for, and focus on the work only humans can do
Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
Work digital-first for your daily work

About the job

Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el mayor ecosistema inmobiliario de América Latina. Guiados por un propósito compartido de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven, contamos con un portafolio diversificado de marcas y soluciones en diferentes países de América Latina y también con un Hub de Tecnología en Portugal. Desarrollamos tecnologías e innovación para transformar e impulsar la experiencia de vivienda en su totalidad.

Juntas, nuestras marcas líderes ofrecen soluciones que cubren todas las etapas del proceso de viviendar: Inmuebles24 (México), Zonaprop (Argentina), Adondevivir y Urbania (Perú), Plusvalía (Ecuador), ImovelWeb y QuintoAndar (Brasil).

Con el apoyo de un equipo de inversionistas y consultores de clase mundial, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic y SoftBank, QuintoAndar Group está actualmente valorado en más de 5.100 millones de dólares y sigue creciendo año tras año.

Aquí trabajarás con los mejores profesionales del mercado, en un entorno que respira innovación, colaboración y alto rendimiento. Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, visita https://grupoquintoandar.com/es/.

About the job

About us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.




About the role:

We're looking for a writer who can produce content that genuinely stands out. Content that ranks, earns citations, builds credibility, and gives readers something they couldn't get from an AI summary.

You'll spend the majority of your time on content: researching and writing articles, contributing to original research reports, and building the kind of assets that attract attention from humans, Google, and LLMs.

You'll also bring solid copywriting skills that come into play on specific assets: emails, landing pages, and occasionally social media posts.

What we're looking for is someone who raises the bar on what we produce. Someone who brings genuine editorial judgment and the instinct to push past consensus answers toward something worth reading.

You'll work in an AI-augmented environment, using Claude and internal workflows to accelerate research and drafting, but strong human judgment is what separates great output from good output here.

This is a role for someone who can research fast, write clearly, and ship on tight deadlines.




Responsibilities:

Produce high-quality, well-researched articles optimized for SEO and GEO.
Update articles that are outdated, underperforming, or misaligned with current messaging.
Contribute to proprietary data initiatives, helping compile survey results, analyze data, and shape findings into publishable research assets.
Write high-converting B2B copy across emails, landing pages, case studies, and core website pages.
Use Claude and internal AI workflows to accelerate research and first drafts, then apply strong human judgment to refine and elevate final output.
Collaborate closely with the Content Lead to align on direction, incorporate feedback, and iterate until work meets quality standards.
Maintain messaging, positioning, and brand voice consistency across all content and copy.
Help improve, build, and maintain templates and workflows so high-quality assets can be produced faster over time.
Continuously build domain expertise in our industry and ICPs to increase speed and quality of written assets.




Must-Haves:

2+ years of B2B marketing content writing or copywriting experience (services, SaaS, or agency).
Outstanding storytelling skills
Knows how to find the interesting angle, the credible source, and the data point that makes a piece worth reading.
Proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused copy for web, decks, email, ad campaigns, and other marketing collateral.
Strong self-editing discipline. Expects multiple iterations and improves drafts before feedback.
Experienced in using AI for research and drafting while knowing when heavy human rewriting is required.
World-class portfolio showing strong work across assets such as landing pages, case studies, white papers, articles, and emails.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Ability to hit deadlines, manage multiple projects, and adapt tone by channel and audience.




Nice-to-Haves:

Startup or agency background.
Experience collaborating with designers to create premium, polished marketing assets.
Familiarity with SEO and A/B testing copy.
Experience with community engagement: Reddit, Quora, LinkedIn, or professional forums. Understands how to contribute helpfully to a conversation rather than just promote. Knows what gets ignored and what earns credibility.
Experience contributing to original research: surveys, data reports, industry studies. Comfortable working with raw data and shaping it into a narrative.




What's in for you:

100% remote role.
Compensation in USD.
Time off: 14 vacation days, US working holidays + 4 local floating holidays, birthday off.
Health insurance stipend.

title: RSNA Expert - Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Overseas Exhibition Project Manager to oversee the comprehensive management of the entire process for international exhibitions, including the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA) annual meeting. This role will lead exhibition planning, execution, vendor coordination, and client relationship management to ensure optimal brand presentation and participation outcomes at international events. Additionally, this position will serve as a key liaison for the company's digital accounts, collaborating closely with the marketing team to effectively convert offline exhibition traffic into online digital assets.




Position Responsibilities:

1. Exhibition Project Management (RSNA & Overseas Exhibitions)

· Manage the full lifecycle of planning and execution for the RSNA annual meeting and other overseas exhibitions, including booth reservation, exhibit material shipping, construction plan coordination, and on-site services.

· Maintain efficient communication with venues, external suppliers (construction, logistics, service providers) to ensure the smooth execution of all exhibition phases.

· Develop and manage project timelines and quality standards, ensuring critical milestones are met on schedule.

· Oversee on-site operations during exhibitions, including construction supervision, activity execution, and emergency handling.

· Possess thorough knowledge of RSNA rules and regulations to ensure exhibition behavior complies with organizer requirements and mitigates compliance risks.

2. Supplier and Budget Management

· Participate in the tendering, evaluation, and selection process for service suppliers (construction, logistics, PR, etc.), managing the Request for Proposals (RFP) process.

· Prepare and monitor exhibition project budgets, including booth fees, construction costs, shipping, travel expenses, etc., ensuring expenditures stay within budget and identifying cost-saving opportunities.

· Responsible for reviewing, archiving, and ensuring compliance for all exhibition-related contracts.

3. Client Relations and Sales Support

· Maintain efficient communication with exhibitors, providing professional services and on-site support.

· Nurture existing client relationships, identify potential client needs, and assist the sales team with registration and administrative processes.

· Collaborate with the digital marketing team to ensure sales leads generated during exhibitions are effectively entered into the CRM system (e.g., Salesforce) for data integration.

4. Cross-Cultural Communication & International Coordination

· Navigate cross-regional and cross-cultural work environments, building strong collaborative relationships with overseas organizers, service providers, and partners.

· Adapt to overseas travel requirements, leading teams to participate in RSNA and other international exhibitions, providing on-site support and problem-solving.

· Coordinate with internal departments (Marketing, Sales, Product, etc.) to ensure exhibition objectives align with the company's overall strategy.

5. Documentation and Reporting

· Organize, archive, and manage exhibition-related documents, including participation contracts, service agreements, and exhibition materials.

· Regularly prepare comprehensive post-exhibition summary reports, including effectiveness evaluation, ROI analysis, and recommendations for improvement

· Monitor industry trends and exhibition developments, providing data-driven insights and optimization suggestions for the company's exhibition strategy.




Required Skills & Education:

1. Education Background

· Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in International Business, Exhibition Management, Marketing, or a related field.

2. Work Experience

· Minimum 3 years of project management experience specifically with overseas exhibitions, having successfully led the preparation and execution of multiple international events.

· Experience with RSNA or other major medical/professional international exhibitions is highly preferred.

· Experience in domestic and international exhibition organization is preferred.

3. Professional Skills

· Proficient in the full cycle of exhibition project management, including planning, execution, and evaluation.

· Familiar with international trade practices and characteristics of overseas markets, possessing strong negotiation skills.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Asana).

· Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is a plus.

· Experience in financial modeling and budget management is an advantage.

4. Language Ability

· Fluent in English with excellent listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills, capable of using English as a working language for business communication with international partners.

· Overseas work or study background is highly preferred.

5. Core Competencies

· Excellent communication, coordination, and execution skills, capable of building and maintaining strong collaborative relationships across departments and international teams.

· Strong project and time management skills, able to handle multiple tasks and emergencies simultaneously.

· High sense of responsibility and strong ability to work under pressure, adaptable to overseas travel and the high-intensity pace of exhibition work.

· Strong learning agility and market insight, capable of quickly grasping industry dynamics.

· Customer-oriented mindset with attention to detail and a pursuit of excellence in the industry’s exhibition experience.

description:
About the job

Growth Marketer

Seneca Cost Segregation · Remote · Salary: $2000-$3000/month + Target based bounus




About Seneca

We help real estate investors keep more of their money. Cost segregation is a tax strategy that accelerates depreciation and puts cash back in our clients’ hands, often six figures in Year 1. We’ve performed over 10,200 studies and analyzed more than $1B in cost basis, and we’ve never lost an IRS audit.

We’re a lean, fast-growing team scaling toward $5–10M. That means real ownership, real budget, and real impact from day one. No layers, no politics, no waiting for permission.




The Role

We’re hiring a Growth Marketer to own the full marketing funnel, from first touch to qualified pipeline. You’ll build the nurture and conversion systems that turn leads into sales conversations, sharpen our paid channels, and create the reporting that tells us exactly what’s working.




This is a hands-on builder role, not a team-management role (yet). You’ll do the work, with the leverage to grow as we scale. If you think in systems instead of manual effort, use AI to multiply your own output, and want to see your work move the revenue number, this is for you.




What You’ll Own

Nurture and conversion. Build and optimize nurture, re-engagement, and sales-funnel catalyst campaigns in GoHighLevel that move new leads through the funnel and into sales conversations.
Lead-to-sales handoff. Design the handoff so reps get context, not just a name. The goal is qualified leads that are ready to engage, not raw volume.
Paid search. Improve performance from Google Ads, from targeting and copy to landing pages and conversion tracking. Kill what’s not working, double down on what is.
Social creative. Manage the generation and optimization of creative for social ads, often AI-assisted. Test fast, read the data, cut losers quickly.
Reporting. Work with Operations to build improved reporting across all leads and the full marketing funnel, from first-touch attribution through to closed revenue.
The number. Own a monthly qualified-lead and pipeline target. You’ll have visibility into your performance and the autonomy to act on it.




Who You Are

Creative. You come up with the hook, the angle, and the test, not just the spreadsheet.
AI-native. You use AI well beyond chat. You’ve built loops, agents, or automations to do your own job faster, and you can show us what you’ve made.
A systems thinker. Your instinct is to build a repeatable system, not to grind through the same manual task twice.
Metrics-driven. You’re comfortable owning a number and being measured against it. You speak in CPL, CAC, conversion rate, and ROAS.
Excited by speed. You want to work at a fast-growing company where you ship, learn, and iterate, not wait on a quarterly planning cycle.
Target-based Experimenter: testing > assuming. You build and measure, adjust, repeat, and then scale. And know when to double down based on data + your experience. 

 

This Probably Isn’t a Fit If…

Your answer to every lead-gen problem is “spend more on ads.” Paid is one channel, not the strategy.
You avoid committing to a number, or treat activity as the same thing as results.




Our Stack

GoHighLevel (CRM and automation), Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and Google Search Console, GTM, WordPress site, Claude AI and some Codex. You don’t need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be the kind of person who gets fluent in a new tool fast and self-starts to hit your targets.




How to Apply

Send us a short note on a growth system you built and the result it drove. Include one example of a loop, agent, or automation you made to speed up your own work. We read every application that shows us something real.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the job

About Zenit Corp

Zenit Corp is a rapidly growing ecommerce group that owns and operates multiple direct-to-consumer brands across different international markets.

Our focus is on building category-leading brands with strong fundamentals, scalable systems, and long-term growth potential. We are not building a single ecommerce business, but a portfolio of brands designed to scale aggressively over the coming years.

We are looking for creative individuals who want more than just a job. We want people who are eager to create, execute, improve, and grow alongside the company.

The Graphic Designer will be responsible for producing high-quality visual assets that strengthen our brands, support marketing initiatives, enhance communication, and help drive growth across multiple ecommerce channels.

This role is ideal for someone creative, detail-oriented, organized, and capable of translating brand direction, marketing goals, and AI-generated concepts into strong and polished visual content.

Role

The Graphic Designer is responsible for developing visual content across social media, websites, advertising campaigns, ecommerce assets, presentations, banners, and promotional materials.

This role requires strong design skills, excellent visual judgment, an understanding of branding, experience working with AI-generated imagery, and the ability to adapt creative assets across multiple formats and platforms.

The designer will collaborate closely with marketing, content, creative, and leadership teams to ensure all visual materials are consistent, engaging, brand-aligned, and execution-ready.

Graphic Designer Responsibilities❖ Graphic Design

➢ Design visual assets for social media, websites, landing pages, advertising campaigns, and ecommerce platforms.

 ➢ Create banners, presentations, promotional materials, and brand communication assets.

 ➢ Develop visually appealing and brand-consistent designs.

 ➢ Translate creative direction and campaign requirements into production-ready visuals.

❖ AI Image Generation

➢ Use AI-based image generation tools to create, enhance, and adapt visuals for campaigns, content, and ecommerce assets.

 ➢ Understand basic AI workflows such as prompting, refinement, upscaling, background creation, and variations.

 ➢ Combine AI-generated visuals with traditional design tools to produce high-quality final outputs.

 ➢ Identify opportunities to leverage AI to speed up production and improve creative output.

❖ Brand & Visual Consistency

➢ Maintain visual consistency across all brands and marketing channels.

 ➢ Apply branding principles such as typography, color systems, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy.

 ➢ Organize design files, templates, and visual resources in a structured way.

 ➢ Contribute to improving scalable design systems for multi-brand use.

❖ Creative Collaboration

➢ Work closely with the creative strategist and marketing team.

 ➢ Translate campaign objectives into effective visual executions.

 ➢ Contribute ideas for visual concepts, campaigns, and brand development.

❖ Content Optimization

➢ Adapt designs for different platforms, formats, and use cases.

 ➢ Create multiple variations of assets for testing and performance optimization.

 ➢ Refine designs based on feedback, performance data, and creative direction.

Role Objectives❖ Creative Quality & Impact

➢ Produce high-quality visual content aligned with brand identity.

 ➢ Support marketing initiatives with strong and effective creative assets.

 ➢ Improve engagement through visually compelling design.

 ➢ Strengthen consistency across all brand touchpoints.

 ➢ Improve production speed and efficiency through AI tools and optimized workflows.

Requirements❖ Experience & Technical Skills

➢ Minimum of 2 years of experience in graphic design.

 ➢ Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite or similar design tools.

 ➢ Basic experience with AI image generation tools and workflows (mandatory).

 ➢ Strong portfolio demonstrating previous design work.

 ➢ Solid understanding of layout, typography, composition, branding, and digital design principles.

 ➢ Ability to create assets for ads, social media, websites, presentations, and campaigns.

❖ Communication & Work Style

➢ B2 English level or higher.

 ➢ Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.

 ➢ High attention to detail and strong organizational habits.

 ➢ Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

 ➢ Open to feedback and able to iterate quickly.

 ➢ Strong ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

What We Offer❖ Compensation & Growth

➢ Salary up to USD 10,000 per year.

 ➢ High-performance, fast-paced work environment.

 ➢ Direct impact on a rapidly scaling ecommerce group.

 ➢ Long-term collaboration opportunities.

 ➢ Exposure to multiple ecommerce brands and creative challenges.

 ➢ Experience working with AI-powered design workflows and modern creative tools.

Required Equipment❖ Work Setup

➢ High-performance computer.

 ➢ Stable and fast internet connection.

 ➢ Distraction-free workspace.

Candidate Profile❖ Ideal Candidate

➢ Creative, detail-oriented, structured, and reliable.

 ➢ Strong visual judgment and understanding of brand consistency.

 ➢ Comfortable using AI tools to improve speed and quality of design output.

 ➢ Able to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and feedback cycles.

 ➢ Ownership mindset with consistent delivery of high-quality work.

 ➢ Excited to work in a fast-paced environment where design directly impacts business growth.

description:
About the job

About The Team

We are looking for an experienced Marketing Technologist or Marketing TPM in the Marketing Operations space to help build highly coordinated and efficient infrastructure that enables Zillow's marketing organization. As part of this role, you will integrate with and operate on various marketing systems and will be a key point person for data, infrastructure, activation and analytics for marketing initiatives and campaigns.

About The Role

This role will serve as a technical liaison between marketing, analytics, engineering and marketing vendor teams to bring all partners together toward a common goal. The ideal candidate shines in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, and has a balance of program management and hands on technical skills. If you like solving complex problems and are passionate about enabling marketing teams and delivering the vision of Zillow 2.0, we want to hear from you!


Play a key role in configuration, integration and operations of marketing systems including Marketing Analytics Platform to help with automating data ingestion pipelines, building taxonomy tools, datasets for end to end Marketing Campaign performance and reporting. 
This role is a combination of hands-on-keyboards(Manage marketing systems integrations, data ingestion, and built ETLs to prepare analytics datasets) AND program management (work with various teams to align on roadmaps for collecting, testing and preparing both third party and own data). 
Integral team member driving the marketing technology roadmap by participating in onboarding of new platforms from implementation, integration, execution, data and security compliance review and training user teams. 
Drive the shift to an AI-native operating model by applying systems thinking to fundamentally change workflows, leveraging AI as a 'creator' and 'true coworker'. 
Lead the investigation and implementation of AI-driven tooling and integrations (e.g., Meta Ads AI Connectors, LLM-powered agents, Databricks embedded prompts) to automate campaign setup, content generation, and operational execution for marketing initiatives. 
Enable self-service data and conversational analytics by deploying AI/LLM agents to allow non-technical teams to query diverse data sources and surface campaign performance insights. 
Build dashboards/reports needed by marketing teams using AI and Genie spaces. 
Coordinating with other dev dependencies to align cross-tech team sprint schedules & release plans. 
Documents and maintains standard/efficient processes, automating as much as possible. 
Enable cross-team testing scenarios. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


You have 3+ years of experience in Engineering, Analytics, Tech. Operations, Marketing Technologist role, shipping scalable platforms and services in marketing-related domains
You are experienced in SQL, Python (or other programming languages), Databricks/Tableau Dashboards and familiar with ETL tools and integration with Marketing systems. 
You have hands-on experience in using AWS services like S3, Lambda, etc. 
You have experience applying systems thinking to drive the shift to an AI-native operating model and fundamentally change workflows. 
You are skilled in implementing AI-driven tooling and integrations. 
You have experience enabling self-service and conversational analytics by deploying AI/LLM agents. 
You champion fast experimentation cycles with AI capabilities to validate and translate new technical direction. 
You gravitate toward the detail but can keep the big picture in focus. 
You love data and all that it can power. 
You take a highly analytical approach, using data to drive step-change results. 
You have experience in a TPM tool like Wrike or JIRA. 
You exhibit a collaborative working style with a solid focus on execution
You have the modesty to question assumptions, seek broad input, and validate iteratively. 
You have operational excellence, clear communication and take ownership of your work. 
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Operations Management, or similar field preferred or equivalent experience


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

description:
About the job

Te frustra cuando una campaña se lanza y nadie sabe realmente si funcionó? 




A nosotros también.

Por eso estamos buscando un(a) Especialista en Marketing que vea más allá de los clics y las impresiones.

Alguien que entienda que detrás de cada campaña existe un negocio, un objetivo y una oportunidad de crecimiento.




Probablemente conectes con esta vacante si alguna vez has pensado:

💭 "¿Por qué estamos haciendo esto si nadie analizó los resultados anteriores?"

💭 "Hay mejores maneras de comunicar este mensaje."

💭 "Las métricas deberían servir para tomar decisiones, no para llenar reportes."

💭 "Me gustaría participar más en la estrategia y menos en la ejecución mecánica.




Lo que harás

Liderar reuniones virtuales con clientes.
Dar seguimiento continuo a sus campañas.
Crear copys publicitarios para diferentes plataformas.
Configurar campañas y validar que todo funcione correctamente.
Analizar resultados y generar recomendaciones accionables.
Convertir datos en decisiones.




Lo que valoramos

Más que años de experiencia, buscamos criterio.

Queremos personas que sepan hacer preguntas inteligentes, identificar oportunidades y tomar decisiones respaldadas por datos.

Porque para nosotros el marketing no se trata de lanzar anuncios.

Se trata de generar resultados.




📩 Si disfrutas combinar comunicación, estrategia y análisis, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

About the job

Introduction

Position: AI-Powered Lead Generation Specialist
Schedule: Part-Time, 20+ hours per week, with potential to grow into a full-time role
Location: Remote
Preferred Region: Latin America




Overview

If you're passionate about sales, automation, AI, and building meaningful connections, this is an opportunity to combine all four in a fast-growing environment.

Our client is a leadership, mental performance, and athlete development business dedicated to helping young athletes improve their confidence, mindset, leadership, and overall performance. Through a combination of coaching, mentorship, and proven systems, the organization empowers athletes to unlock their full potential both in sports and in life.

They are seeking a tech-savvy and results-driven AI-Powered Lead Generation Specialist to help build and manage their Instagram lead generation system. This role combines appointment setting, lead nurturing, CRM management, and AI automation. You'll play a key role in optimizing conversations, qualifying prospects, and helping drive business growth through scalable systems and meaningful engagement.

Set up, manage, and optimize ManyChat automation workflows for Instagram lead generation
Integrate Claude AI with ManyChat to create personalized and scalable DM conversations
Monitor and manage AI-driven conversations to ensure prospects receive accurate and timely responses

Follow up with prospects through Instagram DMs and additional communication channels

Identify opportunities to improve automation workflows, response rates, and conversion rates

Test and optimize AI prompts, automation sequences, and conversation flows

Experience working with Instagram outreach and direct message conversations
Experience using CRM systems and lead tracking tools
Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
Experience qualifying leads and booking appointments
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
Comfortable learning and implementing AI tools and automation platforms
Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a remote environment
Strong problem-solving abilities and technical aptitude
Reliable internet connection and professional home office setup




Nice-to-Have Requirements

Experience with ManyChat automation
Experience integrating Claude AI, ChatGPT, or other AI platforms into business workflows
Background in sales automation, chatbot management, or conversational marketing
Experience with HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar CRM platforms
Understanding of social media marketing and audience engagement strategies
Experience supporting high-ticket coaching, consulting, or service-based businesses
Athletic background or previous experience participating in competitive sports, with the ability to relate to and effectively communicate with athletes




Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to join a growing coaching business that is making a meaningful impact on young athletes both on and off the field. You'll work directly with leadership, contribute to the development of scalable lead generation systems, and have the chance to blend sales, relationship-building, AI, and automation into one dynamic role.

If you enjoy taking ownership, improving processes, experimenting with new technology, and helping drive growth through meaningful conversations, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact while growing alongside the business. As the company continues to expand, so will the opportunities to take on greater responsibility and advance your career.

About the job

Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

In this role we are looking to coordinate, execute, and monitor the company’s marketing strategies, working closely with the Brand Manager. Also, you will ensure the correct implementation of campaigns, execution of promotional events, materials, and the brand’s positioning across various channels.

Key Responsibilities: 


 Coordinate the execution of marketing campaigns (digital and traditional).
